TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_0: Welcome back, ! I've just had word from Erenville.
It seems he's managed to secure passage to Tural aboard a guildship vessel.
Why don't you wait in the main hall while I go and inform your travel companions? It should only take a moment.
Your next grand adventure begins, eh?
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Ojika gave us the good news. We've made ready to set sail at a moment's notice.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_KRILE_000_021: The only one yet to arrive is Erenville himself...
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_ERENVILLE_000_022: It took some persuasion, but the gleaners' guildship has granted us places aboard a vessel bound for Tural.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_ERENVILLE_000_023: There'll be other passengers─researchers and artisans and the like─so we'll need to share deck space.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_KRILE_000_024: That's fine, Erenville. I doubt anyone expected we'd have a ship all to ourselves.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_ERENVILLE_000_025: They're not casting off just yet, so if you have any lingering concerns, now is the time to voice them.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_WUKLAMAT_000_026: I wouldn't call it a concern, but everyone's still clear on what it is we'll be doing in Tural, yes?
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_ALPHINAUD_000_028: The nation of Tuliyollal is in the midst of deciding its next ruler.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_ALPHINAUD_000_029: As your chosen allies, we shall assist you during the rite of succession, and support your bid to become Dawnservant.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_ALISAIE_000_030: In addition to that, Alphinaud and I have another objective.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_ALISAIE_000_031: As part of its reconstruction, Garlemald seeks ways to reconcile and reengage with its neighbors.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_ALISAIE_000_032: By visiting Tural, we hope to learn more about how its myriad cultures interact with one another. How they find common ground, develop stronger ties─the sort of insights that might help our friends in Ilsabard.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_ALISAIE_000_033: But we'll pursue this goal in our own time. You can be assured that we'll give the contest all due attention.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_WUKLAMAT_000_034: That's all I ask. Otherwise, you're welcome to do as you like.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_WUKLAMAT_000_035: You wanted to find out about your grandfather, right, Krile?
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_KRILE_000_036: Yes. As far as we could determine from the old missive I found, he had been tasked with investigating the golden city by your father, the Dawnservant.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_KRILE_000_037: Yet oddly enough, we have no record of that investigation in our archives, and nothing to explain the earring which accompanied the letter.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_KRILE_000_038: Thus for reasons both official and personal, I should very much like to get to the bottom of this mystery.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_WUKLAMAT_000_039: I'm sure there'll be a chance to speak with Papa. You can get your answers right from the source!
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_KRILE_000_040: I look forward to meeting him.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_WUKLAMAT_000_041: In any case, you're not the only one with an interest in the city of gold.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_ERENVILLE_000_042: The golden city is a children's bedtime story. I am part of this expedition only because the Third Promise has commanded that I serve as guide.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_WUKLAMAT_000_043: Still playing the part of the stoic servant, I see.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_WUKLAMAT_000_044: What of you? Don't you dare tell me you've changed your mind!
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_A1_000_001: Hoist sail and let the wind take us as she pleases!
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_A1_000_002: We won't make you Dawnservant by standing here and talking about it.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_A1_000_003: I go wheresoever adventure is to be found...
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_WUKLAMAT_000_046: Well said! We won't get far wallowing in the shallows!
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_WUKLAMAT_000_048: Heh, that's what they tell me.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_ERENVILLE_000_049: Right, then. If all are still committed to the journey, then I say we make ready to depart.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_ERENVILLE_000_060: Eager as they are, the others have already left for the harbor.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_ERENVILLE_000_061: We're not in danger of missing the boarding call, but perhaps we should be on our way as well.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_KRILE_000_080: Have you spoken with our shipmates? Tural is still a good distance away, and it might be a pleasant way to pass the time.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_ALISAIE_000_090: I can feel my edge start to dull on these long sea voyages. How about some light sparring later?
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_ALPHINAUD_000_095: I'm told this vessel has been equipped with a barrier generator to protect it from storms.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_ALPHINAUD_000_100: A reassuring thought─though I nevertheless pray there will be no need for it...
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_GUILDSHIP04860_000_: I'd heard Erenville was looking for passage to Tuliyollal, so I managed to squeeze his party aboard one of our chartered vessels. As fortune would have it, we had just scheduled an expedition to Tural.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_FONJEANTAINE_000_11: Hm? Oh, this will be my first visit to Tural.
Fonjeantaine's the name. I was working at Eshtaime's Aesthetics in Ul'dah, you see, but my employment with them, uh...came to an end.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_FONJEANTAINE_100_11: That's why I visited Sharlayan, in the hopes of starting over. While I was attempting─and failing─to find a new job, I seized the chance to board this vessel when I overheard room for another passenger had suddenly opened up.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_FONJEANTAINE_000_11: I'm told the Dawnservant welcomes all regardless of origin, and so Tuliyollal seemed like the perfect place to begin anew.
<sigh> Hopefully things will be better this time...
I wonder what the city will be like...
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_SAILORSUNBURNED_000: Did you want to make a wager? We're taking bets on who'll be sat next in the Dawnservant's shiny chair.
There are four claimants in the rite of succession─your young Wuk Lamat being one of them, of course.
But from what a Mamool Ja bloke was telling us, the other three are all strong contenders. Not too many keen to risk their coin on the Third Promise.
Wait, I recognize you─you're the champion of Eorzea! If the Third Promise has you on her side, then that shifts the odds a fair bit! I might have to change my bet...
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_ADVENTURER04860_000: My story? Well, since you asked, I wanted to retrace the historic journey of the great Ketenramm. You know─the first Eorzean to set foot on Tural, almost eighty years ago.
The Mamool Ja's leader is said to have welcomed Ketenramm with open arms, and sent him home with a bounty of silverware as a token of their friendship.
But the real treasure was the crops he brought back─popotoes, tomatoes, and corn─which spread across Eorzea like wildfire. His grand adventure led to a culinary revolution!

The tales say Ketenramm returned to Tural several times after that, but his ship vanished during his last recorded voyage, and he was never heard from again. That even a seasoned explorer like him could meet such an end is testimony to the ocean's peril...
Some parts of Tural are said to be so remote that not even Ketenramm made it to them. If I could explore those places, then perhaps I'll become even more famous than him!
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_GIGIMOLU_000_141: I'm a merchant myself, based in Ul'dah. Specialty imports and exports, Eorzean and Turali both.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_GIGIMOLU_000_142: If this is your first “crossing the salt,” as they say, do remember that the social mores of Eorzea are not necessarily the same as those over yonder.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_GIGIMOLU_000_143: Consider this: it is not uncommon for the various races to be referred to instead by the names of certain clans. For the Miqo'te, the Hhetsarro; the Hrothgar, the Xbr'aal. Not because every member of a given clan is of the same race, mind, but because many individuals of said race are associated with that clan. A fair assumption, in certain cases─but take care not to give offense.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_GIGIMOLU_000_145: The goods I'm bringing over on this trip are a rare sight to the Turali, so I expect to make a decent profit. The local merchants are an agreeable folk.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_HOOBIGOMERCENARY048: I see you in Eorzea before. You great and famous hero.
...Gah, I've had enough of playing the simpleton. There was a time when we took great pains to maintain the deception, but with more of you Eorzeans coming to Tural, it's become impractical.
Besides, my mercenary days are over. Too many of our warband have fallen, and so we head home to lick our wounds...
I look forward to a long soak in the hot springs of Urqopacha. And no complaints when I dance the bathing dance.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_KRILE_000_160: Did you learn anything of interest?
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_KRILE_000_161: Oh! I hadn't heard that about the clan names. We should have Wuk Lamat and Erenville teach us the ones we should know.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_KRILE_000_162: Actually, it's getting a little chilly up here on deck. Let's all gather in the cabin.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_WUKLAMAT_000_180: Ahhh, it's so nice to feel that familiar breeze again... I wasn't sure my stomach would make it.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_KRILE_000_185: I wonder what kind of trouble those soldiers are expecting?
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_ALPHINAUD_000_190: According to Erenville, the Vanu I thought I saw belongs to a clan known as the Hanuhanu. It seems they share more than a physical resemblance.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_ALISAIE_000_195: What an amazing city─as lively as Ul'dah, and even more colorful...
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_ERENVILLE_000_200: Well, despite the storm's efforts to the contrary, here we are. Safe and sound.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_SYSTEM_000_210: You have arrived in Tuliyollal! You can return to the city at any time by speaking with the sprightly sailor in Scholar's Harbor in Old Sharlayan.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_KRILE_300_001: I wonder what kind of trouble those soldiers are expecting?
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_ALPHINAUD_200_001: According to Erenville, the Vanu I thought I saw belongs to a clan known as the Hanuhanu. It seems they share more than a physical resemblance.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_ALISAIE_100_001: What an amazing city─as lively as Ul'dah, and even more colorful...
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_ERENVILLE_000_001: I would ask if the journey tired you, but...I'm sure you've endured far worse.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_011: I...ugh. Still a bit queasy... No more boats for a while...
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_ERENVILLE_000_012: I realize we've just arrived, but we should get you familiar with the city before the rite of succession begins.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_ALPHINAUD_000_013: No arguments here. I should very much like to explore.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_ALISAIE_000_015: Are you sure you're in any condition to do so...?
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_XBALAALMALE04861_00: Ah hah! We were wondering who these strange folk were. So the Third Promise has found herself some new followers, then!
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_019: N-No, not at all! Couldn't be better! The Third Promise does not get seasick, no sir!
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_020: As for my handpicked entourage here, I've recruited them to help me win the rite of succession. I was about to show them around the city, in fact.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_XBALAALFEMALE04861_: But a group of foreigners is going to attract attention, especially if they're in the company of the Third Promise. Everyone will be curious. We certainly were!
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_XBALAALMALE04861_00: Your siblings have a tendency to, uh, command a respectful distance. But you─you're just so easy to approach!
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_024: And I enjoy it so much when you do. Please, don't ever worry that you're a bother to me.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_XBALAALMALE04861_00: You're very kind. Good day to you, Third Promise.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_ERENVILLE_000_027: Wuk Lamat is technically royalty here. Like it or not, a person of her station surrounded by this many outsiders is bound to draw a crowd.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_ERENVILLE_000_029: I suggest we move in two groups so as to attract less attention.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_031: , you and Krile can come with me.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_ALPHINAUD_000_033: We'll get in touch once we've had a good look around.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_ERENVILLE_000_034: That voyage was hard on all of us, so take it slow and recuperate. We have time enough for that.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_KRILE_000_036: Perhaps we should wait a bit. At least until Wuk Lamat's nausea subsides.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_037: No need for that! Look, I'm ready to go!
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_KRILE_000_040: Tuliyollal isn't going anywhere. Let's give Wuk Lamat a little more time.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_050: I'm fine now, really. Can't stand around all day feeling sorry for myself, what with the contest looming and all.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_051: Now, then. Seeing as we're already here, I might as well tell you about the harbor.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_052: Erenville already mentioned the reefs in our coastal waters, which explains why you don't see any big ships moored at the docks.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_053: Only vessels with shallow drafts can navigate the bay─mostly small fishing boats or barges ferrying cargo up and down the rivers from inland settlements.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_054: Much of the incoming traffic is from Yok Tural, the southern landmass. The clans there produce various goods for export.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_055: Their wares are unloaded here and carted off to the merchant stalls in the neighboring markets. Speaking of which, Bayside Bevy should be our next stop.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_SYSTEM_000_056: Wuk Lamat and Krile are now accompanying you. Keep them at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_SYSTEM_000_057: You can leave your quest companions behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with them and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_SYSTEM_000_058: If you wish to have your companions join you again, return and speak with them at the original location.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_SYSTEM_000_059: While you are accompanied, you may encounter “conversation points” along the way which offer additional topics of discussion.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_SYSTEM_000_060: Enter the glowing area and speak with your quest companions to initiate these bonus conversations. Enjoy exploring your surroundings together!
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_061: Tuliyollal is like my own garden─I could lead you around with my eyes closed. If this tour were a ship, it'd be plain sailing all the way!
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_062: Urgh... The word “ship” alone is enough to curdle my stomach...
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_KRILE_000_063: Wandering around this city is so exciting! Unfamiliar wonders everywhere we look!
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_SYSTEM_000_064: Are you sure you wish to part ways with your companions?
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_065: Did you miss a meal or something? We'll wait for you at the harbor, so hurry back!
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_KRILE_000_066: Something urgent to attend to? Not to worry, we can meet you at the harbor.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_067: Ah, there you are. Let's get back to it!
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_KRILE_000_068: Everything all right? Then on with the tour!
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_069: This is Bayside Bevy, Tuliyollal's largest marketplace.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_070: Being right on the harbor, everything from fresh fish to imported wares go directly to the shelves. Anything you want, they most likely have.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_071: Oh, right, I should mention that here in Tuliyollal we buy things with “pel,” a currency that the Pelupelu created.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_072: But don't worry! More and more trade is coming in from Eorzea, so most shops are happy to accept your gil.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_073: There's also Wachumeqimeqi, another market to the east of here, but that can wait for another time. I have other places I want to show you first.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_074: Next, we'll head back a bit, then northwards up the stairs to a certain plaza. Hehe, I can't wait to see the look on your faces!
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_SYSTEM_000_075: Your companions have yet to arrive. Be sure they are at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_076: As long as you remember it was invented by the “Pelupelu,” you'll never forget what our currency is called!
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_KRILE_000_077: 'Tis reassuring to know we can use our gil for shopping here!
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_080: What do you think of that, eh?
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_KRILE_000_081: Goodness me, you have aetherytes in Tuliyollal?
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_082: I think I told you before, but my brother, Koana, spent three years studying in Sharlayan.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_083: He fell in love with the nation and its ways, and brought back to us the knowledge of aetheryte construction. Papa warmed to the idea at once─had one built immediately.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_084: Did you do the “attuning” thing? If you're ready to continue, we'll head down again and then up the slope to the side. Right at the top is the gate which leads to Xak Tural.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_085: Let's make a stop at Brightploom Post on the way, though─that's the headquarters for the Landsguard.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_086: Make sure you attune to the aetheryte! I don't fully understand how it works, but I do know you'll regret it if you forget.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_KRILE_000_087: Thank goodness for aetherytes. Though I don't share Wuk Lamat's dislike of ships, I'm not especially eager to make that voyage again...
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_091: We have a lot of narrow, winding streets that crawl up the sides of the mountain. As you can see, though, the builders made sure the city's main thoroughfares were wide enough to accommodate wagons.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_KRILE_000_092: Trudging up and down all these slopes and stairs is exhausting. I understand now where Wuk Lamat gets her endless endurance.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_093: Here we are─Brightploom Post. The soldiers stationed here are responsible for defending Tuliyollal and preserving the peace.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_094: The Landsguard are led by our nation's strongest warrior, and so naturally Papa has commanded them since the beginning.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_095: ...At least until three years ago, when Zoraal Ja took over as commander. The title is no empty honor─it means the First Promise is considered equal to the Dawnservant in martial strength.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_096: Meanwhile, I haven't even managed to...
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_097: Well, I'll discuss my brothers and their accomplishments later. Alphinaud and Alisaie should be around to hear it, too.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_098: Come on, it's time I showed you the skygate. It's right at the northern end of Talonmarch!
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_099: If I'm to succeed Papa, then it's my brothers I need to surpass first...
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_KRILE_100_099: Zoraal Ja─that's clearly a Mamool Ja name. An interesting family.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_101: And on the other side is an equally massive bridge to match. Both were constructed by a race of giants─the Yok Huy.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_102: Strictly speaking, Tural is actually two separate continents: Yok Tural, the southern lands of the Mother; and Xak Tural, the northern lands of the Father, which lie beyond the bridge.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_103: Legends say it used to be one great landmass. But long, long ago, the two gods fought a titanic battle, and when one threw the other to the ground, the impact was so devastating as to split the continent in twain.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_KRILE_000_104: A familiar-sounding tale... I am put in mind of the conflict between Hydaelyn and Zodiark.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_KRILE_000_105: But getting back to Xak Tural. Those lands are also part of the Tuliyollal nation, correct?
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_106: That's right. Isn't my father incredible? He united the peoples of two continents into a single nation.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_107: The many clans of Tural had been at war for generations. It was only when Papa traveled the lands and put a stop to their myriad conflicts that we finally had peace.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_108: And that's the main reason I want to win the throne: so I can preserve the peace he built.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_109: ...But I see you're more interested in what's behind the gate than hearing about my aspirations.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_110: Crossing the bridge to Xak Tural requires a special travel pass. Unfortunately, they won't issue any new permits until the rite of succession is over. I promise to get you one when I'm Dawnservant, but until then...you'll just have to wait!
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_A3_000_002: Then I'll make sure you win─mark my words!
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_A3_000_003: I wish we could go there right now...
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_112: I've never broken my word! Once the throne is mine, that travel permit is yours!
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_113: You really mean that... Heh, woe to anyone who stands between you and adventure!
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_114: Be patient. I swear that once the throne is mine, that travel permit is yours.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_WUKLAMAT_000_120: Tired from all this walking? Take a moment to rest, and we'll continue the tour!
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_KRILE_000_130: We must have covered half the city by now...
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_KRILE_000_131: Tuliyollal is unlike any other place I've visited. I'm thoroughly enjoying myself!
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_KRILE_000_001: Creation stories are often rooted in true events. Given the similarities, could it be that Tural's legend was inspired by Hydaelyn's clash with Zodiark?
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_010: We'll head west next, towards the Arch of the Dawn. The dirigible landing is on the way.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_KRILE_000_011: You have dirigibles, too? Tuliyollal certainly doesn't want for methods of travel.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_012: We get by! Now, if you've seen enough of this area, let me know and we'll continue on.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_020: The Arch of the Dawn is on the other side of the city, so speak up if you see something that interests you as we walk!
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_SYSTEM_000_021: Wuk Lamat and Krile are now accompanying you. Keep them at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_SYSTEM_000_022: You can leave your quest companions behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with them and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_SYSTEM_000_023: If you wish to have your companions join you again, return and speak with them at the original location.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_031: I hope you aren't too tired. Tuliyollal still has plenty of sights to see!
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_KRILE_000_032: We should heed Erenville's suggestion and take it slow where we can. I imagine we'll need our full strength for the contest to come.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_SYSTEM_000_033: Are you sure you wish to part ways with your companions?
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_034: A private matter? We'll be waiting for you by the skygate, then!
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_KRILE_000_035: Understood. We'll meet you by the skygate.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_036: I wasn't sure you were coming back... Not that I was worried, mind you. Just a little restless, is all!
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_KRILE_000_037: Finished what you needed to do? Then let's resume our tour!
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_KRILE_000_038: I'm still struggling to conceive how one could construct an entire city on the side of a mountain.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_039: This was originally the site of a Yok Huy temple. The giants built it when they were first making the bridge to Xak Tural, to appease the god who slumbers in the great ocean trench.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_040: After the Yok Huy withdrew, the temple stood empty for centuries. So when Papa was establishing his new nation, he saw a structure he could refurbish into a palace, sitting practically in the center of Tural.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_041: He gathered artisans to do the work, and the houses they built for themselves became the foundation of the city you see today!
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_042: Speaking of houses, we'll be passing through the Resplendent Quarter, the biggest residential district in Tuliyollal. We climb these sets of stairs here─all the way up!
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_SYSTEM_000_043: Your companions have yet to arrive. Be sure they are at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_045: The stairs leading up to the peak can get pretty steep. Careful you don't fall─I've been one step away from death more than a few times!
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_KRILE_000_046: So this was once a place of worship... The Yok Huy seem a fascinating people, but I've not seen any in the city. I wonder when we'll have the chance to meet them.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_051: Papa's palace is called Vollok Shoonsa, which roughly translates to “invincible resilience.”
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_052: You probably want to take a closer look, but we'll be coming back here later. Let's move on for now.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_KRILE_000_053: The sheer scale of this place is incredible. I wonder what that carving at the top represents...
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_KRILE_000_054: So, this is the Resplendent Quarter. What manner of people live here?
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_055: Oh, we have residents from all the Yok Tural clans: Mamool Ja, Xbr'aal, Pelupelu, Moblin, Hanuhanu...
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_056: We also have Tonawawta, Hhetsarro, and Shetona who moved south from their ancestral lands in Xak Tural.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_057: In essence, it's a gathering of people from every corner of Tural.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_KRILE_000_058: A true representation of Tuliyollal's diverse character... The adornments on each building contribute to the eclectic cultural aesthetic. It's all so beautiful!
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_059: I'm glad you think so! Come, we continue down the stairs.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_060: You might hear the Hyur in Tural referred to as “Tonawawta,” one of our major clans. As for Erenville, he belongs to a Viera clan known as the “Shetona.”
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_KRILE_000_061: One need only look to the children playing for a sense of how peaceful things must be here.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_071: That big drum there is called the Dawnherald. They play it for formal occasions, like when honoring the Landsguard's return from a dangerous duty.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_072: I tried hitting it with my axe once and ripped the skin. Earned me a proper scolding, let me tell you! I think that was the time Papa held me upside down by the ankle...
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_KRILE_000_073: I've never seen such an enormous drum. What would one even use to beat such an instrument?
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_074: And here are our dirigibles! Not bad, eh?
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_075: I hear other nations use airships to sail the skies, but you'll only find balloons in Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_076: We have them for the exact same reason as the aetherytes. Koana brought back the plans from Sharlayan, and Papa thought them fantastic and commissioned their construction. This was around three years ago.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_077: Since that time, we've added flights to other settlements. Trade with frontier communities has never been easier.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_078: But that's enough about dirigibles. The Arch of the Dawn awaits!
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_079: Balloons are all well and good, but flying through the air is not for me. It's not that I'm afraid, of course, it just seems...unnatural.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_KRILE_100_079: Hearing about dirigibles reminds me of the Ixal and their flying vessels. But whereas their designs use several bladders, it seems the Turali craft rely on one large envelope to lift them into the air.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_080: This is it: the Arch of the Dawn.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_081: When the giants were still here, it was known as the Yok Tural landgate. But when Papa founded Tuliyollal, everyone began using its present name in honor of his great achievement.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_082: Through this gate is Kozama'uka, the wetlands south of the city. Depending on what the rite of succession asks of us, we might end up going in that direction.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_KRILE_000_083: Kozama'uka... The name alone is intriguing.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_KRILE_100_083: Speaking of which, what were those fluffy animals we passed earlier?
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_084: Ah... Those are alpacas. Fearsome, four-legged fiends.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_KRILE_000_085: Fearsome? They seemed quite placid to me...
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_100_086: You'll learn soon enough, Krile. You'll learn soon enough...
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_086: But forget the alpacas─I have something far more important to show you. Come along!
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_KRILE_000_090: Are these pillars what Wuk Lamat wanted to show us?
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_WUKLAMAT_000_100: If you wish to learn the history of Tuliyollal, then look no further!
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_001: Heh, this spot's captured Krile's attention.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_KRILE_000_005: What is special about these pillars, if I may ask?
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_100_005: At a glance, they might look like ordinary stone decorations.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_200_006: But if you take a really good look, you'll see they're something much more interesting!
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_KRILE_000_020: I suppose we ought to do as Wuk Lamat suggests.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_SYSTEM_100_010: The following event cannot be skipped. You may wish to cancel any pending Duty Finder registrations.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_KRILE_000_010: Pictures...? Wait, no, these are glyphs!
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_KRILE_000_011: They seem to tell a series of stories, many of them featuring a two-headed Mamool Ja. Oh! Then this must be...
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_012: That's right. It follows the exploits of my father, Gulool Ja Ja, and his journey to unite our lands. We call it the Tuliyollal Saga!
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_013: The deeds he performed and the bonds he forged, all immortalized in stone.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_014: There's no better way to learn how Tuliyollal came to be. Study them as long as you like!
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_020: The four stones closest to us cover the first half of Papa's travels. Let's start with those.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_021: If you're done with the first half, we can move on to the second!
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_Q10_000_000: View the second half of the pillars?
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_022: Not ready to move on yet? That's fine! I don't mind retelling the stories.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_SYSTEM_000_023: Speak with Wuk Lamat to view the second half of the pillars.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_024: And these four comprise the rest of the saga.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_030: This pillar tells the Lay of the Brotherhood. It depicts the scene where Papa granted an audience to the foreign explorer, Ket...something. I can never remember the name.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_032: Ah, that's the one. Ketenramm's arrival in Tural is what prompted Papa to embark on his own journey.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_033: It's said the two grew to be close friends─brothers in spirit, if not in blood. But no one knows what became of the explorer in later years.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_KRILE_000_034: Ketenramm's disappearance is a mystery in Eorzea as well. The records say he traveled between our lands and yours for a while, but then it's assumed he was lost at sea.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_035: This one recounts the Lay of Repast. As you can probably tell, the figure depicted here is of the Xbr'aal, like me.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_036: For decades, the Xbr'aal and the Mamool Ja were at war for control of the forest of Yak T'el.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_037: The actions Papa took to end that conflict have since been hailed as the first steps in the founding of Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_KRILE_000_038: There is a clan of Hrothgar in Bozja known as Helions. In their society, the women rule as queens, and the men serve as devoted subjects.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_KRILE_000_039: Yet here in Tural, Xbr'aal men and women appear to be of equal status. How dramatically culture can vary with location.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_040: Here we have the Lay of Reeds. This is the story of when Papa visited the Hanuhanu in their village in Kozama'uka.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_KRILE_000_041: Ah, the people Alphinaud almost mistook for Vanu Vanu, if not for the colorful plumage. He spent a fair bit of time among the Vanu in the Sea of Clouds, so it's no surprise he took an interest in your countrymen.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_042: I don't know how it is with your Vanu, but our Hanu are a bright and cheerful sort. They hold this one festival every year─very famous, and a lot of fun.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_043: Uh, let's see... This one is the Lay of Pots, which depicts the Moblins of Kozama'uka.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_044: They might wear odd masks and sound weirdly muffled when they talk, but the gold- and silverwork they sell is the best you'll find anywhere. Moblin goods are the standard when it comes to gift giving.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_KRILE_000_045: Clearly the Vanu aren't the only people with distant Turali counterparts...
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_046: The Lay of Gold. This pillar shows one of the Pelupelu, whose homeland is in Urqopacha.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_047: Having created our currency, the Pelu are rightfully known as the merchant clan. They oversee Tuliyollal's markets, and their traveling peddlers are a common sight no matter where you go in Tural.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_048: Don't let their size fool you! They might be mistaken as children, but beneath those beaked masks, they are clever and calculating traders.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_049: Ah, the Lay of Proof... That big fellow is of the Yok Huy, the largest of Tural's peoples.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_050: These giants once used their great size and strength to establish a dominion encompassing all of Yok Tural.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_051: Having brought the southern reaches to heel, they then turned northwards, setting their sights on Xak Tural. You'll recall that massive bridge they built beyond the skygate...
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_052: Some time after launching their northern campaign, however, they just...gave up. They abandoned the lands they'd conquered and withdrew into the mountains of Urqopacha. I've never even seen any of their kind so much as set foot in the city.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_KRILE_000_053: This was a people with the power and resourcefulness to raise a temple on a mountaintop and build a bridge across the sea with stone. What would move them to renounce their ambitions and their place in Turali history...?
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_054: Oh, this one is my favorite: the Lay of Ice. It depicts the battle with the legendary tural vidraal, Valigarmanda!
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_055: I should explain. A tural vidraal is a creature that has lived far beyond its usual lifespan and awakened to preternatural power.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_KRILE_000_056: Tataru described the Far Eastern auspices in a similar fashion. Could this be the same phenomenon?
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_057: Valigarmanda itself was dubbed the Skyruin, a name earned for the destruction and terror it visited upon Tural every time it stirred from its slumber.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_058: But eighty years or so ago, its ruinous reign was brought to an end! After a great struggle, Papa and his comrades managed to overcome the raging vidraal, and sealed it away in the Urqopacha mountains.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_059: Despite its reputation, however, Valigarmanda is also a symbol of power. That's why you'll see its likeness on Tuliyollal's national emblem, and adorning the banners at the palace.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_061: Papa says he left a blank pillar for the next chapter of Tuliyollal's history. Whatever that might be.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_062: Well, there you have it. I trust that gave you a better understanding of our nation. If you want to review anything, just let me know.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_A1_000_001: I think I have a decent grasp.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_065: You know, I feel awfully hungry all of a sudden... No surprises there seeing I couldn't keep anything down for a while. But now I think I'm ready to eat again!
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_066: So let's go and have ourselves a bite of a local delicacy! Come, I'll take you to the best restaurant in the city!
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_KRILE_000_067: I like the sound of that!
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_068: Of course! Take as much time as you need!
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_069: Had your fill of history, then?
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_KRILE_000_080: What a lovely establishment. I'm reminded of the Bismarck in Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_090: Have you ever had tacos? They're a Tuliyollal classic! You bake a crunchy shell made from corn flour, and fill it with meat and salad.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_091: A lot of shops and stalls sell them, but I like how they're made here at Xbalyav Ty'e best.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_092: And I need one right in front of me, right now! Let's head downstairs and place an order with old Br'uk Evu!
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_100: This is Br'uk Evu, the owner. Don't let his unassuming appearance fool you─when it comes to making tacos, he is the greatest artisan in all of Tural!
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_KRILE_000_105: Every dish looks delicious! At the risk of sounding like Wuk Lamat, the mere sight of so much fine cuisine is making me ravenous.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_110: Br'uk Evu's lovingly made tacos went to waste, and it's all that brutish Bakool Ja Ja's fault...
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_KRILE_000_120: I was looking forward to trying some authentic Tuliyollal cuisine, but we should hurry and join Alphinaud and the others at the palace.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_121: All right. It's a bit of a climb to the top, but you can head up from the Resplendent Quarter, or even the eastern side of Talonmarch, if you prefer.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_122: Now that you have an idea of how the city's laid out, I'll let you find your own way to Vollok Shoonsa.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_ERENVILLE_000_130: Do you have a better feel for the city now?
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_KRILE_000_135: There are so many narrow, winding streets. But even if you get lost, all you have to do is keep heading up, and you'll arrive at the palace eventually.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_ALPHINAUD_000_140: We saw a two-headed Mamool Ja on our way here. Another claimant in the rite of succession, according to Erenville.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_ALISAIE_000_145: The food is amazing. A passing Mamool Ja let us try a fruit called “cherimoya” and it was just sublime.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_150: You made it. Good. Then we're all here.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_WUKLAMAT_000_151: I'm still hungry enough to eat a whole roasted colibri, but the contest won't wait for us forever!
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_WUKLAMAT_000_001: Oh, I could ask Namikka to cook me something afterwards...
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_KRILE_000_002: There are so many narrow, winding streets. But even if you get lost, all you have to do is keep heading up, and you'll arrive at the palace eventually.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ALPHINAUD_000_003: We saw a two-headed Mamool Ja on our way here. Another claimant in the rite of succession, according to Erenville.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ALISAIE_000_004: The food is amazing. A passing Mamool Ja let us try a fruit called “cherimoya” and it was just sublime.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_SYSTEM_000_005: Upon speaking to Erenville, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_SYSTEM_000_006: It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ERENVILLE_000_008: I've acquainted the twins with the city as best I could in a short time.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ERENVILLE_000_009: Their unbridled enthusiasm made it rather difficult. Invariably something would catch their eye, spurring them to run down an alley to investigate. 'Twas like herding a pair of unruly coeurls.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_WUKLAMAT_000_010: Heh, I understand all too well. Sharlayan had the same effect on me.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_WUKLAMAT_000_011: Right, then. Now it's time we saw the inside of the palace. Papa will want to know I'm home, and to meet the allies I've chosen.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_WUKLAMAT_100_011: Given how impulsive he is, though, there's no telling what we might be in for...
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_KRILE_000_012: I know not what drives Zoraal Ja, but it engulfs him like an inferno...
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ERENVILLE_000_013: As you just witnessed, Wuk Lamat has no great army of supporters. Not yet, at least.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ALPHINAUD_000_014: So Koana, the Second Promise, is intent on developing his country by means of Sharlayan innovations. Given his background, I suppose it should come as no surprise.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ALISAIE_000_015: That two-head claimant, Bakool Ja Ja, treats everyone around him as lesser beings. No doubt he'd try to elevate the Mamool Ja above other races should he become Dawnservant─not unlike how the Garlean Empire afforded special status to pureblood Garleans.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_WUKLAMAT_000_016: Well, so much for the brief reunion I had in mind. Papa is not one to waste time when he decides to act.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_WUKLAMAT_000_017: I'm used to it by now, of course, but others are often caught off guard. In any case, we should talk about how we're going to find the city of gold.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_WUKLAMAT_000_018: All we have to work with are the seven tablets and their connection to the Tuliyollal Saga...
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ALPHINAUD_000_019: Might I suggest first comparing the tablets against the pillars? We could check for any discrepancies between them.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_WUKLAMAT_000_020: Good idea. Let's go and take a look!
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_WUKLAMAT_000_021: Hm. At a glance, they seem much the same...
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ERENVILLE_000_022: The preparation of intricately carved tablets for every claimant must have taken considerable effort and forethought. We should consider them weighty reminders that this “contest” is no light-hearted matter.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ALISAIE_000_023: I wasn't expecting events to progress that quickly, but I won't complain. The contest is the main reason we're here, after all.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_KRILE_000_024: I won't give up until we find the golden city. For Wuk Lamat as well as myself.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ALPHINAUD_000_026: Wuk Lamat─the tablets, if you would.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Everyone has a tablet? Then let's compare them to their respective pillars. Keep an eye out for even the smallest differences...
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_KRILE_000_031: Unless I'm missing something, the glyphs appear to be identical.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ERENVILLE_000_032: The only difference being that the tablets have hollows where the keystones are to be fitted.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ALISAIE_000_033: So now that we've established that the scenes are the same, where do we go from here?
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ALPHINAUD_000_034: The Dawnservant said we were to retrace the path he walked in uniting Tural's peoples, and that we would encounter seven electors along the way...
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_WUKLAMAT_000_035: Then we have the answer here in front of us: Papa's path is all laid out in the Tuliyollal Saga.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_KRILE_000_036: The events the glyphs portray─do we know the exact locations where they took place?
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ALPHINAUD_000_037: If one is close, we could go there and search for an elector. That would confirm we're on the right track.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_WUKLAMAT_000_038: Hm, let me think... The Lay of Reeds was in the nearby Hanuhanu settlement.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_WUKLAMAT_000_039: Papa took me there once. It was during festival season, and the whole village was alive with good cheer.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_WUKLAMAT_000_040: There's also the Lay of Gold. That one involved the Pelupelu village, which is about the same distance from here.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ERENVILLE_000_041: Before going anywhere, we should ask around about the road ahead.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ERENVILLE_000_042: I heard a lot of talk as we toured the city about that storm we passed through at sea. Apparently it ravaged Yok Tural several days ago.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ERENVILLE_000_043: Since our roads are not as well paved as Eorzea's, they're more susceptible to damage from natural disasters. If we want to avoid wasting time taking a dead-end trail, I suggest we spend a few moments making inquiries.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_WUKLAMAT_100_044: Just leave it to me! I'll bring the information to us!
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ERENVILLE_000_045: ...It would be prudent to ensure we're prepared for the journey. I'll guide you to the accommodations I've arranged.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_KRILE_000_050: Oh, such lovely little cottages, and they're on the water!
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ALPHINAUD_000_051: What a comfort to have our lodgings sorted in advance.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ALISAIE_000_052: Wuk Lamat said she would “bring the information” to us. I wonder what she meant by that...
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ERENVILLE_000_053: That's right, the reservation is under Wuk Lamat's name. If you don't mind, I'll leave my companions to you.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ERENVILLE_000_055: I'll go and track down the Third Promise. Once you've finished organizing your gear, you can meet us outside Xbalyav Ty'e.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_PESHEKWA_000_056: Greetings, visitors to Tuliyollal, and welcome to the For'ard Cabins!
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_PESHEKWA_000_057: Whenever you are ready, I will show you to your rooms.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_SYSTEM_000_060: Await your companions and embark on the rite of succession?
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ALISAIE_000_061: Trust you to be the keenest to head out, .
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ALISAIE_000_062: But where are Erenville and Wuk Lamat, I wonder...
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_WUKLAMAT_000_065: Seeing as we needed information, I thought who better to get it from than the locals? These two hail from the villages we're thinking to visit.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ERENVILLE_000_066: I give you credit for taking initiative, at least.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_HANUHANUCOLLABORATO: I am honored that the Third Promise would seek my advice.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_PELUPELUCOLLABORATO: I, too, am happy to answer your questions. Any encounter might be an opportunity to do business.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_WUKLAMAT_000_070: Thank you both for your help!
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ALPHINAUD_000_071: Ah, before we begin─there will doubtless be other occasions when we need to act independently, so I brought these for the two of you.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ALPHINAUD_000_073: 'Tis called a linkpearl─a gemstone harvested from a special shell. When linked together, they allow people to communicate across great distances.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_WUKLAMAT_000_074: Is that so!? What a handy thing to have!
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_WUKLAMAT_000_076: It'll be very useful on our travels. Speaking of which, I should get back to introducing my two new friends here!
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_KRILE_000_080: Who should we speak to first, do you think?
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ERENVILLE_000_081: Wuk Lamat may not be as experienced or accomplished as her brothers, but she has an affinity for the people. For her, finding those willing to cooperate is as simple as asking.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ALPHINAUD_000_082: Even up close, the Hanu are remarkably similar to the Vanu. Aside from those brilliant feathers, of course.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_ALISAIE_000_083: Is there a reason the Pelupelu all wear those masks...?
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_HANUHANUCOLLABORATO: Please, ask anything. I'll gladly tell you what I know.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_PELUPELUCOLLABORATO: What a stroke of luck to forge this connection to the palace. May it be the beginning of a profitable partnership...
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_WUKLAMAT_000_086: The Tuliyollal Saga features a number of Tural's clans. Two of those, the Hanuhanu and the Pelupelu, have settlements relatively close to the city, so I brought a representative of each.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_WUKLAMAT_000_087: As I mentioned before, the Hanu are a cheerful people who love their festivals. They make their appearance in the Lay of Reeds, and their home village─Ok'hanu─is located in Kozama'uka.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_WUKLAMAT_000_088: The other, smaller fellow is one of the Pelu, a clan of business-minded folk from Urqopacha. They appear in the Lay of Gold, and craft all kinds of marvelous goods in Wachunpelo, their village.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_WUKLAMAT_000_089: Now, as for deciding which village to visit first...
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_WUKLAMAT_000_090: Why don't you put that adventurer's instinct of yours to work for us, ? Pick our destination!
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_SYSTEM_000_091: Upon completing this quest, the main scenario will branch into two quest paths.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_SYSTEM_000_092: Accepting the quest from the helpful Hanu will temporarily prevent you from accepting the quest from the approachable Pelu, and vice versa.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_SYSTEM_000_093: The second quest path will become available from the respective NPC once you have completed the series of quests from the first path.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_SYSTEM_000_094: Furthermore, story elements and quest rewards will not be affected by your initial choice of path. Speak with the NPC you prefer, and embark on the trail for the rite of succession!
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_SYSTEM_100_050: The quest “To Urqopacha” will become available once you have completed this quest series beginning with the helpful Hanu.
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_HANUHANUCOLLABORATO: I've been quite content waiting here, dining on the Third Promise's coin, but it seems you're ready to ask your questions now.
So, what is it you'd like to know?
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_WUKLAMAT_000_052: The route to Ok'hanu─we go south through the Arch of the Dawn, then follow the road which runs alongside the Kozama'uka river, is that right?
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_HANUHANUCOLLABORATO: It is. Be warned, however: my brethren tell me the recent storm has rendered the path even muddier than usual. The footing is quite poor in some parts.
Far worse was the destruction visited upon our homes, though. Houses were torn apart, and several people injured if not killed. Even our beloved festival is in danger of being called off this year.
If you do still plan on going, I must urge you to proceed with caution.
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_WUKLAMAT_000_056: We'll be sure to watch our footing, thank you.
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_WUKLAMAT_000_057: Now I'm worried for the Hanu─it sounds like they were hit hard by that storm. Anyway, if we're bound for Kozama'uka, we should head over to the arch...
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_WUKLAMAT_000_058: We'll be back to talk to you in good time, master merchant. Meanwhile, you can eat and drink your fill at Xbalyav Ty'e─it's all been arranged!
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_KRILE_000_060: Through this gate and we'll be on our way south to Kozama'uka...
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_ERENVILLE_000_065: The Hanuhanu are a friendly folk who should welcome us with open arms. Assuming they are not too preoccupied with recent troubles, that is...
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_ALPHINAUD_000_070: I should have liked to observe the festival, but the Hanu are probably not in the mood to celebrate.
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_ALISAIE_000_075: I swear that gate gets bigger every time I see it. Considering the size of Gulool Ja Ja, though, I suppose it's better than having it be too small.
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_WUKLAMAT_000_080: Are we all ready to leave?
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_ALPHINAUD_000_100: “Wetlands” is an apt name. Much of the ground here is positively saturated.
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_ALISAIE_000_105: I'd love to stand at the bottom of those huge waterfalls and bask in the majesty of it all! Pity they're so far away.
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_KRILE_000_110: There is no stopping the Third Promise, is there? A good thing she has Erenville to keep her from getting lost...
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_ALISAIE_000_111: For all his grumbling, he's certainly there for her. Everyone should be so lucky to have such a loyal childhood friend.
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_ALISAIE_000_112: Right, let's get moving. If we continue along this road, we should find ourselves in the village before long.
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_KRILE_000_125: Assuming we have the right idea, one of the Dawnservant's electors should be here somewhere.
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_ALPHINAUD_000_130: So this is a Hanuhanu village! One can tell at a glance how very different their culture is to the Vanu's.
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_ALISAIE_000_135: The water from the falls must flood the wetlands and flow into all these streams and rivers...
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_ERENVILLE_000_140: Ah, everyone has arrived, and none the worse for wear. Except for a certain Third Promise who slipped in the mud despite my explicit warnings.
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_WUKLAMAT_000_141: Hey! I asked you not to say anything!
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_WUKLAMAT_000_142: A-Anyway! This is the Hanuhanu village I was telling you about: Ok'hanu!
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_KRILE_000_001: Assuming we have the right idea, one of the Dawnservant's electors should be here somewhere.
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_ALPHINAUD_000_005: One can tell at a glance how very different the Hanu culture is to the Vanu's.
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_ALISAIE_000_010: The water from the falls must flood the wetlands and flow into all these streams and rivers...
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_ERENVILLE_000_015: I agreed to serve as a guide, not a nursemaid.
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_WUKLAMAT_000_020: It's like our friend said. The people are in no mood for festivities...
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_KRILE_000_021: I can only assume they are still recovering from the damage wrought by the storm.
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_WUKLAMAT_000_022: Indeed... Well, let's do what we came to do and find this elector.
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_ERENVILLE_000_025: It's a Hanu greeting. Surely you heard it the last time you were here.
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_WUKLAMAT_000_026: Well, I was busy enjoying the festival...
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_ZANUHALI_000_027: Greetings to the Third Promise and her entourage! I, Zanuhali, welcome you to Ok'hanu.
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_ZANUHALI_000_028: As elder of my people, I shall also be fulfilling the duties of elector during the rite of succession.
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_WUKLAMAT_000_029: So our idea about the electors was correct. We just do as Papa said, and retrace his path from the saga!
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_WUKLAMAT_000_030: I'm ready! Give me the feat and test my worth!
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_ZANUHALI_000_031: All in good time, all in good time. In fact, I came to let you know that we are not quite ready to begin.
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_ZANUHALI_000_032: For the moment, please enjoy the hospitality of our village.
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_WUKLAMAT_000_033: Should we poke around a bit, then? We might pick up some clues about the feat. You know, prepare ourselves.
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_WUKLAMAT_000_035: What! You think I'm being too cautious!?
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_ALISAIE_000_036: No, no, I'm impressed, is all. You admire and respect your father, who is prone to decisive action, so I expected you to rush in first and ask questions later. Or never.
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_WUKLAMAT_000_037: I do look up to Papa, but you should know that he has a pragmatic side too. The Head of Reason is the thinker who takes time to consider all the possibilities.
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_WUKLAMAT_000_038: With the long naps he takes these days, though, the Head of Resolve is less restrained by his wisdom. I can't fault you for thinking that's all there is to him, but there's more to the Dawnservant you've seen thus far.
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_ALPHINAUD_000_039: I should like to speak with the Head of Reason one day.
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_WUKLAMAT_000_040: Ah, well...I'm sure you'll catch him awake soon enough.
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_ERENVILLE_000_041: To return to the subject at hand, you wish to take a look around Ok'hanu, then? Do some groundwork before the feat begins?
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_WUKLAMAT_000_042: Something like that. I mean, I could probably pass this test with my eyes closed, but it'll keep us busy while we're waiting!
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_ALPHINAUD_000_043: Wuk Lamat has the right of it. As Elder Zanuhali is a resident of this village, learning more about it can only improve our chances in the feat.
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_WUKLAMAT_000_044: Right, then. It helped to do some investigating at Wachunpelo, so let's take a look around here as well!
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_ALPHINAUD_000_045: Might I suggest a division of forces? For instance, Erenville, Alisaie, and Krile could concentrate on the southern half of the settlement.
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_ALPHINAUD_000_046: Meanwhile, Wuk Lamat, , and myself will handle this northern half.
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_WUKLAMAT_000_050: This is even worse than I expected...
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_HANUHANUNOTFEELING0: You heard about the storm? I've never seen the likes of it before.
With the supplies and help the Dawnservant sent, we're making progress repairing and rebuilding our homes...
But while rooves and walls can be patched, there is so much else that was lost for good...
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_SYSTEM_000_060: The gaping hole in the wall and missing portion of the roof are clearly the work of the storm's powerful winds. Repairs appear to be ongoing.
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_WUKLAMAT_000_075: A lot of houses are still damaged, and the Hanu I've spoken to are not their usual cheery selves. That storm broke more than wood and reeds.
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_WUKLAMAT_000_076: There must be something I can do to help them...
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_WUKLAMAT_000_077: I'm going to look around a bit more.
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_SYSTEM_000_085: The dry and shrunken bundles suggest the reeds were harvested some time ago.
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_SYSTEM_000_086: Woven from reeds, this boat-like vessel is reminiscent of a bird. The beak and feathered tail in particular stand out.
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_ALPHINAUD_000_090: This boat must be woven from the same reeds I've seen gathered into bundles here and there. The plants hold both practical and cultural significance to the Hanu, then...
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_KRILE_000_092: (-Krile-)I'm told they're ready to receive us now. Come to the large building in the south of the village!
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_ALPHINAUD_000_094: We ought to hurry over, too.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_KRILE_000_001: I understand not wanting to fall behind, but rushing ahead risks playing into our opponents' hands. Let's not do anything reckless and think matters through!
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ERENVILLE_000_005: This kind of feat is tailor-made for a rational, educated scholar like Koana.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ALPHINAUD_000_010: So the Hanuhanu also eat the reeds? Yet another way in which they differ from the Vanu...
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ALISAIE_000_015: Not that I intend to gratify him with a response, but Bakool Ja Ja's provocations are hard to ignore.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_025: I don't know the first thing about farming, but if there's a way to save the harvest and help the Hanu, then we're going to find it!
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_026: I'll make Bakool Ja Ja eat his words...
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ALPHINAUD_000_027: Understanding the nature of the problem will be the key to solving it. We need to examine the reeds themselves, and then deduce the cause of their poor condition.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ALPHINAUD_000_028: Erenville, will you take us to the fields where the reeds are grown?
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_KRILE_000_030: Look at these fields! Why, this could be a painting!
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ERENVILLE_000_035: I know she wants to do her best, but she should be careful not to make promises she cannot keep.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ALPHINAUD_000_040: I see. They irrigate the fields by diverting water from the neighboring river. 'Tis unlikely the reeds ever dry out...
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ALISAIE_000_045: And there I thought these feats would have us battling dire fiends or similar. Agriculture is a far thornier problem...
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_050: You can all stand back. I'll get to the bottom of this problem in no time!
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ERENVILLE_000_051: Give me strength... Let's all of us scour the fields and help our bold leader identify anything unusual.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Naught amiss with the paddies themselves as far as I can tell...
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ALISAIE_000_075: Oh, a water strider. A bit sluggish, though. More of a water shambler...
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_076: I'll find the cause of all this! Any moment now!
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_SYSTEM_000_080: As Zanuhali described, the reeds appear wilted and unhealthy.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_SYSTEM_000_081: The water contains no obvious contaminants, and looks fresh and clear at a cursory glance.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_SYSTEM_000_082: The soil in the paddies is as one would expect. Rich in color and suitably moist─not dry nor flaky.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_SYSTEM_000_083: A small frog catches your eye. Strangely lackadaisical, it doesn't even bother to hop when it eventually scurries away.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_090: Seen enough? I'll call everyone together, and we can share our discoveries!
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_091: Well, what do we think? Any obvious problems?
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_KRILE_000_092: I agree─the waters look to be of good quality, as does the mud in which the reeds have been planted.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ERENVILLE_000_093: The frogs and insects are unusually torpid. This suggests the problem is affecting not only the reeds, but also the creatures which live among them.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ALPHINAUD_000_094: Could something invisible to the naked eye be polluting the water?
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ERENVILLE_000_095: We would need an alchemist to know for certain...
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_096: I don't have much to add about the fields...but something else occurs to me.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_097: When you were describing how the creatures seemed lifeless...
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_098: I couldn't help but be reminded of all the listless villagers.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_099: They've suffered a terrible tragedy, I know...but there is another reason for their flagging spirits, I believe.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_101: The festival! This is traditionally an occasion for celebration and renewal, so without it, the Hanu are struggling even more to recover!
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_102: The last time I visited, the village was in the middle of the festivities. You'll never see the Hanuhanu more joyful and alive!
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_103: It's an indispensable part of their culture, and its absence will only compound their woes. So I say we help them put on their festival─give them a reason to cheer in these sad times! Who knows? Maybe fixing one problem could lead us to a solution for the other!
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ERENVILLE_000_106: I fail to see the relation between festivals and fields...
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_107: Is it so strange an idea...?
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ERENVILLE_000_108: I also fail to see the relation between festivals and fields...
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ALPHINAUD_000_109: Let's not be too hasty in dismissing the idea. Things which seem unrelated can later prove to be connected in surprising ways.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_KRILE_000_110: True. And being bereft of ideas as we are, any proposal is worth entertaining.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ALISAIE_000_112: Besides, this is Wuk Lamat's journey. It's only right that we follow her lead.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_114: By the way, does anyone know where the festival float is? It's like a boat woven from reeds that looks like a bird...
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_115: In that big building to the north? Let's go and see it!
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ERENVILLE_000_116: There's much less debate when I'm traveling alone...
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_KRILE_000_120: What a charming float. I wonder what bird was the inspiration for its design...
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ERENVILLE_000_125: I've never been here during festival season, so this is all new to me, too.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ALPHINAUD_000_130: The handles gave me pause before, but now I understand their purpose.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ALISAIE_000_135: Look at the size of that thing. I hope they don't expect me to help carry it...
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_140: Yes, this is the float I remember!
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_KRILE_000_141: Hm, does it not appear somewhat damaged to you...? We should take a closer look.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_SYSTEM_000_142: Inspect the festival float. You may move the camera, as well as zoom in and out. Target a section and examine it in more detail with .
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_146: Well, I think we can all agree this bird-boat is in dire need of repairs.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_147: Now, how do we go about fixing it...?
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_KRILE_000_149: We were admiring your festival float. 'Tis a shame it's in such a poor state. Due to the recent storm, I gather?
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_LINUHANU_000_150: (-Brusque Hanu-)Yes, we had to leave it exposed while we ushered our people to safety. With the float in this condition, there can be no Lifting of Wings. No Ihih'hana...
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_151: Ihih'hana! That's what the festival was called. I want to help you hold it!
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_LINUHANU_000_152: (-Brusque Hanu-)Have you not seen our village? Homes are ruined, we're struggling to make repairs, and you want us to hold a harvest festival!?
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_153: I know how it sounds! But giving into misery never improved anyone's situation. A celebration of life and growth may help give you the strength to work through this tragedy!
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_LINUHANU_000_154: (-Brusque Hanu-)The role of festival leader is mine this year, and there's nothing I would like more than to lift everyone's spirits...
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_LINUHANU_000_155: (-Brusque Hanu-)But we don't even have enough materials to repair the float. We need abokixa for the missing eye, uyuipo wood for the poles, and feathers from the Wind's Chosen to adorn the tail.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ERENVILLE_000_156: Two of these I know─abokixa is a type of precious stone used in arcane equipment, and uyuipo wood is essential for crafting ceremonial instruments. These chosen feathers, however...
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_LINUHANU_000_157: (-Brusque Hanu-)The Wind's Chosen is the victor of a competition in which the contestants see who can blow a feather the furthest using wind magicks. And that's something of a problem right now.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_LINUHANU_000_158: (-Brusque Hanu-)We Hanuhanu are gifted at employing such airy sorceries, but expend a great deal of mana when doing so. We are soon exhausted by the effort, and having no reeds to eat will only make it harder.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ERENVILLE_000_159: I think I understand. Your vibrant reeds grow quickly and vigorously─so much so that they stifle the development of nearby plants. They must be a potent source of the energies you naturally lack.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_LINUHANU_000_160: (-Brusque Hanu-)They are indeed. Owing to the poor harvest this year, we've been left enervated. And if we cannot gather the correct materials as dictated by custom, we cannot repair the festival float.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ALPHINAUD_000_161: ...Oddly enough, we may have just stumbled upon our solution.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ALPHINAUD_000_162: The Wind's Chosen would, by necessity, have a natural gift for manipulating magical energies. Which means any feathers taken from the victor should be high in aetherial conductivity.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ALPHINAUD_000_163: The float's construction also requires a stone used in arcane equipment, as well as timber favored for ceremonial tools. The demand for such specific materials must have an underlying reason...
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_A2_000_001: The float might also function as an arcane device.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_A2_000_002: I'd wager the float is actually a secret weapon for smiting the Hanu's foes!
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ALPHINAUD_000_165: Precisely what I was thinking. This boat of reeds is in fact an arcane focus of some kind.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ERENVILLE_000_166: So it does what? Unleash rays of searing light from its eyes or some such nonsense? Surely you jest...
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ALPHINAUD_000_167: While an intriguing supposition, I arrived at a slightly different conclusion. This boat of reeds is in fact an arcane focus of some kind.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ALPHINAUD_000_168: I imagine you've already reached the same conclusion, but I believe this boat of reeds is in fact an arcane focus of some kind.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_169: A focus? For what? ...Oh! Ihih'hana is a harvest festival, isn't it!?
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_170: That must mean the float was made to encourage healthy crops. So, if we repair the boat and hold the festival, its arcane powers might fix what's wrong with the reeds!
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ALPHINAUD_000_171: We won't know until we try, but 'tis a sound theory. Celebration, prayer, ritual ceremonies─these have all been known to elicit miraculous effects.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_LINUHANU_000_172: (-Brusque Hanu-)Wait, wait, wait. The float, a tool for magic? This is the first I'm hearing of it.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ALPHINAUD_000_173: In the beginning, it may well not have been. After a good harvest year, there would be no reason to change it. But when the harvest was poor, new adornments were likely added, and those who performed the labor may have imbued their work with ardent hopes for a brighter future.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ALPHINAUD_000_174: Through years of trial and error, the Hanu would have refined their festival float into a focus for harvest prayers.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_176: I know you're practically fainting from hunger, but reviving Ihih'hana really does sound like the solution to all your woes. And I promise, we'll do everything in our power to help you!
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_LINUHANU_000_177: (-Brusque Hanu-)I'm still not convinced about this focus business...but I accept your aid nonetheless. I will introduce you to the shipwright who's been maintaining the float these last few years.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_LINUHANU_000_178: (-Brusque Hanu-)He's replaced both the eyes and the poles before, so he should know where and how to procure what we need.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ALPHINAUD_000_179: Then allow Alisaie and I to acquire the feathers. We will encourage the people of Ok'hanu to gather and vie for the title of Wind's Chosen by sharing with them our own reserves of mana.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_ERENVILLE_000_180: I'll go with you. I carry some alchemical brews that may afford the same effect.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_181: The three of us will visit the shipwright, then!
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_LINUHANU_000_182: (-Brusque Hanu-)Not without me. I've worked hard to fix the float as best I can, and the responsibility is mine, after all.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_LINUHANU_100_182: I've...not introduced myself, have I? My name is Linuhanu.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_183: Nice to meet you, Linuhanu. And certainly─let's all go together!
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_WUKLAMAT_000_190: We're making progress now! The solution to Ok'hanu's woes is as good as found!
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_LINUHANU_000_195: To find myself working alongside the Third Promise herself is...unexpected, to say the least.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_KRILE_000_200: Thanks to Wuk Lamat, we've found ourselves a promising way forward.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_KRILE_000_201: Experience and knowledge are valuable assets, but there is something to be said for following one's instincts.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_WUKLAMAT_000_001: We're making progress now! The solution to Ok'hanu's woes is as good as found!
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_KRILE_000_005: I wonder what manner of shipwright repairs reed-woven boats...
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_LINUHANU_000_010: The shipwright's name is Wuk Evu. He's a Xbr'aal who only moved to Kozama'uka a few years ago, but has since mastered our customs to an almost frightening degree.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_LINUHANU_000_011: He's especially strict when it comes to manners, so make sure to offer him a proper Hanuhanu greeting. We wouldn't want to offend him right before asking a favor.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_WUKLAMAT_000_012: A proper Hanuhanu greeting...? Oh, that one!
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_WUKLAMAT_000_013: Don't worry, I remember how it goes!
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_LINUHANU_000_014: Then we shouldn't have any problems. Let's head to Ok'bek'be, to the east of here.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_WUKLAMAT_100_020: Look over there! Do you see that big, winding staircase!?
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_KRILE_100_021: Oh, it seems they have a place here where visitors can stay. Looks cozy.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_LINUHANU_200_022: This is Ok'bek'be, the Village of All. Those who drift into Kozama'uka from Tuliyollal and elsewhere are welcome to live here alongside the Hanu.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_LINUHANU_300_023: As for Wuk Evu, he lives and works in the House of Waters High, at the top of that large tree nearby. Follow me, but I should warn you: the climb up the stairs can be challenging.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_LINUHANU_000_025: I should mention that Wuk Evu isn't only a stickler for etiquette. He is also... Well, you'll find out soon enough.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_KRILE_000_030: We are hoping to enlist the man's aid, so it pays not to be rude in any case.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_KRILE_000_040: A rather eccentric fellow, but I feel his heart is in the right place!
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_LINUHANU_000_045: Cave Kikitola is southwest of Ok'hanu. We can return to the village first, then head there on foot.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_LINUHANU_000_050: I almost envy how effortlessly he can shift from one mood to its polar opposite. At least I presume he does so by choice...
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_KRILE_000_055: Southwest of here, was it? Let us be on our way.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_KRILE_000_060: Look, you can see the falls at the back of the cave! These hollows must have been carved out by the constant deluge of water from above...
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_LINUHANU_000_065: Cave Kikitola, as promised. Home to many deadly creatures. Venture inside if you feel confident, but I will conduct my own search out here.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_LINUHANU_000_066: You can spot raw abokixa by its green-hued glimmer. Bring anything matching that description to me.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_KRILE_000_067: I shall help scour the inside of the cave, then. You take the west half and I'll take the east!
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_LINUHANU_000_070: I am reluctant to send you into danger for the sake of the float, but if you are willing...
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_SYSTEM_000_075: Upon closer inspection, you find that the glimmer you spied was just light reflecting off the water...
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_SYSTEM_000_076: A shiny pebble catches your eye, but its coloring is grey rather than green.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_SYSTEM_000_077: You find a chunk of stone glowing a distinct shade of green. This seems like the exact kind of mineral Linuhanu was looking for.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_KRILE_000_080: Some of the cave's inhabitants took umbrage at my presence, but it was nothing a few swishes of my brush couldn't handle.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_LINUHANU_000_085: I picked over the ground near the entrance but found nothing. Did you have better luck inside the cave?
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_LINUHANU_000_086: Yes, this is abokixa. Along with Krile's contribution, we have more than enough for our needs.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_LINUHANU_000_087: The stones you've brought shine very brightly. I thank you both.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_LINUHANU_100_088: ...He would have been happy to know we were putting things right.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_LINUHANU_000_088: Truth be told, a good friend of mine was meant to be festival leader for this year's Ihih'hana.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_LINUHANU_000_089: But when that big storm hit, he...he did not survive. It fell to me to carry on in his stead.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_KRILE_000_090: That was why you agreed to Wuk Lamat's request, despite your initial reluctance.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_LINUHANU_000_091: Yes. It hurt to hear, but she was right. Though I must mourn, I cannot let my grief consume me.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_LINUHANU_000_092: Her words made me realize that the path to my recovery─our recovery─is already laid out before me. And I will walk it. For myself, and for my friend.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_KRILE_000_093: Thank you for sharing your story with us. Please, rest assured that we've taken your plight to heart.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_KRILE_000_094: I'm certain our companions are procuring the other materials as we speak.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_KRILE_000_095: Everything will come together, and the Hanu shall host a splendid, uplifting festival!
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_KRILE_000_097: With that, let us return and deliver the abokixa into Wuk Evu's waiting hands.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_WUKLAMAT_000_100: We just got back ourselves. Did you find the stone we needed?
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_KRILE_000_105: I hope Wuk Lamat's foray was as productive as ours.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_LINUHANU_000_110: We've come too far to stop now. The Lifting of Wings must go on!
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_WUKEVU_000_115: Thanks to the Third Promise and her mighty swings, we've collected some suitable logs of uyuipo. What of the abokixa?
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_WUKEVU_000_116: Yes, these are excellent samples. A goodly quantity, too.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_WUKEVU_000_117: At this stage, you've likely surmised that the Lifting of Wings encourages the crops to grow─but not exactly how, eh?
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_WUKEVU_000_118: Well, you're in for a treat. If all goes to plan, the results should be spectacular.
