TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_WUKEVU_000_119: Now, to get to work crafting these pieces for the float. I could use an assistant versed in the arcane arts to enhance the uyuipo's conductivity...
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_KRILE_100_121: Then I'd be delighted to help.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_KRILE_000_121: Everyone else should head back to Ok'hanu. We'll join you at the float once the work here is complete.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_KRILE_000_130: I'm excited to see how Ihih'hana turns out!
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_WUKEVU_000_135: The final touches are fairly routine and shouldn't take long. Go ahead and wait by the float.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_LINUHANU_000_140: As Wuk Evu said, the festival really is a spectacle to behold.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_WUKLAMAT_000_145: Gathering the uyuipo was a trial in and of itself.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_WUKLAMAT_000_146: At first, Wuk Evu criticized everything I did. Then he suddenly yelled “I've spoken ill of the Third Promise and must punish myself!” and proceeded to slam his head into an uyuipo tree...
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_WUKLAMAT_000_147: I told him not to worry about it─again─and it was like snuffing out a candle. He's an odd one, that's for sure!
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_WUKLAMAT_000_148: At least we've seen to the poles and the new eye. Now we just have to wait for the feathers from the twins!
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_LINUHANU_000_001: As Wuk Evu said, the festival really is a spectacle to behold.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_KRILE_000_002: I'm excited to see how Ihih'hana turns out!
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_WUKLAMAT_000_005: We should get some rest before the excitement begins...
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_HANUHANUMALE04869_0: Over there, by the float─isn't that the Third Promise? Then the rumors are true. She's trying to complete the Feat of Reeds by reviving Ihih'hana.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_HANUHANUFAMALE04869: The festival is a prayer for healthy crops, but does she honestly believe that will be enough to save our harvest?
The Second Promise, meanwhile, barely glanced at the fields before leaving Ok'hanu altogether. Maybe we asked too much of our young claimants...
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_HANUHANUMALE04869_0: Oh, I wouldn't be too quick to count Koana out. A friend of mine overheard him muttering by the reeds. Something about what “needs to be done.”
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_HANUHANUFAMALE04869: Is that so!? Perhaps we'll get to see another of his innovations firsthand.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_WUKLAMAT_000_011: Heh, that sounds like our Koana. One look at the reeds was all he needed to think up a solution...
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_LINUHANU_000_012: Be that as it may, our own solution is nearly ready.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_WUKLAMAT_000_013: Indeed! As soon as the others get back, our long-awaited festival can begin!
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_ALPHINAUD_000_014: It took some doing, but we managed to gather competitors to vie for the title of Wind's Chosen. The winner was only too happy to donate his feathers.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_ALISAIE_000_015: You should've seen it! He called forth an incredible gust that sent his feather sailing for malms!
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_ALISAIE_000_016: We had a turn ourselves, but it's more difficult than it looks. Poor Erenville's twirled in the air for a moment before landing on his foot...
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_ERENVILLE_000_017: I am a gleaner. Magic is not part of our training.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_KRILE_000_018: As for us, we've brought the wood and gemstone replacements crafted by Wuk Evu. All that's left is to attach them.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_WUKEVU_000_019: Has it been decided who will ride the float?
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_WUKLAMAT_000_020: Papa was the guest of honor the last time I was here. I remember being surprised they could even lift the thing with his hulking weight on top of it.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_LINUHANU_000_021: The rider must be a personage of great esteem, which is why an invitation is usually extended to the Dawnservant. This time, however, I have another in mind.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_LINUHANU_000_023: Our beloved Ihih'hana, the Lifting of Wings, is only being held because of you and your companions. Thus do I nominate you, Wuk Lamat, as our guest of honor.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_WUKLAMAT_000_025: ...This boat won't make me seasick, will it?
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_WUKLAMAT_000_027: Then weigh anchor! I can hardly refuse a request from one even more enthusiastic about the festival than me!
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_WUKLAMAT_000_028: I would be delighted to ride your float!
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_LINUHANU_000_030: I have roles for the rest of you as well. We'll be carrying the festival float in a slow procession towards Kozanuakiy, where the sacred likeness of Kixaihih is ensconced.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_LINUHANU_000_031: What I'd like you to do is clear the path of dangerous wildlife, so that the procession can move along unimpeded.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_WUKLAMAT_000_033: You expect me to sit still until Wuk Evu has finished with the float? Let me come along and help with the clearing!
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_ERENVILLE_000_034: As you know, I'm not much for fighting. I'll stay behind and assist Wuk Evu with the repairs.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_LINUHANU_000_035: If you aren't sure where you need to go, the path I spoke of begins at the south of the village and branches off to the east. That will lead you across the bridges to the Stride of the Sun.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_ALPHINAUD_000_036: Then we shall see to clearing it end to end.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_ERENVILLE_000_040: With my lack of combat skills, I would only get underfoot. Happy hunting.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_LINUHANU_000_045: The Ihih'hana procession often runs afoul of territorial creatures on the way to Kozanuakiy. I would greatly appreciate you removing those threats in advance.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_WUKEVU_000_050: I'll get to work. By the time you're done mashing monsters, the float will be good as new.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_ALPHINAUD_000_055: If the float functions as I think it does, I would not be surprised if it were attracting the creatures. The concentration of aether would be an irresistible lure.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_ALISAIE_000_060: Weapons at the ready! We'll make short work of this task!
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_KRILE_000_065: The degree to which Wuk Evu pursues his interests is remarkable. Apparently his studies of the Kozama'uka region were so invigorating that he decided to move here and immerse himself in the culture.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_WUKLAMAT_000_070: As Linuhanu said, Kozanuakiy should be down this way, then off to the east when the path branches. Then something about bridges and the Stride of the Sun...?
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_WUKLAMAT_000_071: Anyway, let's split up and get to work. Once you've culled all the threats you can find, we'll meet up in front of Kixaihih!
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_ALISAIE_000_085: Now this is my kind of busywork!
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_KRILE_000_090: I told you, you don't need to watch over me anymore.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_ALPHINAUD_000_095: At this rate, we'll soon have the route to Kozanuakiy secured.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_WUKLAMAT_000_120: Ah, you were a step ahead of us.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_ALPHINAUD_000_121: This must be the likeness of Kixaihih.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_WUKLAMAT_000_122: The Hanuhanu deity of the harvest.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_A1_000_001: Even their sacred images are woven with reeds.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_A1_000_002: I was half expecting a flying whale...
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_A1_000_003: It reminds me of something I saw in Akadaemia Anyder...
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_WUKLAMAT_000_124: Makes you appreciate how much their culture revolves around the reed harvest, doesn't it? It's said that Kixaihih was worshipped on another continent. This ancient faith was then brought to Tural by the first Hanuhanu.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_WUKLAMAT_000_125: A whale? Why a whale of all things...? Anyway, it's said that Kixaihih here was worshipped on another continent. This ancient faith was then brought to Tural by the first Hanuhanu.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_ALPHINAUD_000_127: 'Tis possible a vestigial memory of that time endured. A subconscious recollection from the inheriting soul providing the basis for an entirely new religion.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_WUKLAMAT_000_128: I...have no idea what that means.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_WUKLAMAT_000_129: As far as I know, Kixaihih was worshipped on another continent. This ancient faith was then brought to Tural by the first Hanuhanu.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_ALPHINAUD_000_130: The Hanu migrated here from another continent? Then mayhap the two do share a common ancestor...
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_ALISAIE_000_131: This is all very fascinating, but shouldn't we be getting back to Linuhanu? He'll want to know the path is safe for the procession.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_WUKLAMAT_000_132: Right, and I need to ride on the float! I'll run ahead and tell him we're done here!
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_WUKLAMAT_000_140: I'm glad we kept the float out of Bakool Ja Ja's clutches, but gods... He brushed me aside like I was a bothersome gnat.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_ERENVILLE_000_145: A tense encounter. I'm thankful Alphinaud thought to share those linkpearls.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_KRILE_000_150: I'm thankful we made it back before anyone was seriously injured.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_ALPHINAUD_000_155: Given the nature of the rite of succession, I expect such altercations are inevitable.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_ALISAIE_000_160: He waited for us to leave so he could steal the float. A coward and a thief!
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_WUKEVU_000_165: If I've learned one thing in my life, it's that poor manners often betray poor character.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_LINUHANU_000_170: Thank you for coming to our rescue.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_LINUHANU_000_171: I tried to protect the float, but against that two-head... I may as well have not been there at all.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_WUKLAMAT_000_172: Nonsense! You stood your ground and bought us the time we needed to make it back. You were incredibly brave!
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_WUKLAMAT_000_001: I'm glad we kept the float out of Bakool Ja Ja's clutches, but gods... He brushed me aside like I was a bothersome gnat.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_ERENVILLE_000_005: A tense encounter. I'm thankful Alphinaud thought to share those linkpearls.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_KRILE_000_010: I'm thankful we made it back before anyone was seriously injured.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_ALPHINAUD_000_015: Given the nature of the rite of succession, I expect such altercations are inevitable.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_ALISAIE_000_020: He waited for us to leave so he could steal the float. A coward and a thief!
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_LINUHANU_000_025: I was so afraid Wuk Lamat would come to harm... Ok'hanu has seen enough death.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_WUKEVU_000_030: With that exciting interlude over, you'll be pleased to know that my repairs are finished as well.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_WUKEVU_000_031: Before we commence the festival, however, it would be a courtesy to inform the villagers that Ihih'hana will be held after all.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_WUKEVU_000_032: Go forth, but do not forget your greetings! At this stage, I should hope the reminder is unnecessary.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_SYSTEM_000_034: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase containing the word “Ohokaliy” to greet the Ok'hanu villagers.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_WUKEVU_000_040: Don't tell me you've forgotten the greeting? Fine, watch closely...
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_HANUHANUNOTFEELING0: <sigh> There's nothing to look forward to anymore...
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_SYSTEM_000_051: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase containing the word “Ohokaliy” to greet the Ok'hanu villagers.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_HANUHANUNOTFEELING0: The festival is about to begin? What do you expect me to say...
...besides “Of course I'll be there!” Cleaning up the storm's aftermath may have been hard on us all, but the Lifting of Wings is tradition! And a joyous one at that!
I won't sit here brooding my days away! Give me a moment to get ready!
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_HANUHANUMELANCHOLY0: Ugh... Without Ihih'hana, life feels so empty...
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_SYSTEM_000_057: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase containing the word “Ohokaliy” to greet the Ok'hanu villagers.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_HANUHANUMELANCHOLY0: Thank you for letting me know. I would very much like to attend the festival, but the repairs should be finished as soon as possible. What to do, what to do...
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_HANUHANUSAD04870_00: <sniff> So much has been taken from us... Why even try?
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_SYSTEM_000_061: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase containing the word “Ohokaliy” to greet the Ok'hanu villagers.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_HANUHANUSAD04870_00: What? The float is fixed!? Our fallen friends would be glad to know that Ihih'hana will soon be underway. They would have wanted us to honor them with celebration, not let their loss deter us from it.
I must go and enjoy the festival for those who no longer can!
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_WUKEVU_000_070: The Hanu were pleased to hear their festival was going ahead, I imagine?
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_WUKEVU_000_071: That is well. Once your friends return, the Lifting of Wings can begin at last.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_KRILE_000_080: Even deprived of their usual sustenance, the Hanu seemed invigorated the moment the festival began. Ihih'hana truly is magical!
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_ERENVILLE_000_085: I wasn't sure what to expect...but the festival was admittedly impressive.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_ALPHINAUD_000_090: With their fields rejuvenated, the Hanuhanu, too, might finally replenish their flagging reserves of aether.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_ALISAIE_000_095: I'd like to take a turn riding the float. ...What? It looked like fun! Don't pretend the thought didn't cross your mind.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_WUKEVU_000_100: I told you, didn't I? Spectacular.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_LINUHANU_000_105: I was too quick to dismiss the idea that the float had arcane properties. I think I wanted to believe that no one knew more about Ihih'hana than me.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_LINUHANU_000_110: As it turns out, there are many things I have yet to learn...
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_WUKLAMAT_000_115: Should I have left the float behind like that? I was so excited to see the reeds...
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_LINUHANU_000_116: Nothing to worry yourself over. My brethren have been swept up by festival fever─last I saw, they were taking turns at the carrying poles on the way back to the village.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_LINUHANU_000_117: Please, feel free to look over the fields and enjoy the sight of what you've accomplished.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_KRILE_000_200: While Koana seems a decent sort, he strikes me as a man who likes to keep others at a distance.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_ERENVILLE_000_201: Two-headed troubles aside, Wuk Lamat completed the feat and earned a keystone. That's all that matters.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_ERENVILLE_100_201: That makes two out of seven keystones... So far, so good.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_ALPHINAUD_000_202: I'm curious as to who these Archons the Second Promise mentioned could possibly be...
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_ALISAIE_000_203: Where has Bakool Ja Ja gone, I wonder? And what did his follower mean by their “other” prospect...?
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_WUKLAMAT_000_210: My journey has just started and already I've met so many wonderful people.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_WUKLAMAT_000_211: Wuk Evu, for one. He's a bit eccentric, but everyone could stand to be as respectful of other cultures as he is.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_WUKLAMAT_000_212: And Linuhanu─it warmed my heart to see him honor his departed friend through Ihih'hana, and to help others do the same.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_WUKLAMAT_000_213: I can't help but feel excited thinking who else I might meet over the course of the contest. Come on, let's head back to Xbalyav Ty'e!
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_ALPHINAUD_000_120: The Hanu's festival must be as central to their traditions as the sundrop dance is to the Vanu.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_ALPHINAUD_000_121: I have not forgotten our obligations to Wuk Lamat, but it's moments like these─when we can immerse ourselves in the cultures of others─that fill me with anticipation for the new experiences this adventure will bring us.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_ALISAIE_000_125: I pray we don't cross paths with Bakool Ja Ja at the next feat...
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_ALISAIE_000_126: But even if we do, we've made a good start on these challenges. Hopefully we can keep it up.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_KRILE_000_130: I noticed Zoraal Ja was not at the Hanu village...
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_KRILE_000_131: Yet in a contest like this one, 'tis only a matter of time until the claimants are pitted against each other in direct competition.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_ERENVILLE_000_135: When Wuk Lamat declared her intention to save the festival, I feared where it would lead us. I'm glad to see my concerns were unfounded.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_ERENVILLE_000_136: ...Traveling with so large and diverse a group is...unfamiliar to me. If she could see me now...
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_WUKLAMAT_000_145: And just like that, we found an elector and won our first keystone. I knew I was right to trust your instincts!
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_WUKLAMAT_000_146: Come on! Let's keep things moving, and march onwards to Urqopacha!
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_ERENVILLE_000_147: Chances are good we'll find an elector there as well. Before we do anything, however, we should see what your opportunistic Pelu friend has to say.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_WUKLAMAT_000_149: The contest has barely begun and we already have two keystones! Surely even my talented brothers aren't doing this well!
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_SYSTEM_100_050: The quest “To Kozama'uka” will become available once you have completed this quest series beginning with the approachable Pelu.
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_PELUPELUCOLLABORATO: I've been waiting for what feels like days...and eaten enough of Br'uk Evu's tacos to feed an army!
What is it you'd like to know?
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_ERENVILLE_000_052: Our main concern was confirming the state of the road ahead.
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_ERENVILLE_000_053: As I recall, to reach Urqopacha, we depart from the Arch of the Dawn, then take the road west at the first fork. Should we be wary of anything along the way?
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_PELUPELUCOLLABORATO: That is indeed the way to Urqopacha. After the damage wrought by the recent downpour, however, you'll be doing more stumbling than walking.
But do take heart! When it comes to rugged terrain, we have a most dependable solution available. Come with me!
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_WUKLAMAT_000_056: We'll be back to talk to you in good time, friend Hanu. Meanwhile, you can eat and drink your fill at Xbalyav Ty'e─it's all been arranged!
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_WUKLAMAT_000_060: Ugh, why did it have to be alpacas...
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_ERENVILLE_000_065: The beasts are sure-footed, that's for certain.
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_KRILE_000_070: Oh my! Are these fluffy babies our mounts!?
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_ALPHINAUD_000_075: Talking to a Pelu before we departed was a wise decision. I for one would rather not brave a treacherous, slippery trail on foot.
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_ALISAIE_000_080: The Pelupelu all being small is confusing enough, but those masks make it almost impossible to tell men from women, let alone guess at their age.
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_PELUPELUCOLLABORATO: May I introduce to you our most dependable companion─the alpaca!
These animals can traverse Urqopacha's steep mountain trails as if they were gentle fields, and all while carrying heavy loads. Our merchants would be lost without them!
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_KRILE_000_087: So they fill much the same niche as our chocobos back home.
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_WUKLAMAT_000_088: You don't have alpacas in Eorzea?
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_ERENVILLE_000_089: Alpacas are native to Yok Tural. Eorzea has its chocobos, and the eastern lands have their horses. Why go to the trouble of breeding another pack beast in a place which ill suits its qualities and where it is not needed anyway?
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_WUKLAMAT_000_090: Hm... But must we ride these little monsters?
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_KRILE_000_091: I get the impression you aren't fond of alpacas.
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_WUKLAMAT_000_092: When I was small─and being a bit naughty─I went around pulling on their wool. One of them spat on me, and it was the foulest stench you can imagine...
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_ALISAIE_000_094: What are they like to ride?
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_ERENVILLE_000_095: Alpacas bred as mounts are inquisitive and docile. Even those without experience find them easy to handle.
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_PELUPELUCOLLABORATO: So...was my information useful to you?
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_WUKLAMAT_000_098: I... Yes, very helpful. Even if it wasn't what I wanted to hear...
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_PELUPELUCOLLABORATO: Good! I'll take my payment now!
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_WUKLAMAT_000_100: You want me to pay you!?
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_WUKLAMAT_000_101: ...I guess I should've expected as much from a Pelu merchant. Let me see what I have on me.
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_ERENVILLE_000_102: The Pelupelu value the act of spreading joy through trade, as you should know. They take pride in making deals that benefit both parties.
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_WUKLAMAT_000_103: Here you go! A fair price for your fair advice.
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_PELUPELUCOLLABORATO: Yes! I made a trade with the Third Promise herself! My friends will never believe this!
I shall be on my way now. I wish you safe travels!
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_WUKLAMAT_000_106: Off you go then, and thank you!
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_WUKLAMAT_000_107: I better not get spit on again...
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_ERENVILLE_000_108: You brought that on yourself. Remain calm and gentle, and so will they.
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_WUKLAMAT_000_109: I'm still not happy about this... But if we need to ride alpacas to reach Urqopacha, then that's what we'll do.
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_KRILE_000_130: The palace crowds were more supportive of her brothers, but Wuk Lamat's peaceful politics do have their quiet adherents, I see.
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_ALPHINAUD_000_135: I feel the change in altitude most keenly. While mayhap not to the same degree as the Sea of Clouds, the air is decidedly thin here.
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_ALISAIE_000_140: I could see more buildings down the path Bol Noq' was taking. I wonder what's over that way...
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_ERENVILLE_000_145: This is it: Wachunpelo, home of the Pelupelu. Wuk Lamat should have arrived before us...
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_PELUPELUAMIABLE0487: You've come all this way for the rite of succession? Oh! So this means I'm exchanging words with the future Dawnservant!
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_WUKLAMAT_000_148: P-Please, the outcome is far from decided...but it is a possibility!
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_PELUPELUAMIABLE0487: How fortunate, then, that I deal in cloaks woven from especially luxurious alpaca wool. Such a garment would look magnificent when draped over the shoulders of our budding ruler.
And a nation's ruler should dress her best for her adoring people, yes? Finery for our finest lady, that's right! Come, Third Promise, my well-stocked shelves are but a few steps away...
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_WUKLAMAT_000_151: “Finest lady”? Heh heh, I like the sound of that...
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_WUKLAMAT_000_152: Alright, I suppose a quick look wouldn't hurt...
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_ERENVILLE_000_153: Ahem. What did we just talk about?
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_PELUPELUAMIABLE0487: Ah, a Shetona from far-off Xak Tural? Northern winters are bitterly cold affairs, I'm told. I cannot imagine how you survived them without a lovely warm cloak of quality alpaca wool...
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_ERENVILLE_000_156: No, thank you. I'm not in need of new clothes at the moment, and neither is the Third Promise. Perhaps another time.
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_PELUPELUAMIABLE0487: Of course, of course! My shop door is always open!
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_ERENVILLE_000_158: You were saying something about not being “easily charmed”?
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_ERENVILLE_000_160: As I mentioned previously, the Pelu people live for bringing happiness through trade. They won't cheat you or sell you defective goods.
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_ERENVILLE_000_161: They will, however, disarm you with their deft turns of phrase, and unwitting customers like Wuk Lamat fall prey to this affable approach time and time again.
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_ERENVILLE_000_162: Your only recourse is a clear and firm refusal─they won't pursue the matter should you make your disinterest plain.
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_ALPHINAUD_000_163: A valuable insight into the minds of the Pelupelu. Let us all take Erenville's words of caution to heart.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_ERENVILLE_000_001: I swear... I let her out of my sight for one moment...
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_KRILE_000_005: Wuk Lamat is lucky to have Erenville. Everyone─royalty especially─needs a friend unafraid to chide them when the need arises.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_ALPHINAUD_000_010: 'Twould seem the Pelupelu are also partial to coffee.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_ALISAIE_000_015: All these houses and buildings made to Pelupelu size...and mine, too, come to think of it.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_020: Not my finest moment, I'll admit... But now that we're here, let's do what we came to do: find the elector!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_ALPHINAUD_000_021: Allow me to propose a strategy, then. Krile, Alisaie, and I will speak with the merchants. Wuk Lamat, you and Erenville might try approaching travelers and passersby.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_ALPHINAUD_000_022: , pray investigate any of the other establishments which catch your eye. Should we learn aught of use, let us relay it to the Third Promise.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_PELUPELUCRAFTSMAN04: Ah, I thought you were a new face in town. Here for the rite of succession, I take it? Me, I don't much care who sits the throne so long as they keep Tural peaceful.
People tend not to be in the mood to relax and sip our excellent mezcal once arrows and spears start flying, if you know what I mean!
Speaking of which, would you like a cup? A joy shared is a joy doubled, I say.
Oh right, yes, you were asking about that elector business.
Being but freshly returned from my trading route, I've heard that there's a contest afoot, but not much else. Our head ledger, Tobli, could probably tell you more about it...
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_MABLU_000_036: Hello there, I'm Mablu! Did you have a question for me?
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_MABLU_000_037: ...Sorry, I don't know about any “electors.” You should take a moment to see our prized alpacas before you leave, though!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_MABLU_000_038: Oh, but be sure to admire them from a respectable distance! Get too close, and our nervous darlings may be tempted to spit on you─and that stuff stinks!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_MABLU_000_039: It happened to a visiting buyer not so long ago. Tobli─that's the head rancher─was so mad at me for not giving a proper warning.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_MABLU_000_040: No one makes a mistake without Tobli noticing. He knows everything that happens on this ranch.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_PELUPELUIMPATIENT04: Electors? Oh yes, I've heard all about the rite of succession!
They're looking to put a new ruler on the throne, eh? Personally, I'm rooting for Zoraal Ja.

If the First Promise wins, he'll look to expand our sphere of influence. That means access to more resources and more customers─in the thousands column, potentially! So many new trading opportunities to spread happiness far and wide!
Others have been coming around to my way of thinking, so I've begun crafting goods inspired by the Resilient Son. Would you care to purchase something?
Very well. You said you wanted to know about the elector? I could help you...but I won't. I can tell you're no supporter of Zoraal Ja or his policies.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_PELUPELUCRAFTSMAN04: Speak to Tobli, our head ledger. He'll have the answers you seek.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_MABLU_000_055: Well, it's back to work for me! I'll catch a scolding if Tobli finds me standing idle!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_PELUPELUIMPATIENT04: The First Promise will come here too, won't he? I'll have to give him a nudge in the right direction.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_070: You really have to watch yourself around these silver-tongued peddlers. I almost bought a bottle of mezcal. And a stack of blankets. And then there was this enchanting ornament...
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_071: Anyway, I did manage to learn that Tobli is the man to talk to about the contest. Now if only they'd share where this “head ledger” of theirs is to be found.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_072: Really!? He's also the head rancher?
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_073: Well, the alpaca ranch is not far from here. I say we pay it a visit before the others return.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_SYSTEM_000_085: The beast regards you with wary eyes and a twitching jaw. Backing away slowly may be the wisest course of action...
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_TOBLI_000_090: Keep a respectful distance from the alpacas, if you please. For your sake and for theirs.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_PELUPELUPOWERFUL048: Our guests have arrived, I see!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_PELUPELUCOOL04872_0: So, the rite of succession has begun...
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_105: <shiver> That is a lot of alpacas. Still, we know the head ledger could be here somewhere...
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_106: I can't let fear deter me. N-Not to say that I'm scared, of course!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_107: Excuse me, is one of these workers Tobli?
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_MABLU_000_108: Tobli? Oh yes, he likes to mingle with the ranch hands and keep an eye on things. I can't tell you which one he is, though.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_109: You...can't? Is this part of the contest?
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_MABLU_000_110: All I can say is that Tobli often mentions his favorite pungent subject.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_MABLU_000_111: He also can't resist a profitable trade─though who among us could, am I right? Still, if you bring him a very good deal, he might let his identity slip.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_112: Heh, so it's like a game.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_113: Easy enough. All I have to do is offer Tobli a deal he can't ignore! No problem at all!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_114: ...Well, maybe one problem. I don't think my purse is deep enough to pay everyone we think might be Tobli. Let's ask some questions first to narrow down the field.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_115: Great! We can meet back here to share our impressions!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_MABLU_000_120: Hm...? Well, obviously I'm not Tobli! I-I mean...oops. I shouldn't have said that.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_MABLU_000_121: You're meant to find out for yourself who Tobli is, or if an elector is even in the village at all. Good luck!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_TOBLI_000_122: Ah, a visitor from across the salt, if I'm not mistaken.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_TOBLI_000_123: Be warned: the alpacas will spit if you startle them. I suggest you keep your movements slow and deliberate.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_PELUPELUPOWERFUL048: You think I might be Tobli? Hahaha, well maybe I am!
All I will say is that, in this village, none have reared more alpacas than I!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_PELUPELUCOOL04872_0: Yes...yes, that's me. Excellent work from the Third Promise and her entourage. Sharp instincts. Shall we commence the rite of succession, then...?
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_130: I'll sniff out the head ledger in a heartbeat! You'll see!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_MABLU_000_135: Remember: I never actually said there was an elector in Wachunpelo!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_TOBLI_000_140: Hurry along. I've coats to brush and smelly spit to mop up.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_PELUPELUPOWERFUL048: The Third Promise must demonstrate her worth!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_PELUPELUCOOL04872_0: Well...? Are you not ready to begin the contest...?
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_160: I see we're both done with our interrogations.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_161: So, who do you think it is? I have my suspicions, but let's hear your pick.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_Q2_000_000: Who do you think Tobli is?
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_163: Ah, the worker so intent on stable chores. I had my eye on that one, too! Time to rip the mask off our mystery ranch hand...so to speak.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_164: We know it's you, Tobli! And to prove it, I propose a deal: a generous sum of coin for confirmation of your true identity!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_TOBLI_000_166: (-Tobli-)As you have correctly guessed, I am indeed Tobli. Head ledger of Wachunpelo, and head rancher of the Family Ranch.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_TOBLI_000_167: (-Tobli-)I am also one of Gulool Ja Ja's chosen electors.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_168: Aha! In a place featured in the Tuliyollal Saga, just as we thought!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_169: I was right to trust in your instincts. And I wager this won't be the last time!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_170: ...Though it took more coin than I would've liked to know for certain.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_MABLU_100_172: She found you out fair and square, Tobli!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_TOBLI_100_173: (-Tobli-)And I'm glad she did─would've been a pity had her bid ended here.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_173: That loud, boastful fellow? I suppose he could be Tobli. Only one way to find out!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_174: Nothing would make me happier than knowing your identity. So how about we make a deal and you tell me the truth. I have money!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_PELUPELUPOWERFUL048: Hahaha, then I agree to your trade.
Done and done! As for my part of the bargain...
I am not Tobli. Not the head ledger, and not the head rancher; just a humble ranch hand!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_179: Dammit, , I trusted you! That coin could've bought me three hundred gourmet tacos!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_180: ...No, I can't let this taco tragedy distract me from what matters most. We need to determine which one is Tobli!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_181: Hm, he seemed...unconvincing to me. But if that's your choice, then that's who we'll talk to!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_182: Tobli! I offer you a deal: the truth of who you are in exchange for a tidy sum. What do you say?
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_PELUPELUCOOL04872_0: I say hand over the coin...
The truth is... I'm not even a ranch hand. I just like to come by and watch the alpacas.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_185: What!? You don't even work here!?
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_186: I knew I should've gone with my gut on this one!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_187: ...But now's not the time to mourn wasted coin. We need to regroup and rethink this!
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_TOBLI_000_190: I've done my duty and assigned the claimants their feat. The rest is up to them.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_MABLU_000_195: I was impressed with how easily Zoraal Ja found Tobli, but...also sort of frightened.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_ERENVILLE_000_200: I did say remaining calm was key, but the same rules don't apply to wild alpacas.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_KRILE_000_205: So this is our sought-after elector.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_ALPHINAUD_000_210: Judging by the volume of Wuk Lamat's scream, alpaca expectoration must have a nasty odor, indeed. I'm content to remain ignorant of the smell.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_ALISAIE_000_215: Zoraal Ja puts me in mind of Garlemald's own exalted son. Of the two, though, Zenos was undeniably more arrogant.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_220: <pant> <pant> I had to go and wash that nasty stuff off my face. I think I got all of it...
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_WUKLAMAT_000_221: But would you mind taking a sniff for me, just to make sure? The stench has ruined my sense of smell.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_TOBLI_000_001: I've done my duty and assigned the claimants their feat. The rest is up to them.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_005: I was impressed with how easily Zoraal Ja found Tobli, but...also sort of frightened.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_010: So, uh...can you still smell it? Be honest.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_KRILE_000_015: So this is our sought-after elector.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Judging by the volume of Wuk Lamat's scream, alpaca expectoration must have a nasty odor, indeed. I'm content to remain ignorant of the smell.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_ALISAIE_000_025: Zoraal Ja puts me in mind of Garlemald's own exalted son. Of the two, though, Zenos was undeniably more arrogant.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_SYSTEM_000_030: The beast regards you with wary eyes and a twitching jaw. Backing away slowly may be the wisest course of action...
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_ERENVILLE_000_035: As Wuk Lamat helped demonstrate, the valley alpacas are wary of people. Getting close enough to catch one will not be an easy task.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_036: You might have warned me about that earlier! I have enough trouble with tame alpacas─how do you expect me to wrangle a wild one!?
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_TOBLI_000_037: With the proper saddle. We infuse the leather with a relaxing scent that soothes the spitting beast.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_038: Wonderful! Give me one of those, then!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_TOBLI_000_039: Have you perhaps forgotten we are a clan of merchants? If you want a taming saddle, then you'll need to find a saddler and make them an offer.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_TOBLI_000_040: They don't come cheap, of course. Crafting a saddle will cost you the equivalent of ten pel...in the thousands column.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_041: You mean ten thousand pel!? I don't have that kind of coin!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_ALPHINAUD_100_041: Converting to gil, that comes to around a million or so. Mayhap if we all pitch in...
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_200_041: No, no, this is my feat to accomplish─I wouldn't feel right about having others pay the cost. I'll find the money. Somehow.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_TOBLI_000_043: That basket of wool is worth the sum you paid me earlier: one pel, in the hundreds column.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_TOBLI_000_044: Beginning with the wool, you can trade for ever more valuable goods until you have something suitable to bargain with for the saddle.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_045: That's a nice gesture... But you think I can turn a hundred pel into a million? That's ten thousand times more!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_ERENVILLE_000_046: We need ten thousand pel, not a million. So we're looking at a hundred times more.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_100_046: Oh. Right. I panicked and got it confused with Alphinaud's million gil.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_ERENVILLE_000_047: I'm not so sure about this trading idea... You were almost talked into buying a cloak you didn't need mere moments after you arrived.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_048: But, I just... Gah, I hate it when you're right!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_049: Then let me help you with your dealmaking!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_051: Mablu! I work here as a ranch hand, but I've also learned a lot about the peddler profession!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_052: It's alright if I aid them now, yes? I guided the claimants towards the first step of the feat, like you asked.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_TOBLI_000_053: As long as Wuk Lamat goes alone to capture her alpaca, she is free to accept assistance from whomever she likes.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_054: Hooray! Let's see about getting you that saddle, then, Third Promise.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_055: I don't know why you made your offer, but I could use an ally with a beak for bargains. Welcome aboard, Mablu!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_ALPHINAUD_000_056: Should the rest of us stay behind, perhaps? It may be easier to haggle over prices without so many voices chiming in.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_TOBLI_000_057: Yes, stay here and pitch in with the ranch work. With Mablu gone, I'll need extra hands to tend to the alpacas.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_KRILE_000_058: Gladly! Although, , I think you should go with Wuk Lamat.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_KRILE_000_059: You've seen markets and bazaars the world over, and surely have sage advice to share.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_ERENVILLE_000_060: In that case, you should also hold on to the alpaca wool. If it's misplaced or soiled in some way, you'll have nothing to bargain with.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_061: As if I'd do such a thing! ...But I'll leave the wool with  anyway. The better to keep my hands free.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_062: To begin, I suggest we try trading the wool to Havli, the saddler. He won't agree to the deal, of course, but it'll give us an idea of how much he'll accept for his wares!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_TOBLI_000_070: Mablu hasn't given up, I see...
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_KRILE_000_075: I have every confidence you'll come back with the saddle!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_ERENVILLE_000_080: Tending the alpacas, are we? I had some experience with that when I was younger...
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_ALPHINAUD_000_085: Turning a hundred pel worth of wool into a ten thousand pel saddle is exactly the kind of suggestion I'd expect from the head of a merchant clan.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_ALISAIE_000_090: I'd worry if it was just Wuk Lamat, but it sounds like Mablu knows a thing or two about trading.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_SYSTEM_000_095: The beast regards you with wary eyes and a twitching jaw. Backing away slowly may be the wisest course of action...
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_100: Is it really possible to make a hundred times what that wool is worth just through trading?
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_105: This is the artisan who makes our taming saddles!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_HAVLI_000_110: Something I can do for you?
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_111: We've come to bargain! I need one of your special taming saddles to catch a wild alpaca.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_HAVLI_000_112: A saddle, is it? And how will you be paying for it?
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_113: With this basket of fine alpaca wool!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_HAVLI_000_114: What use does a saddlemaker have for wool? Besides, this would barely cover the cost of a single strap buckle. Offer me something I actually want.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_HAVLI_000_116: Mezcal. I like to nurse a cup at day's end while I inspect my finished work. Bring me a jug of quality stuff, and you've got yourself a deal.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_117: This bodes well for us, Third Promise. Such mezcal can be had for only five pel in the thousands column!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_HAVLI_000_118: Hold on, hold on, did you say “Third Promise”? Then my offer has changed─the saddle is going to cost you a jug of premium mezcal, aged three years at least.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_119: Three years!? That stuff is valued at ten thousand pel or more! Why have you doubled the price!?
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_HAVLI_000_120: Because I must support the man of ambition who'll see my business prosper. Zoraal Ja will go to war, and his cavalry will need saddles. Lots of saddles.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_HAVLI_000_121: It's nothing personal, Third Promise. But I won't sell you my craft for anything less than my asking price.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_122: Can't say that I blame him. I'm known for championing peace, and peace is unlikely to bring him more customers.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_123: Those of our grandparents' generation remember the dark days when the clans were at war. Many of these Pelu pray for your victory, Wuk Lamat.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_124: The younger ones, though...to them, strife and bloodshed are as children's stories. They think themselves safe from these horrors and take the peace we now enjoy for granted.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_125: Still others are unsatisfied with this quiet prosperity and crave the future the Second Promise envisions. They've become obsessed with innovations like the dirigibles that have made trade swift and easy.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_126: Then you have those like Havli, convinced that the First Promise's plans for conquest will afford them opportunities for great profit.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_127: But what about you, Mablu? Aren't you of the younger generation? At least a year or two younger than me, I'd say.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_128: Oh, I was raised on the old tales. I've memorized the accounts of what it was like when the Yok Huy ruled our village.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_129: That's why I offered to help. I want you to become Dawnservant, to keep our nation from going back to the way it was.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_130: Well, then, I guess I'd better make sure I win the contest!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_131: But the type of mezcal the saddlemaker wants is so very expensive...
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_132: Weren't we expecting to need ten thousand pel from the outset? Nothing's changed, we just need to get on with it!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_133: I may not have a head for trade or the stomach for alpacas, but I won't give up with the peace of Tuliyollal on the line!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_134: Then neither will I! We will make you Dawnservant!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_135: Aiming for that ten thousand pel jug right away will only bring us failure and frustration. So let's first try exchanging the wool for anything even a touch more valuable.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_136: The trick is to find someone who needs alpaca wool and is willing to trade at a loss to acquire it. Someone who supports your bid for the throne, for instance.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_137: Of course, the weaver! Bol Noq' was his name, I believe!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_138: He went out of his way to say he agreed with my vision and he was here to buy wool.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_139: I think I remember the direction he was going, but for now, let's head back to that road where we first met him.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_150: Is this where you met the weaver?
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_155: This is the spot. After Bol Noq' talked to us, he walked off to the south...
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_156: Then he was probably going to Icuvlo's Inn. Most visitors to Wachunpelo end up staying there.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_157: Let's go and check, shall we?
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_160: I hope he's willing to offer us something wonderful in exchange!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_BOLNOQ_000_165: Ah, we meet again... But wait. Weren't you all on your way to Wachunpelo?
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_171: Thanks! Now let's see if we can turn a profit!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_172: Bol Noq', I'm glad we found you. Are you interested in making a trade?
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_BOLNOQ_000_173: Third Promise, you...you wish to do business with me? Might I ask what this is all about?
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_BOLNOQ_000_174: I see. So the goal is to turn that basket of wool into a jug of three-year-old premium mezcal...?
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_BOLNOQ_000_175: Then allow me to invest in your efforts!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_BOLNOQ_000_176: Peace in Tural is what allows me to cross freely into the lands of my suppliers. Naturally, I would prefer that one pledged to preserve that peace win the throne.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_BOLNOQ_000_177: Thus do I humbly offer you this wool poncho─a small token that I pray contributes to your victory!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_178: Oh, that's fine craftsmanship! A garment like that would easily fetch five pel...in the hundreds column!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_179: That's very generous, Bol Noq', thank you! I promise I won't let you down!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_BOLNOQ_000_180: I have every faith in you, Third Promise. May fortune bless your future dealings.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_181: I can't believe you quintupled your investment with your first deal! We're off to a spectacular start!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_182: Only because  remembered our weaver friend. All I did was hand over the wool.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_183: That's not true! The connections you build with people are vital. This is one of the most fundamental precepts of trading─one which you've instinctively mastered!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_185: I know so! Now, let's take our five hundred pel poncho and trade it for something even more valuable!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_186: Here, , you take the poncho. If I lost it somehow, Erenville would never let me hear the end of it...
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_187: All set? Our next deal is waiting to be found!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_SYSTEM_000_188: Success! You traded a one hundred pel basket of alpaca wool for a five hundred pel wool poncho!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_190: We turned a hundred pel into five hundred. I know it's only five times more, but it feels like five hundred times more!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_195: Leveraging connections is a sound strategy, but we should also consider supply and demand. An individual in urgent need of a good poncho will offer more than a merchant simply looking to stock his shelves.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_196: That makes sense. But how do we know if someone needs a poncho?
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_A1_000_002: They have a fabulous sense of style!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_198: That's the obvious answer, isn't it? We look for a person without a poncho, and hope they're eager to buy ours!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_199: It's a nice, sturdy poncho, but the design is traditional. I don't think fashion is part of its appeal.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_200: So only those people with a practical need would be interested...
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_201: Wait, that's the obvious answer, isn't it? We look for a person without a poncho, and hope they're eager to buy ours!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_202: Yes, there you go! We find the demand for our supply!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_203: So, where should we begin our search for prospective buyers?
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_204: There are any number of places, but we could do worse than starting right here at the inn. There might be interested travelers.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_205: Hm, who here needs a poncho...? A lot of Mamool Ja hardly wear anything to begin with.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_206: Those are probably Landsguard or sellswords. Mamool Ja who soldier for a living prefer not to wear much above the waist─it hampers their movements.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_207: So even if they have bared shoulders, Mamool Ja carrying arms can be struck off the list.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_208: That's a Landsguard. Probably dropped by the inn to take a break between patrols.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_209: This one's already fully dressed─an artisan or peddler, perhaps? Come to rest after visiting Wachunpelo, like Bol Noq', would be my guess.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_210: That Mamool Ja is armed. Could be a Doppro courier? I've seen them flying their wivres, and those types aren't fond of excessive clothing either.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_211: Let's see. No coat or cloak...but also no weapon? Oh, we might have a winner!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_100_211: Tell me─who among these gathered travelers do you think might be amenable to a proposal?
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_200_211: So professional fighters like those of the Landsguard would have little interest. Though the same could be said of any Turali who prioritizes ease of movement in their work...
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_212: Ho there, friend. You're not a mercenary by trade, right? I was curious about your bold choice of dress...or lack thereof.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_HOOBIGOANXIETY04873: Oh, it was no choice of mine, believe me! I was attacked by beasts on the way here, and barely escaped with my scales intact. My coat was not so lucky.

I'm actually a toolmaker from Tuliyollal, and was dressed quite smartly─all the better to show the Pelu I am a man who takes pride in his appearance and therefore his work as well. But now look at me...
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_215: Well, sir, this is your lucky day!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_HOOBIGOANXIETY04873: What a splendid poncho! This would be the perfect replacement for the coat I lost!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_217: We'd be willing to part with it, if you'd like to make a trade. For one of your fine tools, perhaps?
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_HOOBIGOANXIETY04873: What about this hatchet? I crafted it myself and will vouch for its quality.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_219: The blade looks sharp, the haft well made. I'd value it at one pel in the thousands column.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_220: Oho, from five hundred to a thousand? We have a deal!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_HOOBIGOANXIETY04873: Wonderful! A fine garment such as this should put me on even footing with any Pelu merchant.
Like the eponymous owner of Miplu's Mate Garden, for one. Her field hands use hatchets to harvest the mate, and I thought to impress her with the tool I sold you.
No matter, I have other wares to sell. Glad I am to have met you!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_224: Did you hear that? We've already found our next buyer. To Miplu's Mate Garden we go!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_225: Yes, but it's a fair distance on foot. We should take alpacas!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_WUKLAMAT_000_226: These ones will be the calm type...right?
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_SYSTEM_000_227: Success! You traded a five hundred pel wool poncho for a thousand pel hatchet!
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_MABLU_000_235: Well done recognizing that toolmaker as a potential customer! If you've a mind to change professions, you'd make an excellent merchant!
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_001: We've been doing so well! Even Tobli would have to agree...
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_005: Before we get moving... You should be the one to hold this.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_006: With that, I suppose we should hop on the alpacas Mablu has so kindly provided...
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_010: If I'm going to catch a wild alpaca after this, I can't be shying away from the tame ones. Not that I'm scared of them, you understand. Or their nasty, disgusting, foul-smelling spit...
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_015: Ready to go? Let's mount up!
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_500: And it's off to the mate fields we go!
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_501: Please don't spit, please don't spit...
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_502: You'll be fine! These ones are accustomed to people!
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_504: You have a knack for riding, no matter what you say!
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_505: Without our alpaca friends, we Pelu would never have become traveling merchants. Can you imagine walking all the way across Tural?
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_506: I swear, that mountain is too tall to be real.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_507: Worqor Zormor... Wasn't that the name?
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_508: A forbidding sight, isn't it? One I've never appreciated up close.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_509: You have to take the long way around the cliffs to get there─to the highlands belonging to the Yok Huy.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_510: So, Mablu, you said you were learning about the peddler profession. You don't care for ranch work?
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_511: No, no, I love it! I love working with alpacas!
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_512: But becoming a peddler has always been a dream of mine.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_513: It's just... I'm not sure I have the talent for it.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_514: If I can help you buy the taming saddle, though, then it'd be proof that I can do this after all.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_515: In that case, you'd best get ready to be a merchant!
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_017: We made it...and without a single smelly incident.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_100_019: I sent the alpacas back to Icuvlo's Inn, so we'll walk along the main road when we return to the village.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_018: Speaking of roads to travel... You were adopted by the Dawnservant, weren't you, Third Promise?
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_020: Then perhaps you understand. I was an orphan too, you see─Tobli took me in. He took in all the ranch hands, actually.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_022: Yes, and everyone works hard at their chores, grateful for the opportunity to repay the head ledger's generosity. Yet here I am, the only one wanting to go off and be a merchant...
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_023: I'm sorry, I don't know why I'm telling you this! We need to keep trading things for your saddle if you're to prepare for the Feat of Gold.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_024: As it's mate harvesting season, they can't have too many quality hatchets. Add to that Wuk Lamat's way with people, and we should have no trouble making a favorable deal.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_025: That's Miplu herself over there! Pass the hatchet to the Third Promise, and let's get to bargaining!
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_030: Did you give the hatchet back to Wuk Lamat? We should let her do the talking.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MIPLU_000_035: To what do I owe this honor...?
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_040: You have that little axe for me?
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_041: Thanks! Now to see what we can get for it...
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_042: You're Miplu, the owner of these fields? I have a mind to trade, if you're interested.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MIPLU_000_043: Well, well, the Third Promise! I might be convinced to entertain a proposal. What do you have on offer?
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_044: This hatchet! Forged by a seasoned artisan, the razor edge of this exceptional tool will make light work of your crops!
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MIPLU_000_045: Hrm... The quality is acceptable, I suppose. I offer you a large sack of mate leaves in exchange.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_046: A sack of mate leaves is valued at one pel in the thousands column─the same price as the hatchet. This deal would bring us no closer to the mezcal...
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_047: If I may, Mistress Miplu. It's harvesting season, is it not? Does not the demand for hatchets afford them a higher value?
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MIPLU_000_048: It is indeed the season. Which is why I procured an ample batch of tools well in advance.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_049: We've missed the window for demand... In that case, we'll have to fall back on connections.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_050: Think of it this way! A generous deal here will put you in the Third Promise's good graces. Surely that's worthy of consideration?
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MIPLU_000_051: I do not wish to give offense, but I must tell you that I stand with the Second Promise. His innovations will improve every aspect of our lives, I believe─including farming. And I will no longer have need of hatchets.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MIPLU_000_052: I assure you that I have nothing but respect for Wuk Lamat. That is why I'm prepared to purchase a spare hatchet at a fair price.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_053: I-I suppose it is fair given your reasons. But we ourselves would be no better off for the transaction...
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_054: How about this, then. If we were to help bring in your harvest, would you give us a better deal?
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MIPLU_000_055: As a matter of fact, I would! Until Koana's reforms come about, I can always use more hands in the fields.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_056: Then you can go ahead and add our labor to the bargain!
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_057: Added value to tip the scales... How could I have forgotten one of the most basic rules of trading?
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_058: You can rest here if you like, Mablu.  and I have mate to gather!
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MIPLU_000_060: Off to the fields, then, and mind you pick the healthy leaves. I'll take five good bundles from each of you.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_070: I wasn't sure Miplu would bite, but it goes to show that you never know until you try!
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_075: Did you see how Wuk Lamat came to my rescue there? She really is good with people...
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MIPLU_000_080: You've brought me some leaves, then?
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MIPLU_000_081: An acceptable harvest. We'll see how your companions fared before I make any decisions, though.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_082: Here, we've brought our share as well.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MIPLU_000_083: Thank you, Third Promise. This is more than enough to hold up your end of the bargain.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MIPLU_000_084: Now it's time to honor mine. After adding the value of your labor to the price of the hatchet...
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MIPLU_000_085: I am prepared to offer you a full sack of our highest-grade mate leaves!
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_086: Premium mate! Bought at the shop, one sack of those leaves would cost no less than five pel in the thousands column!
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_087: Then we can bid farewell to this hatchet.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MIPLU_000_088: I'll give it a good home. Talk of the contest aside, I'm glad we could come to a mutually agreeable trade.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_089: As am I! All the best with the rest of your harvest!
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_091: It's as I was saying before... Even after everything Tobli's done for me, I'm planning to abandon it all and become a merchant.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_092: But then I needed your help after forgetting a basic rule of trade. How can I expect Tobli to accept my decision then...?
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_A1_000_001: Have you mentioned your plans to leave?
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_A1_000_002: So you intend to give up, then?
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_094: Not exactly. I wanted to prove I could succeed as a peddler before I declared my intentions...
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_095: I can't! After getting a taste of real trading, I want to be a merchant more than ever!
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_096: Then you'll just have to be honest.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_097: I seek to follow in my father's footsteps, but not because he expects it of me. I want to preserve Tural's peace, and becoming Dawnservant happens to be the best way to do it.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_098: You should live a life of your own choosing, and I wouldn't be surprised if Tobli held the same opinion. So talk to him.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_099: ...You're right! It's better to find out for sure than worry over what he might say! Thank you for the advice.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_100: But first, we have a saddle to buy. I want that success under my belt so I can be sure of my decision!
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_101: What's next, then? We try to trade our tea leaves for something halfway to ten thousand pel?
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_102: No, I think we're close enough now. I say we go straight for the premium mezcal!
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_103: Bargain our way into double the value, eh? Think you can do it?
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_104: Trust me! I will make this trade work!
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_MABLU_000_105: I admire you, Third Promise. That you're holding your own against such strong competition for the throne is inspiring!
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_100_105: Uh... Am I really holding my own against Koana and Zoraal Ja...?
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_WUKLAMAT_000_106: I-I mean, of course I am! I'm Wuk Lamat of the Dawn's Promise, after all!
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_SYSTEM_000_107: Success! You traded a thousand pel hatchet for a five thousand pel sack of top-grade mate leaves!
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_001: I've never been one to take it slow. Once I have a goal in mind, it's full speed ahead! That's who I am!
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_WUKLAMAT_000_005: Before we go, let me give you the mate leaves. I don't need to risk proving Erenville's point...
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_006: Ready, then? Our next stop is the mezcal distillery!
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_WUKLAMAT_000_010: Oof, the smell of mezcal is overpowering. The fumes alone are making me dizzy...
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_015: We'll want to speak with a man by the name of Gobli. Even among his fellow distillers, he's regarded as a master of the craft.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_016: He knows the value of his product, so if we're to convince him to trade for twice what the leaves are worth, we're going to need targeted information. That means asking around and taking in the gossip!
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_017: If you could talk to people here in the distillery, , perhaps Wuk Lamat could do the same at the village entrance.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_018: Meanwhile, I'll head to the north side and see what I can learn!
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_BEBEELJA_000_025: Me? I'm a chef from Tuliyollal. I often come here to buy Gobli's mezcal─the finest in Tural, according to my customers.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_BEBEELJA_000_026: He always brings out a jug during our dealings, but I can't handle the stuff too well myself...
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_BEBEELJA_000_027: I take small sips─not wanting to be impolite, you understand─but still end up so addled as to agree to whatever price he quotes me.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_BEBEELJA_000_028: It would be nice to have less, uh, potent refreshments during such conversations. Else I might have to seriously reconsider our arrangement...
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_BEBEELJA_000_030: His spirits are excellent, I agree, but they're simply too strong for me...
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_TSUVLI_000_035: Gobli might be a deft hand at distilling, but he's got no sense when it comes to appearances.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_TSUVLI_000_036: Rumor has it he's been invited to the palace for business negotiations. If he presents himself to the court wearing his usual rumpled attire, though, he'll be laughed out of Sunperch.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_TSUVLI_000_040: Most Pelupelu have at least one set of especially fine garments. The success of a deal can hinge on how you present yourself, so it pays to dress to impress.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_RAPLU_000_045: There's not much I can say about Gobli, but I can tell you what Gobli's been saying...
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_RAPLU_000_046: The other day, he was muttering about monsters prowling around Agave Jaws─that's the field where they gather ingredients for the mezcal.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_RAPLU_000_047: Their presence has made it harder to procure said ingredients, and thus driven up the price of his product─a boon, some might argue, but it's hard to celebrate when it affects the work as it does. Can't rightly bring joy to people if you can't keep making the thing they love.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_RAPLU_000_050: Hiring mercenaries to come and cull the threats would eat into profits. I bet Gobli would be glad to find a less expensive solution...
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_060: So, what did you find out?
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_061: Oh, we can make use of all of those tidbits! The deal is as good as sealed!
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_062: As for me, I found out where Gobli is working─there's a millstone at the top of the slope behind the distillery. You go on ahead and I'll bring Wuk Lamat!
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_GOBLI_000_070: You have business with me, ? Why don't we talk down below so as not to distract the alpaca from his work.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_GOBLI_000_071: Now, what's this about? Keep it brief, if you would. I'm a busy man.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_WUKLAMAT_000_072: We're in the market for a three-year-old jug of premium mezcal. Assuming you have any on hand, that is.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_GOBLI_000_073: Ah, an excellent choice. I must warn you, though: it doesn't come cheap.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_WUKLAMAT_000_074: We don't have pel...but we can offer a sack of mate leaves in exchange! It's top-grade stuff, like the mezcal!
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_GOBLI_000_075: No deal. Mate leaves are well and good, but I don't have any use for them.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_GOBLI_000_077: Still, I'd hate to send you away empty-handed. Why don't we sit and chat awhile over a cup of mezcal?
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_078: Now the real bargaining begins. Which of our cards do you want to play first?
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_A1_000_001: The Hoobigo chef's distaste for strong drink.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_A1_000_003: The monsters in the agave fields.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_080: Let's hold on to that one. We need to consider our timing!
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_081: I appreciate your hospitality, but I'm afraid I can't hold my drink. I've heard one of your regular customers─a Hoobigo chef─is the same.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_082: Seeing as not everyone can enjoy mezcal, I wonder if you might benefit from having other refreshments to offer...
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_083: Something like mate tea, for instance. And brewed from the finest leaves, of course!
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_GOBLI_000_084: Ah, you're right─absolutely right! I had noticed a growing reluctance on the part of my Hoobigo friend, but did not realize I myself was to blame. I must endeavor to be a better host. Still, even with that added value in mind, no sack of leaves is worth the mezcal you're after.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_WUKLAMAT_000_085: (Should we offer to cull the monsters causing them trouble?)
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_086: (Not yet! We'll keep that card up our sleeve until we need it.)
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_087: As I expect you're aware, the rite of succession is currently taking place. That's why the Third Promise has graced us with her presence.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_088: When the contest is decided, the subsequent ascension ceremony and banquet will be a prestigious affair. If your mezcal were to be served there, it would bring your distillery immeasurable fame!
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_089: Wait... Could it be that your rumored invitation to the palace is to discuss that very possibility?
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_GOBLI_000_090: As a matter of fact, yes... I must admit, I'm still reeling from the abruptness of it all. It would be a great honor and opportunity...if I can secure the deal.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_091: Well, I should think your exceptional mezcal would speak for itself! That said, there's no such thing as being too prepared, and first impressions last. You'll want to be wearing your very best when you walk into Vollok Shoonsa.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_092: It would be such a shame to miss this chance of a lifetime simply for want of proper garments...
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_GOBLI_000_093: That it would... Are you saying you have garments to offer? Something ideal for court?
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_094: We have no garments on hand, I'm afraid, but we can provide you with the next best thing: an introduction to a weaver. His name is Bol Noq', and his works are highly regarded in Tuliyollal!
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_095: As a supporter of Wuk Lamat and keen observer of palace politics, he will doubtless be happy to guide you in the selection of an outfit to fit this golden occasion.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_GOBLI_000_096: That is certainly a tempting proposal, and one of which I should like to take full advantage. But the scales still aren't quite balancing.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_WUKLAMAT_000_097: Say, weren't there monsters running amok in Agave Jaws? That's a problem we could easily solve for you!
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_GOBLI_000_098: Truly? I would be most grateful for your immediate assistance. I was resigned to hiring sellswords to clear them out.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_GOBLI_000_099: Factoring in that saved expense and an introduction to a trusted weaver, this is shaping up to be a sound bargain. Alright! You have a deal.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_WUKLAMAT_000_100: Yes, I knew you'd come around! Give us a moment, and  and I will take care of those prowling nuisances!
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_101: In the meantime, I'll use the time to pen an introductory letter to Bol Noq'.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_102: The fields you're looking for are just north of Wachunpelo. Be safe!
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_GOBLI_000_115: That young woman is one formidable trader.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_WUKLAMAT_000_120: That should be Agave Jaws, just over there. This'll go faster if we split up. Come and find me once you've finished clearing out your share of the pests!
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_WUKLAMAT_000_140: Compared to the creatures I hunted with Papa, this was no challenge at all.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_WUKLAMAT_000_141: Come on, let's head back to the distillery. All that's left is to give Mablu the sack of leaves so she can seal the deal!
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_WUKLAMAT_000_150: Go on, give Mablu the sack of leaves so she can seal the deal!
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_GOBLI_000_155: Finished already? Even hardened mercenaries would have taken longer!
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_160: Those monsters were no trouble for you, it seems! Now, if I could just have the sack of leaves...
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_161: Thank you for looking after our precious trading goods!
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_162: Your monster problem has been resolved, Master Gobli! Here are the mate leaves and a written introduction to Bol Noq', as agreed.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_GOBLI_000_163: Then the deal is done. Here. Your jug of premium mezcal, aged three years. Please accept it with my compliments.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_WUKLAMAT_000_164: Yes! We finally have the mezcal! Great work─especially you, Mablu!
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_165: You were the one that inspired me to come this far, Third Promise. But let's not celebrate until we have the saddle in hand!
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_GOBLI_000_166: Mablu, is it? You drive a hard bargain, young peddler. I look forward to doing business with you in the future.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_MABLU_000_167: Thank you, but...truth be told, I'm just a ranch hand. For now. Should I ever become a proper merchant, though, I'll be back to strike more deals with you!
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_SYSTEM_000_168: Success! You traded a five thousand pel sack of top-grade mate leaves for a ten thousand pel jug of premium mezcal!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_MABLU_000_001: Master Gobli's praise makes me confident I can be a peddler after all... Well, a bit more confident than before, at least!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_GOBLI_000_002: I'm satisfied with our trade, and I trust you are too. Should you have need of more mezcal, you know who to come to!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_WUKLAMAT_000_003: Even at the palace, I don't think I've held a ten thousand pel jug of anything before. My hands won't stop shaking... Here, you'd better hold on to it until we get to the saddlemaker.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_MABLU_000_004: Ahahaha! Can you imagine if we dropped it and had to start all over again?
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_MABLU_000_005: Luckily, Havli's place is not far─we just need to head across the plaza!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_MABLU_000_007: The Third Promise looks ready to trade the mezcal now!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_HAVLI_000_008: My price is final. Bring me a jug of premium mezcal, or go bargain with another saddlemaker.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_WUKLAMAT_000_009: This is it─the trade we've been working towards!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_WUKLAMAT_000_010: Phew, still in one piece... Right, time to make our deal!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_WUKLAMAT_000_011: Get your tools ready, saddler─we've brought your precious mezcal!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_HAVLI_000_012: Wait, you actually got your hands on a jug? But you had nothing─a few measly clumps of wool...
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_WUKLAMAT_000_013: What we had was an aspiring trader with a gift for negotiation.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_HAVLI_000_014: Although I'd sooner aid no claimant but Zoraal Ja, I cannot go against the guiding principles of the Pelupelu.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_HAVLI_000_015: The trade is a fair one. I will craft your saddle, Third Promise.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_HAVLI_000_017: Stay and wait if you like. I have all the requisite materials, so this won't take long.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_HAVLI_000_018: ...Your commission is ready. Catching a wild alpaca is never a simple affair, but you'll have an easier time of it with one of my saddles.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_HAVLI_000_019: Now, if you don't mind, I have other work that needs finishing. Ah, I can taste that smooth mezcal already...
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_WUKLAMAT_000_020: We did it! The saddle is ours!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_WUKLAMAT_000_021: And to think we started out with only a hundred-pel basket of alpaca wool... Mablu, you are going to be an incredible merchant!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_MABLU_000_022: Thank you! It makes me so glad to hear you say that, Third Promise!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_WUKLAMAT_000_023: We got what we came for, so let's return to the ranch! The others will be waiting.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_SYSTEM_000_025: Success! You traded a ten thousand pel jug of premium mezcal for a taming saddle!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_MABLU_000_026: It looks like everyone's been pitching in with the alpacas!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_WUKLAMAT_000_027: Let's tell them the good news!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_KRILE_000_028: Tobli and Erenville have been teaching us how to care for alpacas. One gentle girl ate the feed straight from my hand!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_ERENVILLE_000_029: You've been away for some time. I assume trading was productive?
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_ALISAIE_100_029: I made the mistake of startling one and caught a glob of spittle for my trouble. I'm beginning to understand Wuk Lamat's aversion to the animals...
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_HAVLI_200_029: So that was the Third Promise. She's not the spoiled, untested daughter I was expecting...
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_WUKLAMAT_000_031: Yes, and thanks in no small part to Mablu!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_MABLU_000_032: Before you rush off to catch an alpaca, though, let me teach you how to saddle one. I'll bring out one of our wild-born friends so you can practice!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_WUKLAMAT_000_033: I know, I know. This is something I need to learn.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_WUKLAMAT_000_034: Great sunken gods, I did it!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_ERENVILLE_000_035: He hardly seemed bothered, much less inclined to spit. As if he was completely accepting of Wuk Lamat's touch...
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_MABLU_000_036: That is because of the singular scent with which the saddle has been coated. Alpacas find it very soothing.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_WUKLAMAT_000_037: You know, I've never taken a good, long look at one of you before, but...
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_MABLU_000_039: Ahahaha, you're only now noticing that!?
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_WUKLAMAT_000_041: Having done exactly what he set out to do...
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_ALISAIE_000_042: That alpaca he's brought... Is it just me or is it...glowing?
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_ERENVILLE_000_043: I've heard tales of such a beast. They say the golden alpaca lives a solitary existence deep in the valley, where it shuns the company of both man and its own kind.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_WUKLAMAT_000_044: How did he manage to snare a prize like that?
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_SAREELJA_000_045: A beast knows its betters. Faced with overwhelming strength, it will yield rather than risk death. An apt illustration of how greatly the power of the First Promise exceeds yours, Wuk Lamat.
