TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_WUKLAMAT_000_046: Strength alone won't win him our father's throne. I'll be the one to find the golden city, and then Tural can remain at peace.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_ZORAALJA_000_047: An everlasting desire for peace can only be forged in the fires of war.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_ZORAALJA_000_048: To unite as one, the people must be taught. They must suffer the horror and the hopelessness firsthand.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_SAREELJA_000_049: Exhaustion from prolonged conflict. The wages of war's merciless nature. These are what moved the clans to join in the founding of Tuliyollal all those years ago.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_SAREELJA_000_050: Consider the younger generation of this village. Since birth have they basked in unbroken harmony, and behold: they regard war not as tragedy but opportunity.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_SAREELJA_000_051: Thus does the Resilient Son seek to provide education. He offers much-needed lessons in the realities of conquest and a renewed appreciation for peacetime.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_ALPHINAUD_000_052: 'Tis true that war's misery breeds a longing for peace.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_ALPHINAUD_000_053: But I have seen with my own eyes what becomes of an empire forged through the violence you propose─the rebellions it spawned, and the ruins it left behind.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_ZORAALJA_000_054: The Garlean Empire was a congregation of simpletons.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_ZORAALJA_000_055: The oppressed fought back against their oppressors. As well they should.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_ZORAALJA_000_056: Men are not beasts. Only a fool would seek to rule over all with the threat of force alone.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_SAREELJA_000_057: This is why Gulool Ja Ja did not elevate the Mamool Ja; why he treated all clans with equal respect.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_SAREELJA_000_059: The First Promise has his gaze fixed upon more distant horizons! He would unite not only Tuliyollal, but the star in its entirety!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_ZORAALJA_000_061: I need not explain myself to you.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_TOBLI_000_062: Oh, well done! Well done, indeed! The First Promise has completed the Feat of Gold with an appropriately golden flourish! May I present to you your much-deserved keystone!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_WUKLAMAT_000_063: He's always been like that─never sharing his innermost thoughts with me or even with Koana.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_WUKLAMAT_000_064: It's like we're not even family...
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_MABLU_000_066: I could never agree with Zoraal Ja. I want Tuliyollal to be a land of peace, now and always.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_KRILE_000_067: Zoraal Ja is willing to go to war for his twisted vision of peace. But should he achieve this peace, then what...?
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_ERENVILLE_000_068: A golden alpaca in the flesh... Like the golden city, I thought them a children's tale.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_ALPHINAUD_000_069: So much of our star has begun to embrace reconciliation and rebuild...and this would-be warlord would thrust us all back into turmoil. We cannot allow it to happen.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_ALISAIE_000_070: What kind of idiot thinks the world can be united with war? Even most Garleans have since realized that their conquests were a mistake.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_SYSTEM_100_070: The alpaca seems glum. Perhaps it is wistful for the soothing scent of the taming saddle...
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_WUKLAMAT_000_071: I'll ponder Zoraal Ja and his mysteries later. Right now, I need to think about finishing the Feat of Gold!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_WUKLAMAT_100_071: I have my saddle, I've practiced how to use it, so lead on to where the wild alpacas roam!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_MABLU_000_072: The valley of Oruncanca is northwest of here. Come on, everyone─even if we can't enter ourselves, we can see Wuk Lamat off on her hunt!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_MABLU_000_074: Oruncanca is a steep and treacherous place, so only those with the head ledger's blessing are permitted to go there.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_KRILE_000_075: Mablu's right. The least we can do is let Wuk Lamat know we're cheering for her!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_ERENVILLE_000_076: I've never set foot beyond this point. The valley is said to be home to fiends far more ferocious than spitting alpacas.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_ALPHINAUD_000_077: How deep do you think the valley is? I glanced over the edge on the way here, but the mist was too thick to even speculate.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_ALISAIE_000_078: Zoraal Ja may have caught his alpaca first, but that doesn't mean Wuk Lamat is out of the running. She can do this.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_WUKLAMAT_100_79: I can do this... I know I can...
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_SYSTEM_000_079: Cheer on Wuk Lamat as she marshals her courage to attempt the harrowing task of capturing a wild alpaca.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_SYSTEM_300_079: Your chosen method of support has confused Wuk Lamat. Perhaps a tried-and-true cheer will prove more effective.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_WUKLAMAT_000_080: Thanks to Alphinaud and his healing hands, I can actually stand again...maybe even walk!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_KRILE_000_081: We were out here for quite some time, but I'm glad Wuk Lamat was able to catch her alpaca. And Erenville choosing to share his story with us was a welcome surprise!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_ERENVILLE_000_082: ...I spoke too much. If Wuk Lamat is up to it, we should be heading back to Tobli.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_ALPHINAUD_000_083: Wuk Lamat had no serious injuries to speak of. However, she had clearly been pushed to the very limits of her endurance.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_ALISAIE_000_084: Alphinaud was quick to lend a hand with dismantling the tent. Is this to be his new obsession now that he's mastered collecting firewood...?
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_MABLU_000_085: I'm so relieved the Third Promise came back to us safely!
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_MABLU_000_086: And the alpaca she tamed is a healthy-looking beast. Surely this will be enough to satisfy the Feat of Gold!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_001: Thanks to Alphinaud and his healing hands, I can actually stand again...maybe even walk!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_KRILE_000_002: We were out here for quite some time, but I'm glad Wuk Lamat was able to catch her alpaca. And Erenville choosing to share his story with us was a welcome surprise!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_ERENVILLE_000_003: ...I spoke too much. If Wuk Lamat is up to it, we should be heading back to Tobli.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_ALPHINAUD_000_004: Wuk Lamat had no serious injuries to speak of. However, she had clearly been pushed to the very limits of her endurance.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_ALISAIE_000_005: Alphinaud was quick to lend a hand with dismantling the tent. Is this to be his new obsession now that he's mastered collecting firewood...?
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_MABLU_000_006: Wuk Lamat still seems a bit unsteady on her feet. Hardly surprising after she spent the night chasing alpacas. You know what will melt away fatigue like magic, though? Mate tea!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_MABLU_000_007: I'll run to the ranch and get a pot brewing. That way you can take your time, and the tea will be ready when you arrive!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_ALPHINAUD_000_008: As Mablu so wisely suggested, we shall set a slower pace for our exhausted Third Promise.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_MABLU_000_009: Came back ahead of the others, did you? I should hurry along with the tea, then─Wuk Lamat can't be that far behind!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_020: Ooh, that tea really is magical─I feel better already!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_KRILE_000_021: I see you've become more comfortable around our fuzzy friends.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_022: Watching this one taught me a lot about alpacas. What grasses and fruits they eat, what sounds they react to, their adorable little quirks...
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_023: I guess I've grown kind of fond of them!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_TOBLI_000_024: Welcome back, Third Promise. Accomplished the Feat of Gold, have you?
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_TOBLI_000_025: Hm, yes, there is no mistaking a valley alpaca.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_TOBLI_000_026: I commend you on your success. Well done!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_028: ...Although I couldn't find a shiny one like Zoraal Ja did.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_TOBLI_000_029: I'd be surprised if you had! Golden alpacas are born but once every few decades. They are elusive, solitary creatures that are rarely seen─much less captured─thanks to their innate physical and magical gifts.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_TOBLI_000_030: Only a single other person is known to have caught one before─that being Gulool Ja Ja himself.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_TOBLI_000_033: It was before the founding of Tuliyollal, in a time when the mountain giants─the Yok Huy─held our people in thrall.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_TOBLI_000_034: Compelled by their overlords, our forebears would ride their alpaca mounts to the highlands to deliver gifts of food and other tributes. Those were wretched days, to hear Grandfather tell it.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_TOBLI_000_035: Then along came the young Gulool Ja Ja, yet unburdened by the mantle of Dawnservant.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_TOBLI_000_036: Our people were amazed by this imposing two-headed figure, equal to the Yok Huy in stature, and puzzled by his entourage of mismatched companions.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_TOBLI_000_037: Some trembled in fear, believing a new conqueror had come.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_TOBLI_000_038: Yet Gulool Ja Ja showed no such inclinations. He sat and spoke with us, sipping from the cups of mate tea we offered him, and grew somber when he learned of our plight.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_TOBLI_000_039: None could have anticipated what their visitor decided to do next! Gulool Ja Ja ascended the cliffs to face the giants and freed the Pelupelu from the Yok Huy's subjugation!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_TOBLI_000_040: He then turned an appraising eye upon our riders and proposed we take to the road to peddle our beverages. The suggestion seemed obvious for one who traveled as he did, intent on fostering amity between the clans.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_TOBLI_000_041: So it was that a few words from Gulool Ja Ja transformed us into a clan of itinerant merchants.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_042: I've never heard the bond Papa forged with the Pelupelu spoken of in that way before. The saga is not so detailed.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_TOBLI_000_043: Then you may not know that Gulool Ja Ja sought a sure-footed guide for his trek up into the highlands. Thus did he capture a golden alpaca.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_044: So both my brother and my father caught the rarest of creatures...
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_045: ...while an ordinary one was the best I could manage!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_MABLU_000_046: The feat required no more than that, Third Promise. And you brought back a perfectly wonderful beast!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_047: Mablu's right. You're a perfectly wonderful beast. If anyone's ordinary, it's me...
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_TOBLI_000_048: Not only did you accomplish the Feat of Gold, you also made many trades and brought joy to many people in true Pelupelu fashion. I sorely doubt your sibling could have achieved the same result.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_TOBLI_000_049: You should be proud of the accomplishments which earned you your keystone.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_051: So this is what they look like.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_ALISAIE_000_052: Go on, set it in the tablet!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_053: A perfect fit! That leaves six more.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_MABLU_000_054: You're well on your way, Third Promise!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_055: We'd have been lost without you, Mablu. Thanks to you, I learned so much about the Pelu people and your customs.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_056: It might seem obvious, but I've come to realize the importance of properly knowing something. It was because I didn't understand alpacas that I was uncomfortable around them.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_MABLU_000_057: I'm thankful to you as well, Wuk Lamat. You've given me the courage to say what I wasn't sure I could ever say!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_MABLU_000_058: Tobli... I want to leave the ranch and become a merchant!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_MABLU_000_059: I appreciate everything you've done for me, and I've loved every moment caring for the alpacas.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_MABLU_000_060: But this is something I need to do! I need to walk my own path, and make my own trades!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_TOBLI_000_061: As your parent, allow me to say one thing.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_TOBLI_000_062: I've always tried to give my wards lives filled with as much happiness as I could provide. Yet never once have I wanted that to be the only happiness you knew.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_TOBLI_000_063: You have my blessing to walk any path you choose, Mablu. It gladdens me to hear you've found a calling you wish to pursue with such passion. You will make an exceptional peddler, I'm sure of it.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_065: What did I tell you, Mablu!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_MABLU_000_066: There's one last thing I can help you with, Third Promise. You need to find the golden city, right?
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_MABLU_000_068: Then I suggest you talk to the Yok Huy.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_MABLU_000_069: They once ruled over far more than just Urqopacha and the Pelupelu. A thousand years ago, they were the overlords of Yok Tural and all its peoples.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_MABLU_000_070: During that era, the Pelupelu were commanded to search for a city of gold.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_MABLU_000_071: They scoured every corner of the continent, but never found any trace of that fabled place.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_072: But...if they didn't find anything, what could the Yok Huy have to tell us?
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_KRILE_000_073: They may not have found it...but the fact that they thought to look for it at all makes me curious. Perhaps there's value in delving into how the legend originated?
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_ERENVILLE_000_074: We lose nothing from asking the question. Besides, if we're determined to follow the path of the saga...
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_MABLU_000_076: Oh, Krile. I have a question I'd been meaning to ask, and since we've finished with the feat─where did you acquire that earring?
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_KRILE_000_077: My earring? Do you recognize it?
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_MABLU_000_078: Yes, pieces just like it first became fashionable in Yok Tural around twenty years ago. Since then, it's become common to wear one as a charm for safe travel.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_KRILE_000_079: Twenty years ago─right about the time my grandfather made his journey. Yet the Dawnservant implied the earring was connected to the golden city in some way. Surely there was more to its significance than simple fashion...
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_MABLU_000_080: If you want to know how it first came to be crafted, I could try to find out. Seeing as it's a regular seller for many merchants, I'm curious to learn about it myself!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_KRILE_000_081: I would appreciate that very much, thank you.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_082: Jumping feetfirst into the peddler business, eh, Mablu?
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_083: Right then, that's two keystones down. I say we head back to Tuliyollal and plan our next move!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_084: Right then, let's head back to Tuliyollal and get ready to search for the next elector!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_085: Farewell for now, and thanks for all your help! I will become Dawnservant, so make sure you set aside your best mezcal for the occasion!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_TOBLI_000_086: She has a fearsome opponent in that brother of hers. He even brought a golden alpaca to heel.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_MABLU_000_087: But you've heard Zoraal Ja's supporters talk. They might see opportunity in his expansionist ambitions, but they find the man himself intimidating. Terrifying, even.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_MABLU_000_088: Whereas I've grown to love Wuk Lamat! Everyone she meets will come to love her, too, and that's why she'll win the throne!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_TOBLI_000_089: You might be right, Mablu. You might be right.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_ALPHINAUD_000_90: The Yok Huy once ruled the entirety of Yok Tural. I'm curious to see what has become of them.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_ALISAIE_000_91: I expected as much from the moment I saw him, but winning the contest against Zoraal Ja will not be easy.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_KRILE_000_92: I never dared hope we would find a lead for this earring mystery so quickly.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_ERENVILLE_000_93: Four-legged troubles aside, Wuk Lamat completed the feat and earned a keystone. That's all that matters.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_ERENVILLE_000_94: That makes two out of seven keystones... So far, so good.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_095: It feels good to have the Feat of Gold safely under our belt...even if my victory pales beside Zoraal Ja and his shiny golden alpaca.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_096: I know I shouldn't let it bother me, and gods know you've all been so supportive, but I want to be strong─or wise─like my brothers. To be a Promise that people respect.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_097: ...Which is not likely if I stand here carrying on and on about things! Let's move on!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_098: Back to Xbalyav Ty'e with us─the contest has hardly begun!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_ALPHINAUD_000_100: I've heard there are hot springs in Urqopacha. Mayhap, time permitting...
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_ALPHINAUD_100_100: I have not forgotten our obligations to Wuk Lamat, of course. Having immersed ourselves in the cultures of others, though, my anticipation for the new experiences this adventure will bring us has only grown.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_ALISAIE_000_101: The Pelu remind me of Lalafell, never letting their size slow them down or hold them back. They move at their own pace, making their textiles and mezcal, and raise alpacas to bear them to market.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_ALISAIE_100_101: Idle musings aside, we've made a good start on these challenges. Hopefully we can keep it up.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_KRILE_000_102: Neither Koana nor Bakool Ja Ja appeared to be in Wachunpelo... I imagine they're around somewhere, making progress even as we are.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_KRILE_100_102: Yet in a contest like this one, 'tis only a matter of time until the claimants are pitted against each other in direct competition.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_ERENVILLE_000_103: A golden alpaca... Alone, I may have tried to track the beast myself.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_ERENVILLE_100_103: ...Traveling with so large and diverse a group is...unfamiliar to me. If she could see me now...
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_105: And just like that, we found an elector and won our first keystone. I knew I was right to trust your instincts!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_106: Come on! Let's keep things moving, and march onwards to Kozama'uka!
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_ERENVILLE_000_107: Chances are good we'll find an elector there as well. Before we do anything, however, we should see what your patient Hanu friend has to say.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_WUKLAMAT_000_109: The contest has barely begun and we already have two keystones! Surely even my talented brothers aren't doing this well!
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_ALPHINAUD_000_001: I have not forgotten our obligations to Wuk Lamat, but it's moments like these─when we can immerse ourselves in the cultures of others─that fill me with anticipation for the new experiences this adventure will bring us.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_ALISAIE_000_005: We've made a good start on these challenges. Hopefully we can keep it up.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_KRILE_000_010: In a contest like this one, 'tis only a matter of time until the claimants are pitted against each other in direct competition.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_ERENVILLE_000_015: Traveling with so large and diverse a group is...unfamiliar to me. If she could see me now...
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_020: We've now won keystones from both the Feat of Reeds and the Feat of Gold. Surely that means our approach to the contest was the right one?
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_ALPHINAUD_000_021: So it would seem. By continuing to retrace Gulool Ja Ja's journey as presented in the saga, we should find the remaining electors in turn.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_022: Then let's visit the giants next! Like Krile said, the fact that they were searching for the golden city might mean they know something useful.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_ERENVILLE_000_023: The home of the Yok Huy is in the upper reaches of Urqopacha. Unless you're keen on scaling the cliffs, we'll have to take the long way around─through Kozama'uka.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_ERENVILLE_000_024: This route will take us close to the Moblin village...which is another important location in the saga.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_ERENVILLE_000_025: Since we'll need all the keystones eventually, it makes sense to pay them a visit while we're passing through.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_026: So we call on the Moblins first, then. Let's head there right now!
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_ERENVILLE_000_027: I'm afraid “right now” is going to be a problem...
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_ERENVILLE_000_028: The Flight of We Wingless, the great stairs leading to the Moblin settlement, collapsed in the storm.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_029: What are we to do, then?
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_ERENVILLE_000_030: There is an alternative, but it requires preparation. Until it's ready, you could rest at the cabins or see more of the city. Whatever you prefer.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_ERENVILLE_000_031: Just to be sure: you'll accept any method of travel as long as it gets us to our destination?
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_032: Of course. Who do you take me for?
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_ERENVILLE_000_033: ...Hmm. Then as your guide, I will see to the arrangements.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_ALPHINAUD_000_034: Well, it seems we have some free time on our hands. Let us make the most of it.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_035: I need to get my axe repaired. I nicked the blade pretty badly when I took a swing at Bakool Ja Ja.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_036: That reminds me, I never got around to introducing you to Ropli, did I? He's the man in charge of Wachumeqimeqi, and a good person to know. Want to come along?
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_040: Ready? The markets of Wachumeqimeqi are to the east, on the other side of Bayside Bevy.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_SYSTEM_000_041: Wuk Lamat is now accompanying you. Keep her at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_SYSTEM_000_042: You can leave Wuk Lamat behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with her and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_SYSTEM_000_043: If you wish to have Wuk Lamat accompany you again, return and speak with her at the original location.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_051: Wachumeqimeqi is everything that Tuliyollal was built to be.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_052: This is Aunt Tii's Tacos, named for its owner here, the lovely Tiisol.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_053: If you're after the best tacos in Tuliyollal, this place sits at the top with Xbalyav Ty'e.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_TIISOLJA_000_054: You say that, Third Promise, but you only ever eat old Br'uk Evu's food! Come and buy mine for a change!
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_055: Sorry, Tiisol! It has been a while, hasn't it? I swear I'll stop for a bite once the contest is over.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_SYSTEM_000_056: Are you sure you wish to part ways with your companion?
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_057: Something you eat not agree with you? Well, I'll be waiting by Xbalyav Ty'e whenever you're ready!
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_058: Feeling better? Let's get back to it, then!
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_ROPLI_000_059: Apologies, but I'm rather busy at the moment. Please come back later.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_SYSTEM_100_060: You should have Wuk Lamat accompanying you before continuing.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_SYSTEM_000_060: Wuk Lamat has yet to arrive. Be sure she is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_ROPLI_000_061: My, my, the Third Promise. How might I assist you this fine ?
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_062: Well met, Ropli! I need to buff a nasty nick out of my axe blade.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_ROPLI_000_063: Yes, it's been chipped quite terribly. Trying to cleave rocks again, were we?
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_064: Er, something like that. Think you can fix it?
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_ROPLI_000_065: You stand among Tural's most prestigious gathering of artisans and ask this question? 'Tis child's play. We'll have it repaired for you in two shakes of an alpaca's tail.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_066: Good to hear! I leave it in your capable hands.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_ROPLI_000_067: Who's your companion, if I may ask?
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_068: This is , a great adventurer I recruited from across the salt!
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_069: I brought  here to meet you, actually. Thought  might have reason to visit Wachumeqimeqi sooner or later.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_ROPLI_000_070: Then allow me to introduce myself. I am Ropli, humble representative of this grand center of trade. A pleasure to meet you, .
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_ROPLI_000_071: You there! Stop dithering in the shadows and announce your business already!
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_072: Hrm, I've seen that man somewhere before...
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_073: A jewelry maker you met on the voyage over?
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_074: Oh, I remember─I spoke with him, too! Fonjean...taine? Yes, that was his name!
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_ROPLI_000_075: You've been loitering like a flighty admirer who can't pluck up the courage to confess his feelings. Out with it, then. Why are you here?
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_FONJEANTAINE_000_07: I, uh... That is to say...
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_ROPLI_000_077: <sigh> And we're no closer to solving that enigma.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_078: Hrm, I wonder if he could use someone to talk to... I say we go and ask! Let me know by linkpearl if you find him first.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_ROPLI_000_080: Our nervous man of mystery fled westwards...never to be seen again?
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_FONJEANTAINE_000_08: You were conversing with Master Ropli... But wait─we've met before, haven't we? On the ship...
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_086: You've found him? Good, I'll be right there!
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_087: Why did you run off like that? Did you have business with Ropli or not?
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_FONJEANTAINE_000_08: Please, you needn't concern yourselves with my affairs! I'm undeserving of such attention!
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_089: Huh? What are you going on about?
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_FONJEANTAINE_000_09: I beg of you, do not ask me to explain! Do not!
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_091: Sorry, but the more you tell me not to, the more curious I become. Besides, you look like you need a friend.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_FONJEANTAINE_000_09: <sigh> You are too kind... So be it. I suppose I can share with you a morsel of my misery...

Before I came to Tuliyollal, I worked as a goldsmith at the most prestigious jewelry maker in all of Ul'dah─Eshtaime's Aesthetics. Oh, it started off well enough, but as the days passed, everything began to go wrong!

Compared to the masterpieces of my talented colleagues, my products were lacking. Mediocre! I lost all confidence. Crippling doubt had possessed me, and any veneer of bravado I tried to put forth soon cracked beneath its weight!

Thus did I take ship, hoping to find a fresh beginning on new shores. Yet as you witnessed, I lack the courage to even approach a potential employer. You stand before a man wallowing in the wreckage of his ill-spent existence!
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_096: Uh...alright, then. You offered a “morsel,” then served us the full course.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_097: You must've really wanted someone to hear your story. If you like, I could try to give you a few words of advice.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_FONJEANTAINE_000_09: Then...you have experience with my predicament? Of feeling terribly inadequate compared to your undeniably superior peers?
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_099: Well...when you put it that way, I, uh...
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_100: Ah...hahaha, not me! I'm Wuk Lamat, Third Promise of Tuliyollal!
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_FONJEANTAINE_000_10: O-Oh, of course, you're a member of the royal family! Please forgive my presumptuousness!
But what of you? Have you ever measured your work against that of your colleagues and found yourself wanting...?
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_A2_000_001: You can't measure your worth by the success of others.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_FONJEANTAINE_000_10: How can I not? Should my work not meet the same exacting standards, no new commissions will be forthcoming! What then was the point of my becoming a goldsmith...?
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_FONJEANTAINE_100_10: If even an ally handpicked by the Third Promise can feel such doubt, then what hope is there for me? I must question why I bothered to become a goldsmith in the first place...
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_FONJEANTAINE_000_10: Hmmm... Looking back, 'twas my father who inspired me to take up the trade. His exquisite creations brought radiant smiles to the faces of his clients, and I admired him deeply for it.
But in the course of striving to be as great a goldsmith as him, I lost sight of my original motivation...
All I ever wanted was to spread joy through my craft, as he did.
Perhaps...perhaps I will give this one last try. Thank you both for reminding me of what is truly important!
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_121: Oh, sorry, ! I didn't mean to ignore you.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_WUKLAMAT_000_122: But, yes─I'm glad to see Fonjeantaine is giving himself another chance!
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_001: I can't help but wonder if Fonjeantaine will follow through. Let's see if he's actually gone to talk with Ropli!
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ROPLI_000_002: Our lurker seems a changed man. I'm not sure it even is the same man.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_FONJEANTAINE_000_00: 'Twas kind of you to come, but you needn't worry. I've found my courage!
Pray accept my apologies for my earlier behavior.
My name is Fonjeantaine, and I am a goldsmith from Ul'dah in faraway Eorzea.

I realize this is a bold request, but I should like to continue practicing my trade here in Wachumeqimeqi─if you will have me! I ask only for the opportunity to bring happiness to others with my creations.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ROPLI_000_007: So that's what it was about. You were looking for work.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ROPLI_000_008: Consider yourself hired. Wachumeqimeqi is always in need of skilled craftsmen and women.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ROPLI_000_009: I'll handle the necessary paperwork. Can you start tomorrow?
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_FONJEANTAINE_000_01: I must thank you both again for your sage and timely advice.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_012: I don't know that I was all that helpful...
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_FONJEANTAINE_000_01: But you were. Had you not come to speak with me, I would not have had that moment of much-needed self-reflection.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ERENVILLE_000_014: (-Erenville-)The arrangements have been made. Come and meet me at the entrance of High Tide Harbor.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_015: Oh, I almost forgot. Do you have my axe ready, Ropli?
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ROPLI_000_016: Ready and waiting. Behold the sublime touch of a Wachumeqimeqi artisan.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_017: Oho, it's as sharp and deadly as the first day I held it! Thank you!
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_018: Well, good luck to you, Fonjeantaine. Let me know if that doubt creeps back in─I'd be happy to talk you out of it.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_019: As for us, we should head for the harbor. Wouldn't want to keep Erenville waiting!
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ROPLI_000_020: Always a happy day to add a new artisan to the ranks. Do let me know if there's anything else I can help you with.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_FONJEANTAINE_000_02: I know better than to hold myself to an impossible standard. The only thing that matters is the joy my craft can bring to others.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_022: I wonder what Erenville's alternate means of travel is...
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_KRILE_000_023: I wandered through the bayside markets and found earrings almost identical to mine. They indeed seem to be a common travel charm, just as Mablu described.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ALPHINAUD_000_024: I went to reexamine the Tuliyollal Saga. Should we continue apace, we shall soon come face-to-face─or rather, face-to-knee─with those enormous Yok Huy. I am told some of them tower over even the hulking Gulool Ja Ja.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ALISAIE_000_025: All that waiting was making me hungry, so I tried a taco from both Xbalyav Ty'e and Aunt Tii's. I think I prefer Tiisol's spicier flavors.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_030: Enough with the secrecy─what's this big plan of yours!?
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ERENVILLE_000_031: Look there. That is my big plan.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ERENVILLE_000_033: It's a punutiy. She'll be pulling our boat upriver.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_034: How do we know she won't thrash about and sink us instead...?
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ERENVILLE_000_035: They're gentle and timid creatures. For the most part. She's unlikely to cause a fuss unless you give her reason to.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ALISAIE_000_036: First alpacas, now punutiys. We're relying a lot on animals for this journey.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_KRILE_000_037: We should be thankful we have an animal expert as our guide, then.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_038: But did it have to be my old nemesis? Another boat...
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ERENVILLE_000_039: Well, I took you for someone who was up to the challenge. Was I wrong?
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ERENVILLE_000_041: Long ago, when fighting still raged between the clans, the inhabitants of Kozama'uka rode these riverboats to move swiftly through hostile territory.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ERENVILLE_000_042: But the vessels see little use with Tural now at peace, so I was able to borrow one of the few which remain.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ERENVILLE_000_043: I did consider a dirigible, but the pilots warned me that the updrafts near the falls would make landing difficult.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ALPHINAUD_000_044: You said you borrowed “one,” yet there appear to be several on the water...
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_KOANA_000_046: Lamaty'i. Traveling up the river, I presume?
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_047: Seems that way. Does this mean you've earned two keystones already? I can't believe how well you've managed despite undertaking the contest alone.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_KOANA_000_048: I was never alone. I've had my own entourage with me since the beginning.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_THANCRED_000_049: (-Thancred-)My friends, it's been...well, not that long.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ALISAIE_000_050: Thancred! Urianger! What are you doing here!?
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_THANCRED_000_051: Escorting a Promise, the same as you.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_KOANA_000_052: I'd heard much of the incomparable Archons during my time at the Studium. As soon as the contest was confirmed, I thought who better to recruit to my cause? I contacted the scholarch, who arranged an introduction to these two gentlemen.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_URIANGER_000_053: The Second Promise had specific requirements: they who would be his assistants must boast both proven survival skills and mastery of the arcane arts.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_URIANGER_000_054: Thus did Thancred and I receive the summons.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_KOANA_000_055: My own studies concentrated on technology which our people could readily use, such as inventions born of magitek or clever engineering.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_KOANA_000_056: Where magic was concerned, I covered only the foundation.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_KRILE_000_057: Knowing you two, I expect you had other reasons for accepting the job?
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_THANCRED_000_058: A few. The nation of Tuliyollal spans an entire continent. Depending on who wins the throne, the world may be plunged into instability once more.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_THANCRED_000_059: Ever have we striven to preserve peace. Where is our place, if not here and now?
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_THANCRED_000_060: We did our due diligence, of course, and made sure of who we were working with before agreeing to this endeavor. He's even more opaque than Urianger at times, but is surprisingly─
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_KOANA_000_061: That's quite enough of that! We must be on our way!
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ALISAIE_000_062: Wait. I have one question before you leave.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ALISAIE_000_063: Koana and Wuk Lamat are vying for the throne. As Koana's entourage, does that mean you're resolved to defeat all his opponents...including us?
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_THANCRED_000_064: We're sworn to do all in our power to win this contest for Koana─even if it means competing against our own comrades.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_THANCRED_000_065: We intend to hold nothing back, and expect you to do the same.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_067: I thought you were taking a boat...
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_KOANA_000_068: If even you have been forced to travel on water, then the others will be doing the same. I would rather walk than risk confrontation on a leaky barge with no possibility of retreat.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_069: It's true that I can't stand boats...
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_070: But I trust the route Erenville has chosen for us!
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ERENVILLE_000_071: Leave the handling of the punutiy to me. Should other wildlife attack us, however, I may have difficulty keeping her under control. Do your best to draw them away─as far from the front of the boat as possible.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ALPHINAUD_000_072: Then we shall remain on deck and stand guard. Although it may be wise to have at least one of us sit up front with Erenville, just in case.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_KRILE_000_073: I'd like to stay on the deck. I'm eager to put my pictomancy to the proof...
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_KRILE_000_074: And I'll take any chance to show you that I can hold my own on the battlefield!
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ALPHINAUD_000_075: Then Krile will stand on guard with .
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ALPHINAUD_000_076: Then Krile will stand on guard with .
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ALISAIE_000_077: I'll keep Erenville company, then. With my blade, I can respond more quickly to threats than Alphinaud.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ERENVILLE_000_078: Thank you. If a fight breaks out, I'll try to stay out of your way.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ALPHINAUD_000_079: Then I shall endeavor to provide aid where it is needed.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_080: I can do that as well!
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ERENVILLE_000_081: That should cover most eventualities. Secure your gear, and board the boat when you're ready.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_BAKOOLJAJA_000_083: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Let the hunt begin!
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_A1_000_002: Form a party and enter Ihuykatumu.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_090: We can't stand here all day debating the dangers ahead─we have a contest to win!
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ALPHINAUD_000_091: As Koana said, once we're on the boat, there'll be little room to fight and nowhere to run. We must be prepared for all manner of threats.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_KRILE_000_092: This should be a good opportunity for you to see how far my training has progressed!
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ERENVILLE_000_095: We'll take this smaller boat to board the big vessel with the punutiy.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ALISAIE_000_096: Koana decided the river route was too risky, but I wonder how the other claimants are planning to travel...
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ALISAIE_000_110: I was worried we might not catch up to you.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ERENVILLE_000_111: Those caverns you traversed were dug by the Yok Huy in their search for gold. Remnants of their excavations can be found throughout this region.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_112: While I appreciate the lesson, O wise guide, are we...ulp...landing this boat any time soon?
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ERENVILLE_000_113: Our river journey is almost over. For proof of that, you need only look ahead...
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ALPHINAUD_000_114: The falls were impressive enough from a distance, but it's almost too much now...
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_115: Yes, amazing... Now please let me off...
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_KRILE_000_117: Are you...? Oh, you're not alright.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ALPHINAUD_000_118: I should be surprised if she was. Even without the nausea, we're all spent.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ERENVILLE_000_119: There is a mountain shelter nearby─a resting spot for those who've ascended the stairs. I suggest we make use of it.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ALPHINAUD_000_120: That would be a welcome respite.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ALPHINAUD_000_121: Have you the strength for a short walk, Wuk Lamat? We can rest along the way, too...
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_123: A Promise is meant to lead from the front, not mewl and moan like a sick kitten...
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_124: ...Ignore me, it's the nausea talking. I'm fine, really. Lead on. I'll follow.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_KRILE_000_125: Very well. But if I might say one thing...
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_KRILE_000_126: Just because you're a Promise or a claimant for the throne doesn't mean you can't be seen to struggle. You needn't bear this burden alone, so please don't hesitate to talk to us. We're always willing to lend an ear.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_A2_000_001: Everyone's allowed to be weak sometimes!
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_A2_000_002: Leaning on others is a skill all leaders require.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_129: I've always believed this is my problem alone, but perhaps you have the right of it...
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_100_129: Alright. I'll talk about...things. Just give me a moment to collect my thoughts.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_KRILE_200_129: Of course. As long as you need.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ERENVILLE_300_129: We'll be waiting at the shelter when you're ready.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_125: I've long felt that I could never tell anyone when I was confused or hurting─that admitting to weakness would bring shame to Papa's name.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_126: But if you say you're willing to listen, then...there are things I'd like to talk about.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_100_126: Come on, let's catch up to the others.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_130: Now that I've decided to share, I feel so nervous...
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ERENVILLE_000_131: This place is called Many Fires for the constant stream of peddlers and travelers who make camp here after climbing the stairs.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_KRILE_000_132: This seems a cozy spot for Wuk Lamat to let her guard down. I know it can't be easy for her.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ALISAIE_000_133: This side of the region is so different from where the Hanu live. The striking colors of the vegetation alone...
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ALPHINAUD_000_134: We should stop here for the night.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ALPHINAUD_000_135: I understand the desire to rush ahead, but we need to recuperate from our punishing river adventure.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ERENVILLE_000_136: Then let's settle in. We'll need a cookfire, and there's meal preparation to be done.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ERENVILLE_000_140: It is good to see Wuk Lamat more sure of herself.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_KRILE_000_141: I'm glad we could take a moment to talk things through. Wuk Lamat seems much happier for it.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ALPHINAUD_000_142: I have some small experience with the pressures of leadership─and crumbling beneath its weight, as you well know. If anything good can be said to have come of my failures, I hope it is my capacity to help others avoid similar mistakes.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_ALISAIE_000_143: It doesn't matter if Wuk Lamat's scared of alpacas or gets sick on boats. It doesn't change who she is or what she means to her people.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_144: Being able to say those things has brought me such relief. It's like a stone has been lifted off my chest, and I can take a full breath at last.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_WUKLAMAT_000_145: I don't want to encumber myself like that again. I want to be better─will be better. For myself and for my people.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_SYSTEM_000_150: You may now enter Ihuykatumu with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_KRILE_000_005: I'm glad we could take a moment to talk things through. Wuk Lamat seems much happier for it.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_ALPHINAUD_000_010: I have some small experience with the pressures of leadership─and crumbling beneath its weight, as you well know. If anything good can be said to have come of my failures, I hope it is my capacity to help others avoid similar mistakes.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_ALISAIE_000_015: It doesn't matter if Wuk Lamat's scared of alpacas or gets sick on boats. It doesn't change who she is or what she means to people.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_ERENVILLE_000_020: The Moblin settlement of Earthenshire is not far from here, but be warned: the road we'll be taking is a favored hunting ground for bandits.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_ERENVILLE_000_021: With the stairs currently impassable, there'll be fewer travelers, meaning the brigands will be desperate for victims to ambush.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_ERENVILLE_000_022: Although considering present company, I suppose my concern is unwarranted.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_WUKLAMAT_000_023: Bandits on the road? What have Zoraal Ja and the Landsguard been doing!?
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_WUKLAMAT_000_024: Seems it's up to me to restore order to the area!
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_ERENVILLE_000_025: And off she goes again... For now, we'll head west and aim for the bank of the second river.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_ERENVILLE_000_030: The bandits' lair is said to be somewhere near here, but I'd prefer we avoid seeking out trouble.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_KRILE_000_035: Oh, I see─this is the river which feeds the waterfalls above Ok'hanu.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_ALPHINAUD_000_040: Again and again, I am struck by the majesty of the falls. It is difficult to comprehend the sheer volume of water this natural wonder produces.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_ALISAIE_000_045: I felt eyes on us several times as we made our way here, though they soon seemed to lose interest.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_ERENVILLE_000_051: Apparently they're not foolish enough to attack a party of this size.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_ERENVILLE_000_052: Earthenshire is just a little farther ahead, on the opposite bank of Miyakabek'zoma, but let's remain vigilant all the same.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_KRILE_000_065: Goodness me! It's like the entire village is made of pottery!
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Even as Hanuhanu culture is distinct from the Vanu, Moblin society has developed quite differently to that of their goblin cousins.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_ALISAIE_000_075: Not another claimant in sight. Does that mean we're ahead...or behind?
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_ERENVILLE_000_080: This is it─the village where the Lay of Pots from the Tuliyollal Saga took place.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_ALPHINAUD_000_081: Earthenshire... Idyllshire... Might the similarity be a cultural inclination, I wonder.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_ALISAIE_000_082: The settlements themselves couldn't be more different, though. This shire appears custom-built to resemble pots, while the other is a repurposed town.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_REDIROQ_000_083: (-Elderly Moblin Woman-)Pfff... Pfffkohhh... Welcome to Earthenshire! Do I have the pleasure of happygreeting the Third Promise and her retinue?
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_WUKLAMAT_000_084: That's us. We're looking for the Dawnservant's elector, if you happen to know who that is.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_REDIROQ_000_085: You are exchanging tongueflaps with her right now. Rediroq is the elector you seek.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_WUKLAMAT_000_086: Oh, that's helpful! We can cut straight to performing the feat!
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_REDIROQ_000_087: As much as Rediroq would like to do just that, we have a much more pressing worry.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_REDIROQ_000_088: The storm which hit our village shattered the cliffs and dropped rocks on our braincases! Many helphands for the potsworn were injured. This is no time for feats or mettletests!
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_WUKLAMAT_000_089: I'm sorry to hear that. After learning what the storm did to the stairs, I feared you'd been caught in its path. Uh, not to change the subject, but...what are the “potsworn”?
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_ERENVILLE_000_090: Goldsmiths contracted to work for the Moblins. The word comes from the pot-like workshops where they practice their craft.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_ERENVILLE_000_091: The Moblins provide these potsworn with tools, materials, living quarters─everything the artisans could possibly need. This allows them to concentrate on producing what is widely known as the finest gold- and metalwork in Tural.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_PAPAWNI_000_092: (-Disappointed Artisan-)This is unacceptable. I was promised no distractions!
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_PAPAWNI_000_093: (-Disappointed Artisan-)If this is the best they can offer, I should have never left Wachumeqimeqi...
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_REDIROQ_000_094: You see? The potsworn desert us! Without enough healthy helphands, we are failing to uphold our side of the potpact!
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_REDIROQ_000_095: Should all our potsworn leave, Earthenshire will grind to a halt! We have to do something, and do it soon!
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_WUKLAMAT_000_096: Then let us stand in for the injured helpers! It would give me the chance to learn more about your people and your village, and if it brings us closer to beginning the feat, then all the better!
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_WUKLAMAT_000_097: This isn't strictly part of the contest, so don't feel obligated to join in. Take a rest while you can.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_WUKLAMAT_000_099: I was hoping you'd say that! I actually wasn't sure I could do this on my own.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_ERENVILLE_000_100: We'll all help. I doubt any of us could just sit around and watch.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_ERENVILLE_000_101: What  means to say is we'll all help. I doubt any of us could just sit around and watch.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_WUKLAMAT_000_102: I was hoping you'd feel that way! I actually wasn't sure I could do this on my own.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_REDIROQ_000_103: We'll take every helphand we can get. Rediroq truthswears that once the potsworn have their perfect workshops again, we will commence the feat with all haste!
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_REDIROQ_000_104: You and the Third Promise can assist helphand Rakorok.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_REDIROQ_000_105: You other four, follow Rediroq. There are other helphands in need of hand-lending!
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_WUKLAMAT_000_106: I really appreciate you pitching in.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_WUKLAMAT_000_107: I meant what I said at Many Fires. There'll be no more feigning strength. No more playing at being an invincible Promise.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_WUKLAMAT_000_108: If there's one thing I've learned on this journey, it's how practiced you are at aiding those in need.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_WUKLAMAT_000_109: And I mean to make the most of having such an incredible mentor at my side!
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_WUKLAMAT_000_110: Now, let's find this Rakorok fellow and see what we can do for him.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_WUKLAMAT_000_120: I think I've found our helphand. First we'll solve this problem for the Moblins, then we'll see about completing their feat!
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_RAKOROK_000_130: Pfff... Pfffkohhh... Rakorok can't meet his obligations without more helphands! The potpact is broken and the pots are emptying!
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_RAKOROK_000_131: You've come to aid Rakorok!? Rakorok accepts your hand-lending with joyous feelsmiles!
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_RAKOROK_000_132: If we can offer the potsworn their promised goodliving, we might save the day yet.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_WUKLAMAT_000_001: First we'll solve this problem for the Moblins, then we'll see about completing their feat!
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_RAKOROK_000_003: Pfff... Pfffkohhh... What Rakorok needs is for new helphands to create goodliving for potsworn Kaahe.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_RAKOROK_000_004: The helphand assigned to Kaahe was hurt during the rockrain, so Rakorok took over...but he knows nothing of Kaahe.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_RAKOROK_000_005: What does Kaahe want? What does Kaahe need? Helphands do not bother the potsworn with straightasks! Our job is to observe and anticipate─to prepare things with guessthink!
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_RAKOROK_000_006: Please, guessthink with Rakorok. Find out what Kaahe is lacking so we can provide it!
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_RAKOROK_000_009: Kaahe is only one of many potsworn in need of caretaking. We work through the night with no sleep and no rest, but there are too few of us to go around!
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_WUKLAMAT_100_010: This is where Kaahe works, is it?
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_WUKLAMAT_200_010: Let's take a peek inside, then.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_WUKLAMAT_000_010: That must be Kaahe. It'd be a lot quicker if we could just talk to him, but that's not the way they do things around here, apparently.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_WUKLAMAT_000_011: We'll have to leave him be, and try our hand at some “guessthink.”
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_SYSTEM_000_012: Inspect the workshop. You may move the camera, as well as zoom in and out. Target a point of interest and examine it in more detail with .
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_WUKLAMAT_000_021: Alright, after taking a good look, I think I have an idea of what things Kaahe might want to improve his working conditions.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_WUKLAMAT_000_022: Let's head back outside and talk to Rakorok.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_WUKLAMAT_000_024: Come on, let's share what we observed with Rakorok!
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_RAKOROK_000_025: Pfff... Kohhh... You made your observations? What did you guessthink?
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_WUKLAMAT_000_026: First off, I noticed Kaahe hasn't touched his food, and an empty belly can't be good for his concentration.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_WUKLAMAT_000_027: Maybe the cooking isn't to his liking?
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_RAKOROK_000_028: But our food is very mouthpleasing! Why wouldn't he want to eat it?
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_RAKOROK_000_029: Argh, but Rakorok is sure of nothing when it comes to Kaahe's tastes!
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_WUKLAMAT_000_030: I can help you with that. My brother Koana is also Hhetsarro, and while everyone has their personal preferences, there are some they tend to share.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_WUKLAMAT_000_031: Like an aversion to piping hot dishes. If it was brought to him like that, Kaahe probably wouldn't have been able to eat until it cooled down, and by the time he came back to it, he might've found it cold and unappetizing.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_WUKLAMAT_000_032: The simplest solution is to serve dishes that taste good no matter the temperature!
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_RAKOROK_000_033: Rakorok never would have thought of that! Would the Third Promise mind explaining these things to our cook?
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_WUKLAMAT_000_034: Not at all. But I don't think that was the only reason Kaahe couldn't concentrate.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_WUKLAMAT_000_035: The Hhetsarro homeland is hot and dry, but even Kaahe seemed to be suffering in front of that furnace. Is there any way you could cool down the workshop?
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_RAKOROK_000_036: Oh, we could try a draftyshard. They make a lovely breeze!
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_WUKLAMAT_000_037: Do you know where we can get one of those?
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_RAKOROK_000_038: You can gather them from the Shoals of No Return. There are many old boats there, abandoned by those who gave up on their search for the golden city.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_WUKLAMAT_000_039: So we salvage them from the wrecks. Could you handle that for us, ?
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_WUKLAMAT_000_040: Oh, and one more thing. From what I could tell, Kaahe's files and saws and things were very worn down─maybe a new set of tools is in order?
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_RAKOROK_000_041: Ahhh! Rakorok was too preoccupied with stocking materials─a serious oversight which he will rectify! Supplying good tools for goodliving is a helphand's responsibility!
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_WUKLAMAT_000_042: Then we all have work to do! We can meet back here when our tasks are done.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_RAKOROK_000_043: The Shoals of No Return are past the crags, through a tunnel southeast of here. You should be able to spot the passage from just outside the village!
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_KOANA_000_045: You're , aren't you? What brings you out here?
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_KOANA_000_046: Ah, the issue with caring for the potsworn.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_KOANA_000_047: When they approached me with that same problem, I suggested they commission artisans in Sharlayan instead. The quality of craftsmanship would be guaranteed, after all.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_KOANA_000_048: However, the Moblins did not care for the idea.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_KOANA_000_049: Surely, it would be more effective to engage a uniformly trained collective. I cannot understand their fixation on individual contracts...
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_THANCRED_000_050: Perhaps the custom will make more sense once we begin the Feat of Pots.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_THANCRED_000_051: Until then, we've been deemed unfit to assist in the matter of “helphands,” and are instead tasked with tending the injured. We were on our way back from procuring herbs for Urianger, in fact.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_KOANA_000_052: Settlements in Kozama'uka, too, have been isolated by the storm's destruction. What would have become of the wounded had we not found a way here?
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_KOANA_000_053: Should I become Dawnservant, one of my first acts will be to establish reliable trade routes to the capital. When I imagine how much good we can achieve with Sharlayan technology...
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_KOANA_000_054: My apologies─I have much to consider.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_THANCRED_000_056: We'll meet again soon, I'm sure. Take care, .
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_SYSTEM_000_057: You spot the tunnel opening. Head through the passage to the Shoals of No Return and recover the draftyshard.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_SYSTEM_000_058: This crystalline shard is faintly warm to the touch. It does not appear to be the wind crystal you seek.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_SYSTEM_000_059: This crystalline shard feels damp in your hand. It does not appear to be the wind crystal you seek.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_SYSTEM_100_059: This crystalline shard emanates a soothing whisper of wind. It seems you've found the crystal Rakorok sent you to salvage.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_RAKOROK_200_059: Pfff... Pfffkohhh... Is that a cool breeze Rakorok feels?
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_RAKOROK_000_060: Yes! Thank you for seekfinding a draftyshard! Rakorok will add it to the new set of tools he brought.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_WUKLAMAT_000_061: And I come bearing good food tidings! The cook has prepared a feast fit for the most discerning Hhetsarro, and it's on its way even as we speak!
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_WUKLAMAT_000_062: Let's go in and see what Kaahe thinks of our efforts.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_KAAHE_000_063: I was wondering what occasion called for me to receive so many visitors...
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_KAAHE_000_064: A fine meal, new tools, and a welcome source of cool air─now I remember why I signed a potpact!
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_KAAHE_000_065: I am grateful for your kind considerations. Allow me a moment or two, and I'll reciprocate with a piece worthy of a potsworn.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_KAAHE_000_066: An oil lamp to brighten the halls of Vollok Shoonsa. The craftsmanship satisfies Earthenshire's reputation for quality, I trust?
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_RAKOROK_000_067: Pfff... Kohhh... Such luster! Such brilliance! Truly a gift fit for the Dawnservant!
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_KAAHE_000_068: I'm glad you like it. Considering the time I've wasted till now, I hope to continue crafting at this improved pace.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_KAAHE_000_069: I have a contract to fulfill, after all!
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_KOANA_000_071: Lamaty'i, I am told the elector has deemed the crisis past, and is prepared to task us with the feat.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_WUKLAMAT_000_072: That's great news! Thank you for letting me know!
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_KOANA_000_073: So this is the craft of a potsworn. It is indeed a masterful piece.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_KAAHE_000_074: Thank you for your words of praise, Second Promise. I drew inspiration from Kozama'uka's natural beauty and sought to capture it in my work.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_KOANA_000_075: I wondered why the Moblins did not simply build a workshop in the city, and now I have my answer...
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_KOANA_000_076: Even Sharlayan goldsmiths could not easily replicate such exquisite artistry.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_KAAHE_000_077: One cannot create great things if one lacks creative impetus. Tuliyollal, fortunately, does not want for inspiration. Anyone wishing to learn the basics of a craft would do well to study it there.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_KAAHE_000_078: I was raised among Hhetsarro more traditional than most, and the shared ingenuity of Tural's various peoples was eye-opening.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_KOANA_000_079: You lived as a traditional Hhetsarro? I have few fond memories of nomadic life...
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_WUKLAMAT_000_085: I tried a serving of the dish we prepared for Kaahe. It was so good, I had a second helping!
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_KOANA_000_086: Would that I could forget that time...
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_RAKOROK_000_087: Pfff... Pfffkohhh... Rakorok is very grateful to you!
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_RAKOROK_000_088: I thank you for both your hard work and clever guessthink. When it comes to helphanding, knowing the potsworn really is important!
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_WUKLAMAT_000_089: Well, that's true for pretty much everyone you meet. It's a lesson I've had drummed into me several times already on this journey.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_001: I tried a serving of the dish we prepared for Kaahe. It was so good, I had a second helping!
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_RAKOROK_000_002: Pfff... Pfffkohhh... Rakorok will see that potsworn Kaahe's lustrous oil lamp is delivered to the palace at once!
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_KOANA_000_003: The elector bids the claimants assemble in the large building on the west side of the village. I will head over after finding Thancred and Urianger.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_KOANA_000_004: Ah, I also ran into the Leveilleur twins on the way here. I took the liberty of directing them to the venue.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_005: We're rivals. It's not his job to make sure I know the feat is starting. But even now, he's conscientious to a fault...
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_006: Anyway, let's not keep Rediroq waiting!
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_RAKOROK_100_006: Pfff... Pfffkohhh... Rakorok is thankful potsworn Kaahe did not quitleave like the others! He thinks you will have no hardtimes with the coming feat!
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_007: I thought everyone would be here by now.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_REDIROQ_000_010: Pfff... Pfffkohhh... Rediroq thanks you for assisting helphand Rakorok!
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_REDIROQ_000_011: She will announce the feat once the other claimants arrive, so please be patient a little while longer.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ALPHINAUD_000_020: I'm happy to report that we were able to convince one of the potsworn to stay. How did you fare?
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ALPHINAUD_000_021: So you managed to do the same. Splendid.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_MOBLINEXPED04882_00: Pfffkohhh... Welcome to Earthenshire, First Promise! We support your plans for saltcrossings and the new potsworn they will bring!
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_MOBLINEMOTION04882_: Hail the mighty Zoraal Ja! He cleared many piles of rockfall as if they were pebblestones! The Resilient Son for Dawnservant!
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_THANCRED_000_024: Zoraal Ja was clearing fallen rocks? I'm surprised he would volunteer his time for anything unrelated to the contest.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_BAKOOLJAJA_000_025: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Well, well, we meet again.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ALISAIE_000_026: Just in time for the feat to begin. I'll bet he was already here, laying low while the rest of us did all the work.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_REDIROQ_000_027: Pfff... Pfffkohhh... Claimants, your attention please!
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_REDIROQ_000_028: As Rediroq has explained, many of our potsworn left us following the storm.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_REDIROQ_000_029: The precious metalwork crafted by those artisans bring in much jinglyshine from across the salt! Should our stream of trade goods dry up, Earthenshire will suffer! Tuliyollal merchants will suffer!
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_REDIROQ_000_030: So Rediroq sets you this feat: each of you are to find one cleverhand goldsmith to bring back here to us!
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_031: So we're to recruit new potsworn. Makes sense for the Feat of Pots.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_SAREELJA_000_032: Calling this a “feat” does not justify taking advantage of the claimants and their influence. How does finding workers for you demonstrate their worthiness for the throne?
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_REDIROQ_000_033: You are free to refuse Rediroq's request. She will be happy to inform the Dawnservant of Zoraal Ja's disqualification!
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ZORAALJA_000_034: The rite is a means to an end. The steps we take to get there are not important.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_REDIROQ_000_035: Then Rediroq declares the Feat of Pots begun! But remember: a potpact must be agreed to willingly. No grabsnatching or deceitful tongueflaps!
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_BAKOOLJAJA_000_036: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)The elector said nothing of taking a willing artisan from a rival...
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_BAKOOLJAJA_000_037: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)...which is exactly what we should do.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_BAKOOLJAJA_000_039: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)A fine suggestion, Brother!
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_BAKOOLJAJA_000_040: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)I'm glad you think so, Brother. Come, let us lay our plans!
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ALISAIE_000_041: That nasty brute is up to something...
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ALPHINAUD_000_042: Aye, he may seek to delay us again as he did on the river. We can but remain vigilant while we plot our course.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_KRILE_000_043: What do you think, Wuk Lamat? Have you any candidates in mind to satisfy this feat?
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_044: I know some artisans amongst my supporters, but they're all in their twilight years.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_045: I couldn't ask them to give up the comforts of Tuliyollal to live in this remote village─no matter how beautiful the scenery.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_046: Meanwhile, Koana probably has a hundred young craftspeople to choose from...
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_047: Not that I'm comparing us, you understand! That's just statement of fact.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_048: Hmmm. I suppose we could try asking around Wachumeqimeqi...?
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ALPHINAUD_000_049: That seems a logical place to start. Back to Tuliyollal it is!
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_050: Wait... Does that mean we have to take the boat again?
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_051: No, no, no! I can't do it! I can't stomach another boat ride!
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_100_051: You said I should share my burdens, so I will speak plainly.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_300_051: ...I get really, really sick on boats.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ERENVILLE_200_051: Wuk Lamat, this is hardly news...
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_KRILE_000_052: But it was brave of you to admit. In any case, we won't be fighting the current this time! Heading downriver will be much smoother.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ERENVILLE_100_055: I've procured many unusual items for clients, but meeting the personalized needs of a potsworn is not an experience I'd care to repeat.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_KRILE_200_055: Wuk Lamat suffers such terrible bouts of seasickness. I wish I had a spell or potion that could ease her nausea...
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ALPHINAUD_300_055: Did we mention the potsworn in our care required a constant stream of encouragement in order to craft?
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ALPHINAUD_400_055: The four of us must have chanted the same cheer dozens, if not hundreds, of times. Erenville was scolded more than once for not cheering loudly enough.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ALISAIE_500_055: What obstacle will Bakool Ja Ja throw at us next? Or will he try something more direct...?
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_055: Ugh... I need a moment... Upriver or downriver, Ihuykatumu is too rough for me...
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_056: The nausea is a bit more bearable now that I've stopped trying to hide it, but I'd still rather not set foot on a boat if I can help it...
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_00_057: Alright...I think I'm ready. Let's see if Master Ropli can help us recruit a potsworn.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_060: Phew... The fresh harbor air was just what I needed.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ERENVILLE_000_061: Wachumeqimeqi is a gathering spot for skilled artisans of all kinds. If we're to find a potsworn candidate, I can think of no better place to begin our search.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_KRILE_000_062: So this is the Wachumeqimeqi that Wuk Lamat was talking about. I had yet to make it this far in my wanderings.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ALPHINAUD_000_063: Erenville brought us here on our first tour of the city, but time did not permit a close look. I should like to observe these masters at work.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ALISAIE_000_064: Surely at least one person will answer Wuk Lamat's call for a potsworn. Maybe Master Ropli can help us.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ROPLI_000_066: Greetings, Third Promise. What brings you back to Wachumeqimeqi? You've not chipped your axe again, have you?
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_067: No, Master Ropli. Actually, I have a favor to ask...
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_068: So what do you think? Do you know of any craftsmen who might be interested?
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ROPLI_000_070: Filching my artisans for the Moblins, eh? Well, seeing as it's the Third Promise making the request, I'm willing to look the other way if one of them decides to take you up on the offer.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ROPLI_000_071: Only, I can't think of a suitable candidate off the top of my head. Who do I know with a mastery of goldsmithing that would also have no qualms about relocating to Earthenshire...?
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_A1_000_001: That Eorzean goldsmith... What about him?
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_A1_000_002: What of the Elezen man who just started working here...?
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_073: You mean Fonjeantaine? He did say he was employed at some fancy jewelry store across the salt.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_074: And considering the distance he's already come, I'd like to think he wouldn't mind moving a little up the river.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_075: That said, he's only just got himself a new job. Is it too soon to ask him to sign a potpact?
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ERENVILLE_000_076: There's no harm in making the offer. Once he hears how well the potsworn are treated, he may even jump at the chance.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ROPLI_000_077: Either way, you won't find Fonjeantaine at his workbench at this hour. He's finished for the day. Probably enjoying a meal over at Xbalyav Ty'e.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_078: Then maybe we should go and talk to him. Just you and me, since he knows us. Wouldn't want him to feel intimidated by having to deal with a crowd of new faces.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_079: The two of us can handle this. Take a rest at the cabins, if you like.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_080: Right! Let's go and see a man about a pot!
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_090: Ugh, I'm still not sure about this...
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ROPLI_100_090: When Fonjeantaine first arrived, the ways of our city were so new and confusing for him. It's funny how quickly people get used to things, though.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_FONJEANTAINE_000_09: Oh, , you're here too. The Third Promise said she wanted to chat. I've just finished eating, so shall we find a quiet spot outside?
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_092: The last time we talked on this beach, you were in a miserable state.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_FONJEANTAINE_000_09: Ahahaha, yes, I was, wasn't I? A lost soul... Until the two of you came along and helped me rediscover my purpose.
My new place of employment has been most welcoming, and for the first time in a long time, I feel content with my lot in life.
So, what is it you wished to discuss?
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_097: Well, it's hard to ask this right after you've settled in...but I'm looking for someone to become a potsworn.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_FONJEANTAINE_000_09: Ah, I've heard my new colleagues mention the term. That's when an artisan signs a contract to work for the Moblins, isn't it? But...you're not a Moblin. I'm not sure I understand.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_099: It's for a feat in the rite of succession. I need to bring a new potsworn to Earthenshire.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_FONJEANTAINE_000_10: So that is the way of it.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_101: We've barely met, and after pushing you to work at Wachumeqimeqi, I'm now demanding you throw that away and sign a potpact instead. It's a selfish request, I know.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_FONJEANTAINE_000_10: I have something to tell you, Third Promise.
The other day, I completed the necessary procedures for immigration. I'm pleased to say I am now an official subject of Tuliyollal.
I've since endeavored to learn what I can of my new nation, beginning with the rite of succession and its claimants─including you, of course.
Now, you will recall it was my father's example which led me to pursue goldsmithing.
He was at East End when Garlean forces laid siege to the settlement. And in the ensuing chaos, he was slain.
War took him from me in an instant. The man I loved and admired. I never wish to suffer such a loss again...
And so, as much as I'm indebted to you for turning my life around, it is as a fellow peace-loving Tuliyollan that I want you to win the throne.
If I can help you achieve that by signing a potpact, then I shall gladly do so.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_FONJEANTAINE_000_11: I shall return to Master Ropli and inform him of my decision.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_112: Allow me. I'm the reason you're leaving, so I should be the one to deliver the news.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_BRUKEVU_100_113: Perhaps you remember me? Br'uk Evu, owner of Xbalyav Ty'e? I'd like a word, if you don't mind.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_BRUKEVU_000_113: You're Wuk Lamat's ally from across the salt, right? And a hero of some renown, too, if the gossip's to be believed.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_BRUKEVU_000_114: Well, as it so happens, I could use some heroic help. It doesn't need to be right now, but could you come by when you have a spare moment?
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_BRUKEVU_000_115: Much appreciated! I'll be waiting for you at my shop, then.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_SYSTEM_000_116: You can now gain access to role quests! Speak with Br'uk Evu at Xbalyav Ty'e, and pursue new adventures as you progress through the rite of succession.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ROPLI_000_120: I see you managed to find Fonjeantaine.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_FONJEANTAINE_000_12: It feels ungrateful to leave so soon after Master Ropli granted me employment, but surely he'll understand... I do this for the future of Tuliyollal!
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_122: Master Ropli. I'm sorry to have to tell you this, but, uh...
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ROPLI_000_123: Fonjeantaine has agreed to sign the potpact, yes?
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ROPLI_000_124: While it is a shame to lose a capable goldsmith, to have one of our own handpicked to serve the Third Promise is a great honor for Wachumeqimeqi.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ROPLI_000_126: Of course, if you happen to know other talented artisans, regardless of their expertise, I hope you send them my way.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ROPLI_100_126: It could even be yourself, if you're so inclined.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_FONJEANTAINE_000_12: Though my time here was brief, I will not forget your kindness, Master Ropli. I am blessed to have these workshops be my first home in Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ROPLI_000_129: Come back to us if the Moblins cut you loose. You'll always have a job at Wachumeqimeqi.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_FONJEANTAINE_000_13: I expect you'll want to leave for Earthenshire as soon as possible. I'll go and pack my things.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_ALPHINAUD_000_131: (-Alphinaud-)What became of Fonjeantaine? Were you able to find him?
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_132: We did, and he's agreed to become a potsworn. We'll leave when he's ready, but you still have a little time.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_WUKLAMAT_000_134: I had plenty of reasons to win the contest, but now I have one more. Fonjeantaine's putting his faith in me, and I won't let him down!
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_SYSTEM_000_135: You may now unlock deliveries for Wachumeqimeqi. Speak to Ropli, and pursue new endeavors as you progress through the rite of succession.
TEXT_KINGMB104_04883_WUKLAMAT_000_002: Right then, I have some things to take care of at the palace.
TEXT_KINGMB104_04883_WUKLAMAT_000_003: While you can pass the time however you like, I'd suggest you head back to the cabins.
TEXT_KINGMB104_04883_WUKLAMAT_000_004: After all, even heroes need to rest, and we still have a big journey ahead of us!
TEXT_KINGMB104_04883_PESHEKWA_000_011: Welcome back, . You've had a Landsguard messenger most anxiously waiting on your return.
TEXT_KINGMB104_04883_MESSENGER04883_100_: of the Third Promise's entourage? I've been all over the city looking for you.
TEXT_KINGMB104_04883_MESSENGER04883_000_: The Dawnservant summons you to the palace. You are to present yourself to the gate guard stationed outside Sunperch at your earliest convenience.
Oh, and one more thing: you are not to mention this visit to Wuk Lamat.
TEXT_KINGMB104_04883_GATEKEEPER4883_000_: The Dawnservant awaits you within. While I was not informed of the reason for your audience, in terms of attire, I would suggest full battle regalia.
TEXT_KINGMB104_04883_SYSTEM_000_030: You must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 92 or above to proceed.
TEXT_KINGMB104_04883_WUKLAMAT_000_040: If he had his way, Papa would keep dueling until the day he dies.
TEXT_KINGMB104_04883_WUKLAMAT_000_041: Even now, I know of only three people who didn't need to be carried away after their bouts: Zoraal Ja, your lance-wielding friend Estinien, and yourself.
TEXT_KINGMB104_04883_WUKLAMAT_000_042: You really do live up to your fearsome reputation!
TEXT_KINGMB104_04883_WUKLAMAT_000_043: I'm curious, though. Did Papa want anything else of you?
TEXT_KINGMB104_04883_WUKLAMAT_000_045: Well, if that's all it was...
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKLAMAT_000_001: I still haven't had one bite of Namikka's food thanks to Papa's nonsense, so I'm going back to finish my plate before I head out.
