TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKLAMAT_000_002: I've otherwise asked everyone to meet at the For'ard Cabins. Come and join us after you've had a moment to recover, eh?
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_Q1_000_000: Await your companions and continue with the rite of succession?
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKLAMAT_000_007: Is that it? You're all set to go?
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_FONJEANTAINE_000_00: I left Eorzea prepared to travel in search of work, so I had few belongings to begin with. Bidding farewell to my fellow artisans took rather a lot of time, however.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKLAMAT_000_009: Again, I appreciate you making this commitment, Fonjeantaine.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Shall we depart for Earthenshire, then?
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKLAMAT_000_012: Wuk Evu, what are you doing here?
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKEVU_000_013: Ahhh! I spend my days correcting manners, and here I am perpetrating the grave offense of delaying the Third Promise's departure!
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKEVU_000_014: Please, take up your axe and rend my flesh unto taco meat!
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKLAMAT_000_015: Must your demands be so gruesome!? Besides, I told you that kind of thing doesn't bother me!
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKEVU_000_016: All right, then. I won't let it bother me either.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKEVU_000_018: I'd come to the city to purchase supplies when I spotted your entourage getting ready to leave. You seek the city of gold, if I'm not mistaken?
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKLAMAT_000_019: That's right─it's the final step of the rite of succession. If you know anything about the subject, I'd love to hear it.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKEVU_000_020: Then allow me to be of service. As you know, legends of the golden city have been passed down in Tural for a thousand years.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKEVU_000_021: Yet when it comes to describing the place itself, the stories do not always agree. Some portray it as one might expect: a glittering metropolis of golden towers. Others suggest it is more unassuming and owes the name to a fabulous treasure hidden at its heart.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKEVU_000_022: Every telling, however, has a common thread: those who go in search of the golden city do not return.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKEVU_000_023: The lesson to be learned from this, Third Promise, is that to seek the legend is to court death. I must implore you to proceed with the utmost care.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKEVU_000_024: That is all I wished to say. I shall pray for your safe journey.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ERENVILLE_000_026: What are we to make of these cautionary tales? If every expedition has ended in tragedy, how then did the Dawnservant find the city and return without incident?
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_KRILE_000_027: It seems the legend originated with the Yok Huy. Speaking with them remains our strongest lead, I feel.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ALPHINAUD_000_028: A lead we shall follow in time. But first, let us see Fonjeantaine safely into the Moblins' care.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKLAMAT_000_030: We're back, and we've brought with us a willing potsworn. This is Fonjeantaine, a talented goldsmith who once worked at Eshtaime's Aesthetics in Ul'dah.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_REDIROQ_000_031: Wonderful! Impressive! You are first to return, Third Promise!
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_REDIROQ_000_032: And with an artisan from across the salt, no less! We welcome you and your unique skills to Earthenshire. Helphand will show you to the Workpot.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_FONJEANTAINE_100_03: This is it, then. I look forward to hearing you proclaimed Dawnservant!
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKLAMAT_000_033: Thank you, Fonjeantaine. I'll be sure not to disappoint you.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_REDIROQ_000_034: You have reachmet the requirements of the Feat of Pots. Rediroq presents your keystone with joysmiles and wellwishing!
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_REDIROQ_000_036: Pfff... Pfffkohhh... More potsworn candidates!? Come, come, tell Rediroq your tales!
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_KOANA_000_037: Another feat accomplished, another keystone acquired.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_SAREELJA_000_038: Ohohoho, you are doing well. I expected nothing less of Zoraal Ja's esteemed siblings.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_SAREELJA_000_039: Your cleverness in particular is most admirable, Second Promise. We must have you apply that Sharlayan knowledge you so cherish, and arm Tural with weapons of magitek design.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_SAREELJA_000_040: ...In your role as the new Dawnservant's chief advisor, of course.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_KOANA_000_041: The tools of war hold no interest for me. I wish only to improve our nation through practical innovations.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_KOANA_000_042: Foreign powers will think twice about testing our strength once Tuliyollal is known for its advanced technology.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_KOANA_000_043: Just as the Garlean Empire was deterred from invading Sharlayan.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_SAREELJA_000_044: That may well be true... But how long will it take Tuliyollal to progress to this advanced state? How many years?
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_KOANA_000_045: With a collective commitment to education and hard work, it should not take so very─
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ZORAALJA_000_047: Easier to expand our territory...and swallow Sharlayan whole.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_THANCRED_000_048: Conquer other nations through force of arms, and you're looking at a future of uprisings and bloodshed. Yours wouldn't be the first failed empire.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ZORAALJA_000_049: Then we keep fighting, until the mounting costs convince them to lay down their weapons. Until all have grown tired of loss.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKLAMAT_000_050: How would such an outcome bring anyone joy!? What you propose is a mockery of peace!
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_REDIROQ_000_051: Pfff... Pfffkohhh... Rediroq is reminded of days long ago.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_REDIROQ_000_052: In the time before Tuliyollal, there were no potpacts for the potsworn. It was normal to grabsnatch artisans, and force them to work for Mobbies.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_REDIROQ_000_053: Until the day Gulool Ja Ja arrived. The families of the grabsnatched pleaded with him, and so he came to Earthenshire.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_REDIROQ_000_054: Mobbies are not a warmake people. We feared death had come for us, but Gulool Ja Ja just wanted to talk!
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_GULOOLJAJA_000_055: (-Vow of Reason Gulool Ja Ja-)Be at ease. We are here to trade words, not blows.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_GULOOLJAJA_000_056: (-Vow of Reason Gulool Ja Ja-)The goldwork crafted in this village is superb. One can tell at a glance the quality of materials used; the mastery of technique employed.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_GULOOLJAJA_000_057: (-Vow of Reason Gulool Ja Ja-)Yet it does not stir the heart. A goblet shaped by bound hands and broken spirit is devoid of luster.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_GULOOLJAJA_000_058: (-Vow of Reason Gulool Ja Ja-)Compare that now to the works of a joyful artisan. She pours her very soul into her creations, and they shine like the newly risen sun. Have you not seen this to be true?
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_REDIROQ_000_059: And so began the custom of goodliving. Happy potsworn make good works, and good works make Mobbies happy!
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_REDIROQ_000_060: Gulool Ja Ja's words were wise! Joysmiles did indeed bring fine craft and much jinglyshine!
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_KOANA_000_061: So the Head of Reason was behind the forging of potpacts...
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_REDIROQ_000_062: Yes! Reason and cleverthink changed Mobbies' way of life!
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_SAREELJA_000_064: The First Promise tires of your talk of olden days. He would rather look to the future, and the next feat.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_KOANA_000_065: We should be getting on as well.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ALISAIE_000_066: Bakool Ja Ja never did come back, did he?
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_RAKOROK_000_067: Pfff... Pfffkohhh... Do you have a moment, Third Promise?
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_RAKOROK_000_068: Rakorok would repay you for handhelping with Kaahe. He brings a tale of the golden city!
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKLAMAT_000_069: Really? I'd love to hear it!
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_RAKOROK_000_070: The towers, the streets, all fashioned from gold. Everywhere you look, every splendor you can imagine!
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_RAKOROK_000_071: The young, the old, and everyone in between, they live in golden happiness. A city of eternal bliss, forever perched above the clouds!
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKLAMAT_000_072: Everything fashioned from gold, eh? And just imagine everyone living in golden happiness─now that's a city I'd like to visit!
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_KRILE_000_073: Excuse me, Rakorok, where did you hear that particular tale?
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_RAKOROK_000_074: From our longtime Yok Huy friends! They live up in the mountains, in Urqopacha.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKLAMAT_000_076: Seems everything is pointing us their way!
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKLAMAT_000_077: This feat and everything leading up to it has taught me much about the Moblin way of life. I'll be sad to leave Earthenshire and your joysmiles behind!
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ERENVILLE_000_080: These tales raise many questions... Let us hope the giants have answers.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_KRILE_000_081: The stories describe a place of boundless happiness, but are also rife with dire warnings of seekers who did not return. What are we to make of this...?
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ALPHINAUD_000_082: It unsettles me that Zoraal Ja is even a claimant in the first place. Surely his father cannot condone his violent ambitions...
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ALISAIE_000_083: The Head of Reason in Rediroq's story sounds so different from the Head of Resolve. They share the same body, yet their personalities are wholly distinct.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_REDIROQ_000_084: Worry not for potsworn Fonjeantaine! He is in good helphands!
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKLAMAT_000_085: Right, we should go and see the giants next!
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ERENVILLE_000_086: Agreed. Golden mysteries notwithstanding, their village is featured prominently in the saga and is not to be ignored.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ERENVILLE_000_087: The Urqopacha highlands should be easy enough to reach from here.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ERENVILLE_000_088: If we leave Earthenshire from the west, there's a road which leads up into the mountains. Let's find that first.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ERENVILLE_100_089: This road will take us through the mountains to the Urqopacha highlands. An exhausting route, perhaps, but a straightforward one.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_KRILE_200_089: We're to meet with the Yok Huy at last...
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ALPHINAUD_300_089: The highlands are where the Lay of Proof took place─that being Gulool Ja Ja's encounter with the Yok Huy.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ALPHINAUD_500_089: But 'tis also the stage for the Lay of Ice, where heroes fought the monstrous Valigarmanda. I am most curious to know what the rite will demand of us there...
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ALISAIE_600_089: One day we're sailing up rivers, and the next we're hiking up mountains.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKLAMAT_000_090: Looks like the trail is going to get steep from here on in. I hope everyone is ready for some climbing!
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WAWKESA_000_092: (-Bright-haired Tonawawtan Man-)I'm glad I caught you... Rediroq asked me to bring you back to the village.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WAWKESA_000_093: (-Bright-haired Tonawawtan Man-)She says there's something she forgot to give you.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKLAMAT_000_094: Huh...? Something other than the keystone?
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WAWKESA_000_095: (-Bright-haired Tonawawtan Man-)Yes, an item of great importance, or so I was told. It shouldn't take long, if you would please follow me.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_WUKLAMAT_000_096: I wonder what this is all about? Well, no need for everyone to come─I'll be back in a little while!
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_REDIROQ_100_100: Pfff... Pfffkohhh... Moblins are busy ensuring goodliving for new potsworn! Rediroq has no time for idle tongueflaps!
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_KRILE_000_100: He had rather interesting hair for a Hyur...or should I say Tonawawta? In any case, strange that I never noticed him while we were in Earthenshire.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ERENVILLE_000_101: Knowing Wuk Lamat, she was probably eating sweets behind our backs and forgot to pay the shopkeeper or something equally careless.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ALPHINAUD_000_102: I'm eager to continue to the highlands and meet a Yok Huy face-to-face. We've heard much about them, but I'm not entirely sure what to expect.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ALISAIE_000_103: That man seemed familiar somehow... But I just can't place him.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_KRILE_000_104: This is taking quite a while... Just keep waiting for now, I suppose.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ALPHINAUD_000_110: Perhaps there were complications? Well, let us wait a little longer.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ALISAIE_000_120: This is getting a little ridiculous. Did she get lost on the way back to find us?
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_KRILE_000_121: But how? There's only the one road.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ERENVILLE_000_122: I wouldn't underestimate Wuk Lamat's sense of direction...or lack thereof.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ALPHINAUD_000_123: Fortunately, she has a linkpearl. Let's see what's keeping her, shall we?
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ALPHINAUD_000_124: She's not responding... Perhaps we should all return to Earthenshire.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ALPHINAUD_000_125: 'Twas Rediroq who had business with her, yes?
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_KRILE_000_130: She doesn't seem to be here...
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ERENVILLE_000_131: I'd thought Wuk Lamat was just being her usual impulsive self, but now I'm not so certain...
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ALPHINAUD_000_132: I pray naught untoward has befallen the Third Promise.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ALISAIE_000_133: Something's not right. I can feel it...
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_REDIROQ_000_134: Pfff... Pfffkohhh... Back again so soon?
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ALPHINAUD_000_135: We've come looking for Wuk Lamat. Did you not send someone to fetch her?
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_REDIROQ_000_136: Rediroq did not! Neither has she seen the Third Promise since you were last here.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_KRILE_000_137: Then who was that man who came for her...?
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_THANCRED_000_138: Oh? I thought you'd left already.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_KOANA_000_139: Where is Lamaty'i? Is she not with you?
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_KOANA_000_140: You don't know where she is? How could you let this happen!?
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_URIANGER_000_141: That thou shouldst worry for thy sister is understandable. Yet rather than assign blame, thine energies are better spent on locating her.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_KOANA_000_142: I will help you search. This is not how I'd wish a fellow claimant to lose the contest─my sister least of all.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_THANCRED_000_143: In that case, dividing our forces will allow us to cover more ground.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_KOANA_000_144: and I should work together at least, the better to facilitate communication between our groups.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_ALPHINAUD_000_145: Then the rest of us will split up. Report in should you find anything.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_THANCRED_000_146: We'll be on our way as well.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_REDIROQ_000_001: This is most worrisome! If Rediroq hears anything, she will let you know!
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_002: If Lamaty'i was returning to Earthenshire from the west, then she should have passed through here...except Rediroq swears she didn't see her.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_003: In which case, 'tis entirely possible that Lamaty'i never made it back to the village at all.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_004: The only way to be certain is to ask the sentry stationed at the opposite entrance.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_010: If the guard did not see Lamaty'i, then we can be fairly sure she's not in Earthenshire. She's not one to pass without notice.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_MOBLINGUARD04885_00: Pfff... Kohhh... The Third Promise? Mobbie has been standing at his post with diligent eyewatchings─he has seen no claimants pass this way.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_012: What of a Tonawawta with brightly colored hair?
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_MOBLINGUARD04885_00: Mobbie knows something of this one! He hears tongueflaps about a Pelu peddler in Many Fires who was attacked by a crazyhair bandit on the road!
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_014: A bandit, you say...? Thank you, you've been most helpful.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_100_014: My sister is clearly not here. Though I wish it were otherwise, we must consider the possibility that the Tonawawtan messenger and the brigand described by the sentry are one and the same, and that Lamaty'i is in very real danger.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_015: Come, let us hurry to Many Fires. I'd like a word with this peddler should they still be around.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_020: Here, . This is the merchant who ran afoul of the bandit.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_MOBLINGUARD04885_10: Pfff... Kohhh... Mobbies' bandit problem is only getting worse!
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_PELUPELUPEDDLER0488: Was there something I could help you with...?
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_022: I'm told you were the victim of a bandit attack. Could you recount exactly what happened?
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_PELUPELUPEDDLER0488: My goodness─I thought I recognized you! I'll tell you everything I remember, Second Promise!
It was that scoundrel Wawkesa who ambushed me.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_025: You know the name of your attacker?
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_PELUPELUPEDDLER0488: There's no mistaking that hair. All my peddler friends have stories of that notorious bandit leader and his predations.
Wawkesa and his gang will stoop to any low for the sake of a few pel. And with no fresh quarry coming up the broken stairs, they've had to become more creative.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_028: Little wonder he went after Lamaty'i. He likely thinks to ransom her for a royal sum.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_029: I expect he'll soon make his demands...but I don't intend to wait. We'll find this villain first, and deliver his deserved payment in person.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_030: What say you to a small deception? I will assume the role of a well-to-do merchant to lure Wawkesa out of hiding. Then, when he comes sniffing about, we catch the rat by the tail.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_PELUPELUPEDDLER0488: An excellent plan! And I have just the right garments for your disguise─at a specially discounted price, of course!
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_032: A brush with bandits hasn't dampened your mercantile spirit, I see. Very well, I accept your generous deal.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_034: I will precede you into Many Fires to make my presence known. You follow on behind, boasting to those along the way how you paid me a hefty purse in exchange for a rare gemstone or some such.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_035: If Wawkesa is as coin-hungry as they say, then a recently enriched peddler should be an irresistible mark. We let him strike, and then we spring our trap.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_PELUPELUPEDDLER0488: I pray that your scheme is successful!
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_MOBLINMOOD04885_000: Pfff... Kohhh... Mobbie enjoys being helphand for potsworn, but it's exhausting work. He hopes to find amusing distractions here in Many Fires!
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_PELUPELULIVELY04885: I'm always on the lookout for new opportunities─you need to keep an ear out if you want to succeed in business!
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_SYSTEM_100_044: Follow Koana's lead and try not to fall behind.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_046: Share with him how happy your imaginary deal with me has made you. Once you've put on an appropriate display, we can continue to our next performance.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_050: We want Wawkesa to notice us─be loud and convincing.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_XBALAALKIND04885_00: Something I can do for you, friend?
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_SYSTEM_100_051: You have the kind-eyed Xbr'aal's full attention. Play the role of a happy collector, who has acquired a rare and expensive gemstone.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_XBALAALKIND04885_00: A rare gemstone from that Hhetsarro merchant, you say? I envy the profit he must have made from such a sale! Since the stairs were destroyed, I've not been able to peddle goods at my usual haunts!
Are you...confused? I know I am.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_SYSTEM_000_054: The Xbr'aal is unsure of the message you're trying to convey. Play the role of a happy collector, who has acquired a rare and expensive gemstone.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_XBALAALKIND04885_00: I would advise that peddler to keep an eye out for shady characters. Rumors of good fortune have a way of attracting bandits in these parts.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_061: A good start, but I would make certain Wawkesa is aware of me. Let's continue.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_062: That Moblin over there looks amenable to conversation. The stage is yours, .
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_070: Share your “good fortune” with that Moblin merchant too, if you would. We need to make sure these rumors attract Wawkesa's notice.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_MOBLINMOOD04885_000: Pfff... Kohhh... What can Mobbie do for you?
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_SYSTEM_100_071: You have the enthusiastic Moblin's full attention. Play the role of a happy collector, who has acquired a rare and expensive gemstone.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_MOBLINMOOD04885_000: Pfff... Kohhh... The Hhetsarro sold you a sparklestone for your collection?
Well that explains your giant joysmiles! Mobbie is happy for your happiness! Mobbie is also jealous of the merchant and all the jinglyshine he must have made!
Pfff... Kohhh... Whatever you are doing, Mobbie would like you to stop!
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_SYSTEM_000_075: The Moblin is unsure of the message you're trying to convey. Play the role of a happy collector, who has acquired a rare and expensive gemstone.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_MOBLINMOOD04885_000: Pfff... Kohhh... Be careful when trading tongueflaps around here. There are sneaky, greedy brigands who will get bigeyes and grabsnatch that merchant's jinglyshine...and your sparklestone, too!
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_081: That should be enough...but perhaps one last act to drive it home.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_082: Do you see that cheerful Pelu? Tell him the tale of your precious gemstone, and then we'll be done with this part of the charade.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_090: Just this one last performance, I promise.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_PELUPELULIVELY04885: How nice to see a smiling face! Care to share the reason for it? I've heard nothing but mumblings and grumblings since that storm passed through!
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_SYSTEM_100_091: You have the cheery Pelu's full attention. Play the role of a happy collector, who has acquired a rare and expensive gemstone.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_PELUPELULIVELY04885: A passing peddler had the very gemstone you sought for your collection!? That is a stroke of luck!
And I'll wager the merchant was just as pleased to fill his pockets with your grateful coin, eh?
Well, I'm inspired to go and earn some pel of my own. Who knows? Maybe opportunity will find me, even as it found you!
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_095: Ah, my most valued customer. The profit from that single purchase of yours should see me through weeks of idle leisure!
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_096: Traveling with such a fat purse and no sellswords is tempting fate, so I shall make Earthenshire my last stop and then return forthwith to Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_097: Did you see? The rat has come for a nibble.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_PELUPELULIVELY04885: Hm? What am I to make of this!?
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_SYSTEM_000_099: The Pelu is unsure of the message you're trying to convey. Play the role of a happy collector, who has acquired a rare and expensive gemstone.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_100: You played your part to perfection, . A  of many talents, just as Thancred and Urianger described.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_KOANA_000_101: Now let us lure Wawkesa out and spring our trap.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_KOANA_000_001: Let us execute the final stage of the plan.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_KOANA_000_002: I will set out towards Earthenshire alone and unarmed, the better to sell the act of a defenseless merchant. Assuming Wawkesa is watching, he will likely wait for some quiet stretch of the road before accosting me.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_KOANA_000_003: I'll be relying on you to follow closely behind, remaining hidden until the time comes to spring the trap on our bandit king. Just remember: we need him alive.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_KOANA_000_010: Wawkesa will tell us what he's done with Lamaty'i.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_WAWKESA_000_011: I hear business has been good to you, master merchant. How about you share some of the profits?
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_WAWKESA_000_012: And by “some,” I mean every coin you have!
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_WAWKESA_000_013: Y-You're that gemstone collector... Oh, I see what this is. We've been tricked!
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_WAWKESA_000_014: Spit in your eye! Men─kill these vidraal!
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_KOANA_000_015: Slippery vermin. We'll have to interrogate his underlings instead.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_KOANA_000_016: If you would be so kind, . Pray leave them capable of speech.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_KOANA_000_020: I would assist you, but alas, I am unarmed.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_KOANA_000_030: I was hoping to talk with your boss, but I suppose you three will have to do.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_SHETONATHIEF04885_0: Wait... That's the Second Promise! What do you want with us!?
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_HHETSARROTHIEF04885: Think I'm scared of a fancy title? I'll take your royal ears as a trophy...as soon as I get free of these ropes!
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_KOANA_000_033: I know your gang is behind my sister's abduction. Tell me where she is.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_SHETONATHIEF04885_0: Eat 'paca shit, saltlover! You'll get not answers from us!
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_HHETSARROTHIEF04885: That's right! We don't serve you!
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_KOANA_000_036: Do not play games with me. Where is Wuk Lamat!?
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_KOANA_000_037: I am fast losing patience. Talk now or die. The choice is yours.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_HHETSARROTHIEF04885: <gulp> W-We were hired to nab the Third Promise, that's all. We don't know where they took her...
We weren't told that either. Only Wawkesa knows─he's the one who took the job.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_KOANA_000_041: Well, it seems we needed their leader, after all.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_KOANA_000_042: Once I've arranged for the Landsguard to take custody of these criminals, I'll call on Thancred and his tracking skills. But perhaps you could pursue Wawkesa in the meantime?
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_KOANA_000_043: The bandit was running in an easterly direction. Should you locate him, I suggest you shadow him rather than force a confrontation─he might lead us to where Lamaty'i is being held.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_KOANA_000_050: Go after Wawkesa. I'll watch these miscreants until they can be taken into Landsguard custody.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_SYSTEM_000_060: Follow Wawkesa from a distance. The objective will end in failure if you are noticed or fall too far behind.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_SYSTEM_100_060: Should your quarry begin displaying the effect shown in the picture, you will be discovered when he turns around. To avoid detection at these times, make use of cover such as rocks and trees.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_SYSTEM_110_060: The objective will also end in failure if you follow too closely. Keep your quarry in sight, but avoid stepping into the detection circle.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_SYSTEM_000_061: Should you fail to complete the objective, you may try again by returning to the designated location.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_WAWKESA_000_063: Finally! My money─give it to me now. The Landsguard may be hunting us already!
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_HOOBIGOBAKOOLJAJAMI: (-Shady Hoobigo-)Calm yourself. We had our own troubles finding a suitable hideaway.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_WAWKESA_000_066: We're finished. Take your prize and leave me out of the rest!
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_HOOBIGOBAKOOLJAJAMI: (-Shady Hoobigo-)Such hostility. You were hurting for coin, and I offered you gainful employment out of the kindness of my heart.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_WAWKESA_000_068: Kindness!? You brought a blackened tempest upon us!
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_WAWKESA_000_069: One look, and I could tell that  was a killer. A butcher. A salted devil in the flesh.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_HOOBIGOBAKOOLJAJAMI: (-Shady Hoobigo-)Oh, spare me your fearful bleating. Go on! Scamper away now before the scary mercenary comes to claim your head.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_THANCRED_000_071: (-Thancred-)Koana told me the news. You've found the abductor, then? What's the situation?
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_THANCRED_000_072: (-Thancred-)And you think the bandits were hired by this Hoobigo?
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_THANCRED_000_073: (-Thancred-)Alright, new strategy. Forget Wawkesa and stay on the Mamool Ja's tail. We don't want to endanger the Third Promise, so keep your distance until we're certain they have her.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_THANCRED_000_074: (-Thancred-)I'll catch up to you as soon as I'm able.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_SYSTEM_000_080: Follow the Hoobigo from a safe distance. The objective will end in failure if you are noticed, or if you fall too far behind.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_SYSTEM_000_081: Should you fail to complete the objective, you may try again by surveying the designated location.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_Q2_000_000: Attempt to follow the shady Hoobigo?
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_KOANA_000_090: I may have put rescuing Lamaty'i ahead of my own progress, but do not take that to mean I've given up on the contest.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_KOANA_000_091: You understand how important she is to me. Yet regardless of how close we were, I would have made this same choice.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_KOANA_000_092: After all, if I am incapable of saving my sister while also winning the throne, then I am not fit to inherit our father's heavy mantle.
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_KOANA_000_001: We need to gather our forces...
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_KOANA_000_002: Firstly, allow me to brief everyone on our present situation.
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_KOANA_000_003: ...Thus, at the very least, we believe this Hoobigo knows where Lamaty'i has been taken. Thancred is shadowing their boat even as we speak, and I should like to join him with all haste.
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_KOANA_000_004: Unfortunately, our quarry had the foresight to release your punutiy from its harness, leaving us without a means to give pursuit.
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_KOANA_000_005: Erenville. As an expert on wildlife, what are our chances of recapturing the beast?
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_ERENVILLE_000_006: With the right mix of feed, it can be done. I should like an extra hand to help scatter it about, however.
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_KOANA_000_008: Meanwhile, the rest of us should work on getting the harness repaired. It appears to have been damaged when the punutiy was let loose...
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_ALPHINAUD_000_009: With all the peddlers here in camp, we should have little trouble purchasing replacement materials. As for any necessary metalwork, Earthenshire's artisans are but a short walk away.
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_KOANA_000_010: Then let us divide the tasks and have at it.
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_ERENVILLE_000_011: There was an unusually aggressive herd of wild punutiys downriver, so our girl will have fled in the opposite direction. Come, we'll try the waters upriver.
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_ERENVILLE_000_020: Assuming our punutiy has come this way, she'll be hiding in the depths of Marsh Ligaka. We'll need to lure her back to the shallows with the promise of food.
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_ERENVILLE_000_021: Wild punutiys eat mainly aquatic grasses and plants, but the tame ones are often fed vegetable scraps.
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_ERENVILLE_000_022: Knowing this, I added leftovers to the feed I've prepared. This should help the mixture stand out against the marsh's natural scents.
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_ERENVILLE_000_023: Ligaka is crawling with predators, however, so I'll leave it to you to scatter feed deeper in. I'll be waiting for you near the shallows with the rest of our punutiy's enticing feast.
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_ERENVILLE_000_030: Come and let me know once you've scattered the feed.
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_SYSTEM_000_031: You scatter Erenville's punutiy feed along the water's edge.
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_ERENVILLE_000_035: All set? I've just finished laying out the last of the bait. Step back out of sight and leave the rest to me.
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_ERENVILLE_000_041: Shhh, there's nothing to be afraid of. We just need your help one last time.
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_ERENVILLE_000_042: You're hungry, I wager. Come on, come with me.
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_ERENVILLE_000_044: We'll be fine here, I think. I'll give her a few more treats, then lead her over to the boat. You can let Koana know we have our punutiy back.
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_ERENVILLE_000_050: Shhh, everything's alright now. Being alone in a strange river must have been frightening for you...
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_SYSTEM_000_052: The punutiy seems comforted by Erenville's scent.
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_KOANA_000_053: Erenville has the punutiy in hand, then? Good. I expected nothing less from a certified gleaner.
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_KOANA_000_054: As for the harness, we were able to purchase all the parts we need. The Leveilleur twins are over in Earthenshire right now, having the potsworn make the repairs.
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_KOANA_000_055: I'm told it shouldn't take long. We'll be ready to embark on our rescue mission as soon as we hear from Thancred.
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_KOANA_000_001: Thancred must know something by now...
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_KOANA_000_003: I had but to invoke his name. Thancred followed the Hoobigo's boat to its destination, and confirmed that they are indeed holding my sister captive.
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_KOANA_000_004: “They,” of course, being Bakool Ja Ja and his minions. I swear, I will make them regret this.
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_KOANA_000_005: Lamaty'i is in Richleaf tunnels. The moment the harness is repaired, we strap in the punutiy and make our way back down Ihuykatumu!
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_KOANA_000_010: I am glad to see you unharmed, Lamaty'i.
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_WUKLAMAT_000_011: Thanks again for coming to my rescue, Koana.
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_ALPHINAUD_000_013: Bakool Ja Ja must be desperate indeed to resort to such aggressive tactics.
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_WUKLAMAT_000_014: I shouldn't have been so careless. I underestimated him, and it cost me a keystone!
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_WUKLAMAT_000_015: Fonjeantaine upended his life so that I could accomplish the Moblin's feat. He believed in me─believed in my cause─and I've let him down!
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_A1_000_002: So we take back what was stolen!
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_A1_000_003: We won't let Bakool Ja Ja get away with this.
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_WUKLAMAT_000_017: You're right. It's not over till it's over!
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_WUKLAMAT_000_020: The next time I meet that brute, I'll knock him straight on his scaly behind and take back my keystone!
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_THANCRED_000_021: Speaking of vengeance, didn't Bakool Ja Ja curse some “useless Boonewa sycophant” when he caught sight of us?
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_KOANA_000_022: A reference to Sareel Ja, I would assume. He is devoted to our brother, and is the only Boonewa I know of participating in the rite of succession.
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_KOANA_000_023: If Zoraal Ja was somehow involved in this...
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_KOANA_000_024: I will never forgive him for putting our sister in danger! He will have forfeited his right to be called brother!
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_KOANA_000_025: Ahem... Bakool Ja Ja should face punishment, of course, but so must the bandits who had the temerity to abduct Lamaty'i.
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_KOANA_000_026: I shall request that Father send a contingent of Landsguard to enforce the law in this region.
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_WUKLAMAT_000_027: I agree that measures need be taken to keep travelers safe.
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_WUKLAMAT_000_028: But I wonder what pushed these people towards a life of banditry in the first place? If we dig deeper, we might find a way to improve things for everyone.
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_KOANA_000_029: ...'Tis something to think about. For now, however, the rite continues. I thank you all for your help.
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_ALPHINAUD_000_030: We should be moving on, as well. Are you feeling fit to travel, Wuk Lamat?
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_WUKLAMAT_000_031: You bet I am! Zoraal Ja's gained a good head start, and it's time we clawed back some lost ground!
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_KRILE_000_040: Koana is the picture of composure and rationality...except when it comes to matters concerning Wuk Lamat's safety. Far be it from me to fault a brother for being protective, but still.
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_ERENVILLE_000_041: The Wuk Lamat I once knew would have been inconsolable at the loss of a keystone.
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_ERENVILLE_000_042: This journey─and your companionship─is doing her a world of good.
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_ALPHINAUD_000_043: We'll need to take that keystone back from Bakool Ja Ja before we arrive at the city of gold. He will not relinquish it without a fight, though...
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_ALISAIE_000_044: Though they share a single body, it's obvious Bakool Ja Ja has two minds when you see one head calming the other head down.
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_ALISAIE_000_045: His personalities are as distinct as two individuals could be.
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_WUKLAMAT_000_046: I really am sorry this happened. From now on, I won't let my guard down around suspicious strangers.
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_WUKLAMAT_000_047: And again, I do appreciate you all coming to save me!
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_KRILE_000_001: Koana is the picture of composure and rationality...except when it comes to matters concerning Wuk Lamat's safety. Far be it from me to fault a brother for being protective, but still.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ERENVILLE_000_002: The Wuk Lamat I once knew would have been inconsolable at the loss of a keystone.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ERENVILLE_000_003: This journey─and your companionship─is doing her a world of good.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ALPHINAUD_000_004: We'll need to take that keystone back from Bakool Ja Ja before we arrive at the city of gold. He will not relinquish it without a fight, though...
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ALISAIE_000_005: Though they share a single body, it's obvious Bakool Ja Ja has two minds when you see one head calming the other head down.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ALISAIE_000_006: His personalities are as distinct as two individuals could be.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_000_007: The road beckons, friends! Let's be on our way to the Yok Huy!
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ERENVILLE_000_008: Then it's back to where the path through the mountains begins. You remember: the spot where you were tricked into walking off with Wawkesa?
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_000_009: Just going to rub my face in it like that, eh?
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_000_010: I wonder if he's raising my hackles on purpose, though. You know, trying to keep my anger directed at him instead of myself.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_000_011: Either way, we can't be standing around here all day. We have a lot of lost time to make up for!
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_KRILE_000_013: Erenville said this path will take us all the way to the Urqopacha highlands, didn't he?
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ALPHINAUD_000_014: Zoraal Ja will not have been wasting time while we were busy tussling with Bakool Ja Ja. We need to hurry.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ALISAIE_000_015: Those bandits must have been watching us from the moment we stepped off the riverboat... I knew I felt eyes on us.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_100_016: I couldn't leave without letting Rediroq know what happened, so I stopped in Earthenshire to say a few words before moving on.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_000_016: ...And now Erenville's nowhere to be seen! Couldn't he wait a few more moments!?
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_000_017: Hmph, so much for giving him the benefit of the doubt. Come on, let's catch up─I want to give that smug gleaner a piece of my mind!
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_KRILE_000_018: I worried Wuk Lamat would agonize over the loss of her keystone, but it seems I had nothing to be concerned about.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_000_021: <pant> <pant> I've never...climbed so high before... I'll tell Erenville off...once I catch my breath...
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_KRILE_000_022: The Yok Huy have a deep connection to the legend of the golden city. This visit will allow us to ask them about it directly.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ALPHINAUD_000_023: We have to be quite high up by now... Which makes me wonder how much higher the summit of Worqor Zormor must be.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ALISAIE_000_024: Seems those buildings up ahead are the village we're headed for.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ERENVILLE_000_025: As I'm sure you've noticed, the air grows thin at this elevation. Take it slow until your body adjusts. Deep breaths. Drink plenty of water.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ERENVILLE_000_026: A few more steps and we'll be in Worlar's Echo.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ERENVILLE_000_028: I knew the path led here, but I've never set foot in this village myself.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_KRILE_000_029: Thank the gods─they have an aetheryte. I don't fancy the idea of trudging up that mountain trail a second time!
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Everything here is giant-sized, but that structure in the back is on a different scale altogether. A temple of some kind, mayhap?
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ALISAIE_000_031: Chilly air. Stout stone construction. If I squint a bit, I might think I was in Ishgard for a moment.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_000_032: Phew... I think I'm getting used to the air up here.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_000_033: So this is the place from the Lay of Proof, where Papa met with the Yok Huy...
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_000_034: And that must be them. I don't think I've ever actually seen one outside of a picture.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ERENVILLE_000_035: So it is for most Turali. The giants rarely visit the lowlands.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ERENVILLE_000_036: Here, in their mountain fastness, they tend to the solemn duty they pledged to undertake in their pact with the Dawnservant─
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ERENVILLE_000_037: To watch over the tural vidraal Valigarmanda, and maintain its prison within their temple.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_KRILE_000_038: Ah yes, Wuk Lamat told us about the tural vidraal─creatures that live for far longer than normal and awaken to strange powers.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ERENVILLE_000_039: Indeed. Yet even among those anomalies, Valigarmanda is unrivaled in strength. It has endured for centuries, bringing catastrophe each time it emerges from its lair.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ERENVILLE_000_040: As you learned in the Lay of Ice, it was Gulool Ja Ja who at last managed to imprison the beast, and it has lain dormant in the temple ever since.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ERENVILLE_100_040: It's said the building still bears a gaping hole in its ceiling from when Valigarmanda was lured inside by Gulool Ja Ja's final ploy.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_000_041: I'd like to see this strongest of all tural vidraal. I wonder what it was like to fight it!
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ALPHINAUD_000_042: Worlar's Echo was where both the Lay of Proof and the Lay of Ice took place...
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ALPHINAUD_000_043: Does this not suggest we'll be facing two feats this time?
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_000_044: That's a question we can ask the elector once we find him. Or maybe we should flush out Bakool Ja Ja first so I can beat my keystone out of him...
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_A1_000_001: Identifying the Dawnservant's elector should be our priority.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_000_046: Damn right! Now, where to start looking...
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ALPHINAUD_000_047: Ahem. Perhaps the feats should take precedence while we're here? I am sure there will be other opportunities to confront Bakool Ja Ja.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_000_048: I suppose we do still have four keystones to earn. And no matter what we do, the contest will pit us against him sooner or later...
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_000_049: Alright, let's seek out the elector!
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ERENVILLE_100_049: Then I suggest we pay a visit to “Karryorzar the Gracious”─or so their temple is called. The Moblins told me that High Luminary Gurfurlur is to be found there. If we are to ask someone for information, then he seems a wise choice.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ERENVILLE_200_049: We'll need permission to enter the temple, but I expect it won't be a problem for the Third Promise.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_KRILE_300_049: While this is certainly an impressive building, it doesn't seem the sort of structure one would build to hold a tural vidraal...
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ALPHINAUD_400_049: The temple guards have been watching us most intently. One does not stroll freely into Valigarmanda's prison, it seems.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ALISAIE_500_049: Is it taboo to request entrance to the temple, you think?
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_YOKHUYGUARD04889_51: Who are you? What business have you at Karryorzar the Gracious?
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_600_049: Let's see if I can convince the guards to let us through.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_700_049: I am Wuk Lamat, Third Promise of Tuliyollal, and I seek your elector for the rite of succession. May I speak with Gurfurlur?
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_YOKHUYGUARD04889_80: The High Luminary has granted admittance to the claimants. You may enter.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_900_049: Huh. That was easier than expected. In we go, then!
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ZURMURWUR_000_054: He is not here, at present. I am Luminary Zurmurwur.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ZURMURWUR_000_056: It is. The tural vidraal whose name has evoked terror since time immemorial.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ZURMURWUR_000_057: Even my people, once conquerors of all beneath the sun, were as brittle leaves before Valigarmanda's tempestuous power.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ZURMURWUR_000_058: When the Skyruin descended upon Urqopacha eight decades ago, the casualties were staggering. Had Gulool Ja Ja and his companions not intervened, we would have been slaughtered to the last.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ZURMURWUR_000_059: Their titanic battle with Valigarmanda raged for ten days and ten nights.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ZURMURWUR_000_060: As their foe fought on, tireless and relentless, our heroes were pushed beyond the limits of their endurance.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ZURMURWUR_000_061: Thus did the Head of Reason concoct a desperate plan. Gulool Ja Ja tricked the Skyruin into losing control of its own ice magicks, causing the unwitting tural vidraal to encase itself in frozen aether.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_000_062: And it's been like this ever since. Nice work, Papa!
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_000_063: But...what happens if the ice ever melts?
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ZURMURWUR_000_064: That same question looms large in our minds, for the magicks sustaining this prison grow weaker with each passing year.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ZURMURWUR_000_065: Valigarmanda commands powers of fire and lightning and ice. Some believe that the violence of the recent storm was the result of those energies slipping free.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ZURMURWUR_000_067: Setting future worries aside, you are come to attempt the Feat of Proof, yes? The High Luminary, chosen elector of the Dawnservant, has left me with instructions for all aspiring claimants.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ZURMURWUR_000_068: You are to scour our forbidding mountains, and find the waiting Gurfurlur. That is to be your challenge.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ALPHINAUD_000_069: Ah, so the search itself is the feat.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_000_070: You've already spoken with my brothers, I take it?
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ZURMURWUR_000_071: I have. Their expeditions are underway.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_000_072: Then we'd better pick up the pace!
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ALPHINAUD_000_073: Aye, but we'll need a direction to search in first. Let's see what hints we can gather from the villagers.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ERENVILLE_000_086: I've encountered many extraordinary creatures in Eorzea and elsewhere, but long has it been since I've felt such an overwhelming presence─like a thousand dagger points pricking my skin.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_KRILE_000_087: I sensed the recent expulsion of a great deal of aether from Valigarmanda's prison. The ice will hold for but a few years more, I fear.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ALPHINAUD_000_088: As large as the Yok Huy are, seeking blindly for one in the expanse of these mountains would be an exercise in futility. We need more information.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_ALISAIE_000_089: Tural vidraal sound an awful lot like the auspices of the Far East. Are they the same thing under a different name, do you think?
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_000_090: Gods, Valigarmanda is enormous! I know Papa had friends with him, but it's incredible he could hold his own against that thing.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_WUKLAMAT_000_091: Should its prison ever fail, though, we can't expect the old guard to come running. It'll be up to us to save the day...
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_WUKLAMAT_000_001: If we want to pass this feat, it looks like we've got more climbing ahead of us!
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ERENVILLE_000_005: I've encountered many extraordinary creatures in Eorzea and elsewhere, but long has it been since I've felt such an overwhelming presence─like a thousand dagger points pricking my skin.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_KRILE_000_010: I sensed the recent expulsion of a great deal of aether from Valigarmanda's prison. The ice will hold for but a few years more, I fear.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ALISAIE_000_015: Tural vidraal sound an awful lot like the auspices of the Far East. Are they the same thing under a different name, do you think?
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ALPHINAUD_000_020: As we've just been informed, the Feat of Proof requires us to seek the High Luminary Gurfurlur somewhere upon these mountains.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ALPHINAUD_000_021: However, if earlier feats are any indication, we must assume the challenge precludes the Yok Huy from answering our questions in a straightforward manner.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ALPHINAUD_000_022: Thus I would ask that you pay close attention while attempting to divine Gurfurlur's whereabouts.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ALPHINAUD_000_023: Though the giants may not give us a precise location, there may be clues hidden within their words. Such is my theory, anyway. Let us see what we can discover.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_WUKLAMAT_000_030: The Yok Huy are bigger than I imagined. Side by side, they'd make even a Hanu look small.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ALISAIE_000_035: This wall is covered in Yok Huy writing. I wonder what it says...
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_KRILE_000_040: From what I've seen of them so far, the Yok Huy seem a gentle and reserved people.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ERENVILLE_000_045: They grow corn here, too. It's a common crop wherever you go─including up north in Xak Tural.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ALPHINAUD_000_050: When you've finished asking around, we can meet back where we started.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_YORGERWOR_000_055: The High Luminary? No, I've not seen him today.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_YORGERWOR_000_056: Now let me ask you a question. That Xbr'aal who came out of the temple earlier... Was that really the Third Promise?
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_YORGERWOR_000_057: She seems rather unimposing. How is she meant to succeed the mighty Gulool Ja Ja?
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_YORGERWOR_000_060: Zoraal Ja was far more impressive. He exudes the same sense of indomitable strength as his father.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ZURFERLAR_000_065: Asking after the High Luminary as well, are you? I know not where to find him, but I do hope you have the opportunity to speak together.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ZURFERLAR_000_066: He is a great man, with a deep reverence for our traditions. These glyphs we carve, for one─he affords them as much value as any treasure we possess.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ZURFERLAR_000_067: They are records of lives lived. Your arrival, too, I will etch into the stone, that the story of our meeting may endure for untold turnings of the sun.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ZURFERLAR_000_068: If you are curious about our ways, then I bid you visit Proof, to the northwest of here. It is one of our gravesites.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ZURFERLAR_000_070: Go to Proof. The stones will help you understand my people.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ZERBORLOR_000_075: A Tuliyollan? ...No, you are from farther away than that, I think.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ZERBORLOR_000_076: As for the High Luminary, I can only guess where he might be. He is warder of the Skyruin, but also keeper of the sepulchres, and his duties often take him outside the village.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ZERBORLOR_000_080: As we receive few visitors, it is not often that I speak Turali. I am glad for the chance to keep in practice.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ALPHINAUD_000_090: First things first. Was anyone able to coax forth a definite location for the High Luminary?
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ALPHINAUD_000_091: As expected. What, then, of clues or other hints that might point us in the right direction?
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_WUKLAMAT_000_092: I heard that in addition to his usual duties, Gurfurlur is also charged with keeping the graves.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_KRILE_000_093: As did I. The Yok Huy's sepulchres appear to hold a special significance in their culture.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ALPHINAUD_000_094: Hm. But would it be appropriate for us outsiders to enter into their burial grounds...?
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ALPHINAUD_000_095: “Proof,” you say. And he encouraged you to visit this place yourself?
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_WUKLAMAT_000_096: Then let's go and take a look. Even if we don't find Gurfurlur there, it will give us the chance to learn more about the Yok Huy!
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_KRILE_000_097: The gravesite is somewhere northwest of here? Well, we can leave from that side of the village for a start. Shall we?
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_KRILE_000_110: The others have gone on ahead to Proof, following the trail west. There are sharp drops everywhere, so we're all moving at our own pace. Some of us are not built for craggy terrain...
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_KRILE_100_110: I thought to get my bearings from up here first so I don't stumble off a cliff. Why don't you try catching up to Erenville? He should be able to point you in the right direction.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_KRILE_200_110: Is that Proof, way over there...?
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ALISAIE_000_105: It's not quite mountain climbing, but these steep slopes are exhausting enough...
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ALPHINAUD_000_120: These have the look of homes rather than graves, but 'twould seem long years have passed since anyone living resided here.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ERENVILLE_000_125: Take a look at this crater. There is no wood, no trees, not even dried grass, and yet the ground still burns.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ERENVILLE_000_126: This must be one of the scars left by Valigarmanda's rampage, as told by the saga.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ERENVILLE_000_127: The Skyruin's fires are described as eternal─flames that can be quenched by neither storm nor time. And here I thought it a literary embellishment.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ERENVILLE_000_128: Ah, but now I've lost sight of Wuk Lamat. Proof is northwest along the main road, so hopefully she's still heading the right way...
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ERENVILLE_000_145: “A world you cannot experience alone.” Is that what her journey with the Dawnservant showed her? Something that I, too, might find...?
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_WUKLAMAT_200_155: Heh heh, Wuk Lamat wins again!
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_WUKLAMAT_100_155: Looks like everyone is here now, so...
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_YOKHUYQUIET04890_00: No, I am not. The High Luminary did, however, task me with providing a lesson on sepulchres to those who came in search of him.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_WUKLAMAT_000_157: Oh, so we were meant to find our way here after all. Are you to tell us who is buried here?
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_YOKHUYQUIET04890_00: No one is “buried” here in the sense you mean. When a body has served its purpose, we consign it to the flames, then scatter its ashes across the peaks.
Moreover, we do not conceive of death as others do. For us, a person does not die when their heart ceases to beat, but only when they are no longer borne in the hearts of all who know them.
This is why we build our sepulchres before age or mishap claims us─that we might etch ourselves into the living chronicle for all eternity.
This grave belongs to a good friend. His mortal vessel ended its journey some years ago, but he lives within me, even now.
Up there stands my own sepulchre.
As long as it exists, so too will I. I will endure in the hearts of those who read my grave glyphs, in the same manner my friend does in mine.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_KRILE_000_165: Has it always been thus for your people? This conception of existence and death?
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_YOKHUYQUIET04890_00: Continue along this path to the Indelible Passage. Behold the history upon its walls, and you may find the answers to your questions.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_WUKLAMAT_000_167: Then that's what we'll do. Your traditions are fascinating, and I'd love to know more!
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_YOKHUYQUIET04890_00: I thank you for allowing me to share them, for in doing so will I remain in your hearts also.
Go now to the Indelible Passage. In its murals is the history of my people laid bare.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_YOKHUYHONEST04890_0: I've been waiting for you.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ALISAIE_000_180: I get the feeling they were expecting us...
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_KRILE_000_185: To not only be remembered, but to live on inside the hearts of others...
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_KRILE_000_190: If it's possible, then Grandfather surely lives on inside mine. 'Tis a comforting thought.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ERENVILLE_000_195: I've never spoken with a Yok Huy before, and had no idea they held such a philosophy on life and death.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ALPHINAUD_000_200: Look at these splendid murals! They appear to depict four different scenes...
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_WUKLAMAT_000_205: Hello! A fellow we met at Proof suggested that we come here...
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_YOKHUYHONEST04890_0: Yes, the High Luminary commanded that I watch for your arrival. As the chroniclers of our people, it has ever been my family's duty to pass on the teachings of the murals from generation to generation.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ALISAIE_000_207: They really are magnificent. And together they tell the tale of your people's history?
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_YOKHUYHONEST04890_0: They are the events which shaped us. I would share them with you ere you continue on your way.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_WUKLAMAT_000_209: Please! We would love to hear all about it.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_YOKHUYHONEST04890_0: Then I will begin.
This first mural depicts a time more than eleven hundred years ago. An age of great prosperity for the Yok Huy...
Blessed with size and strength unmatched by other peoples, our ancestors marched forth and brought much of Yok Tural under their dominion.
Then, when all before them had been conquered, they turned their gaze northwards, seeking to expand their territory and power.
Here we see the expedition to Xak Tural. Unable to cross the strait by ship, our forefathers set to building a bridge to the northern lands─a grand labor which consumed the greater part of a century.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_WUKLAMAT_000_215: Zorgor the Boundless. We still make use of that bridge in Tuliyollal for travel. I can't imagine the patience and dedication it took to complete a work of that scale.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_WUKLAMAT_000_216: But I've never heard of any Yok Huy living in Xak Tural. What happened to the ones who went north?
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_YOKHUYHONEST04890_0: Look upon this next mural and behold the answer.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_KRILE_000_218: The scene suggests that many giants perished all at once. What manner of enemy could have repelled their invasion?
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_YOKHUYHONEST04890_0: A foe unnamed and unseen. When the expedition pushed forth into Xak Tural those thousand years ago, its soldiers were felled by disease.
No. No virulent plague or newly arisen blight. For the local Tonawawta and Shetona, it was but a mild affliction of the sort that comes with the turning of the seasons.
What manifested for them as slight fevers and coughs, however, proved deadly to our people.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_YOKHUYHONEST04890_1: Out of every ten Yok Huy who joined that northern campaign, nine succumbed to the infection. Those who survived continued to suffer, finding it difficult to sire offspring.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ERENVILLE_000_223: I've heard of this before. Lacking an inherited resistance, visitors to distant lands can fall deathly ill to diseases a local might shrug off.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ALPHINAUD_000_224: These events might also have given rise to the practice of cremation, rather than the burial, of mortal remains.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_YOKHUYHONEST04890_0: This final mural depicts the return of our grieving brethren to Urqopacha.
The reason they first left─why they had fought so long and pushed so far─was to ensure peace for our homeland.
This undertaking began in ancient times. When our forebears learned they shared the continent with peoples unalike to us in appearance or custom, they feared invasion was inevitable.
Rather than meekly await their fate, they decided to strike the first blow. Yet as they fought on and on, the old idea of peace drifted further and further away.
Only after the disaster in Xak Tural and their withdrawal to the mountains did they come to understand...

The peace we envisioned had been ours for the taking all along. It was here, in the place which birthed us; here, in the stones upon which we recorded our days; here, in this tranquil life we had traded for conquest and conflict.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_WUKLAMAT_000_231: When you do nothing but fight, it can blind you to what's right before your eyes...
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_YOKHUYHONEST04890_0: And so we return to the present. I trust you found this brief history of our people enlightening?
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_WUKLAMAT_000_233: I'm always glad to learn more about my fellow Turali─how you've lived until now, and how you wish to live from now on!
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_YOKHUYHONEST04890_0: Then I believe you are ready to proceed. The High Luminary bids you meet him upon the summit of Worqor Zormor.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_WUKLAMAT_000_235: I had a feeling we'd end up scaling that big old mountain... Well, it's a feat worthy of the name!
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_YOKHUYHONEST04890_0: Follow the trail south of here to begin your ascent, but be wary: beyond the entryway, the mountainside is home to ferocious beasts both mundane and otherwise.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_WUKLAMAT_000_237: We'll keep that in mind! Thank you for the warning─and the lesson!
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_WUKLAMAT_000_238: Finally, we know where we're going─to the top of Worqor Zormor!
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_WUKLAMAT_000_240: If I'd known we'd be climbing Worqor Zormor, I might not have raced up and down all those trails. My feet are killing me.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_YOKHUYHONEST04890_0: Your genuine interest in our history is...refreshing.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ALISAIE_000_245: <pant> This thin mountain air...is going to be the death of me...
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ALISAIE_000_246: Wha─ How long have you been standing there!? I was just taking in the scenery, is all!
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ALISAIE_100_246: Come on─we don't want to fall too far behind Alphinaud and the others!
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_KRILE_000_250: The true size of a mountain is never more apparent than when you're standing right at its foot...
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ERENVILLE_000_255: I fear I won't be of much use to you as a guide past this point. Even in Tuliyollal, there is precious little written about the sacred peak of Worqor Zormor. Beyond whimsical poetry, that is.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ALPHINAUD_000_260: I cast a rejuvenating spell on Wuk Lamat. Even our indomitable Third Promise is feeling the strain of these slopes.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_ALISAIE_000_265: I hope we come across Bakool Ja Ja on our way to the summit─we still owe him for the troubles he caused us in Kozama'uka.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_WUKLAMAT_000_270: You remember how the chronicler was saying that the more they fought, the further away they moved from their idea of peace?
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_WUKLAMAT_000_271: It occurs to me that if Zoraal Ja is attempting the Feat of Proof, then he will have heard that same lesson.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_WUKLAMAT_000_272: I can only hope that it's made him reconsider his own stance on “educating” people through war.
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_KRILE_000_001: The true size of a mountain is never more apparent than when you're standing right at its foot...
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_ERENVILLE_000_005: I fear I won't be of much use to you as a guide past this point. Even in Tuliyollal, there is precious little written about the sacred peak of Worqor Zormor. Beyond whimsical poetry, that is.
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_ALPHINAUD_000_010: I cast a rejuvenating spell on Wuk Lamat. Even our indomitable Third Promise is feeling the strain of these slopes.
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_ALISAIE_000_015: I hope we come across Bakool Ja Ja on our way to the summit─we still owe him for the troubles he caused us in Kozama'uka.
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_VORPORLOR_000_020: I set out to kill Tuliyollal's favorite daughter this day. To be aided by her instead was...unexpected.
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_VORPORLOR_000_025: I will not harm you or yours until this debt is repaid.
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_ALPHINAUD_000_030: I will tend to this one's wounds. Go on ahead with the others.
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_ERENVILLE_000_035: As I've said before, I am no fighter. I'll follow from a distance and keep well out of your way.
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_A1_000_002: Form a party and enter Worqor Zormor.
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_WUKLAMAT_000_040: We'll be seeing you soon, Gurfurlur!
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_KRILE_000_045: That bird must roost somewhere on the mountain. We'll need to be wary of the skies, as well.
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_ALISAIE_000_050: While I didn't mind guarding Erenville on the river, I look forward to swinging a blade on the front lines this time!
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_WUKLAMAT_000_070: Stay with me! We'll have a healer see to you soon!
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_KRILE_000_075: There, that should help. Rest awhile, and you'll be back on your feet in no time.
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_ERENVILLE_000_080: This is a Sharlayan restorative potion. Drink it slowly.
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_ALISAIE_000_085: You'll be fine. Just try to avoid sudden movements so you don't reopen your wounds.
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_KOANA_000_090: Urianger says fire aether pervades the entire village. What happened here...?
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_THANCRED_000_095: Many of the villagers sustained burns, but the fire found no purchase in these stone buildings. A small mercy.
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_URIANGER_000_100: Though Valigarmanda's escape is of dire concern, we must needs tend to those caught in the conflagration.
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_ALPHINAUD_000_106: There is much I would explain, but by the time I arrived to investigate a sudden surge in aether, there were already fallen giants everywhere.
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_ALPHINAUD_000_107: Right now, everyone is preoccupied with treating the wounded. Pray catch your breath, and then lend a hand where you can.
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_SYSTEM_000_110: You may now enter Worqor Zormor with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_WUKLAMAT_000_001: Stay with me! We'll have a healer see to you soon!
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_KRILE_000_005: There, that should help. Rest awhile, and you'll be back on your feet in no time.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ERENVILLE_000_010: This is a Sharlayan restorative potion. Drink it slowly.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ALISAIE_000_015: You'll be fine. Just try to avoid sudden movements so you don't reopen your wounds.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_KOANA_000_020: Urianger says fire aether pervades the entire village. What happened here...?
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_THANCRED_000_025: Many of the villagers sustained burns, but the fire found no purchase in these stone buildings. A small mercy.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_URIANGER_000_030: Though Valigarmanda's escape is of dire concern, we must needs tend to those caught in the conflagration.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ALPHINAUD_000_035: If you are ready, there are many injured here who need aid. Should you find anyone passed out from their wounds, I ask that you alert me to them.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ALPHINAUD_000_036: Otherwise, I shall be tending to whomever requires the most urgent healing. We can gather here once we've seen to these people's hurts.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ALPHINAUD_000_040: Once we've treated the wounded, I'll have everyone meet at the spot where we were talking earlier.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_YORGERWOR_000_046: Everything was bathed in bright red. A searing heat enveloped my entire body. I couldn't move...
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ZURFERLAR_000_048: Everything burns... The touch of cloth is agony. Yet I will live. Leave me─there are others in more dire need of help.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ZURFERLAR_100_048: We are fortunate indeed that you and your companions have come.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ZERBORLOR_000_050: My wounds are nothing serious, but this dryness in my throat... It's as if all the moisture has left my body.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ZERBORLOR_100_050: That strangers from across the salt should be the ones to aid us...
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ALPHINAUD_000_060: I've done all I can for now. The injured you found were awake and alert, then?
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_WUKLAMAT_000_062: We've left the injured as comfortable as we could.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_KRILE_000_063: Many were suffering from burns to a greater or lesser degree. Did a fire sweep through the village?
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ALPHINAUD_000_065: Once I'd healed the giant attacked by that mountain bird, the group's leader─Vorporlor, I believe they called him─bade me depart. It was then that I felt an intense wave of aether, and returned to find Worlar's Echo in this state.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ALPHINAUD_000_067: I rushed over to the first giant I saw. Though delirious with pain, he repeated the same warning: Valigarmanda had broken free. Thus did I contact you with all haste.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ALISAIE_000_068: Well, we're going to need more information than that before we can deal with the situation.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_WUKLAMAT_000_069: Yes, we should speak with the temple guard, and see what's become of the Skyruin's prison!
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_WUKLAMAT_000_080: We need to find out exactly what's going on!
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_KRILE_000_085: They did say the prison was beginning to fail, but I felt certain it would hold for another few years, at least. Was I mistaken?
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ERENVILLE_000_090: The High Luminary will have returned by now. Hopefully he's found out more than we have...
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ALPHINAUD_000_095: I would be glad to learn that this was all some misunderstanding... A futile hope, by the looks of things.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ALISAIE_000_100: Whatever answers exist await us inside the temple.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_YOKHUYGUARD04889_00: The High Luminary grants you entry, and awaits you within.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_KRILE_000_110: Two casters releasing spells of fire at the exact same moment... A feat impossible for any but a two-headed Mamool Ja.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ERENVILLE_000_115: When I said I would take on the duties of a guide, that did not include the tracking of ancient and terrible tural vidraal. Still, we can't leave Valigarmanda free to ravage the land.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ALPHINAUD_000_120: Should a claimant reckless enough to free the Skyruin become Dawnservant, what would become of Tuliyollal?
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ALISAIE_000_125: That fiend Bakool Ja Ja─he's rotten through and through! There's nothing “blessed” about him!
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_WUKLAMAT_000_130: So, Erenville. Any ideas on how we can track Valigarmanda?
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ERENVILLE_000_131: The tried-and-true method of comparing sightings with other signs of passage is the most reliable. But also the most time-consuming.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ERENVILLE_000_132: There is a second option... Not as reliable as the first, but if we're lucky, it will let us ascertain the Skyruin's whereabouts far more quickly.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ERENVILLE_000_133: Though a tural vidraal of extraordinary nature, Valigarmanda is still a creature of this world.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ERENVILLE_000_134: Like you and me, it is thus sustained by corporeal energy and possesses a unique aetherial balance. Which means this device should come in handy.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_WUKLAMAT_100_135: A floating hand!? Now's not the time to be playing with toys!
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ERENVILLE_000_135: This is no toy─it's an aether seeker. As the name suggests, gleaners use it to detect the aether of living beings.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_WUKLAMAT_000_136: And you've had that in your pack this whole time...?
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ERENVILLE_000_137: I can calibrate it to follow a specific aetherial aspect. The problem with Valigarmanda, however, is that it can shift freely between the elements of fire, ice, or lightning...
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ALPHINAUD_000_138: Well, we know that in order to awaken Valigarmanda from its icy imprisonment, Bakool Ja Ja cast spells which quickened its fire-aspected aether.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ALPHINAUD_000_139: And the residents here were uniformly afflicted by burns.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ALPHINAUD_000_140: Therefore the logical conclusion is that, upon breaking free, Valigarmanda unleashed a great fiery blast.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ERENVILLE_000_141: Then the choice is plain. Fire.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ERENVILLE_000_142: The seeker, however, is not without its faults. As we were not able to input our quarry's unique aetheric signature in advance, the device will respond to any living source of fire-aspected aether.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_KRILE_000_143: So, we have the reliable─yet slow─method of information gathering, versus the potentially swift─but easily misled─gleaner tool. I say why not pursue both methods at the same time?
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_WUKLAMAT_000_144: Good idea! We'll have the first to fall back on if the second fails!
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ERENVILLE_000_145: You travel with me, then, . In case the seeker leads me to some other fiery fiend.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ALISAIE_000_146: The rest of us can stay behind and talk to eyewitnesses. The more Skyruin sightings we can compare, the more accurate our information will be.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ALPHINAUD_000_147: If no one has any objections, I shall remain here in the village and tend to the Yok Huy.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ALPHINAUD_100_147: Very few are seriously injured, but I am wary of wounds inflicted by a creature like Valigarmanda. I should like to be close at hand should their condition suddenly worsen.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_WUKLAMAT_000_148: Right, it sounds like we all have work to do!
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_ERENVILLE_000_149: We should be on our way as well.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_ERENVILLE_000_005: We'll head to the outskirts of the village first, then set the seeker to detect fire-aspected aether.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_AETHERSEEKER04893_0: SeNsOrS sEt To DeTeCt AeThErIaL aSpEcT: fIrE.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_ERENVILLE_000_015: Right, the seeker is ready to go. Worlar's Echo is still suffused with the Skyruin's residual aether, so I've excluded it from the search area to prevent it from swamping the sensors.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_AETHERSEEKER04893_0: AfFiRmAtIvE! tRaCkInG nEaReSt SoUrCe Of FiRe-AsPeCtEd AeThEr!
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_SYSTEM_100_015: Once you choose to depart, Erenville will accompany you. The aether seeker will then begin leading you onwards.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_SYSTEM_200_015: Follow the aether seeker to its destination without falling behind.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_SYSTEM_300_015: If you leave Erenville for any reason, or lose sight of the aether seeker, you may try again by returning to the starting point.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_ERENVILLE_000_019: Don't look at me─the seeker is pointing the way.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_Q2_000_000: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Erenville?
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_ERENVILLE_000_020: Understood. Come back to the village entrance when you're ready to pursue our quarry without interruptions.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_ERENVILLE_000_021: Are you sure you're ready this time? Then let's resume tracking.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_SYSTEM_100_022: Erenville will now accompany you. Keep up with the aether seeker and head for your destination.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_SYSTEM_100_023: Erenville has yet to arrive. Be sure he is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_ERENVILLE_200_023: We need to keep up with the seeker, or we won't be able to track Valigarmanda. Let's head back to Worlar's Echo and see if we can pick up the trail.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_SYSTEM_300_023: Speak with the aether seeker at Worlar's Echo to try again.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_ERENVILLE_400_023: Ready? Don't let the seeker out of your sight this time.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_AETHERSEEKER04893_0: <beep> SoUrCe Of FiRe-AsPeCtEd AeThEr LoCaTeD. tRaCkInG dIsEnGaGeD.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_ERENVILLE_000_025: Not quite the legendary creature we were after.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_ERENVILLE_000_026: Would you mind dealing with that fire sprite? It will continue to confuse the seeker if we leave it be.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_ERENVILLE_000_035: You'll have to snuff out that sprite before we can resume tracking. Take care you're not burned in the process.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_AETHERSEEKER04893_0: AfFiRmAtIvE! tRaCkInG nEaReSt SoUrCe Of FiRe-AsPeCtEd AeThEr!
<beep> SoUrCe Of FiRe-AsPeCtEd AeThEr LoCaTeD. tRaCkInG dIsEnGaGeD.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_ERENVILLE_000_044: Frightening enough, but again, not what we were looking for.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_ERENVILLE_000_045: If you would be so kind...?
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_ERENVILLE_000_055: As I said, the seeker method is not without its faults. Once it locks onto a source, it will follow it forever.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_ERENVILLE_000_060: My thanks. I'd ask if it gave you any trouble, but considering who I'm talking to...
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_ERENVILLE_000_061: Seeker, resume tracking. And do try to point out something useful this time.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_AETHERSEEKER04893_0: <beep> SoUrCe Of FiRe-AsPeCtEd AeThEr LoCaTeD. tRaCkInG dIsEnGaGeD.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_ERENVILLE_000_064: Ah, another remnant of Valigarmanda's last rampage. The crater's flames registered to the seeker as corporeal aether...
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_ERENVILLE_000_065: In the words of the Tuliyollal Saga, when Valigarmanda rages out of control, its fire burns forever, its ice does not thaw, and its lightning crackles without cease. Thus was the Dawnservant able to turn the Skyruin's perpetual magic against itself, trapping it within an unmelting prison of ice.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_ERENVILLE_000_066: This is no mundane fire, but some kind of...everlasting sorcery. Once again, it is a strange feeling to see fanciful poetry proven true...
