TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_ERENVILLE_000_069: The important thing is that the fire was classified as living aether─we can feed a sample into the seeker and greatly improve its accuracy. One moment...
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_ERENVILLE_000_070: Understood. Come back to Solace when you're ready to continue.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_ERENVILLE_000_071: You need to keep up with the seeker, or we won't be able to track Valigarmanda. Let's head back to Solace and see if we can pick up the trail.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_SYSTEM_000_072: Speak with the aether seeker at Solace to try again.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_ERENVILLE_000_085: There. Now the seeker should ignore any aetheric signature but Valigarmanda's.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_ERENVILLE_000_086: ...Had I realized this was possible from the start, then you needn't have fought those creatures at all.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_ERENVILLE_000_087: My apologies. It seems I still have much to learn from this journey─as a gleaner, and as a guide.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_ERENVILLE_000_005: This time, the seeker should be attracted solely to Valigarmanda's aether.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_ERENVILLE_000_006: Resume tracking based on the latest sample.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_AETHERSEEKER04893_0: <beep> SaMpLe AeThErIaL sIgNaTuRe DeTeCtEd. EnGaGiNg AcCeLeRaTeD pUrSuIt MoDe!
<beep> SoUrCe Of AeThErIaL sIgNaTuRe LoCaTeD. tRaCkInG dIsEnGaGeD.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_ERENVILLE_000_015: Good, the seeker was drawn directly to the Skyruin's fire. Now we know we've set the correct parameters for its aetherial aspect.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_ERENVILLE_000_016: I'll try increasing the threshold for aetheric concentration─that should direct us to the tural vidraal itself.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_ERENVILLE_000_025: I think we'd notice if Valigarmanda was inside this passage. Let's head through to the other side.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_SYSTEM_000_035: During this quest and when using the Duty Support system, you have the opportunity to undertake this trial with a party of NPC companions. Some of these allies' roles will differ from those you are normally able to select.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_A1_000_002: Form a party and enter Worqor Lar Dor.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_WUKLAMAT_000_040: Even Papa may not have been able to slay Valigarmanda...but with the Dawn's Promise and our allies all fighting together, I believe we can do just that!
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_KOANA_000_045: What is on your mind, Brother...?
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_KRILE_000_055: I've never faced anything this powerful before, but I swear I won't hold you back!
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_ALISAIE_000_060: Valigarmanda will demand our undivided attention. Let's hope Zoraal Ja has nothing sinister planned.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_THANCRED_000_065: I knew Koana wouldn't be one to rush off and leave others to deal with a creature like Valigarmanda.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_URIANGER_000_070: It hath been some while since last I joined thee in battle. Indeed, so full have been our days upon these shores, it doth seem a lifetime hath passed.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_SAREELJA_000_075: That the future Dawnservant should ignore my counsel to indulge a whim is...vexing.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_ERENVILLE_000_080: You and yours have journeyed to the edge of existence and back─I'm sure defeating this “overgrown snake-bird” is well within your capabilities. Yet I bid you to be cautious, all the same.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_WUKLAMAT_000_100: Heh heh, I'm still giddy from our victory...
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_KOANA_000_105: The matter of outdoing our father aside, this was the best outcome we could have hoped for. Never again will our people need fear the looming shadow of the Skyruin.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_KRILE_000_110: Didn't I tell you? I pull my own weight in battle now!
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_ALISAIE_000_115: Witnessing Zoraal Ja in battle, I understand why he's widely considered to be Tuliyollal's greatest warrior.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_THANCRED_000_120: Koana did well. Our Promise has promise too, don't you think?
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_URIANGER_000_125: 'Tis fortunate we vanquished that winged calamity ere it could inflict greater suffering upon these lands.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_ERENVILLE_000_130: Your proud expressions bespeak a successful hunt. Not that I'm surprised in the least.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_ERENVILLE_000_131: Zoraal Ja came back earlier, but left almost immediately with Sareel Ja in tow. He seemed disinclined to share in any victory celebrations.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_WUKLAMAT_000_132: That's nothing unusual for Zoraal Ja.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_WUKLAMAT_000_133: No, it's Bakool Ja Ja that concerns me. He's probably far ahead now, making the most of the mayhem he caused.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_WUKLAMAT_000_134: I still can't believe he did something so evil just to slow us down... If we hadn't slain Valigarmanda, it wasn't only Urqopacha at risk─there would have been deaths across the entire continent!
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_WUKLAMAT_000_135: I'm more certain than ever that Bakool Ja Ja cannot be allowed to rule. I have to catch him and take back my keystone!
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_WUKLAMAT_000_001: I'll make Bakool Ja Ja answer for this!
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_KOANA_000_005: The matter of outdoing our father aside, this was the best outcome we could have hoped for. Never again will our people need fear the looming shadow of the Skyruin.
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_KRILE_000_010: Didn't I tell you? I pull my own weight in battle now!
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_ALISAIE_000_015: Witnessing Zoraal Ja in battle, I understand why he's widely considered to be Tuliyollal's greatest warrior.
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_URIANGER_000_020: 'Tis fortunate we vanquished that winged calamity ere it could inflict greater suffering upon these lands.
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_ERENVILLE_000_025: Spending time alone with Sareel Ja was akin to torture. Despite my obvious disinterest, he spewed a constant stream of mean-spirited bile. Honestly, I might have preferred facing fire and ruin with you on the battlefield...
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_THANCRED_000_030: The Yok Huy must still be anxious, wondering where and when Valigarmanda will strike next.
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_THANCRED_000_031: I suggest we hurry back and allay their fears. Alphinaud's as well, I should think.
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_WUKLAMAT_000_032: Yes, you're right! We shouldn't let them worry another moment!
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_ERENVILLE_000_040: I expected I would be asked to track many things during the course of our journey, but Valigarmanda was not among them.
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_KOANA_000_045: Amidst the chaos of the Skyruin's awakening, I'd forgotten we still have the Feat of Ice to complete...
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_KRILE_000_050: I thought the villagers would be in hiding. Alphinaud's confidence in us must have reassured them.
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_ALPHINAUD_000_055: Welcome back. Not for a moment did I doubt that you'd return safe and sound.
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_ALISAIE_000_060: Scaling a massive mountain. Fighting an elector. Battle against a legendary monstrosity... Yes, you could say I'm a little tired.
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_THANCRED_000_065: While we were contending with that screeching menace, I expect Bakool Ja Ja was off to the next feat.
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_URIANGER_000_070: I see Master Alphinaud hath made good use of the time to further tend the wounded.
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_WUKLAMAT_000_075: Before we do anything else, we should talk to Gurfurlur.
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_ERENVILLE_000_080: So Yak T'el is where the Yok Huy had their golden dreams. We may soon have the chance to investigate that tale firsthand.
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_KRILE_000_085: A heavenly land, suffused with a golden glow...
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_ALPHINAUD_000_090: With only two keystones remaining, we've at last begun to gain a fuller picture of the legend of the golden city.
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_ALISAIE_000_095: What a turn of events─we were only meant to strengthen the ice, but Bakool Ja Ja's idiocy forced us to do them one better.
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_ZURMURWUR_000_096: Long has it been since any from Chirwagur Saltern have deigned to enter Worlar's Echo. A day for unusual visitors, indeed.
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_GURFURLUR_000_097: Watching Vorporlor get caught up in Wuk Lamat's unstoppable wake reminds me of my younger days...
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_WUKLAMAT_000_100: I don't think Vorporlor and his brethren will have a sudden change of heart about Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_WUKLAMAT_000_101: But that doesn't mean they'll never change at all. Today is proof of that!
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_WUKLAMAT_000_001: Right! Time to track down the next elector!
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_KRILE_000_005: A heavenly land, suffused with a golden glow...
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_ALPHINAUD_000_010: With only two keystones remaining, we've at last begun to gain a fuller picture of the legend of the golden city.
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_ALISAIE_000_015: What a turn of events─we were only meant to strengthen the ice, but Bakool Ja Ja's idiocy forced us to do them one better.
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_ZURMURWUR_000_016: Long has it been since any from Chirwagur Saltern have deigned to enter Worlar's Echo. A day for unusual visitors, indeed.
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_GURFURLUR_000_017: Watching Vorporlor get caught up in Wuk Lamat's unstoppable wake reminds me of my younger days...
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_ERENVILLE_000_020: I think it's time we returned to Tuliyollal. After scaling Tural's tallest mountain and battling a legendary beast to the death, even dauntless heroes like you could probably use a rest.
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_ERENVILLE_000_021: In any case, there are preparations to be made before we can visit the next destination laid out in the saga.
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_ALPHINAUD_000_022: The respite would be most welcome. I believe I hear the For'ard Cabins calling our names.
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_WUKLAMAT_000_030: I'll take the opportunity to think on some things.
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_KRILE_000_035: No sooner did we set foot back in Tuliyollal than I felt the weight of recent events set in all at once. I am definitely due for a long nap.
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_ALPHINAUD_000_045: <yawn> I won't say no to clean sheets and a soft pillow.
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_ALISAIE_000_050: There are still two feats left to go. We want to face them refreshed and ready for action.
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_PESHEKWA_000_055: Welcome back to Tuliyollal. Your cabins are waiting for you.
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_ERENVILLE_000_056: Rest well, everyone. We can meet back here later on.
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_ERENVILLE_000_057: I have a small errand to run in the city, so I'll leave you to recover.
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_ERENVILLE_000_058: Will you be heading to the palace, Wuk Lamat?
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_ERENVILLE_000_060: Lost in her own little world, it seems. Well, no matter─I'll be back soon enough.
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_PESHEKWA_000_061: An attendant is standing by to unlock your cabin. Enjoy your stay!
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_PESHEKWA_000_071: The rite of succession must be an absolutely exhausting endeavor. The comforts of our cabins are at your disposal whenever you wish to retire, .
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_XBALAALEMPLOYEE0489: Welcome back,  . Your cabin is just as you left it─minus a light layer of dust!
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_WUKLAMAT_000_090: Sorry to drag you away from your nice, comfortable cabin, but I could feel the walls closing in.
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_WUKLAMAT_000_091: Oh, I know! I'll take you to one of my favorite places in Tuliyollal─that should help me get my thoughts in order.
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_WUKLAMAT_000_092: We'll go to the Resplendent Quarter and make our way up from there!
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_PESHIWA_000_100: Oh, hello, dear. You're one of Wuk Lamat's new friends...?
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_WUKLAMAT_000_105: Peshiwa, what are you doing up and about? Is your back feeling better?
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_PESHIWA_000_106: It's much healed now, so don't make a fuss. Besides, I can't be lounging in bed all day when you're out there fighting your hardest to win the throne.
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_PESHIWA_000_107: You're the claimant with the greatest love for peace.
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_PESHIWA_000_108: I love this nation of ours, and lending you my support is the least I can do.
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_WUKLAMAT_000_109: When I see you smile like that, how can I not be encouraged?
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_PESHIWA_000_110: Oh ho ho, there's plenty more who believe in your cause. I can recruit a whole battalion of smiling faces if you think it'll help!
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_WUKLAMAT_000_111: Yours alone is more than enough. Thank you, Peshiwa!
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_PESHIWA_000_112: And thank you, Third Promise. I shall pray for your success in the contest.
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_WUKLAMAT_000_115: It's just that with the progress we've made in the contest, even these everyday encounters feel that much more special.
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_WUKLAMAT_000_116: Do you think we can take our time, and maybe wander around a little first? Then we can head to that spot I was thinking of.
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_ALPHINAUD_000_130: You look to be in good spirits. I assume your leisure time was well spent.
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_ALPHINAUD_000_131: I was glad to snatch some quality sleep, myself. After all, it will soon be back to the road for us!
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ALPHINAUD_000_001: I'm sure the others will be along shortly. I do hope everyone has rested well.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ALPHINAUD_000_002: Now that we have refreshed ourselves somewhat, let us consider all claimants as they currently stand.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Zoraal Ja and Koana have completed every feat thus far and hold five keystones apiece.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ALPHINAUD_000_004: Wuk Lamat would be equal with them but for Bakool Ja Ja's thievery, which has left us one short.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ALISAIE_000_005: That conniving braggart didn't so much as lift a finger for the Feat of Proof and wreaked havoc for the Feat of Ice. He can't have more than three keystones at most.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_WUKLAMAT_000_006: He may think he can simply steal what he needs to win, but he's sorely mistaken. I will be taking back what is mine─this I swear!
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ALPHINAUD_000_007: I fear that reclaiming your keystone may not be enough─that is, if Bakool Ja Ja's unleashing of Valigarmanda is any indication.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ALPHINAUD_000_008: Using his lead, I anticipate that he will move to obtain the remaining keystones before disrupting his rivals' attempts.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ALPHINAUD_000_009: We may all find ourselves being forced to take from one another.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_WUKLAMAT_000_009: I can't say I'd be comfortable with that.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_WUKLAMAT_000_010: But neither will I surrender my claim to the throne so easily. If it's for the sake of preserving the happiness of my people, I'll do what I must!
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ERENVILLE_000_011: The last two keystones we require are those of the Lay of Repast and the Lay of the Brotherhood.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ERENVILLE_000_012: The former depicts the cessation of hostilities between the Mamool Ja and Xbr'aal in the forests of Yak T'el. Specifically near a village called Iq Br'aax.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_WUKLAMAT_000_013: That's where I was born, if you recall. I haven't been back there since Papa took me in when I was a baby.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ERENVILLE_000_014: Where the Lay of the Brotherhood takes place, however, is unclear. In the saga, it is said that a foreign explorer came seeking an audience with the Dawnservant...but little more than that.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ALPHINAUD_000_015: Eorzea has a similar tale─the explorer Ketenramm befriended a two-headed king known as the Autarch before commencing his travels across Tural.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ALPHINAUD_000_016: He journeyed here several times afterwards but was ultimately lost at sea. At least, that is the commonly held belief.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_WUKLAMAT_000_017: Your two-headed king certainly sounds like Papa. So this Ketenramm fellow must have come to Tuliyollal!
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ERENVILLE_000_018: But if he indeed arrived some eighty years ago, the capital may not have been built yet. Vestiges of Yok Huy architecture notwithstanding.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ERENVILLE_000_020: Wait─you said “Autarch,” didn't you? Then Ketenramm must have met the Dawnservant in Mamook!
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ERENVILLE_000_022: One of the grandest in Tural, once upon a time─and the seat of the Mamool Ja's homeland. It too lies in Yak T'el, not far from Iq Br'aax.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ALISAIE_100_022: Then all things considered, Yak T'el seems the obvious choice for our next destination.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ERENVILLE_000_023: From here, the safest method of travel is by dirigible. We should make for the landing once our preparations are complete.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_WUKLAMAT_000_024: W-We're riding in one of Koana's balloons? ...They can't be any worse than ships, can they?
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_KRILE_000_035: Yak T'el... Where the Yok Huy dreamt of the golden city...
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ERENVILLE_000_040: Ready to leave when you are.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ALPHINAUD_000_045: How exciting! The design of Turali dirigibles intrigues me. I must note how they perform compared to Eorzean airships...
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ALISAIE_000_050: For as much as I wish we could ignore him, Bakool Ja Ja is a real threat. We can't afford to let our guard down.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_EMPLOYEESTERMINAL04: The next flight to Yak T'el will be leaving shortly. Passengers are asked to keep hands, legs, and luggage inside the dirigible at all times.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_WUKLAMAT_000_056: A-Are we sure that thing will stay in the air? ...All the way to Yak T'el!?
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_WUKLAMAT_000_057: A-Are you ready!? Bags packed and, er, good-byes said!? There's no going back once we lift off!
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_WUKLAMAT_000_058: N-Not that I'm nervous or anything. I'm just making sure that you're not nervous!
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_WUKLAMAT_000_059: Oh, who am I kidding...my knees won't stop shaking. Hey, will you hold my hand? J-Just until I've settled my nerves.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_WUKLAMAT_000_061: You're the nicest person I've ever met, . I'll try not to crush your hand...
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_WUKLAMAT_000_062: That stick-in-the-mud!? He'd never let me live it down!
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_MABLU_000_063: There she is! Third Promise, wait just a moment!
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_WUKLAMAT_000_064: Mablu and Tobli! Of course, of course─I'll wait as long as you need!
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_MABLU_000_065: Sorry to delay you, but we were able to discover the origin of Krile's earring!
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ALPHINAUD_000_067: You said before that it gained popularity in Yok Tural as a protective ward for travelers, correct?
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_MABLU_000_068: That's right! We tracked down the elderly merchant to whom first sales are attributed.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_MABLU_000_069: According to him, the design imitates an accessory worn by a foreign mage he met at market some twenty years ago. Little did he know that charming taste of salt would prove to be a commercial triumph!
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_KRILE_000_070: A foreign mage wearing this earring could only be Grandfather. Did the merchant happen to mention which market?
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_TOBLI_000_071: One in Yak T'el─to where it seems you are already bound.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_KRILE_000_072: What luck. Then I shall seek my next clue once we arrive.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_KRILE_000_073: Is it mere coincidence that brought my grandfather there? Or...
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ALISAIE_000_074: Yet another discovery to look forward to.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_KRILE_000_075: Thank you both for coming all this way.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_MABLU_000_076: Anything for the Third Promise! Good luck with the rest of the rite!
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_WUKLAMAT_000_077: Th-Thanks! I won't let you down. I've just got to board this dirigible and...and I'm as good as there!
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_EMPLOYEESTERMINAL04: Last call for passengers to Yak T'el!
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_TOBLI_000_080: Yak T'el will test her mettle, without a doubt.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_TOBLI_000_081: The next Dawnservant must be willing to bear the full weight of this nation's history...no matter how heavy it may be.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_WUKLAMAT_000_90: Would it kill Erenville to give me the benefit of the doubt? Or the benefit of a second chance?
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_KRILE_000_91: I can hardly fathom how difficult travel must have been before the Second Promise introduced dirigibles. Can you imagine having to walk all this way?
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ALPHINAUD_000_92: Well, that journey was delightful. The wind was fair and the vessel hardly rocked at all.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ALISAIE_000_93: Worry not─Krile and I will ensure our Promise doesn't wind up at the bottom of one of these cenotes.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ERENVILLE_000_95: With thicker vegetation comes reduced visibility. I advise you to keep someone in sight at all times.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_WUKLAMAT_000_100: See? No tumbles! ...Thanks to Krile and Alisaie, but it still counts.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_KRILE_000_105: For all of Erenville's insistence, I have yet to discover anything particularly blue about this forest.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ALPHINAUD_000_110: Is that Iq Br'aax over there, I wonder?
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ALISAIE_000_115: Take care not to get separated. I'd hate to lose you to this rampant undergrowth.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ERENVILLE_000_121: Iq Br'aax is up ahead. Let's be on our way.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_WUKLAMAT_000_130: Hah! I've fallen into High Tide Harbor enough times to be a professional diver─there's no way I'd fall into something like this on accident!
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_KRILE_000_135: Are all cenotes this deep, I wonder?
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ERENVILLE_000_140: What's so blue about this forest? You'll see.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ALISAIE_000_145: Just so you know, I shall be very cross if you push me.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ALPHINAUD_000_150: Erenville was not exaggerating about the cenotes. It would be a grueling ordeal to climb out of one.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_ERENVILLE_000_151: Well, thankfully we made it here without incident. Let's not dally any longer.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_KRILE_000_001: Are all cenotes this deep, I wonder?
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_ERENVILLE_000_005: We should press on. The other candidates may be well ahead of us.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Are we ready to proceed? I am eager to learn more about Iq Br'aax and Xbr'aal customs.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_ALISAIE_000_015: Just so you know, I shall be very cross if you push me.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_ALPHINAUD_000_021: Our first task should be finding the elector. Hopefully our relative tardiness will not reflect poorly upon us...
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_HUNMURRUK_000_022: (-Gentle Villager-)The Third Promise and her retinue, I presume.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_WUKLAMAT_000_023: You presume right. I seek the Dawnservant's elector.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_HUNMURRUK_000_024: (-Gentle Villager-)Then come and join us in the Garden of the Stars, at the village center. Everyone is waiting for you.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_ALPHINAUD_000_027: There is but one way to find out. Come, let us follow him.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_WUKLAMAT_000_030: I consider myself a connoisseur of all things tasty and Turali, but this is the first I've heard of xibruq pibil...
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_ERENVILLE_000_035: The First Promise and Bakool Ja Ja are formidable on the field, but in the kitchen? I think the odds are in our favor.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_KRILE_000_040: Only two claimants can receive keystones from this feat. Intimidating, perhaps, but irrelevant─we shall prevail!
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_ALPHINAUD_000_045: The Second Promise will no doubt have thoughts on how best to proceed. Let us ask for his perspective.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_ALISAIE_000_050: Do you suppose the First Promise and Bakool Ja Ja will wear matching aprons? I dearly hope so.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_THANCRED_000_055: As much as I would have loved to defeat you all in a high-stakes culinary battle, I couldn't have asked for better allies.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_URIANGER_000_060: For the pairings to be thus decided, the stars align for us indeed.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_KOANA_000_061: How fortunate that this feat's unique stipulations have frustrated Bakool Ja Ja's attempts to delay us.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_WUKLAMAT_000_062: Serves him right! That's what he gets for endangering my people with his schemes!
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_WUKLAMAT_000_063: Why doesn't he just compete fairly? He's plenty strong─and obviously has a mind for strategy, twisted though it may be.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_KOANA_000_065: Putting aside our competition for the moment, allow me to express how glad I am for this opportunity to work together. As I see it, our team possesses a distinct advantage─
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_WUKLAMAT_000_066: Heh. Of course we do! Any team I'm on is bound to succeed.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_ERENVILLE_000_068: You mean we have an advantage in numbers, yes?
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_ERENVILLE_000_069: Our competition has a team of six─the two claimants, Sareel Ja, and Bakool Ja Ja's lackeys.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_ERENVILLE_000_070: Whereas we are a team of nine. That's three more people we can mobilize.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_ALPHINAUD_000_071: With the tasks suitably delegated, it should be a brisk affair to learn the recipe and assemble necessary ingredients.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_KRILE_000_073: Well, we mustn't be overconfident, lest we make a careless mistake that could've been easily avoided.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_KOANA_000_078: Our first order of business should be determining the recipe for xibruq pibil. We can hardly gather ingredients for a dish we know nothing about.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_KOANA_000_079: Given the nature of this feat, asking for answers directly may prove less effective than simply observing the daily habits of the Xbr'aal people.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_KOANA_000_080: Let us gather here once we have seen what clues this village has to offer.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_HOOBIGOBAKOOLJAJAMI: Tch. So much for our plan...
We ought to cut our losses and head to Mamook. This feat is nothing but a fool's errand.
You're the fool if you think he won't tan our hides for leather if we dare to return without enough keystones! Besides, we've taken from the house cat before─how difficult could a second time be?
Wh-What are you looking at, salt-licker!? Mind your own business!
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_XBALAALHUNGRY04898_: I wish I could tell you, friend! A dish so delicious is meant to be shared. Alas, we are forbidden from divulging anything─orders from Hunmu Rruk himself.
But your mentioning it has given me a fierce craving! I only hope there's still ibruq to be had at market... <wink>
Hmm? I was simply thinking aloud about my next meal! No harm in that.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_SYSTEM_000_105: An unusually colored banana peel has been neatly arranged on the ground─which appears to be smoking.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_XBALAALCOOKS04898_0: Oh no! It appears I've gone and dropped my najool─I mean, Ja Tiika banana peel! I could barely see it for all the steam issuing from my underground oven. Ahhh, there's nothing like enjoying a tasty banana while you use the leaves in your cooking!
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_XBALAALCHEERFUL0489: This should be all I need...
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_SYSTEM_000_115: A number of spices, some entirely unfamiliar to you, are nestled in a basket.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_XBALAALCHEERFUL0489: <chuckle> That one's called “achiote.” We mostly use it to add a bit of color to, er, our most popular cuisine...but its medicinal benefits are significant as well.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_KOANA_000_121: What did we discover about xibruq pibil?
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_ALPHINAUD_000_122: True to your prediction, the villagers were forbidden from educating us, er, directly.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_ALPHINAUD_000_123: However, many were still preparing it as one might a staple dish, and observation of their techniques yielded clues enough.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_KRILE_000_124: A lady blending local herbs and spices was only too happy to describe the ones I didn't recognize─while neither confirming nor denying any relation to xibruq pibil.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_KRILE_000_125: But one in particular she attributed to all common Xbr'aal dishes. “Achiote,” she called it.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_KOANA_000_126: I see. Then if xibruq pibil is indeed a dish as ubiquitous as Alphinaud claims, we have confirmed our first ingredient.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_URIANGER_000_127: Meanwhile, I did observe a cook burying bundles wrapped in the leaf of najool─or banana, in certain localities. 'Twould seem the use of subterranean ovens is commonplace.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_WUKLAMAT_000_128: I saw the same! I think we all know what's inside those bundles, then, don't you?
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_A1_000_002: A sizzling slab of beef. It smelled so good, I could practically taste it...
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_A1_000_003: The squeaky flesh of a bipedal fish!
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_KOANA_000_130: As would be expected of a dish called “xibruq pibil,” indeed.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_ERENVILLE_000_131: I think you were smelling what you wanted to smell. Cattle is uncommon in Yok Tural and unlikely to be an ingredient used in Xbr'aal traditional cuisine.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_WUKLAMAT_000_132: What kind of creature is that? There seem to be more hunters than fishers here, so I think we're looking for a different meat─but I'd be keen to give it a try next time!
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_KOANA_000_133: So to summarize, this dish is one of ibruq, flavored with a combination of spices that includes achiote, and steamed underground within najool─or banana─leaves.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_ALPHINAUD_000_134: Given our assumptions are correct, we must now learn where and how to procure our ingredients.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_ERENVILLE_000_135: As a staple cuisine, its ingredients would be close at hand─which is why Thancred and I scouted the surrounding forests while you all were exploring the village.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_ERENVILLE_000_136: Between the local vegetation and wild ibruq, we should have everything we need in regards to meat and spices.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_WUKLAMAT_000_137: Heh, leave it to a master gleaner!
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_KOANA_000_138: With that, we should next divvy up our tasks. While some gather ingredients, others should make ready the kitchen.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_KRILE_000_141: I can help prepare the kitchen.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_ALPHINAUD_000_142: Permit me to assist as well. Our ovens will doubtless require firewood, and I have some experience in its gathering.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_URIANGER_000_143: I, too, should be glad to volunteer mine aid.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_THANCRED_000_146: Then the rest of us will gather ingredients. I can make quick work of the spices and herbs myself.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_ERENVILLE_000_147: I am happy to lead someone to a suitable ibruq, if they will perform the requisite deed. Alisaie?
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_KOANA_000_148: As for the najool leaves, I believe I am capable of acquiring that much on my own.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_ERENVILLE_000_149: Be warned─you won't find najool in these parts. They only grow in the Ja Tiika Heartland, forests far below these.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_KOANA_000_150: Hm. Such an excursion may be time-consuming. Perhaps we ought to try bartering first.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_KOANA_100_150: This feat encourages our communication with the locals, after all.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_KOANA_000_151: Lamaty'i, . If you would accompany me on my errand?
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_WUKLAMAT_000_152: No better way to whet my appetite!
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_KOANA_000_153: Good. Let us be about our tasks, then.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_KOANA_000_160: ...Lamaty'i had no specific task assigned to her, so I had her accompany me. No more, no less.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_WUKLAMAT_000_165: Come on! Let's go and get those najool leaves.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_WUKLAMAT_000_166: The sooner we do, the sooner we can eat!
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKLAMAT_000_001: Spiced ibruq wrapped in najool leaves? That sounds like a winning combination to me!
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_KOANA_000_005: Let us see if there are najool leaves to be had in town.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_KOANA_000_006: Perhaps the cook Urianger mentioned might be persuaded to spare us a few.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKLAMAT_000_010: An underground oven! This must be the cook Urianger was talking about.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_KOANA_000_015: Hmm... The earth here is indeed fashioned into an oven of sorts. Fascinating.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_XBALAALCOOKS04898_0: Oh, hello again! Did you need something?
Najool leaves! For purposes other than xibruq pibil, naturally...
Unfortunately, I've just used up my last. You'll have to travel to the lower forests for more.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_XBALAALCOOKS04898_1: Golmajiik Grove is the source of the finest najool leaves you'll find. Wild variants you sometimes see in city markets can't compare.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_KOANA_000_023: I see... I had hoped to avoid such a lengthy venture, but if there's no other way to obtain our ingredient, then to the Ja Tiika Heartland we shall go.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_HUNMURRUK_000_024: Allow me to save you the trip.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_HUNMURRUK_000_025: Traveling there requires that you go through the Ty'iinbek Traverse, but it has caved in. Due to the recent storm, I expect.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKLAMAT_000_026: What? But that means we can't get our najool leaves!
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_KOANA_000_027: ...But we can, can't we? If there were no other way of procuring them, you would have suspended this feat, or else altered its objective.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_HUNMURRUK_100_028: Anyway, I apologize for the interruption, but having overheard your conversation, I felt compelled to chime in.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKLAMAT_200_028: That's very kind of you. Any last-minute advice you'd be willing to share?
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_HUNMURRUK_300_028: Only to undertake the Feat of Repast with an empty stomach. You may find xibruq pibil to be a delicious but daunting dish to finish.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKLAMAT_000_029: Still...if there are no leaves here, and we can't travel for more, how are we supposed to gather all our ingredients?
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_KOANA_000_030: These feats are meant to deepen our understanding of the peoples and cultures of Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_KOANA_000_031: So perhaps there is something about xibruq pibil that we have yet to learn. Something of significance other than its recipe or ingredients.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKLAMAT_000_032: Oh, I see... Like who was the first to make it─its history, that sort of thing!
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_XBALAALCOOKS04898_0: Ahem! If it's Yak T'el's history you're interested in, you should start with the old war.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKLAMAT_000_034: Between the Xbr'aal and the Mamool Ja, right?
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_XBALAALCOOKS04898_0: These forests have borne witness to centuries of warfare, the evidence of which remains a scar upon the earth.
To know the end of that bloodshed is to know xibruq pibil.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKLAMAT_000_037: Huh? What does steamed ibruq have to do with bloodshed?
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_KOANA_000_038: Precisely the question we must answer. Vexing though such a detour may seem, I can think of no other way to approach this feat.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_XBALAALCOOKS04898_0: In that case, you may wish to visit the site of a settlement ruined by the war. The village of Ilyon Asoh─it lies a short distance to the east.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKLAMAT_000_040: The village of Ilyon Asoh? Understood! Thank you for your help.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKLAMAT_000_041: Come, let's go and see this place!
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_XBALAALCOOKS04898_0: I was told not to talk about xibruq pibil. The history of our people and the─<cough>─important developments therein are another matter.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKLAMAT_000_055: Everyone knows there was a war between the Mamool Ja and Xbr'aal. But I, uh...may have forgotten some of the details.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_KOANA_000_060: The village of Ilyon Asoh must be further east.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_KOANA_000_061: Let us continue with haste. For all we know, our competitors may be on our heels.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_KOANA_000_070: This place feels forgotten by time...
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKLAMAT_000_075: So this is the village of Ilyon Asoh...or what's left of it.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKEVU_000_076: It was a place of light and life. My great-grandfather called it home, in fact.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKLAMAT_000_077: Wuk Evu! I didn't know you were in Yak T'el!
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKEVU_000_078: I was picking up lumber from Iq Br'aax when I heard the Third Promise was on her way to this site of deep historical significance.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKEVU_000_079: I immediately saw another opportunity to be of service, and so followed you here.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKLAMAT_000_080: Wuk Evu is a shipwright who came to our aid during the Feat of Reeds.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKEVU_000_081: A pleasure. You are a member of the Third Promise's retinue, I presume?
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_KOANA_000_082: For the moment, I suppose I am. My name is Koana. Pleased to make your acquaintance.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKEVU_000_083: Koana! Now that's a good name. A familiar name! Where have I heard...
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKEVU_000_084: Koana!? As in the Second Promise of Tuliyollal!?
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKEVU_000_085: To think that I addressed the Dawnservant's own son as some common retainer! Such disrespect cannot be excused. Please, take up your gun and─
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKLAMAT_000_086: Oh, come on, not this again!
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_KOANA_000_087: I take no offense, so please do not dwell on it.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKEVU_000_088: All right, then. I shan't dwell on it.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKLAMAT_000_089: A-And right on cue... At least he's consistent?
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKEVU_000_090: I understand you wish to learn about xibruq pibil. While I am forbidden by the Xbr'aax Rax to divulge any information regarding its preparation, I would be happy to share what I know of Yak T'el's history.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKEVU_000_092: In its most basic sense, the conflict between the Xbr'aal and Mamool Ja was one of land.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKEVU_000_093: The Mamool Ja live in the lower forest, where the thick canopy obscures the sun and the soil is unforgiving to crops. This drove them to covet the upper forest─the home of the Xbr'aal─and they launched a determined campaign to seize it for themselves.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKEVU_000_094: Yet advantage ever favors higher ground, and the Xbr'aal forces held the upper hand against the invaders, rebuffing them time and again.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_KOANA_000_095: But as the state of this village would attest, the tide eventually turned. What brought it about?
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKEVU_000_096: Something you know all too well: blessed siblings.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKEVU_000_097: You must understand. The Mamool Ja were once a people as much at war with themselves as they were with others.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKEVU_000_098: The Hoobigo, Boonewa, and Doppro each sought to assert dominance over the others, even as they engaged the Xbr'aal in battle.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKEVU_000_099: In an effort to strengthen bonds and discourage infighting, Hoobigo and Boonewa leaders arranged a marriage between their children. However, this political measure altered the course of history in ways no one could have ever imagined.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKEVU_000_100: It was long believed that partners of differing clans could not have children together.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKEVU_000_101: But then it happened. A child arrived who shared the blood of Hoobigo and Boonewa both─a two-headed Mamool Ja.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKEVU_000_102: Blessed with tremendous physical strength and magical prowess, he grew into a mighty warrior before eventually arising as the first Autarch─ruler of all three clans.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_KOANA_000_103: Such qualities would dispose anyone to leadership. Character notwithstanding.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKEVU_000_104: Under the Autarch's rule, the newly united Mamool Ja became a force to be feared, and the war soon came to a head.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKEVU_000_105: I think it best you see the results firsthand. Let us visit another battlefield from that time, and there I shall continue the tale.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKEVU_000_120: I hope I have been of sufficient service to the Third Promise.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_KOANA_000_125: I never imagined our father was instrumental to xibruq pibil's invention...
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKLAMAT_000_130: Papa really did live up to his words. He traveled the land and learned about our people's myriad cultures.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_WUKLAMAT_000_131: And we're doing the same now...
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_WUKEVU_000_001: I hope I have been of sufficient service to the Third Promise.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_WUKLAMAT_000_005: It's thanks to Wuk Evu that we were able to learn this forest's history.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_WUKLAMAT_000_010: That's twice now that he's helped us. To think that we might never have met him if we hadn't thought to fix the float...
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_KOANA_000_015: Wuk Evu has given us valuable insight into the origins of xibruq pibil.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_KOANA_000_016: However, we are still no closer to procuring the necessary najool leaves. Unless...
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_KOANA_000_017: Tell me─was that historic feast commemorated in some fashion? With a monument, for instance?
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_WUKEVU_000_018: Indeed it was. Allow me to show you.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_KOANA_100_018: It is only speculation, but I dare to hope...
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_WUKLAMAT_100_019: What does Koana want with a monument?
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_WUKEVU_000_019: Offered up by the two factions, these weapons symbolize their vow that they would never again raise arms against each other.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_KOANA_000_020: Since this feat demands a journey through history, I thought it only logical that a monument like this might steer us true.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_KOANA_100_020: Especially one at the heart of so significant a battlefield.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_KOANA_000_021: Lamaty'i, ─would you help me search this area for clues? Tell me if anything catches your eye.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_KOANA_100_022: Look here─this soil has been recently overturned.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_KOANA_000_024: Well, well... I would have been satisfied to find only a hint, but here they are─fresh najool leaves.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_KOANA_100_024: Hunmu Rruk's doing, I'd wager. There's a poetry in hiding them on this battlefield, given that it was central to the war they helped end.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_WUKLAMAT_000_027: Heh! So he planned all this from the start!
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_WUKLAMAT_000_028: Thank you again, Wuk Evu. We wouldn't have found these leaves without your help.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_WUKEVU_000_029: It was my honor to render assistance.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_WUKEVU_000_030: And, with apologies to present company, allow me to offer my encouragement as well, Third Promise. Ever since I witnessed your performance in the Feat of Reeds, I have been certain that you are the claimant most worthy of leading our nation.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_WUKEVU_000_031: All devised solutions to the Hanuhanu's ailing crops, but you alone sought to know their culture and revive Ihih'hana, even if it seemed unrelated to your task.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_WUKEVU_000_032: In my humble opinion, no one cares more for the people of Tuliyollal and what they hold dear.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_WUKEVU_000_033: Should you again require the historical musings of an old shipwright, I am ever at your service.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_WUKEVU_000_034: For now, I take my leave.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_KOANA_000_036: ...We have what we need. Let us return to Iq Br'aax.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_WUKLAMAT_000_040: You have to wonder whether Wuk Evu is actually a historian and not a shipwright.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_KOANA_000_045: I'm glad we were successful. The others should be back soon, I expect.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_WUKLAMAT_000_051: We got the najool leaves! Wuk Evu came along and helped us find them!
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_KRILE_000_052: Wuk Evu was here? I would have liked to say hello.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_WUKLAMAT_000_053: Yes, he gave us an important history lesson...
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_ALPHINAUD_000_054: That Gulool Ja Ja brought an end to centuries of warfare surprises me little─but to achieve said peace through cuisine is something else entirely.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_WUKLAMAT_000_055: Leave it to my old man to find the oddest of solutions. But how about the rest of you? Is our kitchen ready?
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_KRILE_000_056: Everything should be in order. Urianger and I made another tour of the village and borrowed the cooking utensils we need─with no mention of what we needed them for, of course.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_ALPHINAUD_000_057: And I am pleased to report that we are stocked with the finest firewood this forest had on offer.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_ALISAIE_000_059: Erenville and I found our ibruq, so we should have meat aplenty.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_ERENVILLE_000_060: It was a spirited creature. So much so that its hunter fell down a cenote trying to catch it...
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_ALISAIE_000_061: What part of “never speak of this to anyone” did you not understand!?
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_THANCRED_000_062: I picked a good portion of local herbs, with particular attention to the seeds that yield achiote. I'm told our resident astrologian divined the appropriate measurements for the seasoning as well.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_URIANGER_100_062: Aye. Through further inquiry did I determine the ideal balance of spices.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_KOANA_000_063: Then all that remains is to prepare the dish itself. I presume that at least one among us is versed in the culinary arts?
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_KRILE_000_064: I can hardly claim profound skill, but I have cooked for myself. You can leave the rest to me.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_KRILE_100_064: And you, I hope. As I recall, you are an accomplished culinarian.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_KRILE_200_064: And you, I hope. I could use your adventurer's grit when it comes to skinning the ibruq.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_WUKLAMAT_000_065: Oooh, my mouth is watering already!
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_KRILE_000_070: I'm relieved that our dish was well received.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_ERENVILLE_000_075: One final feat remains. After this one, I hardly know what to expect.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_ALPHINAUD_000_080: Depriving the First Promise of a keystone is a crucial victory indeed.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_ALISAIE_000_085: We need to start considering how to reclaim that keystone from Bakool Ja Ja...
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_WUKLAMAT_000_090: That was sooo good! I'm already looking forward to having xibruq pibil again.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_WUKLAMAT_000_091: Here, . Krile made more using leftover ingredients. You'll love it!
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_WUKLAMAT_000_092: I'm thinking to buy more for the road, myself. Now that the Feat of Repast is over, the villagers should be free to offer it to us, right?
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_SYSTEM_000_093: New wares are now available from the Xbr'aal merchant in Iq Br'aax.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_KRILE_000_001: Now, we must hasten to the next feat. Though I find myself a touch reluctant to do so, given Mablu's parting words...
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_ERENVILLE_000_005: One final feat remains. After this one, I hardly know what to expect.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_WUKLAMAT_000_010: Feat of the Brotherhood, here we come!
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_ALISAIE_000_015: We need to start considering how to reclaim that keystone from Bakool Ja Ja...
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Seeing as we now face the penultimate objective of the rite, it would be wise to travel to Mamook and undertake the Feat of the Brotherhood without delay.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_ERENVILLE_000_021: Wise, yes, but impossible. The Ty'iinbek Traverse, which connects the upper forest to the Ja Tiika Heartland, is still impassable.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_ERENVILLE_000_023: I'm afraid not. Work to clear the path is underway, though, so I'm hopeful we can resume our journey soon.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_ALPHINAUD_000_024: Then let us each use this time as we see fit.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_ALPHINAUD_000_025: I, for one, would like to explore the village's surrounds─if Erenville would oblige me with a tour?
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_ERENVILLE_000_026: Very well. I have no other engagements.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_ALISAIE_000_027: Then I will come with you─if only to prove that I am capable of keeping my footing.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_KRILE_000_028: Though I shouldn't rejoice in our delay, it does afford me an opportunity to look into my grandfather's purported visit to Yak T'el.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_WUKLAMAT_000_029: Oh, that's right! Mablu did say something about a foreign mage coming through here decades back, didn't she? I'll come with you!
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_ALPHINAUD_000_031: Let us reconvene here after our respective diversions.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_KRILE_000_032: As I recall, the merchant met my grandfather at a market in Yak T'el some twenty years ago.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_KRILE_000_033: Any who might reliably remember him must therefore be at least middle-aged. Let us make inquiries where we can.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_WUKLAMAT_000_040: This fellow looks promising! Definitely older than I am.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_KRILE_000_045: I hope someone in Iq Br'aax knows something...
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_XBALAALOLD04901_000: A foreign mage, twenty years ago?
Yes, I remember him. It's not often we get visitors from across the salt, let alone those traveling with infants. A baby girl, as I recall.
I only saw him in passing, mind─if anyone were to know more, I'd wager it would be Hunmu Rruk. He was already Xbr'aax Rax then.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_KRILE_000_053: A baby girl? It couldn't have been...
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_KRILE_000_054: Th-Thank you, sir! That information is very helpful.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_XBALAALOLD04901_000: If you want to know more about that mage, I'd suggest speaking with Hunmu Rruk. He's sure to remember him.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_WUKLAMAT_000_065: So Hunmu Rruk has been Xbr'aax Rax for over twenty years... That's before I was even born!
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_KRILE_000_070: This may be the very lead I was hoping for!
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_075: Hello again. Do you require assistance?
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_KRILE_000_076: A foreign mage passed through Iq Br'aax roughly twenty years ago, possibly carrying a young child. Do you remember him?
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_077: Why do you ask me this? Who is this man to you?
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_KRILE_000_078: He may have been my grandfather, and I wish to know what brought him here.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_KRILE_000_080: Not by blood, but he is family nonetheless.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_081: A foreign mage did indeed visit Iq Br'aax. Master Galuf.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_100_081: So far as his identity is concerned, I trust you are satisfied?
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_082: More than that, however, I cannot say.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_084: I simply cannot. I beg your forgiveness and understanding.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_KRILE_000_085: Very well, I will not press. Thank you for confirming his presence here─the rest I will discover myself.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_KRILE_000_086: Out of more general curiosity, I have another question. They say the Yok Huy once dwelled in these forests. Where was that, exactly?
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_087: General curiosity, indeed... But yes. Before they withdrew to Urqopacha some five centuries ago, the Yok Huy claimed Yak T'el as their own.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_088: Many of their architectural remains can be found in the lower forests─the Ja Tiika Heartland.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_KRILE_000_089: Then that's where they must have had their visions...
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_KRILE_000_090: Thank you. That answers much and more.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_091: I understand what it means to long for one's family. So believe me when I say that, though my position forbids me from aiding you further, I wish you nothing but success.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_092: By helping the Third Promise find the golden city, you will surely find the answers to your questions.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_093: Speaking of which, I have a query of my own for you, .
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_094: May I request a moment of your company?
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_WUKLAMAT_000_095: Go on. We'll wait for you.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_WUKLAMAT_000_100: Go on and see what Hunmu Rruk needs.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_KRILE_000_105: So in order to get my answers, I need to find the golden city...
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_KRILE_000_110: Well, that was my intent from the first. I'll do everything in my power to make it happen!
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_116: First, let us head to the cenote behind this village.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_120: It was my intention to see you off without saying anything, but Mistress Krile's plea has softened my resolve...
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_121: As the leader of our community, I am gladdened to see that the Third Promise has surrounded herself with such compassionate and trustworthy companions.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_122: Would you tell me of her journey thus far?
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_123: Is that so... It seems the rite has been a source of great learning and growth for Wuk Lamat.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_124: It does me well to hear that.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_125: ...My daughter would be about her age.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_126: Girls are rarely born amongst the Xbr'aal. So when she arrived, the village was elated. Such joy I felt when first I held her...and pain when I found her at the bottom of a cenote.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_127: Three years old. An accident, it was said. But I knew better.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_129: Though we never caught them, a suspicious figure was seen fleeing towards the Ja Tiika Heartland. Towards Mamook.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_130: Once bitter enemies, the Mamool Ja and Xbr'aal had learned to live in peace...
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_131: But who could doubt the intent of such a reprehensible act? By targeting the child who would one day lead her people, the criminal sought to undermine the future of the Xbr'aal.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_132: I was determined not to let them succeed. And so I let the memory of my daughter die in that cenote, and gave her into the care of the one person I knew who could protect her.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_133: Though she was born to lead the Xbr'aal, fate had a greater plan for Wuk Lamat.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_134: Only the Dawnservant and I know the truth. But I must now take you into my confidence for one reason.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_135: If the villain who attempted to murder my daughter was indeed of Mamook, then rancor towards the Xbr'aal still burns.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_136: I was caught off guard once. I will not suffer the same tragedy again.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_137: And so I ask you, not as the Dawnservant's elector but as a father, to watch over the Third Promise. Defend her from her enemies that may be lurking in shadow. Will you do this for me?
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_138: Thank you. From the bottom of my heart.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_GULOOLJAJA_000_139: (-Vow of Resolve Gulool Ja Ja-)Will you hear my question and answer me plainly? Address me not as the ruler of Tuliyollal, but a concerned father.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_HUNMURRUK_000_140: Suffice it to say, this conversation must remain between us. Pray breathe not a word of this to anyone.
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_HUNMURRUK_000_001: Recalling the past has rendered me...emotional.
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_HUNMURRUK_000_002: I require a moment to compose myself. But please, do not keep the Third Promise waiting.
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_HUNMURRUK_000_005: I feel better having spoken with you. My thanks.
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_KRILE_000_010: Finished speaking with Hunmu Rruk, have you?
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_SYSTEM_000_015:
Upon speaking with Wuk Lamat, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_WUKLAMAT_000_016: You're back! So what did Hunmu Rruk want?
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_WUKLAMAT_000_017: Heh, it's all right, you don't have to say. More importantly, the Ty'iinbek Traverse still isn't clear yet. Something about even more rocks.
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_KRILE_000_018: Then I think I'll take the opportunity to rest. All that cooking and preparing for it has worn me out...
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_WUKLAMAT_000_021: You're one of Bakool Ja Ja's... What do you want?
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_HOOBIGOBAKOOLJAJAMI: I've come to fetch you. You're welcome to refuse, but know that it would be most unwise.
I'm sure your salted friend has an idea. What do you think?
And they say house cats don't come when called! Follow me, Promise.
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_SYSTEM_000_500: In this battle, you will play as Wuk Lamat.
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_SYSTEM_000_501: Through skillful combat, Wuk Lamat will gain the resolve she needs to unleash powerful limit breaks.
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_SYSTEM_000_502: Not only do these attacks deal great damage, they will recover HP. Use them early and often to emerge victorious!
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_SYSTEM_000_030: You must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 94 or above to proceed.
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_KRILE_000_040: For as weathered as our Promise looks, she's positively glowing with confidence. What in the world happened?
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_ERENVILLE_000_045: The twins ran me from one end of the Ut'ohmu Horizon to the other, asking about everything of remote interest along the way...
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_ALPHINAUD_000_050: Erenville's tour was both educational and exciting! I hope we can persuade him to conduct another in the lower forests.
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_ALISAIE_000_055: Did something happen while we were away? There's a certain satisfied air about you...
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_WUKLAMAT_000_060: Seems we were last to return. I'm glad everyone made it back safely.
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_WUKLAMAT_000_061: Thank you for having faith in me. Keeping out of the fight even when it got dirty couldn't have been easy for you.
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_WUKLAMAT_000_062: But Bakool Ja Ja won't be the last person to threaten those I care about.
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_WUKLAMAT_000_063: I wanted to prove to myself that I can stand up to such villains, even when I stand alone.
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_WUKLAMAT_000_064: Which isn't to say I won't ask for your help when I need it, of course! I know better than that now!
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_KRILE_000_001: For as weathered as our Promise looks, she's positively glowing with confidence. What in the world happened?
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ERENVILLE_000_005: The twins ran me from one end of the Ut'ohmu Horizon to the other, asking about everything of remote interest along the way...
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Erenville's tour was both educational and exciting! I hope we can persuade him to conduct another in the lower forests.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ALISAIE_000_015: Did something happen while we were away? There's a certain satisfied air about you...
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_WUKLAMAT_000_020: So what's the state of the Ty'iinbek Traverse?
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ERENVILLE_000_021: Still being cleared, I'd assume. Hunmu Rruk said he would notify us as soon as work was done.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_KRILE_000_022: Then perhaps now would be a good time to consider how we might reclaim Wuk Lamat's stolen keystone. The next feat will be our last, after all.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_WUKLAMAT_000_023: Oh, I already got it back.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ALPHINAUD_000_025: Not to mention how! This is Bakool Ja Ja we're talking about!
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_WUKLAMAT_000_026: ...So I taught him a lesson and took my keystone back.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ALISAIE_000_027: You bested Bakool Ja Ja in single combat? Bravo!
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_WUKLAMAT_000_028: Hehe, what can I say? I've had good friends to encourage and cheer me on.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_HUNMURRUK_000_029: There you are. Our excavators have contacted me with news of their success. The Ty'iinbek Traverse is now safe for travel.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ERENVILLE_000_030: Then we finally can make for Mamook.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ALISAIE_000_031: Come to think of it, isn't it Bakool Ja Ja's home? We can only hope its residents don't share his winning personality.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ALPHINAUD_000_032: If it is indeed the city where Ketenramm first met the Dawnservant, surely some civility awaits us.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_HUNMURRUK_000_033: I would not be so certain.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_HUNMURRUK_000_034: It is true that the Dawnservant received Ketenramm in Mamook and was instrumental in the establishment of friendly relations between the Xbr'aal and Mamool Ja.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_HUNMURRUK_000_035: But since that time, most of the Mamool Ja who supported his peace have left their city in favor of abiding in the capital.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_HUNMURRUK_000_036: What remains is a cloister of Mamook. And while these traditionalists do not take up arms against us, neither do they bear great love for outsiders.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_WUKLAMAT_000_037: Whatever they're like, the people of Mamook are also of Tuliyollal. If I'm to be Dawnservant, it's my job to know them first of all.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_WUKLAMAT_000_038: Well, we'll be on our way, then. I'm glad I could learn about where I came from. And eat so much xibruq pibil besides!
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_WUKLAMAT_000_039: Thank you for everything, Hunmu Rruk. Till next time, take care!
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ERENVILLE_000_040: First we make our way across the Xobr'it Cinderfield, due southeast.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_WUKLAMAT_000_050: I filled my bag with xibruq pibil before we left, but I'm down to my last serving already...
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_KRILE_000_055: I wonder if the First and Second Promises have already arrived in Mamook.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ALPHINAUD_000_060: If Bakool Ja Ja ran in this direction after losing to Wuk Lamat, then he undoubtedly was returning to Mamook.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ALISAIE_000_065: After seeing that battlefield, I find it miraculous that the Dawnservant was able to negotiate a peace.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ERENVILLE_000_070: The Traverse will bring us straight into the Ja Tiika Heartland.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ERENVILLE_000_071: ...Remember how you insisted this forest is green?
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_KRILE_000_080: This path is quite steep, isn't it? Let us take our time and descend safely.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_KRILE_000_83: I'll take a moment's rest, I think...
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ALPHINAUD_000_090: I spoke with one of the excavators on my way down. Apparently, Bakool Ja Ja cleared away the one fallen tree remaining by barreling through it.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ALPHINAUD_000_091: That Wuk Lamat single-handedly defeated someone possessed of such physical might is nothing short of remarkable.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ALPHINAUD_000_092: Still, we ought to proceed with caution. There's no telling what his wounded pride might compel him to attempt.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ALPHINAUD_000_100: We will doubtless face Bakool Ja Ja again. I cannot say I relish the thought of the reunion.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ALISAIE_000_105: Erenville said this Traverse was dug to facilitate incursions into the forests above. Intentions notwithstanding, you have to admire the dedication.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_WUKLAMAT_000_115: Just look at this thing! What a vibrant glow!
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ERENVILLE_000_121: In more ways than one. Take my pairing stone and hold it close to the glowing rock.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ERENVILLE_000_125: Go on. Use my pairing stone and see what happens.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_SYSTEM_000_130: As you hold the pairing stone in the soft glow, it affixes itself to the boulder with surprising force.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ERENVILLE_000_131: Pairing stones are natural magnets─and that's a meteorite filled with iron. One of many remnants of an ancient meteor shower.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ERENVILLE_000_132: The heterogeneous aether they emit causes surrounding flora to glow unique hues, as you can see.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_WUKLAMAT_000_133: So these glowing boulders came plummeting down from the heavens? Vidraal be merciful...
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ALPHINAUD_300_134: A far cry from the upper forests, indeed.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_WUKLAMAT_000_134: This place is already so fascinating... I'm eager to hear what the people of Mamook can tell us about it!
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ALPHINAUD_000_140: Now to see whether or not Hunmu Rruk's fears were well founded...
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ALISAIE_000_145: Rather more quiet than I expected...
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_KRILE_000_150: I wonder what the final feat will be.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_WUKLAMAT_000_155: And here we finally are... Now to find the elector!
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ERENVILLE_000_160: As this is also my first time visiting Mamook, I have no experience interacting with the locals.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_ERENVILLE_000_161: But given Hunmu Rruk's parting words, I would advise...a cautionary approach.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Now to see whether or not Hunmu Rruk's fears were well founded...
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_ALISAIE_000_005: Rather more quiet than I expected...
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_KRILE_000_010: I wonder what the final feat will be.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_ERENVILLE_000_015: See if you can't convince Wuk Lamat to be cautious as well.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_WUKLAMAT_000_020: Well, we all know what comes next─let's find that elector!
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_ALPHINAUD_000_021: Two streets seem to converge upon this plaza, so I propose we split our numbers between them.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_ALPHINAUD_000_022: Given Hunmu Rruk's guidance, I also suggest that we err on the side of caution and move throughout the city in pairs.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_ALPHINAUD_000_023: Erenville can come with me, and Alisaie can go with Krile. That leaves  to accompany Wuk Lamat. If these arrangements are to everyone's satisfaction, then may our respective searches prove fruitful.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_WUKLAMAT_000_030: ...You can still hear me, right? And see me?
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_SYSTEM_000_036: Your words may as well be ambient noise for all the care this citizen pays you.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_SYSTEM_000_037: As you begin to speak, the man abruptly turns and leaves.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_WUKLAMAT_100_040: Please tell me you've had better luck...
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_WUKLAMAT_000_040: No one will talk to you either? I was prepared for hard stares and harsh words, but this is something else...
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_WUKLAMAT_000_041: That building there looks like a shop, doesn't it? Let's go and take a look. A merchant wouldn't ignore us, surely!
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_WUKLAMAT_000_050: Hello there! We'd like to ask you something, if you don't mind?
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_WUKLAMAT_000_052: W-We're just trying to find someone─the Dawnservant's elector. Could you tell us where they are?
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_WUKLAMAT_000_053: <sigh> How are we supposed to find the elector if nobody will even speak with us?
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_ALPHINAUD_000_054: (-Alphinaud-)Everyone, can you hear me? Come to the massive stone structure on the west side of the city, as quickly as you can!
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_WUKLAMAT_000_060: It's hard to believe Zoraal Ja was bested in battle...
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_KRILE_000_065: The First Promise's attendant just now...did his words not strike you as strange?
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_KRILE_100_065: “I will be the one to reach the golden city.” As though he intends to venture there with or without Zoraal Ja...
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_ERENVILLE_000_070: I have heard about this channeling art before.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_ERENVILLE_000_075: Passed down through a certain clan, it employs arcane implements to produce a smoke from which the mage can conjure a shade.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_ALPHINAUD_000_085: The electors we have met thus far have all had their peculiarities, but each we felt would judge claimants equally.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_ALPHINAUD_000_086: This Zereel Ja, however, seems set in his belief that only blessed siblings are worthy of the throne.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_ALPHINAUD_000_087: Why would the Dawnservant name an openly biased man elector?
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_WUKLAMAT_000_088: Worrying over Zereel Ja won't get us anywhere. That lady, on the other hand, was the first person to address us with any civility since we arrived.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_WUKLAMAT_000_089: We should go and meet her─hear what she has to say. The western outskirts, right?
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_ERENVILLE_000_110: If Zereel Ja is Boonewa and she is Hoobigo, then...
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_ALPHINAUD_000_115: To bid us thus meet with her in private... This is both an important and delicate matter.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_ALISAIE_000_120: Whatever her relation to Zereel Ja, I hope we can trust her. We could do with at least one ally in this city.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_MIILALJA_000_125: (-Miilal Ja-)Thank you for coming. My name is Miilal Ja.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_MIILALJA_000_126: (-Miilal Ja-)Here we may talk freely, away from prying eyes.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_WUKLAMAT_000_127: And what was it you wished to talk about?
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_MIILALJA_000_128: (-Miilal Ja-)Tell me, what do you think of Mamook?
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_WUKLAMAT_000_129: Well, we don't have much to say yet. No one wants to speak with us.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_MIILALJA_000_130: (-Miilal Ja-)All who remain in this city are devoted to the traditional ways.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_MIILALJA_000_131: (-Miilal Ja-)They believe that blessed siblings are superior─that only they are worthy to lead the peoples of this continent. Most would not deign to address outsiders, deeming them beneath notice.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_ALISAIE_000_132: Sounds like an ideal community so far as Bakool Ja Ja is concerned.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_MIILALJA_000_133: (-Miilal Ja-)...I am tired. Exhausted by this...this senselessness.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_MIILALJA_000_134: (-Miilal Ja-)There are others like me, but we dare not speak our truth aloud.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_MIILALJA_000_135: (-Miilal Ja-)Yet now we have an opportunity to reclaim our agency.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_MIILALJA_000_136: (-Miilal Ja-)For you have bested Bakool Ja Ja.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_MIILALJA_000_137: (-Miilal Ja-)You─a Xbr'aal, inferior by all presumptions─triumphed over our two-headed champion.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_WUKLAMAT_000_138: This time, anyway. Next time, I might not be so lucky. Bakool Ja Ja is just that strong.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_WUKLAMAT_000_139: I seriously don't understand why he cheats so much. It seems to me he'd do better if he just trusted his own abilities.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_MIILALJA_000_141: (-Miilal Ja-)Other blessed siblings have fallen before. Molaa Ja Ja of the Silverscales, for one. He traveled across the salt in search of conquest, only to be overcome.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_MIILALJA_000_142: (-Miilal Ja-)Other blessed siblings have fallen before. This is known.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_MIILALJA_000_143: (-Miilal Ja-)But no matter how the individual may falter, the people still believe in blessed siblings' supremacy.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_MIILALJA_000_145: (-Miilal Ja-)He who united Tural under one rule─who in their eyes stands as testament to the tradition's infallibility. Regardless of your father's virtuous intent, his greatest triumph has only fanned the flames of our people's obsession.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_MIILALJA_000_146: (-Miilal Ja-)However, as both his daughter and claimant to his legacy, your triumph could prove that Gulool Ja Ja's true strength lies not in his birth, but in his character. And in so doing, you may give us the strength to renounce blessed siblings forever.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_WUKLAMAT_000_147: I can understand wanting to forsake zealotry, but isn't forsaking two-headed Mamool Ja going a bit far?
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_MIILALJA_000_148: (-Miilal Ja-)You must decide that for yourself. Whether the price we pay is worth an empty dream.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_WUKLAMAT_000_001: If I can use my status as the Dawnservant's daughter to help the people of Mamook, I'm happy to do so. But I'd like to better understand Miilal Ja's motivations first.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_KRILE_000_005: “The price we pay”... Is she referring to the marriages between the Hoobigo and Boonewa clans?
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_ERENVILLE_000_010: What I know about Mamool Ja extremism is limited to what I've heard through rumors. The same is true for most who hail from Xak Tural.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_ALPHINAUD_000_015: Gulool Ja Ja labored to break down walls. That his very existence would instead lead some to raise them is unfortunate...
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_ALISAIE_000_020: I expect it was for his devotees that Bakool Ja Ja joined the rite of succession.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_MIILALJA_000_025: There is a place that will help you to understand our plight.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_MIILALJA_000_026: It lies far to the west of here. Follow me.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_ERENVILLE_000_030: You won't find sights like these anywhere else.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_WUKLAMAT_000_035: Is that a meteorite up there?
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_ERENVILLE_000_036: Aye. And judging by their attachment, that tree must benefit from the meteorite's unique aether.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_ERENVILLE_000_037: Anyway, we should press on. Miilal Ja was anxious for us to see whatever it is she has to show us.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_KRILE_000_040: The canopy blocks out the sun so completely, it's as if we're in a room without windows...
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_ALISAIE_000_045: A hunting camp, like as not.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_KRILE_000_046: I'd love to talk to Mamool Ja hunters and learn about their ways, except they'd probably ignore me...
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_KRILE_000_047: The others have continued on. Let's catch up to them.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_MIILALJA_000_050: The place I would show you is just ahead.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_KRILE_000_055: A cavern. And it looks deep...
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_ERENVILLE_000_060: I was not aware that such tunnels could be found in the Ja Tiika Heartland. A well-kept secret indeed...
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_ALPHINAUD_000_065: Having seen how dark this forest is, I can understand why so many Mamool Ja chose to live in Tuliyollal instead.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_ALISAIE_000_070: What are we looking at, then?
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_WUKLAMAT_000_075: This is the place you wanted to show us?
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_MIILALJA_100_076: It lies just beyond this passage.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_MIILALJA_000_076: Entry to these grounds is not permitted even to the devout.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_MIILALJA_000_077: Nonetheless, I would reveal our secrets to you. Rest assured I shall take full responsibility.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_MIILALJA_000_078: Come. See for yourself the truth of the blessed.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_WUKLAMAT_000_080: Hey, ... Before we rejoin the others, can we talk for a moment?
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_WUKLAMAT_000_081: I really hated him, you know. Bakool Ja Ja. With every fiber of my being.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_WUKLAMAT_000_082: He tried to ruin Ihih'hana, sabotaged us on the river, kidnapped me for my keystone, and released the most vicious tural vidraal of all time! Anything he could do to cause us pain, he did!
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_WUKLAMAT_000_083: Never in a million years would I forgive him...
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_WUKLAMAT_000_084: But the moment I understood why he did what he did─the pain he's been carrying this whole time─all my anger just...evaporated.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_A1_000_001: Does his pain justify his actions in your eyes?
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_A1_000_002: He still needs to make amends.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_WUKLAMAT_000_086: I hear you. Bakool Ja Ja's motives don't absolve him of his crimes. He must answer for them, like anyone else.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_WUKLAMAT_100_086: But right now, my duty is to ensure that no one in Mamook feels desperate enough to go to such lengths ever again.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_WUKLAMAT_000_088: Anyway, thanks for listening. Now that I've voiced that, I feel readier for the challenges ahead. Come on, let's head back to the city!
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_KRILE_000_090: It's amazing how Wuk Lamat can connect with anyone. She has an incredible gift.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_ERENVILLE_000_095: To think that there was such a dark secret behind blessed siblings... Even among the Mamool Ja, I cannot imagine many know the whole truth─especially not those who reside in the capital.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_ALPHINAUD_000_100: I had no idea Bakool Ja Ja was bearing such a burden. Had he but chosen a different path...
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_ALPHINAUD_100_100: Still, I believe our true character is demonstrated not by right action, but rather by our conduct upon recognizing our faults. It is a struggle I know all too well...
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_ALISAIE_000_105: ...Sometimes it's best to just forgive and move on. It can be difficult─gods, don't I know it─but that's all the more reason to try your damndest to look past how you were wronged and let bygones be bygones.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_WUKLAMAT_000_110: Bakool Ja Ja's scale represents his faith in us.
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_WUKLAMAT_000_111: We won't fail him or his people.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_KRILE_000_001: It's amazing how Wuk Lamat can connect with anyone. She has an incredible gift.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_ERENVILLE_000_002: To think that there was such a dark secret behind blessed siblings... Even among the Mamool Ja, I cannot imagine many know the whole truth─especially not those who reside in the capital.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_WUKLAMAT_000_003: The only way to help Mamook is to understand Mamook. We won't let Bakool Ja Ja down!
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_ALISAIE_000_004: ...Sometimes it's best to just forgive and move on. It can be difficult─gods, don't I know it─but that's all the more reason to try your damndest to look past how you were wronged and let bygones be bygones.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_ALPHINAUD_000_005: We haven't a moment to lose.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_ALPHINAUD_000_006: According to Miilal Ja, Moxutural Zooj is an abandoned settlement northwest of the city. It should afford us the privacy we require.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_ALPHINAUD_100_006: We must work quickly, lest Zereel Ja discover our intentions. Fortunately, Bakool Ja Ja thought to give us additional scales, so we might cover more ground in less time.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_WUKLAMAT_000_007: Everyone should take one and get going. Use them to gather as many people as you can.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_WUKLAMAT_000_008: , let's retrace our steps. Maybe this time we can convince folks to lend an ear.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_WUKLAMAT_000_010: Look! I've already made a new friend!
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_BOONEWABLUNT04904_0: ...That scale. If the blessed trust you, then so will I.
So, what is it that you require of me?
Bakool Ja Ja bids us come to Moxutural Zooj?
A strange place for an assembly, but very well. I will not refuse he who fights for our dreams.
