TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_HOOBIGOMALESHOP_000: Did I not tell you to move along? I can't be seen talking with the likes of you!
A blessed scale? In an outsider's hands? ...What business do you have with me?
So Bakool Ja Ja sent you to call an assembly... I'm not sure what to make of this, but I shall go to Moxutural Zooj at once.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_WUKLAMAT_000_020: Have you managed to gather some of the good folks?
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_WUKLAMAT_000_021: Wonderful! The esteemed Bakool Ja Ja will be pleased. This fellow here will be coming to Moxutural Zooj as well.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_WUKLAMAT_000_022: Apparently, there's a najool nursery to the west called Golmajiik Grove. Could you go and see who you can talk to there as well?
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_WUKLAMAT_000_023: I'll meet you in Moxutural Zooj afterwards. There's just one more person I need to find!
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_BOONEWABANANA04906_: Oh! My apologies, I was unaware. I thank you, blessed scale bearer, for bringing me word of this gathering.
I shall away to Moxutural Zooj at once.
Now that I think on it, why would Bakool Ja Ja grant you his scale...?
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_HOOBIGOMALESHOP_000: What a curious place to gather...
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_BOONEWABLUNT04904_0: Whatever Bakool Ja Ja requires of me, I shall happily provide.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_ALPHINAUD_000_062: You invited the Second Promise as well?
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_KOANA_000_063: <sigh> Lamaty'i. Need I remind you that this rite is a competition?
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_KOANA_000_064: Whatever advantage you're about to share with me, you ought to utilize to your own benefit. I have barely made headway in communicating with the locals─at this rate, you lead the race to the golden city.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_WUKLAMAT_000_067: No, no. Mamook has a problem I can't solve on my own, and you're the most clever person I know.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_WUKLAMAT_000_068: I want you to hear the people firsthand, so that we might come up with a way to help them.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_KOANA_000_069: Very well. I am at your disposal.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_WUKLAMAT_000_070: Everyone, thank you for gathering on such short notice! I am Wuk Lamat, Third Promise of Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_BOONEWAMALEUNFRIEND: Promise? I thought you served Bakool Ja Ja!
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_BAKOOLJAJA_000_073: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)No. They did not.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_BAKOOLJAJA_000_074: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)The scales they showed you were mine. I entrusted them to the Third Promise and her retinue.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_BAKOOLJAJA_000_076: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Because Wuk Lamat has won my trust. Now, you will hear her words.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_WUKLAMAT_000_077: Bakool Ja Ja shared with me the truth about blessed siblings. About the price you pay to conceive them.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_WUKLAMAT_000_078: As an outsider to your community, it is not my place to judge you or your culture.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_WUKLAMAT_000_079: Culture is born of the experiences of its people. Of their lives and their land.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_WUKLAMAT_000_080: But it breaks my heart to know that yours has brought you all so much suffering.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_WUKLAMAT_000_081: If any here wish to break from the cycle of tragedy that creating blessed siblings demands, I ask that you join us.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_BAKOOLJAJA_100_081: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Please. I don't want any more of our children to die.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_HOOBIGOMALESHOP_000: We have no choice! Only blessed siblings can liberate us from our suffering. Without them, we have nothing!
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_BAKOOLJAJA_000_085: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)That remains to be seen. Speak with the Third Promise. Share with her your worries and your pain, and together we may find a new way forward.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_HOOBIGOMALESHOP_000: If she is trustworthy...then I will speak with her.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_MIILALJA_000_087: It would be best if you withdrew, my son. Many cannot yet speak freely in your presence.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_ALISAIE_000_088: Let's keep an eye out for Zereel Ja. He wouldn't take kindly to this sort of gathering.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_WUKLAMAT_000_089: Once we understand everyone's concerns, we'll be better equipped to help them. Let's make sure they feel heard.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_HOOBIGOFEMALECONFUS: Even if Bakool Ja Ja trusts the Third Promise, I don't know if I'm comfortable discussing this with her...
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_HOOBIGOMALESHOP_000: Belief in blessed siblings and the salvation they would bring has sustained me for years and years. But if there's another way...if the Third Promise can truly help us...
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_BOONEWABLUNT04904_0: I don't know what to think or how to feel about this...
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_MIILALJA_100_097: I'm sure my son would have preferred to stay, but his presence alone still greatly sways our people's behavior.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_WUKLAMAT_000_098: I'm glad Koana agreed to help us.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_WUKLAMAT_000_099: He's always been good at solving complicated problems. Me, not so much─but I'll support Mamook's people however I can.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_WUKLAMAT_000_100: By combining our respective strengths, we'll help them discover a new source of hope. I know we will!
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_MIILALJA_000_020: I'm sure my son would have preferred to stay, but his presence alone still greatly sways our people's behavior.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_HOOBIGOFEMALECONFUS: Even if Bakool Ja Ja trusts the Third Promise, I don't know if I'm comfortable discussing this with her...
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_HOOBIGOMALESHOP_000: Belief in blessed siblings and the salvation they would bring has sustained me for years and years. But if there's another way...if the Third Promise can truly help us...
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_BOONEWABLUNT04904_0: I don't know what to think or how to feel about this...
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_WUKLAMAT_000_045: All right, . Before we start, let's make sure we're remembering our history correctly.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_WUKLAMAT_000_046: The Mamool Ja and Xbr'aal fought for centuries over the land in the upper forest. But due to infighting, Mamool Ja forces struggled to make significant gains.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_WUKLAMAT_000_047: In order to promote cooperation, the Hoobigo and Boonewa clans intermarried─and that's how blessed siblings were first conceived.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_WUKLAMAT_000_048: With that in mind, let's talk to the people and learn why they rely on blessed siblings.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_WUKLAMAT_000_050: What is it? There are still people we haven't spoken with.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_HOOBIGOFEMALECONFUS: Blessed siblings promise us more than strength─they promise us the sun.
This forest is dark and inhospitable. When given the opportunity to live in Tuliyollal, most of our people didn't think twice.
Still, the prospect of being among so many outsiders was intimidating enough to keep many of us here.
Blessed siblings are meant to deliver us from this accursed forest─to lead us to the fertile land above, where we might make a place for Mamool Ja to abide in peace and plenty.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_WUKLAMAT_000_059: So you desire fertile land. One that's all your own...
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_HOOBIGOFEMALECONFUS: We've long since given up on anyone understanding our plight.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_BOONEWABANANA04906_: As you'll have noticed, this forest is very dark. Hardly any sunlight makes it through the canopy, so it feels like it's always night.
We plow, we fertilize, we irrigate─yet our crops shrivel and die as though cursed.
The only one that grows well is najool─Ja Tiika banana in Turali. Try living on that and little else for a few centuries and see how you like it.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_WUKLAMAT_000_068: A forest where nothing grows... It's not hard to imagine why you'd want to leave.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_BOONEWABANANA04906_: This forest rejects us. From our doomed crops to those unnatural meteorites─the signs are unmistakable.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_HOOBIGOMALESHOP_000: This land was once rich with ore, but the Yok Huy did not stop digging until all the veins were spent.
The meteorites are only good for so much. Even if we made overtures to traders, we have little to offer.
Nothing would make me happier than to make a good life for my family in the place where I was born. But that's impossible...
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_WUKLAMAT_000_078: So with resources as sparse as they are, you don't have good prospects for trade...
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_HOOBIGOMALESHOP_000: Trust me. If this forest had anything else others might want, I would have found it by now.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_BOONEWABLUNT04904_0: Those who have known only open skies and bountiful land cannot comprehend our plight.
To thrive we must take what we lack by force. And for that, we need the might of blessed siblings.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_WUKLAMAT_000_087: There have to be other ways to thrive─ways that don't require fighting!
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_BOONEWABLUNT04904_0: We who live in this forest have precious little choice. We have to fight if we're to do more than survive.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_WUKLAMAT_000_100: Well, I think I'm starting to understand.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_WUKLAMAT_000_101: Everyone had their own perspective, but all their concerns were about the forest itself.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_WUKLAMAT_000_102: Dark, infertile─cursed. Hearing that, it's little wonder that people here wish they had better land. And who better to get it for them than blessed siblings?
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_WUKLAMAT_000_103: It's hard to convince people to stay in a place that can't provide what they need. You'd think the meteorites, at least, would have value, but apparently not...
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_WUKLAMAT_000_104: Hold on. Didn't Erenville mention something about the meteorites? That the aether they emit makes the plants glow blue?
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_KOANA_000_105: A rather significant physiological effect, I would say. If we were to study these meteorites, we might discover other ways they influence local flora.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_KOANA_000_106: I noticed a curious amalgam of tree and meteorite just south of here. Determining precisely how they interact with one another may yield crucial insights.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_WUKLAMAT_000_107: Everyone, I really appreciate you for sharing your thoughts with us. Thanks to your insights, we have a promising idea already.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_WUKLAMAT_000_108: We just need a moment to investigate it further, so please bear with us! We'll be right back!
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_KOANA_000_110: I had known that Yak T'el was battered by a veritable deluge of meteorites long ago, but I never considered how their presence might be affecting the environment...
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_KRILE_000_115: At first glance, this forest seems a haven of mysterious beauty. But the reality of living here is quite another matter...
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_ERENVILLE_000_120: Plants that shrivel as though cursed... I think I can hazard a guess as to why...
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_ALPHINAUD_000_125: What a remarkable tree... I hope it will provide us with the insights we need.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_MIILALJA_000_126: I'll watch over things here while you're away. Go and help the Third Promise however you can.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_WUKLAMAT_000_130: It really is incredible how a tree could support such an enormous boulder.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_KOANA_000_131: The meteorite's aetheric emissions are palpable, even from this distance...
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_KOANA_000_132: Seeing this again makes me feel more confident in sharing a theory of mine. I suspect that only plants with an aetheric affinity to these meteorites can thrive in this forest.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_ALPHINAUD_000_133: If so, the gargantuan trees that create the dense canopy would by necessity possess the same affinity. As well as the aforementioned najool tree.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_KOANA_000_134: Indeed. I should like to analyze samples of meteorite before drawing any definitive conclusions, however.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_KOANA_100_134: I carry with me a few devices that will aid in this endeavor, but perhaps you and Krile could lend your expertise as well?
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_ERENVILLE_000_135: I'd like to join you. The aetheric signature of those meteorites may be crucial in determining what manner of species might fare well here.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_WUKLAMAT_000_137: Ahhh, I think I see what you're getting at! If we can prove to them the cursed forest isn't quite so cursed, maybe the people won't feel like blessed siblings are their only solution!
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_WUKLAMAT_000_138: So how can I help? Want me to climb the tree and break off a piece of meteorite for you?
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_KOANA_000_139: There are plenty of fragments on the ground already. It should be enough for our purposes if we gather about five pieces each.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_KRILE_000_140: Even better if those fragments are gathered from disparate locations.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_KOANA_000_141: I will collect your pieces once you have them.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_KOANA_000_165: I have mine already, so let me know when you have yours.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_KOANA_000_172: Alphinaud, Krile, and I will combine the gathered samples and conduct an analysis forthwith.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_KOANA_000_173: Determining the wavelength may take a little while, but I am hopeful that our efforts will bear fruit.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_KOANA_000_174: I'll tell my sister to await our arrival at Moxutural Zooj, so go and meet her there. We will return with our results as soon as possible.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_MIILALJA_000_175: Many are reluctant to trust the Third Promise, but all agreed to wait for her return. That alone gives me cause to hope.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_WUKLAMAT_000_180: We've done all we can. The rest we must leave to Koana and the others.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_WUKLAMAT_000_181: I don't know the first thing about those Sharlayan devices of his, but if they can be of help to Mamook, I'm glad he has them!
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_WUKLAMAT_000_182: There's hope for this forest yet, . I can feel it.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_MIILALJA_000_000: Many are reluctant to trust the Third Promise, but all agreed to wait for her return. That alone gives me cause to hope.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_001: I'm sure Zereel Ja would have choice words for us if he knew what we were up to.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_002: But his people are my people, and I can't ignore their plight.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_003: If I'm to call myself Dawnservant one day, I have to bring an end to the tragedy here. Many are depending on me, Bakool Ja Ja not least of all.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_004: Anyway, I'm sure Koana and the others will be back with their report soon.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_010: They shouldn't be much longer now!
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_KOANA_100_020: Good, everyone is assembled. In light of our news, I thought it only right to call the others.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_KOANA_000_020: Thanks to the efforts of all, I'm pleased to say our analysis has yielded many valuable insights.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_KOANA_000_021: And I daresay the prognosis is hopeful.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_KOANA_000_022: Earlier, we asked about the hopes you place in blessed siblings. Why they are important to you.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_KOANA_000_023: Your overwhelming response was a frustration towards this forest.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_KOANA_000_024: From a lack of natural resources to the inability to cultivate crops, in all respects have you ever struggled to build a prosperous home. Thus your understandable desire for new land.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_KOANA_000_025: However, this would be an unfortunate dismissal of what makes your forest uniquely valuable.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_KOANA_000_026: That is, the soil. Our tests have proven, without a doubt, that the Ja Tiika Heartland is abundantly fertile.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_KRILE_000_027: This may be surprising to hear, as you have seen crops fail time and time again. But we have discovered the root of this problem as well.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_KRILE_000_028: The meteorites scattered throughout your forest emit an unusual energy that greatly influences the development of surrounding plant life.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_KRILE_000_029: Some plants thrive on this energy─like the najool and the giant trees that create the canopy. But others, as you well know, are sickened by it.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_ERENVILLE_000_031: Across the salt in a place called Sharlayan, there is a peerless collection of flora sampled from every corner of the world.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_ERENVILLE_000_032: Now that we know what energies are most prevalent in your forest, we can offer you seeds and starters guaranteed to thrive here.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_ERENVILLE_100_032: I took the liberty of contacting a few colleagues via linkpearl. Should you desire them, a sample of our best candidates can be shipped here in short order.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_ALPHINAUD_000_033: Just as Eorzea acquired the popoto and tomato from Tural, so too might Mamook benefit from foreign crops.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_HOOBIGOMALESHOP_000: You mean...we'd be able to grow more than najool here?
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_ALPHINAUD_000_035: Precisely. While care must be taken to choose those species that will not have an adverse effect on the ecosystem, your agricultural options should increase markedly.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_036: With the right crops, Mamook will have all it needs to prosper, both at home and in trade. Blessed siblings don't have to be the answer anymore!
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_BOONEWAMALEUNFRIEND: Then...there was never any need to fight? Never any need to sacrifice...
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_BAKOOLJAJA_000_038: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)We can't change the past. But we can try to make the future better.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_BAKOOLJAJA_000_039: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Let the old teachings end with us.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_040: I know blessed siblings represent absolute strength to you. Letting go of that idea can't be easy.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_041: But I'll prove that when we work together, our combined strength can achieve anything!
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_HOOBIGOFEMALECONFUS: If there's another way... For our children and our home... We'll no longer suffer in silence!
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_044: Sometimes, we have to fight alone─but not this time.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_045: Would you say a few words, ?
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_A1_000_001: Anything is possible when you work together. Our victory over Valigarmanda is proof of that.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_A1_000_002: With faithful allies at your side, you can save even the entire star.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_A1_000_003: In friends both old and new, you can find the light to banish the darkness!
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_BOONEWAMALEUNFRIEND: The Skyruin!? The great Gulool Ja Ja himself struggled to even seal it!
Saving the star is far beyond the scope of our needs...but I acknowledge the value of allies.
Friends? A perplexing notion from an outsider...but not unwelcome.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_050: We've said what we wanted to say!
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_051: Now all that's left is to defeat my father's shade in the Feat of the Brotherhood and clear the way for Mamook's bright new future!
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_BOONEWAMALEUNFRIEND: Do not give us cause to question our faith in you, please. Live up to your words.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_052: After we complete his feat, let's be sure to tell Zereel Ja the good news about his forest. I'm sure he's as eager as anyone to eat what tasty foods they'll grow here!
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_KOANA_000_053: Compassion even for the likes of him. You continue to eclipse me in every way...
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_BAKOOLJAJA_000_055: (-Bakool Ja Ja-)We're counting on you, Wuk Lamat...
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_ERENVILLE_000_060: Wuk Lamat's gone ahead to announce her readiness.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_ERENVILLE_000_061: I never imagined the samples we so feverishly collected for the exodus would find new purpose here...
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_ERENVILLE_000_062: But if they help these people improve their prospects, all the better.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_ERENVILLE_000_063: Anyway, we should go and meet our comrades where Zoraal Ja made his own attempt. The final feat awaits...
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_KRILE_000_070: This feat may bring us closer to the golden city, but for now we must stand strong for the people of Mamook!
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_ERENVILLE_000_071: I can offer moral support at best. For whatever it's worth. Good luck.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_ALPHINAUD_000_072: Zereel Ja's intention was for this feat to prove the supremacy of blessed siblings.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_ALPHINAUD_100_072: But Wuk Lamat shall instead prove that there are other ways for Mamook's people to empower themselves.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_ALISAIE_000_073: Where did Koana go? Have you seen him?
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_074: Someone has gone to fetch Zereel Ja. He should be here soon.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_SYSTEM_000_075:
Upon proceeding, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_SYSTEM_000_080: You must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 95 or above to proceed.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_KRILE_000_090: The Second Promise has warmed a great deal since we first met him. I daresay that wise and witty duo has been of no little influence.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_ERENVILLE_000_091: I am glad to see you all remain in one piece.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_ALPHINAUD_000_092: Joyed though I am by this outcome, I am also eager to speak with Ketenramm while we have the chance.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_ALISAIE_000_093: Even as a shade, the Dawnservant's strength was incredible. I shudder to imagine how we might have fared without the Second Promise's support.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_KETENRAMM_000_094: Naught like a bit o' hardship to see yer precious children grow into fine adults.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_ZEREELJA_000_095: ...I will not stand in your way.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_ZEREELJA_100_095: But mark me─your victory does not afford you authority to dictate our future. We will decide what is best for Mamook. No one else.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_096: Let's go and tell the people of our victory!
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_098: You brought everyone? We were just coming to you!
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_099: We did it, Miilal Ja. We proved to the Autarch that not even my father's full power could overcome the strength of our fellowship.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_MIILALJA_000_100: I knew you would. I was right to trust you.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_HOOBIGOMALESHOP_000: You fulfilled your promise. Now, it's our turn.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_BOONEWABANANA04906_: You've shown us another way. That we can build the lives we've always wanted. Here, in our homeland, without sacrifice!
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_HOOBIGOFEMALECONFUS: Since our new crops will come from across the salt, I suppose we will have to treat with outsiders... A-As equals, of course.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_104: Inside or outside, we're all just people. No matter what we look like or where we're born.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_105: When you're not used to all the color and variety, differences can feel like obstacles.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_106: But by learning more about what makes us different, we can also find common ground in places we never expected. Something new may become something you love!
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_107: And someone you once hated might one day become your friend.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_108: You'll never know unless you keep an open mind. And while it may feel scary, taking that first step towards understanding is always worth it.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_HOOBIGOMALESHOP_000: Of course... Learning about outsiders may well help Mamook grow.
But what happens when they learn about us? About what we've done?
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_ZEREELJA_000_112: For generations, our covenant has been kept secret, and so shall it remain.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_ZEREELJA_000_113: The atrocities committed here were facilitated by the Autarchs. We and no one else are responsible.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_ZEREELJA_000_114: For my deeds, I am prepared to forfeit my life. But I will not suffer others to be damned alongside me.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_115: No one's being damned. And your life isn't forfeit.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_116: The last thing this city needs is more death. Bakool Ja Ja hasn't fought this hard for this long only to lose his father.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_117: If you truly feel responsible, be the first person to extend understanding to others on behalf of Mamook.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_118: Your community is waiting for you─here and in Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_MIILALJA_000_119: We can still make things right, my love. Choose a different side of history.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_MIILALJA_000_120: Thank you, Third Promise. Thank you for everything.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_121: ...You still owe me an explanation about that cabbage, you know.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_WUKLAMAT_000_122: The people of Mamook have accepted you. Merchants and menders are now available for use.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_WUKLAMAT_000_001: Tankwa does look similar to some Eorzean sailors I've seen, but I never would have guessed he was Ketenramm!
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KRILE_000_002: We ought to speak with Ketenramm before we do anything else.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ERENVILLE_000_003: This is my first time meeting Ketenramm. A Roegadyn if I ever saw one.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ALPHINAUD_000_004: Of all the things I expected to discover in Tural, Eorzea's most legendary sailor was not among them...
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ALISAIE_000_005: It's never too late to let go of prejudice. No matter how difficult it may seem, it can be done.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KETENRAMM_000_006: This ain't no place for a proper chat.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KETENRAMM_000_007: Me cabin's just north of the city. “Blue-eyes' Abode,” as people here call it on account of me dazzlin' twinklers.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KETENRAMM_000_010: Naught but four walls and a roof, but enough for most folk. Make yerselves comfortable.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KRILE_000_011: I wonder how long it's been since he settled down here...
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ALPHINAUD_000_013: I've heard that upon Ketenramm's disappearance, explorers from across Eorzea banded together in search of him. But I doubt they ever thought to look here...
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ALISAIE_000_014: A rather humble residence for a legendary explorer. I would've expected a manor decorated with exotic treasures.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_WUKLAMAT_000_015: Why did you choose to settle down in Mamook? They haven't exactly been welcoming to outsiders─legendary explorer or otherwise.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KETENRAMM_000_016: All the more reason to keep a weather eye on 'em. Though seein' how ye've won them over, methinks I'll have less need for vigilance.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KETENRAMM_000_017: I'm here at Gulool Ja Ja's behest to ensure his hard-won peace is kept. And, incidentally, to remind Zereel Ja of his duty as elector should he have forgotten it.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_WUKLAMAT_000_018: My old man ordered you to stay here? That's no way to treat an honored guest...
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KETENRAMM_000_019: Heh. I'd say I'm more than yer father's “guest” by now. Or didn't ye see the sepulchre atop Worqor Zormor?
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_WUKLAMAT_000_020: That's right...“Ketenramm” was one of the names!
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KETENRAMM_100_021: Yer father and I fought shoulder to shoulder in many a battle, Valigarmanda bein' but one of our triumphs. He and I are brothers.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KETENRAMM_000_021: So when yer brother tells you to stand watch, ye stand watch. Ye trust in his judgment an' his strength of will─even if that means ye have to sit out the occasional scrap.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KETENRAMM_000_022: Surely you understand such a bond? Surrounded as ye are by all these bright an' eager faces.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_WUKLAMAT_000_023: I do. My comrades are my strength─and it's thanks to them that I understand Papa's hopes for this nation. What I must continue to protect.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KETENRAMM_000_024: Then prove yer readiness for the throne, Wuk Lamat. Find the golden city!
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_WUKLAMAT_000_025: Oh, I will. With these ones beside me, even uncovering a legend should be child's play!
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KRILE_000_026: Especially since I believe I already have.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KRILE_000_028: Well, as you know, electors are forbidden from giving unfair advantage to claimants.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KRILE_000_029: So when Hunmu Rruk refused to divulge why my grandfather passed through Iq Br'aax twenty years ago, his silence spoke volumes.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ALISAIE_000_030: You think Galuf's visit had something to do with the golden city?
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KRILE_000_031: Precisely. Moreover, only the Yok Huy who lived in Yak T'el ever dreamt those golden dreams.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KRILE_000_032: When exposed to certain triggers, those with magical aptitude have been known to receive visions.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KRILE_100_032: And if Gurfurlur's abilities are at all representative, the Yok Huy are no stranger to the arcane...
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KRILE_200_032: Which means the dreamers of eld likely owe their experiences to their inherent qualities and their proximity to the city itself. Here, in these forests.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_WUKLAMAT_000_033: Then all we need to do is search Yak T'el from top to bottom, right?
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ALPHINAUD_000_034: It would behoove us to try and narrow our focus. To that end, I propose we return to Mamook and make inquiries.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ALPHINAUD_000_035: While there, we can all take the opportunity to see to any necessary travel preparations. When everyone is ready, let us assemble at the aetheryte.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KETENRAMM_000_037: She told me about you. Said she tasked ye with findin' the golden city.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ERENVILLE_000_038: Aye. I might even succeed, despite my best efforts.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ERENVILLE_000_039: I had begun to think it was a fool's errand. My own fruitless search in my youth proved as much.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KETENRAMM_000_040: Yet here you are, older and wiser, playin' the fool again.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ERENVILLE_000_041: Courtesy of the company I've been keeping, perhaps. Wuk Lamat's not the only one to have grown thanks to her comrades.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KETENRAMM_000_043: Heh. Was I ever that young...?
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ERENVILLE_000_052: You waited for me? It seems Ketenramm knows my mentor, so we chatted for a bit longer.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ERENVILLE_000_053: Alphinaud said to meet by the aetheryte, so I'll see you there.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KRILE_000_060: The merchants were more than happy to mend my gear and sell me supplies.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KRILE_000_061: One would hardly believe that they were ever averse to aiding visitors.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_WUKLAMAT_000_062: Hehe! You won't believe how many najool they gave me!
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_WUKLAMAT_000_063: Now all we need is a hint to point us in the right direction. City of gold, here we come!
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_MIILALJA_000_064: I think I can offer that much.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_MIILALJA_000_065: I have an inkling of where the golden city might be.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_WUKLAMAT_000_066: Miilal Ja! A-And Zereel Ja!? You've come to help us?
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ZEREELJA_000_067: As an elector, I am forbidden from speaking of the golden city. ...But my wife is beholden to no such constraints.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_WUKLAMAT_000_068: Then anything you can tell us would be greatly appreciated.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_MIILALJA_000_069: Our people have lived here for centuries. There is no corner of this forest we do not intimately know─save for one.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_MIILALJA_000_070: Do you recall the place I showed you, where my son confessed the truth of blessed siblings?
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_MIILALJA_000_071: That stone pier stands at the entrance of the Skydeep Cenote. The final resting place for children we lost to our zealotry.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_MIILALJA_100_071: Precious few are permitted beyond the cenotaph doors, and we have not explored its deepest recesses. If the golden city is in Yak T'el, it may well be hidden there.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_WUKLAMAT_000_072: Will you permit us to search for it?
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ZEREELJA_000_073: ...I have no reason to refuse you.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ZEREELJA_000_074: No longer will we rely on blessed siblings, nor will we conceal the sacrifices made to conceive them.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ZEREELJA_000_075: The cenote is no longer under our protection. It is a dismal burial ground...and our children deserve better. Their bodies will be moved to a place of comfort and peace.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_WUKLAMAT_000_076: I'm sure Bakool Ja Ja would appreciate that. And we're here to offer any help, if you need it.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_MIILALJA_000_077: Your father also visited the cenote, come to think of it.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_MIILALJA_000_078: It was many years ago by now, but a notable affair due to the foreigner he brought with him. A mage, I believe.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ZEREELJA_000_080: The Dawnservant did not disclose his reasons, but he descended past our cenotaph and into the old Yok Huy quarries.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KRILE_000_081: Doubtless the very same ones excavated by Vorporlor's dreamers.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KRILE_000_082: Then the golden city must be there.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_WUKLAMAT_000_083: In the depths of the Skydeep Cenote!
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_WUKLAMAT_000_084: Thank you, both of you. We'll set out straightaway!
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_MIILALJA_000_085: You will find a winged beast or two lingering in Gok Draak Descent. They will carry you below.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_MIILALJA_000_086: I believe in you, Third Promise. You will make a magnificent Dawnservant.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_WUKLAMAT_000_087: This is it, everyone. To the Skydeep Cenote!
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_Q1_000_090: Ride the beast to the Skydeep Cenote?
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_POPMESSAGE_000_091: With a powerful leap, the beast takes flight!
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_WUKLAMAT_000_092: This is the cenotaph. Which means that beyond these doors is...
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ERENVILLE_000_093: Rite of succession or no, disturbing the souls that rest here feels wrong.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_WUKLAMAT_000_094: I know...but I can't turn back. Let's pay our respects, at the very least.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_WUKLAMAT_000_096: I'm ready to complete my journey.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ERENVILLE_000_100: I confess, I anticipated my duty as a guide with no little weariness.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ERENVILLE_000_101: I knew our journey might change the course of my nation, but...I did not think it would change the course of my own life.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_A2_000_002: Form a party and enter the Skydeep Cenote.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_WUKLAMAT_000_102: Part of me is sad to see our journey end...but I have to see what's waiting for us in there!
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KRILE_000_103: Wuk Evu, Mablu...so many people have helped us reach this moment. Let us honor their generosity and find the golden city at last!
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ALPHINAUD_000_104: Cenotaphs are notorious for attracting malefic creatures. We must exercise all due caution.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ALISAIE_000_105: I don't know what's down there, but I'm eager to see it with my own eyes.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_PESHEKWA_100_120: We have been eagerly awaiting your safe return.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ERENVILLE_000_120: That was wholly unlike what I imagined in my youth... Since when did a place like that exist in Yok Tural?
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KRILE_000_121: I understand now why the Students of Baldesion were petitioned...
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_KRILE_000_122: But what were my grandfather's findings? Not only regarding that stone, but that gate...
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ALISAIE_000_123: It feels as though we have more questions than we set out with. But for now, returning in one piece is cause enough for celebration.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ALPHINAUD_000_124: Well, we've done it. We've seen Wuk Lamat to victory in the rite of succession.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ALPHINAUD_000_125: Like me, I expect you have no few questions about the golden city, but they must wait until our claimant has settled into her new role.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ALPHINAUD_000_126: Even as we speak, she prepares for the ascension ceremony back at the palace. I'm given to understand it will be held in a few days time.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_ALPHINAUD_000_127: In the meantime, let us all enjoy some well-deserved rest.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_SYSTEM_000_130: You may now enter the Skydeep Cenote with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_KINGMC114_04910_SYSTEM_100_001: Upon speaking with Peshekwa, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
TEXT_KINGMC114_04910_SYSTEM_200_001: It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_KINGMC114_04910_PESHEKWA_000_001: Welcome back. And may I congratulate you on Wuk Lamat's victory in the rite of succession.
TEXT_KINGMC114_04910_PESHEKWA_000_002: It is our great honor to host the comrades of our future Dawnservant.
TEXT_KINGMC114_04910_PESHEKWA_000_003: Such a grand journey has doubtless left you fatigued. Please relax and enjoy your stay.
TEXT_KINGMC114_04910_KOANA_000_020: Surprised to see me? I suppose it's only natural...
TEXT_KINGMC114_04910_KOANA_000_023: That my sister was able to realize her potential is testament to the quality of her traveling companions. Particularly you.
TEXT_KINGMC114_04910_KOANA_000_024: For that, you have my heartfelt gratitude.
TEXT_KINGMC114_04910_A1_000_001: I only did as you might have in my position.
TEXT_KINGMC114_04910_A1_000_002: Wuk Lamat did all the work. I was just moral support.
TEXT_KINGMC114_04910_KOANA_000_025: My primary business in calling is to deliver a message from Lamaty'i. As you well know, after the ascension ceremony she will officially take up the mantle of Dawnservant.
TEXT_KINGMC114_04910_KOANA_000_026: She has expressed a desire for you to accept a post within her administration...
TEXT_KINGMC114_04910_KOANA_000_028: You needn't decide immediately. My sister will broach the matter with you again after the ceremony.
TEXT_KINGMC114_04910_KOANA_000_029: Whether you continue to assist Lamaty'i or not is up to you.
TEXT_KINGMC114_04910_KOANA_000_030: That is all. If you'll excuse me.
TEXT_KINGMC114_04910_KOANA_000_031: ...You have become someone irreplaceable to her. As her brother, I acknowledge that with no little jealousy.
TEXT_KINGMC114_04910_KOANA_000_032: But believe me when I say that I hope you will stay by her side.
TEXT_KINGMC114_04910_ERENVILLE_000_050: She might have told someone what she was planning...
TEXT_KINGMC114_04910_ERENVILLE_000_051: But Wuk Lamat does not act without the best interests of her people in mind.
TEXT_KINGMC114_04910_ALPHINAUD_000_052: The Head of Reason was very wise indeed to devise something so elaborate and meaningful as the rite of succession. 'Tis a shame he could not be here to bear witness to the end.
TEXT_KINGMC114_04910_ALISAIE_000_053: A bittersweet celebration to be sure, but I'm glad Wuk Lamat finally got the recognition she deserves.
TEXT_KINGMC114_04910_KRILE_000_054: Wuk Lamat was brilliant up there, wasn't she?
TEXT_KINGMC114_04910_KRILE_000_055: The part with the Second Promise was surprising, but between the two of them, I daresay our new Dawnservants will be capable of anything.
TEXT_KINGMC114_04910_KRILE_000_056: The future of Tuliyollal is bright indeed.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ERENVILLE_000_001: She might have told someone what she was planning...
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ERENVILLE_000_002: But Wuk Lamat does not act without the best interests of her people in mind.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ALPHINAUD_000_003: The Head of Reason was very wise indeed to devise something so elaborate and meaningful as the rite of succession. 'Tis a shame he could not be here to bear witness to the end.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ALISAIE_000_004: A bittersweet celebration to be sure, but I'm glad Wuk Lamat finally got the recognition she deserves.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_KRILE_000_005: Wuk Lamat has truly come into her own, has she not?
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Indeed. Even as she moved the people with her heartfelt words, she retained her characteristic spontaneity─as evidenced by her nomination of Koana as fellow Dawnservant.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ERENVILLE_000_015: As sudden as it was, I would like to believe she gave it all due consideration.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ALISAIE_000_020: She could do far worse. Koana completed every feat except the last, and that he only forfeited to help Wuk Lamat secure victory.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_KRILE_000_025: I look forward to seeing how Tuliyollal will prosper under their care.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_035: I could see you all perfectly from up there.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ALISAIE_000_040: That was an impressive speech, Dawnservant.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_050: Besides, after everything we've been through together, you're nothing less than family.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_055: So...like my family does, I'd like you to call me Lamaty'i.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_A1_000_002: I'll try to pronounce it correctly!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_065: Thank you. It means a lot to me.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_KRILE_000_070: It would also be my honor to call you Lamaty'i.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_075: Oh, don't worry about that. However you say it, I know it'll be with love.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_KRILE_000_080: If we do mispronounce it, please correct us, but...
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_KRILE_000_085: It would be my honor to call you Lamaty'i.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_090: Come on, say something would you? We already have Erenville for the mocking silences!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_KRILE_000_095: I think you've simply caught our friend off guard.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_KRILE_000_100: Personally, it would be my honor to call you Lamaty'i.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ALPHINAUD_000_110: Indeed. Consider us your Eorzean cousins, if such a notion appeals to you.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_120: It's a little embarrassing...but not in a bad way!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_125: There's still lots I'd like to say, but I need to make my rounds first.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_130: I want to thank my supporters who're visiting for the occasion. Could you wait for me here?
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_KRILE_000_135: Of course. We'll keep ourselves entertained.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_140: That said, would you join me, ?
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_145: Wonderful! Come and meet me outside the Winged Walk, then.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_KRILE_000_160: Don't worry about us! Go on and have fun with Wuk La─er, Lamaty'i!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ERENVILLE_000_161: She'll always be “Wuk Lamat” to me. No matter how important she gets.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ALPHINAUD_000_162: I don't believe I saw Ketenramm in attendance. Did you?
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_170: Our first stop is Aunt Tii's Tacos─and not just for a snack, I promise. Wuk Evu and Mablu should be there.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SYSTEM_000_171: Wuk Lamat is now accompanying you. Keep her at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SYSTEM_000_172: You can leave Wuk Lamat behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with her and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SYSTEM_000_173: If you wish to have Wuk Lamat accompany you again, return and speak with her at the original location.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_190: Of course, since we'll be at Aunt Tii's Tacos anyway, we might as well pick up some snacks as well, right?
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SYSTEM_000_195: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Wuk Lamat?
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_200: Did something come up? That's fine─meet me by the Winged Walk once you're finished!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKEVU_000_201: Why if it isn't ! Marvelous ceremony, wasn't it?
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SYSTEM_000_202: You must be accompanied by Wuk Lamat and have her at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SYSTEM_000_203: Wuk Lamat has yet to arrive. Be sure she is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKEVU_000_210: Dawnservant Wuk Lamat. Words cannot well express the profound joy your ascension has brought me.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_215: No need for formalities. I'm still the same old me.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKEVU_000_220: All right, then. I shall forgo formalities.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKEVU_000_225: Argh, but I cannot! You are Dawnservant! Too disrespectful it is to address you without your due title!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_230: As Dawnservant, I'm ordering you not to bother with formalities!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKEVU_000_235: All right, then. I won't bother anymore.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_TOBLI_000_240: I could more easily converse with a drunken alpaca.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_MABLU_000_245: Thank you for helping Wuk Lamat become Dawnservant, !
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_MABLU_000_250: Political opinions in our community may have been divided, but a Dawnservant's ascension presents us all with a prime opportunity. Which is why I convinced everyone to participate in a commemorative sales campaign!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_MABLU_000_255: A wonderful plan, no? My first big undertaking as a merchant!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_LINUHANU_000_260: I do like the sound of a sale! ...So long as I'm not persuaded to buy too much.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_265: It's so good to see all of you again. I wanted to personally thank each of you for your help.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_270: The Feat of Reeds and the Feat of Gold were my first true tests as a claimant. If not for your guidance, I would have failed the rite of succession before I fully understood its importance.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_275: Now that you've given me a taste for celebrating culture, I can't wait to see what else Tuliyollal has to offer. In Xak Tural, for instance!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKEVU_000_280: As always, you must observe proper etiquette. I would be happy to offer my services as a tutor, should you desire them.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_285: I can think of no better instructor! I'll be sure to bring Koana as well.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_LINUHANU_000_290: Your duties as Dawnservant will be plentiful─but don't forget your promise to attend Ihih'hana next season.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_295: Of course! I wouldn't miss it.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_MABLU_000_300: When I've made a name for myself as a merchant, I'll come by the palace and tell you all about my biggest sales!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_305: Hehe, I look forward to it!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_TOBLI_000_310: I have been personally attending to your alpaca's care. Dare we hope to see you at the ranch again?
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_315: Hehe, tell my fluffy, spit-filled friend that Wuk Lamat will visit soon.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_320: Anyway, you'll have to excuse us. Oh─you haven't seen Fonjeantaine around here, have you? A tall, slim fellow with long pointy ears.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKEVU_000_325: I saw a man matching that description by the weapons dealer in Bayside Bevy. In the company of a Moblin and a pair of Yok Huy, if I remember correctly.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_335: Enjoy the festivities, everyone. And the tacos!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKEVU_000_350: We could not have asked for a finer Dawnservant.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_360: Sounds like Fonjeantaine has made new friends. Which should make him easy to find!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_FONJEANTAINE_000_36: Ah, ! A pleasure to see you again.
Wuk La─er, Dawnservant! ! You honor us with your presence!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_370: Thank you for coming, everyone! I know the journey to Tuliyollal isn't a short one.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_RAKOROK_000_375: Pfff... Pfffkohhh... Longroad worth the travel to congratulate new Dawnservants!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_GURFURLUR_000_380: To hear the Head of Reason has passed brings me sorrow, but we who remember him will ensure he lives on. May the accolades of this day be as offerings to the future he envisioned.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ZURMURWUR_000_385: The High Luminary and I attend on behalf of Worlar's Echo. Had our people come en masse, we would have been an obstruction.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_390: Nonsense! You're always welcome─all of you! This is your city as much as anyone's!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_FONJEANTAINE_000_39: I'm glad to see you hale and whole, . Though I know little of the particulars, I can only imagine your latest adventure has been both long and...colorful.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_FONJEANTAINE_000_40: Beginning with near shipwreck, if you'll remember! Yet here we stand, celebrating the ascension of your claimant.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_405: When my journey began, I thought only of preserving the peace that my father worked so hard to create.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_410: But the Feat of Pots, the Feat of Proof, and the Feat of Ice showed me that peace is not simply the absence of war.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_415: Being able to live together in safety and happiness─that was what my father envisioned for this nation. That's the Tuliyollal I want for you all.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_420: So I promise you this─as Dawnservant, I will do everything I can to bring that same happiness to the bandits in Kozama'uka and the Yok Huy of Chirwagur Saltern. I won't forsake them.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_GURFURLUR_000_425: As I was moved by your father's influence, so too may the Chirwagur come to accept your peace.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ZURMURWUR_000_430: Their beliefs have stood for a millennium. While not easily shifted, neither are they immutable.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_435: Heh! Well, I can be pretty determined. They'll come around eventually, mark my words!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_FONJEANTAINE_000_44: I can vouch for the efficacy of such determination. Thanks to the Moblins' hospitality, I have been able to rediscover the joy of my craft and honor my father's legacy.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_RAKOROK_000_445: Pfff... Kohhh... Now that goodliving is secure, the village overflows with feelsmiles! Such cooperation between helphands and potsworn is the very spirit of a healthy potpact.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_450: A partnership like yours is bound to be fruitful. I look forward to seeing the fantastic pieces you produce!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_455: There are some other people I'd like to see, so we should take our leave. Let's try and find Hunmu Rruk.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ZURMURWUR_000_460: The Xbr'aax Rax? I believe I saw him on the sands below.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_470: Enjoy your time in the city! And remember─this will always be your home too.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_FONJEANTAINE_000_48: Come and visit us in Earthenshire! Rakorok and I should be glad to welcome you.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_485: Let's make for the Gleamsands. Hunmu Rruk should be there!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_HUNMURRUK_000_486: Glad am I to see you, . I had hoped I might extend congratulations to the Dawnservant, but she no doubt has other duties to attend to...
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_HUNMURRUK_000_490: My, my. You honor us with a personal visit, Dawnservant. Congratulations upon your ascension.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_495: No, no, none of that. My title may have changed, but I'm still just Wuk Lamat.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_HUNMURRUK_000_500: More than “just,” I'd say. You have grown into a leader fit for this nation. Your father must be proud.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_505: I hope so. But...big events like this make me wonder, you know? What my birth parents might say if they knew.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_HUNMURRUK_000_510: ...I imagine they would say that it fills their hearts with joy to see the strong, compassionate woman you have become.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_HUNMURRUK_000_515: I owe you my thanks as well. For fulfilling your promise to me.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_MIILALJA_000_520: I told Bakool Ja Ja to stay with us so we could all congratulate you in person.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_MIILALJA_000_525: But he marched off, muttering something about not being able to face you just yet.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ZEREELJA_000_530: The boy needs purpose. Purpose beyond catering to the demands of others. He was always too obliging for his own good...
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_535: I'm sure he'll find it in his own time. Especially if he knows his family is there for him.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_545: By the by, have you seen Ketenramm anywhere? Er, Tankwa, that is!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_MIILALJA_000_550: Ketenramm, was it? A strong name...if a bit exotic.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_MIILALJA_100_550: We called upon him before leaving Mamook, but he wasn't at home. I don't recall seeing him at the ceremony either.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_HUNMURRUK_000_555: The First Promise was notably absent as well. Though I assumed he required time to salve his injured pride.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_560: Everyone thought he'd be the one to succeed Papa. My victory must have come as quite a shock to him.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_565: As for Tankwa, I'm sure he's around here somewhere. Or ready to appear when we least expect him.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_570: We'd best be going, but relax, enjoy, and make yourselves at home! And come and visit us any time!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_575: All right, I think I found everyone I could find. Let's return to the others in the Winged Walk!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ERENVILLE_000_590: There are rumors that Gulool Ja Ja may go on pilgrimage now that he's no longer Dawnservant. Though I'm sure the transition process will keep him in the capital for some time yet.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ALPHINAUD_000_591: Gulool Ja Ja stopped by to offer his thanks for our support.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ALPHINAUD_000_592: He also bade me extend his gratitude to you for assisting a concerned father? I'm not sure what he meant by it, but I assume you do.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ALISAIE_000_593: Oh, you're back! Erenville was just regaling us with stories of Lamaty'i from when they were little.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_594: What, the one about the taco? It was basically clean when I found it─or no, the one about Papa's feathers!? Look, I didn't know where else to wipe my nose, and I was too little to know better!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_HUNMURRUK_000_595: Wuk Lamat may have realized her goal, but I hope you will continue to be a friend to her.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_WUKLAMAT_000_600: Let's head back to the Winged Walk. Everyone's waiting!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_KRILE_000_601: Is Wuk Lamat still making her rounds?
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_KRILE_000_605: Welcome back. I hope you didn't rush on our account.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ERENVILLE_000_620: Past these gates and over the bridge lies Xak Tural.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ERENVILLE_000_625: You have your permit, yes? Packed and ready? No last-minute stops to make before we leave?
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ERENVILLE_000_630: <sigh> Forgive me. I'm afraid traveling with our new Dawnservant may have scarred me for life...
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SYSTEM_100_070: Meanwhile, in the depths of the Skydeep Cenote...
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ZORAALJA_000_070: This...is the gate to the golden city?
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SAREELJA_000_071: Two decades ago, your father bade me transcribe a letter to a scholar across the salt, petitioning the study of this place.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SAREELJA_000_072: What he discovered was something the Dawnservant feared enough to seal away forever...or so we thought until the rite's objective became the city of gold.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SAREELJA_000_073: But to think that Tankwa would be entrusted with its safekeeping! Had I known that doddering old fool carried a set of keystones, we might have spared ourselves those tiresome feats.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SAREELJA_000_074: Great power sleeps here─and with it, you shall obtain your birthright.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ZORAALJA_000_075: So you say. Yet the new Dawnservants succeeded where I could not. Taking their throne will be no easy task.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SAREELJA_000_076: The Resilient Son underestimates his own potential! There is no need for worry.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SAREELJA_000_077: I have liberated the key from the Dawnservant's vault. You alone have the means to unlock the gate.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SAREELJA_000_078: You will gain all you were denied. The rite, your father's shade─these bitter memories shall soon be forgotten.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SAREELJA_000_079: Seize your future, Promise. Open the gate, and become the ruler you were destined to be!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SPHENE_000_084: (-???-)If only I could. Alas, this gate will not open for me. Only the key in your possession can connect us.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SAREELJA_000_085: Then...you are the guardian of the city's great power?
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SPHENE_000_086: (-???-)I do not claim this power is great... But the knowledge I possess is enough to realize any desire. To remake worlds.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ZORAALJA_000_089: Fascinating. Name your price, then. For my desire is the world itself...
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SAREELJA_000_090: Yes, yes! The Resilient Son rises! Together we shall create a nation worthy of our rule!
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ZORAALJA_000_092: The useless tool is cast aside.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_ZORAALJA_000_093: Deliver me a new world. One that bends to my will.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_ERENVILLE_000_002: Then present your travel pass to that guard, and let us be off.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_ERENVILLE_000_003: You won't have to wait long to enjoy sightseeing. The bridge to Xak Tural is a wonder in its own right.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_ERENVILLE_000_005: Go on, show your travel pass to the guard.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_LANDSGUARDKEEPER_00: This gate is barred to all save those with express permission from one of the Dawnservants.
...Signed by Vow Wuk Lamat herself! My apologies, . If you would wait here just a moment.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_RRONEEKLENDERA_000_: 'Fraid so. If one'll suffice, I have a creature ready and waiting.
But if you need two, then you'll have to wait.
The rroneek have been actin' strangely of late─more easily spooked and otherwise disagreeable. Pickin' out the few fit for rentin's provin' bothersome work.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_ERENVILLE_000_034: They're usually so docile, and the ones I saw earlier didn't appear to be unhealthy, either. But much has changed since last I was here...
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_ERENVILLE_000_035: Not the best start to our journey.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_ERENVILLE_000_036: Still, the train station isn't far. Seeing as we aren't in a hurry, let's go on foot.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_RRONEEKLENDERA_000_: About that, sir. As well traveled as you look, it's not only the rroneek that've been givin' us trouble. Other wildlife have shown signs of aggression, too.
A merchant should be returnin' soon with one of our beasts. Stick around till they do, and I'll see you both on rroneek for a safer trip.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_ERENVILLE_000_039: Your offer is most appreciated, but I don't think my friend here is particularly concerned about the wildlife.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_A1_000_001: Actually, I may be a little concerned...
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_A1_000_002: But the rroneek, Erenville. The rroneek!
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_A1_000_003: Whatever gets us where we're going faster.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_RRONEEKLENDERA_000_: As well you should. Glad to see at least one of you's got some sense.
Hahaha! If this is your first time in Shaaloani, I can understand your enthusiasm. It'd be a shame not to ride one at least once while you're here.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_ERENVILLE_000_044: A fair point. If we're to give you the “authentic Shaaloani experience,” I suppose it's worth the wait.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_RRONEEKLENDERA_000_: Even if you left now, waitin' for the rroneek'd be faster than walkin', and safer besides. You'll be back on the road before you know it, I promise.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_ERENVILLE_000_047: Right, change of plans. There's a small town nearby. We can pass the time there while waiting.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_RRONEEKLENDERA_000_: Take it you're headin' to Hhusatahwi, then. I'll have a man bring the rroneek over there.
Just mind yourself around the drunkards and troublemakers, eh?
Won't take long, rest assured. Keep an eye out for a man in Hhusatahwi with two rroneek.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_ERENVILLE_000_060: Last time I was here, it was little more than a camp with a shop or three.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_ERENVILLE_000_070: No sooner do we set out than we run into excitement... At least no one was hurt.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_ERENVILLE_000_071: This Dustwatch has their work cut out for them. For as long as I can remember, all disputes big or small were settled by dueling.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_ERENVILLE_000_072: The peoples of Shaaloani rarely saw eye to eye. And for better or worse, it was the simplest way to settle differences.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_ERENVILLE_000_073: Since most would sooner not risk their lives, though, it encouraged parties to pursue peaceful resolutions in a roundabout fashion.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_ERENVILLE_000_074: The Dustwatch was likely established by supporters of Koana, preferring peace be enforced through the formal rule of law.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_ERENVILLE_000_075: A reasonable stance, all things considered. If things ever got out of hand, the Landsguard would be forced to step in. What freedom they have now would be lost under Zoraal Ja's authority.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_ERENVILLE_000_076: All of which is to say that, unless a lengthy stay in a jailhouse appeals to you, be mindful of how you handle your arms in town.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_RRONEEKLENDERA_000_: Won't take long, rest assured. Keep an eye out for a man in Hhusatahwi with two rroneek.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_001: I should like to think the stableman has arrived with the rroneek by now...
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_002: I'll go on ahead to check. If you still want to have a look around, then be my guest. Come and find us when you've had your fill.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_RRONEEKLENDERB_000_: The friend, I take it? Sorry to have kept you both waitin'.
Unruly wildlife's not the only source of recent distress, I'm afraid. Also been a rise in robberies targetin' merchants. As a result, we've got a lengthy list of folks wantin' to use our rroneek.
Which is why I have to ask that you stop at Sheshenewezi Springs.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_013: That's fine, of course, but why haven't the Dustwatch dealt with this banditry?
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_RRONEEKLENDERB_000_: Kemakka and his fellows are doin' what they can, but they reckon the bandits are operatin' as a gang. Roundin' 'em all up's easier said than done.
If you have anythin' of value, you'll want to take care.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_016: Thank you for the warning. We'll be sure to stay vigilant.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_RRONEEKLENDERB_000_: Right, then. If you're ready to set off, I'll see you on your way.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_018: Now that I think on it, this is the first time I've traveled with only a single companion. It makes for fewer complications.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_RRONEEKLENDERB_000_: Ready? Then saddle up. Your friend seems to know the way, so I won't bother givin' you directions.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_SYSTEM_000_021: Mount the rroneek and travel with Erenville?
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_022: This is your first time, so let's take it slow. Take care not to let it toss you.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_023: I continue to be struck by how much Shaaloani has changed.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_024: That town we just visited wasn't even here several years ago...
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_025: With few reliable opportunities to replenish water supplies, travelers turned to nopalitenders.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_026: Not just for the water in their stems, mind. Their fruits are also said to be both nutritious and delicious.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_027: See that hole there? Some might hope to find water there, but it is brimming with ceruleum.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_028: The eruption of flames from within make for a spectacle, inspiring cautionary tales of people who wandered too close.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_029: The Whalaqee, meanwhile, show great reverence to ceruleum and its blue flames...
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_030: ...But that is a discussion for another time. We're here.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_031: A good thing for these rroneek.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_032: No sooner did we dismount than the next passengers are already on their way. They really are short on rroneek.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_034: This is Sheshenewezi Springs, perhaps the busiest town here in Shaaloani. People travel here from all over hoping to find their fortune.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_035: The change come to Hhusatahwi was surprising enough, but this is no less impressive. They've achieved a great deal in the three years I've been away.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_036: The station is on the eastern side of town, but there should still be time before the next train departs.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_037: If you don't mind, I'd like to pay visit to an old friend of my mentor.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_038: Iyaate is her name, and if she learned that I passed through without saying a word, she'd never let me hear the end of it.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_039: She set out from our village some ten years ago, hoping to earn coin as she traveled about Tural. I can but assume she too came here seeking greater opportunities.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_040: In any case, let us see if we can find her. Her blue hair should make her easy to spot.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_045: This is your first time riding, yes? Even so, I can't imagine it will prove difficult for you.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_IYAATE_000_050: Hm? Yes, I'm Iyaate. And who might you be?
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_IYAATE_000_052: Could it be...? Goodness, it is!
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_IYAATE_000_055: A man grown. You were such a darling little thing as a child.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_056: You know, it's only been three years since last we spoke.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_IYAATE_000_057: Really? Only three? I suppose it all starts to get hazy after a while, living as long as we do.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_058: Well, this is Iyaate. She's known my mentor since they were children.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_IYAATE_000_060: Never thought I'd see the day when you travel with company. You really have grown, Elene'shpya!
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_A1_000_063: Is that what they call you here?
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_065: Alright, alright... I was born Elene'shpya. I adopted a new name when I became a gleaner─one that adheres to eastern Viera conventions─so as to avoid drawing attention.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_066: Given that this is a homecoming, it was only a matter of time before you found out. Nevertheless, I would appreciate it if you would continue using my chosen name.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_IYAATE_000_067: A homecoming? You know, I've been thinking of paying the old stamping grounds a visit myself. It would be good to see Cahciua again.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_IYAATE_000_068: She's the finest archer I know, Elene'shpya's mother and mentor. Every time I dropped by, she'd treat us to a veritable feast prepared with fresh game she'd hunted herself.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_069: You're impressive with the bow too, Iyaate. Even among the Shetona.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_IYAATE_000_070: Oh, I couldn't compare to Cahciua. But her skill at arms pales in comparison to her knowledge of nature.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_IYAATE_000_071: That's what earned her a place among Gulool Ja Ja's traveling companions, after all.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_IYAATE_000_072: She was always the inquisitive sort, but her journey across Tural lit a fire in her.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_IYAATE_000_073: Even after Elene'shpya was born, she often left him in my care so that she could embark on another expedition in search of the unknown.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_IYAATE_000_074: Oh, how you would cry and beg her to take you along. It must've been hard on you.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_IYAATE_000_076: What? We're all friends here, aren't we?
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_IYAATE_000_077: No matter how many times he asked, the answer was always the same. “You can come when you prove you're a true explorer.”
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_078: Thus did she task me with finding the golden city.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_079: Despite my best efforts, all paths led nowhere. I assumed it was but a dreamer's fancy, a ploy to goad me into experiencing the wider world.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_080: But it was real. And we found it.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_082: As part of the rite of succession. I assumed everyone had heard.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_IYAATE_000_083: That's amazing! Oh, she'll be thrilled.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_084: And eager to bombard me with questions, no doubt.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_085: Well, we should be on our way.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_IYAATE_000_086: Thank you so much for stopping by. Give my best to Cahciua.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_IYAATE_000_095: Both of you be careful out there.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_100: No doubt these are the infamous local bandits.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_NAMIKKA_000_101: Please, you have to help! I've been robbed!
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_HHETSARROBANDIT_000: Come any closer and we'll slit her throat from ear to ear!
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_105: If you so much as nick her skin, you won't live to regret it.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_TONAWAWTABANDIT_000: Hold on. Did he say this is Wuk Lamat's nursemaid? Maybe this ain't such a good idea...
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_HHETSARROBANDIT_000: Take the goods to the boss. We'll deal with this.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_NAMIKKA_000_109: (-Namikka-)Please, you have to give it back!
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_110: I'm going after Namikka. This lot I leave to you.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_TONAWAWTABANDIT_000: Cocky bastard! I'll hang 'im by the ears and feed the old woman to the dogs!
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_HHETSARROBANDIT_000: We can deal with them later. First, we need to put this one in the dirt.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_BALLOON_000_120: Damn it all.  doesn't know when to quit.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_BALLOON_000_121: Ugh... We're dead if the boss finds out...
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_NAMIKKA_000_130: Thank you. I don't know what I would've done without you.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_131: The bandit managed to get away, but I have an idea of where they're headed.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_132: You said they stole something from you?
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_NAMIKKA_000_133: A bracelet. It was a parting gift from Wuk Lamat.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_134: I see... Close as you two were, I can only imagine how much it meant to you.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_135: But what brings you all this way?
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_NAMIKKA_000_136: With the rite of succession ended, and Wuk Lamat crowned the next Dawnservant, she is ready to stand on her own.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_NAMIKKA_000_137: I told her as much, and of my plans to return home to Yyasulani. She gave me the bracelet that I might always remember our time together.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_NAMIKKA_000_138: It filled me with such joy, I wanted everyone to know─everyone to see this wonderful gift given to me by the Vow of Resolve... And now it's gone.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_NAMIKKA_000_139: I would've let them take every coin to my name, if only they had left me that bracelet.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_140: I would ask what you intend to do, but I know that look.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_A1_000_002: I'll knock them senseless. It's what Wuk Lamat would want.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_NAMIKKA_000_142: Please, you mustn't put yourself in harm's way for my sake.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_143: I can assure you, no harm will come to us.  will make certain of that.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_144: I understand your methods can be brutal, but it would be wise to show some restraint, lest you find yourself on the wrong side of the law. Perhaps I should come as well, to be sure all proceeds as it should.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_NAMIKKA_000_145: I don't know what to say... I can see why Wuk Lamat puts so much faith in you both.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_146: Before anything else, let's see her back to Sheshenewezi Springs. She'll be safer in town, and with Iyaate there to keep an eye on her, we should have nothing to worry about.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_150: No need to worry. She's fine.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_IYAATE_000_160: Erenville told me what happened, and you needn't worry about Namikka. If those bandits should find us, I'll kick up a fuss and see them driven off.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_IYAATE_000_161: That bracelet meant everything to her, and those bastards wouldn't care even if they knew. Makes me sick.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_IYAATE_000_162: But at least she's safe, and I know you'll set things right.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_ERENVILLE_000_165: A number of Iyaate's mining fellows are here as well. Namikka is in good hands.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_010: Alright, let's go and recover that bracelet.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_011: While I have nothing but contempt for these bandits, as this involves a gift from Wuk Lamat, we must be mindful how our actions might reflect upon her.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_012: I doubt Namikka would find joy in the return of said gift if lives were taken in the process.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_013: If it comes to violence, I ask that you stop short of killing them. The rest, we can leave to the Dustwatch.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_IYAATE_000_014: Well now, that makes me think you're strong. Really strong. Are you?
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_A1_000_001: I may have saved the star on one occasion.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_A1_000_002: No more than any other adventurer.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_IYAATE_000_016: You saved the star!? That's a bold claim to make, but if true, that certainly speaks to your strength!
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_IYAATE_000_017: Aren't we humble now? But the matter-of-fact way you say it makes me think it's a tremendous understatement.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_IYAATE_000_018: L-Lest you misunderstand, I'm not questioning your abilities. As a matter of fact, that silence is the sort of response I'd expect from a peerless warrior!
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_019: If your curiosity has been sated, then please indulge mine─is there anything you can tell us about these bandits?
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_IYAATE_000_021: Well, of late there's been talk about some unsavory types coming and going from Tonatenyawi to the southwest.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_NAMIKKA_000_022: Is that the old mining town that was abandoned?
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_IYAATE_000_023: That's the one. Now that ceruleum extraction is big business, no one wants to waste their time picking at the dried-up veins there.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_024: Sounds like a perfect lair for bandits─not to mention that the one with the bracelet fled in that direction.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_IYAATE_000_025: So you'll be investigating the place? I can let the Dustwatch know, if you like.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_026: No, not yet. It would be best if we went alone.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_027: There's something I'd like to ascertain. If you've no objections?
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_040: It seems the bandits have claimed this place for themselves.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_041: They've made no attempt to conceal their presence. How can the Dustwatch not have noticed by now?
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_042: A question for another time. First, we must find the bracelet.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_043: I don't see the bandit who had it. Perhaps they're in one of the buildings.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_044: Ramshackle as they are, it should prove a simple thing to eavesdrop on anyone inside.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_045: If you would go and have a look about, I'll keep watch for trouble.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_SYSTEM_000_049: The bandits will not notice you here. You can safely eavesdrop on any inside.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_SYSTEM_000_050: As you lean in to listen, you begin to pick out voices in the muffled chatter...
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_SYSTEM_000_051: (-Brash Bandit-)...Dunno where we'd be without him. Probably shoveling sand, praying we'd strike it rich.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_SYSTEM_000_052: (-Ratty Bandit-)Ain't that the truth. Only an idiot would work the mines with easier money to be had.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_SYSTEM_000_053: (-Ratty Bandit-)Not when we've got a boss who can keep the Dustwatch off our backs, hah!
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_SYSTEM_000_054: (-Brash Bandit-)Hey, watch what you say! The wind's got a way of carrying secrets to the wrong ears.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_SYSTEM_100_054: (-Ratty Bandit-)Maybe so, but who'd ever believe one of them sainted souls was running our crew?
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_SYSTEM_110_054: (-Brash Bandit-)That drunk who bought your story about the gold-shitting alpaca, am I right?
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_SYSTEM_000_056: As you lean in to listen, a familiar voice rings out through the wall.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_SYSTEM_000_057: (-Zekowa-)Let me out of here, you bastard!
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_SYSTEM_000_058: (-Nettled Bandit-)Shut your mouth, you sniveling little brat!
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_SYSTEM_000_059: (-Zekowa-)Make me! I'll get you all back for framing my friends!
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_SYSTEM_000_060: (-Zekowa-)The Vulture most of all! You tell him he can eat shit!
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_SYSTEM_100_060: (-Nettled Bandit-)Heh. How about we give you the chance to tell him yourself? We'll see how tough you are then.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_SYSTEM_000_061: As you lean in to listen, you hear someone entering the room on the other side.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_SYSTEM_000_062: (-Craven Bandit-)I've brought back a prize you're gonna love, boss!
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_SYSTEM_000_063: (-Craven Bandit-)Have a look at this bracelet─beautiful, ain't it? Bet it was made by a famous artisan!
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_SYSTEM_000_064: (-Ruthless Ringleader-)You idiot! How are we supposed to move something like this without attracting attention!?
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_SYSTEM_000_066: (-Ruthless Ringleader-)<sigh> Reckon we could find a sailor who won't ask questions. Sell it for a song.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_SYSTEM_000_067: (-Ruthless Ringleader-)Here, your reward. And don't bring me this kind of grief again.
