TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_070: The bandits who took the bracelet may be in this building. Have a listen and see what you can find out.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_071: The bandits could be in any of these buildings. I'll keep watch here while you go and check them out.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_075: Finished, are you? Let's retreat for now.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_080: So, were you able to learn anything?
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_081: Their leader is a man of the Dustwatch!?
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_082: That would explain why these bandits have been able to do as they please. And you say they gave the bracelet to him?
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_083: It seems we have our work cut out for us. Did you hear anything else of note?
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_100_083: Zekowa? That's the boy who confronted one of the officers in town, isn't it?
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_084: And you say they threatened to take him to speak with “the Vulture”? Their leader's alias, no doubt.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_085: Fitting for a man who preys on the helpless.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_086: Well then. Not only do we have a better idea of who's behind the recent rash of robberies in Hhusatahwi, but we also know he has the bracelet.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_087: Retrieving it without bloodshed will prove difficult, though, if he's that quick to point a gun at his own underlings...
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_A2_000_001: We need to get him alone.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_A2_000_003: I'll storm their hideout─I can take them!
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_089: You're right. If we confront him with his henchmen around, a violent outcome is all but guaranteed.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_091: The direct approach may have served you well in the past, but it won't suffice here. Wihuwte is the deputy chief of the Dustwatch. He could claim we're the criminals in all this, and no few people would believe him.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_092: Hmmm... I might have a plan.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_093: There's a small settlement to the southeast of here─Luwateninyawawsa. Meet me there and I'll explain everything.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_100: If we're to retrieve the bracelet without conflict, it won't be done barging in through the front door. We'll have to lure him out.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_101: To do that, we'll avail ourselves of yeheheceyaa─dragon-like creatures that live to the south of here.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_102: It's their breeding season, you see, and the males will flock to the scent of a female in heat.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_103: With a few ingredients, and a sample of their feces, I can create an attractant that resembles this scent when burned.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_104: We can then lure the yeheheceyaa into the bandits' hideout, flushing out the Vulture and his gang.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_105: Then, while they contend with our flying friends, we can sneak in and search for the bracelet.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_106: I'm afraid I must ask that you collect the excrement. While you see to that, I will go and procure the remaining ingredients.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_107: ...And before you say anything, I do not ask this because of any aversion to feces. It would simply be easier for me to find the specific species of wild plants we require.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_108: Here. Take this pouch, see it filled, and I will handle the rest.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_SYSTEM_000_110: You survey the area, but see no sign of yeheheceyaa droppings.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_SYSTEM_000_115: You find a pile of yeheheceyaa droppings, and gingerly scoop them into your pouch.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_122: All that's left is to mix the feces with tumbleclaw fibers, dried nopalitender root, and a generous helping of animal fat.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_123: Come. Let's get back to Tonatenyawi.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_ERENVILLE_000_130: Everything is ready. Time to set our plan into motion.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ERENVILLE_000_001: A fair number appear to be gathered inside. Now's our chance.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ERENVILLE_000_002: I will keep watch from here. The attractant I leave to you.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ERENVILLE_000_003: Toss it into the bonfire near the middle of town. The yeheheceyaa will come soon after.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_SHAALOANIGANGB_000_: What did you put in the fire!?
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_WIHUWTE_000_015: Someone wanna explain that ungodly stench to me?
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_WIHUWTE_000_021: Hmph, so the smoke's what drew them here? I swear, when I find out who did this...
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ERENVILLE_000_022: I'd say our friends have stirred up enough trouble. Time to retrieve the bracelet.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_024: (-Zekowa-)I'm still in here in case you've forgotten!
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ERENVILLE_000_025: Sit tight. We'll be back for you.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_026: (-Zekowa-)What!? You gotta get me out of here now! They're gonna kill me!
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_030: (-Zekowa-)Hey! Are you going to help me or what!?
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ERENVILLE_000_031: <sigh> The bracelet must wait. Let's break him out and withdraw for now.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ERENVILLE_000_040: All that effort, and naught to show for it...
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_041: Sorry about that... But damn, I didn't think anyone would have the balls to take on the Vulture!
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ERENVILLE_000_042: No need to apologize. We were planning to save you. Eventually.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_043: Really? And I don't even know who you are. You secret admirers of mine or something?
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_044: Hehe, I'm just havin' fun with you. But I do appreciate the help.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ERENVILLE_100_044: This man they call the Vulture. I've seen his face before.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ERENVILLE_110_044: Was he not the officer you confronted in town?
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_120_044: The one and the same. When he's not masquerading as a gang leader, he serves as deputy chief of the Dustwatch.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ERENVILLE_130_044: That would explain why the bandits are so confident they can avoid capture.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_045: You're trying to get back something the Vulture stole, right? Let me help. It's the least I can do after you bailed me out back there.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_046: I have an idea where he's hid his cache. Reckon he's headed there now, too.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_047: We can go together. I've got a score to settle with him myself.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ERENVILLE_000_048: I don't doubt that you do, but we need to know what it is first. Will you tell us?
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_049: Right, so. Those bandits at Tonatenyawi? They're called the Daybreakers, and it was me and my friends that founded the group...
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_050: B-But it wasn't a gang of cutthroats! Not back then...
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_051: We just wanted to protect people who couldn't protect themselves. Kids being harassed by bullies, workers being exploited by the mining concerns─folks who needed help to even the odds.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_052: That was three years ago. And whenever we found someone scheming in the shadows, we settled matters the best way we knew how.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ERENVILLE_000_054: I see. By the old laws, anyone who loses in a duel must be held to account for their crimes, even those in positions of authority.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_055: And we made damn sure they did, every time. Before we knew it, our small band of friends commanded a force to be reckoned with.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_056: Then, about a year ago, the Vulture and his thugs showed up. They got the better of us and took over the Daybreakers.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_057: Everyone was afraid of him, so they did his bidding without question. But when he showed them how they could make a fortune, easily─that was when he really won them over.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_058: Now the Daybreakers is nothing but a bunch of bandits and cutthroats who prey on the people it was created to protect.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_059: I talked it over with my friends, Kwikana and Liwine, and we all agreed the only way to stop him was to challenge him to a duel.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_060: And he accepted. I still remember how he gloated that he'd win...
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_061: But when the day came, he showed up with the Dustwatch and had my friends arrested on charges of robbery.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_062: As if that wasn't enough, he set their bail at a price no one could ever hope to pay.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_063: With them locked away, there was no one left to help me. None of my old friends from the Daybreakers, and certainly not the Dustwatch...
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ERENVILLE_000_064: And that's why you were ready to challenge him in the middle of town.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_065: I was, until that guy with the spear stopped me.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_066: No sooner had I stepped out of town than the Vulture's minions caught me by surprise. They took me prisoner, then...well, you know the rest.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ERENVILLE_000_067: You said the Dustwatch would be of no help. Are they all working for the Vulture, then?
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_069: The sheriff, Kemakka─he's as honest as they come, a staunch keeper of the peace. Problem is, he's a little too trusting and doesn't suspect a thing.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_070: If it were my word against the deputy chief's, who do you think he'd believe?
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ERENVILLE_000_071: Well, if he knows where this Vulture keeps his spoils, perhaps he can help us recover Namikka's bracelet. What do you think?
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_072: For what it's worth, I have a plan. But I can't do it alone.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_074: All I ask is that you hear me out─but not here. I'll be waiting for you at Sheshenewezi Springs.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ERENVILLE_000_075: I guess we can decide what to do after he gives us the pitch.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_080: Thanks, I owe you one. For a moment there I thought you might actually leave me behind.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ZEKOWA_000_091: This is where he hides his loot. I expect he'll show up soon.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_ERENVILLE_000_095: I'm grateful he could take us to the deputy chief, but it will all be for naught if we're seen.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_000: Well, well, look who it is.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ERENVILLE_000_001: Storing stolen goods here seems risky, but I suppose it's an option for someone with his authority.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_002: Yeah. He moves the spoils in ceruleum barrels, where no one would think to look.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_003: They're mixed in with regular shipments of fuel to Tuliyollal, where they're sold off.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_004: You said he stole a bracelet of yours, right? If he knows you're on his tail, chances are he'll be eager to get what he can for it.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_100_004: But I doubt he'd trust a lackey with that business, given the provenance of the piece. No, I'll wager he's not letting that bracelet out of his sight till he's got coin in hand.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ERENVILLE_000_005: I wasn't sure what to make of you after Hhusatahwi, but I'm glad to see you're more than an impulsive child.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_006: Ah, well...not my finest hour, I'll admit...
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_007: But there's a lesson in that: the Vulture's a slippery bastard. If we're going to catch him, we need to back him into a corner with hard evidence. That's my plan.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_008: First, we need to lure him away from here─over to Hhusatahwi would be ideal. For that, I need one of you to help me.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_009: This will buy time for the other to search the barrels for any stolen goods.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_010: And using that, we'll expose him as a criminal.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_100_010: There's no way to tell if Wihuwte's carrying the bracelet, but regardless, there'll be time enough to find it once he's behind bars.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ERENVILLE_000_011: But won't he simply feign innocence?
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_012: Oh, he'll try. And that's when I'll challenge him to a duel!
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ERENVILLE_000_013: A duel? That approach didn't work out so well for your friends, as I recall.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_014: True. But unlike before, I'll challenge him in front of the whole town. That way he won't be able to wriggle out of it like before.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_015: Every man, woman, and child of the wilds understands the importance of duels and the old laws. The deputy chief would never disgrace himself by refusing.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ERENVILLE_000_016: But wouldn't you be breaking the law by using a firearm in town?
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_017: It's not as if we'd be using live rounds, but it's a risk I'm willing to take.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_018: What's important is that I get him to duel with as many witnesses as possible. When he loses─and he will lose─that'll be the end of the Vulture.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ERENVILLE_000_019: The plan is not without flaws, but...what do you think?
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_A1_000_001: I say let Zekowa have his duel.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_A1_000_002: We can trust in the old laws.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_A1_000_003: As long as we get the bracelet back.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_021: Thanks. I sure was lucky running into the two of you. You won't regret this, I promise!
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_022: Not even he can ignore our traditions. Once he loses, I'll have him confess to his crimes.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_023: That bracelet's really important to you, huh? Don't worry. I'll see to it you get it back.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ERENVILLE_000_024: If you're satisfied, then so am I.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_025: I knew I could count on you!
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ERENVILLE_000_026: I was seen in Tonatenyawi, so it's probably best I stay and search the barrels.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_027: Then you're with me. Tell the Vulture I tried to rob you, but you managed to overpower me. Even if he suspects a trap, he won't be able to resist taking the bait.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_028: You'll want to buy your friend as much time as possible, and make your way to Hhusatahwi. Once you've got the Vulture there, I'll take care of the rest!
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_029: All right, then. Let's get to it!
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_030: Shouldn't be long now before Wihuwte shows up.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_WIHUWTE_000_040: The yeheheceyaa were likely that Shetona's doing. What's his angle?
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_WIHUWTE_100_040: Hmph. And then there's the brat. It's past time I dealt with him.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_SYSTEM_000_041: Wihuwte is oblivious to your presence. Perhaps a gentle poke will get his attention.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_WIHUWTE_000_051: Ah, an unfamiliar face in these parts. Ahem. Have you need of the Dustwatch, ?
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_WIHUWTE_000_052: What? Zekowa tried to rob you, but you apprehended him!?
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_WIHUWTE_000_053: I see... So desperate was he to see his friends free from prison, he turned to a life of crime. How awful...
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_WIHUWTE_000_054: You have my sincerest thanks, . Might I trouble you to take me to him?
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_SYSTEM_000_055: Wihuwte is now accompanying you. Keep him at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_SYSTEM_000_056: You can leave Wihuwte behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with him and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_SYSTEM_000_057: If you wish to have Wihuwte accompany you again, return and speak with him again at the original location.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_WIHUWTE_000_059: Something the matter? If not, then please, lead on.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_SYSTEM_000_060: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Wihuwte?
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_WIHUWTE_000_061: You have somewhere to be? Very well, but I implore you to hurry. I have a duty to see this criminal brought to justice.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_WIHUWTE_000_062: That was a distressingly long wait, . But I presume you can show me to the miscreant now?
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_SYSTEM_000_063: You must be accompanied by Wihuwte and have him at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_SYSTEM_000_064: Wihuwte has yet to arrive. Be sure he is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_WIHUWTE_000_067: Not that this is an appropriate time for me to play tour guide, but if you insist... Sheshenewezi Springs is home to a thriving ceruleum mining industry. The prospect of easy coin has attracted some undesirables, though...
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_WIHUWTE_000_070: Is this the place? I don't see him...
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_A3_000_001: Whoops, silly me. This isn't the right place.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_WIHUWTE_000_072: I see... <sigh> Very well, lead on.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_WIHUWTE_000_075: There's gold in these fields. Blue gold...
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_WIHUWTE_000_076: Ahem. Best be wary of the beasts in these parts. They may prefer to snack on ceruleum, but for you I reckon they'd make an exception.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_A4_000_001: I could have sworn I left him here...
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_A4_000_002: Sorry. I'm still learning my way around.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_WIHUWTE_000_082: This some sort of joke? Of all the... Let's keep moving.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_A5_000_002: I left him tied up around a big rock. Must have been a different rock.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_WIHUWTE_000_092: My patience is wearing awfully thin, . If he isn't at the next place we stop, I may be forced to do something you and I would both dearly regret.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_WIHUWTE_000_098: Unless you'd rather I feed you one raw─needles and all─cut the chitchat.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_WIHUWTE_000_101: I don't see him anywhere! Where is Zekowa!?
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_WIHUWTE_000_102: Tell me where he is, or I'll bury you in the same grave.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_A6_000_001: Confound it, he must have escaped!
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_A6_000_002: Goodness me, where could he have gone?
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_WIHUWTE_000_104: That's it! I've had it with these games, and I've had it with you!!!
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_106: If you want to place me under arrest, you'll have to work a little harder!
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_WIHUWTE_000_107: You'll be begging for a cell by the time I'm done with you!
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ERENVILLE_000_110: That ended up being rather more complicated than expected, but all's well that ends well.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_112: I couldn't have brought him to justice without your help. I don't know how I'll ever repay you.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_ZEKOWA_000_115: Hahaha! That was a pretty nice shot, right?
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_ZEKOWA_000_001: Hahaha! That was a pretty nice shot, right?
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_ERENVILLE_000_010: Now that we have the bracelet, let us return to Sheshenewezi Springs.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_ZEKOWA_000_011: Will you be staying there long? I'd like to give you a proper thanks after I find my friends.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_ERENVILLE_000_012: We weren't planning on it, but there's no need to rush. We'll see you at the Springs, then.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_ZEKOWA_000_015: I'll catch up to you just as soon as I've taken care of my friends.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_IYAATE_000_020: Welcome back. I'm glad to hear those bandits got what they deserved.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_ERENVILLE_000_023: They were understandably worried, but I've told them of what happened in Hhusatahwi. Our minor adventure made for quite the tale.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_NAMIKKA_000_030: My bracelet. Thank you. Thank you so much.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_NAMIKKA_000_031: This is more than just a gift. It is a part of me I could never hope to replace.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_NAMIKKA_000_032: Truly, Wuk Lamat is blessed to have such devoted friends.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_ERENVILLE_000_033: Well, I wouldn't put it quite that way... I prefer to think of us more as long-standing acquaintances.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_IYAATE_000_034: Regardless of how you choose to describe it, there's no denying the depth of your bond. Though I'm sure you'll continue to do so.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_IYAATE_000_035: Can't say I'm surprised the deputy chief turned out to be the bandits' leader. I always knew something wasn't right about him.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_ERENVILLE_000_036: An easy claim to make with the gift of hindsight.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_ZEKOWA_000_037: (-Zekowa-)There you are. The real Daybreakers have arrived!
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_ZEKOWA_000_038: I'd like you to meet my two best friends, Kwikana and Liwine.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_KWIKANA_000_039: If it wasn't for you believing in Zekowa, and doing what you did, we'd still be locked up.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_KWIKANA_000_040: You have no idea how satisfying it was to see that bastard Wihuwte put behind bars.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_LIWINE_000_041: We never gave up hope that Zekowa would find a way to get us out. He always was the best of the Daybreakers. Glad he was able to convince you to go along with his plan.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_LIWINE_000_042: Unfortunately, our group is smaller now, and lacking in strength besides. Some outlaws might see us as an easy target.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_ZEKOWA_000_043: Even so, if anyone should give the Dustwatch the slip, the Daybreakers'll be there!
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_ZEKOWA_000_044: We'll train night and day, so no one'll get the better of us ever again. Isn't that right?
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_KWIKANA_000_045: Right! And you'll teach us how you draw your pistols so fast, won't you?
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_LIWINE_000_046: Well, we won't need to duel if all goes as it should.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_ZEKOWA_000_047: But on the off chance it doesn't, we'd best make sure everyone can match or beat my speed.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_ZEKOWA_000_048: We owe you a great debt, and one of these days, I'll be sure to repay it. On that you have my word.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_NAMIKKA_000_050: If you'll excuse me, I shall find a quiet place to rest.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_NAMIKKA_000_051: As I'll be here a while yet, though, do let me know if there is any way I can be of assistance.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_ERENVILLE_000_052: Were you not planning to take the train home?
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_IYAATE_000_053: Oh, train service has been suspended. Didn't I tell you?
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_IYAATE_000_055: Something about the tracks being damaged in the last quake. The tunnel was closed as well.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_ERENVILLE_000_056: An earthquake? It must have happened when we were still down south.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_IYAATE_000_057: There've been quite a few tremors of late, and a rather large one struck not long before you two arrived. I can only hope no one was hurt...
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_IYAATE_000_058: At any rate, if you want to know when service will resume, you could speak with the stationmaster yourself.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_ERENVILLE_000_059: Let's do that. The station is just over there.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_IYAATE_000_060: I'd like to believe the train will be up and running again soon...
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_SHENZA_000_063: I'm sorry, but there's nothing we can do with the tracks as they are.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_ERENVILLE_000_065: It seems people aren't too happy about the train delays.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_SHENZA_000_070: We'll be ready to handle that timber when you and the chief get back.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_ZAWPYA_000_075: With your help, we'll get the railroad operating again. And then you'll have the chance to see our engine in motion─it's poetry, I tell you!
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_NITOWIKWE_000_080: Right, we've got work to be getting on with ourselves!
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_ERENVILLE_000_090: Though no small number live in Shaaloani, I must confess that I've never visited the home of the Hhetsarro.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_ERENVILLE_000_091: As they largely live in accordance with older traditions, I suspect they may have a dim view of the railroads...
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_SHENZA_000_000: We'll be ready to handle that timber when you and the chief get back.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_ZAWPYA_100_000: With your help, we'll get the railroad operating again. And then you'll have the chance to see our engine in motion─it's poetry, I tell you!
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_SHENZA_000_002: There's another station on the way, so be sure to drop in. The train'll be in the depot, but you can still see it from outside!
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_SHENZA_000_003: I'm quite taken with the sleek design of the headend, myself. Though if you peek through the windows, you can probably catch a glimpse of─
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_ZAWPYA_000_004: Enough jabbering, Shenza. Thanks to these two, we finally have some real work to do, so let's get to it.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_ERENVILLE_000_006: I suppose there's no harm in stopping at the station. It's on the way, after all.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_ERENVILLE_000_008: I must confess, the train is an impressive sight. How easy it must be to ship goods throughout the wilds now.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_ERENVILLE_000_009: Right, Mehwahhetsoan should be to the northeast of here. Let's continue on.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_WAWLIKA_000_010: Ah, there you are. The village is just up ahead.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_WAWLIKA_000_011: Truth be told, I've never had direct dealings with the people of Mehwahhetsoan. But I do know that their traditions mean a great deal to them, as does the land...
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_ERENVILLE_000_012: Ahhh, such lovely clean air... It feels like a treat after the overpowering ceruleum of Sheshenewezi Springs.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_ERENVILLE_000_013: The waters nearby are just as pristine. It's a paradise for people and animals both.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_HHWATO_000_014: (-???-)I'm glad you appreciate the blessings of nature as we do.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_HHWATO_000_016: I am Hhwato, chief of Mehwahhetsoan. And this is my son, Shepetto.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_WAWLIKA_000_018: I thank you for the warm welcome, and apologize for our sudden intrusion.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_WAWLIKA_000_019: I'm Wawlika, stationmaster of Xak Tural Railing.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_WAWLIKA_000_020: The recent earthquake has damaged our tracks, and we require timber to make repairs.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_WAWLIKA_000_021: This is  and Erenville, who have volunteered to assist us with the restoration effort.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_SHEPETTO_000_022: <sniff> You've a most curious air about you. Of oil and steel, tanned leather, and the faintest hint of.... I gather you are not from these lands?
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_A1_000_002: I'm a traveler of the star.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_SHEPETTO_000_024: Truly? I would love to know more of you and the lands you have seen...
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_ERENVILLE_000_025: I am told your people hold your traditions in the highest. Yet I gather you are curious about those of others as well?
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_HHWATO_000_026: But of course. Nature is boundless, as is our love for her lands and her children. The hhetso, in particular, have done much to guide our way of life.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_HHWATO_000_027: Where to hunt, to gather, to lay our heads─the hhetso teach us all these things and more. It is for that reason, I believe, that we are attuned to the shifting winds around us.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_ERENVILLE_000_028: I see... That word, hhetso─it means “leader of souls” in the Hhetsarro tongue, does it not?
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_HHWATO_000_029: It does. There are many creatures revered as hhetso among the Hhetsarro. Here, we look to the rroneek for guidance.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_HHWATO_000_030: However, as you may have gleaned from our use of aetherytes, while we are committed to our traditions, this does not mean we reject all outside influences.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_HHWATO_000_031: That said, there are certain things that give us pause...
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_HHWATO_000_032: We will furnish you with the timber you require. But first, as neighbors in this land, we ask that you indulge us in a discussion.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_WAWLIKA_000_033: We'd be glad to, of course!
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_HHWATO_000_034: Wonderful. We do not often receive guests come such a long way, and my son is always so delighted to hear their tales. Now, if you'll follow me.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_ERENVILLE_000_035: Such beauty. I know more than a few gleaners who would love to explore this land.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_HHWATO_000_040: I will speak frankly. We fear the winds of change will soon bring misfortune to the land.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_HHWATO_000_041: The rroneek have made the potential for danger plain.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_HHWATO_000_042: As you may have heard, their temperament has become erratic of late.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_ERENVILLE_000_043: A stableman near Hhusatahwi mentioned that. Do you know what has caused this?
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_HHWATO_000_044: We have our suspicions. Since others were drawn to this land by ceruleum, Shaaloani has undergone a transformation.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_WAWLIKA_000_045: And the railroads are a part of that...
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_HHWATO_000_046: As strong and resilient as they may seem, rroneek are sensitive creatures. The roar of the train as it thunders through the plains may well cause them distress.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_SHEPETTO_000_047: As my father said, we do not necessarily reject outside influences or innovations. But in this, we can't help but worry.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_WAWLIKA_000_048: Understandably. I thank you for being forthright.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_WAWLIKA_000_049: This matter concerns not only the Hhetsarro, but all of Shaaloani.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_ERENVILLE_000_050: Hmm... Perhaps we should bring it to the attention of Vow Koana.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_HHWATO_000_051: Vow Koana, you say... We know him only through rumors, but he is apparently...how shall I put this?
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_SHEPETTO_000_052: Hardheaded and aloof. He values technological advancement and efficiency to the detriment of all else.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_ERENVILLE_000_054: Heh. While there is a grain of truth to the rumors, he is not nearly as bad as they make him out to be.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_A2_000_001: His journeys have changed him for the better.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_A2_000_002: He's a bit awkward so he tends to get misunderstood.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_A2_000_003: He is a passionate man who cares for his people, like his sister.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_HHWATO_000_056: So in the course of traveling with him, you witnessed him change with your own eyes?
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_HHWATO_000_057: Is that so? As we admittedly have never met him ourselves, perhaps we were too quick to judge his intentions.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_HHWATO_000_058: Is that so? That is certainly a side of him we weren't aware of.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_ERENVILLE_000_059: fought beside Vow Koana in the rite of succession. I'd take  word over rumors.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_SHEPETTO_000_060: You took part in the rite of succession!?
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_WAWLIKA_000_061: You're that close to the Dawnservants!? I was grateful for any help, but had no idea I had recruited a bona fide hero.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_HHWATO_000_062: The succession of Dawnservants filled us with uncertainty for the future, but there is clearly much we do not know.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_HHWATO_000_063: On this particular occasion, the winds of change are not meant to be feared. No, we must open our hearts and minds that we might see Vow Koana for who he truly is.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_SHEPETTO_000_064: Do you think he might visit someday?
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_HHWATO_000_065: Just as his father offered us guidance, I'm hopeful that he will do the same.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_HHWATO_000_066: Thank you for hearing and allaying our concerns. I'm glad we could speak.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_HHWATO_000_067: As for your timber, we have freshly cut logs near the lake. Please, take all that you require.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_WAWLIKA_100_068: I promise we'll keep the rroneek foremost in our minds as we continue working on the railroad. And if needs be, we'll seek Vow Koana's counsel.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_WAWLIKA_000_069: My thanks again for your time and the timber. We shall endeavor to return the favor.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_SHEPETTO_000_070: I hope to see you again soon.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_ERENVILLE_000_075: This tent is made with the hide and bones of rroneek. I wonder what else they are used for here.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_WAWLIKA_000_080: If they follow the rroneek with the seasons, it makes sense that they would live in tents that can be broken down and transported easily.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_SHEPETTO_000_085: Say, do you like to hunt? And what weapons do you like to use?
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_WAWLIKA_000_090: We've more than enough timber to fix the ties.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_WAWLIKA_000_091: Now we need to transport it to the station─which will be a bit more involved than I thought. I didn't expect we'd be given so much.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_WAWLIKA_000_092: Mind waiting here a spell while I round up a few more hands and a rroneek? I won't be long!
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_ERENVILLE_000_093: I'm glad that went well. And thankfully, it seems we won't need to make several trips for the timber.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_ERENVILLE_000_095: We have to carry all of this back to the station?
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_HHWATO_000_100: We must talk again soon. Next time, perhaps, on a hunt together.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_SHEPETTO_000_105: You'll come back, won't you? There's so much I'd like to know about the lands beyond Tural.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_HHWATO_000_000: We must talk again soon. Next time, perhaps, on a hunt together.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_SHEPETTO_100_000: You'll come back, won't you? There's so much I'd like to know about the lands beyond Tural.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_ERENVILLE_000_001: While we wait, we could get started moving the timber somewhere more accessible.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_ERENVILLE_000_002: It shouldn't take long if we split the work.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_SYSTEM_000_003: Deliver the crate of timber to the main road.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_SYSTEM_000_004: You will have two minutes to complete the task. Should you fail, return to the starting location and begin anew.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_ERENVILLE_000_010: What are a few logs compared to the nigh-countless crates of Labyrinthos.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_SYSTEM_000_020: Carry the timber from Mehwahhetsoan to the main road.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_ERENVILLE_100_020: I should think this will be enough.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_WAWLIKA_000_021: That was mighty kind of you to move all that lumber. Sorry we didn't make it back sooner.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_SHENZA_000_023: Once we've repaired the tracks, we'll have you on the first train out of town. Ain't that right, chief?
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_WAWLIKA_000_024: Er... As much as I'd love to make it so, there aren't any spots available.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_WAWLIKA_000_025: You'll have to wait for the one after, I'm afraid, but you'll be riding free of charge. It's the least we can do to repay your kindness.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_ERENVILLE_000_026: That's fine. Namikka and no few others were here long before we arrived. It's only right they go before us.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_WAWLIKA_000_027: I hope you'll stop by and see the train off.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_WAWLIKA_000_028: It's a breathtaking sight, let me tell you!
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_SHENZA_000_029: And Nitowikwe will be driving! No engineer compares to her, and it's always a treat to watch her work!
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_ZAWPYA_000_030: The only work we should be worried about is our own, Shenza. And we've still more to do.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_ERENVILLE_000_031: I'll find somewhere quiet near the station to pass the time. If there's anything else in Shaaloani you're keen to see, I'll leave you to it.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_WAWLIKA_000_033: My thanks again for your timely assistance. Won't be long now before the tracks are fixed and you're on your way.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_SHENZA_000_035: It'll be good to have the train running again. I missed the sound of her barreling down the tracks.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_ZAWPYA_000_037: We'll handle the rest of the work from here. You just sit tight now!
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_ERENVILLE_000_040: Had your fill of the sights? Well, they appear to have almost finished...
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_SYSTEM_000_041: Upon proceeding, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_SYSTEM_000_042: It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_SYSTEM_000_043: Wait for the train to depart from the station?
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_WUKLAMAT_000_060: No... Papa can't die... He can't...
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_SUNPERCHGATEKEEPER_: Do you have business at Sunperch?
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_KOANA_000_030: We must see to the people... Assess casualties, as well as any damage done to the city. Yes...
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_KETENRAMM_000_035: If only I'd been more careful...
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_ALISAIE_000_045: Gulool Ja Ja was so proud to be succeeded by his children. To think that he will never get to see them carry on his legacy...
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_KRILE_000_050: At a time like this, we must take the initiative. There will be countless people in need of help.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_SUNPERCHGATEKEEPER_: Will you be returning to Sunperch?
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_LANDSGUARD04920_000: Vow Wuk Lamat. Vow Koana. I bring word from the city. The enemy has withdrawn, and the Landsguard have begun rendering aid to the people.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_LANDSGUARD04920_100: Casualties within our ranks have hindered progress, but we continue to do all that we can.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_KOANA_100_060: I thank you for the report. Please inform the guard they are to prioritize such efforts until further notice.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_WUKLAMAT_000_060: The people... I need to help them.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_ALPHINAUD_000_061: We will assist you in whatever way we can, of course.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_WUKLAMAT_000_062: Thank you, thank you. There are sure to be wounded everywhere─more than I could count.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_ALISAIE_000_063: We'll split up and help all of them. You can count on us!
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_WUKLAMAT_000_064: Alphinaud and Alisaie, could you take Bayside Bevy? And Krile and Erenville, the palace perimeter.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_WUKLAMAT_000_065: As for , please come to the Resplendent Quarter with me. We'll all meet back here afterwards.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_KOANA_000_070: We will close off Sunperch for now. We need to ascertain the full extent of the situation.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_KETENRAMM_000_075: Don't you worry about Koana. I'll keep an eye on the lad.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_ALISAIE_000_100: So Bakool Ja Ja protected you... That's wonderful.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_CRYINGCITIZEN04920_: B-But my husband and son... They were...they were... <sob>
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_STUNNEDCITIZEN04920: Did you see them? Those soldiers?
They looked like people, but they killed and killed with no hesitation...
If they attack us again, how can we hope to defend ourselves...?
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_SCAREDMERCHANT04920: Th-Thank you, the pain is better now. But I can't stop shaking...
Where did they come from? Why did they attack us? And why are those things still in the sky?
We had peace under Gulool Ja Ja! We were safe! But now...
I'm sorry I raised my voice. It's just...I don't know what to do...
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_ANGRYSOLDIER04920_1: My thanks. I'll be fine now.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_ANGRYSOLDIER04920_0: But we failed to protect the people...
Why did so many have to die? Where were Vow Wuk Lamat and Vow Koana!?
Ugh, they're not to blame. I understand, I do, but... <sigh> I need to clear my head...
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_CONFUSEDCITIZENS049: Thank you... I thought I was done for...
I heard something disturbing. The enemy leader─they say he looked like Zoraal Ja.
But that can't be true, can it? Why would the First Promise attack his own people?
But if it was him, what happens now? Is he going to come back? What do we do if he does?
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_WUKLAMAT_000_130: You've finished aiding the people here?
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_WUKLAMAT_000_132: There were children among the wounded. Children.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_WUKLAMAT_000_133: ...No, now isn't the time. There are still others who need help.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_WUKLAMAT_000_134: Could you go and see how things are at Talonmarch? And afterwards, go and find Alisaie at Bayside Bevy.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_ALPHINAUD_000_135: The people are shaken. We must do what we can to help them, and quickly.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_ALISAIE_000_140: It breaks my heart to see what's become of Tuliyollal. I can't begin to imagine how the people are feeling.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_SYSTEM_000_150: There is no evidence of significant damage from the battle. The fighting did not spread this far, it seems.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_SYSTEM_000_151: The shop appears to have weathered the chaos, though its wares have been strewn across the floor.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_SYSTEM_000_152: The port remains unscathed, but the enemy ships continue to loom overhead.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_SYSTEM_000_153: The fresh scorch marks on the ground are doubtless from the enemy assault...
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_ALISAIE_000_160: I've helped all those I could find, and seen them delivered into the Landsguard's care.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_ALISAIE_000_161: As many casualties as there are, it would've been worse if the Landsguard hadn't fought as bravely as they did.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_ALISAIE_000_162: And if Zoraal Ja actually meant to harm the people...
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_ALISAIE_000_163: I mean, look around. The buildings are hardly damaged.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_ALISAIE_000_164: I suspect his aim was more to incite fear. To show that he could strike whenever he pleases.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_ALISAIE_000_165: ...But we can discuss that later. How is Lamaty'i?
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_ALISAIE_000_166: Even after what happened to her father, she's trying so hard to fulfill her duty to the people...
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_ALISAIE_000_167: Still, everyone has their limits. She needs rest, and soon.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_ALISAIE_000_168: Someone mentioned seeing her head towards the shore. Perhaps she's gone to the Gornitruq Gleamsands.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_WUKLAMAT_000_180: I'm fine. Just needed a moment to settle my nerves.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_WUKLAMAT_000_181: Thank you for being there for me, and for urging me on despite all my sulking.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_WUKLAMAT_000_182: Sitting around complaining isn't very leader-like, is it?
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_WUKLAMAT_100_182: So much has happened so quickly. I struggle to make sense of it all.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_WUKLAMAT_110_182: The strange soldiers, those floating ships, the new power Zoraal Ja commands...
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_WUKLAMAT_120_182: Given everything he's done, and still intends to do, I know I can't afford to run headlong into battle. Not this time.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_WUKLAMAT_000_183: I cannot let this terrible pain in my heart lead me astray. But I will make it my strength─the strength to do what I must.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_WUKLAMAT_000_184: Right, I'm heading back to the palace. I need to talk strategy with Koana.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_WUKLAMAT_000_185: Could you and the others join us in a while? However we decide to proceed, I want you all to be aware of it.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_WUKLAMAT_000_186: Oh, and...could you tell Alisaie I'll be all right? She's probably at Bayside Bevy.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_ALISAIE_000_190: Oh, you're back. By that, I take it to mean Lamaty'i is feeling better.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_ALISAIE_000_191: She needs to be strong for the people of Tural, I understand that. But she doesn't have to do it alone.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_ALISAIE_000_192: So if she intends to fight, then we fight. Together.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_ALISAIE_000_194: I wish I knew exactly what we were up against.
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_ALISAIE_000_001: It's clearly not a person, but it doesn't look like any automaton or magitek weapon I've ever seen.
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_ALISAIE_000_002: As far and wide as you've traveled, though, perhaps you've encountered something similar before.
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_ALISAIE_000_003: Would you mind taking a closer look? It may yield some clues as to Zoraal Ja's new powers.
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_SYSTEM_000_010: Examine the fallen soldier. You may move the camera, as well as zoom in or out. Target an area and inspect it with .
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_A1_100_001: It's unlike anything I've ever seen.
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_A1_100_002: It looks like a person, but it's clearly mechanical.
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_ALISAIE_000_012: Indeed... While it resembles a person, it has features that make it uncanny, the lack of a face not least of all. Did you see any sign of a power source?
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_ALISAIE_000_013: So it probably doesn't run on ceruleum or any other conventional fuels.
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_ALISAIE_000_014: I tried channeling aether into it earlier, but there was no response. That would seem to rule it out as an arcane entity.
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_ALISAIE_000_015: It's completely lifeless now─a far cry from the unstoppable enemy it was in battle...
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_ALISAIE_000_016: Even the material it's made of is a mystery. Rather than a metal, it's more akin to stone... Wait. Haven't we seen this somewhere recently?
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_A1_000_002: The palace is made of stone too!
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_ALISAIE_000_018: That's right! The glowing stone used in the chamber with the gate to the golden city!
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_ALISAIE_000_019: Uh, yes, it certainly is. But it's nothing like what was used to craft this machine.
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_ALISAIE_000_020: Its stone is smooth and has a glow─like that which we saw in the chamber with the gate to the golden city.
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_ALISAIE_000_021: And while the soldiers are a different color, the warships are the same black as the stone of the gate itself.
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_ALISAIE_000_022: There has to be a connection. Let's share our observations with the others when we gather at Sunperch.
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_ALISAIE_000_023: The sooner we get to the bottom of this mystery, the better.
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_ALISAIE_000_025: At first, I assumed they were soldiers in armor. But when I cut them down, it became clear that wasn't the case.
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_ALISAIE_000_030: Looks like everyone is here already.
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_ALISAIE_000_040: We'll find a way to breach the dome, and we'll make sure everyone inside is safe.
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_ALPHINAUD_000_045: I fear we need to know more if we're to defend against another assault.
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_YSHTOLA_000_050: Another reflection encroaches upon our own, but how, and why now?
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_GRAHATIA_000_055: I'm indebted to Ojika for overseeing our operations in my absence. I will endeavor to make myself as useful as I can here.
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_KRILE_000_060: I struggle to believe I am from another reflection. I wonder, does this mean my soul is thinner than a native of the Source?
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_KRILE_000_065: Surely not. Y'shtola would have noticed. Gods, there's so much I don't understand, my head is ripe to burst...
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_WUKLAMAT_000_090: I know what I have to do now.
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_SUNPERCHGATEKEEPER_: Vow Wuk Lamat and the others are waiting for you. Right this way.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_ALISAIE_000_001: We'll find a way to breach the dome, and we'll make sure everyone inside is safe.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_ALPHINAUD_000_005: I fear we need to know more if we're to defend against another assault.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_YSHTOLA_000_010: Another reflection encroaches upon our own, but how, and why now?
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_GRAHATIA_000_015: I'm indebted to Ojika for overseeing our operations in my absence. I will endeavor to make myself as useful as I can here.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_KRILE_000_020: I struggle to believe I am from another reflection. I wonder, does this mean my soul is thinner than a native of the Source?
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_KRILE_000_025: Surely not. Y'shtola would have noticed. Gods, there's so much I don't understand, my head is ripe to burst...
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_SUNPERCHGATEKEEPER_: Vow Wuk Lamat and the others are waiting for you. Right this way.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_WUKLAMAT_000_050: I know we're in a hurry to set off. But before we do, I need to address my people.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_WUKLAMAT_000_051: The peace we swore to uphold has been shattered. They need to understand what's happened and how we intend to fix it.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_WUKLAMAT_000_052: So I want to call an assembly at the Winged Walk and assure them that all will be well.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_WUKLAMAT_000_053: But as shaken as they are, I don't know how many will come...
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_ALPHINAUD_000_054: It's those who are most distressed that truly need hear your words...
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_ALPHINAUD_000_055: If you like, I shall seek out such souls and encourage them to attend.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_ALISAIE_000_056: I'll help too. This is an important step in the city's recovery.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_KRILE_000_058: While you handle that, Erenville and I will see to provisions for the expedition.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_WUKLAMAT_000_059: Thank you... I'll go ahead and have the Landsguard announce the address. People must first know there's going to be one before they can decide whether or not they want to hear it.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_ALPHINAUD_100_059: If you could see to the Resplendent Quarter and Bayside Bevy, Alisaie and I will split the rest of the city between us.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_YSHTOLA_000_060: I shall have to examine one of these mechanical soldiers later.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_GRAHATIA_000_065: I have a mind to inform Thancred and Urianger as well, but they may have already left Tural.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_HOARDINGESIDENT0492: I need to stock up food and medicine. As much as I can. And what else is there? I can't afford to forget anything...
Sorry, , but I'm busy. Too much to do and too little time.
There's no telling when those stone men will return. I have to get out of here, find somewhere safe.
Vow Wuk Lamat wants to speak to us?
Perhaps she has a plan, then. I suppose there's no harm in hearing what she has to say.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_FLUSTEREDMAN04922_0: Whatever it is, I don't have time. I have to finish repairing this cart.
There's only so much I can carry on my back. When those hollow devils come again, I need to be ready.
Vow Wuk Lamat and Vow Koana mean well, but they're young and inexperienced. They can barely look after themselves. If we're to survive, I do not know if we can count on them.
They're going to strike back at the enemy? So they're resolved to face this...
Maybe it is too early to be thinking of running... Alright, I'll go and hear their address.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_DEPRESSEDWOMAN04922: My father is gone. Leave me to mourn.
Gulool Ja Ja is slain? And yet Vow Wuk Lamat and Vow Koana still fight for our nation. For us...
Very well. If they would speak, the least I can do is listen.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_ALPACAHERDER04922_0: It's not safe here, not anymore. I could try to leave Tural, but...where else is there to go?
You look like the well-traveled sort. Please, I can't stay here─but I fear nowhere in Tural is beyond the enemy's reach. What of the lands across the salt?
I know, I know. Even if I ran, I know I'd regret it in the end.
I love Tural. This is my home, and I know the Dawnservants would give their lives to defend her.
I will put my faith in them, and listen to what they have to say.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_STUNNEDFARMER04922_: If Tuliyollal falls to the enemy, what will happen to us? To our homes, our farms─everything we've worked so hard to build?
Lives and communities and histories, all reduced to ash by these merciless villains...
I heard Vow Wuk Lamat is planning to address the people, but what's the point? What can she and her brother possibly have to say?
Really? The Dawnservants have a plan already? They've lost so much, yet they're prepared to carry on.
And standing around worrying about what's to come will change nothing...
It would be a lie to say I'm hopeful for the future, but I will go hear what they intend to do.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_RESIDENTSONALERT049: I can't leave now. What if those soldiers come back?
And what are those strange machines looming overhead? Gods, I have so many questions.
I see... It would put my mind at ease to learn something─anything─of the threat we face.
All right, then. I'll go to the Winged Walk.
Thank you. I feel better already, and likely better still once I hear what the Dawnservants have to say.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_CALMMERCHANT04922_0: Whew, the wares are mostly intact. Glad tidings for my clients.
Oh! Sorry friend, but I've no time to spare. Vow Wuk Lamat and Vow Koana will soon be giving a public address, and I have to finish taking inventory before then.
Given the circumstances, it must be quite important. You'll want to be there as well.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_SYSTEM_000_113: This person does not need to be persuaded to attend Wuk Lamat's address.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_CALMMERCHANT04922_1: Only a few more crates and I'll be on my way to the Winged Walk.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_RESTINGRESIDENT0492: Phew. Cleaning up is tiring work.
You've been busy helping as well, I'm guessing?
Right now it's tough for everyone, but Tuliyollal won't succumb to this.
With the new Dawnservants to protect and lead us, we'll get through it together.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_SYSTEM_000_118: This person does not need to be persuaded to attend Wuk Lamat's address.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_RESTINGRESIDENT0492: Vow Wuk Lamat has asked we gather at the Winged Walk, yes? I'll be on my way after a short rest.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_POSITIVERESIDENT049: Hm? Checking on everyone, are you?
The city's definitely seen better days, but we can only spare so much time for mourning. Only by looking to the future can we overcome this crisis─and we'll all need to do our part.
I've no doubt Vow Wuk Lamat and Vow Koana will share similar sentiments at their address.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_SYSTEM_000_122: This person does not need to be persuaded to attend Wuk Lamat's address.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_POSITIVERESIDENT049: It's about time I was on my way to the Winged Walk.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_CALMRESIDENT04922_0: I still can't believe we were attacked...
For a mercy, my family was spared. I don't know what I would've done had they come to harm.
I understand Vow Wuk Lamat is going to make an address soon. I'll be there, of course.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_SYSTEM_000_126: This person does not need to be persuaded to attend Wuk Lamat's address.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_CALMRESIDENT04922_1: If you were coming to ask after us, you needn't be concerned. My family is thankfully unharmed.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_WUKLAMAT_000_130: It looks like you've brought quite a few people. Thank you.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_ALPHINAUD_000_131: Alisaie had actually returned ahead of you, but upon hearing that you were still out there, she decided she was unsatisfied with her own efforts and left again.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_KOANA_000_132: My apologies for involving you all in Turali affairs.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_ALPHINAUD_000_133: We are simply helping dear friends in need. Having traveled the lands of Tural, sharing in the rich cultures of your people, I can see it no other way.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_ALPHINAUD_000_134: What's more, Zoraal Ja and his army pose a threat not only to Tural, but to the star as a whole.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_ALPHINAUD_000_135: We will stand with you, to protect what you hold dear.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_ALPHINAUD_000_137: I don't expect you've had much, if any, rest. How are you holding up?
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_WUKLAMAT_000_138: I'm fine, thanks to a little encouragement from .
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_KOANA_000_139: You needn't worry about me either.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_KOANA_000_140: Whatever weariness I feel is no match for my desire to protect my people.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_KOANA_000_141: We will restore peace to the nation and preserve our father's legacy...
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_KOANA_000_142: And it begins by speaking to the people from our hearts.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_WUKLAMAT_000_144: We need to see to a few things first, but feel free to go ahead to the plaza and wait.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_KOANA_000_150: Thank you again for spreading word of our address. I fear those who needed assurance most would not have been present otherwise.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_YSHTOLA_000_155: I was just discussing the gate to the golden city with Ketenramm. He has been patiently answering my few questions.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_GRAHATIA_000_160: It seems Krile and Erenville have yet to return. Still busy making preparations for our expedition, I presume.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_KETENRAMM_000_165: "A few questions“? More like a bleedin' broadside of 'em. Took me back to me time with Galuf, it did. Sharlayan scholars, I swear...
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_ALPHINAUD_000_170: Did you not see Alisaie on your way here?
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_GRAHATIA_000_180: Listening to Wuk Lamat and Koana, I was reminded of my time in the First.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_GRAHATIA_000_181: While the Exarch was no king, I often found myself speaking before the people of the Crystarium in like manner. And through their deeds, they answered me.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_GRAHATIA_000_182: The people of Tural, too, will rise to the occasion. This I can tell.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_KRILE_000_185: The people of Tural have come together for this fight. We must endeavor not to fail them.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_YSHTOLA_000_190: It is inspiring to see such diverse peoples rally as one.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_ALISAIE_000_200: I'm glad to see so many people came. I wasn't sure how many I had won over, so I decided to keep at it.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_ALPHINAUD_000_205: That was a rousing speech, was it not? Let us do our part to ensure that the Dawnservants can fulfill their promise to the people.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_KRILE_000_001: The people of Tural have come together for this fight. We must endeavor not to fail them.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_YSHTOLA_000_002: It is inspiring to see such diverse peoples rally as one.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ALISAIE_000_004: I'm glad to see so many people came. I wasn't sure how many I had won over, so I decided to keep at it.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_GRAHATIA_000_005: I look forward to the day when peace is restored to Tural. There is so much I wish to see.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Well, the hour of departure is at hand.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Those of us remaining here shall accompany you part of the way.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_YSHTOLA_000_012: I, for one, would like to see the dome firsthand.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ALPHINAUD_000_013: We set forth as soon as everyone is ready. I will inform Wuk Lamat that─
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ALPHINAUD_000_016: We were just planning to call on you. Are you ready to leave?
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_017: I am. Seeing the people come together as one, knowing they haven't given up hope, it was all the encouragement I could ask for.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_018: Right then, let's get going! We leave from the Xak Tural skygate!
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_021: This is it, my friends. We go to strike down Zoraal Ja and secure peace for Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_022: We'll be passing through Shaaloani, where there have been reports of enemy movement, so stay sharp.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_KRILE_000_025: We should have everything we need for the expedition, from food to medicine to gear. It's quite amazing how much you can fit in Erenville's rucksack!
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_YSHTOLA_000_026: Even from afar, I can sense something isn't right about that dome.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ERENVILLE_000_027: Yyasulani isn't exactly a short distance from Shaaloani. If the train isn't operating, we'll need to consider other means of travel.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ALISAIE_000_028: As Lamaty'i says, let's stay vigilant.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ALPHINAUD_000_029: Koana and Ketenramm will continue to manage affairs at the palace. Once I've inspected the dome, I will join them to make preparations against further incursions.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_GRAHATIA_000_030: The dome appears to lie well beyond Shaaloani. A good thing we have Erenville to guide us.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_040: The Landsguard had told me about them. They emerged from the dome in quick succession and took to looming overhead.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ALISAIE_000_041: A display of force, like the vessels in Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_042: Indeed. And while they haven't taken any aggressive actions, I want to see how things are in the area before moving on.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_043: We'll be passing a few settlements on the way to Shaaloani Station. It's the perfect opportunity to look around.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ERENVILLE_000_044: In that case,  and I know a few locals who can help.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_045: Then let's divide into two groups.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_046: Erenville, Alisaie, and  will come with me to inquire with the locals. Meanwhile, the rest of you can go and inspect the dome.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ALPHINAUD_000_047: Understood. Once everyone has finished, let us reconvene at Shaaloani Station.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_048: We can start with Hhusatahwi. That's where the Dustwatch is based, if I remember correctly.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ERENVILLE_000_049: You do. The sheriff Kemakka should be able to tell us a few things.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_KEMAKKA_000_050: Oh, it's you two...and I'll be, Vow Wuk Lamat as well!
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_051: You're sheriff of the Dustwatch, yes? What's the situation here in Hhusatahwi?
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_KEMAKKA_000_052: Well, the enemy hasn't tried to pick a fight with us yet. The ships gave us a shock when they first appeared, but they've just been floating there, holding position.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_KEMAKKA_000_053: That said, I've received some unsettling reports from elsewhere. We've been investigating to the extent we can, but we're spread thin and haven't looked in on Sheshenewezi Springs yet.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_KEMAKKA_000_054: Apparently, mechanical soldiers were seen in the vicinity...
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_055: What!? If this is true, then the people there are in danger!
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ERENVILLE_000_056: I worry about the other townships as well. If the rest of you could head to the Springs, I'll pay a visit to Mehwahhetsoan.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ALISAIE_000_057: I'll accompany Erenville. See you all in a while.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_060: Everything seems in order at a glance...
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ERENVILLE_000_061: The people of the wilds are brave indeed to remain here with those ships overhead.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ALISAIE_100_061: So this region has its own peacekeeping force.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_KEMAKKA_000_062: We're honored that Vow Wuk Lamat should visit us personally. Please take care out there.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_100_070: The mechanical soldiers don't seem to be in the area.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_071: Still, we should talk to the locals. Let's each make rounds and see what we can learn.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_IYAATE_000_080: , you came! As you can see, we're doing all right.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_IYAATE_000_081: After those ships appeared in the sky, soldiers clad in white showed up and surrounded the town.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_IYAATE_000_082: But to our surprise and relief, a traveler came along and dealt with them all in a flash.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_IYAATE_000_083: I'll never forget the way he soared through the air, spear in hand. Shame I never had the chance to ask his name.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_IYAATE_000_084: We're all safe thanks to him, but I can't say the same for those in Yyasulani. We haven't heard from anyone there. I hope Namikka is well...
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_XTRREMPLOYEE04923_0: Oh, you're the one who helped us the other day!
Wawlika and the others are out investigating, and they've confirmed that Nitowikwe is safe.
It was after the train had begun its journey back here that the dome appeared.
So those who were riding the train then are fine, but we don't know what's become of those who disembarked in Yyasulani...
<sigh> What a mess. And just after we finished fixing the tracks.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_SYSTEM_000_100: The mechanical soldier shows no signs of life.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_SYSTEM_000_101: It appears to have been run through with a polearm.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_SYSTEM_100_101: The mechanical soldier appears to have been run through with a polearm.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_IYAATE_000_102: Elene'shpya must be worried sick. I do hope he's all right...
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_XTRREMPLOYEE04923_0: I'll be sure to tell the chief you stopped by when they return.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_104: Ah, so that's the way of it. Good thing he showed up when he did.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_105: You heard about the spearman as well?
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ZEKOWA_000_107: (-Zekowa-)What's this? Someone spreading more gossip about me?
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ZEKOWA_000_108: Talk of how I saved the town travels fast, hahaha!
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ZEKOWA_000_109: That's not to discount the help of my friend here, of course. We gave those machines a real beating!
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ESTINIEN_000_110: I thought you'd come sooner or later. Do you know what's happening?
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_111: So you were indeed the one keeping the people safe! Thank you.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ESTINIEN_000_112: Think nothing of it. The automata aren't particularly strong.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ESTINIEN_000_113: But are the rumors true? Gulool Ja Ja is slain?
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_114: I'm afraid so... Zoraal Ja used some dirty trick to get the better of him...
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_115: We'll make him pay for what he's done, mark my words.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ESTINIEN_000_116: You're going to help her, I assume?
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ESTINIEN_000_117: I see. With your contingent, you won't lack for strength. In which case, I will remain in Shaaloani and keep an eye on things.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_118: That helps us more than you know! I'll send word to my brother before we set off. If you find yourself in trouble, don't hesitate to contact Koana.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ZEKOWA_000_120: Wait a second! You're the Vow of Resolve!?
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_121: I am. And you're Zekowa, right? I'll be counting on you to keep everyone here safe.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ZEKOWA_000_122: Absolutely! If more of those hollow men show up, I'll send them packing!
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ZEKOWA_000_123: I'm the fastest gun in Shaaloani, after all.  can attest to that.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_124: Glad to hear it. We leave Shaaloani in your capable hands.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ZEKOWA_000_125: Let's get patrolling right away, then!
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ESTINIEN_000_126: Stay safe out there, and don't do anything reckless.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ESTINIEN_000_127: ...Wasted words, eh? Just do what comes naturally.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_128: Right then, it's time we headed to the station and joined the others.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_130: Thanks to Estinien, there were no casualties to speak of in Shaaloani.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ERENVILLE_000_131: The Hhetsarro were safe as well. At the very least, there were no sightings of soldiers there.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_132: What about the dome? Did you learn anything of note?
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_YSHTOLA_000_133: It is composed of exceedingly high concentrations of lightning energy.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_YSHTOLA_000_134: To even touch the barrier would prove fatal. When approaching it, we must exercise all caution.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_135: Then how are we supposed to get inside? If Zoraal Ja and his army emerged from within, there ought to be an entrance...
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_SHENZA_000_136: (-Shenza-)An entrance, you say? It so happens we might have an inkling where one is.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ERENVILLE_100_136: These are the engineers of Xak Tural Railing, which operates the train between Shaaloani and Yyasulani.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ZAWPYA_000_137: When we went out to recover the train, we had ourselves a look at the dome through a telescope.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_SHENZA_000_138: It was then that we saw it: a large fortress-like structure that looked like it straddled the dome's edge!
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ALISAIE_000_139: You're telling us part of it is inside, and part of it outside?
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ZAWPYA_000_140: That seemed to be the case, yes. While we only observed from afar, the soldiers were coming and going from it. From that, I'd say it serves as a passage between the outside world and whatever's inside.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ZAWPYA_000_141: But as you'd expect, the area was heavily defended. It won't be easy to get near.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ERENVILLE_000_142: Do you know what became of the passengers who went to Yyasulani? Wuk Lamat's nursemaid was among them, a woman named Namikka.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WAWLIKA_000_144: I'm afraid not. Only those passengers who were headed back here are accounted for.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_NITOWIKWE_000_145: I can say for a fact that everything was fine when we arrived in Yyasulani.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_NITOWIKWE_000_146: But when that big tremor struck not long after we left the station, I hit the emergency brakes and looked back, and all I could see was the dome.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_SHENZA_000_147: What's more, the fortress sits right on the tracks of all places. What are the odds of that, eh?
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_KRILE_000_148: Assuming this fortress serves as a means to pass through the dome, we should first determine how we're to reach it undetected.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_149: I don't care if we're detected. I say we smash our way inside.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_150: Despite how it sounds, I actually gave this some thought. Zoraal Ja wants me to prove that I'm Father's worthy successor. If I fail, he'll destroy Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_151: By charging in head-on, I make my intentions plain as day, and in so doing keep his eyes on me.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WAWLIKA_000_152: A bold strategy. I like it!
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WAWLIKA_000_153: Of course, your plan'll be no good if you're cut down before reaching their base.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WAWLIKA_000_154: What you need is something that'll get you there quick and break through their defenses with a single, decisive blow─and we have just that.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WAWLIKA_000_155: Since the tracks go straight to the fortress, we can reinforce our train with armor, load her with all the fuel she'll carry, and send her hurtling at it to explode on impact!
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ZAWPYA_000_157: You were just saying how relieved you were the train's in one piece. And now you want to turn it into a bomb!?
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WAWLIKA_000_158: The train's not important! Our dream was to have railroads running from coast-to-coast, remember?
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WAWLIKA_000_159: If these invaders have their way, there may not be any more railroads, let alone trains to run on them. Is that what you want!?
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WAWLIKA_000_160: It's a sacrifice we have to make.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WAWLIKA_000_161: These good folks are willing to put their lives on the line to get inside that dome and put a stop to all this. The least we can do is help them.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_NITOWIKWE_000_163: Listen. No matter how hard things may get, no matter how many times we fall, we can always get back up.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_NITOWIKWE_000_164: As long as we're alive, we can always build another train. So have faith─and quit your complaining!
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_SHENZA_000_165: But what if we fall really, really hard? There's no getting back up if we're dead...
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_NITOWIKWE_000_166: No one's dying on this train. I'll see to it myself.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_NITOWIKWE_000_167: Needless to say, this'll be a one-way trip, and we'll need to jump off at the last moment if we don't want to go out in a blaze of glory.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WAWLIKA_000_169: There's no changing her mind, is there?
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WAWLIKA_000_170: Just promise me you'll be careful out there, honey.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_A1_000_172: We'll keep your wife safe, we promise.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_A1_000_173: We won't leave you with any sorrows to drown, never fear.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WAWLIKA_000_174: I'll hold you to it. Can't start a family business without her, much less a family.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WAWLIKA_000_175: Seeing as I've never had a drink in my life, I certainly hope not.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WAWLIKA_000_176: It'd be a lie to say the loss of the train doesn't concern me.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WAWLIKA_000_177: But with good friends, and my loving wife beside me, that's all I really need in the end.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_SHENZA_000_178: Well, at least it'll go down as the legendary train that saved Tural.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ZAWPYA_000_179: That it will. But first, we've got work to do so she'll look the part.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ALISAIE_000_180: I don't know much about magitek, but if there's anything I can do to help, you need but say the word.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WAWLIKA_000_182: If any of you are willing and able to lend a hand, there's work that needs doing over at the storehouse.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ALPHINAUD_000_183: It seems we have a path forward. I believe this is a good time for me to return to Tuliyollal and inform Koana of the situation.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_YSHTOLA_000_184: I shall return as well. I have new investigations to pursue.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_YSHTOLA_000_185: The dome's elemental aspect is similar to that of the gate in the golden city. If we can identify a connection, we may learn something of use in our fight.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_186: It's one mystery after the next, but at least we're not without clues. It may not be easy, but I know we can get through this together.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_KRILE_000_200: Raha and I visited the settlements west of here. Thankfully, there was no damage or casualties to speak of.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ERENVILLE_000_205: Mehwahhetsoan is still safe, but the animals are unsettled by recent events.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ALISAIE_000_210: It seems those soldiers only appeared in Sheshenewezi Springs. Could they have been after the ceruleum?
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ALPHINAUD_000_215: I heard from Wuk Lamat that Estinien was here.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ALPHINAUD_000_220: With him to watch over them, the people of Shaaloani will have naught to fear.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_GRAHATIA_000_225: The dome is absolutely massive. What manner of kingdom do you suppose he's claimed within its borders?
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_230: It seems the people of Shaaloani are safe. What a relief.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_240: Even only just having met them, I can see how important the train is to Wawlika and the engineers.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_WUKLAMAT_000_241: We can't let their sacrifice be for nothing.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_KRILE_000_245: To use this train as an explosive is a brazen plan. We'll have but one attempt, so we had best make it count!
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_ALISAIE_000_255: Well, we have our plan. Now let's finish this train and blast our way into the dome.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_GRAHATIA_000_260: The ships seem content to remain waiting in the skies, so let us take this opportunity to do what we can and prepare.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_KRILE_000_001: To use this train as an explosive is a brazen plan. We'll have but one attempt, so we had best make it count!
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_ALISAIE_000_010: Well, we have our plan. Now let's finish this train and blast our way into the dome.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WUKLAMAT_000_015: We'll make this plan work─see if we don't!
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_GRAHATIA_000_020: While I have no objections to the plan itself, I have one concern.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_GRAHATIA_000_021: How can we be certain Zoraal Ja will not strike Tuliyollal in retaliation?
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WUKLAMAT_000_023: But when my brother told me to come and prove myself, he meant it.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WUKLAMAT_000_024: He wants to show that his kingdom is superior to Tuliyollal, and it'll give him no satisfaction to attack when he knows I'm not there.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WUKLAMAT_000_025: No, he'll be waiting inside the dome. Waiting for us to challenge him so he can crush us and prove his strength.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_ALISAIE_000_026: Indeed... If anything, we're more likely to put Tuliyollal in danger by not taking the fight to him.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_KRILE_000_027: So we indulge Zoraal Ja. At least, until Tuliyollal has shored up its defenses.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WUKLAMAT_000_028: Right. We'll charge in from the front and keep his eyes on us.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WUKLAMAT_000_029: During which time Koana will find a way to fortify Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_GRAHATIA_000_030: If you believe this is the best course, then we shall trust in your judgment.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_GRAHATIA_000_031: I expect there will be no small amount of enemy resistance, but we will do all in our power to assist you.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WUKLAMAT_000_033: Well, time is of the essence. Let's go and see what's left to be done for the train.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WUKLAMAT_000_035: Everyone's hard at work on the train. I can't wait to see how it turns out.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_KRILE_000_037: Shenza has given me a list of materials. We'll see to it they have everything they need!
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_ALISAIE_000_038: It's a shame Cid and his engineers aren't here to help. If they were here, I expect they'd turn it into a flying train.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_ERENVILLE_000_039: Zoraal Ja's forces remain quiet for now. If there is any movement, I'll alert everyone immediately.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WAWLIKA_000_040: Looks like work is getting underway. We'll finish in no time at all!
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WUKLAMAT_000_041: So what can we do to help? No need to hold back!
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WAWLIKA_000_042: As I understand it, the two of you met your fair share of craftsmen during the rite of succession.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WAWLIKA_000_043: Would you happen to know a few who'd be willing to come and help us complete modifications to the train?
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WUKLAMAT_000_044: Of course! What sort of craftsmen did you have in mind?
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WAWLIKA_000_046: Perhaps my greatest concern is keeping the train safe from enemy attacks.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WAWLIKA_000_047: Even with you all aboard to fend them off, it'd be over in an instant if they managed to get just one good hit on the ceruleum tanks.
