TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WAWLIKA_000_048: According to eyewitnesses, the soldiers use lightning-based weapons, so I've a mind to install grounding rods. Would you happen to know a carpenter who could handle that?
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_A1_000_002: We could ask the fellow with a fetish for formalities.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WAWLIKA_000_050: A master carpenter from Ok'hanu, eh? If they'd be willing, we'd be glad to have them.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WUKLAMAT_000_051: No objections from me. Just be sure not to forget their traditional greeting...
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WUKLAMAT_000_052: Heh, you mean Wuk Evu. While he has his quirks, there's no questioning his carpentry!
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WAWLIKA_000_053: A master carpenter from Ok'hanu, eh? If they'd be willing, we'd be glad to have them.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WAWLIKA_000_054: But we'll need more than just a carpenter if we want this done in a timely fashion.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WAWLIKA_000_055: We've got a lot of equipment that needs moving. Heavy equipment. I don't suppose you know anyone up to the task?
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WUKLAMAT_000_058: But I wouldn't exactly call him strong. For a task like this, I think we should ask someone like, say, Zurmurwur.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WAWLIKA_000_059: You're friends with the Yok Huy? I'll be damned. We'll not want for strength with help like that.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WUKLAMAT_000_060: Zurmurwur would be perfect! We'd be hard-pressed to find folks stronger than the Yok Huy, and I'm sure he'd be willing to help.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WAWLIKA_000_061: You're friends with the Yok Huy? I'll be damned. We'll not want for strength with help like that.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WAWLIKA_000_062: Next, I'd like to outfit the train with some powerful weaponry of its own.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WAWLIKA_000_063: Like as not, the soldiers will be riding their flying vessels. We'll need countermeasures to deal with them.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WUKLAMAT_000_064: That's true... I for one can't use magic, nor am I handy with a firearm like my brother.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WUKLAMAT_000_065: Any ideas for ranged weapons we can use?
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_A3_000_001: Let's borrow guns from Koana for everyone!
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_A3_000_002: Let's install ballistas on the train! Big ones!
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WAWLIKA_000_067: Guns, eh? While they'd be suitable in theory, it takes no ordinary marksman to hit a flying target.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WAWLIKA_000_068: So it'd need to be something that doesn't require that level of skill and precision. But weapons aren't exactly my field of expertise...
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WAWLIKA_000_069: Ballistas, eh? While they'd be powerful, it seems to me it'd take too long to reload between shots.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WAWLIKA_000_070: If there were some sort of ballista that could reload quickly, then that might work. But weapons aren't exactly my field of expertise...
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_GRAHATIA_000_071: Perhaps I can be of assistance.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_GRAHATIA_000_072: The Crystarium employed aetheric cannons for its defenses, and I see no reason why the design cannot be adopted for your train.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_GRAHATIA_000_073: While I did not conceive them myself, I know their design. It should be possible to build them here, provided we have the requisite materials and skilled smiths.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WUKLAMAT_000_074: Now, that sounds like something Fonjeantaine can help with. What are the materials we need?
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_GRAHATIA_000_075: The barrel can be fashioned from any metal, so long as it's highly conductive to aether. To power the cannon, we will require fire-aspected crystals of the highest purity.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WAWLIKA_000_076: Fire crystals, eh? Might be as the miners over at the Springs can help with that.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_GRAHATIA_000_077: Then if I could leave the crystals and smiths in everyone's hands, I shall get started drawing up the schematics.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WAWLIKA_000_078: Right then, I'll secure us the smiths.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WAWLIKA_100_078: In the meantime, could you deal with the materials? Shenza is in charge of our supplies, so it might be good to talk to him about it first.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WAWLIKA_000_079: Well, I think we're set for a plan! Thanks for the consultation!
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WAWLIKA_000_080: Now let's get this train dressed up, and give her the proper farewell she deserves!
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_GRAHATIA_000_085: Right. Time to put my knowledge gained in the First to use.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WUKLAMAT_000_091: To make good speed, I'm going to try and enlist some more help from among our friends back in Yok Tural.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_WUKLAMAT_000_092: I'll leave the materials in your care. I think I saw Shenza over to the southeast.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_SHENZA_000_100: That should be enough lumber for the armor. What else do we need...?
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_SHENZA_000_101: Oh! Sorry, I didn't see you there. What can I do for you?
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_SHENZA_000_102: Aetheric cannons? Interesting. I have an idea where we can get the conductive metal, so I'll take care of it.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_SHENZA_000_103: I'm not sure about the fire crystals, though. Might be best if you spoke directly with a miner. Can I leave that to you?
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_SHENZA_000_105: You're friends with Iyaate, aren't you? One of the best miners around. If anyone can get you the crystals you're after, it's her.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_SHENZA_000_110: Iyaate is sure to get you all the fire crystals you'd ever want, and then some.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_IYAATE_000_120: Oh, . What brings you around these parts?
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_IYAATE_000_121: The purest fire crystals, you say?
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_IYAATE_000_122: I think I heard tell about them before, but what was that about...?
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_GRAHATIA_000_000: Right. Time to put my knowledge gained in the First to use.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_KRILE_100_000: Shenza has given me a list of materials. We'll see to it they have everything they need!
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_ALISAIE_110_000: It's a shame Cid and his engineers aren't here to help. If they were here, I expect they'd turn it into a flying train.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_ERENVILLE_120_000: Zoraal Ja's forces remain quiet for now. If there is any movement, I'll alert everyone immediately.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_SHENZA_130_000: Iyaate is sure to get you all the fire crystals you'd ever want, and then some.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_IYAATE_000_002: You can find them to the south of town. They actually ingest fire crystals and keep them in their gut, if you can believe it!
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_IYAATE_000_003: If you want the purest crystals, though, you'll have to go after the oldest, toughest analas. Nothing you can't handle, right?
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_IYAATE_000_004: I'll show you where you can find some to hunt. Looking forward to seeing why Erenville thinks so highly of you.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_IYAATE_000_010: There's quite a lot of fiery wildlife in these parts. We think it's due to the ceruleum, but no one can say for sure.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_IYAATE_000_011: Still, it's not often that you see the bigger, dominating sort─and that's what you need.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_IYAATE_000_012: What you'll have to do is hunt down a few of their kind. Establish yourself as a threat─that's known to draw out the leader.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_IYAATE_000_013: That's the spirit! While you're on the hunt, I'll keep watch nearby to make sure no hapless travelers come stumbling in.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_IYAATE_000_015: The leaders are certain to show up if you kill a few of the common ones. It's only a matter of when.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_SYSTEM_000_020: You see no signs of your prey. Perhaps you will have better luck to the south.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_POPMESSAGE_000_030: A hefty, cantankerous anala comes lumbering towards you with murderous intent.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_IYAATE_000_040: Amazing! You dealt with the beasts in no time at all!
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_IYAATE_000_041: You need the crystals delivered to Shenza? I'll see that he gets it.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_IYAATE_000_042: These fire crystals are for the train, aren't they?
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_IYAATE_000_043: I heard about your plans to enter the dome.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_IYAATE_000_044: I want to thank you for going to such lengths to stop these invaders.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_IYAATE_000_045: And though he'd grumble if he knew I was asking this, please take care of Elene'shpya.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_IYAATE_000_046: Anyway, I'd best be on my way─and you as well. In case you're going to meet her, I saw Wuk Lamat heading for the station.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_WUKLAMAT_000_050: Shenza told me you got the crystals for him. Good work!
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_WUKLAMAT_000_051: I've just returned from looking for extra help. We'll see in a moment who answers the call!
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_ERENVILLE_000_052: All will be in readiness for them when they arrive.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_ERENVILLE_000_053: Dammit... I'm idle for a moment, and all I can think about is my home...
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_WUKLAMAT_000_054: Keep your chin up, Erenville. We'll be on our way soon, and we'll find your mother.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_WUKLAMAT_000_055: It'll be good to see her after all these years. There's so much I'd like to ask her about her time together with Papa.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_ERENVILLE_000_056: Oh, she'll talk your ears off. Once my mother starts, there's no stopping her.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_WUKLAMAT_000_057: I wouldn't want it any other way!
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_WUKLAMAT_000_058: Right, let's return to helping where we can! The real work begins when the extra hands arrive!
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_WUKLAMAT_100_080: Thanks for making the trek here. To be honest, I wasn't expecting so many of you!
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_WUKEVU_000_080: Since the attack on Tuliyollal, I had been wondering if there was aught I could do to help.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_WUKEVU_100_081: So when I heard about the upcoming operation from Vow Koana, I leapt at the chance to do my part!
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_MABLU_000_082: Peace will be restored, and then we can all enjoy a nice cup of mezcal!
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_MABLU_100_082: This is our home, and we'll do whatever it takes to keep it safe.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_ZURMURWUR_000_083: While I assist with the efforts here, High Luminary Gurfurlur does the same at the capital.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_WUKLAMAT_000_084: With all of us working together, there's nothing we can't accomplish!
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_WUKLAMAT_000_085: Let's get to it, my friends!
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_NITOWIKWE_000_088: You've done your part. Leave it to us to finish mounting the armor and cannons, and have yourselves a hard-earned rest.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_WUKLAMAT_000_089: Thank you all again for answering the call.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_ZEKOWA_000_090: No need for thanks, now! Whenever you need help, just give us a holler!
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_WUKEVU_000_091: Indeed. We must all do our part when our nation is imperiled.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_MABLU_000_092: Hear, hear! We love Tural, and we love you, Vow Wuk Lamat!
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_WUKLAMAT_000_093: I love you all too! Your kindness and goodwill will not be in vain, this I promise!
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_ERENVILLE_000_100: Taken care of the crystals, have you? Things proceed apace here too.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_WAWLIKA_000_110: Thanks again for all your help. Wouldn't have been able to finish so quickly without you.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_WAWLIKA_000_111: Go and rest up, friend. Won't be long before the train's ready.
TEXT_KINGMD115_04926_WAWLIKA_000_001: From here on out, we won't stop working till the train's ready.
TEXT_KINGMD115_04926_WAWLIKA_000_002: If you have any preparations, now would be a good time to see to them. The boarding call will come before you know it!
TEXT_KINGMD115_04926_SYSTEM_000_010: Wait for the engineers to finish working on the train?
TEXT_KINGMD115_04926_A1_000_002: Form a party and enter Vanguard.
TEXT_KINGMD115_04926_WUKLAMAT_000_020: There's no way Zoraal Ja will be able to ignore our explosive entrance.
TEXT_KINGMD115_04926_KRILE_000_022: The idea of venturing into enemy territory is daunting, but I believe I'm ready. Or as ready as I'll ever be...
TEXT_KINGMD115_04926_ALISAIE_000_024: Just a little further and we'll be inside the dome!
TEXT_KINGMD115_04926_GRAHATIA_000_026: We couldn't have made it this far without the train. Let us see to it we go the rest of the way.
TEXT_KINGMD115_04926_ERENVILLE_000_028: I'll remain out of sight until the fighting is over. At the risk of repeating myself, try not to do anything reckless.
TEXT_KINGMD115_04926_NITOWIKWE_000_030: The rest is up to you now. I can make my own way back, so don't worry about me. Take care and good luck!
TEXT_KINGMD115_04926_ROADWARDEN_000_035: Ah, it's you. Wawlika told me you may be passing through. Be careful out there.
TEXT_KINGMD115_04926_ZANDER_000_40: That such a serious breach should be allowed... But it ends now.
TEXT_KINGMD115_04926_ZANDER_000_41: We redeem our honor with your lives!
TEXT_KINGMD115_04926_WUKLAMAT_000_050: I was prepared for something strange, but this... It's like another world.
TEXT_KINGMD115_04926_ALISAIE_000_065: I don't know what I was expecting, but it wasn't this.
TEXT_KINGMD115_04926_GRAHATIA_000_070: There was no sensation of passing into a different world. This couldn't be a reflection...could it?
TEXT_KINGMD115_04926_SYSTEM_000_100: You may now enter Vanguard with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_GRAHATIA_000_005: There was no sensation of passing into a different world. This couldn't be a reflection...could it?
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_ALISAIE_000_010: I don't know what I was expecting, but it wasn't this.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_WUKLAMAT_000_015: Things keep getting stranger and stranger...
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_ERENVILLE_000_022: No, definitely not. Nor the wall over there.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_WUKLAMAT_000_023: The material's not something we use in Tural. It's closer to what we saw at the gate to the golden city, or those mechanical soldiers.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_KRILE_000_024: Such a massive structure couldn't possibly have been built in so short a time.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_GRAHATIA_000_025: Then I'm inclined to assume we've been transported to another location. Or perhaps...
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_GRAHATIA_000_026: Well, speculation will avail us naught. We need to learn more before we can draw conclusions.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_ALISAIE_000_027: Let's take a look around, then.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_KRILE_000_030: This place is isolated by the dome, yet the skies are heavy with thunderclouds. The air oversaturated with lightning-aspected aether...
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_ERENVILLE_000_035: I recognize the lay of the land. It's definitely Yyasulani. And yet...
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_GRAHATIA_000_045: This place is unnatural in a way I've never seen before.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_ALISAIE_000_050: That looks like a train station, doesn't it?
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_ERENVILLE_000_051: That must be Yyasulani Station, where the passengers disembarked!
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_ALISAIE_000_052: Then perhaps we'll find someone to talk to there. Let's go and investigate.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_KRILE_000_055: This aetheryte is of Turali design.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_ERENVILLE_000_060: It's fallen into total disrepair. Almost as if it hasn't been used in decades...
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_GRAHATIA_000_065: Amidst enormous alien structures, we have more familiar sights like this station...
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_ALISAIE_000_070: This is a water tower for trains, isn't it?
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_WUKLAMAT_000_080: Hmm. I'm pretty sure this is Yyasulani Station...
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_WUKLAMAT_000_081: But from the state of it, I'd swear it was abandoned years ago.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_WUKLAMAT_000_082: I'm not sure what to make of this. We should look around a bit more.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_WUKLAMAT_000_085: I think this thing is broken.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_SYSTEM_000_090: You find a train turntable. The thick layers of rust suggest it hasn't been used in years.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_SYSTEM_000_091: The tracks are heavily rusted. It would seem they haven't been tended to for a long while.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_SYSTEM_000_092: The building is a rotting husk. It has clearly been many years since anyone lived here.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_WUKLAMAT_000_100: Finished poking around, have you? Let's gather everyone, then. I want you all to take a look at this.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_WUKLAMAT_000_101: It's one of the mechanical soldiers. Long since broken, apparently.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_WUKLAMAT_000_102: But I'd say its presence confirms this is indeed Zoraal Ja's domain we're in.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_WUKLAMAT_000_103: What about the rest of you? Did you learn anything?
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_KRILE_000_104: So all evidence suggests this is Yyasulani Station...
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_ERENVILLE_000_105: Aye, and I've no doubt we're in Yyasulani. But I don't understand why these buildings are so run-down.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_ERENVILLE_000_106: They were completed barely a year ago.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_ALISAIE_000_107: For new structures to deteriorate and enormous ones to appear in a flash... If I didn't know better, I'd say time flows differently here.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_WUKLAMAT_100_107: Is such a thing even possible?
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_GRAHATIA_000_108: We have encountered this phenomenon before, as it so happens.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_GRAHATIA_100_108: Though it may be difficult to believe, our world is but one of several. In some respects they are similar to one another, but in others wholly different. We call them reflections.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_GRAHATIA_000_109: Simply put, the rift between dimensions causes time to flow at a different pace in each world. While hours pass in one, years may have come and gone in another.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_KRILE_000_110: But if this is Yyasulani, then we should still be in the Source. The flow of time should be synchronized.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_WUKLAMAT_000_111: I'm not sure I follow all this talk of reflections and dimensions...
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_WUKLAMAT_100_111: But if Erenville says this is Yyasulani, then it must be.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_WUKLAMAT_000_112: Your village is a little further along, right?
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_ERENVILLE_000_115: Y-Yes. It's a short distance to the northwest.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_WUKLAMAT_000_116: Let's head there next, then. Rather than talk theory, it's always better to confirm things firsthand.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_ALISAIE_000_119: It doesn't seem to be hostile, at least. Perhaps we can ask it some questions.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_ALISAIE_000_120: Can you tell us where we are?
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_MECHANICALDOLL4927_: (-Defective Automaton-)Unable to confirm credentials. <bzzzt> Please present citizen identification.
(-Defective Automaton-)Unable to confirm credentials. <bzzzt> Confirm. <bzzzt> Confirm. <bzzzt>
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_WUKLAMAT_000_124: T-Too strange by half... Let's leave it be and get going.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_GRAHATIA_000_125: Would you accompany me for a moment? There's something I wish to investigate.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_GRAHATIA_000_130: Look there. The lightning appears to be drawn to those pole-shaped structures over yonder.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_GRAHATIA_000_131: The design suggests they're some manner of lightning rod.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_GRAHATIA_000_132: Let's go and take a closer look.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_GRAHATIA_000_140: This material appears to be the same as that used in the mechanical soldiers and warships.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_GRAHATIA_000_141: On closer inspection, it appears to bear fine etchings... Rather reminiscent of arcane runes, these. I suspect they're not merely decorative.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_GRAHATIA_000_142: I would posit it's used to harness lightning as a source of energy. Quite impressive technology.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_GRAHATIA_000_143: I'll share this observation with Y'shtola. For a blessing, the dome doesn't appear to interfere with linkpearls.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_GRAHATIA_000_144: Thanks for accompanying me. Let's head to the village and find the others.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_ALISAIE_000_170: I think it goes without saying, but we're not going to trust her just like that, right?
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_ALISAIE_000_171: Any way you look at it, a mysterious girl who appears out of nowhere, proclaiming herself a queen is suspicious...
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_ALISAIE_000_001: Well, having established that we should be wary, we could use more information.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_ALISAIE_000_002: So let's head to this place, the outskirts, and see what we can learn. Perhaps about Sphene, as well.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_SPHENE_000_010: I trust you have similar farming facilities in Tural?
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_WUKLAMAT_000_011: They're completely different from ours. I've got no idea what all those machines do.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_SPHENE_000_012: We settled on this approach after some trial and error. The Turali have their own methods of farming, which they wanted to continue employing.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_SPHENE_000_013: But the environment makes it challenging. There's too much rain and not enough light.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_SPHENE_100_013: Thankfully, the use of electrope has allowed us to fortify the buildings here, as well as provide what nature cannot.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_SPHENE_000_015: Electrope. It's a material we use for myriad devices and applications.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_SPHENE_000_016: A topic for another time, perhaps. If you would follow me, we're nearly to the outskirts.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_KRILE_000_020: A most unusual farm, but the produce appears normal enough.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_WUKLAMAT_000_025: Have you ever seen such strange contraptions? I wonder what this one is used for.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_ALISAIE_000_030: It's a relief to see the people here are well, at least.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_GRAHATIA_000_035: The innovations of Alexandria are nothing short of extraordinary.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_ERENVILLE_000_040: Those brick buildings... I've seen their like before, though I cannot remember where.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_KRILE_000_050: It's a rather lively settlement, isn't it? In defiance of this ceaseless gloom, almost.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_WUKLAMAT_000_055: It's a relief to see the people here are well. Hopefully the same can be said for everyone in Yyasulani.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_ALISAIE_000_060: I'll admit, I've seen nothing particularly suspicious. Yet.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_GRAHATIA_000_065: It's fascinating how they've combined traditional bricklaying with electrope-based engineering. A curious blending of two cultures.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_ERENVILLE_000_070: This is a Tonawawtan village. Or at least, it was. Before the dome and these strange contraptions.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_SPHENE_000_080: Electrope has done much to improve the efficiency of their farming, but hasn't replaced everything.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_SPHENE_000_081: The people wanted to preserve their old way of life, and we did not want to force ours upon them.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_WUKLAMAT_000_082: You went to such lengths so that our cultures could coexist. Even going so far as to learn our tongue... I'm sure everyone appreciated that.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_SPHENE_000_083: Communication was thankfully not an issue, for the Turali tongue is surprisingly similar to Alexandrian.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_SPHENE_000_084: Of course, there are words and phrases for which there is no equivalent, but those can be taught with minimal effort.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_SPHENE_000_085: Through mutual respect, understanding, and patience, we Alexandrians and Turali have learned a great deal from one another.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_SPHENE_000_086: And I am sure there is much you wish to learn as well. So please, if you have questions, do not hesitate to ask.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_WUKLAMAT_000_090: Touring farmlands with the queen of another nation is not how I expected to spend my day.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_WUKLAMAT_000_001: Touring farmlands with the queen of another nation is not how I expected to spend my day.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_010: Rather than bore you with lengthy explanations, let us head back to the farm we passed earlier.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_011: Yyupye's Halo, it is called. We can speak with one of the farmers when we arrive.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_WUKLAMAT_000_012: ...I guess we're off to Yyupye's Halo.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_WUKLAMAT_000_015: What do you suppose they keep inside this building?
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_020: Here we are. I'm sure you'll learn a great deal from the workers here.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_030: Allow me to introduce you to Mahuwsa, one of the most experienced farmhands in all of Alexandria.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_031: She's well versed in myriad farming techniques. Indeed, the wealth of knowledge she has shared with the other farmers is what has allowed this place to flourish.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_MAHUWSA_000_032: Queen Sphene! To what do I owe this sudden shower of praise?
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_033: My apologies for the interruption. I am come with guests from beyond the barrier.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_034: They wish to learn more of Alexandria, and so I invited them to see how our crops are grown. I do hope that's all right.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_MAHUWSA_000_035: So the rumors of visitors from the outside were true!
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_MAHUWSA_000_036: What manner of hosts would we be to deny them a look around─and I gather Your Majesty also intended to check on things here?
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_037: You know me too well, Mahuwsa. I thought to seize this opportunity to see how the farmers fare, and perhaps pepper them with a few questions. Though I do so enjoy observing and taking part in the work, too.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_038: 'Twould appear we have her permission. So please, walk the grounds to your heart's content.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_WUKLAMAT_000_039: You go on ahead. I'll keep Sphene company.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_WUKLAMAT_000_040: Don't misunderstand─I'm not the suspicious type. But given our positions, it would make sense for us to go around together, wouldn't you say?
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_041: A fair point. But be sure not to let me out of your sight!
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_042: I shall remain under Wuk Lamat's watchful eye. Pray, come find us after you've seen your fill and spoken with the other farmhands.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_WUKLAMAT_000_045: It's a shame Koana's not here to see all these bizarre contraptions.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_050: Finished already, are we? If so, I should very much like to hear what you think of our facilities.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_MAHUWSA_000_055: My duties here are quite varied despite being merely a farmer. We all have to do our part if we're to prosper.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_ELIAS_000_060: Light levels appear to be fine. As for the power source...
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_ELIAS_000_061: Hm? You wish to know about my job?
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_ELIAS_000_062: I tend to the fields, mostly. Watering the crops, keeping the soil fertile, and so on.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_ELIAS_000_063: It admittedly took some time until I fully understood how best to carry out my duties.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_ELIAS_000_064: I also manage the lamps we use in the fields. We do our best to keep everything up to code, but should they ever start to malfunction, it's up to me to fix them.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_ELIAS_000_065: The land and sky being what they are, ensuring a rich harvest makes for constant work. But honestly, I enjoy how involved the process is.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_ELIAS_000_066: Both my parents being Alexandrian, I didn't grow up knowing much of anything about farming. Every day is an opportunity to learn and grow.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_ELIAS_000_070: If you should ever take an interest in farming, I'd be more than happy to teach you what I know.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_HHINEK_000_080: Oh, an unfamiliar face. I gather this is your first time on-site, then?
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_HHINEK_000_081: Well, this here's the storehouse. Or rather, the entrance. The real storehouse is underground, much more spacious, and equipped with a temperature regulation system to keep the harvest from spoiling.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_HHINEK_000_082: Since the entrance is so small, it's much easier to prevent wild beasts from wandering inside─which also makes it a viable facility for breeding and raising livestock. We've even got a few beds down there for emergencies.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_HHINEK_000_083: My parents often complain about how Alexandrian technology and electrope complicate our lives, but it's just a matter of learning how things work.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_HHINEK_000_084: Take my job, for instance. I'm presently overseeing the storage of harvested crops.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_HHINEK_000_085: They'll be taken up to the tower for processing, and from there find their way to every dining table in Alexandria. The work is hard, I'll not deny, but I take great satisfaction in what we do.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_HHINEK_000_090: I actually live up there. It's only for work that I come down to the outskirts.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_KIPEHWI_000_100: They're saying that you and yours are visitors from beyond the barrier. That true?
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_KIPEHWI_000_101: So it is! Which means we're connected to the outside world again.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_KIPEHWI_000_102: Not that I have a desire to leave, mind you. I'm quite content with life here in Alexandria.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_KIPEHWI_000_103: But setting that aside, you're here to observe our work, right? As you can see, I'm in charge of livestock.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_KIPEHWI_000_104: Here at Yyupye's Halo, we produce not only fruits and vegetables, but also meat, poultry, and eggs.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_KIPEHWI_000_105: Tending the animals is an absolute joy, but I have to be careful not to grow attached. It's always a little sad when they're shipped off, but a job is a job.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_KIPEHWI_000_106: Well, I need to get back to it, but it was nice talking to you. Please give my regards to the queen!
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_KIPEHWI_000_110: Perhaps later you could tell me more of what the world is like beyond the barrier.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_120: I see. Don't be too hard on yourself. Anyone would have been hard-pressed to deal with such a thing.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_121: Oh, welcome back. My apologies for failing to notice your return.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_122: I gather you've had your fill of speaking with the farmers? Then let us return to Mahuwsa.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_123: Well? What are your impressions of the farm?
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_A1_000_002: I was amazed that everyone loves their work.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_126: Your words serve to affirm that my people do not work with undue strain.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_127: A curious observation. Do you not love your own work?
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_128: Oh, but I jest. It's true that the people of the outskirts seem the most fulfilled. Always, they take to their duties with good cheer.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_129: So it was the electrope that caught your eye. That's only natural, I suppose, if you come from a place without it.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_130: Still, you only seem mildly impressed. This leads me to believe you have experience with even more marvelous technology. I'd love to hear your tales one day!
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_131: And what did you think of our little tour, Lamaty'i?
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_133: Was that inappropriate? My apologies. I heard the others call you by that name, and I thought...
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_WUKLAMAT_000_134: No. No, it's fine. As you said before, we've no need for titles and formalities.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_WUKLAMAT_000_135: As for my thoughts, I was very impressed. That machines could be used to overcome so harsh an environment is amazing. I've never seen anything like it.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_MAHUWSA_000_136: The feeling is understandable. Indeed, many still find the machinery behind me baffling.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_MAHUWSA_000_137: It's a system that controls the distribution of water for the fields and livestock. It's been acting up lately, though...
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_MAHUWSA_000_139: You needn't worry, my queen. It happens fairly often. Put simply, it's taken in water that had a strong lightning charge.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_MAHUWSA_000_140: We think some creatures have become charged up with the energy, and they're releasing it into the river we use as a source.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_MAHUWSA_000_141: The system would return to normal if the creatures were dealt with. But I'm reluctant to beg it of the army...
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_WUKLAMAT_000_142: We could take care of it if you'd like.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_143: That is most gracious of you to offer, but it is much too dangerous.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_WUKLAMAT_000_144: Oh, it's no trouble for the Vow of Resolve of Tuliyollal!
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_WUKLAMAT_100_144: Regardless of how the relationship between our nations may develop, if there are people in need, I want to help. Simple as that.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_WUKLAMAT_000_145: And  is even stronger than I am. It shouldn't take us long at all.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_146: Then very well, I gratefully accept. But please take all care.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_WUKLAMAT_000_147: This ought to go even faster if you and I search for lightning-charged fiends on our own. Good hunting!
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_150: I do not doubt your strength, but please be careful.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_MAHUWSA_000_155: Sorry for dragging you into our troubles. If it seems too dangerous, don't hesitate to retreat.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_170: Ah, you're both all right, thank goodness!
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_WUKLAMAT_000_171: You really needn't have worried so much. We barely broke a sweat dealing with the fiends. They're all gone now.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_172: Of course I was worried! You're my dear guests!
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_173: But thank you. We truly appreciate this.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_MAHUWSA_000_174: Indeed! With this, we won't have to ask Zoraal Ja's machines for help.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_MAHUWSA_000_175: He's been making a concerted effort to bolster his forces, sparing but a fraction for the people's protection.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_MAHUWSA_000_176: He thinks nothing of our safety. Unlike Queen Sphene...
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_177: Th-That's enough, Mahuwsa. If you have grievances, I will hear them later. But to speak of the king now...
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_WUKLAMAT_000_178: No, she's right. He's never been one to look after his people.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_WUKLAMAT_000_179: ...Anyway, thanks for letting us tour the farm. The folk here are delightful, and it was a pleasure to meet them.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_180: You couldn't have favored us with more uplifting words. My people are my pride and joy.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_MAHUWSA_000_181: And you never fail to let us know─nor how much you care.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_182: Of course! You're my precious family, all of you.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_WUKLAMAT_000_183: You seem a good sort, Sphene. That I'll admit.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_WUKLAMAT_000_184: But you'll forgive me if I'm not ready to lower my guard for the enemy queen just yet.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_MAHUWSA_000_185: Ahahaha! For you to be called that, I dread to imagine what villainy Your Majesty has committed!
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_186: Come now, this is no laughing matter.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_187: A ruler is responsible for the welfare of countless lives, and one wrong decision can lead to untold suffering. Failure is unconscionable...
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SPHENE_000_188: Now, I believe we are done with the farm. Let's move on, shall we?
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_SPHENE_000_010: Perhaps we should head back to the outskirts? I daresay your friends will also have returned by now.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_MAHUWSA_000_011: My thanks again for dealing with the fiends. Come and visit us any time.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_SPHENE_000_020: There is so much of Alexandria I would love to show you!
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_MAHUWSA_000_025: Like everyone, I have the utmost admiration and respect for Queen Sphene. It's a little embarrassing to say such things to her in person, though...
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_WUKLAMAT_000_030: What's going on? How could Pepoane suddenly forget about Namikka?
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_WUKLAMAT_000_031: It's as if he never knew her...
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_ALISAIE_000_032: Could the same thing have happened to others as well, I wonder?
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_KRILE_000_033: There's only one way to find out. Let's make inquiries about Namikka in the area. We can reconvene afterwards at the aetheryte.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_GRAHATIA_000_035: As far as I could tell, Pepoane genuinely had no recollection of Namikka.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_KRILE_000_036: We'll see how it is with other people.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_ERENVILLE_000_037: I've never seen nor heard of anything like this before.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_OUTSKIRTSRESIDENTA0: I'm afraid I don't know that person. I'm sorry I couldn't be of help.
I'm sorry. Perhaps someone else knows this Namikka.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_OUTSKIRTSRESIDENTB0: What's that? Do I know a Namikka?
Never met anyone by that name, and I've worked at the outskirts for a good while now. If she'd spent time here, I would remember.
Like as not, this Namikka is up in the cloud...
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_OUTSKIRTSRESIDENTC0: Hmmm... I do recall caring for someone until recently. And you say that it was a woman named Namikka?
While I can't say for certain if it was her, I wouldn't worry. I'm sure she's just been taken up to the cloud.
It's not common, but it does happen from time to time.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_WUKLAMAT_000_070: So it was the same for everyone.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_WUKLAMAT_000_071: Not a single person remembers Namikka. It's as if the memory of her has been purged from their minds.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_KRILE_000_072: While such a thing might be done with magic, to alter the memories of so many at once would be a tremendous undertaking. We would have felt a surge of aether corresponding to the act, too, and I sensed none in that moment.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_ALISAIE_000_073: Neither did I. But I did notice something else─right before Pepoane seemingly forgot, a light in the device on his head began to blink.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_GRAHATIA_000_074: Could there be a connection? Someone also said something about “soul cells.”
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_GRAHATIA_000_075: But who might we ask about this? If we continued making such inquiries, I expect we would only cause confusion.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_ALISAIE_000_076: Indeed... If we can't readily solve the mystery about Namikka, perhaps we could search for Cahciua instead?
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_ERENVILLE_000_077: Sphene said to try the Thunderyards.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_ERENVILLE_000_078: It should be in this direction.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_WUKLAMAT_000_081: Another kind of mechanical soldier!? It looks dangerous! We'd better destroy it!
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_ALISAIE_000_084: I think it understood our words. It might be worth asking it some questions.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_ALISAIE_000_085: ...Erenville? Are you alright? You look like you've seen a ghost.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_WUKLAMAT_000_087: Well, it went off in the direction we're headed anyway, so let's try to track it down.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_KRILE_000_100: No sign of it over here.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_ERENVILLE_000_111: To the northeast? Then it must be bound for the mines.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_ALISAIE_000_113: It could well be a trap, so let's not rush in too quickly.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_ALISAIE_000_120: I think it's safe to assume it went into the mines.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_KRILE_000_125: An old coal mine? It appears to have long since been abandoned, like so many other places.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_GRAHATIA_000_130: The stones in those crates... Could it be turquoise?
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_ERENVILLE_000_140: I heard faint voices coming from inside.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_WUKLAMAT_000_141: So it's not alone. But we're still going in, of course?
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_WUKLAMAT_000_142: This may be a trap. Be ready for a fight, everyone!
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_ALISAIE_000_150: I'm not worried. We've had to improvise countless times before, after all.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_KRILE_000_155: A device made with electrope. It seems to be the only one here.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_GRAHATIA_000_160: It would appear no one has worked these tunnels in quite some time...
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_ERENVILLE_000_170: I can hear them. Several people up ahead.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_ERENVILLE_000_171: Hmm. I can't make out their conversation with the echoing.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_WUKLAMAT_000_172: Let's keep going. Stay on your guard.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_WUKLAMAT_000_180: I can't say I understand what's going on, but at least Cahciua is safe.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_ALISAIE_000_185: Erenville's mother is a floating machine. Right─that makes about as much sense as everything else thus far.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_KRILE_000_190: At this point, I doubt anything could possibly surprise me.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_GRAHATIA_000_195: The Allagans had machines that could be controlled remotely. Is she using something similar to communicate with us?
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_GEODE_000_200: Always too much excitement with her... Sorry for drawing our weapons on you.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_NOSTALGIA_000_205: If it's any consolation, this is all rather confusing to us as well.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_ERENVILLE_000_220: As far as I can tell, this is indeed my mother. I can think of few people in the world quite so spirited...
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_ERENVILLE_000_221: But as to what's happened, we'll need to ask her...
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_WUKLAMAT_000_001: I can't say I understand what's going on, but at least Cahciua is safe.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_ALISAIE_000_002: Erenville's mother is a floating machine. Right─that makes about as much sense as everything else thus far.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_KRILE_000_003: At this point, I doubt anything could possibly surprise me.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GRAHATIA_000_004: The Allagans had machines that could be controlled remotely. Is she using something similar to communicate with us?
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GEODE_000_005: Always too much excitement with her... Sorry for drawing our weapons on you.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_NOSTALGIA_000_006: If it's any consolation, this is all rather confusing to us as well.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_ERENVILLE_000_009: <sigh> Let's hear what she has to say.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA000_000_010: It's so wonderful to meet you all.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_011: And the Students of Baldesion... It's been a while since I heard that name.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_ERENVILLE_000_012: Dare I ask the reason for your appearance?
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_013: Oh, this? It's just a body that I control remotely. I use this for our operations.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_014: We're members of a resistance organization─Oblivion, we call ourselves, and our goal is to thwart Zoraal Ja's ambitions for conquest.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_015: As the leader, it's prudent that I remain where I can't be easily found.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_ALISAIE_000_016: I see. Whimsical appearances notwithstanding, yours is a serious cause.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_017: Right you are. Though truth be told, Oblivion was founded for an altogether different purpose.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_019: As I expect you've already noticed, everything you see within this dome─the buildings, the people, the very earth beneath our feet─is a fusion of two worlds.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_020: Stopping such a fusion was Oblivion's original mission.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_KRILE_000_021: Then does that mean you know who or what is responsible for it?
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_022: I'm afraid not. This was a long time ago, and our mission statement has become more of a legend that's passed down to members. By the time we joined, our sole objective was stopping Zoraal Ja.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_023: But we failed to do that. And now he's taken his army outside the dome...
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_WUKLAMAT_000_024: None of you wear those strange devices on your heads. Does that have something to do with your work?
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_026: It's a regulator, the pinnacle of electrope technology. And that we don't wear it is indeed related to our operations.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GEODE_000_030: The first, as the name suggests, is the regulation of the wearer's reserve of souls. Should they die, the regulator expends a soul to bring them back to life.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_ALISAIE_000_031: “Reserve”? You mean people walk around carrying spare souls!?
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GEODE_000_032: They do. Souls are packaged in cells, and they can be used to replenish the life force that is lost due to sudden death, such as in accidents. They do nothing for those who die of old age, though.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GEODE_000_033: Distribution of soul cells is based on one's work evaluation. To encourage “exemplary performance” when fulfilling their duties.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_ALISAIE_000_034: Souls as a common resource...and payment for services rendered...
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GRAHATIA_000_035: The voidsent practice of consuming others for their aether comes to mind. And similarly, I expect that the act comes with some risk.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_A1_000_037: Doesn't it dilute your sense of self?
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_A1_000_038: Wouldn't the consciousness of others corrupt your own?
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GEODE_000_039: That is prevented through memory management, a process in which regulators also play a role.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_KRILE_000_040: Memory management? Then the reason everyone has forgotten Namikka's existence...
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GEODE_000_041: The regulators are constantly recording the memories of their wearer, so if they should suddenly die, their memories can be refreshed as part of the restoration process.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GEODE_000_042: This is how they preserve one's identity and sense of self. However, the regulators are also triggered when someone else dies.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GEODE_000_043: Reason being is that regulators forcibly extract memories relating to the deceased from anyone wearing one.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_ALISAIE_000_044: Why would they do such a thing?
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_045: It's a “kindness” bestowed upon the people by Everkeep's core system, so that no one has to suffer the pain of loss.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_KRILE_000_046: So this is what is meant by their memories being in the cloud.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GEODE_000_047: Indeed. All memories of the deceased are wiped from the minds of the people and archived in the system.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GEODE_000_048: It's a frightening function of the regulators─and an integral step in soul cell production.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GEODE_000_049: You see, when a person dies of natural causes, their soul is temporarily housed within the regulator.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GEODE_000_050: It's then delivered to a facility where memories are separated from the soul.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GEODE_000_051: The result is a fresh soul cell, free of impurities, ready for distribution and consumption.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_052: Meanwhile, the memories are stored in the core system. To be “remembered” forever.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_ALISAIE_000_053: And this is why people are happy here? On its surface, it's similar to the Yok Huy philosophy, but I see nothing noble or comforting in it...
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GEODE_000_054: Well, it doesn't seem so terrible to me personally. All comes down to what you're used to, I suppose.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GEODE_000_055: Like the barrier encasing Alexandria, this system was created to overcome the calamity that transformed the world hundreds of years ago.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GEODE_000_056: Amidst the mounting death toll, scientists used electrope to devise a means to save what lives they could so that the nation could endure.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_WUKLAMAT_000_057: I understand the people of Alexandria did what they believed was best to save their people. I just find it hard to believe the Turali would also accept this way of living.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_058: It came as a shock to us as well. In fact, a great many were opposed to it.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_059: Which is why the use of regulators was never compulsory. The people have always been free to go without them if they so wish.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_WUKLAMAT_000_060: Sphene didn't strike me as the sort of ruler to impose her will on others.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_ERENVILLE_000_062: She's the one who suggested we come to the Thunderyards in the first place. She also said she wants to help us stop Zoraal Ja.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_063: Awfully kind of her to point you in my direction. And to speak so candidly as well...
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_064: Whatever her motives, she has given the people a choice: live with the risk of true death, or the security of the regulators.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_ERENVILLE_000_065: Everything that lives must someday die. That is the natural order of things.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_066: Quite right... But however you feel about them, it would be easier to understand what the regulators are capable of if you saw it for yourself.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_067: I know just the person to show you, and as luck would have it, they should be starting work right about now.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_WUKLAMAT_000_068: Who are we going to see, exactly?
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_069: Come with me and you'll find out.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_WUKLAMAT_000_074: So those regulators are to blame for everyone forgetting Namikka. For forgetting what a wonderful person she was...
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_ALISAIE_000_075: I'm sorry, but I just can't accept the idea of using souls as a resource.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_KRILE_000_076: We're to see how the regulators work, but how?
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GRAHATIA_000_077: To alter the memories of the populace with such precision is no small feat.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_ERENVILLE_000_078: What does she intend to show us?
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_081: It is the responsibility of the Thunderyard's hunters to fell any fiends found wandering the area.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_082: We're to meet an acquaintance of mine, Strika, one of these hunters.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_WUKLAMAT_000_085: What do you think is in this box? I'm guessing food.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_ALISAIE_000_086: Judging by its name, I take it this facility is for gathering lightning energy.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_KRILE_000_087: Given the opportunity, I should very much like to study electrope on behalf of the Students.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GRAHATIA_000_088: While I am not blind to the potential benefits of these regulators, the risks inherent in giving another party the power to alter your memories cannot be overstated─never mind the ethical considerations of using souls in such a fashion.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_090: Strika will show you what life can be like wearing a regulator.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_STRIKA_000_100: Cahciua? What are you doing here? And with so many friends.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_101: Apologies for the interruption, but I was hoping they might observe you at work.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_STRIKA_000_102: Hunting, you mean? That's fine, I guess...
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_STRIKA_000_103: Hold on. I assumed they were wearing special regulators like Queen Sphene's crown, but they aren't wearing anything at all.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_STRIKA_000_104: It's much too dangerous to be here without one. What if they're struck by lightning, or attacked by beasts?
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_105: I can assure you they're all quite capable of looking after themselves. If anything should go amiss, I will take full responsibility.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_STRIKA_000_106: Well, don't say I didn't warn you. Danger aside, there isn't really much to see.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_WUKLAMAT_000_107: Cahciua said you're a hunter, but wouldn't it be easier for those mechanical soldiers to guard this place?
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_STRIKA_000_108: It would, if not for the fact they're weak to lightning. The Thunderyard being what it is, they've been ordered to steer clear.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_STRIKA_000_109: Some good they are, eh? But these facilities are vital to the upkeeping of Alexandria's infrastructure, so it falls to hunters like me to deal with any fiends.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_STRIKA_000_110: Given the danger, we're well compensated for our work. It's a perfect profession for anyone looking to build up savings.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_STRIKA_000_111: The special selection of souls for hunters isn't terrible either.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_112: I brought this lot here to see this danger you speak of. If it's not too much trouble to ask.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_STRIKA_000_113: Ah, of course. In which case, it'd be a shame to waste my efforts on just any old beast.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_STRIKA_000_114: You all can handle yourselves in a fight, right? If you cause a ruckus slaying what critters you see nearby, there's a chance you'll draw out something worthy of a demonstration.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_ALISAIE_000_115: I'm not sure I understand, but I suppose we should each slay what we can.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_ERENVILLE_000_120: I'm afraid I must leave the fighting to you.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_125: My fussy little bunbun was never any good at fighting, and this body of mine isn't suited to it either. We leave this work in your capable hands!
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_STRIKA_000_132: It's fine, really. I've faced worse. Just watch.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_WUKLAMAT_000_133: I don't like the looks of this. Let us help!
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_STRIKA_000_139: That was embarrassing. The bastard caught me off guard.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_WUKLAMAT_000_140: Are you mad!? Seriously, let us help!
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_STRIKA_000_141: I told you not to worry.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_STRIKA_000_142: This will only take a moment.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_STRIKA_000_144: Come on, let's get out of here.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GRAHATIA_000_145: That's also a function of the regulator?
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_WUKLAMAT_000_146: I think I understand now how Zoraal Ja was able to return from the dead and defeat Papa, but I'm not sure what we saw at the end there.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_ALISAIE_000_147: As soon as the regulator turned red, it was as if you were possessed. Your movements became beast-like.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GRAHATIA_000_148: Don't tell me...you empowered yourself with the soul of a beast? I'm reminded of the serpentine soldier we encountered at Vanguard who did the same...
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_STRIKA_000_149: So you've crossed paths with one of the king's elite? Such a form can only be achieved from gorging yourself on souls.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_STRIKA_000_150: We could do the same, in theory, but it's incredibly dangerous. Besides, it's not as if they'd allow hunters to carry that many souls to begin with.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_STRIKA_000_151: Well, I should be getting back to work. Take care.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_152: And there you have it. Regulators can be loaded with two kinds of souls, those of peoples and those of beasts.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_153: The souls of people can be used to grant the user preternatural strength.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_154: Naturally, they can also be used to ensure no one suffers an untimely death.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_WUKLAMAT_000_155: And what about the souls of beasts?
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_156: They work much in the same fashion, imbuing you with the strength of the chosen animal.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_157: If, for example, you used the soul of a wolf, you would grow more agile and feral, as you saw with Strika.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_158: Using several of the same type at once, however, would result in physical changes. Your teeth might become fangs, your nails claws─too many, and you'll become more beast than man.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GRAHATIA_000_159: Changing one's form through the souls of other beings... It becomes more and more reminiscent of voidsent.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GRAHATIA_000_160: Yet unlike the void, where the cycle of death and rebirth is simply broken, souls here are forcibly taken before they might reach the aetherial sea. Different means to achieve similar ends.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_ERENVILLE_000_161: A cycle to which all within the dome are bound...
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_ALISAIE_000_162: This is wrong. This is all wrong.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_KRILE_000_163: It is indeed hard to accept, being so far removed from our own beliefs.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_KRILE_000_164: Perhaps more shocking is that the technology to achieve all this was developed hundreds of years ago.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GRAHATIA_000_165: The civilizations in the reflections are surprising indeed...
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_ALISAIE_000_170: Having seen the beauty of the aetherial sea firsthand, I simply can't accept what they've done here in Alexandria.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_KRILE_000_171: I understand this is part of their culture, but it is no less disconcerting.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GRAHATIA_000_172: When Emet-Selch spoke of surprising civilizations in other reflections, I wonder if he had Alexandria in mind.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_ERENVILLE_000_173: Sphene speaks of lived experiences that suggest she's far older than she appears. Considering the power of these regulators, perhaps it's not so far-fetched.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_CAHCIUA_000_174: I've never seen it for myself, but it's said that if a beast's soul is potent enough, a single soul is enough to induce a monstrous transformation.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_WUKLAMAT_000_180: While we all have our thoughts on souls, for now the important thing is we know what power Zoraal Ja has at his disposal.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_GRAHATIA_100_180: It is one thing to separate corporeal aether from incorporeal aether, but to strip memories from the soul entirely is unprecedented technology.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_KRILE_000_181: This is no longer only Tuliyollal's concern. With his newfound power, Zoraal Ja has become a real threat to the entire world.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_WUKLAMAT_000_182: Indeed. He has to be stopped, no matter the cost!
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_ALISAIE_000_001: Having seen the beauty of the aetherial sea firsthand, I simply can't accept what they've done here in Alexandria.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_KRILE_000_002: I understand this is part of their culture, but it is no less disconcerting.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_GRAHATIA_000_003: When Emet-Selch spoke of surprising civilizations in other reflections, I wonder if he had Alexandria in mind.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_ERENVILLE_000_004: Sphene looks to be of an age with Alisaie and Wuk Lamat, but now I wonder if these regulators have anything to do with that.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_005: Regulators give Zoraal Ja a frightful advantage, and that's just one of the devices he's gotten his hands on...
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_006: If we're to have a chance at defeating him, we have to learn all we can about the technology he has at his disposal.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_CAHCIUA_000_020: I trust you've gained an insight into the use of souls in Alexandria?
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_CAHCIUA_000_021: It's shocking, I know─I was overwhelmed myself at first. I expect you'll need some time to digest it all, but for now, let's head back to Earthen Sky.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_023: There's something I want to discuss with everyone. Let's take a moment before we head into the tunnel.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_ALISAIE_000_025: I understand the argument that we should keep an open mind, if this practice is integral to their culture. But every fiber of my being rails against it...
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_KRILE_000_026: What does Lamaty'i wish to discuss, I wonder...
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_GRAHATIA_000_027: 'Tis well that we could see firsthand how regulators are used. To draw upon even the souls of fiends... I shudder to imagine how powerful Zoraal Ja could become.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_ERENVILLE_000_028: To think that everyone has lived here for thirty years. Long enough to become accustomed to the way of life...
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_030: I'm sorry for delaying us, but I have some thoughts I need to share.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_031: In both technology...and values...it's plain there's a wide gulf between Tuliyollal and Alexandria.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_032: And while Zoraal Ja knows everything about us, we know hardly anything about what he's become.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_GRAHATIA_000_033: Indeed... We haven't even seen what lies within that enormous tower, Everkeep.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_034: So here I'd like to make a proposal.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_035: That is, we work with Cahciua and her people.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_036: We need to learn as much as we can about the enemy. The quickest way would be to join hands with Oblivion.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_037: We've only just met them, I know, and we shouldn't be too quick to trust. But the fact remains that they share our desire to stop Zoraal Ja.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_GRAHATIA_000_038: Sphene, too, claims to be at odds with the King of Resolve. May I ask why you would cooperate with Oblivion instead?
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_039: It's simple, really. Their leader is Erenville's mother.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_040: Meanwhile, whatever Sphene may feel, she's a ruler of this nation. There's a greater risk in working with her, and less reason to take her at her word.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_GRAHATIA_000_041: A fair point. And knowing Zoraal Ja, we must assume that his arrangement with Sphene was not made without some consideration.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_KRILE_000_042: All I know is that it would be heartening to have allies in this strange realm.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_KRILE_000_043: I think everyone would agree that any help we can get would be welcome.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_ERENVILLE_000_044: Hold on. There's no guarantee that it's actually my mother behind the machine.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_ERENVILLE_000_045: Without seeing her in the flesh, we can't rule out the possibility of a ploy.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_ERENVILLE_000_046: If it turns out to be a trap, we endanger not only ourselves, but everyone in Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_047: As you say, we have no proof that it really is Cahciua.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_048: But I make my proposal in full awareness of this.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_049: Whether we're going to war or striving for peace, we need to learn as much as we can. Otherwise we can't hope to do anything meaningful.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_050: As it stands, we know too little about this realm. We need to remedy that. We need to study the enemy, and when the time comes, strike down Zoraal Ja for good and all.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_052: I trust you, Erenville. You've always had great instincts, honed from your time training under your mother.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_ERENVILLE_000_053: What if I'm wrong? What if sentiment is clouding my judgment?
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_A1_000_001: If it's a trap, then we'll deal with it when it's sprung.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_ERENVILLE_000_055: <sigh> That's always the way of it with you...
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_ERENVILLE_000_056: Fine. If you're set on this, then I'll say no more.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_057: Then it's settled. Let's head inside and secure ourselves some new allies!
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_ALISAIE_100_057: While I'm all for dealing with Zoraal Ja, we need to consider how our actions may affect ordinary Alexandrians. They're not the enemy, after all.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_KRILE_110_057: I agree with Wuk Lamat. It's a gamble regardless of whether or not we choose to work with the people here, and more knowledge is better than less.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_GRAHATIA_000_058: The Vow of Resolve is possessed of conviction and flexibility both. If the tales are true, she learned much in the course of the rite of succession.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_ERENVILLE_100_058: I'm unaccustomed to seeing her make decisions like a ruler. Better that than her former vacillating self, though.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_059: With the resources at their disposal, I'm hopeful that Cahciua and her people will make great allies!
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_060: Cahciua, there's something I need to tell you and your people.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_061: We came here for no other reason than to strike down Zoraal Ja.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_GEODE_000_062: But...I thought he was your brother.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_GEODE_000_063: Do you really mean to kill your own kin?
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_064: My kin invaded our nation and murdered our people. As Vow of Resolve, it falls to me to bring him to account.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_065: I am prepared to do what I must, and I won't hesitate when the time comes.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_066: Like us, you and yours oppose Zoraal Ja. In light of this, I propose that we work together to stop him once and for all.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_067: I realize that this is sudden. That it's a gamble to trust someone you've only just met.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_068: But I would trust in the conviction of anyone who shares my goal. So fight with me, I beg you!
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_CAHCIUA_000_069: As you say, our goals align. And I don't doubt your resolve in the least.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_CAHCIUA_000_070: If you hadn't proposed working together, I would've done so instead.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_CAHCIUA_000_071: Truth be told, it's been tough going at it alone. While we've gathered ample intelligence, we don't have the strength to take decisive action.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_CAHCIUA_000_072: Besides, how could we not trust you?
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_CAHCIUA_000_073: My only son is with you─my fussy little bunbun. He's all the reason I need.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_CAHCIUA_000_074: Then it's decided. Here's to a fruitful collaboration!
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_075: Thank you, Cahciua, everyone! Together we'll achieve great things, I'm sure of it!
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_ALISAIE_000_076: Then let's not waste any time. We've been wondering about Zoraal Ja's whereabouts. Is there a palace inside that tower?
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_GEODE_000_077: After a fashion. The king resides on the uppermost level. But while Queen Sphene has a penchant for going out in public, he seldom shows himself.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_GEODE_000_078: What's more, his movements are highly classified. Not even his commanders are privy to that information. If anyone knows where he is at any given time, it could only be the queen.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_CAHCIUA_000_079: Even if we don't know his whereabouts, Zoraal Ja will eventually march on Tuliyollal again. That's when we can go after him.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_CAHCIUA_000_080: The drawback is we'd have to wait for the invasion to happen. Innocents would be put in harm's way.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_CAHCIUA_000_081: There's also the possibility that he'll leave everything to his minions and not command the army in person.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_084: My brother has always yearned to surpass our father. That's why he attacked Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_100_084: After waiting for thirty years, the first thing he wanted to do was demonstrate his newfound strength.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_085: But killing Papa didn't satisfy him. So now he's bent on proving himself stronger than me and Koana, who bested him in the rite of succession.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_086: He challenged me to strike him down. He wants a duel to show everyone that he's superior to the Dawnservant, and he won't let his minions deprive him of the pleasure.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_ALISAIE_000_087: Then why hasn't he appeared and given you your chance? Surely, he's aware of our presence here.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_088: At that, I can only guess. Perhaps he wants to dazzle us with his wondrous realm. But if he won't deign to appear, then we'll force him to do so.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_089: Even as we gather intelligence, we make no move to attack him. Show absolutely no interest in a confrontation.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_090: Knowing him, he'll tire of waiting and turn his attention to Koana instead. He'll attack Tuliyollal again, like he said he would.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_CAHCIUA_000_091: I see... If you believe this the best approach, then we have no objections.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_CAHCIUA_000_092: Any campaign against Tuliyollal requires that Zoraal Ja lead his forces through Vanguard. We'll have lookouts keep an eye on it day and night.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_KRILE_000_093: Such a strategy is certainly viable... If we're proceeding with it, though, we should warn those outside.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_ALISAIE_000_094: Indeed. They'll need time to prepare their defenses.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_GRAHATIA_000_095: I should be glad to coordinate our efforts. I'm already in regular contact with Y'shtola, and will make sure to keep our comrades apprised of developments.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_GEODE_000_096: You can leave Vanguard to us. We'll send word at the first sign of movement.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_CAHCIUA_000_097: It seems we have a plan.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_CAHCIUA_000_098: While we wait for Zoraal Ja to move, you'd do well to prepare for battle, and it begins with familiarizing yourselves with the technology that empowers him.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_CAHCIUA_000_099: To that end, I'll show you to Oblivion's main headquarters.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_100: Oh? I thought this place was it.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_CAHCIUA_000_101: <chuckle> You'll be impressed to know that we're located right inside that tower, in the residential district of Solution Nine.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_CAHCIUA_000_102: Hiding a tree in the forest, as it were.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_CAHCIUA_000_103: The only question is how to get you through the checkpoint...
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_104: Ah, about that. Sphene said that she'd make it so we could enter without issue.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_CAHCIUA_000_105: She did? Curious. She's not supposed to have such authority over the sentries.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_KRILE_000_106: If I recall correctly, her words were that she would register us as guests.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_CAHCIUA_000_107: I see. Perhaps we're in the clear, then.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_CAHCIUA_100_107: When you're ready, come and meet me at the tower entrance.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_GEODE_000_108: Before you head out, give us a moment to introduce ourselves properly, eh?
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_GEODE_000_109: After all, names are good to know when working together.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_ALISAIE_000_110: Between making new friends and entering the tower, I can't help but feel a little excited.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_KRILE_000_111: (Is it just me or are Erenville and Cahciua complete opposites in personality?)
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_GRAHATIA_000_112: The intelligence that Cahciua and her people possess will be very useful to our efforts.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_ERENVILLE_000_113: ...It's eerie hearing my mother's voice come from that peculiar machine.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_114: If this isn't their main headquarters, I can't imagine what the actual place is like...
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_NOSTALGIA_000_115: If Cahciua trusts you, then so do we!
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_GEODE_000_120: While Oblivion has operatives all over, we're the main crew here.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_GEODE_000_121: I'm Geode, the leader of this hideout.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_GEODE_000_122: And the dependable young twins behind me are Nostalgia and Wayakkwe.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_NOSTALGIA_000_123: I'm Nostalgia! It's a pleasure to meet you.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_NOSTALGIA_000_124: My sister and I were born and raised inside the barrier.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_NOSTALGIA_000_125: We've been with Oblivion for three years, and our main duties are surveillance and provisioning.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_126: Twins, eh? That explains the resemblance. Wayakkwe is a Tonawawtan name, unless I'm mistaken?
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_NOSTALGIA_000_127: That's right. Our mother is Tuliyollan and our father is Alexandrian. They wanted to honor both cultures.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WAYAKKWE_000_129: Th-Thank you. Though I have no memories of my mother, I like to think I carry a part of her with me.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_130: So, what made you decide to join Oblivion?
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_NOSTALGIA_000_131: We wanted to avenge our father.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_NOSTALGIA_000_132: Ambrose was his name, and years ago, he was taken away after a scuffle with a soldier over a disagreement.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_NOSTALGIA_000_133: It was a minor incident, so at first we clung to the hope that he'd be released. But when months went by with no word from or about him, we made the decision to remove our regulators.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_NOSTALGIA_000_134: We had already lost the memories of our mother. We didn't want to lose those of our father as well.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_NOSTALGIA_000_135: They've all forgotten about him now─everyone who had known him...
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_136: That bastard... Even here, he thinks nothing of his own people!
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_NOSTALGIA_000_137: Some time later, we were approached by a member of Oblivion. Hoping to get justice for our father, we joined the order.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_NOSTALGIA_000_138: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to darken the mood...
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_139: No, no, I appreciate you sharing this. Together, we'll avenge your father.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_NOSTALGIA_000_140: Thank you. Something tells me you have what it takes.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_NOSTALGIA_000_141: You introduce yourself too. Go on!
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WAYAKKWE_000_142: Um... It's pretty much the same story for me.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WAYAKKWE_000_143: And while mine is a Tonawawtan name, I haven't the faintest how things are outside the barrier.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WAYAKKWE_000_144: It's my dream to go and see it with my own eyes. Our mother's homeland.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_WUKLAMAT_000_145: Once peace is restored, you must come and visit. The wilds are beautiful, the food delicious, and everyone so nice. You'll love it!
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_GEODE_000_146: And that's us here. You'll meet others in the Backroom─that's our headquarters. Some of them are a little eccentric, but they have good hearts, all.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_GEODE_000_148: It isn't exactly my place to say this, but thank you for seeking out Cahciua. She talks about you so much, it's clear how important you are to her.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_GEODE_000_150: That's all. Be good to your mother while you still can, eh?
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_GEODE_000_151: Well, we'll let you go now. Feel free to use this hideout as you like.
TEXT_KINGME102_04933_ALISAIE_000_001: Nostalgia and Wayakkwe remind me of Alphinaud and myself. Similar but so very different. We should chat sometime, trade twin tales.
TEXT_KINGME102_04933_KRILE_000_005: It takes no small amount of courage to oppose Zoraal Ja and his army. The members of Oblivion must be driven indeed.
TEXT_KINGME102_04933_GRAHATIA_000_010: At long last, we're entering the tower! ...N-Not that I'm excited or anything. Not unduly.
TEXT_KINGME102_04933_ERENVILLE_000_015: Twelve help her if she's mentioned anything embarrassing.
TEXT_KINGME102_04933_WUKLAMAT_000_020: Right, Cahciua is waiting. Let's head to the tower.
TEXT_KINGME102_04933_CAHCIUA_000_031: If Queen Sphene has registered you as guests, you should be able to march right in.
TEXT_KINGME102_04933_CAHCIUA_000_033: Then you may have a swarm of Zoraal Ja's minions to deal with.
TEXT_KINGME102_04933_WUKLAMAT_000_034: Nothing for it but to see if Sphene has betrayed us, eh?
TEXT_KINGME102_04933_CAHCIUA_000_035: Thank you for your diligent service, friends. My companions and I would like to pass, if you'd be so kind?
TEXT_KINGME102_04933_ROBOTSENTRY04933_00: Outrunner guide unit identified. Registration number...verified.
Six accompanying civilians identified. Verifying credentials...
Credentials verified. Welcome, guests of Queen Sphene.
TEXT_KINGME102_04933_CAHCIUA_000_040: There you have it. It seems the queen was true to her word.
TEXT_KINGME102_04933_CAHCIUA_000_041: Follow me, everyone. Solution Nine awaits!
TEXT_KINGME102_04933_WUKLAMAT_000_060: Towers inside a tower... I see it but I still can't believe it...
TEXT_KINGME102_04933_WUKLAMAT_000_061: Hmm... For now, I say we proceed straight ahead! If we feel like we're getting lost, we can always turn around and go back the way we came.
TEXT_KINGME102_04933_WUKLAMAT_000_070: Ugh, a crossroads already? This place is too much... I've no idea where I should go...
TEXT_KINGME102_04933_WUKLAMAT_000_071: Right, I've made up my mind! Let's head to that building there!
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_001: With Sphene as our guide, we needn't fear getting lost!
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_011: I must say I'm really grateful. This place is so vast and confusing, I didn't even know where to begin.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_012: While the district may seem daunting in size and structure, all the key facilities are situated near leynodes─what you call aetherytes. Remember this and you won't lose your way.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_013: Now then, seeing as it is right here, I will show you the Nexus Arcade first.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_015: This complex is home to all manner of shops. From food and daily necessities to technological conveniences, you can find most everything here.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_016: Everkeep's interior is vast, as you've observed. This arcade makes it possible for people to acquire what they need in one centralized location.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_018: How do you get to the upper levels? I don't see stairs...
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_019: Do you see the glowing pattern over yonder? That is an automatic conveyor.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_020: Such contraptions are found throughout Everkeep, allowing us to swiftly move between faraway places.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_021: That will spare us some walking. Are they also made from that strange metal? Elec...whatsit.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_022: <chuckle> Yes, the conveyors are powered by electrope.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_023: As a matter of fact, the ore is integrated into just about everything in Everkeep. Even the floors and walls.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_024: By etching arcane circuits upon it, electrope can be used to convert lightning energy to those of other elements.
