TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_025: In so doing, we can achieve various effects. For instance, a conversion to wind produces flotation, which is required for the propulsion of our flying vehicles.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_026: A conversion to fire, meanwhile, produces light and heat, and it is employed in devices such as street lamps and heaters. There are even self-heating cups that keep your drink warm.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_027: Can you make a drink cold if you convert to ice instead?
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_028: You certainly can! Our vending machines do just that.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_029: What's more, multiple energies can also be combined to produce some clever effects. For instance, by manipulating the air with wind while projecting light with lightning, it is possible to alter one's appearance.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_030: It's almost scary what you can do with electrope... If such a wondrous material existed in our world, I imagine everyone would be fighting over it.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_031: This shop over here─what does it sell?
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_032: Ah, yes. Let's go and take a look!
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_033: I daresay you will find it interesting.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_040: This shop sells food. Those are the items on the counter.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_041: That's food!? I can't imagine what they taste like...
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_042: <chuckle> I thought you might be surprised.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_043: Your countrymen were too in the beginning.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_100_043: Come, you must sample something. Choose one and I will purchase it.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_GANISTER_000_044: Welcome, friends! How lucky you are for Her Majesty to treat you!
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_GANISTER_000_045: The five items on display are our most popular. I recommend one of them if this is your first time.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SYSTEM_000_046: Select an item that interests you.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_GANISTER_000_047: The synthetic fruit pellets? They're our best approximation of the taste and texture of grape.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_GANISTER_000_048: I've never tried the real fruit so I can't say how faithful they are, but there's no denying their popularity.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_GANISTER_000_049: Ah, the revivifying tonic. I take it you're thirsty.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_GANISTER_000_050: The flavor is a sublime blend of sweet and salty, and it stays fresh for over ten years thanks to the special container.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_GANISTER_000_051: Keen on the perfect meal bar, are you? It's all the nutrients your body needs packed into a single foodstuff.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_GANISTER_000_052: The flavor is formulated to never taste dull, and one bar will satisfy you for a whole day. Many folks prefer this to taking multiple meals.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_GANISTER_000_053: Ah yes, the salad paste. This is designed for those who are concerned about their figure. With its blend of nine varieties of vegetables, it'll help your efforts to slim down.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_GANISTER_000_054: Fashion models swear by it, and youths can't get enough of the stuff either.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_GANISTER_000_055: This here is cultivated steak. It's not quite the same as the real thing they produce in the outskirts, but it's a sight more affordable.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_GANISTER_000_056: This particular product is known as “gold label,” and it's a delicious hybrid of beef and chicken grown at the plant on the fourth level.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_058: I'm going to have the steak. I'm absolutely starving!
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_100_059: I'm going to have the steak like you, . I'm absolutely starving!
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_GANISTER_000_059: Thank you for your custom. This being Her Majesty's treat, it's bound to taste all the better!
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_GANISTER_000_060: Say, would you mind sampling your selections here and now? It's been a long time since we had newcomers, and I'd love to see your reactions!
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_061: This is a great chance to learn about Alexandrian culture, . Let's dig in!
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SYSTEM_100_062: Following Wuk Lamat's lead, you sample your selection.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_062: A-Amazing! I've never had any meat like this before!
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_063: It's tender like chicken but flavorsome like rroneek, and the spices give it just the right amount of kick. I could eat this every day!
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_GANISTER_000_064: Hah, don't mind them. They're just happy to see your honest reaction.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_GANISTER_000_066: Hahaha! It's always such a pleasure! My thanks for humoring me.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_067: This does take me back. Though it was chaotic when the people of Tuliyollal first arrived, we endeavored to learn about one another and embraced our differences.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_068: Ah, right! What about you, Sphene? Aren't you having something to eat too?
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_069: I appreciate the thought, but I'm fine for now, thank you.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_070: Alright. But what's your favorite food, if you don't mind me asking?
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_072: ...Why do you wish to know this?
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_073: Because I want to get to know you better. Why else?
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_074: The more you know someone, the more you grow fond of them.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_075: That's what my old man believed, and my experiences have led me to believe the same.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_078: I'm sorry. It's just...when I think of those who labor to bring us the food, I find I can't settle on one thing...
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_079: Hahaha! I thought I was indecisive, but you're something else!
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_080: Indecisive...? Perhaps I am...but you didn't need to laugh about it...
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_085: My favorite food... That is a question I may never be able to answer.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_090: I don't know about you, but I'm satisfied. Let's keep moving!
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_091: Very well. Next, I was thinking of showing you the residential sector, but it's in part so I can tend to personal matters.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_092: It's a visitation, to be precise...and I believe it will be educational for you as well. Would the two of you mind accompanying me?
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_094: Wonderful. Let me know when you have seen enough here, and we'll make our way.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_095: I was just wondering what kind of homes they have here.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_100: Ready? Then let's head to the residential sector. It lies to the southwest.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_101: As we walk, I would be glad to tell you about any places of interest that we come upon.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SYSTEM_000_102: Sphene and Wuk Lamat are now accompanying you. Keep them at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SYSTEM_000_103: You can leave your quest companions behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with them and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SYSTEM_000_104: If you wish to have your companions join you again, return and speak with them at the original location.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_106: Lamaty'i trusts you without question. How nice it would be to have such a friend.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_107: That meat was sooo good... I have to get everyone at home to try it!
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SYSTEM_000_108: Are you sure you wish to part ways with your companions?
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_109: Of course. Take your time─we shall await you back at the Nexus Arcade.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_110: Have things you need to tend to? Alright, we'll look for you back at that arcade after you're done.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_111: Welcome back. If you are ready, then let us resume the tour.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_112: All sorted? Then let's get moving.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SYSTEM_000_113: Your companions have yet to arrive. Be sure they are at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_120: This is Mosaic, a café. Here you can buy drinks to enjoy while you relax.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_121: I see. In Tuliyollal, there's a similar establishment called Xbalyav Ty'e─that's “seashell” in the local tongue. Is there a story behind the name Mosaic?
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_122: There is. In our continent, the races are named for stones. There's the Hyune, who resemble some Tonawawta; the tall and graceful Eldite; and the diminutive and affable Milalla.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_123: When they all gather here, they appear as a mosaic of colors. Thus did the founder choose to name the café.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_124: Heh, that's nice. If they served tacos here, it'd be perfect!
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_126: A traditional Turali dish, and one of my favorite foods. You must try it one day!
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_128: We'll make it happen once we've restored peace to Tuliyollal. Right, let's continue on!
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_129: Have you eaten these...tacos before? For Lamaty'i to recommend them so highly, they must be delicious indeed.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_100_129: Let's go for some tacos at Xbalyav Ty'e, the three of us!
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_130: And here we are. These buildings are where our citizens live.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_131: They're massive! Each one is bigger than the palace!
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_132: They have to be, for just about all Alexandrians have apartments here.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_133: Lest you wonder, I'm here to visit some people. Their apartment is in the building on the left here at residential radius 9-14.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_135: That's right. Come, the door opens automatically.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_136: I do hope you like the district. The people worked hard to build it, paying attention to every little detail.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_100_137: You really get the sense that Sphene loves her nation, don't you?
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_137: This is the lobby, a common area for residents.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_138: I see... And what does that machine there do?
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_139: Ah, the concierge. They look after the residents. If you require assistance or have questions, they would be glad to assist.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_140: Is that so? I've no shortage of questions, but I'll direct them at you for now.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_141: By all means. You may consider me your personal concierge!
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_142: Hey, Sphene. Can anyone live in this place?
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_143: Naturally! In fact, many of your countrymen make their homes here.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_144: No matter your origin or race, occupation or regulator usage, all Alexandrian citizens are eligible for an apartment. This includes those you met who work in the outskirts.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_145: You've taken care of everyone for thirty years. I'm truly grateful.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_150: This is the place. A mother and son live here.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_153: I have friends with me today. Is that all right?
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_ISADORA_000_154: Of course! Friends of the queen are friends of ours. Please, make yourselves at home.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_ISADORA_000_156: There's been no change, but the symptoms are thankfully mild today.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_157: Hello, Milos. Have you missed me?
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_ISADORA_000_158: My son was born with levin sickness─a severe aetheric imbalance towards lightning.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_ISADORA_000_159: As a result, he suffers from paralysis. He cannot walk and struggles to speak.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_ISADORA_000_160: For a blessing, he still has his hearing, and even on bad days he can communicate with his eyes.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_161: I see... Sphene visits often, does she?
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_ISADORA_000_162: She does. Milos simply adores her. He sometimes even manages a smile when she's here.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_163: What of yourself, Isadora? How are you holding up?
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_ISADORA_000_164: You needn't worry about me, Your Majesty. You always make time for us, and we have everything we need.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_165: I'm glad to hear that. But you mustn't strain yourself, understood?
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_166: There is nothing you can do for him? Perhaps a treatment with souls or...
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_167: Unfortunately no. While souls can revive those who have met with an accident, they cannot reverse the effects of old age and illness.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_168: Truth be told, many children are born like Milos. The illness has existed for generations, but we've been unable to find a cure.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_169: The cause is quite clear, though─the excess lightning in the environment. It's no coincidence the number of cases has risen dramatically these past thirty years.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_172: I'm sorry, Isadora, but I must be going. I promise to make it a proper visit next time, with treats to share.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_ISADORA_000_173: There's no need to apologize, Your Majesty. If it weren't for you, Milos and I wouldn't still be here.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_175: It's my pleasure, Milos. I'll be back soon, so be a good boy. For your mother and for me.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_WUKLAMAT_000_180: To think that there was such an illness...
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_190: My thanks for accompanying me on the visit.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_191: The illness is a part of life in Alexandria, and I thought that you should know about it.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SPHENE_000_192: We'll find a cure one day, mark my words. We'll make it so unfortunate children like Milos smile again.
TEXT_KINGME104_04935_WUKLAMAT_000_001: To think that they had such a problem...
TEXT_KINGME104_04935_SPHENE_000_010: Well, let's continue the tour, shall we?
TEXT_KINGME104_04935_WUKLAMAT_000_011: Look, you obviously have duties to attend to─citizens to look after. We can stop here if you like.
TEXT_KINGME104_04935_SPHENE_000_012: No, no. I do this because I want to, so please do not worry.
TEXT_KINGME104_04935_SPHENE_000_013: Next, I'll show you one of the district's most vital facilities, a place called Resolution. To reach it, we'll need to go by way of leynode nine, where the aetheryte is situated.
TEXT_KINGME104_04935_WUKLAMAT_000_015: <gulp> D-Don't tell me we need to use that now?
TEXT_KINGME104_04935_SPHENE_000_020: The conveyor ahead will transport you to the government sector, where Resolution is located.
TEXT_KINGME104_04935_SPHENE_000_021: The markings on a conveyor indicate its direction, and there is a pair just like it on the other side.
TEXT_KINGME104_04935_SPHENE_000_023: Extremely. There's no need to be afraid.
TEXT_KINGME104_04935_WUKLAMAT_000_024: Wh-Who said I was afraid? Come on, !
TEXT_KINGME104_04935_WUKLAMAT_000_025: N-Nothing to it, eh? A child's amusement ride!
TEXT_KINGME104_04935_SPHENE_000_030: And here we are─Resolution, the operational heart of Solution Nine.
TEXT_KINGME104_04935_SPHENE_000_031: From Resolution we oversee the running of the district and provide essential services to citizens, such as welfare support and job introductions.
TEXT_KINGME104_04935_SPHENE_000_032: It's quicker to show than tell, so let's proceed inside.
TEXT_KINGME104_04935_WUKLAMAT_000_035: What was Sphene wanting to tell us, I wonder...
TEXT_KINGME104_04935_WUKLAMAT_000_036: Well, it can wait for another time. We've been exploring for a while now and should probably go to Cahciua's meeting point.
TEXT_KINGME104_04935_WUKLAMAT_000_037: That'll be back the way we came...I think?
TEXT_KINGME104_04935_WUKLAMAT_000_040: Sphene genuinely cares for her people. I can respect her for that.
TEXT_KINGME104_04935_WUKLAMAT_000_041: And thanks to her tour, I've come to better understand the lives of Alexandrians.
TEXT_KINGME104_04935_WUKLAMAT_000_042: They don't feel so strange and distant anymore.
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_001: So, we're supposed to go to a place called True Vue, in the eastern sector. This conveyor ought to take us there.
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_002: You know, once you get used to it, they're actually kind of fun. Come on, !
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_010: This is the right place, you think?
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_011: I don't see the others, though...
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_012: Well, rather than sitting and waiting, we might as well explore a bit more.
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_014: A Mamool Ja child... What are they doing here?
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_015: You noticed too, right? The resemblance to Zoraal Ja.
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_016: The blue scales of a Boonewa with the features of a Hoobigo...
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_018: At any rate, it wouldn't do to leave such a small child on their own.
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_019: Come on, let's go after them!
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_100_019: I think they ran this way...
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_020: So this is True Vue. I'm not sure what I'm looking at, but it does seem lively!
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_021: That building's just about the only one that isn't lit up. Not open for business at the moment, I guess?
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_024: Listen, we don't mean you any harm. We just want to talk.
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_025: It's a bit odd, don't you think? They run off when we approach, only to suddenly reappear...
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_026: Could it be they want to take us somewhere?
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_027: Is that the way of it? You want us to follow you?
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_028: So it is! Alright, then, lead the way!
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_030: Let's see where they take us.
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_SYSTEM_000_041: Once you choose to depart, Wuk Lamat will accompany you. The blue-scaled Hoobigo child will then begin moving towards the destination.
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_SYSTEM_000_042: Make your way to the destination without falling behind.
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_SYSTEM_000_043: If you leave Wuk Lamat behind for any reason, or lose sight of the blue-scaled Hoobigo child, you may try again by returning to the starting point.
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_100_044: Let's try not to lose sight of them this time!
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_Q2_000_000: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Wuk Lamat?
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_100_045: Hm? Alexandrian food not agreeing with your stomach? Alright, I'll let the little one know you need some time. We'll wait for you back where we started.
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_SYSTEM_110_045: Wuk Lamat has yet to arrive. Be sure she is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_120_045: Damn it, we've lost them! Probably best to return to where we started...
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_SYSTEM_130_045: Speak with the blue-scaled Hoobigo child in the recreation zone to try again.
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_SYSTEM_000_046: Once you choose to depart, Wuk Lamat will accompany you. The blue-scaled Hoobigo child will then begin moving towards the destination.
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_050: Is this where you wanted to bring us?
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_051: What is this place? If you're meant to relax here, it isn't working for me...
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_053: So you're still not inclined to talk...
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_MELANCHOLY_000_054: He'll only talk if he's completely comfortable with you.
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_MELANCHOLY_000_056: After a fashion. But never mind that. How about something to wet your whistle?
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_MELANCHOLY_000_057: Adorable as you are, it's on the house. I can recommend our special─Her Majesty. I'll prepare one without liquor for the boy, too.
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_058: Uh, thanks, but no thanks. We're supposed to meet a friend named Cahciua.
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_059: But we ran into the child on the way, and he led us here.
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_MELANCHOLY_000_061: In that case, go and have a chat with big Tassos there. He'll show you to a fun place.
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_MELANCHOLY_000_063: I don't think he's in a mood to talk, so he can tend the bar with me.
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_064: This has taken a turn for the strange, but you don't think we're walking into a trap, do you?
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_065: Damned if this doesn't have suspicious written all over it...
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_MELANCHOLY_000_070: If you feel like that drink after all, just let me know.
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_TASSOS_000_080: You seem eager to go, but what about your friend there?
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_090: What is this “fun place” meant to be? Is Cahciua there?
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_WUKLAMAT_000_091: Well, I suppose there's only one way to find out...
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_WUKLAMAT_000_005: Come on, let's talk to this Tassos fellow.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_TASSOS_000_010: This area's normally off-limits, but Cahciua's told us about you.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_TASSOS_000_011: Just follow the corridor, and head into the room at the end.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_WUKLAMAT_000_012: Let's go, . Whatever happens, you won't catch me being surprised!
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_WUKLAMAT_000_015: When I go on the attack, do you think I'm pushing forward too quickly?
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_ALISAIE_000_020: A little. Try to keep closer to the rest of us so you don't get surrounded.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_CAHCIUA_000_025: This place was originally designed by a Preservation engineer. That's why it's wall-to-wall with contraptions.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_GENOLT_000_060: Sorry ye had to see me passions spillin' over. Happens when ye put yer heart an' soul into yer craft, ye know?
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_GENOLT_000_061: An' not to be weird or nothin', but I felt a sense o' kinship when I saw ye. As if we've met in another life...
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_GENOLT_000_062: Anyroad! As I was sayin', I need someone to lend me a hand.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_GENOLT_000_063: I haven't slept fer two nights now─not a single wink─an' I'm ripe to collapse.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_GENOLT_000_064: Can't afford to, though─got folks relyin' on me, see. But if I'm to keep at it, I need ye to fetch me my favorite energy tonic.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_GENOLT_000_065: That voucher's good fer two cans─one fer yerself by way o' welcome.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_GENOLT_000_066: Can't get the stuff at any old vendin' machine, though. Ye need to talk to a bloke named Philomon. You'll find him tendin' a bar out on the main strip. Off ye go, now!
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_GENOLT_000_070: Gah, damn it all! It's such a fine-looking beauty in the blueprint─why doesn't mine look like that!?
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_PHILOMON_000_080: Energy tonics you can't get from vending machines!? How dare you suggest that I sell such dangerous stuff!
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_PHILOMON_000_081: Away with you! Away with you, and don't come back!
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_PHILOMON_000_082: ...Ahem. Got a voucher? Slip it to me, then. Nice and subtle.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_PHILOMON_000_090: Ah, so you're collecting for Genolt. A can for him and a can for you, eh?
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_PHILOMON_000_091: Here you go. Yours is formulated for beginners. Gentler than the full-strength stuff.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_PHILOMON_000_092: It's not contraband or anything, so you won't run afoul of the authorities. But if the Rhodina Consortium was made aware of my special selection, it'd be bad for business.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_PHILOMON_000_093: Now, seeing as it's your first time, I want you to drink your tonic here. Just in case there're side effects.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_PHILOMON_000_095: Bottoms up, now. Need to make sure it doesn't affect you in any unintended ways.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_SYSTEM_000_100: Philomon requires that you drink the tonic in front of him, presumably so he can render aid should something go awry...
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_SYSTEM_000_101: You drain the tonic in a single pull!
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_PHILOMON_000_102: Heh, now that's how you do it!
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_PHILOMON_100_102: Your pulse ought to quicken soon, after which you'll start to see everything more clearly. And then, finally, you'll feel a roaring surge of energy.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_PHILOMON_100_103: People say it's like growing a pair of rainbow wings!
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_PHILOMON_000_104: Well, you haven't up and carked it, so hurry along and give Genolt his tonic. He tends to leave it to the last moment, and I expect he's about to keel over.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_WUKLAMAT_000_106: We're learning about regulators at the moment! How's your errand coming along?
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_CAHCIUA_000_107: What do you think of the crew here? An interesting bunch, right? I personally recruited Genolt and Shale, by the way.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_ALISAIE_000_108: Is it just me, or are there rainbows in your eyes?
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_ERENVILLE_000_109: Nary a moment goes by without Genolt moaning and grunting. I presume it's how he expresses his passion for his work.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_GENOLT_000_110: Ye've got the tonic? Give it here, quick!
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_GENOLT_000_111: Ahhhhhh, that's the stuff! Ain't nothin' like it to blow the cobwebs right out─with a great big kaboom!
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_GENOLT_000_112: Awakens something feral in me, it does. Transforms me into a remorseless beast what won't stop till it's done what it was born to do!
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_GENOLT_000_113: Anyroad, sorry for sendin' ye off on an' errand like that. I just can't concentrate without me tonic, ye know? An' the pile o' work only ever gets bigger.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_GENOLT_000_114: Speakin' o' which, I better get back to it! Those weapons an' tools ain't goin' to enhance themselves!
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_GENOLT_000_120: Ahahaha! It begins! Mine's the clarity, mine's the precision!
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_ALISAIE_000_015: Regardless of the circumstances, Zoraal Ja is Gulool Ja's father. The boy is bound to be confused.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_020: If Gulool Ja is outside the tower, we need to find him as quickly as possible!
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_021: Even if he's used to getting around on his own, the wilds are still no place for a child.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_ALISAIE_000_022: Agreed. While Krile and Raha continue reviewing the data, the three of us should devote ourselves to the search.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_023: Alright, let's head to the base of the tower and take it from there!
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_ALISAIE_000_025: Heritage Found is a large area. Splitting up would allow us to cover more ground.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_030: Well, here we are outside, but where do we even begin?
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_ALISAIE_000_031: Perhaps someone has caught sight of Gulool Ja. Let's make inquiries nearby.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_032: Good idea. Could you handle the outskirts, Alisaie?
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_033: In the meantime,  and I will head beyond that big wall.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_035: Where have you gone, little one...?
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_SYSTEM_000_040: Gulool Ja doesn't appear to be in the area. However, you catch sight of a group of people a short distance to the southwest.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_041: You spotted those people too, yes? Perhaps they've seen something. Come on.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_TAAPU_000_045: Hm... I'm not familiar with your footfalls.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_050: Looks like some sort of salvage yard... Well, let's ask after Gulool Ja.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_052: You know the boy? Have you seen him?
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_053: Oh. Forgive me, I didn't know you were...
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_TAAPU_000_054: No offense taken. My name is Taapu. My eyes may be useless, but my ears are sharper for it. I can recognize people by their footfalls, including Gulool Ja.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_055: So he didn't come this way... Where in the world could he be?
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_TAAPU_000_056: I do not know your voices. Who are you to Gulool Ja, and why do you search for him?
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_057: I'm...family. Though we're not related by blood, his father is my brother.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_058: I've only just met Gulool Ja, and we haven't had the chance to talk properly.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_059: But I'm about to do something that will make him hate me, and I wanted the chance to explain.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_TAAPU_000_060: His father is your brother? Then that means you're...
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_061: Yes. I'm Wuk Lamat, Vow of Resolve of Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_062: And I've journeyed here to bring my brother Zoraal Ja to account for murdering our people and our father.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_063: When all is said and done, Gulool Ja may want nothing to do with me.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_064: Nonetheless, I'll always consider him family. I'll always be there for him, and I want him to know that.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_TAAPU_000_065: It tears you apart to do what you must. The quiver in your voice tells the tale.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_TAAPU_000_066: Gulool Ja was headed south. There, he has a place that is as close to a home as he knows.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_TAAPU_000_067: Find and bare your heart to him.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_TAAPU_000_068: Should he in turn bare his heart to you, accept and respect his wishes. As Queen Sphene respected ours when she granted us a place in her realm.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_110_068: But, uh...what do you mean when you say Sphene respected your wishes?
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_TAAPU_120_068: Out of concern for our well-being, Her Majesty had urged us to reside inside Everkeep.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_TAAPU_130_068: When we declined, not only did she gracefully accept our decision─she granted us the necessary supplies to make our home here.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_TAAPU_140_068: And since then, she has paid us regular visits to see how we fare.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_150_068: Heh, that sounds like Sphene alright...
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_069: Well, thanks for telling me about Gulool Ja. I'll find him, and then we'll have a good talk.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_070: We continue south, it seems. Let's keep our eyes peeled as we make our way.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_TAAPU_000_075: Gulool Ja appears to prefer solitude, but deep down he is lonely. Small wonder given his abandonment.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_TAAPU_000_080: Take good care of him, will you? I myself am quite fond of the boy.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_091: And half of it is submerged!
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_092: The architecture looks nothing like what we've seen so far. It's more...Sharlayan.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_093: Ah! There he is, among the ruins!
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_094: I only caught a glimpse, but there's no mistaking that tiny silhouette.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_WUKLAMAT_000_095: Let's hurry after him. It'd be a disaster if a building collapsed while he's inside!
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_WUKLAMAT_000_001: I only saw him for a moment before he disappeared behind a building, but I'm pretty sure Gulool Ja was heading further south.
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_WUKLAMAT_000_002: I'll contact Alisaie on linkpearl and let her know to join us.
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_WUKLAMAT_000_003: This is the area, but the canals and the debris make it hard to get a good view...
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_WUKLAMAT_000_004: Let's split up and search. If you could head into the canals, I'll make my way through the streets.
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_WUKLAMAT_100_004: When we find Gulool Ja, let's watch from a distance until he gets to his destination. Wouldn't want to startle him and cause an accident.
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_WUKLAMAT_000_005: Alisaie is coming as fast as she can. Let's keep searching in the meantime.
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_SYSTEM_000_010: You have located Gulool Ja. Follow him quietly without being noticed.
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_SYSTEM_000_011: Follow Gulool Ja from a safe distance. The objective will end in failure if you are noticed, or if you fall too far behind.
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_SYSTEM_000_012: Should you fail to complete the objective, you may try again by surveying the designated location.
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_WUKLAMAT_000_020: He spoke to us! Gulool Ja actually spoke to us!
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_ALISAIE_000_025: If Otis has been around for as long as he claims, perhaps he knows things that not even Oblivion is aware of.
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_OTIS_000_040: So, my new friends! I would enlist your aid in procuring the ingredients for our repast.
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_OTIS_000_041: After all, the most enjoyable meals are those we make together!
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_WUKLAMAT_000_042: We're happy to pitch in, of course. What ingredients did you have in mind?
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_OTIS_000_043: First of all, some yam and pumpkin. The people of the outskirts should be willing to share their harvest, if you and Gulool Ja could go and speak to them.
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_GULOOLJA_000_044: Sure. I'll ask for the castoffs too, as usual.
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_OTIS_000_045: As for  and Alisaie, I would be obliged if you could procure some woolback meat.
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_OTIS_000_046: The creatures can be found grazing on the slopes outside of town. As beef is less readily available, their flesh makes for a good substitute─that of the younger ones especially, as it is more tender and less gamy.
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_ALISAIE_000_047: Consider it done. We'll be back with the meat before you know it!
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_OTIS_000_048: Thank you kindly! In the meantime, I shall see to other preparations.
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_OTIS_000_050: Hahaha! There is nothing so fine as a meal with friends old and new!
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_ALISAIE_000_055: Say, why don't we make a contest out of it? Whoever delivers the meat first is the winner!
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_ALISAIE_000_060: You haven't finished yet, right? That would be too fast, even for you!
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_OTIS_000_070: What's this? Am I to understand that you have already procured the meat?
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_OTIS_000_071: Good heavens, you have─and such a choice cut it is besides!
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_OTIS_000_072: 'Tis plain you know how to handle yourself in battle. Were it four hundred years ago, I would have recruited you to the royal knights. Hahaha!
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_ALISAIE_000_000: You haven't finished yet, right? That would be too fast, even for you!
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_001: Once Alisaie brings her portion, we shall have a glorious bounty to satisfy growing younglings like yourselves!
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_002: Indeed, I expect there will be ample leftovers to share with the good folk of the driftdowns. They always appreciate a warm meal.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_003: Now, seeing as you have completed your task so quickly, I have another request to make of you. We've exhausted our supplies of kindling electrope, and I should be grateful if you could search the houses yonder for more.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_004: In the old kingdom, electrope rations were issued to each citizen. While small, fragments may still be found here and there.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_005: If you can obtain five pieces, say, at least one ought to be what we require─that is, the kind that converts lightning to fire. Gulool Ja can identify them by their circuitry, so pray take them to him.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_006: The boy has become quite deft at discerning electrope types, and in a very short time, I might add. Now, off you go, and happy foraging!
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_010: Of late, my arms and legs have grown somewhat creaky and uncooperative. A few centuries will do that even to the best of us, I suppose! Hahaha!
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_020: The others have returned as well. What a blessedly lively day this has become!
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_WUKLAMAT_000_021: We've got the requested vegetables, along with a few extra bits! I have to say, all this running around's made me hungry...
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_ALISAIE_000_022: Hmph, I dared to think I had won this time, but it turns out you were already off doing another task.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_GULOOLJA_000_030: Otis says you have electrope for me?
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_GULOOLJA_000_032: Let's see... This one creates wind, this one is for water...
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_ALISAIE_000_033: You can tell just like that? I'm impressed.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_WUKLAMAT_000_034: Clever, isn't he? I'll bet he gets it from his father...
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_GULOOLJA_000_035: Ah, this is it! This converts to fire!
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_GULOOLJA_000_036: It's absorbed lots of lightning, so we should be able to kindle a flame easily.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_WUKLAMAT_000_040: Hehe... It makes me happy to see Gulool Ja happy.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_GULOOLJA_000_041: Wuk Lamat could carry lots of vegetables at once. She's really strong!
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_ALISAIE_000_042: With apologies to Erenville and Krile, let's enjoy the meal!
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_045: Thanks to your kind assistance, we have everything we need for our repast.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_046: You have done your part, and now I shall do mine. I bid you relax, my friends─the meal will soon be served!
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_WUKLAMAT_000_050: This is the kind of thing families do, Gulool Ja. We have meals together and talk about what's on our minds.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_GULOOLJA_000_051: So you ate with your father?
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_WUKLAMAT_000_052: Yes, with them and my brothers. It was mostly the Head of Resolve and I doing the talking, though. Koana and the Head of Reason occasionally joined in, and Zoraal Ja...spoke when he was spoken to.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_GULOOLJA_000_053: You said that you have two papas. Does that mean one is yours, and the other is my father's?
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_WUKLAMAT_000_054: No, no, both are our father. He's what people call blessed siblings─a Mamool Ja with two heads.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_WUKLAMAT_000_055: Zoraal Ja is his trueborn child, while Koana and I were adopted and don't share the same blood.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_WUKLAMAT_000_056: But that doesn't make us any less a family. What matters is that our hearts are connected. The Head of Resolve taught me that.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_GULOOLJA_000_058: Do you have someone like that too? A person you think is family, even though you don't share the same blood.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_A1_000_062: I do, and they're very dear to me.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_A1_000_063: I'm something of a lone wolf.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_GULOOLJA_000_065: I'd like to meet them one day.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_GULOOLJA_000_066: You must be strong. I don't think I could be alone like that for long.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_GULOOLJA_000_067: I-I'm sorry if I said something wrong...
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_WUKLAMAT_000_069: So, Gulool Ja. I'm hoping that we could be family, you and I.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_WUKLAMAT_000_070: Won't you tell me about yourself?
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_GULOOLJA_000_071: You...really want to know about me?
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_WUKLAMAT_000_072: I do. I want to know all about you. The things you love, the things you hate─anything and everything.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_GULOOLJA_000_073: I want to know all about you too!
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_ALISAIE_000_074: That reminds me, we were hoping to hear your story too, Otis.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_075: As you wish. Be forewarned that mine is a tale that will be long in recounting.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_076: It was before lightning had altered the world that I was appointed lord captain of the royal knights.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_WUKLAMAT_000_077: We're talking hundreds of years prior to the calamity, right?
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_078: Indeed. Earlier still than when I assumed this mechanical form─four hundred and fifty-four years ago, to be precise.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_ALISAIE_000_079: Then...you used to be a normal person?
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_080: Oh yes. I was once flesh and blood, like you, and I proudly served as a knight of Alexandria.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_WUKLAMAT_000_081: So rather than a machine that behaves like a person, you were─are an actual person? How is this possible?
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_082: 'Tis only natural that you are confused. Hear my tale to the end, and all shall become clear.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_083: The foremost duty of the royal knights was the protection of the royal family. In my time, that was Their Majesties the King and Queen, and their only child, Her Highness the Princess.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_084: By then, every nation of our star was embroiled in some manner of conflict over electrope. Thus was our kingdom drawn into a war with its neighbor.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_085: That war was the catalyst for the great calamity that altered the environment. Countless countrymen lost their lives amidst the chaos, the king and queen among them.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_086: For a blessing, we were able to protect the princess, who then rose to the occasion and brought hope to her people in those trying times. So kind-hearted was our young queen that, at her behest, we even took in refugees from the enemy nation.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_087: But sadly, her reign was cut short. Like many others, her body had been ravaged by lightning, and one day she collapsed and passed away...
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_089: Aye... Nary was there a citizen whose eyes remained dry, and many a moon was spent constructing a great tomb worthy of her memory.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_090: Yet I clung to hope still. For while Her Majesty was on her deathbed, the kingdom's finest scientists had successfully extracted her soul.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_WUKLAMAT_000_091: Did we hear that right? Extracted her soul?
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_092: Our flesh may wither and die. But so long as we are remembered, we may live on.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_093: This age-old belief had always comforted our people. But as casualties mounted in the wake of the calamity, we sought to make it into reality through the power of electrope.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_094: In time, we succeeded in developing the means to preserve the soul, and it was used to spare the queen eternal death.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_095: Yet it wasn't enough to simply prevent the soul's departure. For the ultimate goal was to recreate a person as they were in life, and this required that their memories be further extracted from their soul.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_096: It took many more years of research to make this possible, by which time I had become a grey old man. With my days numbered, I did not hesitate to volunteer myself as a test subject for the procedure.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_097: So it was that I attained this vessel.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_098: And by my successful rebirth, I paved the way for those who are recreated from the memories of the departed.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_ALISAIE_000_100: If your tale is true, then the queen that your people brought back to life...
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_A2_000_102: It wouldn't be Sphene, would it?
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_A2_000_103: I think we know who it is.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_104: Oho, so you know Her Majesty as well!
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_105: My description of her boundless kindness must have paled in comparison to what you no doubt felt in her presence.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_106: I haven't met her myself, I confess. Not since assuming my current form. Wouldn't want to frighten the living daylights out of her!
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_110: I have seen my queen from afar many times. But I've not the courage to approach her...
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_111: This isn't out of cowardice, mind you, but rather...concern. Yes, concern that I would cause Her Majesty undue distress!
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_GULOOLJA_000_115: Otis has told me the tale before.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_ALISAIE_000_120: Does this mean the queen of Alexandria isn't actually a person like you and me...?
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_WUKLAMAT_000_130: The Endless... So all this time, Sphene wasn't alive?
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_131: She lives yet she does not. 'Tis admittedly a difficult distinction to make.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_132: Having inherited the memories of a departed soul, an Endless feels, thinks, and acts precisely as that person would.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_133: In that sense, I believe they are alive.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_ALISAIE_000_134: The Alexandrians know about this, right? It can't have gone unnoticed that Sphene is perpetually youthful.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_GULOOLJA_000_135: No one really knows about the Endless. People who wear regulators don't even think about death.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_GULOOLJA_000_136: Everyone sees that the queen doesn't change, but they just accept it.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_GULOOLJA_000_137: To them, it's just who she is.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_A1_000_001: Are there Endless apart from yourselves?
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_A1_000_002: Are the people at Everkeep Endless too?
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_139: While there should be as many Endless as those who have died, I believe they are limited in where they can exist. Queen Sphene is unique in her ability to appear before you.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_140: Strictly speaking, I myself am not an Endless. They are created using memories extracted from a soul, but my entire soul was placed inside a machine.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_WUKLAMAT_000_141: Being inside a machine makes you different...how?
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_OTIS_000_142: While I do not understand the finer points, my life is bound to this vessel. If it breaks down, then it would be over for me, much like a being of flesh and blood. Hardly an endless, unchanging life, I'm sure you'll agree!
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_ALISAIE_000_143: An endless, unchanging life... I can't help but be reminded of the Ea.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_WUKLAMAT_000_144: Did Cahciua and the others know about all this?
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_ALISAIE_000_145: Considering their extensive intelligence gathering, I'd be surprised if they didn't.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_ALISAIE_000_146: For now, let's share what we've learned with Krile and Raha. I can't help but have misgivings about this...
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_000_001: We'll have to ask Cahciua what she knows. And if she's been hiding things from us, we need to know why.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_ALISAIE_000_005: As many Endless as those who have died... So where are they? And how have they been “living” up until now?
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_GULOOLJA_000_010: Why are you all making those serious faces...?
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_OTIS_000_020: Although the mood became a tad subdued at the end, I thoroughly enjoyed our repast together!
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_000_021: We did too, Otis. To hear about the Endless was something of a shock, but we likewise enjoyed your company.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_000_022: Above all, I'm glad that you and I could talk, Gulool Ja. We're going to get along great, I just know it!
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_OTIS_000_024: Hahaha! I'm happy for you, my boy!
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_OTIS_000_025: Now then, I presume you will be returning to Everkeep. Permit me to accompany you at least a part of the way.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_000_031: It doesn't matter to me if she's an Endless. Whether she's “alive” like you and me or not.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_000_032: I've seen enough to know that she has a good heart.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_000_033: What worries me is the burden she bears. We still don't know what it is.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_000_034: I expect there are things she can't tell us. Not with Zoraal Ja watching. But at the very least, I'd like to know what the Endless are to her.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_000_035: ...Sorry, I didn't mean to delay us. I just felt the urge to share my thoughts with you.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_000_036: Oh, on the way back, let's make a quick stop at the driftdowns. I want to tell Taapu how it went.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_000_037: Gods, but that yam stew was good...
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_TAAPU_000_038: Ah, you are returned. Were you able to find Gulool Ja?
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_000_039: We were thanks to you. All's well with the boy.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_TAAPU_110_039: And to know that he has family who worries for him. Gulool Ja too must be glad.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_120_039: Heh, I hope so. I'll try not to rush or force anything, though. It's for him to decide what I am to him.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_SPHENE_130_039: My, what a pleasant surprise it is to meet you in these parts.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_140_039: Sphene! What are you doing here?
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_SPHENE_150_039: Visiting my people. Are you doing the same, perchance?
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_170_039: Listen, there's something we'd like to talk to you about. Could we have a word in private?
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_SPHENE_190_039: While we may not discuss it openly, my people will have surely noticed that I haven't changed for hundreds of years. I've made no attempt to conceal my nature.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_SPHENE_200_039: If I may ask, though, who was it that told you about the Endless? Only a few should be familiar with the concept.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_SPHENE_220_039: I bear no ill will towards this mystery individual, lest that be your concern. I'm merely curious.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_230_039: Tell me, Sphene. You care for your people, that much is plain. And I assume you care for the Endless too.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_240_039: Earlier, in Everkeep, there was something that you wanted to tell us. Was it to do with them?
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_SPHENE_250_039: The Endless are as dear to me as my living citizens. They are as much my family.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_SPHENE_260_039: But they can only be sustained by meeting certain exacting requirements. Thus far we've managed to do so, but should more people die, I fear we would be pushed beyond our limit.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_SPHENE_270_039: Their preservation demands vast amounts of energy...
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_280_039: Energy? I don't understand the workings of it all, but is there something we can do to help?
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_SPHENE_300_039: Would you be willing to become Alexandrian citizens?
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_310_039: Wh-What!? I have my nation─my people─to protect. I can't just become Alexandrian...
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_330_039: First you tell us to make peace, then you tell us to go home... What exactly is it that you want?
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_SPHENE_340_039: The same as you, of course. To protect my people.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_A1_000_001: Tell us more about the energy the Endless need.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_A1_000_002: Is there something that only Zoraal Ja can do?
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_SPHENE_350_039: That...I cannot say. I do not ask that you understand or like me. But I wish...
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_SPHENE_360_039: I wish we had been born on the same side of it.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_370_039: Hey, what do you mean by that? Wait! Sphene!
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_390_039: Well, I think we've kept everyone waiting long enough. Let's continue on to Everkeep.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_400_039: And let's not tell Otis about our conversation with Sphene. I don't want to risk causing him pain.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_000_040: I've gone ahead and apologized for us.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_ALISAIE_000_045: A lot has happened, but the important thing is Gulool Ja is safe and well. Cahciua has been worried, so let's hurry back.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_GULOOLJA_000_050: Eating together was fun. I hope we can do it again.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_TAAPU_000_055: Thank you for stopping by to share the news. It gladdens me to know that Gulool Ja is in good hands.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_ALISAIE_000_060: Lamaty'i is right. Let's have faith in everyone and do what we can.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_000_070: This is the moment of truth. We have to hold Zoraal Ja here.
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_WUKLAMAT_000_071: And I know exactly how to do that!
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_ALISAIE_000_001: Lamaty'i is right. Let's have faith in everyone and do what we can.
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_SYSTEM_000_010: Upon speaking with Wuk Lamat, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_SYSTEM_000_011: It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_WUKLAMAT_000_012: Before we get going, I have a request to make of you.
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_WUKLAMAT_000_013: When we confront Zoraal Ja, you must let me face him alone.
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_ALISAIE_000_014: What!? No, that's far too dangerous! Why put you at such risk if we don't have to?
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_WUKLAMAT_000_016: The first is to hold Zoraal Ja within the dome and protect Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_WUKLAMAT_100_016: The second is to free Wayakkwe if she's been captured.
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_WUKLAMAT_000_017: To make sure we succeed, I need to play the worthy foe for Zoraal Ja.
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_WUKLAMAT_000_018: If I come at him with help, he'll likely lose interest and proceed with his attack on the city. That's why it needs to be a duel.
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_ALISAIE_000_019: Even if Tuliyollal is better prepared this time, it's true that it would be best to avoid another battle. And failing that, we might at least weaken Zoraal Ja...
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_WUKLAMAT_000_020: Rest assured I'm not going into this without a strategy. Our time in the dome has given us invaluable insights into Alexandrian culture.
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_WUKLAMAT_000_021: The use of regulators, for one. The secret to Zoraal Ja's strength.
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_WUKLAMAT_000_023: That's right. If I destroy his regulator, he'll be unable to draw upon souls. We'll see how much he wants a duel after that.
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_WUKLAMAT_000_024: So, will you leave Zoraal Ja to me?
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_A1_000_002: It's nothing the Vow of Resolve can't handle!
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_ALISAIE_000_027: It's true that this is your fight, and how you choose to handle it is your decision.
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_ALISAIE_000_028: But if we see you struggling, or Zoraal Ja attempts to call upon his minions, we will go to your aid!
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_WUKLAMAT_000_029: Heh, fair enough! Knowing you'll be there, I can give it my all.
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_WUKLAMAT_000_030: Together with Koana, I'll keep Tuliyollal safe!
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_ALISAIE_000_035: That he should take his own child hostage...
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_WUKLAMAT_000_040: We must hurry back to Everkeep!
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_WUKLAMAT_000_041: Zoraal Ja thinks nothing of others' lives. He will kill his own people!
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_ALISAIE_000_042: Chances are we'll have to face a good part of his army, with Otis among them...
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_SYSTEM_000_053: Your progress through the battle will be saved at certain points. In the event that you are defeated, you will be able to try again from the most recent of these.
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_SYSTEM_000_054: Please note that if you enter battles associated with other quests or log out from the game, this progress will be lost.
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_SYSTEM_000_055: You must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 98 or above to proceed.
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_ALISAIE_000_060: Thank you, Otis... I pray your soul is at peace.
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_KRILE_000_065: To slaughter his adopted people too... Is there no end to his villainy?
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_GRAHATIA_000_070: I did not expect that such carnage would unfold here...
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_WUKLAMAT_000_080: Godsdammit... What is Zoraal Ja trying to achieve by slaughtering his own people!?
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_WUKLAMAT_000_081: That he's still bent on surpassing Papa is clear, but why this massacre? I don't understand...
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_KRILE_000_082: Right now we can only guess at his intent, but his obsession must be strong indeed to endure after thirty years...
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_KRILE_000_083: But now isn't the time to ponder such things. The people need our help.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_ALISAIE_000_001: Thank you, Otis... I pray your soul is at peace.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_KRILE_000_005: To slaughter his adopted people too... Is there no end to his villainy?
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_GRAHATIA_000_010: I did not expect that such carnage would unfold here...
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_WUKLAMAT_000_020: I've been thinking... By wearing regulators, the people of Alexandria had been spared the fear of death.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_WUKLAMAT_000_021: That's because the device not only resurrects you─it also erases your memories of the departed. The very notion of dying would have become vague, if not forgotten.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_WUKLAMAT_000_022: To be killed over and over... I can't imagine how traumatized the survivors must be. Even if they're not physically hurt, they would still need care.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_GRAHATIA_000_023: At a time like this, the citizens need their queen to console them. But where has she gone?
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_WUKLAMAT_000_024: I don't know. There are other districts, so perhaps she's checking on them.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_WUKLAMAT_000_025: In any case, it's too much for her to handle alone...
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_WUKLAMAT_000_026: Countless people will be distraught, and we ought to provide them with what comfort we can.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_WUKLAMAT_000_027: So while Cahciua and her crew tend to those with physical injuries, let's seek out those whose wounds are emotional.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_ALISAIE_000_028: Understood. If you and  want to concentrate on True Vue, the rest of us will see to the other areas.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_WUKLAMAT_000_029: Sounds like a plan. Alright, everyone─we'll meet up in the Backroom after.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_STUNNEDRESIDENT4943: It makes no sense... What right did the king have to destroy our lives like this?
Give us back our peace... Leave us out of your damned war... <sob>
I want no part in it. I just want peace again...
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_TREMBLINGRESIDENT49: <shudder> Never have I been so scared in my life... I'd died in an accident before, but it was nothing compared to this...
To be killed again, and again, and again... It was a living nightmare. And King Zoraal Ja was behind it, you say?
Since he suddenly appeared, he's done nothing good for us. He thinks only of war─ordered more soldiers be produced. And now he unleashes them on us...
He's no king of mine! He's a murderer, and someone needs to make him pay!
Zoraal Ja must answer for his crimes! The false king must be ripped from his throne!
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_EXHAUSTEDRESIDENT49: Th-Thank you... I'm all right, I think...
Say, you were fighting with Queen Sphene, weren't you? Are the rumors true, then?
That Her Majesty isn't a living person. That her actual body is elsewhere─in the cloud or some such─and she uses a special power to appear before us.
I'd always wondered why the Alexandrians never questioned her true nature, but now I think I understand why.
She personally fought to protect us. That's enough for me to know she's a worthy ruler. It doesn't matter what she is.
To fight for her people is proof of her dedication to her people. Whatever she may be, she is our queen.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_CAHCIUA_000_060: We've helped those we could in Solution Nine. We're now looking to send people to the other levels.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_WUKLAMAT_000_090: It seems things are somewhat under control. While Alisaie and the others are still out there...
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_WUKLAMAT_000_091: I couldn't help but worry about Gulool Ja.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_CAHCIUA_000_092: He hasn't uttered a word. And small wonder given his ordeal...
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_WUKLAMAT_000_093: I'm going to talk to him. About everything.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_WUKLAMAT_000_094: Bright as he is, there's no use hiding it. He'd eventually find out, and it'd hurt him more.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_CAHCIUA_000_095: Very well. Above all, he needs to know that he isn't alone.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_CAHCIUA_000_100: To make your own child suffer so... I cannot comprehend the heartlessness.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_WUKLAMAT_000_105: I'll leave nothing out. Neither what's happened, nor what's still to come...
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_CAHCIUA_000_110: They had been keeping a lot inside, both Gulool Ja and Wuk Lamat...
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_GULOOLJA_000_113: I'm sorry I didn't listen and followed you.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_GULOOLJA_000_114: But...I wanted to stop my father. And to maybe understand why he did what he did.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_WUKLAMAT_000_115: You should get some rest, Gulool Ja. You've been through a lot.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_GULOOLJA_000_116: I do feel a bit sleepy...
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_CAHCIUA_000_117: There's a room in the back you can use. Could you take Gulool Ja there?
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_CAHCIUA_000_120: The things I would say to Zoraal Ja as a mother... But I'd better not get started.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_CAHCIUA_000_121: Instead, let me thank you. We couldn't have gotten through this without you and yours.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_CAHCIUA_000_122: Until the others return, you ought to take what rest you can as well. It isn't over yet, after all.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_CAHCIUA_000_123: You could head...<buzzz>...prepare for...<buzzz> Otherwise feel free...<buzzz>...the Backroom.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_CAHCIUA_000_124: A fuzzy image, you say? Is it still happening?
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_CAHCIUA_000_125: Well, it's an old worn thing. There's bound to be a few hitches.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_CAHCIUA_000_126: It's nothing to worry about, though. We'll have a meeting to discuss our next move in a little while, so until then!
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_CAHCIUA_000_005: Had enough rest, have you? Then let's round up everyone!
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_CAHCIUA_000_010: During your confrontation with him, Zoraal Ja bade Wuk Lamat come to the tower's summit.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_CAHCIUA_000_011: Problem is, the elevators have been locked down due to the state of emergency.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_SHALE_000_012: We've been working to lift the access restrictions, but frankly it's not looking promising.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_WUKLAMAT_000_013: Are there any other ways we can get to Zoraal Ja?
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_CAHCIUA_000_015: As you know, Solution Nine occupies Everkeep's ninth level.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_CAHCIUA_000_016: The summit, meanwhile, is the twelfth.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_ALISAIE_000_017: The map appears to be cut off.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_SHALE_000_018: While the king and queen's residence is believed to be located there, the details are highly classified. Hence the lack of map data.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_CAHCIUA_000_019: We do, however, have reliable intelligence concerning everything up to the eleventh level.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_CAHCIUA_000_021: That is Origenics, the facility where souls are separated and refined for use.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_CAHCIUA_000_022: The process begins at the base with the extraction of souls from regulators and fiends.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_CAHCIUA_000_023: Those souls are then transported up to the aetheric separator, where they are cleansed of memories.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_CAHCIUA_000_024: Finally, they are packed within soul cells for distribution.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_GRAHATIA_000_025: Twelve forfend... They've recreated the process by which souls are broken down in the aetherial sea...
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_CAHCIUA_000_026: An affront to nature, I know, but ethical discussions must wait.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_CAHCIUA_000_027: The salient point is that the facility extends vertically from the first to the eleventh level.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_CAHCIUA_000_028: Now, if Zoraal Ja intends to strengthen himself with the people's souls, as we strongly suspect...
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_KRILE_000_029: Then the facility will be operating to process and transport those souls directly to him─on the twelfth level!
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_KRILE_000_030: So in order to reach Zoraal Ja, we make our way through Origenics!
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_CAHCIUA_000_032: As the facility sustains the Alexandrian way of life, security will be extremely tight.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_CAHCIUA_000_033: But if you are willing to brave the route, we'll back you up as best we can. What say you?
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_WUKLAMAT_000_034: It goes without saying that we're going!
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_CAHCIUA_000_036: I'm coming too. You'll need guidance on-site, and this body makes me best suited.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_ERENVILLE_000_037: ...Hold it. Before you set off, I have to ask.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_ERENVILLE_000_038: All this time, you've known that Sphene is an Endless, haven't you?
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_CAHCIUA_000_041: Honestly...it didn't seem relevant to the matters at hand? More complicated to explain than it was worth, and a distraction from our efforts to deal with Zoraal Ja.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_CAHCIUA_000_042: Speaking of which, we should get moving. Those who are sallying forth, we gather in front of the tower!
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_CAHCIUA_000_043: We can count on you to provide support from here, yes?
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_ERENVILLE_000_050: I need to talk to you about... Never mind. It can wait.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_ERENVILLE_000_051: Lest you wonder, I have no objections to remaining here. Someone needs to keep those in Tuliyollal informed.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_WUKLAMAT_000_060: Zoraal Ja is no king. Not anymore. For the sake of Tuliyollal─of the world─we must put an end to his madness.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_ALISAIE_000_065: I've spoken with Alphinaud. Apparently, the dragons came to Tuliyollal's aid!
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_KRILE_000_070: I'm coming too, of course. This is what I've worked so hard to be a part of.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_GRAHATIA_000_075: The summit of Everkeep... Finally, we shall see what the clouds conceal.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_CAHCIUA_000_080: All present and accounted for? Excellent.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_CAHCIUA_000_081: We make for the summit in one push. This will be a grueling climb, so see to it you spare no preparation.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_WUKLAMAT_000_001: Zoraal Ja is no king. Not anymore. For the sake of Tuliyollal─of the world─we must put an end to his madness.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_ALISAIE_000_005: I've spoken with Alphinaud. Apparently, the dragons came to Tuliyollal's aid!
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_KRILE_000_010: I'm coming too, of course. This is what I've worked so hard to be a part of.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_GRAHATIA_000_015: The summit of Everkeep... Finally, we shall see what the clouds conceal.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_CAHCIUA_000_020: The entrance to Origenics is located on the back of Everkeep.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_CAHCIUA_000_021: We can reach it by the water. Come, we head to the pier at the driftdowns!
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_WUKLAMAT_000_025: We're going to ride that oversized container, are we? Don't worry─you won't catch me mewling over a little seasickness. Not anymore.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_ALISAIE_000_030: So we just have to make our way up. Seems nice and straightforward to me.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_KRILE_000_035: Visibility is quite poor, but let us trust in our allies to ferry us safely over.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_GRAHATIA_000_040: A facility for processing souls... As distressing as the very concept is, I confess I'm curious to see the technology employed.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_KILUWSA_000_045: I'm with Oblivion. Cahciua has told me all.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_CAHCIUA_000_050: I will now explain how this mission will unfold.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_CAHCIUA_000_051: Origenics takes delivery at specific times. It is at one such time that we will enter the facility, aboard the hover cargo.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_CAHCIUA_000_052: Kiluwsa here will pilot the vehicle, so you need only sit tight until we arrive at the entrance.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_CAHCIUA_000_053: Our friends in the Backroom will create a diversion so we can steal inside.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_CAHCIUA_000_054: After which we make our way to the summit, striking down any foes that bar our path!
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_WUKLAMAT_000_056: Easy to say, perhaps... But we'll manage one way or another!
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_GRAHATIA_000_058: In anticipation of the unexpected, we should maintain contact with the support crew and adapt as necessary.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_KRILE_000_059: Indeed. I shall use the communicator I borrowed from Shale to keep them informed at all times.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_CAHCIUA_000_060: I see everyone has a grasp of the details. Good. We set off very soon, so be ready!
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_CAHCIUA_000_065: The hover cargo is borrowed from a reforger friend. She was relieved to hear that Gulool Ja is safe.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_KILUWSA_000_070: I'm told you saved Wayakkwe─thank you. I'll be praying for your safety and success.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_A1_100_002: Form a party and enter Origenics.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_WUKLAMAT_000_080: Koana has done his part. Now I must finish things here.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_KRILE_000_082: Zoraal Ja cannot be allowed to cause any more harm. I will do my part to stop him.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_ALISAIE_000_084: With the danger passed in Tuliyollal, we can fight without worry!
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_GRAHATIA_000_086: I expect that Alexandria's military might lies with Origenics. We must be prepared to meet with fierce resistance.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_SYSTEM_000_087: During this quest and when using the Duty Support system, you have the opportunity to undertake this trial with a party of NPC companions. Some of these allies' roles will differ from those you are normally able to select.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_SYSTEM_000_088: Additionally, you may now enter Origenics with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_KILUWSA_000_090: If you're heading back to the summit, I'll launch the hover cargo.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_SYSTEM_000_095: Proceed to the summit of Everkeep?
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_A1_200_002: Form a party and enter Everkeep.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_WUKLAMAT_000_096: Everyone is counting on us. We cannot lose, no matter what!
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_KRILE_000_097: Zoraal Ja will not rest until he has brought the entire world to heel. We must put a stop to him once and for all.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_ALISAIE_000_098: To strike down her brother for the sake of her people... Hers is a terrible burden. But she has us to help her bear it.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_GRAHATIA_100_098: Judging from his words, Zoraal Ja will spare no souls for resurrection. He will burn through every last one to achieve his ambition.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_ESTINIEN_000_099: If Zoraal Ja isn't holding back, then we need but return the favor. Thus shall we honor Gulool Ja Ja.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_ALPHINAUD_100_099: We helped Lamaty'i to triumph over Zoraal Ja in the rite of succession. Even if Koana hadn't asked, it is our duty see this battle through.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_YSHTOLA_100_099: Zoraal Ja will require time to fully harness the souls he has absorbed. Ideally, we can finish things beforehand...
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_ALISAIE_000_105: What you're doing is wrong, Sphene. No matter how hard you try to convince yourself otherwise...
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_ALPHINAUD_000_110: That such a threat existed in another reflection... When Emet-Selch bade you seek discovery, was he aware of it?
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_KRILE_000_115: Sphene has the potential to wreak unimaginable havoc with the key. We have no time to waste.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_ESTINIEN_000_125: No sooner do we deal with one threat...
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_SYSTEM_000_138: Cahciua's vessel shows no signs of life.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_YSHTOLA_000_140: That woman─Sphene, was it? In all likelihood, her true form lies in the reflection yonder.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_YSHTOLA_000_141: But how to go after her now...
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_YSHTOLA_000_142: Cahciua might know something, but her vessel ceased to function when the portal closed.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_YSHTOLA_000_143: Let us examine it. With luck, it will yield some much-needed clues.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_YSHTOLA_000_145: The key to interdimensional fusion... It did not seem so wondrous a thing to me...
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_SYSTEM_000_150: Cahciua's vessel shows no signs of life.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_WUKLAMAT_000_151: Cahciua said that she operates her vessel from afar.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_YSHTOLA_000_153: The words Sphene spoke to your mother─did they mean anything to you?
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_ERENVILLE_000_154: Those who came from my village... None of them remembered her.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_ERENVILLE_000_155: It's the same as what we witnessed happen to those who knew Namikka.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_ERENVILLE_000_157: You noticed something, didn't you? Whatever it is, please tell me.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_YSHTOLA_000_158: While Sphene projected herself onto machines, Cahciua controlled hers remotely. But to me, they appeared identical in their existence.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_YSHTOLA_000_159: Both were inorganic objects suffused with faint amounts of aether. When that aether faded, they became lifeless husks.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_YSHTOLA_000_160: And as we all saw, this happened to both the moment the portal closed...
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_ALISAIE_000_161: So Cahciua was operating her vessel from the reflection beyond?
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_ALISAIE_000_162: But if none of her friends and acquaintances here remember her, then...
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_WUKLAMAT_000_164: The Endless... Those who are recreated from memories of the departed.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_ERENVILLE_000_165: All this time, my mother was dead. She fooled us all.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_YSHTOLA_000_166: Sphene, for one, does not seem to think of them in that way.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_WUKLAMAT_000_167: No. She loves them like she does all her citizens, and she'll do anything to protect them.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_YSHTOLA_000_168: Such as plundering aether from the Source. Alas, Zoraal Ja had his own agenda and spoiled the plan.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_YSHTOLA_000_169: But now that she possesses the key, she could target other reflections without our interference. Reflections whose people have no idea what she is willing to do.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_GRAHATIA_000_170: Then the people of the Source are not the only ones in danger. We must stop her.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_WUKLAMAT_000_171: We have to go where Sphene has gone. I want to talk to her again. And perhaps we'll find Cahciua as well...
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_YSHTOLA_000_172: With the gate closed, we need to find an alternate means of passage. I will look into it.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_ALPHINAUD_000_174: Let us begin by investigating this place. There may be clues relating to what lies beyond.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_ERENVILLE_000_175: Let me help. I'll do whatever you need me to do─anything at all!
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_ALPHINAUD_000_176: Of course, my friend. Your knowledge and expertise would be most welcome.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_ALISAIE_000_177: I expect the investigation will take time. Perhaps you'd like to head back below with Gulool Ja and get some rest.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_WUKLAMAT_000_178: That's not a bad idea. We do need to share these developments with those in the Backroom as well.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_ALISAIE_000_180: You too, . You've more than done your part for now, so leave this to us.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_GULOOLJA_000_185: I'll be fine. You don't need to worry about me.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_WUKLAMAT_000_200: So much has happened and so quickly, I'm still catching up mentally.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_WUKLAMAT_000_201: But where it concerns Zoraal Ja, I have no regrets. I made my choice and did what I had to do.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_WUKLAMAT_000_202: I only wish I could have stopped Sphene too. Stopped her from walking her misguided path...
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_WUKLAMAT_000_203: <sigh> I could definitely use some rest...
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_GULOOLJA_000_001: I'll be fine. You don't need to worry about me.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_010: I'm really sorry, but we're not sure what happened to Cahciua. The others are trying to learn what they can.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_SHALE_000_011: Oh, Cahciua... We'd known that such a day would come, but I wish we could've at least said good-bye...
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_012: You knew, then. That she was already gone.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_SHALE_000_014: Cahciua forbade us from saying anything. She wanted to tell you herself when the time was right.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_SHALE_000_015: I expect she was torn over how to reveal the truth to Erenville.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_016: I see... I don't think anyone can blame her for keeping quiet.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_017: But tell me─how are the people faring? Have they forgotten Zoraal Ja already?
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_SHALE_000_018: No, they still remember him. We wonder if this might be the result of the gate at the summit being closed.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_SHALE_000_019: Most are unaware of developments. They'll be relieved to hear that the king has been defeated, but at the same time, they're like to panic if they learn that the queen has disappeared.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_SHALE_000_020: Right now, Geode is making contact with the various government bodies, but it'd probably be best to keep it all under wraps for a time.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_021: Agreed. Once we've resolved matters, I'll explain everything to the people. I consider it my duty.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_022: As to Zoraal Ja's mechanical army, what's become of them now that he's gone?
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_SHALE_000_024: At the time we suspect that Zoraal Ja passed, the king's authority appears to have been transferred to Gulool Ja.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_025: You mean to say Gulool Ja is the new king!?
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_SHALE_000_026: While a coronation is required to make it official, for the moment, the system recognizes him as his father's successor.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_GULOOLJA_000_027: But...I don't want this. I don't want to be king.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_028: It's not a decision you have to make right away. But given that the authority comes with command of the army, you can't give it up lightly either.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_029: We can think on it together later, but for now, I want you to hold on to it. To what your father has left you...
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_033: Ugh, what is this? Why can't I... Gah!
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_034: Despite everything that's happened─all the terrible things my brother did─I still don't know how to feel towards him... What's wrong with me?
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_A1_000_002: You just need a little time.
