TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_036: You think so? I'll take your word for it...
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_SHALE_000_037: For now, we have things under control. Why not return to Tuliyollal and rest up while the others handle the investigation?
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_038: You know, I think I'll do that. It'll be good to see how things are at home and catch up with Koana.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_039: Hey, why don't the two of you come too?
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_041: Of course not. They might be a little unsure at first, but I'll set them straight.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_042: Besides, I want to introduce you to Koana. As new family.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_044: Really! That is, if you're fine with it?
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_046: Then let's be off! We'll head directly to the palace to see Koana.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_SHALE_000_050: Please have a good rest─you've earned it. I'll keep things low-key for a while myself.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_GULOOLJA_000_060: I'm my own person... I am!
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_KOANA_000_065: Even though I knew all was well, I'm still comforted to see Lamaty'i with my own eyes.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_070: It was indeed Zoraal Ja's realm inside the dome.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_071: A realm he ruled jointly with Sphene. He as the King of Resolve, and she the Queen of Reason.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_072: Just like you and me here.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_073: Their people live very different lives compared to ours. But like us, they live them to the fullest.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_074: And Sphene is a big part of that. She's a considerate and approachable ruler who treats everyone as family.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_KOANA_000_075: You and her must've gotten along well.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_076: We did... But out of love for her people, she's chosen the wrong path.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_077: They're a good folk, the Alexandrians... They welcomed us into their homes, and treated us with kindness and respect.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_078: But Zoraal Ja slaughtered them. Slaughtered those he was meant to protect, for his own ends.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_KOANA_000_079: By the gods... Tell me how this came to pass.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_KOANA_000_085: That a king should harm his own people...
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_090: When his attack on Tuliyollal failed, Zoraal Ja sought to gain more power. So he ordered his people executed and harvested their souls.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_KOANA_000_091: What drove him to commit such an atrocity?
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_092: He claimed he wanted to bring the entire world under his dominion. But that was just a means to achieve his true desire.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_GULOOLJA_000_093: My grandfather... He was a great person, right?
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_GULOOLJA_000_094: Maybe...maybe my father wanted to prove he was his own person. That he wasn't just a great person's son.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_KOANA_000_095: I daresay you are right. As the Resilient Son, our father's trueborn heir, he bore the weight of expectation. That weight was clearly greater than any of us had imagined.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_GULOOLJA_000_096: That's probably why he was who he was. And why he didn't want me...
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_097: Damn it all... If only we had tried harder to reach out to him...
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_GULOOLJA_000_100: What my father did was wrong. He had to be stopped. But...I'm glad I could learn a little about the person he was.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_KOANA_000_105: Growing up, I envied my brother. But that envy may have added to his burdens.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_110: Zoraal Ja had become unimaginably powerful. It was only with 's help that we managed to defeat him.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_111: And now I have a responsibility to the people of Alexandria. And above all to Gulool Ja.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_113: I promised, didn't I? I wanted us to become family. And it isn't only out of obligation. Since I've gotten to know you, I've come to really like you.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_114: You might not be my nephew by blood, but we're family to the end. We'll always be there to help each other, isn't that right?
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_116: You too, . After everything we've been through, we're already as good as family.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_118: What do you mean, “what”? The more family you have, the merrier, don't you think? Come on, let's head into the barracks!
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_GULOOLJA_000_120: I'd like to be family with you too, !
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_125: Like Papa did by taking us in, I want to make my family bigger! You wouldn't mind some extra family too, right, ?
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_KOANA_000_150: I'm glad I could hear what happened in the dome.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_KOANA_000_151: But I'm sorry that you had to bear such a heavy burden, Lamaty'i...
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_152: Don't be. As Vow of Resolve, it was something that I had to do.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_153: Besides, it was your ingenious strategy that kept Tuliyollal safe!
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_154: Asking you to rule with me was definitely one of my better ideas!
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_KOANA_000_155: It was because we all fought as one that we could repel the invaders─and then only with the aid of Vrtra and his kin.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_KOANA_000_156: Thanks to Alphinaud and Estinien interceding for us, we were able to swiftly forge an alliance with Radz-at-Han.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_KOANA_000_157: And when the dragons appeared in our skies, I felt that this was it─the Tuliyollal you had envisioned.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_KOANA_000_158: We owe our new allies a great debt, and I hope that we can repay them one day.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_159: Indeed. Once I've dealt with matters, we should go and thank them in person.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_KOANA_000_160: had told me as much, but you still have work to do, yes?
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_161: Yes. I need to find Sphene.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_162: She harmed our people so that her own might live. But as I was raging at her deeds, I realized something.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_163: Just because Tuliyollal is safe doesn't mean I can ignore what becomes of Alexandria. That's the kind of thinking that led to conflict in the old days.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_164: I want to help the Alexandrian people live in peace and happiness. And the only way to do that is to stop Sphene from walking her path.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_KOANA_000_166: Very well, Lamaty'i. Just promise me you will take care.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_GULOOLJA_000_170: I wish there was something I could do to help...
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_175: It's nice to be home, even if only for a while. Thanks for coming with me, .
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_KOANA_000_180: <sigh> While I had anticipated this, I still can't help but worry.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_181: I'm sorry that I have to go away again so soon.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_182: But even setting Sphene aside, some of our own people may be among the Endless.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_WUKLAMAT_000_183: I can't just sit around and leave everything to the others.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_KOANA_000_184: I understand. I have matters here well in hand, so do what you must.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_KOANA_000_185: . For all you've done for us─for our nation and our family─I fear I can never express sufficient gratitude. But thank you, from the bottom of my heart.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_GULOOLJA_000_000: I wish there was something I could do to help...
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_KOANA_000_001: I understand Zoraal Ja spared no souls for reviving himself in battle. His pride wouldn't permit him to do otherwise, I expect...
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_WUKLAMAT_000_003: Well, it was good to catch Koana up. Now we'll talk to the sol─ ...Hm?
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_WUKLAMAT_000_006: ...Is that so? In that case, let's meet at Sunperch. See you soon!
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_WUKLAMAT_000_007: Y'shtola is heading back. I dare to hope she's found a way to pursue Sphene.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_WUKLAMAT_000_008: If you all wanted to go on ahead to Sunperch, I'll pay our soldiers a quick call.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_WUKLAMAT_000_011: You're all here. Then that means...
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_GRAHATIA_000_012: Aye. We believe we've found a way to travel to the reflection to where Sphene has retreated.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_ALISAIE_000_013: I was busy providing aid in Solution Nine, so I haven't heard the details myself.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_ALISAIE_000_014: Could you start from the beginning, Y'shtola?
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_YSHTOLA_000_015: Per Sphene's own words, the gate atop Everkeep was opened and closed by the power of interdimensional fusion.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_YSHTOLA_000_016: And it was the artifact known as the key that allowed her to control it.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_KRILE_000_017: According to Ketenramm, the key was brought with me to the Source twenty years ago.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_KRILE_000_018: It was then kept here in the palace until its theft by Zoraal Ja, who used it in Yyasulani to fuse a portion of our world with this reflection.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_YSHTOLA_000_019: Following Zoraal Ja's demise, Sphene claimed the key and disappeared through the gate.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_YSHTOLA_000_020: But where exactly did that gate lead? In seeking the answer, we took another look at Origenics─and made a startling discovery.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_YSHTOLA_000_021: As you all know, there should have been one more level at the summit of Everkeep.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_ALISAIE_010_021: The twelfth level─the King of Resolve's royal abode.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_SHALE_020_021: Right. But when you actually went there, you saw that it didn't exist.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_SHALE_000_022: Curious, we analyzed Origenics's logs to see where the memories of the departed were being sent. And where should it be but through the gate, to the missing twelfth level.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_YSHTOLA_000_023: That level alone must have lain outside the fused region, and so was left behind.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_A1_000_026: The reflection to which Sphene has fled is her own.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_A1_000_027: Alphinaud, if you'd be so kind!
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_YSHTOLA_000_029: 'Tis Sphene's home world, and she has returned there, to join the memories of her departed citizens.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_ALPHINAUD_000_030: It means that beyond the gate lies not just any reflection, but the one from which Alexandria originally hailed.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_ALPHINAUD_000_031: 'Tis Sphene's home world, and she has returned there, to join the memories of her departed citizens.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_GRAHATIA_000_032: But as the key lies with her on the other side, we haven't the means to reopen the gate.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_WUKLAMAT_000_033: Forgive me, but I thought we already knew she had gone home─or at least it seemed obvious to me. What I want to know is, how do we pursue Sphene if the gate here is closed?
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_KRILE_000_034: We use another gate. And it just so happens we know where one is.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_KRILE_000_036: Aye. All evidence suggests that the gate there leads to the world whence the Alexandrians and I came.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_ALISAIE_000_037: But assuming that's true, how can we open it?
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_KRILE_000_038: That is what we shall find out, using the code in this earring.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_SHALE_000_039: As you'll recall, Krile's earring is in fact a data storage device.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_SHALE_000_040: An analysis of it yielded a code─something used to control a contraption, and a very large one at that.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_GRAHATIA_000_041: Given the circumstances of Krile's arrival in the Source, we believe that said contraption is the gate to the golden city.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_GRAHATIA_000_042: This is admittedly an educated guess, but we are quite hopeful that it will work.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_WUKLAMAT_000_043: To make such progress in so short a time... You really are amazing!
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_YSHTOLA_000_044: We couldn't have done it alone. The credit must go to the members of Oblivion for acquiring the information we needed, Shale especially.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_WUKLAMAT_000_045: Right then, it seems the plan is set! To the Skydeep Cenote!
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_WUKLAMAT_000_025: I've told the officers of the Landsguard about my intention. They fully support our endeavor.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_KOANA_000_030: Begging your pardon, , but might I have a moment ere setting forth?
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_WUKLAMAT_000_031: Oh, you're already going to give  the thing?
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_KOANA_000_032: Yes. I had thought to save it for later, but in light of these developments, I feel now is the time.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_KOANA_000_033: As Lamaty'i says, I have something for you. Please come with me to Bayside Bevy.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_GULOOLJA_000_035: Are these all shops? It's so different from Solution Nine!
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_WUKLAMAT_000_040: Hehe, I hope you like it!
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_KOANA_000_050: Tuliyollal is safe in no small part due to your valor. As a token of our appreciation, I have commissioned special equipment for you.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_KOANA_000_051: While it is inadequate as an expression of gratitude, I pray it will serve you well in your coming mission.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_WUKLAMAT_000_052: It apparently incorporates foreign technology. Leave it to Koana to request such a thing, eh?
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_KOANA_000_053: Mewazunte yonder has the equipment in his keeping. Just say the word, and he will bring it out.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_SYSTEM_000_100: You may now obtain job-specific gear from Mewazunte.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_SYSTEM_000_101: The weapons and gear obtained can be equipped at level 99. However, all item stats will be subject to item level sync.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_SYSTEM_000_102: Upon reaching level 100 with the corresponding job, these items will no longer be synced.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_SYSTEM_000_103: Furthermore, the gear can be dyed upon completion of the role quests associated with said job.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_GULOOLJA_000_001: I'll bet it looks good on you!
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_KOANA_000_005: These arms and armor are the work of our finest artisans. I can vouch for their quality and functionality both.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_WUKLAMAT_000_010: With your shiny new gear, I reckon you're ready for anything!
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_WUKLAMAT_000_011: Come, let's head to the Skydeep Cenote!
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_KOANA_000_012: Access to the area is presently restricted per my orders, so I shall accompany you.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_GULOOLJA_000_015: This place is a little scary... I don't know if I could come here alone.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_ALISAIE_000_020: It feels like a lifetime ago that we were last here.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_ERENVILLE_000_025: The city of gold. Where it all began...
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_WUKLAMAT_000_040: Koana has already gone inside, but I couldn't help but take a moment. Just being here takes me back.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_ALISAIE_000_041: And it wasn't even that long ago that we visited for the rite. So much has happened since then.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_KRILE_000_042: Truly. Guided by my grandfather's letter, I crossed the seas in search of answers...
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_KRILE_000_043: What awaits us on the road ahead, I know not. But I shall walk it to the end with you all.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_GULOOLJA_000_050: This power I've inherited, I'll use for good. I will!
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_KOANA_000_055: Once again I must leave Lamaty'i in your care. Please return safely.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_ALPHINAUD_000_060: I would dearly love to accompany you. But this time I will content myself with seeing you off.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_ALPHINAUD_000_065: Where you now go, I pray you find hope. I look forward to hearing your account upon your return.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_ALISAIE_000_070: I'm needed here, I accept that. I'm not a child anymore.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_ALISAIE_000_075: I'll spare no effort doing my part, so you do yours too. Together, we'll protect what we hold dear!
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_KRILE_000_080: Twenty years ago I emerged from that gate. Whether or not the answers I seek lie on the other side, I will see things through.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_KRILE_000_085: I would be lying if I said I'm not nervous, but your presence gives me comfort and courage. I imagine your other travel companions often feel the same.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_GRAHATIA_000_090: If Sphene is intent on plundering aether from other worlds, then our task is clear: we must stop her.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_GRAHATIA_000_095: She cannot be allowed to harm anyone else. Neither those who are dear to us, nor strangers we have never met.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_YSHTOLA_000_100: To be completely honest, it is all I can do not to throw myself into that light.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_YSHTOLA_000_105: But I must resist the urge, for my presence will be required here should the gate close. It wouldn't do to lose everyone, our champion not least of all.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_URIANGER_000_110: We who shall remain want for neither expertise nor experience. Worry not on our account, and fix thy gaze upon the path ahead.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_THANCRED_000_115: I'll keep everyone safe. Just concentrate on your own task.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_ESTINIEN_000_120: En route here, I caught sight of a large lizard. It looked palatable enough, so I shall hunt it later.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_ESTINIEN_000_125: We can enjoy the meat while you regale me with tales of the world beyond after you've returned.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_SHALE_000_130: I've done all I can. If you should meet Cahciua...please tell her I said thank you.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_ERENVILLE_000_135: There's no telling what dangers we'll face, I know. But if my mother is out there, I need to find her. And give her a piece of my mind...
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_KRILE_000_150: This is my world. My home...
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_GRAHATIA_000_155: Neither the void nor the First... We are indeed come to an unknown reflection.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_ERENVILLE_000_160: The “city of gold” is an apt description indeed...
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_WUKLAMAT_000_171: We've literally stepped into the Yok Huy legend!
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_KRILE_000_172: Whichever reflection this may be, 'twould seem the barrier between here and the Source is thin in Yak T'el.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_ERENVILLE_000_173: That would explain the Yok Huy's visions and the location of the gate.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_WUKLAMAT_100_173: Hey, Erenville. That volcano over there─you don't suppose it's real, is it?
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_ERENVILLE_100_174: An actual volcano, spewing forth lava, in the middle of a city? I'd like to see that.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_WUKLAMAT_000_174: Look, there's a path down. Let's see where it goes.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_KRILE_000_175: The people here. Could they be...?
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_GRAHATIA_000_180: There's no mistaking the design of this aetheryte.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_ERENVILLE_000_185: I see electrope is used here too.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_WUKLAMAT_000_190: It's strange... Though I've never been to this place before, it somehow makes me feel nostalgic.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_WUKLAMAT_000_191: Unlike Everkeep with all its advanced technology, here it's brick and stone. It's like we've traveled to the past.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_ERENVILLE_000_192: The differences may be more superficial than you think. Take a good look at the buildings around us.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_ERENVILLE_000_193: There's electrope everywhere, along with myriad contraptions.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_ERENVILLE_000_194: Like how Sphene projects her image onto soldiers, I believe this city's appearance is artificial.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_GRAHATIA_000_195: This aetheryte is identical to the one in Everkeep, is it not?
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_GRAHATIA_000_196: This suggests that this place is Alexandrian.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_KRILE_000_197: That would seem a fair assumption. In light of all this, could it be this city is Everkeep's missing twelfth level?
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_CONSTANCY_000_200: My name is Constancy, and like you, I am an Endless.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_CONSTANCY_000_201: We have been recreated from the memories of those who have exhausted their souls─the departed, in other words.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_CONSTANCY_000_202: Great effort is taken to ensure the integrity of your memories, so it will feel no different from when you were flesh and blood.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_WUKLAMAT_000_203: (Let's go along with it for now.)
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_CONSTANCY_000_204: I am a caretaker here at Living Memory, city of the Endless, and it is my pleasure to provide guidance to newcomers such as your good selves.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_KRILE_000_205: City of the Endless... At a glance, there seems to be many different facilities. What kind of place is this?
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_CONSTANCY_000_206: Simply put, it is a recreational attraction. The city is divided into four areas, each of which captures scenery that once defined our continent.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_CONSTANCY_000_207: In this way we ensure that what is lost is not forgotten. That all precious memories endure forevermore.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_CONSTANCY_100_207: In Everkeep's early days, this place was used by the living, but it was made a haven for the Endless hundreds of years later.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_CONSTANCY_000_208: Now then, if you would please follow me, I shall give you a guided tour. Do take care, as wildlife brought here for preservation roams freely.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_WUKLAMAT_000_210: While a tour would be interesting, it's Sphene that we've come to see.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_CONSTANCY_000_211: Oh, so you wish to meet the queen! In that case, you are in luck.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_CONSTANCY_000_212: It was just announced that Her Majesty will enter into a slumber, but there is still time.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_CONSTANCY_000_213: If you try calling to her before the Meso Terminal, at the center of the city, she will likely appear.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_WUKLAMAT_000_214: I'm not sure how things work around here, but let's head to this Meso Terminal.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_WUKLAMAT_000_215: Our thanks, Constancy. We'll take you up on the tour next time.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_CONSTANCY_000_216: I shall look forward to it. Good luck seeking out Her Majesty!
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_CONSTANCY_000_220: Queen Sphene enjoys meeting her people. I am quite confident she will appear for you at the Meso Terminal.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_GRAHATIA_000_225: Like the chamber in the Skydeep Cenote, the electrope here produces a strong golden light. A difference in energy levels, perhaps.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_ERENVILLE_000_230: The plants are real as far as I can tell. Not everything is an illusion.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_KRILE_000_235: I wonder, can the Endless venture elsewhere, or can they only survive here?
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_KRILE_000_240: While Sphene's intentions are good, her methods are anything but. We cannot yield at any cost.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_GRAHATIA_000_245: The Endless were unsustainable from the first. Sphene has been fighting a lost cause.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_ERENVILLE_000_250: The Endless exist in defiance of the laws of nature. But they exist nonetheless, with Sphene holding them to be no different from the living...
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_WUKLAMAT_000_260: Argh! What are we to do now, damn it!?
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_WUKLAMAT_000_261: I felt that I had come to understand Sphene, but I'm still clueless. Utterly clueless!
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_KRILE_000_001: While Sphene's intentions are good, her methods are anything but. We cannot yield at any cost.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_GRAHATIA_000_002: The Endless were unsustainable from the first. Sphene has been fighting a lost cause.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_ERENVILLE_000_003: The Endless exist in defiance of the laws of nature. But they exist nonetheless, with Sphene holding them to be no different from the living...
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_WUKLAMAT_000_004: It doesn't seem like we can do much else here. Let's return to the aetheryte for now.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_WUKLAMAT_000_005: The caretaker, Constancy. Perhaps he can tell us more about this business of Sphene going into a slumber.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_GRAHATIA_000_007: Is that...? No, that's not him.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_WUKLAMAT_000_009: Don't tell me he's gone somewhere else!?
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_KRILE_000_011: Perhaps he has taken other recent arrivals on a tour.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_WUKLAMAT_000_013: Yes... He was here just earlier, a fellow named Constancy.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_015: (-???-)Hello, everyone. You made it here, as I knew you would.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_KRILE_000_016: Is that who I think it is?
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_018: None other. This is the first time some of you are seeing me in the proverbial flesh, isn't it?
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_019: Feast your eyes, then! She who was controlling that unassuming machine was a ravishing Shetona maiden!
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_020: ...That was a bit much, wasn't it? Ignore me.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_ERENVILLE_000_021: So it was true. That you're here means...
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_022: I tried to tell you. So many times. But my courage always failed me...
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_023: I am indeed an Endless. Have been for quite a while now.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_025: Now, you've come to stop Sphene, yes? I can help with that, but I have a request to make.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_GRAHATIA_000_026: You know how to stop her, then?
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_027: While there are no guarantees, your coming here makes it a distinct possibility.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_028: As my wish is relevant to your mission, will you hear me out? You can decide what to do afterwards.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_029: Excellent. To begin, we'll need to head to a different area.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_030: See that sentry? I'll have them grant you access to the zip line.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_032: A fun little mode of transport. They don't see much use, though, as we Endless can teleport freely within Living Memory.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_100_032: This particular line will take you to a zone called Canal Town. I'll be waiting for you there.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_KRILE_000_033: <chuckle> With that endearing pushiness, it could only be Cahciua. Let's go!
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_KRILE_000_034: It has the look of the contraptions found throughout the Isle of Haam, does it not?
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_GRAHATIA_000_035: Cahciua has already teleported ahead, it seems.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_ERENVILLE_000_036: I'm sorry, it's just...she's gone, yet to see and hear her carrying on like nothing's... I don't know how to feel.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_WUKLAMAT_000_037: I think I know how it works! I've got this!
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CANALTOWNGUARD_000_:
Hm? You don't seem to be─

I bid you welcome to Canal Town, the resort of romance and relaxation! Please enjoy your stay!
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_041: That's them. The people Sphene strives to protect.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_WUKLAMAT_000_043: So, what's this request of yours?
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_044: I want you to erase us. Erase the Endless.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_GRAHATIA_000_110: For now, let us hear the rest.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_130: Oh, come now, spare me those gloomy faces.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_131: Being alive, you're the only ones who can do this. And we won't have a better opportunity than now, while Queen Sphene is busy preparing to initiate interdimensional fusion.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_WUKLAMAT_000_132: It's wrong to sacrifice others to sustain the Endless. This I firmly believe.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_WUKLAMAT_000_133: But talking to you now, you seem as real as any of us. And if you need an answer right away, I don't know if I can give it.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_WUKLAMAT_000_134: Is there a reason we need to act so soon?
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_135: Because, as you've just said, it's wrong to sacrifice others to sustain us. Remember, we need life force─other forms of aether don't cut it.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_136: In the beginning, we managed with the aether of those who died in the barrier. But as our numbers grew, there began to be a shortage.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_137: That's why Queen Sphene looked to other sources. Even the aether I'm composed of may have come from the victims of the attack on Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_138: I can't bear that thought. Can't bear to exist because someone died.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_WUKLAMAT_000_139: We'd probably feel the same way if we were in your shoes... But what exactly are you asking us to do?
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_140: In each zone, there is an enormous data storage device called a terminal. That is where our memories are kept.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_141: If you shut down a terminal, the memories within will disappear─along with those Endless created from them.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_ERENVILLE_000_142: But does this need to be done now? Can't we stop Sphene first, and then take it from there?
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_143: It's precisely in order to stop Sphene that it must be done now.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_144: Her own memories are stored within the Meso Terminal, which stands at the heart of Living Memory.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_146: As you would expect, the terminal's defenses are extremely tight. But it has moments of vulnerability, such as when it has just finished calculations, which we can exploit to shut it down from within.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_147: While we wait for that opening, we erase the Endless. Once we are gone, Sphene will no longer have a reason to plunder aether from other worlds.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_GRAHATIA_000_148: Would Sphene simply allow us to shut down the terminals?
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_149: In preparation for fusion, the Meso Terminal is currently performing massive calculations while gathering energy. Even if the system notices us, it cannot easily suspend the process.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_150: Rather than doing so, I believe it will attempt to accelerate the timetable and bridge worlds before the plan can be thwarted.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_151: It wouldn't be a decision Sphene would wish to make, but she would be able to save those who are stored in the Meso Terminal, at least...
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_KRILE_000_152: There's sense in your strategy, and in resolving to stop Sphene, we had anticipated that it might come to this. But to actually talk about erasing the Endless...is difficult.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_153: You needn't feel any guilt. No matter how lifelike we may seem, we Endless are but facsimiles crafted from memories.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_100_153: Besides, stopping Sphene requires that you shut down the Meso Terminal, which sustains all of us. Sooner or later, it will need to be done.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_110_153: If we are to be erased, then let it be before more people come to harm. Living, breathing people with futures they deserve to experience.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_A1_000_002: There has to be another way.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_A1_000_003: I don't want you to go...
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_155: Thank you. For respecting my wish.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_156: I'm afraid not. We spent years scouring Preservation's records, but found nothing. It's truly a bothersome system they've created.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_157: <chuckle> While I appreciate the thought, we can't afford to miss this chance. Do this for me, will you?
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_158: And, as a personal request... While her actions cannot be condoned, I ask that you afford Queen Sphene a measure of understanding. Know that she herself didn't choose to become an Endless.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_159: It was Preservation that made the choice for her.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_160: She is powerless to resist her purpose.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_110_160: The Sphene you know is an ideal that Preservation brought to life.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_120_160: Harnessing the love the living Sphene bore for her people, they brought forth an eternal queen whose primary directive is to preserve the Endless.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_130_160: But as you know, the Endless consume aether. Sphene was compelled to find ways to procure it, and that compulsion has driven her to resort to interdimensional fusion.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_WUKLAMAT_140_160: What? Are you telling me the original Sphene wouldn't have chosen this?
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_150_160: What the queen might have done, only she herself would know.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_160_160: But the scientists of Preservation have vanished, leaving their created queen to walk alone.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_170_160: So as you go about your mission, think not that you're stopping a ruthless villain. But rather, that you're relieving a troubled soul of her burden.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_WUKLAMAT_000_161: Alright, Cahciua. We understand now. Both your reasoning and your feelings.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_WUKLAMAT_000_162: But before we erase the Endless, I'd like to know them. I'd like to know what she fights tooth and nail for.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_WUKLAMAT_000_163: If we're going to reject someone's beliefs, let it be after we've come to understand them. This is a lesson I learned from the rite of succession.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_WUKLAMAT_000_164: I realize we're pressed for time, but if it's alright with you, I want to meet as many people as I can.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_165: You truly are Gulool Ja Ja's kitten... Well, the calculations will take a while still. It should be fine if we do this as we proceed to the terminals.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_KRILE_000_166: I'm with you. We might not be able to learn everything, but it would nevertheless be meaningful if we could glimpse the hearts of those who inhabit this place before we set them free.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_167: I'll leave you to it, then. When you've finished here, come and find me at the fountain near that big clock tower.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_WUKLAMAT_000_168: Right, let's split up and find some locals to speak with!
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_169: It really is a lovely place. You should run along and enjoy it while you can.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_KRILE_000_170: A part of me hopes that my parents are here too, but it's probably too much to ask for...
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_GRAHATIA_000_175: The Endless seem to eat the food with relish, but it couldn't be real...could it?
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_ERENVILLE_000_180: I will not object to your decision... And as my mother says, you needn't feel any guilt.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_ERENVILLE_000_185: Yet I admit I myself am still conflicted. To have such doubts after coming all this way... It's laughable, isn't it?
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_WUKLAMAT_000_190: Your ancestors were refugees from Lindblum? What tales they must have...
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CAHCIUA_000_195: I must say, I'm starting to enjoy myself. Even if it's only brief, this has the feel of a journey.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CHEERFULENDLESS0494: Well now, I don't believe I've seen you around before. A newcomer, I take it?
It's wonderful here, let me tell you! Why, I just bumped into a dear friend in life, and we've been whiling away the hours reminiscing.
It might have been more like days, actually. You don't get a sense of the time here.
By the way, did you hear the announcement earlier? As much as I love this place, I wonder if Queen Sphene can really sustain us forever...
But I suppose there's no use worrying about such things. Anyway, thanks to you, we found a break in our conversation. We'll go and ride the gondola next!
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_CALMENDLESS04949_00: Oh, hello there. Taking in the sights of Canal Town too, are you? Both my wife and I just adore this place.
We had become estranged in life, she and I, but being here gave us the chance to reconcile.
I couldn't be more grateful for the chance to spend these blessed little moments together again.
I have no more regrets. Whether Her Majesty's plan succeeds or no, I can rest with peace in my heart.
Well, we shall continue on our way, but we hope to see you again. Till next time.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_SATISFIEDENDLESS049: You there! Have you tried the popcorn from that stall?
You haven't? You don't know what you're missing!

I consider myself something of a gourmand, and believe me when I say the classic salt flavor is amazing! The saltiness is simply exquisite─that's the only way to describe it. Once you have a mouthful, it's impossible to stop until it's all gone!
And after you've tried that, I urge you to seek out other stalls. There are lots of them everywhere, offering all manner of delights.
For another recommendation off the top of my head...the ice cream over in Asyle Volcane! It's so smooth and rich and─
<slurp> Just thinking about it has given me a hankering... That's it─I'm going to go and have some right now!
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_ERASTUS_000_220: Welcome, welcome! Have a browse and let me know when you're ready to order.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_GRAHATIA_000_221: You're here on that lady's recommendation as well, I take it?
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_GRAHATIA_000_222: I had been wondering what the Endless do for sustenance, so it seemed a good opportunity to learn.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_ERASTUS_000_223: Oho, this is your first time eating, is it?
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_ERASTUS_000_224: The food here is created using aether and memory data. To us, it tastes just like the real thing.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_ERASTUS_000_225: So, how about it? Would you care for some popcorn?
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_GRAHATIA_000_226: Let's give it a try, shall we?
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_ERASTUS_100_226: That's the spirit! Find a table you like, and I'll bring it right out. And lest you worry, there's no charge─all the food is free here.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_GRAHATIA_100_226: Food created with memory data... How will this taste to the living, I wonder.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_GRAHATIA_110_226: Well, as they say, there's only one way to find out!
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_SYSTEM_000_227: You sample a handful of popcorn. While it has texture, you can detect no taste whatsoever.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_GRAHATIA_000_228: Good gods... It tastes like nothing at all...
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_GRAHATIA_000_229: Er, I-I mean...it's amazing! I've never had such tasty popcorn!
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_ERASTUS_000_230: Hehe, it's not our best seller for nothing!
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_ERASTUS_000_233: Hahaha! It's always special, watching newcomers eat for the first time!
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_GRAHATIA_000_234: They're just like the people of Everkeep.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_GRAHATIA_000_235: Their communal spirit, their delighted smiles. Exactly the same...
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_ERASTUS_000_236: Thank you for your custom. Come again any time!
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_GRAHATIA_000_237: By the way, prior to this, a young man caught my eye near the canal. He appeared to be searching for something, and rather frantically.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_GRAHATIA_000_238: Did you perchance see him too?
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_GRAHATIA_000_239: No? I must say I'm curious as to what has him so flustered. Could you help me look for the fellow?
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_GRAHATIA_000_240: My thanks. Let's head to where I saw him.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_GRAHATIA_000_250: 'Twould seem he is no longer in the vicinity.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_GRAHATIA_000_251: Let us keep looking. Whatever it is that troubles him, perhaps we can be of assistance.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_GRAHATIA_000_001: I cannot claim to know exactly how Endless behave, but hopefully our man has not gone far.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_GRAHATIA_000_002: Let us split up to search for him. He is an Eldite with fair hair.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_010: Gods strike me down... We reunite again after a hundred years, and what should happen...
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_011: Y-Yes? My apologies, but I'm in some haste. If you have something to say, please make it brief.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_012: Your friend noticed that I seemed troubled, so you've been looking for me? What kind souls you are!
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_013: I've lost something important─the engagement ring intended for my beloved. A lanky, monkey-like fiend stole it from me.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_014: After running hither and thither, I managed to locate the beast in yonder square, but I'm uncertain how I should take the ring back...
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_015: Once, I might have considered fighting for it, but given the shortage of aether, the danger is simply too great.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_016: If I were to be struck down and my essence dispersed, I am not like to be remade for a long time.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_017: I cannot risk that. Not after my beloved has finally been given form again after a hundred years.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_018: Though it pains me to do so, I shall give up on the ring, but I thank you for your kind concern.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_020: That accursed beast was holding up the ring, taunting me! Grrr, how I should like to teach it a lesson... Just to warn you, it seems to be fond of shiny objects. Should you venture into yonder square, I suggest you keep an eye on your possessions.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_040: Oh, 'tis you again. Was there something else?
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_041: Good heavens, this is the ring! You took it back from that beast!?
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_042: Thank you! Thank you ever so much!
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_GRAHATIA_000_043: I see you've already resolved the situation, .
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_044: You must be the friend who first noticed me. I owe you my gratitude as well.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_045: (-Euclase-)My name is Euclase. I was planning to propose to my beloved with the ring, and thanks to you, I can do just that.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_GRAHATIA_000_046: Well, well, that is cause to rejoice indeed. Did the two of you meet here?
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_047: (-Euclase-)No, we were sweethearts in life. But I died young, and she only followed me decades later.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_048: (-Euclase-)Even then, our reunion wasn't yet to be, for the aether shortage means not everyone can be recreated. I had to wait until but recently to see her again.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_GRAHATIA_000_049: A reunion beyond death... Such a thing would be possible here, I suppose.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_051: (-Euclase-)While our memories are stored in the terminals, less than one in ten of us has been given form at present.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_052: (-Euclase-)I myself have been reincarnated three times now, and each time there seems to be fewer of us. It's fairly a miracle that my beloved and I could meet.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_GRAHATIA_000_053: I see. Given the circumstances, the chances of existing concurrently with an acquaintance would be slim indeed─and slimmer still for a loved one.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_054: (-Euclase-)Truly. That is why I decided to do that which I failed to do in life: ask her for her hand.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_055: (-Euclase-)With her regulator, she was spared the sadness of my death. Even so, she never took another man for the rest of her days.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_056: (-Euclase-)She told me that, although she couldn't remember me afterwards, she could never shake the feeling that someone precious had been a part of her life. The sweet fool...
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_057: (-Euclase-)The ring represents a yearning I have long carried, though I know full well it is only a construct. Like these bodies of ours.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_058: (-Euclase-)...There is a part of me that wonders if this is wrong. Not that I expect us to exist forever, even in this form.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_059: (-Euclase-)But to be with the one I love once again and make her happy... However wrong this world may be, I have nothing but gratitude for Queen Sphene.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_060: (-Euclase-)Now, if you'll excuse me, I shall go and make that proposal. I've made her wait long enough as it is.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_061: (-Euclase-)This isn't much, but please accept it as a token of my thanks.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_063: (-Euclase-)For the gondola. To ensure that order is preserved, we must observe the proper way of doing things even here. It's very much like Queen Sphene to make it so, is it not?
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_EUCLASE_000_064: (-Euclase-)Take care, my friends─and see to it you have no regrets!
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_GRAHATIA_000_065: Well, I think it's about time we rejoined the others...but what do you say we go by gondola?
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_GRAHATIA_000_066: I expect it won't be possible to do so once the terminal has been shut down.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_GRAHATIA_000_067: Come then, let us seek a vessel at the pier.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_GRAHATIA_000_070: I've presented our tickets. While I'm no stranger to boats, I can't help but feel a little excited!
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_GONDOLIER04950_000_: We can push off at any time. Mind the gap when you board.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_GRAHATIA_000_090: 'Twas nice to chat with you again, my friend. It feels as though it has been some time.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_GRAHATIA_000_091: Having met Endless like Euclase, I feel I've come to understand Sphene a little better.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_GRAHATIA_000_092: Anyone would wish those dear to them a long and happy future, and she bears the burden of this desire for all her subjects.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_GRAHATIA_000_093: Yet as Krile said, we too have people we cannot lose...
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_GRAHATIA_000_094: Come, . We can get to the fountain via yonder bridge.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_GRAHATIA_000_095: Now that I look at it closely, the clock has no hands. On account of there being no need to keep track of time, perhaps.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_CAHCIUA_000_100: Finished talking to the locals, have you? I'd be keen to hear your impressions.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_WUKLAMAT_000_110: Krile and Erenville are still out and about, it seems.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_CAHCIUA_000_111: So, how was it? What are your impressions of those you met?
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_WUKLAMAT_000_112: It was great! Everyone was so happy, just talking to them made me happy too.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_CAHCIUA_000_115: While it is a miracle after a fashion, the system strives to make such encounters possible.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_CAHCIUA_000_116: If you meet someone you know, it's probably not by chance. The terminals hold information on unfulfilled longings, and use them to orchestrate reunions like Euclase's.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_GRAHATIA_000_117: I see... That the terminals can do this is impressive indeed. But there is one thing I do not understand.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_GRAHATIA_000_118: According to Euclase, his beloved passed away decades after he did, yet they appeared to be of like age.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_CAHCIUA_000_119: Ah, yes. People are not necessarily recreated as they were when they passed away.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_CAHCIUA_000_120: The appearance of an Endless, I speculate, reflects the happiest period in their life.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_WUKLAMAT_000_121: Is that the case for you, then? Not that I can tell how old you are, as slowly as your people age.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_CAHCIUA_000_122: I'm not sure, to be honest. I have so many happy times, it's hard to know which one applies.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_CAHCIUA_000_123: I'm insufferably inquisitive. Whether it's nature or technology, I can't help but want to learn more about the world around me.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_CAHCIUA_000_124: You might say that discovery is what gives me joy. It made me happy in life...and may have been a blessing afterwards.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_CAHCIUA_000_125: The other Endless are content with what they have here, you see. They don't develop the urge to leave.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_CAHCIUA_000_126: But I was so determined to see the world again that I taught myself how to gain control of a vessel and ventured outside.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_CAHCIUA_000_128: Well, that's enough about me for now. While we wait for Krile and Elene'shpya, I have a favor to ask of you.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_CAHCIUA_000_129: As you may have noticed, most of the fountains here aren't running. That's because, despite its shiny appearance, this city is centuries old and everything is dreadfully run-down.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_CAHCIUA_000_130: The fountains apparently used to put on magnificent shows, and I was hoping that we could get them working again.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_CAHCIUA_000_131: Giving the control units a dose of aether should be enough to restore the circuits and switch them on. But being an Endless, I'm unable to do that.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_CAHCIUA_000_132: I realize this is a selfish request, but at the last, I'd like to treat the people here to the display.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_WUKLAMAT_000_133: Just leave it to us! I'd love to see the show myself!
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_CAHCIUA_000_134: Thank you. The control units are built into the surrounding lampposts. If you tend to a few of them each, you'll be done before you know it.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_CAHCIUA_000_135: Once the fountains are fixed, we can round up Elene'shpya and Krile and head to the Hydro Terminal together.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_GRAHATIA_000_136: So the time is nigh... Come, let us set to it.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_WUKLAMAT_000_145: It looks like ordinary stone, but inside it's electrope. Talk about confusing.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_CAHCIUA_000_150: The fountain shows are supposedly magnificent. Perhaps they'll impress even my fussy little bunbun.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_GRAHATIA_000_170: The show was breathtaking, was it not?
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_CAHCIUA_000_175: I've made a wonderful memory. Thank you.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_WUKLAMAT_000_190: Just to make sure, Cahciua─you're not going to disappear when we shut this terminal down, right?
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_CAHCIUA_000_191: Not just yet. It's the Aero Terminal in the northwestern zone that holds my memories.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_CAHCIUA_000_193: You already know how to operate the terminal. It's the same process as the fountain's control.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_CAHCIUA_000_194: I leave it for you to decide when to shut it down. Doing so will cause the Endless here to fade away, together with this beautiful scenery.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_CAHCIUA_000_195: If you still wish to speak with people or see the sights, you'll want to do that first.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_SYSTEM_000_196: Upon shutting down the Hydro Terminal, it will not be possible to restore Canal Town to its present form.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_SYSTEM_000_197: Are you certain you wish to shut down the terminal?
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_GRAHATIA_000_200: I had braced myself for it, but to actually erase the Endless is...hard.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_KRILE_000_210: This is Living Memory's true appearance...
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_WUKLAMAT_000_220: This hurts. I'd be lying if I said otherwise.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_WUKLAMAT_000_221: But the only way now is forward...
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_GRAHATIA_000_001: I had braced myself for it, but to actually erase the Endless is...hard.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_KRILE_000_002: This is Living Memory's true appearance...
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_WUKLAMAT_000_004: I chose this path. I won't halt my steps.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_CAHCIUA_000_005: Don't torment yourselves so. I asked this of you, so the burden lies with me.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_CAHCIUA_000_006: And remember, we Endless are but facsimiles crafted from memories. You needn't feel guilt for erasing us.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_KRILE_000_007: Be that as it may, it's so hard to say good-bye...
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_WUKLAMAT_000_008: It is. Nonetheless, it's our duty as the living to know and remember them.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_WUKLAMAT_000_009: So let's pull ourselves together and keep at it. Keep seeking them out.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_CAHCIUA_000_010: I'd appreciate that. Come, let's head to the next zone.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_CAHCIUA_000_011: Yesterland, it's called, and another zip line at the Gate of Remembrance will take you there.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_CAHCIUA_000_012: Ah, but I ought to mention...
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_CAHCIUA_000_013: While shutting down a terminal should erase the Endless bound to it, those with strong, unresolved feelings may linger for a time.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_CAHCIUA_000_014: If you encounter such individuals, perhaps you could lend them an ear. For their hopes are proof that they once lived.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_KRILE_000_015: Yesterland has an altogether different look. Each zone has a distinct character, 'twould seem.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_GRAHATIA_000_016: That lively place yonder appears to be Yesterland. I wonder what manner of folk we will find there.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_ERENVILLE_000_017: ...Worry not, . I don't intend to halt my steps either.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_WUKLAMAT_000_018: Cahciua's already gone ahead. Let's get going too.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_YESTERLANDGUARD_000: System reboot complete. <bleep> <bloop> Error. Error. User registration...conf-f-firmed.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_YESTERLANDGUARD_100: I bid you welcome to Yesterland, where the dreams of children and inner children alike come true! Please enjoy your stay!
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_WUKLAMAT_000_020: Amazing... Is this also a recreation of an actual place?
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_CAHCIUA_000_021: After a fashion. Yesterland is themed upon a period of peace, before the Storm Surge had engulfed the world in conflict.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_CAHCIUA_000_022: It was a golden age for Alexandria, and they've captured it here in the form of an amusement park.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_A1_002_023: Tell me I'm not the only one who's excited!
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_A1_004_023: It feels like the Gold Saucer.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_A1_005_023: I'm put in mind of Lyhe Mheg.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_GRAHATIA_010_023: Haha, I'm not ashamed to admit I'm excited as well, and I imagine this is how we're intended to feel.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_GRAHATIA_020_023: So it goes with such places. But at the very least, it doesn't appear overly crowded.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_GRAHATIA_030_023: It does, doesn't it? It's exciting to simply step through the entrance, and I imagine this is how we're intended to feel.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_GRAHATIA_040_023: You mean you've visited the pixies' Garden of Dreams!? Thank goodness you are still with us...
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_GRAHATIA_050_023: 'Tis all too easy to lose oneself in such a wondrous place. By the time you think to leave, dozens of years may have already passed.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_GRAHATIA_000_024: And perhaps the very same could be said of this place...
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_CAHCIUA_000_025: On the far side of Yesterland is a castle. That's where the terminal is located, in the basement.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_CAHCIUA_000_026: I'll go on ahead and wait for you there. Take what time you need to get acquainted with the locals.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_WUKLAMAT_000_028: Like before, we'll speak with the Endless. We'll learn what's dear to them before doing what we must.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_WUKLAMAT_000_029: Right, let's start by exploring and get our bearings!
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_SYSTEM_000_060: The beautiful artwork on the ground depicts a swirl of stars. Perhaps such a sight was once visible in the Alexandrian night sky.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_SYSTEM_000_061: Appearing to be a domicile, this building resembles those that lie submerged in Heritage Found. The windows are composed of a colorful array of stained glass.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_CHILDENDLESS04951_0: Oh, hello there, ! We're just talking about Ser Otis. Do you know him?
He's a bit odd and doesn't get jokes, but he's really strong and can vanquish fiends in a flash!
He's probably out there fighting right now. When I grow up, I want to be strong like him!
When I grow up, I want to be strong like Ser Otis! I'm going to protect Queen Sphene!
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_SYSTEM_000_070: The “Ser Otis” the children spoke of calls to mind another Otis. It might be worth seeking the man out to confirm his identity.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_SYSTEM_000_080: A man is engaged in battle with fiends. He may need a helping hand.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_OTIS_000_085: 'Tis plain you are no stranger to battle. If you would kindly tend to this fiend, I shall protect the children!
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_WUKLAMAT_000_110: Gods, what a surprise to meet Otis.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_WUKLAMAT_000_111: He might not be the exact same as the one we met in Heritage Found, but still...
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_WUKLAMAT_000_112: Thinking back, he mentioned that he was a test subject for soul preservation. That might explain why he's here in this way.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_WUKLAMAT_000_113: In any case, I'd love to talk to him some more. There are some things I need to tell him.
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_WUKLAMAT_000_001: Right, let's go after Otis. He's bound to know about the past─about the Alexandria of old as well as Sphene when she was a living person.
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_WUKLAMAT_000_002: The problem is he doesn't seem to be in the mood to talk... Perhaps we can offer to help him with this Founding Celebration─that might warm him to us.
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_WUKLAMAT_000_003: He set off this way. Come on!
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_OTIS_000_010: “Are you harmed”...or “Are you unharmed”? Hmmm, the latter, methinks...
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_OTIS_000_011: To which Her Highness replies with her winsome smile...
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_OTIS_000_012: “I am thanks to you, my dearest Otis!”
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_A1_000_001: Sorry, I didn't mean to interrupt your rehearsal...
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_A1_000_002: Shall I play the part of the queen?
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_OTIS_000_015: 'Tis fine, I shouldn't have trouble with the lines come the performance. After all, the script is my very own work!
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_OTIS_000_016: I appreciate the offer, but there is no need. The script is my own work, you see, and I know Princess Sphene's lines even better than mine own!
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_OTIS_000_017: There is, however, a scene with which I struggle...
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_WUKLAMAT_000_018: Hey, this looks like fun! Can I join in?
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_OTIS_000_019: Hmph, you as well? I thought I said that I was busy!
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_WUKLAMAT_000_020: You did, but we thought that maybe we could help. You're getting ready for the Founding Celebration, yes?
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_OTIS_000_021: I am... And if truth be told, we are in dire need of assistance.
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_OTIS_000_022: For this edition of the celebration, there is to be a play about the history of our realm for the children's enjoyment.
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_OTIS_000_023: But with fewer of us being given form, we haven't enough hands to carry out the production. Thus have I been tasked with not only writing the script, but performing as myself besides.
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_WUKLAMAT_000_024: Calm down, it's alright. We really are happy to help any way we can. Just tell us what to do.
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_OTIS_000_025: For the same reason the production is shorthanded, it has become difficult to gather a crowd. I'd be obliged if you could spread the word of the play to the children in Yesterland.
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_WUKLAMAT_000_026: Consider it done! We'll take ourselves around and talk to younglings.
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_OTIS_000_027: Splendid! Oh, and to better appeal to them, we have adorable animal costumes for you to wear─together with your cheeriest bearing, of course!
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_WUKLAMAT_000_028: A-Alright. Anything to make the children happy!
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_OTIS_000_029: Let's see... Ah, yes, this one should be suitable for you.
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_WUKLAMAT_000_030: Ohhh, it's a glamour! I was confused for a moment when you handed me the device!

TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_WUKLAMAT_000_035: What's yours going to be, I wonder...
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_OTIS_000_040: Ready, are you? Then let us have you don your costume at once.
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_OTIS_000_041: Marvelous! There's not a child that would fail to be delighted!
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_WUKLAMAT_000_042: Hehe, it really does suit you!
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_OTIS_000_043: Now that you are suitably attired, I pray you go forth and promote our play to the children. Concentrate your efforts here, in the vicinity of the air cab station, and see that you make it fun!
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_OTIS_000_044: In the meantime, I shall continue my own preparations here. Should your costumes wear off, I shall provide you with another.

TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_OTIS_000_050: Ah, I see your costume has worn off. Here, I shall give you another.

TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_WUKLAMAT_000_125: Right, let's give it our best─and have us some fun!

TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_CAHCIUA_000_202: We're more than memories stored in machines. So long as someone remembers us and carries on our legacy, we'll never truly fade away.

TEXT_KINGMF112_04957_KRILE_000_160: All this time, my grandfather was the common thread between us...
TEXT_KINGMF112_04957_GRAHATIA_000_165: Do not mind us and just enjoy yourselves. We shall explore a little more and then make our way to the terminal.
TEXT_KINGMF112_04957_CAHCIUA_000_170: Here it is, the Cleyra Museum of Nature. The main building is closed due to the aether shortage, but happily they're still offering leisure flights.
TEXT_KINGMF112_04957_CAHCIUA_000_171: And these are the fellows that will bear us. How adorable!
TEXT_KINGMF112_04957_ERENVILLE_000_172: They don't look capable of flight...
TEXT_KINGMF112_04957_CAHCIUA_000_173: Ahaha! Come now, you know better than to judge a creature by its appearance. This will be great, I just know it!
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_ERENVILLE_000_001: I know one shouldn't judge by appearance, but still...
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_CLEYRACURATOR_000_0: Hello there! Come to ride the mehwapyarras, have you?
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_CAHCIUA_000_010: Begging your pardon, but this is where you can go on leisure flights, yes?
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_CLEYRACURATOR_000_0: Indeed it is! Bearing you will be our adorable mehwapyarras, who are especially trained by a Turali friend!
Just say the word, and we will send you up, up, and away!
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_CAHCIUA_000_013: And there you have it! Shall we, then?
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_ERENVILLE_000_015: It seems I'll have to trust to the theory of ancestral levitational predisposition...
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_ERENVILLE_000_020: In case you are unfamiliar, the theory holds that all life-forms have an innate capacity for levitational magicks. While said magicks generally remain latent, they may manifest in the ability to fly.
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_CAHCIUA_000_025: My guess is that the mehwapyarras themselves cannot fly, but rather their saddles are imbued with levitation magicks.
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_CLEYRACURATOR_000_0: You are ready? Then go ahead and mount up. The mehwapyarras fly a set route, so you need only relax and enjoy the view!
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_ERENVILLE_000_033: I'll be damned... They really do fly...
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_CAHCIUA_000_034: Hey, the way we're flying in formation, don't we look like migrating birds?
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_CAHCIUA_000_036: Speaking of migrating birds, the mallard is where your name comes from. Did I ever tell you that?
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_ERENVILLE_000_037: That I knew, but I learned it from the shamaness, not from you.
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_CAHCIUA_000_038: A migrating bird can fly anywhere it desires─even across oceans to distant continents.
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_CAHCIUA_000_039: And you've done just that, my clever mallard!
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_ERENVILLE_000_040: I'd thank you not to call me that!
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_CAHCIUA_000_041: Oh dear, is it over already? Time really does fly when you have fun!
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_CAHCIUA_000_042: What a joy to see Living Memory from up high!
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_CAHCIUA_000_044: Ahhh, that was wonderful! An experience worth saving for the very end!
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_CAHCIUA_000_045: You two enjoyed yourselves as well, I trust?
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_ERENVILLE_000_046: It was enjoyable enough, I suppose.
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_CAHCIUA_000_047: From my fussy bunbun, that's high praise. I'm glad I invited you and .
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_CAHCIUA_000_050: If I could, I'd go for another hundred rides, but I must settle for the one.
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_CAHCIUA_000_051: It's time we were headed to the Aero Terminal. If there are still things you wish to do, you'll want to do them now.
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_CAHCIUA_000_052: When you're ready, make your way along the path yonder. I'll find the others and let them know the same.
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_CLEYRACURATOR_000_0: Please come and fly again any time!
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_ERENVILLE_000_060: She's only a facsimile constructed from her memories. I understand this.
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_ERENVILLE_000_061: But when she's right there, as alive and spirited as I've ever known her, how am I supposed to do it? How am I supposed to erase her?
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_ERENVILLE_000_062: Does she even know how it tears me apart?
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_WUKLAMAT_000_070: We saw you from below. It looked like you were having fun.
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_KRILE_000_075: It will be hard, but let us send Cahciua off with a smile.
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_CAHCIUA_000_090: I couldn't have asked for more fulfilling final hours than these.
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_CAHCIUA_000_095: I'm so happy to have met you, . You and everyone. Thank you for the memories.
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_CAHCIUA_000_100: And thank you for watching over my Elene'shpya. He'll be fine now, I know it.
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_ERENVILLE_000_105: No more doubts. I will shut the terminal down.
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_KRILE_000_110: Let's see our task through to the end.
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_GRAHATIA_000_115: We carry on, with their hopes and memories in our hearts.
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_WUKLAMAT_000_120: We'll leave this to you, Erenville.
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_ERENVILLE_000_121: Aye, I won't waver. Not anymore.
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_ERENVILLE_000_122: If you're ready yourselves, then so am I.
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_SYSTEM_000_123: Upon shutting down the Aero Terminal, it will not be possible to restore Windspath Gardens to its present form.
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_SYSTEM_000_124: Are you certain you wish to shut down the terminal?
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_KRILE_000_130: We won't let Cahciua's hopes be in vain!
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_ERENVILLE_000_135: No time for tears... Just as well.
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_WUKLAMAT_000_140: Not a moment too soon... It's as if she's saying she won't let us do as we please anymore.
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_WUKLAMAT_000_141: Through our time here, we've come to know what it is Sphene seeks to protect.
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_WUKLAMAT_000_142: But that doesn't change what we have to do!
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_KRILE_000_005: We won't let Cahciua's hopes be in vain!
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_ERENVILLE_000_010: No time for tears... Just as well.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_WUKLAMAT_000_020: We'll carry out Cahciua's plan. It's our best chance at stopping Sphene.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_GRAHATIA_000_021: It will be dangerous, I shouldn't doubt. We are all prepared, I assume?
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_WUKLAMAT_000_022: That goes without saying. Come, we head to the Meso Terminal!
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_GRAHATIA_000_025: Whatever it takes, we must protect that which we hold dear.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_KRILE_000_030: My parents are watching over us, I'm sure of it. As is my grandfather.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_ERENVILLE_000_035: I will do my part too.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_WUKLAMAT_000_040: No good. It seems we can't simply shut down the Meso Terminal like the others.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_ERENVILLE_000_041: Not surprising in the least. My mother did tell us its defenses are tight.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_ERENVILLE_000_042: But she also left me a means of circumventing them: a program that will send your souls into the terminal's memory banks.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_ERENVILLE_000_043: Therein lies a virtual domain generated by Sphene's memories.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_GRAHATIA_000_044: So we would venture into this domain, and thence seek out and stop Sphene.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_KRILE_000_046: If our souls are transferred in their entirety, dying in that domain would be no different from dying outside of it. There is no guarantee of safe return.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_GRAHATIA_000_047: Nonetheless, that is a risk we must take.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_WUKLAMAT_000_048: We've already come this far, and I'll be damned if I'm going to turn back now.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_WUKLAMAT_000_049: By meeting the Endless, I've gained a better understanding of Sphene and the burden she bears.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_WUKLAMAT_000_050: I want to say a few things to her when we meet again...even if it doesn't make a difference.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_WUKLAMAT_000_051: Whatever happens, we won't let Sphene walk her misguided path any longer!
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_A1_100_001: For those we've yet to meet!
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_A1_100_002: It's our duty as the living!
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_ERENVILLE_000_052: I'll do all I can to provide support. Mother has instructed me on her program as well as the world within the terminal.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_ERENVILLE_000_053: I'll also keep an eye on your bodies while you are gone.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_ERENVILLE_000_054: Should it come to it, though, I won't hesitate to call on our comrades outside. I'm acutely aware of my limits.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_GRAHATIA_000_055: Upon entering the terminal, we will most certainly meet with fierce resistance from its defenses.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_GRAHATIA_000_056: Then there is Sphene herself. In order to initiate interdimensional fusion, she said that she intends to erase her own memories. What manner of entity she will become as a result, none can say.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_GRAHATIA_000_057: And if she invokes the key and opens portals to other worlds, she would have access to vast amounts of aether to bring to bear against us. We must be prepared for anything.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_WUKLAMAT_000_058: Whatever we encounter won't change our objective. And it won't change what I'll do.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_WUKLAMAT_000_059: Come, my friends! It's time to settle this!
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_ERENVILLE_000_060: Come back alive, do you hear? Else I can't repay you for everything you've done.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_A1_000_002: Form a party and enter Alexandria.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_WUKLAMAT_000_070: A part of me still clings to the hope that we can avoid fighting Sphene. But even if we can't, I want to see her people and their legacy live on.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_WUKLAMAT_000_071: I don't know what awaits at the end of this path. But together, we'll walk it all the way!
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_GRAHATIA_000_075: Since we averted the Final Days, it has been one existential threat after another. And now lives in all reflections hang in the balance.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_GRAHATIA_000_076: But considering the key and the power it wields, I cannot help but feel a sense of destiny in our being here. Would you not agree, my friend?
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_KRILE_000_080: As much as we've been able to learn, there is still much and more we do not know about the key.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_KRILE_000_081: What I do know, however, is that interdimensional fusion must be stopped. This is the mission I've inherited from my parents, and I will see it done!
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_ERENVILLE_000_090: Homecomings are usually uneventful affairs. This time, it was anything but for me.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_ERENVILLE_000_091: But all's well that ends well, and we have you to thank for that.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_BOLWRURUQ_000_095: Welcome to the For'ard Cabins, good . While I am still in training, I will endeavor to ensure that your stay with us is comfortable.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_WUKLAMAT_000_100: Well, as much as I'd love to keep chatting, I need to get going. Still a heap of things to do, and it wouldn't do to leave it all to Koana.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_ERENVILLE_000_101: By the way, did Gulool Ja decide to remain in Solution Nine?
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_WUKLAMAT_000_102: He did. I said that he can consider Tuliyollal his home, but he's more comfortable over there. Shale keeps an eye on him for us.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_WUKLAMAT_000_103: But we'll visit him as often as we can. He still needs our support, especially while he's agonizing over his inherited authority.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_WUKLAMAT_000_104: Though I told him he needn't make a decision right away, we can't postpone it forever either.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_WUKLAMAT_000_105: I'll do whatever I can to help Gulool Ja, as well as everyone inside the dome.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_WUKLAMAT_000_106: I promised as much to Sphene...
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_ERENVILLE_000_107: For my part, I'll be keeping to Tural for a time. Among other things, I'd like to look into the problem with the wildlife in Shaaloani.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_ERENVILLE_000_108: So if you get the urge, , let's go on another journey together. There's still plenty of places I would like to show you.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_WUKLAMAT_000_109: Now that sounds like fun! If you ever have need of me, I'll come running!
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_WUKLAMAT_100_109: Oh, and before I forget, I also have a gift for you. Can you guess what it is?
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_WUKLAMAT_110_109: An alpaca! It comes from Tobli's stable, of course, and it's as sure-footed as they come!
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_WUKLAMAT_120_109: Perfect for an adventurer who's always on the move, eh? Here, this is the whistle for calling it.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_WUKLAMAT_000_110: Right, I'll really get going now, but I'm sure we'll meet again soon. Till next time, take care!
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_METEM_000_700: (-Man's Voice-)Fellow citizens of Alexandria. Ever since our beloved queen's passing, you have understandably abided in grief. Sorrow darkens your once-bright faces.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_METEM_000_701: (-Man's Voice-)But is this what Her Majesty would have wished to see? No, most assuredly not. You know this to be true.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_METEM_000_702: (-Man's Voice-)If we are to honor her memory, we must reclaim our smiles. To that end...
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_METEM_000_703: (-Wrangler-hatted Man-)That's right, friends─after a long hiatus, I am pleased to announce the grand reopening of the Arcadion!
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_METEM_000_704: (-Wrangler-hatted Man-)The realm's finest fighters stand ready to entertain you in glorious and thrilling combat! Come and join us, I bid you, and let your cares be forgotten!
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_SYSTEM_000_800: You have completed the main scenario quest “Dawntrail”! Quests to unlock new content have now become available in Tuliyollal and Solution Nine.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_SYSTEM_000_801: Additionally, you may now enter Alexandria with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_SYSTEM_000_802: Rest well, seeker of the unknown, for many and more adventures await you!
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_BOLWURUQ_000_001: Ah, it is a pleasure as always, . Have you been able to relax lately?
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_BOLWURUQ_100_008: Wonderful. As busy as you have been, with the rite of succession among other things, you deserve an opportunity to experience Tuliyollal at a more leisurely pace.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_BOLWURUQ_000_009: Sampling the tacos at Xbalyav Ty'e is one such way to do so. They're made the traditional way and laden with fillings, and are absolutely sublime! If you have an empty stomach, the owner, Br'uk Evu, will look after you!
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_BOLWURUQ_000_010: Ahhh, talking about the tacos at Xbalyav Ty'e has given me a craving... If you have time and an empty stomach, do go and have some for me!
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_BRUKEVU_000_100: Well, if it isn't ! Alone today, are you?
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_BRUKEVU_000_101: I see, I see. If you have a hankering for tacos, then they're on the house. Consider it thanks for everything you've done for Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_BRUKEVU_000_102: I see, I see. If you have a hankering for tacos, then they're on the house. Consider it a token of gratitude for your help tracking down those treasures.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_BRUKEVU_000_103: I see, I see. If you have a hankering for tacos, then they're on the house. Consider it thanks for bringing down the Passage of the Unbound.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_BRUKEVU_000_107: Go ahead and find a table. I'll bring you your meal as soon as it's ready.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_BRUKEVU_000_110: Your red-haired friend has become something of a regular. Rare is the day he won't take one with him on a morning stroll.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_MAN05244A_000_200: (-Gregarious Man-)You still love tacos, I hope? Heh, you ate so many when you turned five, you could barely move afterwards. Remember that?
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_MAN05244B_000_201: No, not really. That was thirty years ago for me...
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_MAN05244A_000_202: Right... Sorry, it's still strange for me too. Just the other day you were a little boy, clinging to your mother's skirt as you set off for Yyasulani...and now you're a man grown with a face full of hair.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_MAN05244A_000_203: Even so, I knew you were my son the instant I saw you. We're still family, and you can always rely on me.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_MAN05244B_000_204: Relying... That feels like the only thing I'm doing right now. On you and everyone else. I can't even start a fire without assistance at my new job...
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_MAN05244B_000_205: Back in Alexandria, we had electrope. If I needed fire, all I had to do was press a button. Everything was at our fingertips.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_MAN05244B_000_206: But here, I'm helpless. A culinarian who can't even light the stove. The way the others in the kitchen stared at me... Gods, I'd never felt so embarrassed.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_MAN05244A_000_207: I'm sorry to hear that... I'd been told the tales, but it seems life is really different within the dome.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_MAN05244B_000_208: My wife and children─I was thinking I'd have them join me once things had settled, but at this rate...
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_MAN05244A_100_208: I say you send for them. If they're your family, then they're mine too. I'll do whatever's necessary to make it work.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_209: I didn't mean to overhear, but it seems you're having trouble readjusting to life in Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_211: To aid folk like yourself, we've established a support group at the Wing of Reflection. There, you can learn the skills you need to live outside the dome.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_212: It isn't easy being back, I know. But I'm hopeful that they can make things easier.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_MAN05244B_000_213: That's exactly what I need! I'll definitely seek this group out─and I'll bring my family with me! Thank you!
