TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_214: Oh, look who it is! I was just about to go and find you, .
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_100_214: You don't mind the company, I hope? I could use a bite to eat myself.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_215: Ahhh, the tacos here never disappoint!
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_216: So, what've you been up to lately?
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_A3_000_001: I've been exploring Tural with my trusty alpaca.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_A3_000_002: I've been catching up on sleep.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_A3_000_003: I've been helping out around Wachumeqimeqi.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_A3_000_004: I've been working to recover some stolen artifacts.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_A3_000_005: I've been making a name for myself at the Arcadion.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_218: Hehe, I'm glad that the spitting devil is serving you well, and you're still enjoying seeing the sights.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_100_218: Given everything we've been through, I don't blame you. But once you've had your fill, I'm sure you'll be itching to get back into the thick of things.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_200_218: I've heard stories about someone helping out the businesses. Seeing how well they're faring now, you've clearly done a fine job.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_300_218: I've been reviewing reports from the Landsguard. Given my responsibilities, I'm not in a position to chase criminals abroad, so I needed someone else to take care of the matter. I'm glad that someone is you!
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_400_218: You're fighting in the arena in Alexandria!? By facing off against tough opponents, I'd wager you've honed your skills even further!
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_219: As for myself, I'm being kept busy with duties at the palace. But whenever I find a moment, I like to walk the streets and talk to the people.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_220: That way, I can better understand the problems they have, and share them with Koana to figure out solutions.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_221: I was on one such walk just now. And as I mentioned, I was hoping to find you.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_222: Koana and I have something we want to discuss with you─as Dawnservants. Do you have time to come to the palace?
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_223: Great. I'll go on ahead. Please come and join us once you've finished here.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_250: It seems Koana's gone somewhere. Sorry...
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_SUNPERCHGATEKEEPER_: , it is always an honor. Vow Koana has stepped away to attend to a pressing matter, but he should join you within before long.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_ALISAIE_000_401: Vow Koana summoned us. Though if truth be told, Alphinaud and I have been seeing him quite regularly of late.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_ALPHINAUD_000_402: He asked us to share our knowledge of Hannish culture, you see, in hopes of further strengthening your alliance. We were of course happy to oblige him.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_GRAHATIA_000_403: Krile and I were likewise summoned. Otherwise we've been carrying on with our work, compiling information on the golden city.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_KRILE_000_404: My grandfather embarked on his investigation twenty years ago. With our report, we shall finish what he started.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_ALISAIE_000_405: Lest you wonder, Thancred and Urianger have left to resume their tour of Tural.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_ALISAIE_000_406: Y'shtola, meanwhile, is back to researching cross-rift travel. She was here just a few days ago to get Koana's permission to investigate Living Memory.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_ALISAIE_000_407: By the way, she mentioned wanting to take a look at the key in your keeping at some point.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_ALISAIE_000_408: If the look she had in her eyes was any indication, I suggest you brace yourself for when she comes calling. You're like to be stuck with her for a while.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_ALPHINAUD_000_409: As for Estinien...we know neither where he is nor what he is doing. Some things never change.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_KRILE_000_411: Think nothing of it. We took advantage of the time to catch up.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_ALISAIE_000_412: So, what can we do for you? Hopefully present company is enough for whatever it is you need.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_KOANA_000_413: The matter for which I have summoned you pertains to Alexandria.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_KOANA_000_414: A state funeral will soon be held in Solution Nine to mourn the passing of Queen Sphene. King Gulool Ja and his administration have invited us to attend.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_KOANA_000_415: While certain issues remain unresolved between our nations, such as the treatment of Yyasulani, I see no reason not to attend.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_GRAHATIA_000_416: For generations, the Alexandrians lived without even the awareness of death. I wouldn't have expected them to have funeral rites still.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_KOANA_000_417: Apparently, the members of Oblivion unearthed records of ceremonies that were conducted in the Alexandria of old. It was they who put forth the proposal that the queen be thus honored.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_418: Leave it to that lot to think of such things.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_419: The people of Alexandria no longer forget the departed. They're being confronted with the idea of death for the first time. I suspect our friends wanted to do something for them.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_KRILE_000_420: Though Sphene was but a simulacrum, she was nonetheless a pillar for her people. The pain of her passing must run deep.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_KOANA_000_421: Indeed. A funeral will give Alexandrians the chance to come together to express their grief, that they might overcome it.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_422: I wasn't sure at first, but I've decided to go. Not only to be there for Gulool Ja, but to put this chapter behind us.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_KOANA_000_423: That I requested your presence was none other than to see if you wish to attend the funeral. You knew Sphene as well, after all...
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_A1_000_001: I think I should go too.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_A1_000_002: Sometimes I wonder if there wasn't another way...
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_425: Because you consider yourself responsible for her demise, I take it. But that's not a burden you bear alone.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_426: Here's my idea. As Vow, I'll attend the funeral as a representative of Tuliyollal. Meanwhile, you can go in a personal capacity, and watch over the people as they mourn.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_427: You and me both. But we made our choices and are responsible for what comes of them. As Vow, I'll attend the funeral in an official capacity. I owe it to the Alexandrian people to bear witness to their grief.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_428: I'd like it if you could be there to watch over everything, like you did all through the rite of succession.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_429: Because of your role in her demise, I take it. But we had no choice. We had to stop her from killing countless innocents.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_430: I won't force you to attend the funeral if it makes you feel uncomfortable. But while I represent Tuliyollal in an official capacity, I'd like it if you could be there to watch over everything.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_KRILE_000_431: I feel the rest of us should go too. Regardless of the reason, the fact remains that we deprived Alexandria of a beloved ruler.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_KRILE_000_432: It's only right that we remember who Sphene was, to her people and to others, so let us stand with you.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_433: Then it's decided. Let's head to Solution Nine and look for Gulool Ja in the Backroom.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_KOANA_000_435: Though I too would ideally attend the funeral, given the circumstances, I think it is best that Lamaty'i represents us.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_KOANA_000_440: Besides, I need to be on hand to oversee the city's repairs, which is taking longer than expected. When that work is complete, we will finally look into installing new thrones.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_KOANA_000_445: But to have Father's throne here still... It makes me feel he is close by. I'm quite happy for it to remain for a while.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_GEODE_000_450: It's good of you to come. We're expecting a large attendance for the funeral─the venue isn't like to hold everyone at once.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_GEODE_000_455: But the altar will remain for those who couldn't be present during the ceremony. We ourselves plan to go and pay our respects afterwards.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_SHALE_000_460: Glad to see the invitation reached you. As you may have heard, we were able to find data on forgotten funeral customs amidst old records.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_SHALE_000_465: It appears to have been preserved by those who rued the loss of culture due to the proliferation of regulators. We're grateful for their foresight.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_GULOOLJA_000_500: Ah, you came for the funeral!
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_501: Of course. I'm the only one who'll officially take part, though. The others will watch over the proceedings.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_502: So, how have you been? It's been a while since my last visit.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_GULOOLJA_000_503: I'm good. Shale is always teaching me new things.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_GULOOLJA_000_504: Recently, I've learned about Everkeep's systems and the mechanical soldiers. It's knowledge I'll need to use my authority properly.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_WUKLAMAT_000_505: Studious as always, I see. By way of a treat, I've brought you gateau au chocolat. It's a kind of cake. I think you'll like it.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_GULOOLJA_000_506: Thank you, Lamaty'i. And thank you for coming. I've never been to a funeral before, so I feel less nervous having you here.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_ALISAIE_000_507: Out of curiosity, what's the custom in Alexandria? In our world, it's common to offer flowers to the departed.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_SHALE_000_508: It's much the same here according to the records. Flowers will be distributed to all attendees.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_KRILE_000_509: Considering that all the worlds used to be one, the practice of offering flowers may well share the same ancient origin. Fascinating, wouldn't you say?
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_WUKLAMAT_000_001: Papa always said he didn't want a somber funeral, so we celebrated his life together with our victory. I'm sure he would've loved it...
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_WUKLAMAT_000_002: I like to think he was watching us from the world beyond, filling his cup every time we filled our own.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_ALPHINAUD_000_005: Although I've been in the Backroom before, there was no time to see the sights. I should like to take a closer look at the equipment.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_ALISAIE_000_010: It's a relief to see that Gulool Ja is doing well. He's been through too much for one so young.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_KRILE_000_015: From a group that plotted to undermine a tyrant king from the shadows to one that aids their fellow citizens in the open... Oblivion has come a long way.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_GRAHATIA_000_020: For the people to take it on themselves to organize and hold the funeral... It speaks to their enduring love for Sphene.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_GULOOLJA_000_040: The flowers are being handed out at Praxis Park. I'm thinking of heading over there now.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_WUKLAMAT_000_041: We'll join you. There's a man I would like to speak with─Gossan. He was apparently Sphene's aide, and the one who sent us the invitation.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_WUKLAMAT_000_045: All correspondence was being handled by the Wing of Reflection, so this is my first time speaking with Gossan.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_ALPHINAUD_000_055: Wuk Lamat's attendance will surely help strengthen relations between the two nations. I get the strong impression that both Tuliyollal and Alexandria wish to put this tragic past behind them.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_ALISAIE_000_060: Judging from all the activity, I presume the funeral will be held here.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_KRILE_000_065: While it appears souls are still being issued, supply must be limited now that they're no longer being harvested. The grim faces in the queue tell the tale.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_GRAHATIA_000_070: It makes sense that Sphene had loyal aides such as Gossan, given how much time she dedicated to walking among her people.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_WUKLAMAT_000_101: I'm Vow Wuk Lamat of Tuliyollal. Thank you for extending us an invitation to Queen Sphene's funeral.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_GOSSAN_000_102: We are honored, truly. I had seen you before from a distance, but never had the pleasure.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_GOSSAN_000_103: I am Gossan, former chief aide to the queen. Since her passing, I have been responsible for administering affairs of state.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_GULOOLJA_000_104: Um, can we get our flowers here?
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_GOSSAN_000_105: Yes, Your Majesty. The flowers are being handed out at the counter yonder, alongside the regulators.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_WUKLAMAT_000_106: What? We need to wear regulators for the funeral?
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_GOSSAN_000_107: Ah, rest assured they are not a requirement. We're aware your people do not use them.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_GOSSAN_000_108: You see, people in the Alexandria of old wore tokens of mourning upon their persons when attending funerals.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_GOSSAN_000_109: As such tokens were black, it was suggested that we might wear regulators painted the same color.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_GOSSAN_000_110: We've yet to produce enough for everyone, but we're distributing them as we are able.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_GOSSAN_000_112: Yet regulator or no, the important thing is that we remember Queen Sphene. Remember her and her kindness as you make an offering of your flower.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_GOSSAN_000_114: The proceedings will soon begin in this plaza. Please take your place once you have your flower.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_GULOOLJA_000_115: I'm sorry. I shouldn't have brought that up...
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_ALPHINAUD_000_120: I hope the altar can provide comfort to those who need it.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_ALISAIE_000_125: Seeing that child reminded me of myself. Of how hard it was for me to accept that Grandfather was gone.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_ALISAIE_000_130: But that sadness is what gave me the strength to come this far, and I would never choose to forget it. Never.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_KRILE_000_135: This seems a good place to continue our conversation.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_GRAHATIA_000_140: Simply leaving Alexandria won't solve all their problems, I fear. The problem runs deeper than that.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_WUKLAMAT_000_200: Hey, Gulool Ja? Do you really know nothing at all about your mother?
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_GULOOLJA_000_201: Shale searched the system for information on residents, but the only Mamool Ja she found listed were my father and me.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_GULOOLJA_000_202: Even if she died and was erased from people's memories, she should've been there. But she wasn't...
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_WUKLAMAT_000_203: Well, that you're here means she was here too, inside the dome. There can't be any other way about it.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_A1_000_001: Perhaps we should try looking again.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_A1_000_002: Do you want to know your mother?
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_GULOOLJA_000_205: Maybe... It's hard to explain. I'm not sad, but I feel like...like I'm missing something.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_GULOOLJA_000_206: So even if it makes me feel sad, I want to know my mother.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_GULOOLJA_000_207: I think so. Even if it makes me feel sad, I want to know her.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_GULOOLJA_000_208: So I want to try looking again. And if I don't find anything this time, I'll give up.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_WUKLAMAT_000_209: I see... Well, if that's what you want...
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_KRILE_100_209: I'd like to help as well, and I believe I speak for the others too.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_GULOOLJA_000_210: But...I can't bother you with this. You already came for the funeral...
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_GRAHATIA_100_211: We came here not only for the funeral, but to see whether all was well in Alexandria. We're not about to leave just yet.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_KRILE_100_213: Besides, in seeking to learn about your mother, we're bound to learn about your father as well.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_KRILE_100_214: By retracing the steps of this man who kept his own counsel, we may gain knowledge that can serve the people of Alexandria.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_WUKLAMAT_000_001: If this is what Gulool Ja wants, then I'll help him however I can. After all, we're family!
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_GULOOLJA_000_005: We might learn more about my father, too? I hadn't thought of that.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_ALPHINAUD_000_010: I understand all too well Gulool Ja's desire. For the longest time I found my own father's actions inexplicable...
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_ALISAIE_000_015: If no records remain of Gulool Ja's mother, then where do we begin our search?
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_KRILE_000_020: I can very much relate to his feelings. I pray Gulool Ja finds what he seeks.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_GRAHATIA_000_030: Assuming neither memories nor records of Gulool Ja's mother remain, we must cast as wide a net as possible. I suggest we split into groups.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_GRAHATIA_000_031: ─if you could make inquiries outside in the outskirts, the rest of us will do the same in Solution Nine.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_CITIZEN05246A_000_1: A Mamool Ja woman? Hmmm, their people have never been a common sight around here...
Why, the last time I saw one would have been before the dome came down over our heads.
She was among an entourage of Landsguard that was dispatched here. I assume they all returned to Tuliyollal after their mission.
But if any remained, I suppose they could've been trapped in here with the rest of us.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SYSTEM_100_103: Your exchange with the chatty Shetona has taught you about “a Mamool Ja woman.”
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_CITIZEN05246A_200_1: I haven't seen the Mamool Ja woman or any of the other Landsguard since then, but I suppose it's possible some of them were trapped here with the rest of us.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_CITIZEN05246B_000_1: Sorry, but I've never heard of a Mamool Ja woman living in these parts, much less one connected to Zoraal Ja.
You might have better luck talking to the people over at a Tonawawtan settlement to the north of Everkeep, in a place called Yuweyawata.
The Resilient Son won their loyalty when he saved them from some crisis or another, or so the story goes. If I remember correctly, their chief's name was Kanilokka.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SYSTEM_100_106: Your exchange with the middle-aged Tonawawta has taught you about “Zoraal Ja's devoted.”
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_CITIZEN05246C_000_1: You're looking for a Mamool Ja woman?
Oh, Gulool Ja's mother... I can't help you there, I'm afraid.
I only know a little about Zoraal Ja, and then only what my father told me.
He said that before the dome cut us off from the outside world, a tural vidraal had appeared and was terrorizing the region.
In response, Zoraal Ja assembled a party of warriors, and with them confronted and felled the beast. It was interesting to hear of the king's feat in the past.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SYSTEM_100_111: Your exchange with the fresh-faced Tonawawta has taught you about “a battle with a tural vidraal.”
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_CITIZEN05246C_200_1: What a battle it must've been, between the king's men and the tural vidraal. And all without regulators, too...
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_WUKLAMAT_000_115: I'm sorry, but I couldn't find out anything useful. None of the people I questioned had heard of a Mamool Ja woman before...
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_GULOOLJA_000_120: Ah, you're back too! I told Shale all about your search.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_ALPHINAUD_000_125: While I failed to learn anything directly related to Gulool Ja's mother, I did find information which may shed some light upon Zoraal Ja.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_ALISAIE_000_130: Lamaty'i didn't seem to have much luck. How did you fare?
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_KRILE_000_135: Zoraal Ja rarely made public appearances, so the people had no idea how he spent most of his time. Yet I believe therein lies the key to the answers we seek.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_GRAHATIA_000_140: Solution Nine is vast indeed. Even with the teleporters, we could cover but a small portion of it.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SHALE_100_200: Gulool Ja has told me all. We've previously tried to track down records of his mother, but came up empty-handed.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SHALE_100_201: With everyone's help, hopefully we can get somewhere this time...
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SHALE_100_202: Ah, so you spoke with quite a few different people as well. Let's combine all our findings and see what conclusions we might draw.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SHALE_000_200: So, Zoraal Ja brought a retinue of Landsguard to Yyasulani, among whom was a female Mamool Ja.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SHALE_000_201: His mission was to rid the region of a tural vidraal, and I believe it safe to say that that was the “crisis” in Yuweyawata he resolved.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_WUKLAMAT_000_202: If some of his troops stuck around for a time, perhaps to assist the villagers with recovery efforts, then they could've indeed gotten trapped in the dome.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_ALISAIE_000_205: We also heard stories about the settlement in Yuweyawata. People lived there until nearly a decade ago, and Zoraal Ja made regular visits.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_ALPHINAUD_000_209: If he required secrecy, a location home to his most loyal followers would be ideal. And if this Mamool Ja woman had remained there, they would have had occasion to come in contact.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SHALE_000_210: I see. But what could Zoraal Ja have been doing in that village?
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_KRILE_000_211: I think we can answer that question.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_KRILE_000_212: In order to retrace Zoraal Ja's steps, Raha and I spoke with a researcher who worked at Origenics.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_KRILE_000_213: He said that, approximately twenty years ago, a number of his colleagues were transferred to a research facility outside Everkeep─per the king's direct order.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SHALE_000_214: This is the first I've heard of such a facility. Only Vanguard was believed to have been under the king's jurisdiction...
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_GRAHATIA_000_215: It was apparently being used to develop a new kind of weapon, but I'm afraid that was all we could learn.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SHALE_000_216: It's plenty to go on. Even if the work there was classified, any materials and equipment needed would have been manufactured within Everkeep.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SHALE_000_217: So if we look into transportation records...
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SHALE_000_219: The routes are full of detours and attempts at obfuscation, but large deliveries were being made to Yuweyawata. Far too large for a mere village.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SHALE_000_220: There hasn't been any activity for years, though. It's likely the facility has been decommissioned.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_GULOOLJA_000_221: Do you think that's where my mother was?
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_WUKLAMAT_000_222: We can't say for certain just yet, but I reckon there's a good chance!
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_GULOOLJA_000_223: This is amazing! Even though no one remembers her, you managed to figure all of this out!
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_GRAHATIA_000_224: Each piece of the puzzle may reveal little on its own, but when we put several together, a picture begins to form.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_GRAHATIA_000_225: And even should memories fade, footprints remain to mark the path of those who walked before.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_GRAHATIA_000_226: A lesson I learned in another life.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_WUKLAMAT_000_227: So we'll be investigating this secret facility in Yuweyawata, then.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_WUKLAMAT_000_228: And this time, I want you to come along, Gulool Ja.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SHALE_000_229: Yuweyawata is on the other side of the lake. To get there, you'll need to take a hover cargo from the driftdowns.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SHALE_000_235: Make your way to the driftdowns when you're ready. Kiluwsa will have a hover cargo ready for you.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_WUKLAMAT_000_240: We've seen how much has changed for the part of Yyasulani that's on this side of the dome. I wonder what it's like on the other...
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_ALPHINAUD_000_245: Someone would have noticed if Zoraal Ja traveled from the driftdowns. I expect he utilized a flying vehicle.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_ALISAIE_000_250: The settlement in the outskirts─that was originally Tonawawtan as well, yes? I wonder if Yuweyawata is similar to it.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_KRILE_000_255: While the researcher we spoke with remembered that he had colleagues, he couldn't recall details about any specific individuals. Not their names nor what they were like...
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_GRAHATIA_000_260: Weapons developed in secret with the aid of devoted followers... Nothing good will have come of this.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_KILUWSA_000_265: I'll remain nearby after dropping you off. Just let me know when you're ready to head back.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_GULOOLJA_000_300: So the hover cargo will take us across the lake... I've never been over there before.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_WUKLAMAT_000_301: It's still inside the dome, so I don't expect it'll be too different from here.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_WUKLAMAT_000_302: We'll likely encounter dangerous beasts, so the rest of us will go first. You follow when it's safe to do so, alright?
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_A1_000_002: Form a party and enter Yuweyawata Field Station.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_WUKLAMAT_000_305: I promised to look after Gulool Ja, but I've spent hardly any time with him. I'm going to make up for that.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_ALPHINAUD_000_310: While I alone haven't seen much of the dome, I am no stranger to braving the unknown. I will not slow us down.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_ALISAIE_000_315: I can't help but be reminded of our foray into Origenics. And of Cahciua...
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_KRILE_000_320: We've seen the havoc that Valigarmanda wreaked on Urqopacha. I wonder what this other tural vidraal might have left in its wake.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_GRAHATIA_000_325: If the facility was used to research new weaponry, then it will have had tight security. Even if it has been closed down, let us proceed with caution.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_GULOOLJA_000_330: Don't worry about me. I'm good at hiding from beasts.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_KILUWSA_000_400: I'll launch the hover cargo whenever you're ready. Just say the word.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_WUKLAMAT_000_600: Teeshal Ja, you said her name was? I wonder what her story is...
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_ALPHINAUD_000_605: The villagers were likely monitoring the imprisoned tural vidraal at Zoraal Ja's behest. And at some point, they became involved in the research of souls...
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_ALISAIE_000_610: Now that the danger is behind us, it's started sinking in just how unsettling this place is. Hard to believe it used to be a village.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_KRILE_000_615: That you should be able to peer into the tural vidraal's past... I wonder what that implies for the beast's consciousness while it was sealed away.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_GRAHATIA_000_620: It seems this Kanilokka was in charge here. From your recounting, he was quite dedicated to Zoraal Ja.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_GULOOLJA_000_700: I wish I could see into the past like you. Then I could see people who are gone.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_GULOOLJA_000_701: Because there aren't any other Mamool Ja women here, for a long time I couldn't even imagine what my mother looked like.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_GULOOLJA_000_702: But when I visited Tuliyollal and saw some, I was finally able to picture her in my mind.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_GULOOLJA_000_703: And one day, I hope I can see what she actually looked like as well.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SYSTEM_000_704: You may now enter Yuweyawata Field Station with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_WUKLAMAT_000_001: Teeshal Ja, you said her name was? I wonder what her story is...
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_GULOOLJA_000_005: Is it alright if I go around by myself now?
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_ALPHINAUD_000_010: The villagers were likely monitoring the imprisoned tural vidraal at Zoraal Ja's behest. And at some point, they became involved in the research of souls...
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_ALISAIE_000_015: Now that the danger is behind us, it's started sinking in just how unsettling this place is. Hard to believe it used to be a village.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_GRAHATIA_000_020: It seems this Kanilokka was in charge here. From your recounting, he was quite dedicated to Zoraal Ja.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_KILUWSA_000_025: I'll launch the hover cargo whenever you're ready. Just say the word.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_KRILE_000_030: While we've discerned the purpose of the research conducted here, the traces of it that remain might afford us greater insight into what came of it.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_KRILE_000_031: Let us take a look around─for information as well as a way to the upper level.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_WUKLAMAT_000_035: It makes me angry to think about what they did here...
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_GULOOLJA_000_040: What happened to the people here? Did they all leave...or did we already meet them?
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_ALPHINAUD_000_045: To think that people actually volunteered their souls for these experiments...
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_ALPHINAUD_000_046: Success was far from guaranteed, and even in the best case, they would cease to be men. Was their devotion to Zoraal Ja so absolute?
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_ALISAIE_000_050: It won't open, and I don't think it'll yield to our shoulders either. We'll have to do it the old-fashioned way and find the key.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_KRILE_000_055: The researchers likely moved between the upper and lower levels. Perhaps we can find a key among their belongings.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_GRAHATIA_000_060: I wonder what Beq Lugg would make of this research into transferring souls.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_SYSTEM_000_100: A lift can be seen behind the wrought-iron gate. As sturdy as it appears, the gate will likely resist attempts to force it open.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_SYSTEM_000_101: A security panel is nearby. Perhaps a verification key will open the way.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_SYSTEM_000_199: A journal lies next to the body...
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_BOOK05247A_000_200: (-Researcher's Journal-)I was transferred to Yuweyawata station in order to train the villagers in the use of electrope technology.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_BOOK05247A_100_200: (-Researcher's Journal-)While a child can quickly learn to operate common contraptions, it will be no easy thing for them to attain the requisite skill to develop new weapons─ones which require no less than the manipulation of souls.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_BOOK05247A_200_200: (-Researcher's Journal-)Thankfully, two of my pupils have demonstrated great aptitude in the field: Kanilokka, the village chief, and Teeshal Ja, a field chirurgeon.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_BOOK05247A_300_200: (-Researcher's Journal-)Further driven by their loyalty to our king, their growth has been remarkable. I dare to hope that, before long, they will be able to carry out their duties without further instruction, and I may be relieved of my duty.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_SYSTEM_000_200: You find nothing that resembles a verification key. Perhaps you should search elsewhere.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_BOOK05247B_000_201: (-Test Subject's Journal-)They're recruiting volunteers for a new experiment. I know I'm not as bright as the others, but they wouldn't laugh at me if I was stronger than them. This might be my chance.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_BOOK05247B_100_201: (-Test Subject's Journal-)Soul transferred few days ago. I can write. Can write good, yes? I am good! Very good!
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_BOOK05247B_200_201: (-Test Subject's Journal-)Getting hard to control strength. Today bit off hand of feeder. Cannot help it so strong.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_BOOK05247B_300_201: (-Test Subject's Journal-)Hungry. Always hungry. Cannot control. Eat. I must eat am eater must eat...
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_SYSTEM_000_202: Supplies for the staff are neatly arranged within the cabinet. Among the various items is a manual outlining regulations and tranquilizing gas to be used in emergencies. You dig deeper...
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_SYSTEM_000_203: ...And find a verification key! Perhaps it can be used to open the iron gate.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_ALISAIE_100_300: You found the key? Great, I'll call the others.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_ALISAIE_000_300: It seems the key can be used to operate the lift as well. Up we go.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_WUKLAMAT_000_302: I didn't expect it to be similar, but this is a far cry from the temple that held Valigarmanda.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_GRAHATIA_000_303: All the machinery appears to still be in operation. I expect there are auxiliary systems in place to ensure that monitoring can continue even in emergencies.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_KRILE_000_304: The warnings indicate various anomalies─related to the seal's failure, most likely. For a blessing, we managed to fell the beast before it could cause harm.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_WUKLAMAT_000_305: Right then, let's see if we can find some clues about Gulool Ja's mother.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_GULOOLJA_000_306: I think I can use this terminal. Shale taught me how.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_GULOOLJA_000_307: There's so much data... I don't know what we should look at.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_GRAHATIA_000_308: Perhaps we can narrow down the search by inputting the name Teeshal Ja.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_GULOOLJA_000_309: Ah, it brought up a lot of results. They all seem to say the same thing...
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_GULOOLJA_000_310: “Teeshal Ja, Administrator of Experimental Treatments: Research Logs.”
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_KRILE_000_312: Chances are the data is encrypted. And even if not, it will take considerable time to go through it all.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_ALPHINAUD_000_313: Then let us take it with us to the Backroom and have Shale analyze it.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_GULOOLJA_000_315: Alright. I'll transfer it to this storage device I brought.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_GULOOLJA_000_317: Thank you so much for bringing me all the way here, everyone!
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_WUKLAMAT_000_318: If you're happy, then so am I. Besides, I was able to learn more about my brother as well. It was a fruitful adventure for the both of us.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_WUKLAMAT_000_320: It seems safe to say my brother returned to Yuweyawata for the tural vidraal. He wanted its power, no matter the cost...
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_GULOOLJA_000_325: Kiluwsa is really good at driving the hover cargo. I wonder if I can learn how to drive it too...
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_ALPHINAUD_000_330: I'll not soon forget our visit to that facility. It was a troubling reminder of the depravity that can arise from the belief that souls are simply a resource to be exploited.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_ALISAIE_000_335: I admit the tural vidraal gave me a fright at first. But then I remembered who felled the mighty Valigarmanda!
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_KRILE_000_340: I'm glad we could find what we sought in that abandoned facility.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_GRAHATIA_000_400: And here we are. The authorities will doubtless wish to be informed about the facility and its contents...
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_GRAHATIA_000_401: But first things first: let us deliver the data to Shale.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_WUKLAMAT_000_405: Gulool Ja had no trouble keeping up during the outing. He really is his father's son.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_GULOOLJA_000_410: It was Shale who gave me the storage device before we left. She said that we'd probably need it...and we did!
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_ALPHINAUD_000_415: Having now spent some time in these harsh environs, I feel I have a better understanding of how much of a steadying presence Sphene was to her people.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_ALISAIE_000_420: From what I can see, things haven't changed much since the funeral. People are still listless like before.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_KRILE_000_425: I've been thinking, it may behoove us to learn how to use the various devices found throughout Alexandria. Better late than never, after all.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_GRAHATIA_000_430: The data will be in good hands with Shale.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_GEODE_000_435: You've found information on Gulool Ja's mother? You lot never cease to amaze...
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_SHALE_000_500: Welcome back. Gulool Ja has already given me the storage device.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_SHALE_000_501: There looks to be a wealth of data, all of which is encrypted, so I'll need time to process everything.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_ALPHINAUD_000_502: In that case, Alisaie and I might take ourselves around the city and check on the people.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_ALISAIE_000_503: Aye, their mood has us a bit worried. I don't know if there's anything we can do to help, but we'll see...
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_SHALE_000_504: Understood. I'll let you know as soon as I've finished my work.
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_ALISAIE_000_505: Thank you. We'll see you again soon.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_WUKLAMAT_000_001: I share our friends' concern. It's not surprising that the Alexandrians are having difficulty coping with their grief...but still...
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_GULOOLJA_000_005: I'll stay here with Shale. There's a lot I can learn just from watching her.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KRILE_000_010: I suspect the Alexandrians' plight reminds Alphinaud and Alisaie of the Garleans'. Little wonder they feel compelled to assist in any way they can.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_GRAHATIA_000_015: I met some members of Oblivion on my way back here. They themselves were returning after having paid their respects to Sphene.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_GEODE_000_030: Alisaie isn't wrong. The mood out there is still grim.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_GEODE_000_031: Some of the Turali remember a time before they were dependent on the soul system, but even they're unsettled and wondering aloud if they'll have the chance to reunite with old friends and family before they pass on.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_GEODE_000_032: With good reason, too. The journey home won't be an easy one for those who've grown old.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_GEODE_100_032: That's why it's mostly been younger folk who've been leaving for Tural─ones with no elders to care for.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_WUKLAMAT_000_033: Word of that problem has reached us in Tuliyollal. My brother is doing all he can to see the Xak Tural railroad restored to operation, so that people may come and go more freely.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_WUKLAMAT_000_034: Unfortunately, the tracks only go as far as Vanguard, so some traveling by foot will still be necessary...
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_GEODE_000_035: Even so, the railroad would make things a sight easier. How long before it's back in service?
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_WUKLAMAT_000_036: I couldn't say. When I left for this visit, Koana seemed reluctant to make promises...
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_WUKLAMAT_000_037: ...But while Shale's working on the data, we could go and see the state of it for ourselves.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_WUKLAMAT_000_038: To Shaaloani Station, then! I'll make sure to keep Koana informed.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_GULOOLJA_000_040: Say hello to Koana for me!
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KRILE_000_045: Raha and I will keep an eye on things here in your absence.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_GRAHATIA_000_050: I would be astonished if they were able to restore railroad service so quickly. The locomotive was nigh obliterated in its collision with the dome...
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_SHALE_000_055: You'll have plenty of time while I work on this. Trust me.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_GEODE_000_060: Let us know if there's good news concerning the railroad. We can disseminate it through our network and hopefully put some minds at ease.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_WUKLAMAT_000_065: I've filled Koana in. He asks that we continue to support the Alexandrians as best we can.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_NITOWIKWE_000_070: Operations are still suspended, but we're trying to remain optimistic. It's good to see you looking well yourselves.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_WAWLIKA_000_100: Vow of Resolve! And  to boot. What can I do you for?
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_WUKLAMAT_000_101: We're hoping for some good news about the railroad. There's an increasing number of people looking to return to Tural that can't make the journey on foot.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_WAWLIKA_000_102: I see. As it happens, the Vow of Reason is also on his way here to take stock of the situation.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_A4_000_002: Gasp! Did our little bunbun finally outgrow his old clothes!?
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_ERENVILLE_200_102: As the guildship has officially approved my transition from gleaner to independent contractor, I was in need of more befitting attire.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_ERENVILLE_300_102: <sigh> Stop that. As you well know, my previous attire was that of a gleaner, and I have chosen a different path. It was time for a change.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_WUKLAMAT_000_103: You're here about the railroad too?
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_ERENVILLE_000_104: It was in part for my sake that the original Dawnblazer was sacrificed, so I felt it only right that I assist with its replacement.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_000_105: I assume Lamaty'i has explained the growing urgency of the need. What have you to report?
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_WAWLIKA_000_106: The new locomotive was on track for completion, but we're having difficulty pulling her into the station, in a manner of speaking.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_WAWLIKA_000_107: You see, when we used the Dawnblazer to get into the dome, urgency outweighed all other considerations, but now we're back to our original problem: how to run the railroad without upsetting the inhabitants of Mehwahhetsoan.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_ERENVILLE_000_108: That is, the rroneek. Though the Hhetsarro that follow them are none too pleased about their hhetso being spooked by the noise of the locomotive, either.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_000_109: The solution I've devised to quieten the railroad should address that complaint.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_000_110: But a silent train presents a different danger. The rroneek will need to be deterred from wandering across the tracks.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_NITOWIKWE_000_111: ...And I suppose we can't just blow the whistle at them, or they'll panic and be put off their grazing again.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_WUKLAMAT_000_112: Weren't the rail routes plotted to avoid the rroneek's preferred grazing areas, though?
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_WUKLAMAT_000_113: It's odd that they're getting so close in the first place...
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_ERENVILLE_000_114: The rroneek's grazing patterns have shifted since the tracks were laid. I am not certain why, but I intend to ask the people of Mehwahhetsoan for their insight.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_000_115: As a major proponent of the railroad, I have a duty to assist in this matter, and I too would hear what the Hhetsarro have to say about it. They are the ones most affected, after all.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_ERENVILLE_000_116: I believe it would be best to begin by consulting their leader, Hhwato. The rest of you can accompany us to the Hhetsarro encampment if you like.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_WAWLIKA_000_120: For now, we'll continue work on the silent locomotive as planned. Here's hoping that whatever you come up with won't require a total overhaul.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_NITOWIKWE_000_125: It's only recently that the rroneek changed their grazing patterns. They didn't stray so close to the tracks before.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_WUKLAMAT_000_130: To think all of this can be packed up at a moment's notice to follow wherever the rroneek lead!
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_ERENVILLE_000_135: Our prior visit to the Hhetsarro was also on railroad business. Pray they do not take us for train enthusiasts...
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_000_140: As committed as the Hhetsarro are to tradition, they are amenable to the unfamiliar...or so I am told.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_SHEPETTO_000_145: That's Koana, Vow of Reason, is it not? I can scarce believe it...
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_HHWATO_000_200: Vow of Resolve, Vow of Reason. I bid you welcome to our camp. But what brings you all the way to Mehwahhetsoan?
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_000_201: I thank you for seeing us. Our visit concerns the matter of the Xak Tural railroad...
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_HHWATO_000_202: You too have noted the rroneek's unexpected change in behavior, then.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_HHWATO_000_203: My son, Shepetto, has been looking into this matter. Shepetto?
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_SHEPETTO_000_204: Normally, we'd expect the rroneek to keep to their favored grounds nearby for a while yet. And despite a thorough search, we haven't found anything wrong with the quantity or quality of the grazing in Pyariyoanaan and Yawtanane.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_SHEPETTO_000_205: Yet they refuse to keep to where they usually would, instead pushing westward, toward your railroad.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_HHWATO_000_206: I certainly see no cause for this unseasonal migration. Nevertheless, should they continue to move west, we will follow.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_000_207: ...As any true Hhetsarro would, I suppose?
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_000_209: As you may have surmised, I am of Hhetsarro descent. My parents traveled with the rroneek as well, though I myself have no memory of the experience.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_100_209: I was left behind as a babe, you see, during such a migration. One of many sacrifices necessitated by a nomadic lifestyle, I am forced to assume...
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_110_209: A chance encounter with a kind Pelu merchant was the only reason I survived. Taking pity on me, he taught me his trade that I might fend for myself.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_120_209: I became a stallkeeper in Tuliyollal's markets, and that is where the Dawnservant found and adopted me.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_130_209: I had already been in the palace some time when Lamaty'i came to join us.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_140_209: Like me, she had been cast aside by her parents. I knew the pain of solitude, and wanted to spare her that suffering.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_150_209: As this tiny child's new brother, I swore: I would always be there for her.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_HHWATO_000_210: Truly? I have never heard of the rroneek choosing a path so arduous as to force such a terrible decision. Nor of any Hhetsarro willingly leaving their own flesh and blood behind. There must have been some exceptional circumstance...
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_000_211: I cannot say. The idea of following in their footsteps that I might better make excuses for their actions never much appealed to me.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_A1_000_001: But if they had good reason, wouldn't you want to know?
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_A1_000_002: Even if it might help you better understand the rroneek's current behavior?
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_000_213: ...As is so often the case, you are correct.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_000_214: Though my discomfort with the Hhetsarro way may arise from fear of reopening old wounds rather than blind fervor for innovation, it would nevertheless see me repeat past mistakes...
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_000_217: And to refuse to learn one of our country's treasured traditions would make me a poor Dawnservant indeed.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_000_218: Please, teach me of the rroneek, and what they mean to you.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_000_219: I promise to listen with an open mind.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_HHWATO_000_220: We would be delighted. In the meantime, your companions are welcome to look around.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_100_220: Will you learn of Hhetsarro culture with me? I should like to approach this with the fervent curiosity that you and my sister share, but it would be useful to know whether I am, er...doing it correctly.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_WUKLAMAT_200_220: Then it's settled! You'll learn more of the rroneek, and we'll have a look around the plains. And perhaps, in the process, we'll find the answers we seek.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_000_225: My knowledge of the culture I was born into is from written accounts alone...and few of them, at that.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_HHWATO_000_230: It will be a joy to share our traditions with the new Dawnservants, as we once did with Gulool Ja Ja.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_SHEPETTO_000_300: The quickest way to learn about our way of life is to do as we do. I hope you're not above manual labor.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_100_300: I am not the most experienced, I'm ashamed to admit. But I shall put forth every effort.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_SHEPETTO_000_301: That's all we ask. Take these tools...
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_SHEPETTO_000_303: Now, introduce yourself to anyone who looks busy and ask if you can help. They'll be happy to teach you what to do in exchange for another pair of hands to do it!
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_000_306: Let us meet back here later to share what we've learned.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_SHEPETTO_000_310: Truth be told, we don't get many visitors keen to learn about our way of life. Anyone around here will tell you whatever you want to know─and then some.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_HHETSARRO05248B_000: You're here to help? Well then, why don't I show you how to care for a rroneek's coat? Go ahead and run your fingers through it. Gently, now.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_SYSTEM_000_406: As you stroke the rroneek's coat, you note that many portions are shaggy and tangled.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_HHETSARRO05248B_000: This one's fur is a bit overgrown, but a good brushing should thin it out. Would you like to give it a try? You'll need the right tool for the job, mind you─a comb of the type you're used to would just get lost in the tangle, like as not.
Ah, Shepetto sent a rroneek brush with you, did he? How like him! Now, just run it through one little patch at a time. Gently...
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_SYSTEM_000_409: You dutifully brush the rroneek until your arms grow weary from the prolonged battle with its coat. It appears much tidier now─though the same cannot be said for your clothes, which have acquired a new coat of their own.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_HHETSARRO05248B_000: Well done! With less excess fur, our friend here will be more comfortable in the afternoon heat, and less susceptible to illness. A combed coat also makes it easier for us to identify injuries, should the need arise.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_SYSTEM_100_411: After admiring your work, you try and fail to brush the fur off of yourself. The rroneek preens.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_HHETSARRO05248B_000: You should come back during shedding season─it's a sight to behold. But thanks to the hhetso's prodigious coats, we never want for clothing and blankets.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_HHETSARRO05248C_000: This won't do. The wind will go right through it. And me without my needle and sinew...
Oh, these are precisely what I needed! I should be able to patch up the covering now.
Given how often we pack up and reassemble our tents, they're bound to get the occasional tear. Fortunately, the rroneek hide they're made of is durable enough that we generally needn't worry.
Rroneek hide's sturdiness makes it an excellent material for clothing and shoes, as well. Of all the many gifts our hhetso bestow, it's the most versatile. I don't know how we'd get along without it!
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_HHETSARRO05248D_000: I'm afraid I've finished with my tasks for the time being. But since you're so eager to learn about our way of life, why don't I tell you a bit about our migration customs?

If you're here, you likely already know that the rroneek are our hhetso─our guides─that we travel with through the turning of the seasons. We trust them to lead us to fertile lands with all we need to survive.
But you may not know that sometimes, the herd splits into two, bound for different paths. On those occasions, we Hhetsarro must also part with half of our number.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_HHETSARRO05248D_100: You may think it a strange and stressful custom, but over the years, it has seen us visit new lands and broaden our horizons as a people. This, too, is the wisdom of the hhetso.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_HHETSARRO05248D_000: One more tidbit for you. When the herd splits, and we part with our kin, we exchange a wish to meet again wheresoever we are guided: “Tseppya ashees ahhetsarro nhheyoan!”
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_HHETSARRO05248E_000: You're learning about the Hhetsarro way of life, are you?
I may have a thing or two to share... But rather than talking your ear off, let me test your powers of deduction. I find answers much easier to recall later if I arrived at them myself.
Ahem! Our hhetso provide us with something that we use in medicines, poultices, and soap, to drive away pests, and to sustain our fires. What is it?
Both horns and hooves have cores of bone, and we use all of these materials, albeit primarily in tent-poles, instruments, and the like. It's not quite the answer I was looking for!

It sounds like there's a story there...but that is indeed the correct answer! We've discovered myriad uses for rroneek chips over time, each a boon to our way of life. Where there is a need, our hhetso always provide.

Alas, not quite! Meat and organs both can be made into delicious fare, and our neighbors are oft glad to trade for them. They do have certain medicinal uses as well, but they aren't fit for all the purposes mentioned in my question.
To remind you: this material is fit for medicines, poultices, and soap, to drive away pests and other evils, to sustain fires, and to flavor food. Have another guess!

I know city folk are squeamish about dung, but you can't deny generations of results. I won't ask that you march across the plains and fill a sack with it─only that you keep an open mind about our customs.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_SHEPETTO_000_500: You smell of the grass and the wind...
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_SHEPETTO_000_501: ...Which is a good thing, I promise. You could nearly be mistaken for one of us─!
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_SHEPETTO_000_502: I have to wonder how Vow Koana is getting on. I assumed he would be reluctant to get his hands dirty, but it seems his wish to understand us was sincere...
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_000_504: Apologies for my tardiness. I was tasked with grazing the rroneek, and ended up rather far afield.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_100_504: I found myself wandering hither and thither at my companion's inclination. To force us back to the trail seemed...inappropriate.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_200_504: But how was your own work? Have you anything to share?
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_A3_000_001: Hhetsarro life revolves around the rroneek, but in turn the people receive all they need.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_A3_000_002: The rroneek are treasured members of this community, as important as family.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_300_504: Yes, I feel the truth of this myself. While I was hesitant to leave my fate to the whims of the hhetso rather than tread man-made paths, I arrived where I was meant to be all the same.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_400_504: Indeed. The rroneek provide for the Hhetsarro, and in turn the Hhetsarro are good to the rroneek. Just as family should be.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_410_504: Mine is not the only way─though at times I lack the experience to know otherwise. My inability to conceive of how a decision might be right does not mean that it is wrong...
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_420_504: My parents had a duty to the rroneek, as they did to me. And so I wonder if their leaving me behind was not so selfish an act as I once believed.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_430_504: I have no way to know, of course...and regardless, this has no bearing on our present concerns. We are here in service of the people of Tural, after all.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_500_504: Nevertheless... I thank you for helping me find deeper meaning in what we've done today.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_KOANA_600_504: And I will endeavor to remain curious─especially where the hhetso are concerned.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_SHEPETTO_000_510: I'm glad to hear that, Vow Koana. You're welcome among our herd any time.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_SHEPETTO_000_005: I expect Vow Wuk Lamat and Erenville will be back soon as well...
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_KOANA_000_002: I believe I finally understand the significance of the hhetso.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_KOANA_000_003: They nourish the Hhetsarro as they grow, and provide warmth and companionship in a harsh and unpredictable world...
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_KOANA_000_004: They are the equal of any man, not beasts to be tamed.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_KOANA_000_005: Moreover, rroneek are sensitive. Though we may treat their injuries or brush their coats to keep them hale, they must ever be free to follow their instincts and seek lands where they might thrive.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_KOANA_000_006: The Hhetsarro would never cage them, and neither should we. To control their migratory patterns or capture those who wander too close to the tracks is out of the question...
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_ERENVILLE_000_009: Then it is particularly important to advance our original line of inquiry. Fortunately, we were able to visit the rroneek's once-favored grazing grounds.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_WUKLAMAT_000_014: As we were told, the grass looks fine. But the place is too quiet. It's not just the rroneek─even the birds and field mice have fled. We did encounter one pack of ceratoraptors, but they looked to be passing through in a hurry.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_KOANA_000_015: Typically, that sort of behavior in the fauna would be associated with natural disasters. Earthquakes, landslides, and the like.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_ERENVILLE_000_016: Though the Hhetsarro would have surely put two and two together were the cause geological, I measured the area's aether to be certain. There was indeed nothing to suggest recent environmental disruption, but I did notice one anomaly.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_ERENVILLE_000_017: A strong aetheric signature to the east. Moving across the plain, albeit slowly.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_KOANA_000_019: And a powerful one, like as not. A predator, given the local fauna's behavior.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_KOANA_000_020: Given where we are... I believe we are dealing with a powerful beast. A predator, perhaps, given the local fauna's behavior.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_WUKLAMAT_000_021: One of the raptors we saw looked like it had a bite taken out of its tail. By something with very large fangs.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_SHEPETTO_000_025: “Rroneek reaver,” in the common tongue. Our people have several names for such creatures. “Fangs that steal hhetso in the night” is another evocative one.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_SHEPETTO_000_026: Rroneek can fend off many predators with their horns, but not the tturuhhetso. Their scales are tough as adamant, and neither horn nor arrow can pierce them.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_ERENVILLE_000_027: A well-toothed carnivore with an unusually tough hide... I cannot recall any such fauna in this region.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_SHEPETTO_000_028: They usually roam the wilds in the northeast, and most herds keep well clear of them. I can't tell you why this one is so far from home and its pack both.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_KOANA_000_030: In any case, I believe the source of the rroneek's consternation is clear. As is our next move. We must drive this reaver away, that they might return to their grazing lands in peace.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_KOANA_000_032: Never fear─we will make certain that the beast threatens you no more.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_WUKLAMAT_000_045: Those rroneek reavers must have a hefty set of teeth...but I'm not worried. We've fought worse.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_ERENVILLE_000_050: A powerful creature behaving unusually... Left to its devices, it may well become a tural vidraal. We must attend to it ere that happens.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_HHWATO_000_055: I am loath to risk inciting panic lest our fears be unfounded...but I will warn my people to take extra precautions.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_SHEPETTO_000_060: We must protect the hhetso, but not at the cost of your lives. Please take care out there.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_KOANA_000_100: The rroneek reaver is a clear threat to the local population. We cannot allow it to roam unchecked.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_KOANA_000_101: But it won't do for us to go running off in search of it without having made proper preparations. And if others returning from across the plain have spotted it, they may be able to inform us of its recent behavior and where it might be found.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_SYSTEM_000_103: Your progress through the upcoming battle will be saved at certain points. In the event that you are defeated, you will be able to try again from the most recent of these.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_SYSTEM_000_104: Please note that if you enter battles associated with other quests or log out from the game, this progress will be lost.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_SYSTEM_000_102: You must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 100 or above to proceed.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_WUKLAMAT_000_200: I can't imagine how Koana must be feeling right now. That reaver─you don't suppose it was the same one that...?
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_ERENVILLE_000_205: We certainly got more than we bargained for when we set out to solve our railroad conundrum...
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_HHWATO_000_210: If Vow Koana counts us among his family, then he is part of ours.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_SHEPETTO_000_215: You made felling that tturuhhetso look easy! On behalf of the hhetso, I thank you.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_KOANA_000_300: To know that the hhetso are safe is more than enough. Yet...would it be wrong to hope that, in protecting them, we also avenged my parents? It is the least I owe to them, after all this time...
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_KOANA_100_300: , I thank you for standing by me. As Dawnservant...and as the oft imperfect man beneath that mantle.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_KOANA_000_301: Now, let us return our attentions to the matter we came here to address, shall we?
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_KOANA_100_301: We have removed the root cause of the rroneek straying from their favored grazing, and obtained the tools to devise an additional precautionary measure─a silent “whistle,” as it were.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_ERENVILLE_110_301: This whistle must be capable of emitting pulses of aether strong enough that they will shy away from the tracks on instinct, yet not so strong as to drive them into a panic.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_ERENVILLE_120_301: If we can achieve this, it will be a far sight better than a traditional whistle. More effective and less stressful for the creatures themselves.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_KOANA_300_301: Let us return to Shaaloani Station and begin work on it, then. Wawlika and his crew will doubtless be relieved to finally have a solution.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_HHWATO_000_305: I am pleased to have seen with my own eyes the wisdom and courage our new Dawnservants will use to lead this nation. I wish them all the best.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_SHEPETTO_000_310: Now that the hhetso have taken to you, you'll have to come and see us again!
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_WUKLAMAT_000_315: This train will be ready in no time!
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_ERENVILLE_000_320: A variety of artisans from across Tural have come to assist with the railroad, so I foresee no difficulty in creating the whistle that Koana proposed.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_KOANA_000_325: Ah, I always carry a spare pair of spectacles or two, as it can be difficult to find replacements outside of the city. You wouldn't believe how many I went through during the rite of succession...
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_WAWLIKA_000_400: You look pleased about something. Good news for the railroad, I take it?
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_WAWLIKA_000_401: So the rroneek were avoiding a predator... Smart ones, they are. And Vow Koana's not too bad himself, what with his whistle idea! Sit tight─we'll have this train on the tracks before you know it.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_WUKLAMAT_000_405: Now anyone will be able to come and go from the dome as they please! I can't wait to spread the word in Alexandria.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_ERENVILLE_000_410: I expect that with the reaver gone, the rroneek will gradually return to their old habits, and we won't see so many approaching the tracks. It is good to see that the whistle will be effective in the meantime, however.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_KOANA_000_415: With that, I believe our work here is done. The fine people of Xak Tural Railing can take it from here.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_WAWLIKA_000_420: The folks that Vow Koana brought in to help rebuild the railroad have already returned home, but I hope we can give them a ride someday.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_NITOWIKWE_000_500: For a while there, we were real worried that we'd never get the railroad running again.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_NITOWIKWE_000_501: But now that the test drive was such a success, we can breathe easy and start hauling people to and from the dome.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_NITOWIKWE_000_502: First Shaaloani, and then...the continent! Watch out, Xak Tural─here we come!
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_WAWLIKA_000_503: I share the sentiment, but we've got a mountain of work ahead of us to ensure smooth operations. Time to get back to it...
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_KOANA_000_504: The efforts of all here today have not gone unnoticed. Once more, I thank you.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_KOANA_000_505: As for our own work...I trust you can handle matters in Alexandria, Lamaty'i?
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_ERENVILLE_000_001: It won't be as I once envisioned...but perhaps someday we can take that train journey to Yyasulani together.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_WUKLAMAT_000_010: Well, it's possible that Shale's made some headway by now. And regardless, we should spread word that the railroad's been restored to service.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_ERENVILLE_000_011: Shale? What do you have her working on?
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_ERENVILLE_000_013: I'd feel the same in his shoes. Have felt the same. Some questions are painful to leave unanswered...
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_ERENVILLE_000_014: There's no cause to look at me like that. The Cahciua we met may have only been a simulacrum, but her memory was real.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_ERENVILLE_000_015: I needn't search for what she left behind, because she left it with me. And I will carry it always...
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_ERENVILLE_000_019: It is merely a token from Alexandria. Our friends in Oblivion would not take no for an answer, and I thought it as good a souvenir as any...
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_WUKLAMAT_000_020: Whatever you say... For what it's worth, I think it's a nice way to bring her with you on your travels.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_ERENVILLE_000_021: ...Yes. Well. You're off to the dome now, aren't you?
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_ERENVILLE_000_022: I thought I might join you for a time. See if there is aught I can do for the people there. Much changed though it is, I still consider it my home.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_WUKLAMAT_000_023: Of course! We can give you the full story on the way.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_WUKLAMAT_000_025: Looks like we arrived at a good time.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_GULOOLJA_000_030: Erenville is wearing his Cahciua! That makes me happy.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_ERENVILLE_000_035: So Zoraal Ja was conducting secret research in Yuweyawata... I have some memories of the place from my childhood.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_KRILE_000_040: You must be exhausted. Shall I nip out for an energy tonic?
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_SHALE_000_045: Glad you're back. We wouldn't want to keep Gulool Ja here waiting any longer than necessary.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_GEODE_000_050: Seeing Erenville never fails to remind me of Cahciua...and I wouldn't have it any other way.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_GEODE_000_051: The dead should be remembered, this I firmly believe. Gulool Ja's mother deserves that too.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_GRAHATIA_000_100: ...A simple yet elegant solution. And thus is the railroad back in operation.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_GRAHATIA_000_101: Meanwhile, Shale has nearly finished processing the data. She will be able to share her findings with us imminently.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_KRILE_000_103: Why, Y'shtola! What brings you here?
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_YSHTOLA_000_104: I've seen enough of the gate in the Skydeep Cenote for now, so I'm shifting my investigation to Living Memory.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_YSHTOLA_000_105: While there, I thought I would do well to have the company of an expert on electrope.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_SHALE_000_106: I'd like to take a closer look at the place myself. I can join you once we've finished here.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_YSHTOLA_000_107: Lest you fear I've forgotten, once I've made headway with Living Memory, the key in your keeping shall be the next subject of my scrutiny.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_WUKLAMAT_000_110: ...You may find it hard to believe, but until the rite of succession, Zoraal Ja was a good brother to me. Always. And I thought that Papa was the best father anyone could ask for.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_WUKLAMAT_000_111: I don't want to think the time we spent together as a family was a lie. But by the same token, the bitterness my brother harbored was all too real...
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_GULOOLJA_000_115: It's okay. I wanted to know more about my parents, and now I do. And I don't regret it.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_GULOOLJA_000_116: I have Lamaty'i, and Koana, and you, . I'm not lonely now.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_ERENVILLE_000_120: No matter how brave a face Gulool Ja puts on, I expect it will take him time to come to terms with this.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_ERENVILLE_000_121: He is a strong one, though. You needn't worry too much.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_KRILE_000_125: Why leave such a record, you ask? I cannot be certain, but I believe Teeshal Ja simply wanted someone to know how she felt. To understand.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_GRAHATIA_000_130: If the dome had not appeared, Teeshal Ja's tale would have been very different. Yet whether or not she would have been happier, I cannot say.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_SHALE_000_135: Teeshal Ja left written records as well. I'll compile them for Gulool Ja. Perhaps something in them will be of comfort.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_YSHTOLA_000_200: "It's better to know“... A profound response, for one so young.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_SHALE_100_200: Though I wish he didn't have to be, Gulool Ja is indeed wise beyond his years.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_YSHTOLA_000_201: Yet one never outgrows the need for dependable companions. 'Tis fortunate that he has you.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_GULOOLJA_100_201: Thank you, Shale. Because of you, I got to hear my mother's whole story.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_SHALE_200_201: You heard it because you were brave enough to listen, Gulool Ja. If you remember one thing, remember that.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_SHALE_000_202: Now then─having shared what I can at present, I am ready to head to Living Memory when you are.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_YSHTOLA_000_203: I am planning to be thorough, so we will need to stop for supplies on the way.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_YSHTOLA_000_204: That said, I promise we won't remain overlong. I know we all have much and more to attend to.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_WUKLAMAT_000_205: With the railroad ready, I'd like to get some idea of how many returnees we can expect before heading back to Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_GULOOLJA_000_210: Is Shale going to be alright out there? The whole time she was working on the data, I never saw her take a break...
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_ERENVILLE_000_215: I'll stick around for a while. Let me know if you need me.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_KRILE_000_220: One wouldn't know it to look at them, but Shale and Y'shtola are birds of a feather. An incorrigibly restless feather...
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_GRAHATIA_000_225: The twins have yet to return. I hope everything is all right.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_GEODE_000_301: Our network's already spreading word of the railroad. We expected people would be clamoring to get on the first train back...
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_GEODE_000_302: Yet the reaction's been the polar opposite. Scant few seem inclined to depart Alexandria any time soon.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_WUKLAMAT_000_303: What? When we spoke before, you said many from Tuliyollal were eager to reunite with friends and family.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_WUKLAMAT_000_304: Maybe they're concerned about getting through Vanguard? If so, we could take turns accompanying them...
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_WUKLAMAT_000_305: In any case, we need to speak with the people ourselves. Let's start at leynode nine.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_GULOOLJA_000_310: Now that the railroad's working again, it'll be much easier to visit Tuliyollal. It would be nice to see Koana again as well.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_ERENVILLE_000_315: I've asked Geode to fill me in on all that has happened in the dome of late. If I hear anything of interest, I'll be sure to pass it on.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_KRILE_000_320: The people were so nervous about remaining in Alexandria... I cannot help but wonder what prompted this sudden change of heart.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_GRAHATIA_000_325: Perhaps we will venture out for a bit ourselves.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_GEODE_000_330: I'm as surprised as you are. Everyone was keen to pack their bags before, but now that the journey's possible, they can't be bothered?
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_WUKLAMAT_100_400: There may still be people gathering in Praxis Park. Let's try there first.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_ERENVILLE_000_410: Sphene was erased. If she's back, then are the Endless...?
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_ALPHINAUD_000_415: We've heard about the Queen of Reason's proclamation. The rumors spread through the district like wildfire.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_ALISAIE_000_420: You saw Sphene with your own eyes, then? So it wasn't someone else...
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_GRAHATIA_000_425: Without the Meso Terminal, how does she propose to create new Endless? We must contact Y'shtola as soon as possible.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_GEODE_000_430: There's naught to report yet, but we have all eyes and ears out in Everkeep and Heritage Found.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_KRILE_000_500: We only caught the proclamation from a distance, but I can tell you that the message about neo regulators was received with utmost clarity.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_ALISAIE_000_501: It couldn't have been Sphene. She should've been destroyed when the Meso Terminal shut down...
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_ALPHINAUD_000_503: ...Without a single Alexandrian to bear witness. Presented with an identical figure claiming to be their beloved queen, 'tis no surprise that they would choose to believe she's alive.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_ALPHINAUD_000_504: What is troubling, however, is their denial that the funeral was held in her honor. 'Tis as if their memories have been erased...
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_GRAHATIA_000_505: Given that the members of Oblivion remain unaffected, that was likely the work of the regulators. But by whose design?
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_WUKLAMAT_000_506: Someone smart enough to play at being the Queen of Reason. In that guise, even if some suspect deception, most of Alexandria will be on her side.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_WUKLAMAT_000_507: We need to find out who she really is.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_KRILE_000_508: While I agree wholeheartedly, we should avoid drawing more attention than we already have. We must be patient until Oblivion's network turns up a lead...or until our self-proclaimed queen makes her next move.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_KRILE_000_000: Ah, , your timing could not have been better. If you have a moment, we have some things we'd like to share.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_KRILE_000_001: Excellent. We'll just wait for Lamaty'i─she should arrive shortly.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_WUKLAMAT_000_002: ! Glad to see you here too.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_KRILE_000_003: And speak of the devil. Let's catch each other up, shall we?
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_WUKLAMAT_000_004: Right. I'll go first if nobody minds.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_WUKLAMAT_000_005: I've been back in Tuliyollal and spoke with Koana. I told him all about the records left behind by Gulool Ja's mother, as well as Sphene's reappearance.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_WUKLAMAT_000_006: We decided that I should remain in the dome until things settled down more.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_WUKLAMAT_000_007: But while I'm Gulool Ja's guardian, I'm also a foreign ruler. I'll have to take care not to appear as though I'm meddling in Alexandrian politics. That's all from me.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_GRAHATIA_000_008: As for the rest of us, we've been keeping track of this new Sphene. She has been making regular appearances before the people.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_GRAHATIA_000_009: And each time she does, she encourages them to become Endless. Alas, much else about her remains a mystery, including why she's chosen to reveal herself now.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_GEODE_000_010: On our end, we've confirmed that only those wearing regulators have had their knowledge of Queen Sphene's death altered.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_GEODE_000_011: Someone must have tampered with the devices to remove any and all memories of the event. Though we haven't yet identified the perpetrator, given recent events, Sphene is the chief suspect.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_KRILE_000_012: Many believe that the Queen of Reason is alive and well, and remember her funeral as a memorial for those lost in the attack. Needless to say, this has proven confusing for those with more accurate recollections.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_GEODE_000_013: We'll carry on with our investigation. I'll head to Earthen Sky now and coordinate with our people there.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_KRILE_000_014: There's one other matter. The highlight of this gathering, you might say...
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_KRILE_000_015: We'd like you to meet a certain someone.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_WUKLAMAT_000_016: By all means. Where's this person now?
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_KRILE_000_017: In the break room. She is unwell, and Y'shtola and Alisaie have been tending to her. They'll be able to explain things.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_GULOOLJA_000_018: I want to see how she's doing, so I'll come too.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_GULOOLJA_000_019: The break room is at the end of the hallway through that door. We can go whenever you're ready.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_KRILE_000_020: Much as I'd love to join you in the break room, I'd rather not overwhelm our guest with too many new faces. Better to keep investigating the activities of our new Sphene.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_GRAHATIA_000_021: Alphinaud and Erenville have taken it upon themselves to attend to the people of Alexandria. Full many are still struggling to deal with recent events, and they hope to make a difference by lending them a sympathetic ear.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_WUKLAMAT_000_040: The original Queen Sphene... We'll tell her what she wants to know. Then we'll decide what we need to do.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_GULOOLJA_000_041: What would Otis do if he were here? What can I do?
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_ALISAIE_000_042: To wake up alone in the distant future, and seemingly by no choice of your own... You can hardly blame her for reacting as she did.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_YSHTOLA_000_043: The treatment may have been effective, but the road ahead for her remains uncertain.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_SHALE_000_044: We turned up her chamber when we searched the Meso Terminal. Safe to say none of us had anticipated this development.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: I...I do not believe that you are lying. So please...tell me everything that has happened. Everything...
