TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_YSHTOLA_000_052: But let us do so with care, lest we cause you undue strain.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_YSHTOLA_000_053: Now, while I should like more of us to assist, it isn't practical to gather everyone, so I will summon G'raha Tia and Krile for now.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_WUKLAMAT_000_054: Come on, we'll give Sphene the grand tour!
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_GULOOLJA_000_055: Sphene asked me not to call her by her title. I understand why, but it feels strange.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Thank you as well, , for your kindness.
The Endless Sphene... You knew her, did you not?
It may take time for both of us to come to terms with this situation─myself especially. But I recognize that I must. I may still be here, but the world I knew is gone...
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_WUKLAMAT_000_000: Come on, we'll give Sphene the grand tour!
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_GULOOLJA_000_001: Sphene asked me not to call her by her title. I understand why, but it feels strange.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_SHALE_000_002: Y'shtola and Alisaie left for the government sector.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_SHALE_000_003: They wanted to discuss how to go about treating those afflicted with lightning. Admirable─I don't know how they keep going without so much as a short break.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Before heading out, I should put on more suitable attire. There's a modern outfit among the items Shale has prepared for me, I believe.
If you would wait outside, I should only need a moment.
Shale said that she chose the outfit herself. Once I've changed, I shall join you outside.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_WUKLAMAT_000_014: Even if she can walk, she's still far from fully recovered. We'll have to take care not to push her too hard.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_GULOOLJA_000_015: I haven't gone outside in a while. Shale decrypted more of my mother's records, so I've been spending a lot of time reading them...
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_SHALE_000_020: As long as we keep Sphene's identity under wraps, it should be safe enough to walk around the city.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_SHALE_000_021: Still, we can't be too cautious while the simulant's off doing whatever it is she's doing. Do take care out there.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_WUKLAMAT_000_022: So you've been to Tuliyollal! Were you able to meet with your friend?
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_RESIDENT05300_000_0: I was! Things were a bit awkward at first─she's still so young, after all─but before long we were talking up a storm. We had so much fun, just like old times!
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: So this is Alexandria... Despite being inside a tower, it feels as though I'm out in the open.
And though the sights are nothing like I remember, electrope is still everywhere I look. 'Tis a strange yet familiar place.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_GULOOLJA_000_030: That lady wants to talk with Lamaty'i, so while they're busy, I'll tell you about what we can see from here. Is there any place that interests you?
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: There are so very many, I can't decide where to begin...
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_GULOOLJA_000_032: Then why don't we let  choose?
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_SYSTEM_000_033: The following event cannot be skipped. You may wish to cancel any pending Duty Finder registrations.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_GULOOLJA_000_040: The lady talking to Lamaty'i just came back from Tuliyollal. It was her first time since being trapped in the barrier thirty years ago. She has family in Alexandria now, so she had to return.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_GULOOLJA_000_041: But the train made it safe and easy for her to make the journey, and it's all thanks to everyone's hard work!
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: There was once a railroad connecting Alexandria and neighboring Lindblum, but operations were suspended when relations deteriorated. Eventually, the tracks were removed entirely.
To see that a railroad now connects us to our new neighbors is gratifying.

Especially considering that our history began with war─with Alexandria the aggressor. In continuing to strive for peace, Tuliyollal's leaders have shown great magnanimity, and I can't help but be moved.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_GULOOLJA_000_045: There are lots of different shops at the Nexus Arcade, selling everything you need. It's always full of people out doing their shopping.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_GULOOLJA_000_046: The Endless Sphene gave  and Lamaty'i a tour of the place. I remember watching them from a distance.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: The castle town I knew had a main thoroughfare that was lined with shops. Whenever I visited, the citizens would come and speak with me about matters great and small.
Just like that lady is doing now with Wuk Lamat...
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_GULOOLJA_000_049: If you attune to leynode nine, you can teleport back here any time you want.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_GULOOLJA_000_050: You can also use it to teleport to other locations in Solution Nine. It makes it easy to get around.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: That's the mode of travel that utilizes aether currents, yes? We had the same in my time, but when the Storm Surge broke out, such nodes were sealed off to prevent enemy use.

And after the war, the aetheric balance across the entire world had collapsed. Not only was travel outside the barrier ill-advised, the act of teleportation itself had become dangerous. We had to abandon the nodes altogether.
'Tis heartening to see them available again for the use of one and all...
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_GULOOLJA_000_054: In the government sector, there's a counter where citizens can get matched to jobs.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_GULOOLJA_000_055: There's also a soul exchange, but no one goes there much these days since there aren't many souls in circulation.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: I'm unsure how I feel about regulators and the treatment of souls as a resource...
I understand the grief of those who have lost loved ones, and the desire to escape the sorrow of death.
Even so, I would never wish to forget. My parents, Otis, Zelenia...I want to remember them all. I am reluctant to impose my personal beliefs upon others, though...
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_GULOOLJA_000_059: Thanks for your help, . I hope Queen Sphene─er...I mean, just Sphene─will feel at home here one day.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: The joy of spying stars between faint gaps in the clouds is absent here, but 'tis a fine thing to be sheltered from the thunder and rain.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_WUKLAMAT_000_070: Sorry about that, I got a little carried away with the conversation.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_GULOOLJA_000_071: It's alright.  and I told her about the places we can see from here.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_WUKLAMAT_000_073: Right then, why don't we stroll through the residential sector and then stop at Mosaic? We can take a break there.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_DELIA_000_074: Welcome to Mosaic. When you're ready to order, just let me know.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: I understand this café was named for the different races, who appear as a mosaic of colors when they gather here. What an inspired idea.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_WUKLAMAT_000_080: We've been walking for a while, so let's rest our feet, eh? Drinks are on me.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_WUKLAMAT_000_081: Sphene, ─the two of you go ahead and order first.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_WUKLAMAT_000_001: If you have any troubles or anything else you want to talk about, I'm always here to lend an ear.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_GULOOLJA_000_002: They were worried about not having neo regulators, but Lamaty'i cheered them up.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Forgive me. I didn't mean to darken the mood.
Still, I feel better for having shared my feelings with you. Thank you.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_WUKLAMAT_000_012: I'm sorry I'm not being much of a guide. I don't usually get approached this often.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: It's quite all right. The people have been through so much. It's only natural for them to seek comfort and assurance from someone they trust.
Besides, I was able to relax with a delicious cup of coffee and have a lovely chat with .
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_WUKLAMAT_000_016: Right then, where to next... We could take a look inside the Nexus Arcade, but it can probably wait for when we actually need something.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_GULOOLJA_000_017: In that case, let's head back to the recreation zone. There's plenty to see on True Vue.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: He was this way when we arrived...
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_GULOOLJA_000_030: He looks pale... We need to find a place for him to rest.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_MALACHITE_000_032: I was on my way to attend to some business...when the memory of being killed here came flooding back... The danger has passed, I know, but the terror lingers...
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_MALACHITE_000_033: <sigh> For all the comfort I've offered others in my work, I can't seem to comfort myself...
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_WUKLAMAT_000_034: The regulators and souls they used to spare themselves the horror of death ended up subjecting them to it over and over again. If only we'd come to their aid sooner...
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_WUKLAMAT_000_035: But we're here now. We can offer this man the comfort he can't give himself.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: He may be physically none the worse for wear, but unseen wounds also require time to heal...
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_GULOOLJA_000_037: I see... When the soldiers attacked, he...
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_MALACHITE_000_040: Try as I might, I can't shake this fear... My courage has completely deserted me...
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_SYSTEM_000_041: The citizen is overcome with fear. He may need someone to rally his spirits to recover.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_MALACHITE_000_050: Thank you, I feel better already... Your encouragement was exactly what I needed...
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_MALACHITE_000_051: (-Malachite-)Ah, but where are my manners? My name is Malachite, and I am an usher.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_WUKLAMAT_000_052: An usher? They're the ones who came to those without long to live, right?
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_WUKLAMAT_100_052: But given everything that's happened, I expect your duties have changed.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_MALACHITE_000_053: (-Malachite-)That's correct. We no longer attend to the dying. It is only after they have passed away in their families' care that we convey their remains to a government storage facility.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_MALACHITE_000_055: (-Malachite-)Henceforth we must inter the deceased─but as the specifics are undecided, the bodies must be kept in cold storage for the time being.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_WUKLAMAT_000_056: I didn't know... I'd heard there were graveyards over by the submerged city, but like funerals, burial customs must be long forgotten.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_GULOOLJA_000_057: Did you have usher duties? If so, we could help.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_MALACHITE_000_058: (-Malachite-)I'm not actually here in an official capacity, so I am loath to trouble you further. But since you asked, I shall explain why I've come.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_MALACHITE_000_059: (-Malachite-)I've taken to delivering the personal effects of the departed to their families. Even though their memories have been entrusted to the cloud, I still remember where they once lived.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_MALACHITE_000_060: (-Malachite-)The rule was to dispose of any belongings─to do anything else was strictly forbidden. But it saddened me to see them discarded like waste, so I began secreting away what I could.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_MALACHITE_000_061: (-Malachite-)Of course, I understand that not everyone shares my sentiments, and I leave it to the families to decide what to do with these items. Some accept my deliveries, others reject them.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_MALACHITE_000_062: (-Malachite-)Whether I'm doing the right thing, I cannot say, but I feel the families should be given the choice.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_GULOOLJA_000_063: Oh... They didn't have it before, then...
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_GULOOLJA_100_063: It's important to think about what people leave to us. I want to help.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_GULOOLJA_100_064: Do you want to help too, ?
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_A1_000_001: Deliveries happen to be my specialty!
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_MALACHITE_000_066: (-Malachite-)I'm truly grateful. Now, there are four items to be delivered here in the recreation zone. I leave them in your care.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_MALACHITE_000_067: (-Malachite-)In the meantime, I will head to the residential sector to make deliveries there. After you've finished, please meet me back here─I would like to know the families' reaction.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_WUKLAMAT_000_068: You know, there've been people in Tuliyollal who had similar episodes due to the trauma of the siege...
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_WUKLAMAT_000_069: Would you mind if I went with Malachite, just to keep an eye on him? Only if you can handle those deliveries without me, of course.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_GULOOLJA_100_069: It's fine, it's fine! I'm sure he'll be happy for the company.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_GULOOLJA_000_070: Come, let's deliver these keepsakes to the families!
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: So, there are four items in total to deliver?
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_GULOOLJA_000_081: Right. Three for people on True Vue, and one for someone over by the Neon Stein. Let's visit them in that order.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Might I trouble you to do the talking, ? I fear my voice may betray my identity...
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_GULOOLJA_000_083: Lead the way. We'll be right behind you.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_SYSTEM_000_084: Sphene and Gulool Ja are now accompanying you. Keep them at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_SYSTEM_000_085: You can leave your quest companions behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with them and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_SYSTEM_000_086: If you wish to have your companions join you again, return and speak with them at the original location.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_GULOOLJA_000_088: I heard before about ushers clearing out the homes of the departed. No wonder he started thinking about their belongings.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Even though they're gone, the mementos of our loved ones give us the means to reconnect with them in spirit. I'm sure the people who receive these items will treasure them greatly.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_GULOOLJA_000_091: The people around True Vue seemed scary at first, but most of them are really kind.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_GULOOLJA_000_092: When I see someone passed out on the street now, I worry if they'll be alright...
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: The way the buildings are all in a row reminds me of the old castle town. Lively as it is here, I can see why Oblivion can blend in.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_GULOOLJA_000_095: Genolt's favorite energy tonic is a special formula, not like the ones they sell here. I wanted to try one, but Shale wouldn't let me.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: So you can purchase beverages from these machines? That's wonderful. I've always believed that technology should be developed for the benefit of the people.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_Q3_000_097: Are you sure you wish to part ways with your companions?
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_GULOOLJA_000_098: Has something come up? Alright, we'll wait for you back where we started.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: If you have urgent matters, then please see to them. I'll take in the view in the meantime.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_GULOOLJA_000_100: There you are! Come on, let's deliver the keepsakes.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Taken care of business, have you? Then let us be about our business.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_BEREAVEDA05301_100_: Hm? Is there something you need?
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_SYSTEM_000_110: You should have Sphene and Gulool Ja accompanying you before completing your delivery.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_BEREAVEDA05301_000_: Hm? Is there something you need?
Ah, so Malachite sent you! He was very considerate. When he offered to bring me the keepsake, he stressed that I didn't have to accept it if I felt uncomfortable.
I see why some would say no, but I couldn't do that. Not when it's something that belonged to my parents...who I understand now I will never see again.

Having spare souls won't save us from the inevitable. That's always been the case. But now, I find myself wondering about this and that. Like how much longer can I afford to muck around with my brothers...
...But I won't bore you with my ramblings. Thanks for bringing me the keepsake, and give my regards to Malachite!
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_BEREAVEDB05301_100_: What is it? If you're trying to sell me something, I'm not interested.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_SYSTEM_000_117: You should have Sphene and Gulool Ja accompanying you before completing your delivery.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_BEREAVEDB05301_000_: What is it? If you're trying to sell me something, I'm not interested.
Ohhh, you brought the keepsake. Thank you. I've been looking forward to this, hoping that it might help me remember...but no such luck, it seems.
The owner is dead, and they'll never become one of these “Endless” Queen Sphene tells us about. It's a sad thought...
Even so, I'm not sure I want to become Endless myself. If they're made by putting your memories into a new body made of aether, doesn't that mean you yourself still have to die first?
The thought of not having to worry about souls was appealing, so I was happy to receive a neo regulator, but I've only had doubts since then...
If Queen Sphene herself recommends it, I want to believe that all will be well, but still... <sigh> Sorry, I need to clear my head.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_BEREAVEDC05301_100_: Oh, hello. Do I know you?
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_SYSTEM_000_125: You should have Sphene and Gulool Ja accompanying you before completing your delivery.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_BEREAVEDC05301_000_: Oh, hello. Do I know you?
Ah, so this is the keepsake... Truth be told, I've been wavering as to whether or not I should accept it. I mean, it belonged to someone that died...
It's got me thinking about what we did to Tuliyollal. I didn't even know we'd killed so many of their people, not until the funeral... What if they decide to retaliate?
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_GULOOLJA_000_130: Lamaty'i─Wuk Lamat would never do that. She and everyone in Tuliyollal know that my father was to blame for the attack, not the Alexandrian people.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_BEREAVEDC05301_000_: Oh dear, I'm sorry... I didn't mean to make you speak ill of your father.
It's just...I can't stop worrying about death, and hearing that they're running out of neo regulators makes it worse. I don't know what to do anymore...
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_GULOOLJA_000_133: That's everyone on True Vue. Let's go to the Neon Stein.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER_10: Hm? Are you talking to me?
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_SYSTEM_000_140: You should have Sphene and Gulool Ja accompanying you before completing your delivery.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER_00: Hm? Are you talking to me?
Oh, right, this. I can't say it stirs any memories...but it does feel familiar somehow.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER_10: You know, you look familiar yourself. Where do I know you from...?
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER_00: Ah, of course! You're the unenhanced challenger─no, champion!
I can't stress how incredible it is, what you've achieved without using feral souls. It's a genuine honor to meet you─though not for the first time, I realize...
It was at the infusion station in the government sector...and it wasn't my finest moment, as you might recall.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_A4_000_001: You're the Arcadion fighter who was desperate for souls.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_A4_000_002: You're the one who yelled at Sphene to her face!
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_A4_000_003: Are you sure we've met before...?
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER_00: That's right... I'm sorry you had to see me like that.
I-I apologized, didn't I? I was so desperate then, I wasn't thinking straight...
Ah, well... Never mind. It's fine if you don't remember me being desperate and rude.
(-Lithander-)Anyway, seeing as we're meeting properly now, the name's Lithander.
(-Lithander-)I used to fight in the Arcadion, but not anymore. I took Queen Sphene's words to heart and found a new job, one where I can put my knowledge of physical conditioning to use.

(-Lithander-)As you know, lots of people were badly hurt when the mechanical soldiers malfunctioned, and I've been assisting with their rehabilitation. It's not something I ever imagined myself doing, but here we are.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_GULOOLJA_000_156: Not many people can help others like you can. I think it's great what you're doing.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER_00: (-Lithander-)Heh, thanks. It's encouraging to hear that.
(-Lithander-)There's this fellow who has to learn how to walk all over again. Becoming Endless would solve his problems, but he's determined to overcome them the hard way, with the body he's got.
(-Lithander-)Seeing that gave me a newfound appreciation for my own body. It's a gift from my parents─a sturdy thing that's survived the arena─and I need to take better care of it.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_GULOOLJA_000_160: I'm the only blue-scaled Hoobigo besides my father. Lamaty'i once told me that.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_GULOOLJA_100_160: I don't know how my father felt about it. And there are times when it hurts to think about the things we share.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_GULOOLJA_000_161: Still, I don't want to lose that. Even if I could look the same as an Endless, I would never throw away this body.
TEXT_KINGMH103_05301_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER_00: (-Lithander-)Most people would find it hard to do so, I imagine. Just the thought makes me feel uncomfortable about the whole becoming Endless affair...
(-Lithander-)Ah, but I need to get back to work. Was nice talking to you─and thanks for the delivery.
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_GULOOLJA_000_000: I'm glad I'm the way I am. It's my parents' gift to me, and how I was able to learn more about them─and about myself.
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: I believe that takes care of the deliveries. Thank you for taking charge, .
From what I've seen and heard, 'tis plain the people held their queen in high regard. And the simulant has exploited their love and admiration to win over so very many...
Come, let us report to Malachite. He should be back at the north of the recreation zone.
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_WUKLAMAT_000_013: Done with your deliveries? We've just gotten back ourselves.
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_GULOOLJA_000_014: Malachite seems to be doing better.
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Those we spoke with all harbored anxiety towards death. 'Tis hardly an unnatural sentiment to have, and yet...
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_MALACHITE_000_020: Thank you for your assistance. With this, every delivery I had planned for today is accounted for.
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_MALACHITE_000_021: The reactions I received were...mixed. While some were glad, others decided they did not want the items after all. How was your experience?
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_GULOOLJA_000_022: Everyone accepted their items, but they all felt differently about them. One person couldn't remember the keepsake's owner, and another couldn't stop worrying about their own death.
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_MALACHITE_000_023: I see. It's difficult indeed to predict how people may behave when confronted with reminders of loss.
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_MALACHITE_000_024: ...Of late, I've come to believe that we are each of us the sum of the moments we've shared with our loved ones.
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_MALACHITE_000_025: And when they passed away, and we lost our memories of these people...we lost a part of ourselves. It's a thought that saddens me to no end...
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_MALACHITE_000_026: If our memories of the departed are no longer to be entrusted to the cloud, I wish that those already taken could be returned to us...
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_MALACHITE_000_027: Well, my friends, I must resume my formal duties. My thanks again for your aid.
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Malachite speaks true─our memories are what define us. They form the path we walked to be where we are.
My Endless self, I expect, was much alike to me in the beginning.
But I cannot become like her no more than she could become like me. For once our paths diverged, so too did our lives and experiences.
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_WUKLAMAT_000_031: That's true... Even if we start from the same place, we all have different journeys. At some point, things like our goals and our ways of thinking are bound to change.
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: The Endless Sphene was one possibility. A version of myself who made choices I want to believe I never would. I'm beginning to come to terms with the fact I did, though.
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_WUKLAMAT_000_035: She was looking straight at us... If I didn't know better, I'd say she wanted us to follow her.
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_WUKLAMAT_000_036: I have a bad feeling about this, but we might not have another chance to figure out what she's up to. We're going after her, right?
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_GULOOLJA_000_037: That was my first time seeing the simulant. Though she was smiling, something about her scared me...
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: 'Tis a strange feeling, pursuing one's spitting image. Where does she want us to go, I wonder...
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_WUKLAMAT_000_040: The simulant headed into the street over there.
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_WUKLAMAT_000_041: The Neon Stein is that way... Let's hurry.
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_GULOOLJA_000_051: What a cruel thing to say to Sphene...
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Forgive me. I was once able to use healing spells, but my long slumber appears to have sapped my magical reserves...
<sigh> It's frustrating to be so powerless...but perhaps I must accept my newfound limitations...
TEXT_KINGMH105_05303_GULOOLJA_000_001: What a cruel thing to say to Sphene...
TEXT_KINGMH105_05303_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Alexandria has no need for Queen Sphene. It's the Queen of Reason─my Endless counterpart─that they love.
And although it is a hard truth to accept...it is nevertheless the truth. I must find a new way to serve...
TEXT_KINGMH105_05303_GULOOLJA_000_012: You're not alone. And together, we can get through anything.
TEXT_KINGMH105_05303_WUKLAMAT_000_017: Well said. And it just so happens there's something that only you can do right this moment...
TEXT_KINGMH105_05303_WUKLAMAT_200_017: Let's start with Calyx. What can you tell us about him?
TEXT_KINGMH105_05303_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: He was a prodigy who specialized in the field of electrope and made his mark during the Storm Surge. Yet even as he basked in the admiration of his peers, he struggled with an illness he had from birth, which left him with precious little time to live.
For him to still be here four centuries on, I think it safe to assume that he too has become an Endless.
TEXT_KINGMH105_05303_WUKLAMAT_000_020: I see... While we're somewhat familiar with Preservation, I never imagined we'd cross paths with one of them like this.
TEXT_KINGMH105_05303_WUKLAMAT_000_022: We do. They're supposed to have created Everkeep's core system as well as the Endless Sphene.
TEXT_KINGMH105_05303_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Did they? All while I was slumbering...
TEXT_KINGMH105_05303_GULOOLJA_000_024: The members of Oblivion have spent a lot of time investigating Preservation. We should head to the Backroom and tell them what's happened.
TEXT_KINGMH105_05303_WUKLAMAT_000_025: We've given the others a summary, but we can wait on the details if you need some rest.
TEXT_KINGMH105_05303_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: To think that Krile's parents were once members of Preservation...
TEXT_KINGMH105_05303_GRAHATIA_000_028: We heard about the ambush. You seem to have weathered it well, but try to avoid straining yourself, do you hear me?
TEXT_KINGMH105_05303_SHALE_000_029: The sign might yield some clues...
TEXT_KINGMH105_05303_WUKLAMAT_000_030: At last we have a plan. Let's make it count!
TEXT_KINGMH105_05303_GULOOLJA_000_031: According to the records from Yuweyawata, my mother was investigating Origenics for her own research into souls.
TEXT_KINGMH105_05303_GULOOLJA_000_032: There was map data for Origenics in the records, and that's how we learned about the castle in the foundation sector.
TEXT_KINGMH105_05303_KRILE_000_033: Calyx determines how many will become Endless, but leaves the choice of who in the hands of the people...
TEXT_KINGMH105_05303_KRILE_100_033: Is this his idea of fairness, or does he simply not care? Perhaps he considers all to be worthy of salvation...? Oh, but it's too early for such speculation...
TEXT_KINGMH105_05303_GRAHATIA_000_034: In the world of Sphene's memories, the town was already submerged. Given their dire circumstances, I expect the people considered stripping the castle for materials to rebuild.
TEXT_KINGMH105_05303_GRAHATIA_000_035: For the structure to endure even now... It speaks to its importance to the Alexandrians, as well as their resilience.
TEXT_KINGMH105_05303_SHALE_000_036: I'm working on securing a route to the foundation sector. Please sit tight for a while.
TEXT_KINGMH105_05303_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Thank you for allowing me to accompany you.
It may take time for me to find my place in this new Alexandria, but I will. Slowly but surely.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_WUKLAMAT_000_000: At last we have a plan. Let's make it count!
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_GULOOLJA_000_001: According to the records from Yuweyawata, my mother was investigating Origenics for her own research into souls.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_GULOOLJA_000_002: There was map data for Origenics in the records, and that's how we learned about the castle in the foundation sector.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: The castle was once my home. I shall do my utmost to be of use on this mission.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_KRILE_000_004: Calyx determines how many will become Endless, but leaves the choice of who in the hands of the people...
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_KRILE_100_004: Is this his idea of fairness, or does he simply not care? Perhaps he considers all to be worthy of salvation...? Oh, but it's too early for such speculation...
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_GRAHATIA_000_005: In the world of Sphene's memories, the town was already submerged. Given their dire circumstances, I expect the people considered stripping the castle for materials to rebuild.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_GRAHATIA_000_006: For the structure to endure even now... It speaks to its importance to the Alexandrians, as well as their resilience.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_SHALE_000_010: Right. I believe I've plotted a viable route to the foundation sector.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_SHALE_000_011: As we don't have much information on the area, I'll come along and gather geographic data on-site. You can leave the navigating to me.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_GULOOLJA_000_012: I'll stay behind this time, but let me know if there's anything I can do to help!
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_SHALE_000_013: Oblivion is fortunate to have a capable adapter like you, Gulool Ja. And no matter what the future holds, your knowledge of electrope is bound to serve you well.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_SHALE_000_014: With such dependable support here, we may embark on our mission. Come, let's head to the lift in the government sector.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_WUKLAMAT_000_016: Oblivion's gotten us permission to use the lift. It's nice when things can move quickly.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: From here, we head to the very bottom of Everkeep. I can't help but feel nervous, returning there after so long...
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_GRAHATIA_000_018: Calyx has all but invited us, so we must assume that we are expected...
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_KRILE_000_019: Though it was but from a distance, I remember the sight of Alexandria's castle in the virtual domain. I wonder how it looks now compared to then...
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_GATE05304_000_020: Everything has been arranged for your passage to the foundation sector!
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_SHALE_000_030: There's no direct lift to the foundation sector, so we'll have to transfer to another on the way.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_SHALE_000_031: If we take the wrong lift, we'll end up in the wrong sector, so be sure to follow her instructions.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_SHALE_000_032: According to Teeshal Ja's records, the tower is divided into inner and outer sections below Origenics. The castle is at the heart of the inner section.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_KRILE_000_033: So upon arriving at the foundation sector, we need to make our way inwards.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_SHALE_000_035: It's been modified to track your coordinates, so I'll be guiding you as I collect data.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_WUKLAMAT_000_036: Sounds like we're all set. Let's get going!
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: I shall follow close behind with Shale.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_SHALE_000_038: We're heading into a trap, so watch your step.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_GATE05304_000_039: I'll be your guide for the descent to the foundation sector, after which Shale will take over. Please take care not to lose the communicator!
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_A1_000_002: Form a party and enter the Underkeep.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_WUKLAMAT_000_041: Calyx uses the people's love for Sphene to further his own schemes. We can't allow him to do so any longer. Whatever it takes, we'll find and stop him!
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_KRILE_000_042: It would be nice if this foray was uneventful, but that would be a naive hope. Better to expect the worst.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_GRAHATIA_000_043: Though we are taking a risk, the far greater danger would be to wait. This time, let us take the battle to Calyx.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_GATE05304_000_050: Heading below? I'd be glad to show you the way!
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Zelenia was kind, but she could be stern. A pillar of strength when I ascended the throne in troubled times.
Not only did she protect me, she also buoyed my spirit whenever it threatened to buckle under the pressures of my station...
By preserving her memory and honor, you've done more for me than you could know. Thank you, .
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_SYSTEM_100_070: You may now enter the Underkeep with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_GATE05304_000_000: Heading below? I'd be glad to show you the way!
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_WUKLAMAT_000_010: The Endless Sphene was just a projected image outside Living Memory, so it was a bit of a surprise to see an actual item that belonged to her.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_WUKLAMAT_100_010: On the way back, I asked Shale why the tiara might have been in the throne room.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_WUKLAMAT_101_010: She believes that it was being used to record Sphene's actions. There's no way to tell now whether or not it was with her knowledge...
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_WUKLAMAT_102_010: But it can't be used for questionable ends anymore, so we can at least take comfort in that.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_KRILE_000_012: The interference made it impossible to locate you, and prevented linkpearl transmissions besides...
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_KRILE_000_013: Apologies that we couldn't be there for the critical moment, but as usual you found a way to handle matters.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_GRAHATIA_000_014: Calyx seems to consider the reflections naught but fields to be harvested for his Endless.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_GRAHATIA_000_015: I do not make a habit of dismissing the assertions of others out of hand, but I cannot abide such callous disregard for life.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_SHALE_000_016: Based on the geographic data I gathered, it seems the inner section containing the castle served as a residential area during the early stages of Everkeep's construction.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_SHALE_000_017: The outer section was then added when they expanded the structure into its present-day shape. I expect the system to dry the earth was installed so that they could build a stable foundation on submerged land.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: The simulant gave the impression that she wouldn't be back, but I suppose only time will tell. And at present, we have no further leads on Calyx...
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_GRAHATIA_000_021: For now, perhaps you could take a moment to contact our friends.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_GRAHATIA_000_022: It would be good to catch each other up on recent developments, and I am certain everyone would appreciate hearing from you.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_WUKLAMAT_000_023: Come to think of it, I have no idea what Erenville's up to...
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_GULOOLJA_000_024: I'll take a look at the Preservation terminal. Hopefully there'll be something useful.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: I shall take the opportunity to review the books from the castle...and one grimoire in particular.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_KRILE_000_026: Most of the tomes we found were dilapidated from age, but some are thankfully still legible.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_GRAHATIA_000_027: Y'shtola, Alphinaud, Alisaie, and Erenville should all be somewhere within the dome. Pray do the honors in any order you like.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_SHALE_000_028: It irks me to think we're being led on by Calyx, but I'll do my best to find clues of his passage.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_YSHTOLA_000_031: (-Y'shtola-)If it isn't . Is something the matter?
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_YSHTOLA_000_032: (-Y'shtola-)...So Preservation is behind the recent intrigue. It doesn't surprise me. I'm glad to hear you are none the worse for your trials, though.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_YSHTOLA_000_033: (-Y'shtola-)As for myself, I've just concluded a meeting with Gossan. I told him about the cure for levin sickness, and we formed a tentative plan to treat all those who are stricken.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_YSHTOLA_000_034: (-Y'shtola-)I'm now otherwise unoccupied, so I shall take a look around the government sector to see if aught is amiss.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_YSHTOLA_000_035: (-Y'shtola-)And if this Calyx is obsessed with the key, then I ought to begin studying it in earnest as well.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ALPHINAUD_000_036: (-Alphinaud-)Ah, excellent timing, my friend. I had a mind to call you myself to see how you were faring.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ALPHINAUD_000_037: (-Alphinaud-)Calyx... While something was obviously afoot, I couldn't have imagined that such an individual would be involved.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ALPHINAUD_100_037: (-Alphinaud-)'Tis well you were able to prevent the simulant from sowing further uncertainty. That said, her absence may have consequences.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ALPHINAUD_000_038: (-Alphinaud-)The people of Alexandria still have great trust in Sphene─'tis plain in the way they speak of her even now, and in how the simulant was able to win them over.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ALPHINAUD_000_039: (-Alphinaud-)When they notice she has ceased to appear again, rumor and worry will spread. We must be mindful of any pronounced shift in the mood of the populace.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ALPHINAUD_000_040: (-Alphinaud-)But forgive me─it's been battle after battle for you, hasn't it? We can handle ourselves for now, so pray rest up while you can and recover your strength.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ALISAIE_000_041: (-Alisaie-)Yes, hello! ...!? For you to call out of the blue, is something wrong?
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ALISAIE_000_042: (-Alisaie-)...What? You went all the way to the bottom of Everkeep, and you didn't think to ask me to come!?
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ALISAIE_100_042: (-Alisaie-)<sigh> But I suppose I've been fairly busy myself...
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ALISAIE_000_043: (-Alisaie-)I'm pleased to say that we've received permission to begin administering the cure for levin sickness to citizens.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ALISAIE_000_044: (-Alisaie-)I'm actually due to visit a boy named Milos shortly, to see how he is responding to his treatment.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ALISAIE_000_045: (-Alisaie-)You've met him before with Lamaty'i, I believe? The two of you should attend as well if you have time.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ERENVILLE_000_046: (-Erenville-), this is a surprise. Has Wuk Lamat gotten into trouble again?
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ERENVILLE_000_047: (-Erenville-)...I see. Knowing you, I expect you're already looking forward to the next obvious trap. Try not to overdo it.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ERENVILLE_000_048: (-Erenville-)I'm in the outskirts at the moment. I've been helping the people with their work, and talking to those I meet to gauge their sentiment.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ERENVILLE_100_048: (-Erenville-)It's been uneventful for the most part, but there was one notable development.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ERENVILLE_000_049: (-Erenville-)Following recent events, some here stopped wearing regulators. This has led to a disparity in what people remember about the queen's death, and the occasional episode of confusion.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ERENVILLE_000_050: (-Erenville-)I'll be sure to let you know if there are any other changes.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_WUKLAMAT_000_051: Being able to contact people so far away so easily can do wonders for your peace of mind. Linkpearls really are convenient things.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_KRILE_000_052: I see you were able to reach everyone. That is well.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_GRAHATIA_000_053: I thought I heard Alisaie yelling. I hope everything is all right...
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: What did the others have to say, if I may ask?
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_WUKLAMAT_000_061: They've finished treating Milos? Then we have to go and visit him!
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Would you mind if I accompanied you? I understand he's afflicted with the selfsame condition as I was, and I cannot help but worry for him.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_WUKLAMAT_000_063: Of course, we don't mind at all.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_KRILE_000_064: In the meantime, I shall take myself around Solution Nine and see how things are.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_KRILE_000_065: I share Alphinaud's concern about the queen's absence. And even setting that aside, the situation is not like to resolve itself while becoming Endless remains an option.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_GRAHATIA_000_066: I had been meaning to visit some shops, so I shall join Krile.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_SHALE_000_067: While everyone's out and about, I'll try to pick up Calyx's trail. I'll see if I can dig up some information about the key for Y'shtola as well.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: It seems we all have things to do. Still, there's no telling what else Calyx might have planned...so please be careful, everyone.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_WUKLAMAT_000_070: Right, let's go to Milos's apartment. It's in residential radius 9-14, if I remember correctly.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_GULOOLJA_000_071: Lamaty'i told me all about Milos. She said he was around my age, but couldn't leave his bed.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_GULOOLJA_000_072: I'd like to go meet him next time. Maybe we can be friends.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_SHALE_000_073: Calyx is more clever than anyone has any right to be, but I'll sniff him out somehow. Just leave it to me.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_WUKLAMAT_000_074: Look, Milos is sitting up! I'd seen the treatment before, so I knew it would work...but it's still so amazing! Alisaie and Y'shtola are miracle workers!
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: I understand my Endless self visited Milos often. I will keep quiet, so as to not draw suspicion.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ALISAIE_000_076: There you are. Next time something is in the offing, you had better remember to call on me!
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ISADORA_000_077: It's so good to see you again, and a delight to know that you and Alisaie are friends. She's been very kind to us.
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_MILOS_000_080: H-Hello... You came before...with Queen Sphene... I'm glad...I'm glad you came again...
TEXT_KINGMH107_05305_ALISAIE_000_081: I believe he'll be fine now. But just for good measure, I'll administer a healing spell.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_WUKLAMAT_000_000: I wish the Endless Sphene could have been here to see Milos...
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_ALISAIE_000_001: As I treated Milos with Angelo, I couldn't help but think of Ga Bu and Halric. I wonder how they've been.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_GULOOLJA_000_004: Lamaty'i told me all about Milos. She said he was around my age, but couldn't leave his bed.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_GULOOLJA_000_005: I'd like to go meet him next time. Maybe we can be friends.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Milos is a kind and brave boy. It did me well to see him.
One day, I hope that I can speak with him about my other self.
Come, let us return to the Backroom. And on the way, let us pick up treats for our friends─a little gift to show our appreciation for their hard work.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_SHALE_000_013: Geode, can you hear me? Something's happened in the outskirts...
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_GULOOLJA_000_014: The people here took care of me, giving me food and making sure I was alright. I can't bear to imagine the soldiers hurting them...
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: So this is how it is outside... These clouds... Ah, never mind─ Finding Erenville is what matters right now.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_ALISAIE_000_017: I don't see Erenville. I pray he hasn't come to harm...
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_WUKLAMAT_000_020: Things have settled down here, but I still see no sign of Erenville. Let's split up and look for him.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_WUKLAMAT_000_021: Gulool Ja, Sphene─please search in the settlement area.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_WUKLAMAT_000_022: Meanwhile, the rest of us who can defend ourselves will head further out.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_ERENVILLE_000_040: That was a close call... My thanks.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_ERENVILLE_000_041: As I was leading the soldiers away, I caught sight of this poor fellow being pursued.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_ERENVILLE_000_042: I went to help, but was rather out of my depth. We're lucky you found us when you did.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_WUKLAMAT_000_043: Erenville! I'm so glad you're safe!
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_ALISAIE_000_044: We were quite worried when we couldn't find you.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_WUKLAMAT_000_045: We encountered soldiers on the way here. Most paid us no mind, but some turned out to be hostile. There's no way to tell until they set on you.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_ERENVILLE_000_046: The ones here also attacked without any warning. If I hadn't been paying attention, it could've ended badly...
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_ERENVILLE_000_047: Hopefully the others were able to escape. We should return to the outskirts and take stock.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_SHALE_000_048: Erenville is safe? What a relief...
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_WUKLAMAT_000_049: I didn't expect to see Malachite out here. Given his own trauma, I wonder if he'll be alright...
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_GULOOLJA_000_051: But...you shouldn't have had to. None of this would've happened if I could control the soldiers...
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: No one thought that Gulool Ja might have been behind the attacks. They know that he would never make the soldiers do them harm.
Even so, he feels responsible for the machines' actions. 'Tis a misplaced burden, and I pray it drives him not to despair.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_ALISAIE_000_054: The situation here appears to have been resolved, but I doubt we've seen the last of such incidents...
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_GEODE_000_055: We responded to Shale's call as quickly as we could. Others are out keeping an eye on soldiers nearby.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_MALACHITE_000_056: I did not expect to see you again so soon. Allow me to thank you again for your earlier help.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_ALPHINAUD_200_100: Thank the Twelve you are all unharmed.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_ALPHINAUD_200_101: 'Tis small solace amidst this tragedy, however...
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_YSHTOLA_200_102: The machine rampage seems to have been only temporary. Soldiers and vehicles alike ceased to operate all at once, as if they had fulfilled their purpose.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_ALISAIE_200_103: It's the same outside Everkeep, though members of Oblivion are keeping watch for good measure.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_ALISAIE_210_103: ...The first attacks came shortly after the announcement that neo regulators had run out. It can't have been a coincidence.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_KRILE_210_104: I struggle to imagine that anyone but Calyx could gain control of the soldiers. This must have served his ends in some way...
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_KRILE_200_104: Gulool Ja, are you still without your authority?
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_GULOOLJA_200_105: It's fine now. I'm in control again.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_YSHTOLA_200_106: We might take the opportunity to shut down the machines. There's no guarantee this won't happen again.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_GULOOLJA_200_107: Lamaty'i just talked with Everkeep's administrators about that. They said it wasn't so simple...
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_WUKLAMAT_200_108: The mechanical soldiers don't only serve as guards. They also perform various vital tasks, like providing medical treatment and managing food production.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_WUKLAMAT_200_109: If we shut them down, we'd struggle to render aid to the citizens, let alone restore their lives to normal.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_GULOOLJA_200_110: I made it so they can't use weapons anymore, though. Hopefully that makes it a little safer...
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_YSHTOLA_200_111: That seems the best approach for now. Thank you for your swift action, Gulool Ja.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_ORIGINALSPHENE_200_: This powerlessness... I can abide it no longer...
No matter how much hardship and loss, we could endure if there was but happiness at the end...
Yet all I see now is suffering and misery...
I want to protect the people. For their happiness, I would do anything and everything.
So please... Please lend me your aid!
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_WUKLAMAT_200_118: Oh Sphene...you've found the words I wished you'd said back then...
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_WUKLAMAT_200_120: Our strength is yours, Sphene! Together, we'll get through this!
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_GRAHATIA_200_121: Let us split up and get to work. Might I trouble you to report to Shale, my friend?
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_WUKLAMAT_200_121: Let us split up and get to work. Might I trouble you to report to Shale, my friend?
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_WUKLAMAT_000_060: Malachite and his fellows are tending to the deceased. His trauma must make the work difficult, but he's determined to do what he can.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_GULOOLJA_000_061: Couriers and cleaners are clearing away the wrecks of vehicles and soldiers. It's the first step to getting things back to normal.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: It pains me that the people were made to suffer even more after so much hardship and tragedy...but you and yours saved many lives. I cannot thank you enough.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_SHALE_000_078: It's been a trying day, but it seems the worst is behind us. What's the situation out there now?
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_SHALE_000_079: You've moved quickly to restore things to normal. Thank you. Yet while disarming the soldiers is indeed prudent, it is a far from comprehensive measure when vehicles can be commandeered to inflict damage and sow chaos...
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_SHALE_000_080: For the time being, I'll set our people to keeping a close watch on machines. I also have a mind to consult the authorities about enlisting hunters to our aid.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: I must regain my proficiency in magic. To that end, I shall seek advice from Y'shtola and Alisaie.
Among the books we recovered from the castle was a grimoire I once used. I hope to learn to wield it again, at everyone's side.
As for the key, I think it best that it remains in your care, though it means you will bear the greatest risk.
In order to ease your burden, I shall endeavor to become a capable warrior and make Otis and Zelenia proud!
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_SHALE_000_001: If you have a moment, , Geode wants to take stock of the current crisis.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_SHALE_100_001: Oblivion may be lacking the finer details in certain areas, so we'd like you to lend your perspective to the conversation.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_100_002: Sorry to drag you into our meeting, but we need to get a better handle on the threats Alexandria is facing right now.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_KRILE_110_002: Not at all. Much has happened since the state funeral, and a clearer idea of where things stand would be beneficial for us as well.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_SHALE_000_002: First things first, then─let's discuss the state of the machine malfunctions.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_SHALE_000_003: Every single sector reported instances of sentries attacking citizens without provocation, and vehicles suddenly becoming unresponsive to controls.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_SHALE_100_003: And while these malfunctions were resolved fairly quickly, they nevertheless resulted in a considerable number of injuries and deaths...
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_WUKLAMAT_110_003: But you haven't heard anything about new incidents since then, right?
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_SHALE_120_003: Right. No additional reports have been logged, as far as I know. That's the good news.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GULOOLJA_000_004: The bad news is, I tried to take control of the soldiers when they started hurting people, but they wouldn't listen to me─even though I have the king's authority.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GULOOLJA_000_005: Once things calmed down, I was finally able to make them give up their weapons. But...if it happens again, I don't know if they'll ignore me like before.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_000_006: The King of Resolve's authority is about the highest there is. Who is this man that can override it with such impunity?
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_100_: Calyx... He lived in the age of the Storm Surge, as I did.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_110_: Lest you forget, he was known for his advancements in electrope technology, and it was he who established Preservation for the purpose of furthering his research.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_120_: The wasting disease which afflicted him, however, was said to leave him scant years left to live... He must have chosen to undergo conversion into an Endless, that he might continue his efforts into the present day.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_130_006: Preservation's early goals seemed noble enough─exploring treatments for levin sickness, designing Everkeep's core system, that sort of thing.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_140_006: Why harm the people he was ostensibly trying to help...?
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: I do not pretend to fully understand Calyx's motivations... Only that he appeared incensed by what he saw as mankind's failings.
He asserted that the strategy of adapting our species through generational succession was outdated; that evolution now requires us to forsake bodies of flesh in favor of eternal preservation.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_KRILE_000_013: We've already seen how he's employed the simulant to convince Alexandrians that Endless conversion is their only hope for survival.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_KRILE_100_013: Eternal life is “assured” for the five thousand who register their neo regulators...
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_KRILE_110_013: But this is merely one part of Calyx's greater plan.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_KRILE_120_013: He wants the key to interdimensional fusion. With that relic in his possession, he will draw aether from the reflections, and expand his efforts to create Endless a thousandfold.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_SHALE_000_018: If we mean to foil Calyx's schemes, then our only option is to determine where he's hiding and put him down.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_SHALE_000_019: Which, unfortunately, is easier said than done. I've been scouring the terminal we found in the depths of Everkeep, but I've failed to uncover even the slightest trace of his activities.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_SHALE_100_019: Give me a little more time, though, and I'm sure I can sniff him out.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_100_020: While Gulool Ja and Shale are working on that, I think I'm going to take a look around town.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_110_020: I want to make sure no new problems have cropped up, as well as search for any information that might lead us to Calyx.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_120_020: You're welcome to come along. Another “malfunction” could happen at any time, and I'd be glad to have some brawlers at my back.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_KRILE_140_020: Raha and the others are helping Oblivion patrol the other levels of the keep, so shall we stick to the streets of Solution Nine?
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_150_020: Sounds like a plan. Thanks, you two, I appreciate the company!
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_WUKLAMAT_000_022: I have to speak with the city's administrators about bringing in the Landsguard. I want our soldiers around to protect those who're moving to Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_WUKLAMAT_000_023: Alphinaud and Alisaie will be joining me for the meeting, so the three of us can cover that sector as soon as we're done!
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: I'd like to join 's group, if you'll have me?
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_100_025: The more mouths to ask questions, the merrier. As long as you're aware of the dangers.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Thank you! I'll do my best not to be a burden.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_SHALE_000_027: I'm more worried about you, Geode. Don't do anything stupid.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_000_028: Pfft, you'll change your tune once we get back with the goods on Calyx. Then the drinks are on you!
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_000_029: Come on, let's continue this outside.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_SHALE_000_030: Good luck with your patrol, and take your time. We can do without Geode until you're done with the old sot.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_SHALE_100_030: Ah, sorry. Just when I think I've internalized better manners, talking with Geode brings back all the old bad habits.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GULOOLJA_000_040: I wish I could grow up faster... There'll be so much more I can do when I'm bigger like you.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_KRILE_000_045: The city looks as though it's regained a sense of normalcy. Alas, the people will not soon forget recent events...
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: I will do my utmost to ensure the happiness of Alexandria and its people...
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_000_047: ...Sorry, I was off in my own little world! Shall we get started?
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_A1_000_003: Let's see what there is to see!
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_000_048: They do, and can't say as I blame them.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_000_049: Me...? I'm well enough, given the circumstances.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_100_049: Right you are. It's time we took some action.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_110_049: It was the queen's fondest wish that her subjects remain shielded from the horrors of death. And so they were for the longest time.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_120_049: Then, the moment mortality once again becomes an unavoidable fact of life, they're greeted with an outbreak of bloody violence.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_130_049: Many are bound to give the Endless alternative serious consideration.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Indeed, and I do not blame them for that. It is only natural that such thoughts should come to mind.
What I cannot forgive is the way Calyx wields fear and misery to manipulate people into making that choice.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_100_: No one─not Calyx, nor anyone else─should dictate how we cope with the specter of death.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_110_: As one who lived as an Alexandrian, I wish to put the choices for this country's future back into the hands of its citizens.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_120_051: And you think we can handle that responsibility? After everything you've seen of us?
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_130_: It is what I've seen that has convinced me you can.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_140_: I awoke four centuries later to find our people living and laughing beneath Alexandria's banner. Though surprised and bewildered, I was overjoyed to see it so. You all deserve to be happy...
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_160_051: We'd best not let you down!
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_170_051: Now, I suggest we move as a group─we don't know if or when a battle might find us.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_KRILE_000_052: Oh. I believe someone came prepared for just such an eventuality.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_KRILE_000_053: Is that the grimoire you retrieved from the old castle?
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_100_: Yes, my parents gifted it to me when I was a child. They were adamant that I should learn to protect the things important to me.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_110_: I was fortunate enough to have a tutor in the arcane arts, so I lay claim to some small measure of skill.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_KRILE_120_053: If that's the case, it might be better if we split into two groups after all. 'Twould certainly be more efficient for information gathering!
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_000_054: I, uh... I guess that makes sense?
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_000_055: The two of you can take the west side of the recreation zone, then.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_100_055: and I will take the east.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_KRILE_000_056: Very well. We shall end our patrol in the plaza just past True Vue and await you there.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_KRILE_000_060: I'll keep my eyes and ears open. Any information could be helpful, no matter how seemingly insignificant.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: My grimoire is inlaid with electrope in a manner which augments arcane power. It should prove a useful tool.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_000_070: Let's do the rounds, then. We'll see what's what, and chat to the people we meet along the way.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_000_071: Pay special attention to anyone who looks overwhelmed or overly excited. Hopefully that will earn us a tidbit or two we didn't know before.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_000_077: I'm guessing you would've preferred to go with Sphene and Krile, but I'm afraid you're stuck with me. I grow on people, though, I promise.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_SYSTEM_100_077: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Geode?
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_000_078: Need to step away? Fair enough. I'll wait for you outside the Neon Stein.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_100_079: Shall we go find Krile and Sphene, then?
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_100_080: Ah, the memories... I used to drink around here all the time.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_110_080: I made sure not to overdo it when I had work the next day, but once we were past the busy season─or when the ladies weren't amenable to my company─well... You'd have to scrape me off the street outside in the morning. Or afternoon.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_120_080: The worst I ever got was on what should have been the worst day of my life...if only I could remember it. I was still wearing a regulator back then.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_130_080: It was also the day I first met Shale, although I guarantee she's forgotten it completely.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_000_081: It was once my job to deliver goods by hover cargo. That's why I know a fair number of names and faces throughout the city.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_000_082: The little ones who'd jump for joy when I brought them packages... The old lady who'd always greet me with a smile... I'd hate for anything bad to happen to them.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_SYSTEM_000_086: You may learn something of interest here. Return with Geode at your side.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_CITIZENA05364_000_0: Are the sentries and air-wheelers safe to be around now?
I just know it's going to happen again...and maybe next time I'll be the one who dies in a horrible accident.
I need a neo regulator. Becoming Endless is the only way─even Queen Sphene said so!
But how to get one...? Maybe I can convince someone who's unsure to give me theirs.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_CITIZENB05364_000_0: What has me in such a fine mood, you ask?
Well, I've just registered my new regulator. I was leery of becoming nothing but memories at first, but now that I've gone through with the registration, I've never felt more at ease!
Also, once it was done, the regulator displayed the current numbers. Of the five thousand slots available, over thirty-eight hundred have already been filled.
So if you're still hesitant, you've not much time to make your mind up. Mark my words, friend: when there's only a few slots left, it's going to get very ugly.
We'll be seeing fights over neo regulators in the very near future. Should you get one, I suggest you register right away.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_DEPRESSED05364_100_: You want to hear my story? While I appreciate you offering a sympathetic ear, there's not much to tell...
If you must know, a good friend of mine died when those machines went crazy. His air-wheeler dropped right out of the sky, and he didn't survive the crash.
Damn fool wasn't wearing a regulator... I know that's not so strange these days, but he'd never bothered with one.
He was at peace with the idea of dying someday, and I thought I understood what that meant. Until it happened...
We used to forget people after they died. No memories. No grief. I'm not sure if we'd be better off if that was still the case.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_110_110: I feel like there was a new factor in these stories we've heard. One we hadn't considered during our discussion with everyone in the Backroom...
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_A3_000_001: That people are still deathly afraid?
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_A3_000_002: That fights are likely to break out over the neo regulators?
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_A3_000_003: That a victim of the violence wasn't wearing a regulator?
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_100_111: That's a point of concern, don't get me wrong, but I think we were acutely aware of it already...
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_100_112: The fact that nearly four thousand people have registered is worthy of its own report. But are you sure there wasn't anything else...?
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_100_114: The vast majority of residents have always worn regulators, so it's not a detail we'd normally think about. With the supply of souls cut off, though, more and more people have been going without them...
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_100_115: We need to look into the casualties from the recent attacks, and check whether or not they were equipped with regulators.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_100_116: Let's ask around on the street over to the east. It was pretty chaotic at the time, but maybe we'll find eyewitnesses who can help us confirm if this was a pattern or not.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_CLEANERS05364_000_1: I'm too scared of the sentries to clean anywhere near them...
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_MACHINE05364_000_11: Hello, how are you today? Please let me know if I may be of service.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_SYSTEM_000_118: You may learn something of interest here. Return with Geode at your side.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_000_119: Aside from Oblivion members, only a handful of people used to go out and about without regulators. How times have changed.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_CLEANERS05364_000_1: You wish to know if the people who died in the machine rampage were wearing regulators?
I'm sorry, but I was assigned to clearing away debris. I didn't see any of the deceased.
No bodies were present by the time I arrived, so I assume the ushers had already done their work...
I do remember there being patches of white dust scattered about that were quite a chore to clean up, but nothing else worthy of mention.
It's terrifying to think that death might be waiting for us around every corner. But what can you do but keep working and hope for the best...?
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_MACHINE05364_000_12: Hello, how are you today? Please let me know if I may be of service.
...City-wide casualty data unavailable. Government officials are currently processing reports from all affected zones.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_000_127: Can you narrow it down to the recreation zone, then? You must have some estimates on hand?
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_MACHINE05364_000_12: Recalibrating parameters. Injured: Eighty-seven individuals. Casualties: Nineteen individuals.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_MACHINE05364_100_12: Please remain calm: I am under orders to ensure the safety of our citizens. In the unlikely event of another mass malfunction, I will act to subdue any affected machines.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_110_129: .... I think it's time we rejoined Krile and Sphene.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_120_129: I was half-joking with my boast to Shale, but we may have stumbled upon something major here. We should share our findings and keep pursuing this avenue of inquiry.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_130_129: Didn't Krile say to meet them in the plaza just outside of True Vue? Let's get going.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_140_: We've finished our patrol as well. Did it not seem that more people wanted neo regulators than before...?
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_160_129: Come on, we should meet Krile and Sphene at the plaza. Can't say I'm thrilled to have Shale owe me a drink over something like this...
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_KRILE_100_130: Oh? Did Geode have something else to attend to?
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_SYSTEM_110_130: You should have Geode accompanying you before sharing your findings.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_KRILE_000_132: So, essentially, you're saying that the people who were killed by malfunctioning machines weren't wearing regulators!?
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_100_132: Well, the numbers are still tentative, and only apply to that one zone. We don't know how they'll stack up against the overall data, but...this is definitely more than a coincidence.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_110_132: I think it's safe to say that anyone who had removed their regulator was a priority target.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Now that you mention it, the person I was treating for injuries wasn't wearing one either...
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_100_: But, why? Why are they being targeted over everyone else?
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_KRILE_000_134: Based solely on the lack of a neo regulator, we cannot judge if a person has no desire to become Endless, or if they simply failed to acquire one of the limited devices.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_KRILE_100_134: But those who wear no regulator at all...
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_KRILE_110_134: They have clearly rejected the old system of using souls to revive themselves.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_KRILE_120_134: Put another way, they have chosen to live their lives in the knowledge that death is an inevitability.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_130_: The chances that such resolute people would wish to become Endless are far lower, I would imagine.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_140_: And so Calyx has chosen those least likely to accept his vision as victims to stoke fear and panic...
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_000_135: But there was no need to kill anyone!
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_000_136: With the way things were, the people were already fearful enough─he could have found five thousand willing citizens without all this madness!
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_KRILE_100_136: You make a good point. Perhaps this sowing of terror is in service to another scheme, or he had some other need for the lives he's taken...
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_A4_000_001: What of the dust found at various sites?
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_A4_000_002: Could something have been done to the victims?
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_000_137: Right, the sanitation worker's story. She saw no bodies, but mentioned piles of white dust...
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_100_137: I wonder... What about that sanitation worker's story? She saw no bodies, but mentioned piles of white dust...
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Dust, but no bodies? Now where have I heard that before...
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_100_: Do you recall when we went to save Erenville from the sentries in the outskirts? That usher Malachite told us much the same thing.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_MALACHITE_110_138: (-Malachite-)When I arrived, I found no body. Only a pile of dust, which the wind quickly scattered.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_MALACHITE_120_138: (-Malachite-)Confused, I questioned the residents, but none knew what had become of it.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: That both stories speak of missing remains is suspicious enough, but the shared mention of this dust is too much to ignore.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_KRILE_100_139: In that case, we should confirm if this substance was present at other sites, and attempt to ascertain its nature.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_KRILE_110_139: Following this thread may lead us not only to an explanation for the missing bodies, but also the intent behind Calyx's murderous actions.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GULOOLJA_000_142: (-Gulool Ja-), we need your help! I've lost control over the soldiers in the residential area. They might be trying to hurt people again.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GULOOLJA_000_143: (-Gulool Ja-)Oblivion members are on their way now, but are you close enough to join them?
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_GEODE_000_144: Dammit! Our new investigation will have to wait... Let's go!
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: She should recover in due course. I'm glad we arrived when we did...
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_MILOS_000_150: When I was sick and couldn't move, my mother was always at my side, always keeping me company. And I'm going to do the same for her!
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_KRILE_000_155: I'll take care of this gentleman. Go and check on Isadora and Milos!
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_WAYAKKWE_000_170: Forgive me, I was reckless... You shouldn't have had to waste time tending my wounds as well.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_WAYAKKWE_000_172: Did you see our other comrade back there? He stayed behind in the lobby, but I heard the sounds of fighting...
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: He... I am sorry. He must have fallen protecting the residents...
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: For their sakes, I have to remain calm...
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_MILOS_000_005: When I was sick and couldn't move, my mother was always at my side, always keeping me company. And I'm going to do the same for her!
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_KRILE_000_010: I'll take care of this gentleman. Go and check on Isadora and Milos!
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_WAYAKKWE_000_020: Our comrade...you think he may have been struck down?
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_WAYAKKWE_000_021: If he is wounded or worse, I should go to him...
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Wait! Please. It isn't safe and you still need rest. Would you stay with Milos and watch over Isadora for me?
We will tend to your friend.
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_WAYAKKWE_000_024: I... Thank you. Please be careful yourself.
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: That man, he... This is awful.
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_WAYAKKWE_000_035: Isadora and Milos had completed their applications to leave the dome and were practically out the door when...all this happened. We'll make sure they're taken care of the moment Isadora is ready to travel.
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_KRILE_000_040: ...Isadora is going to be alright, then? I'm so glad.
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_KRILE_000_041: I've just finished my ministrations here.
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_KRILE_100_041: Our Oblivion comrade was beyond saving, I'm afraid...
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_ORIGINALSPHENE_110_: That brave soul. He gave his life to save another...
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_SOLUTIONRESIDENT73_: He died protecting me... I don't understand why any of this is happening!
That sentry was behaving normally, like any other. Then, all of a sudden, it...it tried to kill me!
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_KRILE_000_042: Weapons or no, Calyx commanded them to commit murder...
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_OBLIVIONF05365_000_: Is it over!? We came as soon as Wayakkwe sent word...
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: I am sorry... By the time we arrived, it was already too late.
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_OBLIVIONM05365_000_: ...Then Geode could be in trouble, too. Once we have this radius locked down, we need to find him.
Possibly. We're not sure what, but he stopped responding to our communications.
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_OBLIVIONF05365_000_: We need to prioritize securing the residential sector, though, at least until we regain control over the sentries...
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Then we should search for Geode.
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_KRILE_100_048: I agree. Since most Oblivion members have sworn off regulators, if our theory holds true, then they could be prime targets for the next attack.
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_KRILE_110_048: Please do what you can to shepherd the residents to safety, but avoid the sentries at all costs.
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_OBLIVIONM05365_000_: Our thanks. Here, take these communicators.
We've made modifications to them to prevent Calyx from intercepting the signal, and have been using them to coordinate movements with allies in the vicinity.
Wayakkwe has one too, so I'll ask her to keep hailing Geode.
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_KRILE_000_053: Geode said he would sweep the surrounding area, so he shouldn't have ventured too far. Let's get going!
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_OBLIVIONF05365_000_: I hope you find Geode soon. I know he's probably saving people with one hand and fighting off threats with the other, but I can't help but worry...
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_OBLIVIONM05365_000_: Leave matters here to us. We'll see to our fallen comrade, and make sure no one else comes to harm.
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_SOLUTIONRESIDENT73_: Pray thank your Milalla friend for me. I would still be a helpless mess if not for her encouragement...
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_KRILE_000_070: Let's search around the apartments first!
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_SYSTEM_000_080: You see no sign of Geode. Perhaps you should search further to the east.
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_SYSTEM_000_090: You see no sign of Geode. Wayakkwe's voice crackles forth from the communicator...
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_SYSTEM_000_092: There is no response. Perhaps you should continue your search further to the east.
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_SYSTEM_000_100: You see no sign of Geode. The neighboring residential radius would be the next logical place to look...
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_KRILE_000_105: I can't... There are no words...
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_ORIGINALSPHENE_100_: And the soul cell he left behind... Was that his twisted way of returning Geode to us?
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Damn you, Calyx... Damn you and your careless cruelty!
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_KRILE_000_113: Even so. Some might say every death was justified if it meant five thousand Endless could continue their immortal lives.
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_KRILE_000_114: And if a reflection's stolen aether allowed for many more Endless? Why, that too would be a noble sacrifice for the greater good...
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_KRILE_130_114: We know only too well... There is naught noble in this sacrifice.
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: We have to stop him. We have to find Calyx, and put an end to this madness as soon as possible...
And under no circumstances can we let the key fall into his possession, .
It falls to us. We must─we will thwart his plans here in Alexandria before he can terrorize innocents in reflections elsewhere...
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_KRILE_000_001: I will hold on to Geode's gun... If you could take the soul cell, please...
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: We should return to the Backroom. Shale and the others need to know what happened.
