TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_KRILE_000_011: Yes, I'll ask Wayakkwe to meet us there as well.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_GULOOLJA_000_025: I got back control of the sentries...probably around the same time Calyx left. I'm sorry, I couldn't stop him...
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_GRAHATIA_000_030: We made a swift patrol of the other levels, and confirmed that Calyx had carried out a number of targeted attacks. All to harvest more aether, it seems...
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_YSHTOLA_000_035: I assume you know better by now, but I hope you're not planning to try anything alone. We are all here with you.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_ERENVILLE_000_040: I've spoken with Wuk Lamat. They've cut their meeting short to deal with the aftermath of this latest violence.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_GENOLT_000_045: They brought back Geode's gun... Its rounds were spent an' its barrel was scorched, so ye can be sure he went down fightin'.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: I am told that the members tasked with keeping residents safe returned with the body of their comrade. They all risk so much...
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_WAYAKKWE_000_050: Another comrade gone. Some days it's almost more than I can bear.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_WAYAKKWE_000_051: Geode was... He was an older brother to Nostalgia and me.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_WAYAKKWE_000_052: Shale knew him longer, though, and is surely taking it the hardest. And that's on top of what happened with Cahciua...
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_WAYAKKWE_000_053: Do you think you could check on her? See how she's doing? She's like to put on a brave face if it's me or my sister.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_WAYAKKWE_000_055: Oh, we have Isadora and Milos under guard, so...that's one less thing to worry about.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_061: We need to press on with the hunt for Calyx, but I can't seem to focus. I should be better than this, I know...
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_A1_000_001: Is there anything I can do?
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_A1_000_002: As you said, you need time to work through it.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_063: You can't help yourself, can you? Still, I appreciate the concern.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_064: You're right. I ought to heed my own words. As it stands, I'm of no use to anyone.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_065: Cahciua used to say the best thing to do with grief was to let it all out.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_066: So, I think I'll take myself over to Earthen Sky and say my good-byes to Geode...
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_067: Why don't you come along? I could use someone to blubber to if you've a shoulder to spare.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_068: Right, then... Let's get out of Everkeep for a bit.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_070: It's a fair trek on foot, so I've arranged for a couple of air-wheelers.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_071: They've had their communications modules removed, so even Calyx shouldn't be able to seize control of them. Say the word, and we'll set off.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_080: Ready? We'll be flying close to the pylons, so follow my lead.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_082: These air-wheelers are Genolt's babies. You won't find a smoother ride in all of Everkeep.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_083: For years now, I've been taking one out for a turn whenever I needed to lighten my mood.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_084: Sometimes Geode would come along, too, and we'd end up racing.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_085: Does that surprise you? Our friendship always had a competitive edge.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_086: We would often talk about how, one day, we might fly our wheelers outside the dome...
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_087: ...Almost there. Be sure the ground is clear before you touch down.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_088: Phew... That's helped clear my head a touch.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_089: You know, , you might be the first person I've ridden with who wasn't an Oblivion recruit.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_090: ...As far as I remember, at least. The memories from my regulator days aren't exactly reliable.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_091: Come on, let's head inside. Hopefully the way will be clear of pests today...
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_111: We can usually avoid such encounters, but sometimes they wander in and block the only path.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_112: Not that it slowed you down at all. I've never seen you fight up close before, and the surveillance feed clearly didn't do it justice.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_113: Ahem. Hopefully that keeps the route clear for a while. Shall we?
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_130: ...I appreciate you helping me through this.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_131: And not only the grief. You've helped me see that my comrades mean even more to me than I realized.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_133: I'll be spending every waking moment working to bring Calyx to account for his crimes.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SHALE_000_134: I'll do my part, then you do yours. Oblivion needs you.
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_SHALE_000_001: It's time I went back to locating Calyx's lair.
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_SHALE_000_002: I have a new strategy in mind, but it remains to be seen if it will aid in narrowing down the possibilities.
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_SHALE_000_003: I'll ask Krile for help. I want to reexamine the data, starting with that of her parents.
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_SHALE_000_004: After all, they were the first to break away from Preservation and establish an organized resistance with Oblivion. There must be something in there that can point us in the right direction.
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: (-Sphene-), is that you? Apologies for calling suddenly.
(-Sphene-)I've been making the rounds in the outskirts, and I cannot help but feel as though something is amiss.
(-Sphene-)Might I ask you to join me? Your perspective would be most appreciated. It can wait until you've finished attending to Shale, of course.
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_SHALE_000_009: It seems your plans have been decided for you. Go on─I've others to speak with before I return to the Backroom.
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_SHALE_000_010: As long as the memories remain, this wound in my heart will never fully heal. But it might be better that way.
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_SHALE_000_015: To feel something─even pain─is to remember that they lived. And to know that I am still alive.
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: As I mentioned, I would benefit from your worldly experience.
Perhaps it is my imagination, but the townspeople appear to be acting oddly. That is, even considering the current state of affairs.
As I am yet unfamiliar with the outskirts, I thought you might be better equipped to judge if their behavior is unusual or not.
Would you speak with them and see what you think? Though I hope to be proven wrong, I fear something is not right here...
It's nothing so obvious as loud wailing or acts of violence, but... Well, it would be best if you saw for yourself.
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_PEPOANE_000_026: I'll be fine now, just fine...
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_FRIGHTNED05367_000_: I can't... I can't go on like this...
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_BLACKREGULATOR05367: Wh-What do you want...? You can't have my regulator!
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_PEPOANE_000_030: Greetings! I remember when you visited with Queen Sphene... Come to check on our well-being, have you?
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_PEPOANE_000_031: Well, I can say that things are rather stressful out here as well.
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_PEPOANE_000_032: Without knowing if or when our machinery might turn murderous, the specter of death is ever present. People are terrified, and the clamor for neo regulators has reached a fever pitch.
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_PEPOANE_000_033: I, personally, was fortunate to have claimed a new device early on, and have long since completed the registration. Death has no hold over me now.
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_PEPOANE_000_034: Now, I must begin my prayers. The darkness draws closer, grows deeper...and we must cast it out...
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_FRIGHTNED05367_000_: Oh, please tell me you brought more neo regulators! Officially, they've all been handed out already, but I've heard rumors there were a few left over...
Surely the government still has some? Or perhaps Queen Sphene!?
I may not look it, but I was a hunter once. Back then, I hardly gave death a second thought. But now that I know the truth, it's all I can think about!
There has to be a way to hold on. There has to...
I can't go on like this...
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_BLACKREGULATOR05367: You... You're not wearing a regulator!? Don't you know the end is coming!?
Well, it's your life to lose. Me? I got myself one of those neo regulators and registered a little while ago.
As soon as I did, a display appeared showing the number of registered users. Right now it's sitting at four thousand one hundred and sixty-eight.
The upper limit was five thousand, wasn't it? Seems the total shot up right after those machine malfunctions. It's only a matter of time before everyone's registered.
I pity those who weren't chosen, but I'm going to be an Endless. I'm going to evolve, and live happily ever after...
I hope you come to your senses and get your hands on a neo regulator, friend!
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: So, what do you think? Was I right to worry?
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_ORIGINALSPHENE_100_: The people are overwhelmed by uncertainty and fear. And with each new registration, that fear inside them grows more insistent...
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: How long until it drives them into full-blown panic?
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_ALISAIE_000_065: (-Alisaie-)We have a problem... I'm already here with Lamaty'i and Alphinaud.
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: It sounds like she wants us there in a hurry. We should go!
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_WUKLAMAT_000_070: I'm sorry I couldn't be there in time. Krile told me everything that happened while we were away...
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_ALPHINAUD_000_075: First those deadly malfunctions, and now a city-wide announcement. He has spent considerable effort recruiting his five thousand Endless. Perhaps more than necessary, even...
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_ALISAIE_000_080: We had the hopefuls who descended on Lamaty'i disperse for now. We could see tempers in the crowd were starting to fray...
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_ALISAIE_000_085: This latest wave of attacks may not have been as widespread, but people are reaching their breaking point. We have to stop Calyx, and soon.
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_GOSSAN_000_090: My apologies. The sign is not responding to any of our attempts to change the display or switch it off...
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Calyx has access to the core system... Which means that if he chose to do so, he could deploy the soldiers beyond the barrier.
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_ORIGINALSPHENE_100_: Even if our people learn to live with death and decide to leave the dome behind, they will not be beyond his reach.
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_ORIGINALSPHENE_110_: Yet if it serves to allay their fears even a little, I beg you, Wuk Lamat: please let them shelter in Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_WUKLAMAT_000_101: We will welcome any and all who want to come. We've already begun evacuations, and we'll be able to pick up the pace once the Landsguard arrives.
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_ALPHINAUD_000_103: In which case, we had best spread out and keep an eye on the crowds. The mood is tense, and we must prepare for possible violence.
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_ALISAIE_000_104: If you happen to determine where Calyx is hiding, though, we'll be ready to move at a moment's notice.
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_ALISAIE_100_104: Surely we'll find a clue of some kind soon. He can't elude us forever.
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_WUKLAMAT_000_105: Violence and fear... This is not the future she envisioned for her nation.
TEXT_KINGMI105_05368_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: You give so much of yourselves to aid those in need. I must endeavor to find my own small way to help...
TEXT_KINGMI105_05368_WUKLAMAT_000_010: Tuliyollal would gladly welcome every last Alexandrian with open arms...
TEXT_KINGMI105_05368_WUKLAMAT_000_011: But what of the nation the late queen was so desperate to preserve? What of that bright haven of peace and laughter?
TEXT_KINGMI105_05368_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Wuk Lamat...
TEXT_KINGMI105_05368_WUKLAMAT_000_013: I won't stand here and let her legacy be sullied any further. I will protect Alexandria─that was the promise I made her at the last!
TEXT_KINGMI105_05368_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: But she betrayed you, did she not? Why do you feel this obligation?
TEXT_KINGMI105_05368_WUKLAMAT_000_018: I saw myself in her, I suppose. We both felt the people's joy as our own, yet alone, we lacked the strength to protect them.
TEXT_KINGMI105_05368_WUKLAMAT_100_018: There is so much that I love in this world─too much for me to take in my arms and keep safe. And that made me afraid. I wanted─I needed someone who shared that love and fear, so together we could do what we couldn't by ourselves.
TEXT_KINGMI105_05368_WUKLAMAT_000_019: Or maybe it's simpler than that...
TEXT_KINGMI105_05368_WUKLAMAT_000_020: Maybe I just wished that we could have been friends.
TEXT_KINGMI105_05368_WUKLAMAT_100_020: So when she turned to me in her final hour, desperate to safeguard Alexandria's future, I swore that I would see it done.
TEXT_KINGMI105_05368_ORIGINALSPHENE_110_: In the end, I think you both found the friend you needed.
TEXT_KINGMI105_05368_WUKLAMAT_120_020: I would be yours as well, Sphene.
TEXT_KINGMI105_05368_WUKLAMAT_130_020: Whenever you fall or struggle to rise, I'll come running to the rescue. And you do the same for me.
TEXT_KINGMI105_05368_WUKLAMAT_140_020: That's how we'll protect the things we love. That's how we'll protect Alexandria!
TEXT_KINGMI105_05368_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: How could we!? We'd not be where we are now without you!

TEXT_KINGMI105_05368_SHALE_000_027: We discovered laboratories on Everkeep's tenth level that once housed a Preservation initiative.
TEXT_KINGMI105_05368_SHALE_000_028: Containment Complex 10-29, it's called, and it's been falsely registered as a distribution center. In reality, it hasn't recorded any traffic in decades...

TEXT_KINGMI106_05369_WUKLAMAT_000_470: It's time to put an end to this. Calyx won't stop until we stop him.

TEXT_KINGMI106_05369_SHALE_000_480: Damn that bastard Calyx! He waited until I was this close before snatching away my moment of triumph!
TEXT_KINGMI106_05369_SHALE_000_481: And that infuriating, condescending way he spoke to us... We'll see whose time is up, you smug little weasel.
TEXT_KINGMI106_05369_SHALE_100_481: Anyway. I know things didn't go to plan, but we learned a great deal about Preservation. That knowledge could come in handy in the days to come.
TEXT_KINGMI106_05369_SHALE_000_482: Though I may not be able to contribute much to a direct confrontation, I mean to see this through with you all, providing whatever support I can.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_GULOOLJA_000_001: Shale has been out of sorts ever since we got back. I don't think she liked what Calyx said... But don't worry, I'll do my best to cheer her up!
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_KRILE_000_005: I've passed on the short version of events to our comrades so that we can all prepare for the challenge ahead.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_WUKLAMAT_000_010: It's time to put an end to this. Calyx won't stop until we stop him.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_ERENVILLE_000_015: The situation isn't the best out there... But at least you've come back to us safe and sound.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_SHALE_000_020: It's a shame that punching an Endless does no damage. I'd love to rearrange that serene face of his...
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: ... We've briefed Erenville on everything that has happened and sent word to the others.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_ORIGINALSPHENE_100_: We've now but to consider what our next actions will be.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Calyx has offered you the opportunity to confront him directly...
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_ORIGINALSPHENE_100_: And though it feels much like striding face-first into an ambush, we have little choice. If we are to destroy the memories he supposedly has stored in the upper reaches of the Meso Terminal, then that is where we must go.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_SHALE_110_031: While I'm still upset at being deprived of my moment, I nevertheless did my due diligence...
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_SHALE_120_031: I can confirm that the relay we found was indeed transmitting surveillance data to a device somewhere in Living Memory.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: When you go to fight Calyx, pray let me fight alongside you.
Let me fight for the memory of Otis and Zelenia, and for the other Sphene I may have become. But most importantly, for my beloved kingdom and a joyful tomorrow!
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_A1_000_001: It has always been your fight as much as ours, if not more.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_A1_000_002: Of course, but no reckless heroics!
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_A1_000_003: If things take a grim turn, I'll keep you safe.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Thank you for understanding what this means to me.
Yes, I understand. I promise not to subject myself or the party to needless danger.
I shall hold you to that. But I will also protect you in turn...because that is what comrades do.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_WUKLAMAT_000_038: I'll be coming with you, as well. You know my reasons.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_KRILE_000_039: It hardly needs saying, but your fellow Scions also have every intention of accompanying you into battle.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_KRILE_000_040: So adamant were Alisaie and the others on this point that they have already left for Living Memory. I am more than ready to do the same.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_ERENVILLE_000_041: I'll keep patrolling the streets for signs of trouble─especially from anyone wearing neo regulators.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_SHALE_000_042: Should you need anything from me, I'll be on standby here in the Backroom.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_GULOOLJA_000_043: I really want to go with you too, but I know I can't. I know that sometimes you have to be patient and trust in your friends.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_WUKLAMAT_000_044: Oh, . Krile and I think that we should talk to Gossan before we leave for Living Memory.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_WUKLAMAT_000_045: Under Calyx's direction, Preservation has helped shape Alexandria's society for centuries. Taking him down will have serious consequences, and we need to warn the officials in charge about what we intend.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Justifications aside, we shall be acting against the wishes of all who desire to become Endless...
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_WUKLAMAT_000_047: Exactly. We don't know if Gossan will approve or oppose our chosen course, but either way, leaving without a word is the wrong thing to do.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Come, we should be on our way. Resolution first, yes?
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_GULOOLJA_000_049: Be safe, everyone! We'll see you when it's over!
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_SHALE_000_050: As I said, I'll be ready and waiting if and when you have need of me. Just make sure you come back in one piece.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_GULOOLJA_000_055: I'll do whatever I can to help Shale and Erenville. It may not be much, but small things add up when you do enough of them!
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Government officials must be fielding demands from all quarters. I do not envy Gossan his position.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_WUKLAMAT_000_065: I see Gossan's wearing a neo regulator. He'll have some thoughts to share on the subject, I'll wager...
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_KRILE_000_070: The air is thick with a sense of unease─not least around Gossan himself.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_ERENVILLE_000_075: Even people from my village have taken to wearing neo regulators. I can only hope it doesn't end badly...
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_GOSSAN_000_080: It is a relief to be freed from my indecision. Until I had removed my regulator, I hadn't realized quite how heavy it weighed upon me.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_WUKLAMAT_000_085: Sphene must be overjoyed to be so welcomed by her countrymen. For their sakes, we need to bring her back safely.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_KRILE_000_090: I'm glad we were able to hear the will of the Alexandrian people. Now it falls to us to see the rest of it through!
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_STRIKA_000_095: Hello, remember me? The hunter from the Thunderyards? It's been a while, but we met when you first arrived in the dome.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_STRIKA_000_096: We've been talking with Lithander and the others and, thanks to some very convincing arguments, we've come around to the idea that we need to start taking responsibility for the future of our nation.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_STRIKA_000_097: There are those like us who rely on regulators for their work, and others who aren't quite ready to give up what they have...but we all share a desire to make things better.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Everyone was so warm and welcoming. Alexandrians are, as ever, a stalwart people.
How glad I am to be home...
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_WUKLAMAT_000_102: Thank you, Gossan. That decision must have been difficult to make.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_GOSSAN_000_103: If only I could claim the courage to do so came from within. The final push came from Alexandria's citizens, and their bravery in taking the first step towards change.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_WUKLAMAT_000_104: Speaking of which, can I ask you to lock that neo regulator away where no one can get to it? That should prevent the registrations from reaching the target number.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_GOSSAN_000_105: I should be glad to do so, but I fear it would be to no avail. According to our most recent surveys, the number of neo regulators in circulation exceeds the stated five thousand.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_GOSSAN_000_106: I surmise the surplus units are to account for those like myself who have had a change of heart, or are otherwise hesitant to register.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_WUKLAMAT_000_107: Ah... That does sound like something Calyx would do. Well, we'll have to face him either way, so no point in delaying the inevitable. On to Living Memory!
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_ALPHINAUD_000_110: 'Tis good to rejoin you all. I needed to step away briefly that I might make arrangements for a certain precautionary measure...
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_ALISAIE_000_115: Last time I had to wait in the cenote, but there's nothing to stop me from joining this fight!
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_GRAHATIA_000_120: We've all been so busy, it seems an age since last we gathered in such a manner. I must say, we do make for a formidable group!
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_KRILE_000_125: Coming here reminds me of my parents. Of the courage they gave me...
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_WUKLAMAT_000_130: Seems Alphinaud and Alisaie were the ones to explain to Koana our need to enter the cenote. He urged us to be extremely careful, of course!
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: I had scarcely awakened here when I fell unconscious. Now that I can fully enjoy the gentle silence of this place, it brings tears to my eyes.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_YSHTOLA_000_140: Ah, 'tis good to see our comrades hale and girded for battle.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_YSHTOLA_000_141: As for us, we've been ahead to inspect the lay of the land. There were no changes of note...aside from with the Meso Terminal itself.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_WUKLAMAT_000_142: Why, what's happened to the Meso Terminal?
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_YSHTOLA_000_143: The wall has receded to provide a convenient entrance into the structure's interior. There was no such ingress when last we were here, so we must assume that Calyx has since manipulated the terminal's electrope.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_YSHTOLA_000_144: All to facilitate his most gracious invitation to the upper levels.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: An invitation I am eager to accept... For the sake of all who love Alexandria, I will not yield nor leave them to despair.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALPHINAUD_000_001: 'Tis good to rejoin you all. I needed to step away briefly that I might make arrangements for a certain precautionary measure...
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALISAIE_000_005: Last time I had to wait in the cenote, but there's nothing to stop me from joining this fight!
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_GRAHATIA_000_010: We've all been so busy, it seems an age since last we gathered in such a manner. I must say, we do make for a formidable group!
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_KRILE_000_015: Coming here reminds me of my parents. Of the courage they gave me...
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_WUKLAMAT_000_020: Seems Alphinaud and Alisaie were the ones to explain to Koana our need to enter the cenote. He urged us to be extremely careful, of course!
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: I had scarcely awakened here when I fell unconscious. Now that I can fully enjoy the gentle silence of this place, it brings tears to my eyes.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_YSHTOLA_000_030: I believe everyone determined to be here is present and accounted for. Shall we make our way to the terminal?
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_YSHTOLA_000_031: We wouldn't wish to keep our insistent host waiting.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALPHINAUD_000_035: An Endless existence for the evolution of mankind... I understand what he strives for, but not what drives him to do so with such ruthlessness.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALISAIE_000_040: So this is where the former queen's memories were stored.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALISAIE_000_041: And she herself tried to erase them... Even as an Endless, her resolve was so strong that she would kill her heart to become the cold machine she believed she needed to be.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_GRAHATIA_000_045: When we shut down all the minor terminals, we watched as the Endless faded away. I do not believe that was a performance staged to deceive us.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_GRAHATIA_000_046: As for the Meso Terminal, however... It had already grown dark by the time we had returned from the virtual domain.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_GRAHATIA_000_047: While I am loath to admit it, 'tis possible its true appearance was hidden from us in our absence. Which is why we must bring this tale to its denouement by our own hand.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_KRILE_000_050: It hadn't occurred to me that one might physically enter the terminal. Although I suppose it makes sense when you think about it. A structure for creating Endless would have required maintenance administered by corporeal hands.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: I remember little of my awakening. The paralysis yet lingered, and my eyes could barely focus...
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_YSHTOLA_000_060: Living Memory is steeped in the dense lightning aether of the Ninth. This pervasive energy must be what the terminal utilizes as a power source.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_WUKLAMAT_000_070: Well, here we are again, facing another battle to decide Alexandria's fate.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: For four centuries I slept here. Upon awakening, I found the world as I knew it had changed.
I was so frightened at first. I couldn't recognize a single thing, and thought everything I loved had gone to dust.
Yet beneath the unfamiliar surface, much remained the same.
For that, I give thanks to Otis and Zelenia and their royal knights, who lay their lives on the line to defend our way of life.
I thank every Alexandrian, who believed in our future and passed on our legacy.
I thank my other self, who so loved this kingdom of ours.
And I thank you all, for kindling this hope in my heart. This courage to take up arms and fight once more.
So let us make our stand together, and fight for what we hold dear.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_SPHENE_100_078: (-Endless Sphene-)The kind and gentle Queen Sphene was too weak to serve her people. And so she will serve them no more.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_SPHENE_110_078: (-Endless Sphene-)Freed from conscience, I shall become a ruler that can protect Alexandria. A devourer of worlds.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_A1_000_001: Together we stand. Together we fight.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_A1_000_002: We will rise to the challenge that the Endless Sphene could not.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: You have my gratitude. And surely Otis and Zelenia will join us in spirit.
That we shall. Her wish to see Alexandria endure is one I am happy to fulfill.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_WUKLAMAT_000_082: Let's head inside and finish this.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_KRILE_000_083: In the upper reaches of this terminal awaits the device which holds Calyx's memories. It falls to us to make the climb and destroy it once and for all.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_GRAHATIA_000_084: Aye, we must bring matters to a definitive end. We'll not suffer him to cause Alexandria further harm nor claim the key.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_YSHTOLA_000_085: The queen entrusted it to  for good reason. And besides, 'twould be a tragedy indeed to relinquish a relic with so much research potential.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALISAIE_000_086: Apparently, Calyx thinks he's taken your measure. I urge you to correct that misguided assumption!
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALPHINAUD_000_087: I wholeheartedly concur, yet would still counsel caution. That he would be so bold as to extend us an invitation bespeaks tremendous confidence in his preparations.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Come, friends. We set forth, into the midst of dreaming Endless.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_A2_000_002: Form a party and enter the Meso Terminal.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALPHINAUD_000_095: We have no idea what Calyx may have planned for us. Alisaie and I have prepared for every eventuality, yet still...
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALPHINAUD_000_096: ...Nay, you must be free to lead our charge unhindered by doubt. As you press onwards, we shall guard the flanks.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALISAIE_000_100: I really do think you take on too much from too many people. And yet...it's never the wrong choice.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALISAIE_000_101: The queen gave you the key for a reason, so I'll be damned if I let Calyx steal it!
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_GRAHATIA_000_105: 'Tis beyond knowing how Calyx has advanced his plans for Endless conversion for the past four hundred years.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_GRAHATIA_000_106: I do know, however, that pursuing an objective for lengthy spans requires an unyielding will─especially when that objective entails changing the world as we know it.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_GRAHATIA_000_107: Calyx is a foe possessed of both considerable focus and resolve. We would do well to recognize him as such.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_KRILE_000_110: If my parents were indeed executed by Preservation, for me this will not only be a fight for the greater good. This will be justice.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_KRILE_000_111: If I'm to add an addendum to Grandfather's account of the golden city, then let it be a rousing good one, eh?
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_WUKLAMAT_000_115: As the Vow of Resolve, or even as just a comrade, I see myself making a lot of promises.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_WUKLAMAT_000_116: I mean to honor every last one of them...starting with the oath I swore to the Endless Sphene. Even if it's just a memory, I want to think of her smiling at that promise kept.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_YSHTOLA_000_120: Calyx's scheme to forfeit flesh to gain immortality calls to mind the Ea. Not that informing him of their fate would do much to dissuade him.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_YSHTOLA_000_121: “Convinced though you may be of this truth, it is yours and not mine. And no conclusion of yours, no matter how grim, can dampen my desire”...
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_YSHTOLA_000_122: Such was my reply to the Ea's warnings. So I know a little something of refusing to listen save when confronted with incontrovertible proof of my error.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: The Alexandria of today has seen countless lives come and go. My other self took their grief and fear and rage upon herself in service to our kingdom.
Around me are gathered those willing to give their all to fulfill the promise they made to her. How can I do any less?
Alexandrians must be free to believe that more than sadness awaits them... That tomorrow can be better than today.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_SYSTEM_000_130: During this quest and when using the Duty Support system, you have the opportunity to undertake this trial with a party of NPC companions. Some of these allies' roles will differ from those you are normally able to select.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_A3_000_002: Form a party and enter the Ageless Necropolis.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALPHINAUD_000_145: As I feared, I was right to bring spare warding scales. Against the threat of a primal, we must take advantage of every warrior we can field.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALISAIE_000_150: The summoning ritual alone made my blood run cold. Like I was halfway to becoming a corpse...
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_GRAHATIA_000_155: An abundance of lightning would indeed obviate the need for crystals. I should like to know whence Calyx came by this summoning knowledge.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_KRILE_000_160: It all finally makes sense. Those mechanical rampages were not orchestrated solely for the purpose of harvesting aether.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_KRILE_000_161: They were intended to heighten the collective fear of death, that the primal manifested by the people's terror would be that much more powerful...
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_WUKLAMAT_000_165: I don't care if that thing is a waking nightmare! Let's send it back into the darkness, !
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_YSHTOLA_000_170: So, 'tis a primal which embodies the concept of death in all its terror. He has made manifest a most troublesome foe.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: What is he saying? That the fears of everyone in Alexandria gave birth to this...this horror?
It's finally over...
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_YSHTOLA_000_177: Let us bask in the victory a moment, shall we? We can take stock once we've had a chance to recuperate.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_KRILE_000_178: I believe Calyx was working to transfer his memories at the end there, but he vanished at the exact moment the device exploded. We must have stopped him just in time...
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALISAIE_000_179: After dealing that last blow, I hadn't a drop of aether left to spend! Thank you for seeing it through to the end.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_GRAHATIA_100_179: Phew... 'Tis good to be out of that terminal. But what of you? No injuries or lingering ill effects?
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALPHINAUD_000_180: She has yet to regain consciousness, but worry not─Lamaty'i will be fine.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALPHINAUD_100_180: I've been in touch with Vow Koana, and he has made arrangements to convey her home. By which he means to come and fetch Lamaty'i himself, apparently. Given the extent of her injuries and exertions, she'll likely spend many days abed.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Oh, Wuk Lamat...
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALISAIE_000_182: You just can't help yourself, can you? Like a certain someone. That said...we couldn't have done it without you.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_KRILE_000_183: And once she had the barrier down, you saw to it that Calyx's stored memories were destroyed along with the memory bank.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_KRILE_000_184: Which means Preservation is no more, I pray.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: No longer will Calyx dictate the course of our people...
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ORIGINALSPHENE_100_: No longer will our grief be locked away or forgotten...
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: The freedom to feel joy and sadness─to feel all that we are meant to experience─is in the hands of Alexandrians once more.
I can never thank you enough!
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_YSHTOLA_000_188: When we are rested and ready, we shall have to conduct a thorough investigation into how Calyx came to know that summoning ritual.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_GRAHATIA_000_189: Aye, for where there are primals, the Ascians are ne'er far.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALPHINAUD_000_190: And we must consider that those who offered up prayers during the summoning may very well have fallen under the entity's sway...
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALPHINAUD_100_190: I shall wait here with our patient until Vow Koana arrives. Feel free to go on ahead and attend to Alexandria's needs in the meantime.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALISAIE_000_191: Yes, we should get going. I'll contact Shale en route and ask for an update on the situation in the city.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Shall we make for the outskirts first, then? We can check on things there before heading into Everkeep.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALPHINAUD_000_195: I expect I shan't be waiting long. After hearing of Lamaty'i's injuries, Koana sounded fit to launch himself here by siege engine.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALISAIE_000_200: I was able to speak with Shale and Erenville. I'll share the news with everyone in just a moment.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_GRAHATIA_000_205: I've given Sphene an abridged explanation of primals and their enthralling influence. Too much detail would overwhelm her.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_KRILE_000_210: Thank goodness... Things are much calmer than I anticipated.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_YSHTOLA_000_215: No signs of recent violence. The soldiers have been behaving, at least.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: ... Everyone has been teaching me what it means to be enthralled by a primal...
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ORIGINALSPHENE_100_: The outskirts seem untouched by trouble, as far as I can tell, but... What if something awful has happened!?
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALISAIE_110_220: Deep breaths, Sphene. Erenville and Shale have brought me up to speed.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALISAIE_120_220: First off... Just as we'd feared, those who adopted the neo regulators appear to have been enthralled.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALISAIE_130_220: So far, however, they've not shown any hostility towards others. I suspect this was due to the calming effect of your broadcast.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALISAIE_140_220: Government administrators are presently working with the rest of the citizenry to bring the afflicted into the care of the authorities, and I'm happy to report that this seems to be proceeding in a largely peaceful manner.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ALISAIE_150_220: ...Which is all well and good, but the city officials are understandably requesting an explanation of events. Raha, Krile, would you be able to handle that?
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_GRAHATIA_000_222: Certainly! We shall return to aid with the treatment efforts forthwith.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_KRILE_100_222: Meanwhile, might I suggest you look in on the people you fought so very hard to save? It may ease your mind to see the fruits of your efforts firsthand!
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Thank you again... How very fortunate we are to have you as our allies.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_SYSTEM_000_250: You may now enter the Meso Terminal with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_ALISAIE_000_001: Once I've had a look around, I'll go and assist with the treatment of the enthralled. We'll have to mobilize Angelo and all his siblings!
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_YSHTOLA_000_005: If every person who was equipped with a neo regulator was affected, then we have no less than five thousand patients. Even with an army of trained mages, rehabilitation may take many moons...
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_YSHTOLA_000_006: And yet this is a best-case scenario. The fact that we even have the capability to exorcise a primal's influence would have been unthinkable not so long ago.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_KRILE_000_007: Let Raha and I brief the officials on what to expect. I think Sphene might like to have you nearby for a little while longer.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_GRAHATIA_000_007: It has never been easy for me to explain primal summoning to the layman in a clear, concise manner... But 'tis a skill I must hone if I'm to uphold the Students of Baldesion's good name.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Mayhap I will take you up on your suggestion. Only...I am concerned that, given who I am, approaching those unaware of my return may only serve to confuse them further...
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_KRILE_100_010: Then why not speak with Mahuwsa? She works the fields at Yyupye's Halo not far from here.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_KRILE_110_010: As one of those who came to see you off before our clash with Calyx, she will surely be glad to know you are safe and sound.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: What an excellent idea! I think I shall do just that. Thank you, Krile!
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_ALISAIE_000_015: Erenville and Shale were both relieved to learn of our victory. I could practically hear the tension drain out of their voices, especially Shale's─she was quite worried for us.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_YSHTOLA_000_020: Sphene's identity will not remain a secret much longer. Her message touched the hearts of people throughout the kingdom.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Ah, so this is the place where Mahuwsa works.
Back in Resolution, she seemed most interested to learn about me, yet I would be glad to learn much more of them, as well.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_MAHUWSA_000_030: Look who it is! Good to see you again, hale and healthy!
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: I am sorry we did not get word to you sooner. How is everyone?
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_MAHUWSA_000_032: Well, nothing terrible befell us, as such. The neo regulator crowd did all start acting strange at the same time, though.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_MAHUWSA_000_033: Pepoane was one of them... I'm told the authorities are tending to him at a medical facility.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_ALISAIE_000_034: You needn't worry. With the proper treatment, we'll soon have everyone back to their normal selves.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_MAHUWSA_000_035: I sure am glad to hear that. I'd like to not lose any more friends, if it can be helped.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_MAHUWSA_000_036: I also hear that the “Queen Sphene” who tried enticing us to become Endless turned out to be an impostor. What kind of heartless villain preys on people's insecurities like that?
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_MAHUWSA_000_037: Yet despite the danger to yourselves, you and yours made sure to put a stop to it, if I understand things correctly?
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_MAHUWSA_000_038: Then we owe you a debt of gratitude. It's up to each of us now to make the most of what you've given us!
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_MAHUWSA_000_039: We're alive because of you. And while we live and breathe, our future is ours to decide.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_MAHUWSA_000_040: Your broadcast was a message of hope. For me. For everyone.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_MAHUWSA_000_042: Now I really should be going. We still have to keep things running without Pepoane and the others, and the outskirts need all the spare hands they can get.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: I... Is there anything I might do to help heal the enthralled!?
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_ALISAIE_100_043: Quite a lot, in fact. I could very much use a mage of your ability.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_YSHTOLA_000_044: Actually, this would be a good opportunity to round up other arcane practitioners, and teach everyone how to use the porxies. The knowledge will come in handy for treating levin sickness, as well.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_ORIGINALSPHENE_100_: Wonderful! I shall petition Gossan to spread the word!
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_YSHTOLA_100_044: Our outskirts tour is canceled, 'twould seem.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_ALISAIE_000_045: By the way, ─Alphinaud told me that Koana arrived to escort Lamaty'i back to Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_ALISAIE_100_045: Alphinaud himself will be returning to Alexandria momentarily, so between the two of us, I think we can sort out the treatment arrangements. Given all that, I had a mind to ask you a different favor.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_ALISAIE_000_046: Would you mind looking in on Gulool Ja? According to Shale, he's been running around the kingdom, determined to personally solve every problem.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_ALISAIE_000_047: Last she heard, he was pitching in over at the driftdowns with Erenville.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_ALISAIE_000_048: If you ask...Taapu, I believe her name was? She should be able to point you in their general direction.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_TAAPU_000_051: And happy I am to hear it─we all prayed fervently for your safe return.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_TAAPU_000_052: Looking for Gulool Ja, are you? He was here, asking if we needed help with anything, or if we had noticed anyone who had been acting strangely.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_TAAPU_000_053: He sounded exhausted, so I told him we were fine for the moment and insisted he take a rest. I can only hope he will heed my advice.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_TAAPU_000_054: I believe he ran off towards the ruins of old Alexandria. He always did seem to like it there.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_TAAPU_000_055: Gulool Ja is a precocious child, but a child, nonetheless. He needs our guidance and support...
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_ERENVILLE_000_060: , how─!? ...Ah, came in search of us, did you?
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_ERENVILLE_000_061: You needn't have trekked all the way out here, but it is good to see you. Alisaie gave us the broad strokes, and Koana had some choice words as well.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_ERENVILLE_000_070: Yet to lift a blade and he wants to spar already. He is Gulool Ja Ja's grandson, alright.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_GULOOLJA_000_080: Thank you both for listening. I'll take it one step at a time, and stick with what I know for now.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_GULOOLJA_000_081: Like...cooking the meals that Otis taught me, and keeping everyone's bellies full! How does that sound?
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_ERENVILLE_100_081: Sounds like a fine idea. Everyone's been working hard, so I'm sure a good meal would be much appreciated.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_ERENVILLE_110_081: Well, I think we've passed a malmstone here.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_ERENVILLE_120_081: What about the Backroom? If you haven't already, I'd expect Shale and the others would appreciate you stopping by to say hello.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_ERENVILLE_000_085: I have no plans to move on just yet. One of the afflicted is an old friend, and I want to stay close while the treatments are ongoing.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_GULOOLJA_000_090: Otis's sword has seen better days... I'll ask Genolt to fix it when I'm big enough to wield it.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_GULOOLJA_100_090: As for my father's weapons, they were found in the Skydeep Cenote. I wonder if he ever intended for me to have them...
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_KRILE_000_095: Oh, we had the same idea, I see! I thought it might be nice to catch up with our Oblivion friends before we delve into more serious matters with the city officials.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_SHALE_000_101: Oh, thank the stars you're safe. I heard the reports, of course, but there's no substitute for actually seeing it.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_SHALE_000_102: Welcome back... We have so much to thank you for.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_KRILE_000_001: Oh, we had the same idea, I see! I thought it might be nice to catch up with our Oblivion friends before we delve into more serious matters with the city officials.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_SHALE_000_010: Now that everyone's back, I say we pause a moment to savor what we've accomplished.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_KRILE_000_011: We've been through much in these past days, haven't we?
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_SHALE_000_012: That's an understatement. We've seen the end of a years-long struggle, for Oblivion and for myself.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_SHALE_000_013: Cahciua and Geode would be happy for us...
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_SHALE_000_014: Oddly enough, fulfilling our purpose has somehow left me with even more work to do. The government has tasked me with conducting a more complete survey of the containment complex.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_KRILE_000_015: Ah, the Preservation facility. That lab where they studied the key certainly demands further investigation.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_KRILE_000_016: I can understand how those experiments may have led to the discovery of reflections, yet they fail to explain Calyx's knowledge of primal summoning.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_KRILE_000_017: I fear that he and his hunger for interdimensional travel were only one facet of a greater puzzle. There is still someone or something out there that may pose a threat to us...
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_KRILE_000_021: In any case, I think it prudent we secure ourselves a spot in Shale's next expedition to the tenth level.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_KRILE_000_022: Right, I have a meeting with city officials to attend. 'Twould be cruel to leave Raha to answer their barrage of questions alone!
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_SHALE_000_023: I should return to my work as well. My first job will be to analyze the data we pulled from Containment Complex 10-29, and locate other facilities of interest.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_SHALE_100_023: I can only hope the information we uncover will serve Alexandria and the future we want to build.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_SHALE_000_024: Whatever we end up finding, however, it's like to take some weeks to put the city back to rights. All these ambitious plans aside, I think you've earned a rest, don't you?
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_SHALE_000_025: Our break room is yours to bunk in for as long as you like. Say the word, and I'll help you settle in.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_SHALE_000_031: Ready for a cot and a fluffy pillow?
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_SYSTEM_000_032: It will likely be some time before the city returns to normal. You may choose to remain in the Backroom and watch over the proceedings...
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_SYSTEM_000_040: While away the days in the Backroom?
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_WUKLAMAT_000_045: So Sphene is to sit the throne once more... She may have questioned her claim, but Alexandria's citizens have made their feelings known.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_KRILE_000_050: A new Alexandrian queen has risen. 'Tis an occasion worthy of grand celebration.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_GRAHATIA_000_055: This great nation is set to become an ever greater one. How fortunate we are to be here and witness this turning point in its history.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_ERENVILLE_000_060: Gulool Ja was also of the opinion that Sphene should become the Queen of Reason. He will be delighted to hear that she has accepted the role.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_GOSSAN_000_065: We shall walk this difficult road together, as Vow Wuk Lamat has assured us.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Thank you for your kind encouragement, .
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_ORIGINALSPHENE_100_: Wuk Lamat is right. Ours will not be an easy road.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_ORIGINALSPHENE_110_: But with your words to lend me strength, I shall take it one step at a time.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_WUKLAMAT_000_071: And Tuliyollal will be there to support you. Speaking of which, I should be getting back to the palace.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_WUKLAMAT_100_071: I'll make my next visit an official one─no sneaking out under Koana's nose like this time. The Vows of Resolve and Reason will both come, and we can discuss our futures together!
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Shall we begin the journey home, then? I expect some confusion among the citizens with restored memories, and I would be present to offer them aid!
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_ERENVILLE_000_078: Well, I believe this marks the end to my role as guide. I was intending to accompany Wuk Lamat back to Tuliyollal...
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_ERENVILLE_100_078: But what are your plans, ? Didn't you have other matters yet to attend to in Alexandria?
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_WUKLAMAT_000_079: No, no, you need to stop by the palace first!
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_WUKLAMAT_100_079: Koana's been wanting to thank you properly, but with everything going on, he hasn't had the chance. Please come back with us, or I'll never hear the end of it!
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_ERENVILLE_000_080: How long has it been since I last walked these streets...? Maybe I spent too long in Solution Nine, but the city seems livelier than it ever was.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_GULOOLJA_000_085: !? No one told me you were coming!
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_KOANA_000_090: ...The memory restoration went well, I am told.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_WUKLAMAT_000_100: It's good to be home. Thanks for coming along!
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_GULOOLJA_000_101: I just got here too. The Landsguard said my training would begin right away, so I'll be staying in Tuliyollal a while.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_WUKLAMAT_000_102: We believe in you, Gulool Ja! And whenever you need advice, your aunt is always happy to give it!
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_ERENVILLE_000_103: ...Oh dear, our Vow of Reason is out of sorts.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_KOANA_000_104: Can you blame me? Lamaty'i─you were supposed to be convalescing in bed.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_KOANA_000_105: So... You would study the way of the blade, Gulool Ja?
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_KOANA_000_107: I will permit your training on one condition: you only practice swordplay in the presence of a grown-up.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_WUKLAMAT_000_109: It won't be long before you're good enough to train without a minder. You take too much after your sire and grandsire for that...
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_GULOOLJA_100_109: Wait─so if you're back here, does that mean everyone already got their memories back?
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_WUKLAMAT_000_110: ...So, that was that. My days of meddling in Alexandrian affairs are over.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_GULOOLJA_000_112: It all turned out for the best. The former queen really did love her people, and it's wonderful that her love lives on in Sphene.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_WUKLAMAT_000_113: It truly is. With that love as the foundation of her rule, the new queen will be a font of hope for Alexandria.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_WUKLAMAT_000_114: There's no better way for a life and legacy to forever endure...
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_WUKLAMAT_000_115: You'll be heading back there, won't you? To Alexandria?
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_WUKLAMAT_000_116: I won't pretend that I fully understand the workings of the key or the reflections. And I know I couldn't have stopped Calyx without you...
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_WUKLAMAT_000_117: ...Nor fulfilled my promise to the Endless Sphene. Thank you, , from the bottom of my heart.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_WUKLAMAT_000_118: Be sure to come and visit us again in Tuliyollal. You'll always be welcome here!
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_ERENVILLE_000_119: It's time I moved on myself. Once I've made the necessary preparations and arrangements, I will embark on an extended journey.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_KOANA_000_120: Well, I expect my days will be filled with administrative duties, much as they already are. I am hoping to compile a comprehensive history of Tuliyollal, however.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_KOANA_000_121: The tale of our beautiful and resilient nation should be preserved for the future, with each successive generation adding their own chapter to the saga.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_GULOOLJA_000_122: I...I think I've learned to be happy with who I am, .
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_GULOOLJA_000_123: Even when I make mistakes and cry and look silly.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_GULOOLJA_000_124: And it's all because of the amazing things I've seen with you. They remind me there's always tomorrow!
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_GULOOLJA_000_125: Becoming the King of Resolve is not something I need to think about until I'm older, but my father's authority did pass to me. So until that day comes, I'll study and train and do the best I can!
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_WUKLAMAT_000_126: You've really come far, Gulool Ja! And you'll keep on doing us proud, I'm sure of it!
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_GULOOLJA_000_127: I guess you have to go now, so be safe and enjoy your travels. We'll miss you!
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_WUKLAMAT_000_128: Send our best to Sphene and the others!
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_WUKLAMAT_000_129: Whatever burdens I must carry, I will. And I'll become stronger for it, just you watch!
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_ERENVILLE_000_130: I won't just vanish over the horizon, I promise. I'll let you know before I leave on my journey.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_GULOOLJA_000_135: I'll visit Shale and everyone as often as I can! There's still so much I want to learn from them.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_KOANA_000_140: I intend to make a formal diplomatic visit to Alexandria in the near future, and express my gratitude to those who have watched over Gulool Ja.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_KRILE_000_145: We've observed no complications with the memory restoration thus far. Thank goodness for small mercies...
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_GRAHATIA_000_150: I hear Gulool Ja has packed his bags and left to train in Tuliyollal. ...Oh, I suppose you would have seen him while you were there?
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_ALPHINAUD_000_155: I'll need to give a full account of what happened here to Thancred and the others. That said, Estinien may prove difficult to track down...
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_ALISAIE_000_160: When did Erenville leave Alexandria? Don't tell me he's embarked on some far-flung expedition without saying good-bye.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_YSHTOLA_000_165: You've had a busy time of it, Warrior of Light. Take advantage of this lull while you may.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_SHALE_000_170: There are still those who can't decide if they want their memories back.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_SHALE_000_171: I said I would restore mine after things calmed down, but the truth is, I'm not sure I'm even ready. So, we'll make this a gradual process, and give everyone the time they need to prepare. Myself included.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: We were just discussing what is to be done after the coronation ceremony. Our heretofore isolated kingdom must join its peers on the world stage.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_ALPHINAUD_000_182: The fact that Alexandria is─or was─a nation of the Ninth will be the cause of some consternation... It may smooth introductions were the Scions to provide an explanation for its arrival in the Source.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_ALISAIE_000_183: Rest assured, Sphene─Etheirys's leaders are well accustomed to hearing Alphinaud report on fantastical events.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Once again, I am in your debt... I dread to imagine what might have come to pass had you never come to our aid.
Ah, I had other news: those who participated in the memory restoration have expressed the desire to hold a funerary service.
Rather than suppress their grief, they would embrace it, creating in their hearts a place for gentle remembrance.

We have yet to hammer out the details, but I was thinking we might host this service on the highest level of Everkeep. Ever since my time, we have believed that the departed continue their journey beyond the clouds...
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_A2_000_003: You'll invite our friends from Tuliyollal, won't you?
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: I'm glad you agree! Some have yet to receive their requested memories, however, so we shall wait until the initial wave of restorations is complete before proceeding.
Yes... I hope that from such a place, our prayers might be heard─a wish for our loved ones to soar forever joyful and free in that heavenly expanse.
Yes, of course... I know of Zoraal Ja only by name, but they will wish to mourn their kin. I shall be sure to ask them.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_GRAHATIA_000_192: After so long distancing themselves from the realities of death, the Alexandrians are to be commended for their courage.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_KRILE_000_193: Yes, 'tis a tremendously brave thing they're doing.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Perhaps our hearts can never capture a memory as perfectly as data in a file...
But what precious recollections we do keep will guide and sustain us as we fulfill the promise of tomorrow.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_SHALE_000_196: You've busy days ahead of you, Your Majesty. Oblivion stands ready to pitch in as needed.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_YSHTOLA_000_197: Oh, and what of my investigations, Shale? I hope you've left some time in your schedule for me.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Do you recall my first tour of the city after I awoke? It was all so strange and frightening, but I've only grown more at home here ever since.
That I now feel a part of this new Alexandria is in large part thanks to your patient guidance.
And so here I will remain. Should you ever have need of my aid with anything at all, pray do not hesitate to ask.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_KRILE_000_201: Some few of us will stay here a while, as it happens. We've made several interesting breakthroughs, and have no shortage of mysteries into which we would delve.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Then be welcome as honored guests for as long as you like. You are, and always will be, my cherished comrades.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_YSHTOLA_000_001: I am told that Shale is the new leader of Oblivion. There is none better suited to carrying on Cahciua and Geode's legacy.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_KRILE_000_002: Eager as ever, our Alphinaud. I do hope he has thought this through...particularly where his sister's wrath is concerned.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_KRILE_000_003: She may know full well that no amount of complaint will dissuade him, but that doesn't mean she won't still give him an earful.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_GRAHATIA_000_004: It feels like an age since we last met here.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: It comforts me to know that some of you will be staying. I would feel rather bereft should you all go at once!
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_SHALE_000_011: What news, ? Can't imagine you brought an entourage along to simply say hello.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_SHALE_000_012: That eager to be on their way, are they?
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_SHALE_000_013: I'll join you. I owe them thanks on behalf of Oblivion, after all.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_YSHTOLA_000_014: And there I thought you would protest against being parted from your work.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_SHALE_000_015: While I am curious to see what emerges once every piece of the puzzle's in place, the majority of the files we've unearthed are encrypted. There's little else I can do until the computer's finished with them.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_SHALE_000_016: ...Besides, unlike our friends, Containment Complex 10-29 isn't going anywhere.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_YSHTOLA_000_017: In other words, we won't be getting any answers ?
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_SHALE_000_018: Afraid not. It's going to be a while yet.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Then shall we depart for Tuliyollal forthwith? Even Lamaty'i's strength has its limits...
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_YSHTOLA_000_031: Despite her protestations, I doubt Alisaie will keep us waiting long.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_KRILE_000_032: Raha seems preoccupied with a matter of great import. Perhaps he is contemplating a prayer to Llymlaen for their safe passage.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_GRAHATIA_000_033: What sort of tacos should I get on the way back, do you think? The aroma is too tantalizing to ignore...
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Tuliyollal is a delight to look upon. They hang patterned cloth where we might use neon, but the city feels no less bright.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_WUKLAMAT_000_035: Koana and Gulool Ja weren't able to make it, but both send their regards.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_SHALE_000_036: Wish we had some of this sea breeze inside the dome. We could perhaps simulate it, but there's no substitute for the real thing.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_ERENVILLE_000_041: I wish you all would not make such a fuss... I am not fond of emotional partings.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_ERENVILLE_000_042: At least Alphinaud and Alisaie were considerate enough to inform me of their plans in advance by linkpearl. Some people we know would have burst out of a crate mid-voyage...
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_ERENVILLE_000_043: In any event, I shall wait here until they finish their preparations.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_ERENVILLE_000_051: It will be pleasant to have some company for the journey back.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_YSHTOLA_000_061: For our many meetings and partings, we have few enough opportunities to properly say our farewells. 'Twas pleasant to take the time for it.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_GRAHATIA_000_062: Though I delight in companionship, solo journeys too have their appeal. And travel by sea is relaxing...
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: With Alisaie and Alphinaud spreading word of Alexandria, we shall soon have the chance to establish relations with other nations. I must make ready to treat with their leaders.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_SHALE_000_064: I'm glad I got the chance to see him off. Cahciua would be glad, too.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_KRILE_000_071: Now it is our turn to take the next step.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_KRILE_000_072: The question is in what direction, and that is a matter I should like to discuss with you.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_YSHTOLA_000_001: For our many meetings and partings, we have few enough opportunities to properly say our farewells. 'Twas pleasant to take the time for it.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_GRAHATIA_000_002: Though I delight in companionship, solo journeys too have their appeal. And travel by sea is relaxing...
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: With Alisaie and Alphinaud spreading word of Alexandria, we shall soon have the chance to establish relations with other nations. I must make ready to treat with their leaders.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_SHALE_000_004: I'm glad I got the chance to see him off. Cahciua would be glad, too.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_KRILE_000_011: If I may, I think it prudent to discuss our future plans elsewhere.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_KRILE_000_012: We are liable to hinder the dockworkers here if we linger.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_KRILE_000_013: Perhaps the beach would be a more appropriate venue.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_YSHTOLA_000_021: Outside of Alexandria, our knowledge of the Ninth is limited to the Storm Surge and passing mentions of Lindblum.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_YSHTOLA_000_022: That being the case, a foray across the Mist Continent would be an invaluable opportunity for discovery.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_KRILE_000_023: Between the Ascians, the key, and the Milalla, there is much to be learned. Surely we can turn up a clue to one mystery or another.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_GRAHATIA_000_024: Once conditions deteriorate past a certain point, an environment becomes anathema to life. Yet man is a resilient creature.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_GRAHATIA_000_025: If there is a way to survive, then he will surely find it.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: The mechanical soldiers won't hesitate to answer their queen. Let us hope they have useful information.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_SHALE_000_031: Now that's settled, I'd best be off. I still need to check for decryption errors periodically, so I can only step away for so long.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_SHALE_000_032: With luck, I'll have plenty to share the next time we meet.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_KRILE_000_034: Let the rest of us make ready for a potential foray and meet at leynode mnemo.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_YSHTOLA_000_041: The atmosphere is certainly less grim than when last I visited.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_KRILE_000_042: Though my mind knows better, I still feel uncomfortable around these mechanical soldiers...
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_GRAHATIA_000_043: Sphene has found us a suitable source of information, sparing you that duty for once.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_CLERKPX0093_000_044: Welcome to Living Memory, ally to Her Majesty! How may I help you?
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: This clerk has made itself available to answer our questions.
Clerk PX-0093, if one wished to descend to the surface from here, how would they typically do so?
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_CLERKPX0093_000_053: Living Memory is currently detached from Everkeep, and is operating independently while supported by its aerial suspension systems.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_CLERKPX0093_000_054: Thus, both lift- and leynode-based transit is currently unavailable. I apologize for the inconvenience.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_GRAHATIA_000_055: Despite its ability to remain aloft, perhaps Living Memory was never intended to function in this state indefinitely. If so, we're out of luck...
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_YSHTOLA_000_056: Not necessarily. Lifts and leynodes were likely the preferred modes of transportation, but that does not preclude the existence of others.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_YSHTOLA_000_057: In the event of an emergency, how would we evacuate this facility?
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_CLERKPX0093_100_058: Living Memory's airship remains prepared to deploy should evacuation be necessary. Would Your Majesty like to appropriate it?
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Yes, please. As soon as is possible.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_CLERKPX0093_000_061: With Your Majesty's authorization, the vessel can be readied for launch without delay. Allow me a moment to execute the bypass protocols.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_YSHTOLA_000_071: As I thought. Now, what awaits us below, I wonder?
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_KRILE_000_072: It never occurred to me that there might be an airship here. How fortuitous!
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_GRAHATIA_000_073: With an airship, a large number of Alexandrians could be evacuated at once, regardless of the situation below. An excellent contingency.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Though I am nervous about what we might find below, I am glad we found the means to get there.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_ORIGINALSPHENE_100_: As queen, I must bear witness to the truth, however terrible.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_CLERKPX0093_000_081: Safety tests have been successfully completed. Setting the Gate of Remembrance as initial destination...
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_CLERKPX0093_000_501: It was purpose-built for Living Memory. However, it was modeled after the vessel Your Majesty used during the Storm Surge era.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: A replica... Still, it does me good to see it.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_CLERKPX0093_000_503: I will deploy the gangway for boarding. This way, please.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_CLERKPX0093_000_504: In order to reach the surface, we must pass through the storm clouds. I advise you to brace for turbulence!
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: The ward Alisaie gave me is reacting...
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_YSHTOLA_000_511: Though not to the extent of the Thirteenth, the aetheric imbalance here is severe indeed.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_GRAHATIA_000_512: It does serve to impress upon one the marvel of the barrier.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: The lightning in Heritage Found is tame by comparison.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_YSHTOLA_000_091: The state of this reflection's aether is more dire than we anticipated.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_YSHTOLA_000_092: I should be surprised if the Ascians had no hand in the war that wrought this.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_GRAHATIA_000_093: The warding scale is truly a godssend for those of us without the blessing of Light. Remind me to send my profuse thanks to Vrtra and the Hannish alchemists once more.
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_KRILE_000_101: A sobering sight, to say the least. But I shan't turn back now that we've come this far.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_YSHTOLA_000_001: The state of this reflection's aether is more dire than we anticipated.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_YSHTOLA_000_002: I should be surprised if the Ascians had no hand in the war that wrought this.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_GRAHATIA_000_003: The warding scale is truly a godssend for those of us without the blessing of Light. Remind me to send my profuse thanks to Vrtra and the Hannish alchemists once more.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_KRILE_000_011: There are no structures, nor any other sign of survivors that I can see...
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: I suspect the crater made this area unsuitable for habitation due to the increased risk of flooding.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_KRILE_000_013: Then we should look further afield. In which direction do you think we might find a settlement?
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: If we're at the edge of Alexandrian territory now, the closest city would be Treno. Should it survive...
As a city-state built on a harbor, it was a nexus of trade, and it remained neutral throughout the war. We Alexandrians always felt fortunate to have it in our neighborhood, so to speak.
Ah, yes! Alphinaud has spoken of Radz-at-Han before. It's near the south sea isles─the Milalla homeland, correct?
Funnily enough, it was also Treno where the Milalla first found a home in our world.
Yes, and though the Milalla population elsewhere grew, most continued to feel a strong connection to the city. I'd like to think that some remain there to this day...
Clerk PX-0093, is this ship capable of taking us to Treno?
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_CLERKPX0093_000_022: I shall run a flight simulation for the route to Treno. One moment...
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_CLERKPX0093_000_023: Simulation complete. There is a near one hundred percent probability that the ship would suffer catastrophic mechanical failure prior to arrival due to ambient lightning. My apologies!
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Oh... Well, thank you for checking.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_GRAHATIA_000_025: If we cannot fly, then we shall have to walk.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Treno lies beyond the mountains... But there should be routes that spare us having to climb.
That cave system, for instance─assuming it hasn't collapsed. Let's try there first.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_YSHTOLA_000_031: Eager though I am to seek new discoveries, the prospect of walking in circles for days on end does not appeal. We are fortunate to have Sphene.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_KRILE_000_032: The place where my people first arrived─and I shall soon see it in person!
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_GRAHATIA_000_033: Of late, I've spent much of my time hunched over reports. A brisk trek across a wasteland shall make for a refreshing change of pace.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Though we have no way of knowing what it's like further in.
Mind you stay alert for beasts, as well. Given the barren surrounds, they're surely ravenous...
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_A1_000_002: Form a party and enter Mistwake.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_YSHTOLA_000_061: Whatever lies ahead shall give us more insight into the state of the Ninth.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_KRILE_000_062: I am anxious and hopeful in equal measure. 'Tis a strange feeling...
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_GRAHATIA_000_063: There should be little reason for anyone to have passed this way since Alexandria's displacement. Let us pray loose rocks are the worst we must contend with.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: I speak so confidently of the Milalla's connection to Treno because my tutor, Tuphut, hailed from the city. Another reason to hope it has survived...
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_SYSTEM_150_070: You may now use mounts within Treno.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_KRILE_000_071: That must be Lumull. Heavens, I can smell the herbal aroma from here...
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_GRAHATIA_000_072: None of the locals we've passed appear terribly distressed. As Sphene surmised, incursions must be a common occurrence.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_LUMULL_000_081: Why, if it isn't our new friends! Thanks again for making short work of our foes.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_LUMULL_000_082: If you've gone to the trouble of seeking me out, I can only assume it's for good reason!
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_LUMULL_000_083: You want to help me? Odd, but I'll consider it. Before anything else, though...
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_LUMULL_000_084: I must insist you drink our signature remedy, Sleepless Rhapsody! Everyone's a fan.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_LUMULL_000_085: You may find it the teensiest touch too sour for your tastes, but it'll set you aright. Just tip it down your throat...
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_KRILE_000_091: Is this custom meant to raise the townsfolk's spirits after a trying event? Does it serve some ritual function?
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_KRILE_000_092: He seems awfully keen on our partaking...
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_GRAHATIA_000_093: Surely we can survive a simple beverage. Surely...
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_LUMULL_100_094: It won't hurt, you have my word. But since it's your first cup, maybe don't stray too far before you drink it.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_LUMULL_100_095: Oh, and don't turn your back! For...best results, you understand.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_SYSTEM_100_100: It would seem you have no recourse but to drink the remedy whilst Lumull stands as witness...
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_KRILE_000_101: I see how drinking that would be...unifying. And it is impressive that they have maintained the tradition here, so far from the Milalla's native lands.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_GRAHATIA_000_102: Given its ability to counteract lightning's influence on the body, that remedy could be of use to the people of Alexandria as well. I am certain Lumull would be more than happy to offer it to them...
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_LUMULL_000_111: <gasp> ...I forgot to introduce myself, didn't I?
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_LUMULL_000_112: Well, I'm Lumull. That was me announcing our victory earlier. And since Grandmother sent you to help with repairs, you'll know I'm her grandson.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_LUMULL_000_113: I'm in charge of resolving any problems the people of Treno may have. My favorite kinds of work include taste-testing menu items, carrying medium-sized objects, searching for lost possessions of immense value...
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_LUMULL_000_114: Oh! And it's a pleasure to make your acquaintance.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_SYSTEM_000_0121: You may now enter Mistwake with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_KRILE_000_001: I see how drinking that would be...unifying. And it is impressive that they have maintained the tradition here, so far from the Milalla's native lands.
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_GRAHATIA_000_002: Given its ability to counteract lightning's influence on the body, that remedy could be of use to the people of Alexandria as well. I am certain Lumull would be more than happy to offer it to them...
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_LUMULL_000_012: Are you certain you want to be put to work? If you've come all the way out to visit us, you must have had more important things in mind. And you've already helped protect the city...
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_KRILE_000_013: Actually, our goal was to ascertain the present state of the Mist Continent.
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_LUMULL_000_014: The whole continent!? Did you come from across the sea?
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_LUMULL_000_017: Alexandria? Are you quite, quite sure?
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_LUMULL_000_018: ...No, sorry, of course you're sure. Would be rude of me to doubt you.
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_LUMULL_000_019: It's just, it's not every day that we get visitors, let alone from a nation that up and vanished!
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_KRILE_000_020: I know that it must come as something of a shock.
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_KRILE_000_021: But this is our first time in Treno, and we should like to get to know the city and its people. That is why we proposed lending a hand to those in need.
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_LUMULL_000_023: Why don't you help distribute this remedy to the rest of our people?
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_LUMULL_000_024: Ordinarily, everyone would've already come for a cup, but the fiends made quite a mess this time. Might be a while before some can step away from their work.
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_LUMULL_000_025: Never fear, though─even if their hands are busy, they'll be more than happy to spare a few words for fascinating folks from afar.
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_KRILE_000_026: We would appreciate that. Thank you, Lumull.
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_LUMULL_000_027: You're the ones doing me a favor, honestly! Here, take this batch.
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_LUMULL_000_028: I'll deliver some to town hall, so you can attend to areas you haven't seen yet!
