TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_GRAHATIA_000_031: Like Miayli, Lumull seemed taken aback by mention of Alexandria. Perhaps they had friends or loved ones who disappeared along with it.
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_KRILE_000_031: If we split up, we can spend more time speaking with the locals while ensuring everyone receives the remedy promptly. Could you each take a portion?
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_A1_000_001: Of course. I haven't had my fill of conversation yet!
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_A1_000_002: Rest assured that I can handle pouring liquid into a cup.
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_GRAHATIA_000_033: I too should be glad to dole out a few servings.
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_KRILE_000_034: Wonderful! Let me divide this up...
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_KRILE_000_035: , why don't you make rounds of the southern part of the city? Raha and I shall tend to the north.
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_KRILE_000_036: Right, let's go and acquire some insights!
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_KRILE_000_041: So the taste is challenging even when one is accustomed to it...
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_GRAHATIA_000_042: Is that so? This city is remarkably self-sufficient.
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_RESIDENTA05429_000_: You must be one of those visitors Lumull mentioned. Odd place to be visiting, though.

Oh, you came to deliver the remedy? Thank you kindly. I was hauling beast carcasses in for processing and copped a good dose of discharged energy for my troubles. It brought on the levin sickness something fierce...
Still, we don't go hunting outside the barrier, so we don't want to waste any part of the creatures that find their way in.
Pelts that're highly charged with lightning aether are the most valuable, of course. Tan them with the right stuff, and you can turn them into protective clothing that keeps you from getting zapped.
The beasts you felled will all be put to good use. Thanks again!
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_RESIDENTB05429_000_: You're that mighty monster-slayer I saw earlier! It's an honor.
And you've brought Sleepless Rhapsody! Bless you─I'm dead on my feet after that battle. We don't usually have that many beasts breaking through at once.
Practice keeps one's skills sharp, though, so in a way I'm glad for it. And I learned a thing or two from watching you.
Oh, I can hardly wait to get to work on my grimoire! I have a number of ideas for improved geometries...
The thoughtful application of new learning is what keeps our ancestors' magic alive and flourishing!
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_RESIDENTC05429_000_: There's a fresh face if ever I saw one... And what's that in your hand?
Oh, don't mind if I do! Safety inspections take priority, but the battle doesn't feel over until I've had a cup of Sleepless Rhapsody...
I'm proud to say that I have some small part in preparing it, too. The herbs come from my very own growery.
One of the greatest discoveries of our time is that seeds carried in by invading creatures can be cultivated into remarkable plants. Plants with the potential to mitigate the lightning's effects!
And with as many hides as we have this time─not to mention stomachs!─it's entirely possible we'll find new varieties of herbs among our harvest.
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_GRAHATIA_000_081: Finished with your supply of remedy as well, have you? I expect the scent will linger on our clothing for days...
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_RESIDENTA05429_000_: Our histories say that when large creatures broke through the barrier, our bravest fighters would launch themselves onto their backs with the trebuchet. We have you to thank for not needing to revive that tradition today!
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_RESIDENTB05429_000_: Now I must face my true nemesis: circles. They're so hard to draw without making them all wobbly!
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_RESIDENTC05429_000_: The flowers around the city also sprouted from seeds that creatures carried in. So truth be told, I find it difficult to begrudge them their trespass.
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_KRILE_000_091: Between the three of us, we ought to have covered every area aside from Lumull's.
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_KRILE_000_092: One of the people I spoke with asked me to pass something along to him, but he hasn't returned yet.
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_KRILE_000_093: In the meantime, shall we discuss what we've learned?
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_KRILE_000_001: One wonders how fearsome this Eyaney truly is...
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_GRAHATIA_000_002: If Treno's barrier is similar in design to Alexandria's, should we assume that electrope technology is standard here as well?
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_LUMULL_000_011: At the moment, Eyaney should be waiting just past that park.
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_LUMULL_000_012: Let's be off before anyone changes their mind!
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_GRAHATIA_000_022: Whenever we meet an engineer from some distant land, I can't help but wish to introduce them to our friends at the Ironworks. Such a firestorm of questions there would be...
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_KRILE_000_031: They put one in mind of another pair of siblings we know, don't they?
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_EYANEY_000_041: <gasp> I entirely forgot to ask your names! Do forgive me.
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_KRILE_000_042: I am Krile, and this is .
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_KRILE_000_043: Accompanying Lumull is G'raha Tia, our own technology enthusiast.
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_EYANEY_000_045: It feels strange putting you to work, but I'd be lying if I said I don't need the help.
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_KRILE_000_046: In the wake of an event like this, I presume a great deal of labor is required to restore everything to working order...
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_EYANEY_000_047: The volume of fixes that need making is one matter, but I could handle it if it weren't for these legs of mine. The paralysis flares up at the worst times, I swear...
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_EYANEY_000_048: I can manage a bit of shuffling from one station to the other on a good day, but I usually leave racing around the city to my brother.
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_EYANEY_000_049: With him off to the mine, though, someone else needs to take care of the lightning sprites. They're drawn to the discharged aether of slain creatures.
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_EYANEY_000_050: I'd offer you the detector to make tracking them down easier, but seeing as Lumull has managed to break it yet again... <sigh>
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_EYANEY_000_051: I do have this, though. Toss some at a sprite, and you can suppress its ability to sense aether nearby. That usually gets them wandering out of the city towards more fertile ground.
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_EYANEY_000_053: We find it's safer not to. When threatened, they'll siphon energy from facilities we need to keep our medical services running, or emit bursts that overload nearby systems.
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_EYANEY_000_054: For the same reason, I recommend you stick to thoroughfares that will allow you to spot them well in advance. I would hate for you to be injured while helping us.
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_KRILE_000_056: We'll want to split up again to cover more ground. Are you ready to go?
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_EYANEY_000_061: I appreciate the help. I'll be here working on the detector while you're away.
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_SYSTEM_100_065: Though you scan the area thoroughly, you see no lightning sprites.
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_SYSTEM_100_066: Though you scan the area thoroughly, you see no lightning sprites.
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_SYSTEM_100_067: Lightning sprites! The time to test your tossing arm has arrived...
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_RESIDENT05431_100_0: Guests are always welcome in Treno. I hope you're enjoying your time here!
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_EYANEY_000_081: You're back! Were there many sprites?
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_EYANEY_000_082: Just a handful on your route, then? Could be worse!
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_EYANEY_000_084: Still, it's important to keep the city free of them. We're much obliged!
TEXT_KINGMJ106_05431_RESIDENT05431_100_0: Guests are always welcome in Treno. I hope you're enjoying your time here!
TEXT_KINGMJ106_05431_EYANEY_000_001: Krile is taking a while... Being new to the city, if something were to happen, she wouldn't know where to go for help.
TEXT_KINGMJ106_05431_EYANEY_000_002: Would you check on her? She started off in the direction of town hall.
TEXT_KINGMJ106_05431_EYANEY_000_011: Thankfully, I can confirm she's in no immediate danger─I got the detector running again just now, and it hasn't picked up any new signals.
TEXT_KINGMJ106_05431_SYSTEM_000_021: Though there are several diminutive folk about, none appears to be Krile.
TEXT_KINGMJ106_05431_SYSTEM_000_022: Perhaps one of them spotted her passing through...
TEXT_KINGMJ106_05431_RESIDENT05431_000_0: You're looking a mite lost there, . Aught I can help with?
TEXT_KINGMJ106_05431_A1_000_001: Have you seen a woman in a yellow hood?
TEXT_KINGMJ106_05431_A1_000_002: I'm looking for a Milalla friend of mine...
TEXT_KINGMJ106_05431_RESIDENT05431_000_0: A Milalla? Seen quite a few of them today, heh. But if she's a friend of yours...
I presume you mean Krile. Had a grand old chat with her earlier.
Not to mention she saved my hide! Can't believe I missed that lightning sprite till it was right on top of me...
It's thanks to her that I got out unscathed.
Bit awkward, striking up a conversation after that. And it'd been a while since I talked to anyone I haven't known my whole life...
She's a kind lass. Good at putting folks at ease, like Miayli. I quite enjoyed telling her about the city.
When we were done chatting, she went off towards the canal. Had a touch of melancholy about her, though, and I wasn't sure why...
Didn't think it was something I said, but I knew that if it was, saying more wouldn't help. So I let her go.
I reckon she'd welcome the company of a good friend right now.
Good place for pondering, that canal. Maybe that's why she went that way.
TEXT_KINGMJ106_05431_KRILE_000_061: Thank you for listening. I'm a little less afraid to face the answer now, whatever it may be.
TEXT_KINGMJ106_05431_KRILE_000_062: And when I find it, I hope you'll be there.
TEXT_KINGMJ106_05431_KRILE_000_063: ...But we've kept Eyaney waiting long enough. Let's hurry back.
TEXT_KINGMJ106_05431_KRILE_000_071: Trifling though it was, I feel that the work we've done has helped me gain a better understanding of Treno. The countless small actions taken by myriad people every day are what make a place what it is, after all.
TEXT_KINGMJ106_05431_EYANEY_000_081: I'm glad you're both back safe and sound!
TEXT_KINGMJ106_05431_EYANEY_000_082: Now we can relax until my brother does the same. With your friend escorting him, he can't get himself into too much trouble...unless he tumbles down the stairs into town again, I suppose.
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_EYANEY_000_001: Grandmother used to tell us stories of the Milalla homeland all the time, but it was the part where the ocean froze over that always fascinated me most. The vast, open sea, turned to ice? Imagine!
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_KRILE_000_011: Earlier, you said that your brother couldn't get into too much trouble if he was with Raha, but how much trouble is that, precisely? One would think they ought to have returned by now...
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_KRILE_000_012: ...Conversely, I hadn't expected to see the two of you again so soon! I take it Miayli's curiosity is sated?
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: I gave her a brief account of the situation in Alexandria, as well as events involving the key.
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_YSHTOLA_000_015: She was most interested in the latter. In fact, it seems she knew of the relic long before we did, and wishes to discuss it with everyone. Would you be able to join us?
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_KRILE_000_016: I should love to go straightaway, but we are awaiting Raha's return...
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_YSHTOLA_000_017: As we speak, Miayli herself is making her rounds through the city. We have time.
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_YSHTOLA_000_021: I wasn't certain if we should divulge any information concerning the key, but Alexandria's present location is difficult to explain without mentioning it. Fortunately, it turned out for the best.
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_KRILE_000_022: If the Milalla arrived in Treno immediately after fleeing the Source, I can understand how its mayor might be privy to knowledge of the key. Particularly when that mayor is a Milalla herself...
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: I have a mind to reestablish diplomatic relations with Treno, but it goes without saying that there are logistical challenges given our respective locations.
The least of these is that any travel would require passage through Tural. To begin with, I shall have to consult with Gossan and the Vow of Resolve.
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_EYANEY_000_025: Alexandria!? The kingdom past the mountains? The one that vanished?
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_EYANEY_000_026: I had wondered where you lot came from, but that wasn't my first guess. Or my fifth, for that matter.
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_YSHTOLA_000_031: While it is not in our nature to stand idle at a time like this, we should first consider how best to apply our individual skills...
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_KRILE_000_041: If anyone can stop a speeding weapon of war, it is . But we must also recognize the threat posed by its company of beasts. If its influence is so powerful that, even as it barrels ahead, enthralled creatures continue to follow it, then the train may well gather additional minions as it draws near.
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_KRILE_000_042: There is no telling how many will charge Treno's gate, so we should prepare for the worst. Perhaps Y'shtola and I ought to remain on guard here.
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_YSHTOLA_000_044: ─while you remove the head of this metal serpent, we will attend to the defense of the city.
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_KRILE_000_045: Among other things, we must do what we can to ensure the citizens get to shelter before the fighting begins. Godsspeed!
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_STATIONWARP_000_051: I really could have gone without a Doomtrain attack today...
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_LUMULL_000_061: Right. The place we're headed is the Bentini Depot.
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_LUMULL_000_062: Although Treno has its own railway station, our assailants from earlier left it in need of significant repairs.
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_LUMULL_000_063: Thus, we'll be taking a hover cargo.
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_LUMULL_000_064: My friend here has volunteered for the mission─and yes, I did explain the dangers.
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_STATIONWARP_000_065: The cargo's equipped with a portable barrier, and frankly, I'm great at my job.
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_STATIONWARP_000_066: I guarantee our safety during the ride. What happens once we get to Bentini... Well, that's your problem.
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_LUMULL_000_067: It certainly is! Let me know when you're ready to move out.
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_STATIONWARP_000_001: I really could have gone without a Doomtrain attack today...
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_LUMULL_000_011: Ready? Then our fearless operator will help you aboard.
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_LUMULL_000_012: We make for Bentini with all haste!
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_STATIONWARP_000_031: I'll have us there in a flash! Do keep any limbs you're attached to and would like to remain attached to inside the vehicle.
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_LUMULL_000_041: Using our on-board systems, I should be able to monitor you from the locomotive. And you'll be able to hear me!
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_STATIONWARP_000_044: I'll have us there in a flash! Do keep any limbs you're attached to and would like to remain attached to inside the vehicle.
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_LUMULL_000_051: I have to believe that Eyaney will be safe with your comrades while we attend to matters elsewhere.
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_LUMULL_000_052: I'll see to the wounded. You try not to join them, alright?
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_SYSTEM_100_053: You must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 100 or above to proceed.
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_SYSTEM_100_054: Your progress through the battle will be saved at certain points. In the event that you are defeated, you will be able to try again from the most recent of these.
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_SYSTEM_100_055: Please note that if you enter battles associated with other quests or log out from the game, this progress will be lost.
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_YSHTOLA_000_061: Exhaustion aside, Krile sustained no injuries you need worry over.
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_GRAHATIA_000_062: After that battle, I think we all required a moment. You had better get some rest too─I mean it.
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: To think Miayli knew Krile's mother... I too am eager to hear the details.
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_KRILE_000_071: While I would rather not have tumbled to the pavement in front of half the city, I am none the worse for wear, thanks to Y'shtola.
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_KRILE_000_072: But what of yourself? If you have any hurts, we can tend to them now before we see Miayli.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_YSHTOLA_000_001: Exhaustion aside, Krile sustained no injuries you need worry over.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_GRAHATIA_000_002: After that battle, I think we all required a moment. You had better get some rest too─I mean it.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: To think Miayli knew Krile's mother... I too am eager to hear the details.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_KRILE_000_011: Curious, isn't it? I want to know. More than anything. Yet part of me is still terrified...
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_KRILE_000_012: But having come so far, I can't turn from the truth now.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_KRILE_000_013: If everyone is feeling up to it, let us go and have our answers.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_YSHTOLA_000_021: While the key is to be the main topic of our conversation, there is no telling what else Miayli might reveal...
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_KRILE_000_022: It's alright. I'm ready to hear it.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_GRAHATIA_000_023: I find myself feeling anxious on Krile's behalf...
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: I had every confidence Lumull would be safe in your company, but it heartens me to see him unharmed nonetheless.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_LUMULL_000_025: Ah, our new friends! Do you know why Grandmother called us here? Both Eyaney and I neglected to ask...
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_EYANEY_000_026: How are you faring? I hope you've recovered from your brush with the Doomtrain─and did I hear something about a behemoth...?
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_YSHTOLA_000_031: If the Milalla's records were in Preservation's possession, I doubt they ever relinquished them. That knowledge must await us back in Alexandria.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_KRILE_000_032: I can't believe I have living relatives here...
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_KRILE_000_033: ...And that they make it seem so simple. Maybe it is enough to just be...Krile.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_GRAHATIA_000_034: Lumull and Eyaney have gone to summon the other Milalla we've met from across the city.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Krile looks like she's just seen the first ray of sunlight on a cloudy day. I'm glad she found that which she sought.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_YSHTOLA_000_041: Once we are back in Solution Nine, I should like to relax with a hot cup of tea.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_GRAHATIA_000_042: Though we're still in the Ninth, it hardly feels like it up here. What a wonder.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: If safe and reliable airship travel to Treno were possible, it would cut down on the length and danger of the journey...
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_KRILE_000_041: It still feels a bit like I'm dreaming... But even should I wake, I'll remember it. I'll remember them.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_KRILE_000_042: ...On a practical note, I am more certain than ever that Shale's work will yield vital insights into the key. I look forward to speaking with her when we arrive in Solution Nine.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: If you don't mind, might we first make our way to Resolution? Gossan will be wondering about my absence...
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_KRILE_000_044: Heavens, yes. I apologize for keeping you from your duties for so long!
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Think nothing of it. I was more than happy to be a part of your adventure. And Gossan will forgive me once I tell him of Treno...
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_YSHTOLA_000_051: Though we learned little about the Ascians, our sojourn was more than worthwhile.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_GRAHATIA_000_053: According to the people of Treno, there are yet other settlements in the Ninth. We shall have to seek them out one day.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Gossan hasn't worn his regulator since his memory was restored. The experience must have affected him deeply.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_GOSSAN_000_062: I wondered why I had seen neither hide nor hair of Your Majesty these past days... May I ask where you have been?
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Er... It's quite a long story...
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_GOSSAN_000_064: However stalwart your companions, traversing the Mist Continent with no knowledge of what awaited was extraordinarily reckless!
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Th-That I cannot deny, but it availed us much. We have the opportunity to resume diplomatic relations with a longtime ally.
And as I did not, in fact, come to harm...all is well that ends well?
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_GOSSAN_000_067: Should you feel compelled to go on any other excursions in future, I expect that you will notify me beforehand.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_ORIGINALSPHENE_100_: Yes, of course... It was remiss of me. I apologize.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_ORIGINALSPHENE_000_: Duty's call is most insistent. Nevertheless, whenever you require my aid, please do not hesitate to seek it.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_SHALE_000_070: You're back. How'd it go? Did you find a way down?
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_SHALE_000_071: Treno... I've heard the name. Incredible that it's sheltered the Milalla all this time.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_YSHTOLA_000_072: What's more, the mayor was able to share the story of the key from her perspective. She believes that the historical documents pertaining to it are stored in Preservation's archives.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_SHALE_000_073: They could be. Though our work isn't done yet, we've made progress on the decryption. I was on my way to the containment complex to review the data in situ.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_YSHTOLA_000_074: In that case, allow me to accompany you. Though it may be incomplete, I should like to review the information available.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_SHALE_000_075: We'll contact you as soon as we've made some sense of it.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_GRAHATIA_000_076: In the meantime, might I suggest that our Warrior of Light get a good night's sleep or two? You never know what manner of hellish technology will be after us next.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_GRAHATIA_000_077: And Krile, I assume you'll be wanting to familiarize yourself with the care and feeding of porxies.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_KRILE_000_078: Indeed. While I'm aware of the principles, I was needed elsewhere when the others were treating the levin-afflicted. I shall have to ask Y'shtola to instruct me.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_KRILE_000_079: 'Tis the least I can do for my family...
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_KRILE_000_080: I intend to visit them whenever possible. But my home will always be here in the Source.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_KRILE_000_001: I trust you were able to get plenty of rest? Good. I thought we might take a moment to ponder our next steps─and perhaps reflect on our recent journey.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_KRILE_000_002: I must admit my thoughts often drift to the Mist Continent and our stay in Treno...
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_KRILE_000_003: It was heartening to see the Milalla prosper despite the odds, and my own flesh and blood strive in that levin-wracked landscape.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_GRAHATIA_100_004: Sphene was eager to restore diplomatic relations, and I have no doubt that Alexandria will provide much-needed support for their neighbor.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_KRILE_000_005: I too shall do everything I can to aid my home away from home─my wonderful, welcoming family included.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_KRILE_000_006: For the time being, though, I'd say we've accomplished all within our power.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_GRAHATIA_000_007: I suppose that just leaves the matter of Preservation's research...
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_GRAHATIA_000_008: It is yet unclear how Calyx learned the techniques he used to summon his dark primal.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_GRAHATIA_000_009: And there is likewise much that remains unknown about the key. Let us hope that Shale's efforts bear more fruit.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_YSHTOLA_000_011: (-Y'shtola-)Shale and I have been reviewing the decrypted files, and have uncovered some intriguing details. Would you care to join us?
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_KRILE_000_012: We'll be with you right away.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_YSHTOLA_000_013: (-Y'shtola-)Excellent. Shale seems rather eager to speak with you all. Come and find us in the deuterolab when you're ready.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_KRILE_000_014: Uncanny timing indeed! Let us make for the containment complex.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_LIFTATTENDANT_000_0: Heading for the containment complex? Right this way!
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_YSHTOLA_000_025: Given that all the data is stored within electrope devices, Shale's expertise has proven invaluable.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_YSHTOLA_000_100: Given that Preservation could not unlock the secrets of the key, it should come as no surprise that we too struggle to understand its nature... In any event, do give Tataru my regards when you see her.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_YSHTOLA_000_105: Ah, I ought to mention that we also uncovered information unrelated to the key.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_YSHTOLA_000_110: According to Shale, certain confidential reports are now accessible via devices in the researchers' commons and the director's office. You might wish to peruse the files before you depart for Sharlayan.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_SHALE_000_115: My colleagues will be just as saddened by your departure. Until we meet again, safe journeys!
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_GRAHATIA_000_120: Oh dear... It occurs to me that I neglected to bring gifts from Tural. Considering the extra work they've had to handle in my absence, I daresay I owe them a veritable mountain of snacks, at the very least...
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_KRILE_000_125: I thought it best to hear what Ojika has to say ere we meet with Tataru. I do hope she is well...
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_2: Welcome back! And what a pleasure it is to see you too, .
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_KRILE_000_201: Thank you for contacting us, Ojika. We came as soon as we could.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_2: Of course. I felt it prudent given how troubled Tataru was...
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_KRILE_000_203: Your concern is much appreciated. As it so happens, we'd reached a convenient juncture in our investigation. Shale and Y'shtola have matters well in hand, leaving us free to make this trip.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_2: That's a relief to hear. Now, let me fetch Tataru for you.
Why don't you take a moment to relax in the main hall? I'm sure you're all still fatigued from your journey!
I shan't be long, but you can unwind in the main hall while I'm gone.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_KRILE_000_215: Only now is it beginning to feel like we've actually returned. Such fond memories within these four walls!
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_GRAHATIA_000_220: Given how frequently Tataru is away on business these days, 'tis a small miracle we're in the same place at the same time.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_3: Voidsent emerging across the star!? How fortunate I contacted you when I did... Please do take care of yourselves!
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_KRILE_000_305: Clearly we made the right decision to come to Sharlayan. Though I dearly wish the circumstances of our return were not so grave...
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_GRAHATIA_000_310: I don't believe we've seen Thancred and Urianger since our battle with the Endless Sphene, have we? They too must have returned here at some point.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_TATARU_000_400: I've been told Alphinaud and Alisaie have withdrawn to Tertium to request aid on the front lines.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_TATARU_000_401: They seemed intent on rejoining the battle once reinforcements were ready, but I shall tell them to wait until you arrive!
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_TATARU_000_001: Sorry to send you packing so soon after your homecoming, but Garlemald desperately needs your aid!
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_KRILE_000_005: Clearly we made the right decision to come to Sharlayan. Though I dearly wish the circumstances of our return were not so grave...
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_0: Voidsent emerging across the star!? How fortunate I contacted you when I did... Please do take care of yourselves!
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_GRAHATIA_000_020: And just like that, we find ourselves faced with another emergency. Fortunately, there is yet time for us to make a difference. Let us make haste for Tertium!
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_ALISAIE_000_025: Thank you for coming at such short notice. I'm glad you're here...
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_URIANGER_000_035: Well met, my friend. Now, let us hearken unto Alphinaud's words.
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_ALPHINAUD_000_100: Ah, ! You've made it in time!
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_A1_000_002: Form a party and enter the Clyteum.
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_ALPHINAUD_000_110: The Clyteum once supplied the imperial army with all manner of munitions and warmachina. Like many such facilities, I am told it had fallen to ruin in the wake of the Empire's collapse...
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_ALISAIE_000_115: Even with magitek support, the Garleans are struggling to beat back the voidsent. We must join them as soon as possible!
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_THANCRED_000_120: I can't say I have your knack for dispatching voidsent, but our time in Tural gave me many opportunities to hone my skills. You shan't find me wanting.
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_URIANGER_000_125: I have seen to my preparations. I suggest we sally forth ere the cold winds sap our strength...
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_GRAHATIA_000_130: In these frosty climes, the weather is as much an adversary as any voidsent. We ought not tarry!
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_KRILE_000_135: I've often thought that if I had been more adept in tending to the wounded of Solution Nine, perhaps not so many would have been lost... I shall do my utmost to see that I do not look back on this battle with regret.
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_ALPHINAUD_000_300: You have my heartfelt appreciation. Without your intervention, I have no doubt the casualties would have been far greater.
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_ALISAIE_000_305: Jullus was quick to put our words─or rather, those of the Dawnservant─into practice!
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_THANCRED_000_310: That boy's come a long way. All credit to Zero for nudging him in the right direction.
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_URIANGER_000_315: With the Clyteum's fissure sealed, I daresay the voidsent incursion is at an end.
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_GRAHATIA_000_320: Voidsent not only absorb the aether of those they consume, but their thoughts as well... With such a legion of minds at their disposal, one hopes they prove a capable ally for Zero.
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_JULLUS_000_400: Reports have begun trickling in. By all accounts, the Ilsabard contingent was successful in containing the threat on their front.
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_JULLUS_000_401: For voidsent to attack in such numbers just as we were finding our feet... I daren't imagine the consequences had you not provided such timely aid.
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_JULLUS_000_402: On behalf of my comrades, thank you. Thank you all!
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_SYSTEM_000_403: You may now enter the Clyteum with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_KINGMK103_05472_ALPHINAUD_000_001: You have my heartfelt appreciation. Without your intervention, I have no doubt the casualties would have been far greater.
TEXT_KINGMK103_05472_ALISAIE_000_005: Jullus was quick to put our words─or rather, those of the Dawnservant─into practice!
TEXT_KINGMK103_05472_URIANGER_000_010: With the Clyteum's fissure sealed, I daresay the voidsent incursion is at an end.
TEXT_KINGMK103_05472_GRAHATIA_000_015: Voidsent not only absorb the aether of those they consume, but their thoughts as well... With such a legion of minds at their disposal, one hopes they prove a capable ally for Zero.
TEXT_KINGMK103_05472_JULLUS_000_020: As you might have gathered, the Dawnservant's wisdom struck a chord... I only hope my words resonate as strongly with the voidsent we met.
TEXT_KINGMK103_05472_LOPORRIT05472_000_2: My valiant savior! I was so frightened I dared not move an ilm...
Oh, you're looking for Livingway? I think I saw her heading southwest, towards the Drowning Brand.
She had several slaughter-bots in tow, but I worry they won't be enough for all the voidsent. You'd better hurry!
TEXT_KINGMK103_05472_LIVINGWAY_000_505: Where in the blazes did you go!? Y'shtola and G'raha Tia went off to help the others, in case you were wondering.
TEXT_KINGMK103_05472_SYSTEM_000_700: Now seems an opportune time to give Zero the parcel Jullus prepared for her.
TEXT_KINGMK103_05472_BLACKKNIGHT_000_705: That key of yours intrigues me. Had my former self known of its existence, I might have sought different means to reach the Source...
TEXT_KINGMK103_05472_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Ah, I recall Jullus speaking of the dumplings his mother used to make.
Thank you for the parcel...and the fond memories.
There's more than enough to share with Golbez. Now that he forgoes the aether of others, I'm sure he'll appreciate the sustenance.

I sometimes wonder what the void would be like if culinary traditions flourished here once more─whether it would suffice to break the cycle of mutual consumption. A heartening thought, if nothing else...
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_BLACKKNIGHT_000_001: That key of yours intrigues me. Had my former self known of its existence, I might have sought different means to reach the Source...
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Until our battle earlier, I hadn't called upon Darkness in some time. In truth, I find Light a better fit these days.
Ever since you left, we've been roaming the void in search of individuals who would join our cause.
Although we returned to the red moon after sensing Enuo's presence, rarely do we linger in a single location.
However, if the interloper you spoke of does intend to seek me out, it might be wise to return to my domain.
Why don't you join us? With Enuo defeated, the Source should be in no imminent danger.
Good. We'll wait for you by the crater.
I presume you remember traveling by nisroch? Once we reach the surface, the creature will convey us to my domain.
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_BLACKKNIGHT_000_100: There is a teleporter situated between here and the center of the moon.
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_BLACKKNIGHT_000_101: I used it to travel to the surface in days long past, though I seldom had need once my generals were in place.
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_BLACKKNIGHT_000_102: Igeyorhm herself crafted the device that I might lay low the servant of Light.
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_BLACKKNIGHT_000_103: Ironic that we now use it seeking to restore Light to the void...
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_BLACKKNIGHT_000_104: Ah, forgive my idle reminiscences. 'Tis time we made our descent.
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_SYSTEM_000_105: Travel to Zero's domain via the teleporter?
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_BLACKKNIGHT_000_110: There are many in this domain who still fear me. I shall remain here to avoid needless provocation.
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Though it was not always so, many who live here now have chosen to do so because they support the cause.
Indeed, if our numbers continue to grow, we may require more territory.
Thankfully, we were able to harness the residual aether from Barbariccia's domain. Those reserves will enable me to expand mine as the need arises.
Right, we had best prepare for our potential guest. Join me in my abode when you're ready.
I imagine you remember these. The transmitters we used to receive Light from the First...
If memory serves, they work by channeling excess aether left in the wake of the Flood into the Crystal Tower.
Using the tower's cross-rift travel capabilities, Light is then conveyed unto the Thirteenth and into these devices.
I have a mind to use them now, but they'll need to be set in an elevated location. Your assistance would be greatly appreciated.
Using the transmitters in here won't suit my plan. We require higher ground.
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_BLACKKNIGHT_000_405: That brilliant beam... Though but a drop in the ocean, I'm sure its radiance dispelled the Darkness from within some few voidsent.
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_PUPPETEERVOIDCENT_0: Perhaps I shall use my abilities to assemble a dwelling in this domain...
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: It would seem Jullus's intervention has helped forge a new bond. Thank you for bringing word to me.
I gather you'll head home sooner rather than later?
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_SYSTEM_000_502: You will not be able to freely return to Zero's domain. Are you certain you wish to leave?
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Then let us return to the red moon. I'm sure you won't begrudge me a proper farewell.
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_ALISAIE_000_605: Halmarut can't be speaking the truth... Can she?
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_THANCRED_000_610: Trust the Ascians to be plotting something utterly reprehensible...
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_URIANGER_000_615: The Ascians once labored to resurrect Zodiark and bring back those who rendered up their lives to summon Him. For the sake of those who now live, we fought tirelessly to oppose them.
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_URIANGER_000_616: If Halmarut doth truly seek a rejoining to avert this Solstice─to ensure some survive when otherwise all would perish...then our interests are not so disparate.
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_GRAHATIA_000_620: To think that individuals of Calyx's ilk or worse exist on other shards...
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_KRILE_000_625: You'll have to forgive me. I'm still coming to terms with it all...
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_YSHTOLA_000_630: Though I am tempted to dismiss a “preemptive rejoining” as an utterly absurd solution, her words are not to be taken lightly...
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_LIVINGWAY_000_700: There you are! One moment you were standing before me, and the next you'd vanished into thin air!
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_LIVINGWAY_000_701: Thanks to you all, the voidsent have been eradicated and the gate lies sealed once more. There's been nary a peep from the crater!
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_LIVINGWAY_000_702: ...Though I can't help but notice none of you seem to share my enthusiasm. Is something wrong?
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_LIVINGWAY_000_703: The star seeks to become whole?
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_LIVINGWAY_000_704: B-But that's preposterous! As far as I'm aware, Hydaelyn made no mention of a natural rejoining. I ought to consult the records to be certain...
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_LIVINGWAY_000_705: But not before thanking you for dispatching the voidsent so handily! You well and truly saved the day.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_ALISAIE_000_001: Halmarut can't be speaking the truth... Can she?
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_THANCRED_000_005: Trust the Ascians to be plotting something utterly reprehensible...
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_URIANGER_000_010: The Ascians once labored to resurrect Zodiark and bring back those who rendered up their lives to summon Him. For the sake of those who now live, we fought tirelessly to oppose them.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_URIANGER_000_011: If Halmarut doth truly seek a rejoining to avert this Solstice─to ensure some survive when otherwise all would perish...then our interests are not so disparate.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_GRAHATIA_000_015: To think that individuals of Calyx's ilk or worse exist on other shards...
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_KRILE_000_020: You'll have to forgive me. I'm still coming to terms with it all...
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_YSHTOLA_000_025: Though I am tempted to dismiss a “preemptive rejoining” as an utterly absurd solution, her words are not to be taken lightly...
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_LIVINGWAY_000_030: I realize present circumstances are hardly conducive to doing so, but please try to get some rest while you can! I know I would be exhausted after your trials in the void...
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_ALPHINAUD_000_040: The implications of the Solstice and the Winterers' schemes, as well as our approach moving forward, will take time to consider. To that end, I believe we should gather and speak in person.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_ALPHINAUD_000_041: And by “we,” I mean all our fellow Scions.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_ALISAIE_000_042: For a change of pace, why don't we convene at the Rising Stones? I'm sure Tataru and the others would be happy to meet us there.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_ALPHINAUD_000_043: A fine idea. In many ways, our return is long overdue.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_ALPHINAUD_000_044: No doubt we could all use some respite after Garlemald, but I trust there are no objections?
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_ALPHINAUD_000_045: 'Tis settled, then. To the Rising Stones.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_LIVINGWAY_000_050: Rest assured we will do all we can to support your endeavors!
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_ALISAIE_000_055: At times like this, the company of friends is all the more precious!
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_THANCRED_000_060: Since leaving for Tural, we've been almost constantly on the move. It feels good to put my feet up in familiar stamping grounds.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_URIANGER_000_065: In spite of time's vicissitudes, some things endure. This sanctuary is surely among them.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_GRAHATIA_000_070: It feels like a lifetime ago I first set foot within these walls. Though given we've all experienced a lifetime's worth of triumphs and tribulations in the interim, perhaps that is only natural.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_KRILE_000_075: There was much and more to take care of in Garlemald, even after tending to the wounded. I shall be sure to share a full report with Ojika.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_YSHTOLA_000_080: 'Tis a pity my stay in Tural came to such an abrupt end. I should like to make arrangements to remain in touch with Shale.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_ALPHINAUD_000_100: Nary a thing has changed since we last gathered here... No doubt Tataru is chiefly responsible for the prevailing state of tidiness.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_ALPHINAUD_000_101: Speaking of whom, she and a great many of our comrades are en route. Let us wait for them a while longer.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_TATARU_000_105: It seems our colleagues have much to catch each other up on. I shall have to brew some tea!
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_ALISAIE_000_110: Don't worry about me. I'm sure you've plenty to discuss with all these old faces.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_COULTENET_000_115: This latest development is indeed a shock, but I am heartened to see not a single face clouded with despair!
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_EPHEMIE_000_120: I helped repel the voidsent incursion in Lapis Manalis. Fighting off fiend-controlled Galateae is something I won't rush to relive, but it was nonetheless good training.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_URIANGER_000_125: Tataru is ever the considerate facilitator. Grateful am I to refrain from weighty discussions and simply converse with old friends.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_CLEMENCE_000_130: Oh, Aenor... I hoped you'd come to your senses, but I see you're still in the throes of withdrawal.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_AENOR_000_135: The brothers are reunited, yet a distance between them persists! How cruel fate is to force me to choose...
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_KRILE_000_140: Hearing our comrades' tales reminds me of my efforts to master pictomancy. We've all come so far─striven so hard.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_GRAHATIA_000_145: Even after discussing the revelations concerning Calyx, there is a great deal to share. 'Tis difficult to know where to begin!
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_ALPHINAUD_000_200: 'Twas by no means an easy decision, but as the Solstice is now our paramount concern, Alisaie and I have opted to formally withdraw from our efforts in Garlemald.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_ALPHINAUD_000_201: After all, anything we can do to protect our world will also serve to keep the Garleans safe.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_ALISAIE_000_202: Jullus and his comrades are already working towards a brighter future of their own accord. Honestly, I'm more worried about us.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_ALISAIE_000_203: It's so difficult to see the path ahead. But hopefully we can get through this and return to Garlemald with our heads held high one day...
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_ALPHINAUD_000_204: Indeed... In the meantime, let us prepare a letter for Jullus and the community. We mustn't let despair stay our hand.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_ALPHINAUD_000_205: We hardly had time to catch up with Mother and Father back in Sharlayan. I hope they don't take umbrage at so brief a visit...
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_HOARYBOULDER_000_21: Coultenet and I had remained in Corvos to monitor the situation among the Garleans and the Corvosi.
Though seldom smooth sailing, in time the region settled, and we were able to return.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_COULTENET_000_212: I understand the Garlean community has made great strides in improving relations with other peoples.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_COULTENET_000_213: Hearing that, I feel renewed zeal for resolving the issues in Corvos.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_EPHEMIE_000_214: Then perhaps you'd like to hear more about the Garleans' accomplishments from me and the twins. It might stoke that fire even hotter!
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_HOARYBOULDER_000_21: I don't suppose your adventures have taken you to Corvos? While it still bears the scars of war, 'tis a beautiful region, and well worth a visit!
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_THANCRED_000_220: After Urianger and I went off on our own, we decided to spend some time exploring Xak Tural. We never had the chance to visit during the rite of succession, you see.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_THANCRED_000_221: We journeyed east through Loazeniheta before heading up the coast to the frigid northern reaches, where they revere a storied beast of the sea. The excursion only served to reinforce just how diverse Tural really is.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_URIANGER_000_222: We also met with the Whalaqee. Though we had not the time to study their arts at length, we were privy to several intriguing demonstrations.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_URIANGER_000_223: Would that we could have indulged our curiosity further and traveled to yet more distant lands. For better or for worse, pragmatism tempered our wanderlust.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_THANCRED_000_225: Suffice it to say, we still have plenty to see of the continent. I should very much like to return, given the chance.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_THANCRED_000_230: Apparently, the landscape in the far south of Yok Tural is quite unique as well. I can see why Ketenramm was so enamored with the vastness of it all.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_YSHTOLA_000_240: Judging by your guise, Clemence, your studies must have been productive.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_CLEMENCE_000_241: Indeed! I have more or less mastered the fundamental principles of Sharlayan astrology.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_CLEMENCE_000_242: At one point I considered exploring other healing arts, but decided to persevere with more focused training to better leverage my skills on the battlefield.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_AENOR_000_243: I don't think I'd be much use on a battlefield these days. I can scarcely hold my bow steady, let alone hit a target... So sorely bereft of brotherly ministrations as I am...
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_CLEMENCE_000_244: I knew you still required constant supervision!
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_YSHTOLA_000_245: You two haven't changed in the slightest. It makes me wonder how our colleagues that couldn't join us today are faring.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_YSHTOLA_000_250: Seeing the two siblings together made me think of my sisters and half-sisters... All twelve of us actually had the opportunity to gather not so long ago.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_OCHERBOULDER_000_26: Aenor and I were training in Gridania when voidsent attacked the Twelveswood. Thankfully, we were able to fend them off with the help of the Twin Adders.
When I heard the invasion had already spread across the star, I realized the gravity of the situation and ordered a confidential report sent to the other Scions.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_KRILE_000_262: That's why Tataru was so quickly apprised! Thanks to you, we were able to make haste for Garlemald.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_GRAHATIA_000_263: While circumstance and duty may keep us apart, we remain bound by common purpose.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_OCHERBOULDER_000_26: Indeed. May that purpose continue to guide us now that we stand together once again!
I hadn't seen Hoary for some time until today. Hopefully he gets a sense of the progress I've made since last we met!
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_TATARU_000_300: It seems everyone has much and more to discuss with one another!
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_TATARU_000_301: Anyway, you're overdue for a proper break! The peace and quiet will help you think.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_TATARU_000_302: Feel free to make yourself comfortable in Dawn's Respite!
